```ts
/**
 * User Interface dropdown menu â€” the Revit-style panel toggle menu.
 *
 * Renders a floating dropdown below the ribbon button. Each row is a
 * checkbox bound to a UiItem from modules/ui-registry. Two footer items
 * (Browser Organization, Keyboard Shortcuts) open small dialogs.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  listUiItems, loadStoredVisibility, persistItem,
  onUiRegistryChange, notifyUiChange,
} from "../modules/ui-registry";

let menuEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let anchorEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
let open = false;

const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

function buildMenu(): HTMLDivElement {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.id = "obs-user-interface-menu";
  el.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;z-index:9500;display:none;min-width:280px;" +
    "background:#1c1e28;color:#e8eaf0;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
    "border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 18px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.55);" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;padding:4px 0;user-select:none";
  el.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  return el;
}

function closeMenu(): void {
  if (!menuEl) return;
  menuEl.style.display = "none";
  open = false;
  anchorEl = null;
}

function positionMenu(anchor: HTMLElement): void {
  if (!menuEl) return;
  const rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
  const menuW = menuEl.offsetWidth || 280;
  let x = rect.left;
  let y = rect.bottom + 4;
  if (x + menuW > window.innerWidth - 8) x = window.innerWidth - menuW - 8;
  if (y + 380 > window.innerHeight - 8) y = rect.top - 380 - 4;
  menuEl.style.left = x + "px";
  menuEl.style.top = y + "px";
}

function renderRows(): void {
  if (!menuEl) return;
  menuEl.innerHTML = "";

  const stored = loadStoredVisibility();
  const items = listUiItems();

  for (const item of items) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;" +
      (item.available ? "" : "opacity:.4;cursor:default;");

    const cb = document.createElement("span");
    cb.style.cssText =
      "display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;" +
      "width:14px;height:14px;border:1px solid #4b5563;border-radius:3px;" +
      "background:transparent;flex:none;color:#0b0d12;font-weight:700;font-size:11px";

    const visible = item.available
      ? item.isVisible()
      : (stored[item.id] ?? false);
    if (visible) {
      cb.style.background = "#38bdf8";
      cb.style.borderColor = "#38bdf8";
      cb.textContent = "\u2713";
    }

    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.textContent = item.label;
    label.style.cssText = "flex:1;font-size:12.5px";

    row.append(cb, label);

    if (item.available) {
      row.onmouseenter = () => { row.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.14)"; };
      row.onmouseleave = () => { row.style.background = "transparent"; };
      row.onclick = () => {
        try {
          item.toggle();
          persistItem(item.id, item.isVisible());
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("[ui-menu] toggle failed", item.id, err);
        }
        renderRows();
      };
    } else {
      row.title = item.unavailableHint ?? "Coming soon";
      row.onmouseenter = () => { row.style.background = "transparent"; };
    }

    menuEl.appendChild(row);
  }

  // Separator
  const sep1 = document.createElement("div");
  sep1.style.cssText = "height:1px;background:#2a2e3a;margin:4px 0";
  menuEl.appendChild(sep1);

  // Footer: Browser Organization
  const bo = mkFooterRow("\u2630", "Browser Organization", () => {
    closeMenu();
    openBrowserOrganizationDialog();
  });
  menuEl.appendChild(bo);

  // Footer: Keyboard Shortcuts
  const ks = mkFooterRow("\u2328", "Keyboard Shortcuts", () => {
    closeMenu();
    openKeyboardShortcutsDialog();
  });
  menuEl.appendChild(ks);
}

function mkFooterRow(icon: string, label: string, onClick: () => void): HTMLElement {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 14px;cursor:pointer";
  const ic = document.createElement("span");
  ic.textContent = icon;
  ic.style.cssText = "width:16px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:#94a3b8";
  const tx = document.createElement("span");
  tx.textContent = label;
  tx.style.cssText = "flex:1;font-size:12.5px";
  row.append(ic, tx);
  row.onmouseenter = () => { row.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.14)"; };
  row.onmouseleave = () => { row.style.background = "transparent"; };
  row.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); };
  return row;
}

export function toggleUserInterfaceMenu(anchor: HTMLElement): void {
  if (open && anchorEl === anchor) {
    closeMenu();
    return;
  }
  if (!menuEl) menuEl = buildMenu();
  anchorEl = anchor;
  renderRows();
  menuEl.style.display = "block";
  positionMenu(anchor);
  open = true;

  setTimeout(() => {
    const docHandler = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!menuEl) return;
      const t = ev.target as Node;
      if (!menuEl.contains(t) && !anchor.contains(t)) {
        closeMenu();
        document.removeEventListener("mousedown", docHandler);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", docHandler);
  }, 0);
}

export function setupUserInterfaceMenu(): void {
  // Re-render on external visibility changes
  onUiRegistryChange(() => { if (open) renderRows(); });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && open) closeMenu();
  });

  (ctx.features as any).userInterfaceMenu = {
    toggle: (anchor: HTMLElement) => toggleUserInterfaceMenu(anchor),
    close: closeMenu,
    isOpen: () => open,
    refresh: () => { if (open) renderRows(); notifyUiChange(); },
  };
}

function ensureOverlay(): HTMLDivElement {
  let ov = document.getElementById("obs-ui-modal") as HTMLDivElement | null;
  if (ov) {
    ov.style.display = "flex";
    ov.innerHTML = "";
    return ov;
  }
  ov = document.createElement("div");
  ov.id = "obs-ui-modal";
  ov.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9600;display:flex;align-items:center;" +
    "justify-content:center;background:rgba(8,9,12,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)";
  ov.onmousedown = (e) => { if (e.target === ov) { ov!.style.display = "none"; } };
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
  return ov;
}

function showModal(title: string, rows: [string, string][], subtitle: string): void {
  const ov = ensureOverlay();
  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText =
    "width:min(520px,92vw);background:#1c1e28;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.65);font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;" +
    "overflow:hidden";

  header.innerHTML =
    "<div style='flex:1'>" +
      "<div style='font-weight:700;font-size:15px'>" + esc(title) + "</div>" +

  close.onclick = () => { ov.style.display = "none"; };
  header.appendChild(close);

  const body = document.createElement("div");
  body.style.cssText = "padding:14px 18px";
  for (const [k, v] of rows) {
    const r = document.createElement("div");
    r.style.cssText =

    vv.style.cssText = "color:#e8eaf0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600";
    r.append(kk, vv);
    body.appendChild(r);
  }

  const footer = document.createElement("div");
  footer.style.cssText =
    "padding:10px 18px;border-top:1px solid #2a2e3a;background:#181a23;" +

  ok.textContent = "Close";
  ok.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 16px;background:#38bdf8;color:#0b0d12;border:none;" +
    "border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 12px system-ui";
  ok.onclick = () => { ov.style.display = "none"; };
  footer.appendChild(ok);

  card.append(header, body, footer);
  ov.appendChild(card);
}

  close.style.cssText =

  for (const [k, v] of rows) {
    const r = document.createElement("div");
    r.style.cssText =
      "display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr;gap:12px;" +
      "padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #242734;align-items:center";
    const kk = document.createElement("kbd");
    kk.textContent = k;
    kk.style.cssText =
      "display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid #3a4050;" +
      "border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;background:#12141b;" +
      "color:#cbd5e1;font:11px ui-monospace,monospace;text-align:center";
    const vv = document.createElement("span");
    vv.textContent = v;
    vv.style.cssText = "color:#e8eaf0;font-size:12.5px";
    r.append(kk, vv);
    body.appendChild(r);
  }

  card.append(header, body);
  ov.appendChild(card);
}

function esc(s: string): string {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * ViewCube Pro — Revit-style orientation widget.
 *
 * Pick zones (26): 6 faces · 12 edges · 8 corners.
 * Right-click menu + bottom button row (Home · Fit · Roll ±90°).
 * Native projection only — no ortho/perspective toggle.
 * World north only — Project North / True North UI removed.
 *
 * All state-dependent initialization happens inside setupViewCube().
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  gotoDir, gotoExactView, fitAll, goHome, setProjection, getProjection,
} from "./camera-tools";

/** Revit: Project North angle (degrees, CCW from True/world +Z as Front). */
let projectNorthDeg = 0;
/** Active orientation mode for the compass & face clicks. */
let northMode: "project" | "true" = "project";

export function getProjectNorthDeg() { return projectNorthDeg; }
export function getNorthMode() { return northMode; }

export function setProjectNorthDeg(deg: number) {
  projectNorthDeg = ((deg % 360) + 360) % 360;
  updateNorthReadout();
}

export function setNorthMode(mode: "project" | "true") {
  northMode = mode;
  updateNorthReadout();
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: {
        message: mode === "project" ? "Orientation: Project North" : "Orientation: True North",
        kind: "info",
      },
    }));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

/** World-space +Z is FRONT at 0° True North. Project North rotates that. */
function northOffsetRad(): number {
  // Project / True North toggles removed — always world (true) north.
  return 0;
}

function applyNorthToDir(dir: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {
  const off = northOffsetRad();
  if (Math.abs(off) < 1e-8) return dir.clone().normalize();
  // Rotate around world Y (up)
  const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), off);
  return dir.clone().applyQuaternion(q).normalize();
}

function gotoDirOriented(dir: THREE.Vector3, _forceOrthoFace = true) {
  // Keep native projection; only orient the camera.
  gotoDir(applyNorthToDir(dir));
}

function updateNorthReadout() {
  try {
    const mode = northMode === "project" ? "PN" : "TN";
    const ang = Math.round(projectNorthDeg);
    readout.textContent = `${mode} ${ang}°`;
  } catch { /* */ }
}

const CUBE_PX = 148;
export const cubeHost = document.createElement("div");
cubeHost.style.display = "none";
cubeHost.style.cssText =
  `position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:${CUBE_PX}px;z-index:30;` +
  `user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none`;

const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
canvas.style.cssText = "display:block;cursor:grab;border-radius:8px";
cubeHost.appendChild(canvas);

const readout = document.createElement("div");
readout.style.cssText =
  "position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-18px;text-align:center;" +
  "font:10px ui-monospace, monospace;color:#94a3b8;letter-spacing:.4px";
readout.textContent = "";
cubeHost.appendChild(readout);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setSize(CUBE_PX, CUBE_PX);
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(42, 1, 0.1, 20);
cam.position.set(0, 0, 4.4);

/* ── Compass ring under the cube ─────────────────────────────────────── */
function makeTextSprite(text: string, color: string, size = 0.5): THREE.Sprite {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = 128;
  const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
  g.fillStyle = color;
  g.font = "700 72px system-ui, sans-serif";
  g.textAlign = "center";
  g.textBaseline = "middle";
  g.fillText(text, 64, 68);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  const spr = new THREE.Sprite(
    new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthTest: false }),
  );
  spr.scale.set(size, size, 1);
  spr.renderOrder = 50;
  return spr;
}

const compassGroup = new THREE.Group();
{
  const R = 2.35;
  const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(R - 0.02, R, 64);
  const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
    color: 0x38bdf8, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthTest: false,
  });
  const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
  ring.renderOrder = 40;
  compassGroup.add(ring);

  const dirs: [string, number, number, string][] = [
    ["N", 0, 1, "#22c55e"],
    ["S", 0, -1, "#ef4444"],
    ["E", 1, 0, "#38bdf8"],
    ["W", -1, 0, "#f59e0b"],
  ];
  for (const [label, x, y, color] of dirs) {
    const spr = makeTextSprite(label, color, 0.55);
    spr.position.set(x * R, y * R, 0.01);
    compassGroup.add(spr);
  }
}
scene.add(compassGroup);

/* ── Cube ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function makeFaceTexture(text: string, bg: string): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = 128;
  const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
  g.fillStyle = bg;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  g.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,70,85,.55)";
  g.lineWidth = 5;
  g.strokeRect(3, 3, 122, 122);
  g.fillStyle = "#1c2430";
  g.font = "700 22px system-ui, Segoe UI, sans-serif";
  g.textAlign = "center";
  g.textBaseline = "middle";
  g.fillText(text, 64, 64);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  tex.anisotropy = 4;
  return tex;
}

const faceDefs = [
  { dir: new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), label: "RIGHT", bg: "#d7dbe0" },
  { dir: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), label: "LEFT", bg: "#d7dbe0" },
  { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), label: "TOP", bg: "#eef1f5" },
  { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), label: "BOTTOM", bg: "#b7bec7" },
  { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), label: "FRONT", bg: "#d7dbe0" },
  { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1), label: "BACK", bg: "#d7dbe0" },
];

const cubeFaceMeshes: THREE.Mesh[] = [];
const cubeGroup = new THREE.Group();
{
  const size = 1.7;
  const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
  const mats = faceDefs.map((f) =>
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeFaceTexture(f.label, f.bg) }),
  );
  const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats);
  cubeGroup.add(cube);
  cubeFaceMeshes.push(cube);
  const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
    new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geo),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x6b7280 }),
  );
  cubeGroup.add(edges);
}
scene.add(cubeGroup);

/* ── 26-zone picking ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
type Zone =
  | { kind: "face"; dir: THREE.Vector3 }
  | { kind: "edge"; a: THREE.Vector3; b: THREE.Vector3 }
  | { kind: "corner"; a: THREE.Vector3; b: THREE.Vector3; c: THREE.Vector3 };

const EDGE_MARGIN = 0.25;

function classifyHit(mesh: THREE.Mesh, pointLocalToMesh: THREE.Vector3, faceNormal: THREE.Vector3): Zone {
  const n = faceNormal.clone().normalize();
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  let right = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(up, n);
  if (right.lengthSq() < 0.01) right = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);
  right.normalize();
  const upOnFace = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n, right).normalize();

  const p = pointLocalToMesh.clone();
  const u = p.dot(right);
  const v = p.dot(upOnFace);

  const params: any = (mesh.geometry as any)?.parameters ?? {};
  const half = ((params.width as number) ?? 1.7) / 2;
  const limit = half * (1 - EDGE_MARGIN);

  const nearU = Math.abs(u) > limit;
  const nearV = Math.abs(v) > limit;

  if (nearU && nearV) {
    return {
      kind: "corner",
      a: n.clone(),
      b: right.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sign(u)),
      c: upOnFace.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sign(v)),
    };
  }
  if (nearU) return { kind: "edge", a: n.clone(), b: right.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sign(u)) };
  if (nearV) return { kind: "edge", a: n.clone(), b: upOnFace.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sign(v)) };
  return { kind: "face", dir: n.clone() };
}

function zoneToDir(zone: Zone): THREE.Vector3 {
  if (zone.kind === "face") return zone.dir.clone().normalize();
  if (zone.kind === "edge") return zone.a.clone().add(zone.b).normalize();
  return zone.a.clone().add(zone.b).add(zone.c).normalize();
}

function zoneLabel(zone: Zone): string {
  const d = zoneToDir(zone);
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (d.y > 0.4) parts.push("Top");
  else if (d.y < -0.4) parts.push("Bottom");
  if (d.z > 0.4) parts.push("Front");
  else if (d.z < -0.4) parts.push("Back");
  if (d.x > 0.4) parts.push("Right");
  else if (d.x < -0.4) parts.push("Left");
  return parts.join("-") || "View";
}

const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const ndc = new THREE.Vector2();

function ndcOf(e: MouseEvent): THREE.Vector2 {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return new THREE.Vector2(
    ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 2 - 1,
    -((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 2 + 1,
  );
}

function pickZone(e: MouseEvent): { zone: Zone; label: string } | null {
  ndc.copy(ndcOf(e));
  raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, cam);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(cubeFaceMeshes, false);
  if (!hits.length || !hits[0].face) return null;
  const hit = hits[0];
  const mesh = hit.object as THREE.Mesh;

  const local = hit.point.clone();
  mesh.worldToLocal(local);

  if (!hit.face) return null;
  const worldNormal = hit.face.normal.clone().transformDirection(mesh.matrixWorld);
  let bestDir = faceDefs[0].dir;
  let bestDot = -2;
  for (const f of faceDefs) {
    const d = f.dir.dot(worldNormal);
    if (d > bestDot) { bestDot = d; bestDir = f.dir; }
  }

  const zone = classifyHit(mesh, local, bestDir);
  return { zone, label: zoneLabel(zone) };
}

/* ── Hover + cursor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function setHover(on: boolean) {
  canvas.style.cursor = on ? "pointer" : cubeDragging ? "grabbing" : "grab";
}

/* ── Drag-orbit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
let cubeDragging = false;
let cubeDown: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;

/* ── Click ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function onClick(e: MouseEvent) {
  const pick = pickZone(e);
  if (!pick) return;
  if (pick.zone.kind === "face") {
    const d = pick.zone.dir;
    if (d.y > 0.9) return gotoExactView("top");
    if (d.y < -0.9) return gotoExactView("bottom");
    if (d.z > 0.9) return gotoExactView("front");
    if (d.z < -0.9) return gotoExactView("back");
    if (d.x > 0.9) return gotoExactView("right");
    if (d.x < -0.9) return gotoExactView("left");
  }
  gotoDirOriented(zoneToDir(pick.zone), false);
}

/* ── Roll camera around view axis ────────────────────────────────────── */
function rollCamera(angle: number) {
  try {
    const cam3 = ctx.world.camera.three;
    const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
    const target = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (controls?.target?.isVector3) target.copy(controls.target);
    else target.set(0, 0, 0);

    const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(target, cam3.position).normalize();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(dir, angle);
    const up = cam3.up.clone().applyQuaternion(q);
    cam3.up.copy(up);

    const pos = cam3.position.clone();
    if (controls && typeof controls.setLookAt === "function") {
      controls.setLookAt(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, target.x, target.y, target.z, true);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[viewcube] roll failed", err);
  }
}

/* ── Right-click menu ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const cubeMenu = document.createElement("div");
cubeMenu.style.cssText =
  "position:fixed;z-index:9000;display:none;min-width:190px;" +
  "background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
  "border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55);padding:4px 0;" +
  "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0)";
document.body.appendChild(cubeMenu);

function menuItem(label: string, onclick: () => void, kbd = "") {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap";
  row.onmouseenter = () => (row.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,0.14)");
  row.onmouseleave = () => (row.style.background = "transparent");
  row.innerHTML =
    `<span style="flex:1">${label}</span>` +
    (kbd ? `<span style="font:10px ui-monospace, monospace;opacity:.55">${kbd}</span>` : "");
  row.onclick = () => { cubeMenu.style.display = "none"; onclick(); };
  return row;
}

function menuSep() {
  const d = document.createElement("div");
  d.style.cssText = "height:1px;background:var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);margin:4px 8px";
  return d;
}

function openCubeMenu(e: MouseEvent) {
  cubeMenu.innerHTML = "";
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("🏠  Home", () => goHome(), "H"));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("⛶  Fit to View", () => fitAll(), "F"));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuSep());
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("⟲  Roll Left 90°", () => rollCamera(-Math.PI / 2)));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("⟳  Roll Right 90°", () => rollCamera(Math.PI / 2)));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuSep());
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("Top", () => gotoExactView("top")));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("Bottom", () => gotoExactView("bottom")));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("Front", () => gotoExactView("front")));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("Back", () => gotoExactView("back")));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("Right", () => gotoExactView("right")));
  cubeMenu.appendChild(menuItem("Left", () => gotoExactView("left")));
  cubeMenu.style.left = `${e.clientX}px`;
  cubeMenu.style.top = `${e.clientY}px`;
  cubeMenu.style.display = "block";

  const close = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
    if (!cubeMenu.contains(ev.target as Node)) {
      cubeMenu.style.display = "none";
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", close, true);
    }
  };
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", close, true);
}

/* ── Bottom button row ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const btnRow = document.createElement("div");
btnRow.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:4px;justify-content:center";
cubeHost.appendChild(btnRow);

const btnCss =
  "flex:1;font:600 10px system-ui;padding:5px 0;background:#22232c;color:#cbd5e1;" +
  "border:1px solid #3a3a4a;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s";

const homeBtn = document.createElement("button");
homeBtn.textContent = "⌂";
homeBtn.title = "Home view (H)";
homeBtn.style.cssText = btnCss;
homeBtn.onclick = () => goHome();

const fitBtn = document.createElement("button");
fitBtn.textContent = "⛶";
fitBtn.title = "Fit to view (F)";
fitBtn.style.cssText = btnCss;
fitBtn.onclick = () => fitAll();

const rollL = document.createElement("button");
rollL.textContent = "⟲";
rollL.title = "Roll left 90°";
rollL.style.cssText = btnCss;
rollL.onclick = () => rollCamera(-Math.PI / 2);

const rollR = document.createElement("button");
rollR.textContent = "⟳";
rollR.title = "Roll right 90°";
rollR.style.cssText = btnCss;
rollR.onclick = () => rollCamera(Math.PI / 2);

const projBtn = document.createElement("button");
projBtn.title = "Toggle Perspective / Orthographic";
projBtn.style.cssText = btnCss + ";flex:2";

function updateProjectionButton() {
  // Guard: this may be called before the viewer is up.
  let p: "perspective" | "orthographic" = "perspective";
  try { p = getProjection(); } catch { /* */ }
  projBtn.textContent = p === "perspective" ? "PERSP" : "ORTHO";
  projBtn.style.borderColor = p === "perspective" ? "#3a3a4a" : "#38bdf8";
  projBtn.style.color = p === "perspective" ? "#cbd5e1" : "#38bdf8";
}

projBtn.onclick = () => { /* projection toggle removed — native only */ };

const northBtn = document.createElement("button");
northBtn.title = "Toggle Project North / True North (Revit)";
northBtn.style.cssText = btnCss + ";flex:2";
northBtn.onclick = () => { /* north toggle removed */ };
function updateNorthButton() {
  northBtn.textContent = northMode === "project" ? "PN" : "TN";
  northBtn.style.borderColor = northMode === "project" ? "#22c55e" : "#38bdf8";
  northBtn.style.color = northMode === "project" ? "#86efac" : "#7dd3fc";
}
updateNorthButton();

btnRow.append(homeBtn, fitBtn, rollL, rollR);

/* ── Event listeners on the cube ─────────────────────────────────────── */
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
  if (e.button === 2) return;
  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  e.stopPropagation();
  cubeDragging = true;
  cubeDown = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
  canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  canvas.style.cursor = "grabbing";
});

canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  if (cubeDragging && cubeDown) {
    const dx = e.clientX - cubeDown.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - cubeDown.y;
    cubeDown = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    const c: any = ctx.world.camera?.controls;
    try {
      if (typeof c?.rotate === "function") c.rotate(dx * 0.008, -dy * 0.008);
      else if (typeof c?.rotateLeft === "function") {
        c.rotateLeft(dx * 0.008);
        c.rotateUp(-dy * 0.008);
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    return;
  }
  const pick = pickZone(e);
  setHover(!!pick);
  readout.textContent = pick ? pick.label : "";
});

canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => {
  if (e.button !== 0 || !cubeDragging) return;
  e.stopPropagation();
  cubeDragging = false;
  canvas.style.cursor = "grab";
  const moved = cubeDown ? Math.hypot(e.clientX - cubeDown.x, e.clientY - cubeDown.y) : 0;
  cubeDown = null;
  if (moved < 5) onClick(e);
});

canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
  if (!cubeDragging) setHover(false);
  readout.textContent = "";
});

canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); fitAll(); });

canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  openCubeMenu(e);
});

/* ── Setup (ViewCube removed from platform) ───────────────────────────── */
export function setupViewCube() {
  // Do not mount or animate the cube.
  try {
    cubeHost.style.display = "none";
    cubeHost.remove();
  } catch { /* */ }

  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[viewcube] renderer dispose failed", err);
  }

    ctx.features.viewcube = {

    rollRight: () => { /* removed */ },
    setProjectNorth: setProjectNorthDeg,
    getProjectNorth: getProjectNorthDeg,

    getNorthMode,
  };
  console.log("[viewcube] disabled — 3D cube not shown");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * View / graphics control layer.
 *
 * Provides persistent presentation presets that act on the current Three.js
 * scene, including loaded Fragments and native authored geometry when their
 * materials expose the standard Three.js graphics properties.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

export type VisualPreset = "shaded" | "shaded-edges" | "wireframe" | "hidden-line";
export type BackgroundPreset = "studio" | "paper" | "night";

let visualPreset: VisualPreset = "shaded";
let sceneTransparency = 0;
let sunEnabled = true;
let background: BackgroundPreset = "studio";

const original = new Map<THREE.Material, {
  opacity: number;
  transparent: boolean;
  wireframe?: boolean;
  depthWrite?: boolean;
  color?: THREE.Color;
}>();
let tracked = false;

function remember(mat: THREE.Material): void {
  if (original.has(mat)) return;
  const m = mat as THREE.Material & { wireframe?: boolean; depthWrite?: boolean; color?: THREE.Color };
  original.set(mat, {
    opacity: m.opacity,
    transparent: m.transparent,
    wireframe: m.wireframe,
    depthWrite: m.depthWrite,
    color: m.color?.clone?.(),
  });
}

function eachMaterial(cb: (mat: THREE.Material) => void): void {
  if (!ctx.world?.scene?.three) return;
  ctx.world.scene.three.traverse((obj: any) => {
    if (!obj?.isMesh || !obj.material) return;
    const mats = Array.isArray(obj.material) ? obj.material : [obj.material];
    for (const mat of mats) {
      if (!mat) continue;
      remember(mat);
      cb(mat as THREE.Material);
    }
  });
  tracked = true;
}

export function setVisualPreset(preset: VisualPreset): void {
  visualPreset = preset;
  eachMaterial((mat) => {
    const m = mat as THREE.Material & { wireframe?: boolean; depthWrite?: boolean };
    const base = original.get(mat);
    if (!base) return;
    if (preset === "wireframe") {
      if (typeof m.wireframe === "boolean") m.wireframe = true;
      m.transparent = true;
      m.opacity = Math.max(0.35, 1 - sceneTransparency / 100);
    } else if (preset === "hidden-line") {
      if (typeof m.wireframe === "boolean") m.wireframe = false;
      m.transparent = true;
      m.opacity = Math.max(0.18, 0.78 - sceneTransparency / 120);
      m.depthWrite = false;
    } else {
      if (typeof m.wireframe === "boolean") m.wireframe = false;
      m.transparent = sceneTransparency > 0 || base.transparent;
      m.opacity = sceneTransparency > 0 ? (1 - sceneTransparency / 100) : base.opacity;
      m.depthWrite = base.depthWrite ?? true;
    }
    m.needsUpdate = true;
  });
}

export function getVisualPreset(): VisualPreset { return visualPreset; }

export function setSceneTransparency(value: number): void {
  sceneTransparency = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(value) || 0));
  setVisualPreset(visualPreset);
}

export function getSceneTransparency(): number { return sceneTransparency; }

export function setSunEnabled(on: boolean): void {
  sunEnabled = !!on;
  if (!ctx.world?.scene?.three) return;
  ctx.world.scene.three.traverse((obj: any) => {
    if (obj?.isDirectionalLight) obj.visible = sunEnabled;
  });
}

export function isSunEnabled(): boolean { return sunEnabled; }

export function setSceneBackground(preset: BackgroundPreset): void {
  background = preset;
  if (!ctx.world?.scene?.three) return;
  const color = preset === "paper" ? 0xf3f4f6 : preset === "night" ? 0x05070b : 0x0f1117;
  ctx.world.scene.three.background = new THREE.Color(color);
}

export function getSceneBackground(): BackgroundPreset { return background; }

export function refreshViewGraphics(): void {
  if (!ctx.world?.scene?.three) return;
  setSceneBackground(background);
  setSunEnabled(sunEnabled);
  if (tracked) setVisualPreset(visualPreset);
}
```

```ts
    "display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px";
  statusLine = document.createElement("span");
  statusLine.style.cssText = "font:11px system-ui;color:#94a3b8;flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
  statusLine.textContent = "Pick a view on the left, then click inside the drawing area.";
  const hintText = document.createElement("span");
  hintText.style.cssText = "font:10.5px system-ui;color:#6b7280;white-space:nowrap";
  hintText.textContent = "Drag the title bar to move";
  footer.append(statusLine, hintText);

  panel.append(header, toolbar, body, footer);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);

  dock = makeDockable(panel, {
    id: "obs-views-panel",
    host: ctx.rightHost,
    header,
    minWidth: 500,
    minHeight: 380,
    defaultDock: "right",
    defaultWidth: 720,
    defaultHeight: 640,
  });

  onViewsChange(() => { if (visible) render(); });
  onAnnotationChange(() => { if (visible) void renderCurrent(); });

  refreshToolbar();

  (ctx.features as any).viewsPanel = {
    toggle: toggleViewsPanel,
    open: openViewsPanel,
    close: closeViewsPanel,
    isVisible: () => visible,
  };
}

function render(): void {
  if (!panel || !sidebar) return;
  const views = listViews();
  sidebar.innerHTML = "";
  for (const v of views) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    const active = v.id === currentViewId;
    row.style.cssText =
      "padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid #1a1d27;" +
      (active ? "background:#16233a;color:#38bdf8;" : "color:#cbd5e1;");
    row.textContent = v.name + "  (" + v.kind + ")";
    row.onclick = () => { currentViewId = v.id; void renderCurrent(); render(); };

    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.textContent = "x";
    del.style.cssText =
      "float:right;background:transparent;color:#fca5a5;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;padding:0 4px";
    del.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (confirm('Delete "' + v.name + '"?')) {
        deleteView(v.id);
        if (currentViewId === v.id) currentViewId = null;
        render();
      }
    };
    row.appendChild(del);
    sidebar.appendChild(row);
  }
  if (!currentViewId && views.length) {
    currentViewId = views[0].id;
    void renderCurrent();
  } else if (currentViewId) {
    void renderCurrent();
  }
}

async function renderCurrent(): Promise<void> {
  if (!canvasHost || !currentViewId) return;
  const view: ViewDef | null = getView(currentViewId);
  if (!view) return;

  let scene: Scene2D;
  if (view.kind === "plan" || view.kind === "rcp") scene = await generatePlanScene(view);
  else if (view.kind === "section") scene = await generateSectionScene(view);
  else if (view.kind === "elevation") scene = await generateElevationScene(view);
  else scene = emptyScene();

  const annotation = buildAnnotationLayer(view.id, view.scale);
  scene.layers.annotation = annotation.entities;

  canvasHost.innerHTML = "";
  const svg = renderSceneToSvg(scene, {
    scale: view.scale,
    padding: 3,
    widthPx: canvasHost.clientWidth || 800,
    heightPx: canvasHost.clientHeight || 600,
  });
  svg.style.cssText =
    "width:100%;height:100%;background:#f8fafc;display:block;cursor:crosshair";
  canvasHost.appendChild(svg);

  svg.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height || !vb.width) return;
    const px = ((ev.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * vb.width + vb.x;
    const py = ((ev.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * vb.height + vb.y;
    const worldX = px;
    const worldZ = -py;
    const worldTol = (vb.width / rect.width) * 8;
    const result = toolState.click(worldX, worldZ, view.id, view.scale, worldTol, view.kind);
    if (result.newSectionViewId) {
      currentViewId = result.newSectionViewId;
      toolState.setTool("select");
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (result.created) {
      void renderCurrent();
    }
    if (result.feedback) {
      setStatus(result.feedback, result.created ? "success" : "info");
    }
    refreshToolbar();
  });

  svg.addEventListener("mousemove", (ev) => {
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
    if (!rect.width || !vb.width) return;
    const px = ((ev.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * vb.width + vb.x;
    const py = ((ev.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * vb.height + vb.y;
    const z = -py;
    setStatus(
      "Cursor: X " + px.toFixed(2) + "  Z " + z.toFixed(2) + " m  -  " + toolState.getHint(),
      "info",
    );
  });
}

export function toggleViewsPanel(): void {
  visible = !visible;
  if (dock) {
    if (visible) dock.show(); else dock.hide();
  } else if (panel) {
    panel.style.display = visible ? "flex" : "none";
  }
  if (visible) render();
}

export function openViewsPanel(): void {
  visible = true;
  if (dock) dock.show();
  else if (panel) panel.style.display = "flex";
  render();
}

export function closeViewsPanel(): void {
  visible = false;
  if (dock) dock.hide();
  else if (panel) panel.style.display = "none";
}

export function isViewsPanelVisible(): boolean {
  return visible;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Walk mode — first-person navigation.
 *
 * Controls:
 *   W A S D     — move
 *   Mouse       — look (pointer lock)
 *   Shift       — run
 *   Ctrl        — crouch
 *   Space       — raise
 *   C           — lower
 *   Esc         — exit
 *
 * The camera in @thatopen/components is driven by `CameraControls`. Simply
 * assigning `camera.position` is not enough — the controls overwrite the
 * camera on their next update tick. We therefore drive the controls via
 * `controls.setLookAt()` on every frame; the controls then place the camera
 * for us and the renderer respects the new position.
 *
 * Ctrl/Alt/Meta combos are passed through to the shortcut registry so global
 * shortcuts (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z…) keep working while walking. Only the movement
 * keys are captured exclusively.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { getLevel } from "./authoring";
import { getProjection, setProjection } from "./camera-tools";

// ── Tuning ──
const EYE_HEIGHT = 1.7;
const CROUCH_HEIGHT = 1.1;
const WALK_SPEED = 3.2;
const RUN_SPEED = 9.0;
const CROUCH_SPEED = 1.4;
const ACCEL = 12.0;
const LOOK_SENS = 0.0022;
const PITCH_LIMIT = Math.PI / 2 - 0.08;
const RAYCAST_INTERVAL = 6;      // frames between ground raycasts
const GROUND_SMOOTH = 12.0;      // Y-follow smoothing
const TARGET_DISTANCE = 5.0;     // metres in front of the eye for the controls target
const GROUND_RAY_LENGTH = 500;   // how far down to look for the ground

interface SavedCamState {
  projection: "perspective" | "orthographic";
  controlsEnabled: boolean;
  position: THREE.Vector3;
  target: THREE.Vector3;
  fov: number;
}

interface WalkState {
  enabled: boolean;
  pos: THREE.Vector3;
  vel: THREE.Vector3;
  yaw: number;
  pitch: number;
  keys: Set<string>;
  targetGroundY: number;
  raycastTick: number;
  rafId: number | null;
  lastT: number;
  saved: SavedCamState | null;
}

const state: WalkState = {
  enabled: false,
  pos: new THREE.Vector3(),
  vel: new THREE.Vector3(),
  yaw: 0,
  pitch: 0,
  keys: new Set(),
  targetGroundY: 0,
  raycastTick: 0,
  rafId: null,
  lastT: 0,
  saved: null,
};

/** Keys walk mode owns exclusively — captured before the shortcut registry. */
const OWNED_KEYS = new Set([
  "w", "a", "s", "d",
  "arrowup", "arrowdown", "arrowleft", "arrowright",
  "shift", "control",
  " ", "c",
]);

const groundRay = new THREE.Raycaster();

// ── HUD ──
let overlay: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let crosshair: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let hint: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let exitBtn: HTMLButtonElement | null = null;

function ensureOverlay(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (overlay) return overlay;

  overlay = document.createElement("div");
  overlay.id = "obs-walk-overlay";
  overlay.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:60;cursor:none;background:transparent;" +
    "user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none";

  crosshair = document.createElement("div");
  crosshair.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:14px;height:14px;" +
    "transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;opacity:.9";
  crosshair.innerHTML =
    `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">` +
    `<line x1="7" y1="1" x2="7" y2="5" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.85)" stroke-width="1.4"/>` +
    `<line x1="7" y1="9" x2="7" y2="13" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.85)" stroke-width="1.4"/>` +
    `<line x1="1" y1="7" x2="5" y2="7" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.85)" stroke-width="1.4"/>` +
    `<line x1="9" y1="7" x2="13" y2="7" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.85)" stroke-width="1.4"/>` +
    `<circle cx="7" cy="7" r="1" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.9)"/>` +
    `</svg>`;

  hint = document.createElement("div");
  hint.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;left:50%;top:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);" +
    "background:rgba(20,22,30,.85);border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.35);" +
    "border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font:11.5px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;" +
    "color:#e8eaf0;white-space:nowrap;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);" +
    "box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4)";
  const kbd = (t: string) =>
    `<kbd style="padding:1px 5px;border:1px solid #3d4250;border-radius:3px;font:10px monospace">${t}</kbd>`;
  hint.innerHTML =
    `<b style="color:#38bdf8">WALK</b> · ` +
    `${kbd("W")}${kbd("A")}${kbd("S")}${kbd("D")} move · ` +
    `${kbd("Shift")} run · ${kbd("Ctrl")} crouch · ` +
    `${kbd("Space")}/${kbd("C")} up/down · ` +
    `${kbd("Esc")} exit · ` +
    `<span style="opacity:.65">Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Z still work</span>`;

  exitBtn = document.createElement("button");
  exitBtn.textContent = "Exit walk mode  (Esc)";
  exitBtn.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:14px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;" +
    "background:rgba(20,22,30,.9);color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.6);border-radius:6px;" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)";
  exitBtn.onclick = () => disableWalkMode();

  overlay.append(crosshair, hint, exitBtn);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(overlay);
  return overlay;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Ground raycast — find the surface below a given (x, z)
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function getWalkTargets(): THREE.Object3D[] {
  const out: THREE.Object3D[] = [];
  try {
    for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      if (model?.object) out.push(model.object);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  if (ctx.groundPlane) out.push(ctx.groundPlane);
  return out;
}

function raycastGround(x: number, z: number, fromY: number): number | null {
  const origin = new THREE.Vector3(x, fromY, z);
  groundRay.set(origin, new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0));
  groundRay.far = GROUND_RAY_LENGTH;
  const targets = getWalkTargets();
  if (!targets.length) return null;
  try {
    const hits = groundRay.intersectObjects(targets, true);
    for (const h of hits) {
      if (h.point.y < fromY - 0.02) return h.point.y;
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return null;
}

function updateGroundTarget() {
  const found = raycastGround(state.pos.x, state.pos.z, state.pos.y + 0.6);
  if (found != null) {
    state.targetGroundY = found;
    return;
  }
  // No surface — keep the last known ground; if we never had one, use level.
  if (!Number.isFinite(state.targetGroundY)) {
    state.targetGroundY = (() => { try { return getLevel(); } catch { return 0; } })();
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public API
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function isWalkModeEnabled(): boolean {
  return state.enabled;
}

export function enableWalkMode(): void {
  if (state.enabled) return;

  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;

  // ── Save camera + controls state ──
  const savedPos = cam.position.clone();
  let savedTarget = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (controls?.target?.isVector3) {
    savedTarget.copy(controls.target);
  } else {
    // Fallback: 5 m in front of camera.
    const d = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(d);
    savedTarget.copy(savedPos).add(d.multiplyScalar(TARGET_DISTANCE));
  }

  state.saved = {
    projection: getProjection(),
    controlsEnabled: !!controls?.enabled,
    position: savedPos,
    target: savedTarget,
    fov: cam.fov ?? 60,
  };

  // ── Force perspective for a natural walking FOV ──
  if (getProjection() !== "perspective") {
    try { setProjection("perspective"); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  cam.fov = 72;
  cam.updateProjectionMatrix();

  // ── Derive initial yaw / pitch from the current view direction ──
  const viewDir = savedTarget.clone().sub(savedPos).normalize();
  state.pitch = Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(viewDir.y, -1, 1));
  state.yaw = Math.atan2(-viewDir.x, -viewDir.z);

  // ── Position: keep the current XZ, snap Y to the ground under us ──
  state.pos.set(savedPos.x, savedPos.y, savedPos.z);
  const levelFallback = savedPos.y - EYE_HEIGHT;
  const groundHit = raycastGround(savedPos.x, savedPos.z, savedPos.y + 2);
  state.targetGroundY = groundHit ?? levelFallback;
  state.pos.y = state.targetGroundY + EYE_HEIGHT;
  state.vel.set(0, 0, 0);
  state.keys.clear();

  // ── Show HUD, lock pointer ──
  const ov = ensureOverlay();
  ov.style.display = "block";
  state.enabled = true;
  state.lastT = performance.now();
  state.raycastTick = 0;

  try { ov.requestPointerLock(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[walk] pointer lock failed", e); }

  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

  try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:walk-mode-changed", { detail: true })); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function disableWalkMode(): void {
  if (!state.enabled) return;
  state.enabled = false;

  if (state.rafId != null) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    state.rafId = null;
  }

  try {
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();
  } catch { /* */ }

  // ── Restore camera + controls via setLookAt so the controls accept the value ──
  const saved = state.saved;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
  if (saved) {
    if (controls && typeof controls.setLookAt === "function") {
      try {
        controls.setLookAt(
          saved.position.x, saved.position.y, saved.position.z,
          saved.target.x, saved.target.y, saved.target.z,
          false,
        );
      } catch { /* */ }
    } else {
      // Fallback: set camera directly and hope the controls tolerate it.
      cam.position.copy(saved.position);
      cam.lookAt(saved.target);
    }
    cam.fov = saved.fov;
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    if (controls) controls.enabled = saved.controlsEnabled;
    if (saved.projection !== "perspective") {
      try { setProjection(saved.projection); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }
  state.saved = null;
  state.keys.clear();

  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = "none";

  try { ctx.fragments.core.update(true); } catch { /* */ }

  try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:walk-mode-changed", { detail: false })); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function toggleWalkMode(): void {
  state.enabled ? disableWalkMode() : enableWalkMode();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Keyboard — exclusive over movement keys, transparent to modifier combos
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!state.enabled) return;

  const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
  if (t) {
    const tag = t.tagName?.toLowerCase();
    if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || t.isContentEditable) return;
  }

  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();

  // Modifier combos (Ctrl/Alt/Meta + another key) belong to the app.
  // Ctrl alone is captured below (crouch).
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) && k !== "control" && k !== "meta" && k !== "alt") {
    return;
  }

  if (k === "escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    disableWalkMode();
    return;
  }

  if (OWNED_KEYS.has(k)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    state.keys.add(k === " " ? "space" : k);
  }
}

function onKeyUp(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  state.keys.delete(k === " " ? "space" : k);
}

function onPointerMove(e: MouseEvent) {
  if (!state.enabled) return;
  if (!document.pointerLockElement) return;
  state.yaw -= e.movementX * LOOK_SENS;
  state.pitch -= e.movementY * LOOK_SENS;
  state.pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(state.pitch, -PITCH_LIMIT, PITCH_LIMIT);
}

function onPointerLockChange() {
  if (!state.enabled) return;
  if (document.pointerLockElement !== overlay) disableWalkMode();
}

function onPointerLockError() {
  console.warn("[walk] pointer lock rejected — WASD still works, mouse-look disabled");
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Main loop — drives the controls via setLookAt
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function tick(now: number) {
  if (!state.enabled) return;
  const dt = Math.min((now - state.lastT) / 1000, 0.05);
  state.lastT = now;

  // ── Movement basis (yaw only) ──
  const forward = new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(state.yaw), 0, -Math.cos(state.yaw));
  const right = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(state.yaw), 0, -Math.sin(state.yaw));

  const input = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (state.keys.has("w") || state.keys.has("arrowup")) input.add(forward);
  if (state.keys.has("s") || state.keys.has("arrowdown")) input.sub(forward);
  if (state.keys.has("d") || state.keys.has("arrowright")) input.add(right);
  if (state.keys.has("a") || state.keys.has("arrowleft")) input.sub(right);
  if (input.lengthSq() > 0) input.normalize();

  const running = state.keys.has("shift");
  const crouching = state.keys.has("control");
  const speed = crouching ? CROUCH_SPEED : running ? RUN_SPEED : WALK_SPEED;
  const targetVel = input.multiplyScalar(speed);

  const alpha = 1 - Math.exp(-ACCEL * dt);
  state.vel.lerp(targetVel, alpha);

  state.pos.x += state.vel.x * dt;
  state.pos.z += state.vel.z * dt;

  // Manual vertical (Space / C) overrides ground-follow this frame.
  const manualVertical = state.keys.has("space") || state.keys.has("c");
  if (state.keys.has("space")) state.pos.y += 2.4 * dt;
  if (state.keys.has("c")) state.pos.y -= 2.4 * dt;

  // Ground-follow raycast every N frames.
  state.raycastTick = (state.raycastTick + 1) % RAYCAST_INTERVAL;
  if (state.raycastTick === 0) updateGroundTarget();

  const eyeH = crouching ? CROUCH_HEIGHT : EYE_HEIGHT;
  if (!manualVertical) {
    const targetY = state.targetGroundY + eyeH;
    state.pos.y += (targetY - state.pos.y) * Math.min(1, GROUND_SMOOTH * dt);
  }

  // ── Camera look direction from yaw/pitch ──
  const look = new THREE.Vector3(
    -Math.sin(state.yaw) * Math.cos(state.pitch),
    Math.sin(state.pitch),
    -Math.cos(state.yaw) * Math.cos(state.pitch),
  );
  const target = state.pos.clone().add(look.clone().multiplyScalar(TARGET_DISTANCE));

  // ── Drive the controls — this is what makes the camera actually move ──
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;

  if (controls && typeof controls.setLookAt === "function") {
    try {
      controls.setLookAt(
        state.pos.x, state.pos.y, state.pos.z,
        target.x, target.y, target.z,
        false,   // no transition — apply immediately
      );
    } catch (e) {
      // If the controls reject, fall through and set the camera manually.
      cam.position.copy(state.pos);
      cam.lookAt(target);
    }
  } else {
    cam.position.copy(state.pos);
    cam.lookAt(target);
  }

  // Keep Fragments in sync with the new camera.
  try { ctx.fragments.core.update(false); } catch { /* */ }

  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupWalkMode(): void {
  window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown, true);
  window.addEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp, true);
  window.addEventListener("mousemove", onPointerMove);
  document.addEventListener("pointerlockchange", onPointerLockChange);
  document.addEventListener("pointerlockerror", onPointerLockError);

  ctx.features.walkMode = {
    isEnabled: isWalkModeEnabled,
    enable: enableWalkMode,
    disable: disableWalkMode,
    toggle: toggleWalkMode,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Revit-style wall shape handles.
 *
 * When a single wall (or beam / duct / pipe / tray / conduit) is selected:
 *   - Two large blue circles appear at each end (shape handles)
 *   - Two flip arrows appear at the midpoint
 *   - Dragging a shape handle stretches / shrinks the element on the ground
 *   - A temporary dimension appears live while dragging
 *   - Endpoints snap to other wall endpoints within tolerance
 *
 * The overlay is HTML/SVG on top of the canvas, so handles are pixel-sized
 * regardless of camera distance. This matches Revit's presentation exactly.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture } from "../core/input-router";
import { history } from "./history";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";
import { units } from "../core/units";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../modules/projects/types";

const HANDLE_RADIUS_PX = 8;
const HANDLE_HIT_RADIUS_PX = 12;
const FLIP_HIT_RADIUS_PX = 16;
const SNAP_SCREEN_TOL_PX = 14;
const DIM_OFFSET_PX = 30;

const WALL_LIKE_TYPES = new Set<string>([
  "wall", "beam", "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit", "strip", "mline",
]);

interface ActiveWall { id: string; el: AuthoredElement; }
interface ScreenPt { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean; }
interface HandlePositions { start: ScreenPt | null; end: ScreenPt | null; mid: ScreenPt | null; }

interface DragState {
  wallId: string;
  which: "start" | "end";
  baseline: AuthoredElement["params"];
  groundY: number;
  currentWorld: { x: number; z: number };
  snapTarget: { x: number; z: number } | null;
}

class WallHandlesManager {
  private wrap: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private svg: SVGSVGElement | null = null;
  private dimG: SVGGElement | null = null;
  private hG: SVGGElement | null = null;
  private drag: DragState | null = null;
  private handlePos: HandlePositions = { start: null, end: null, mid: null };
  private unsubGesture: (() => void) | null = null;
  private installed = false;
  private rafScheduled = false;
  private authUnsub: (() => void) | null = null;
  private selUnsub: (() => void) | null = null;

  init(): void {
    if (this.installed) return;
    this.installed = true;
    this.ensureOverlay();
    this.hookSources();
    this.unsubGesture = inputRouter.subscribe((g) => this.handle(g), 95);
    try {
      ctx.world.camera.controls.addEventListener("update", () => this.schedule());
    } catch { /* */ }
    ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("pointermove", () => {
      if (!this.drag) this.schedule();
    });
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => this.schedule());
    (window as any).__obsWallHandlesActive = true;
    console.log("[wall-handles] ready");
  }

  private hookSources(): void {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    if (auth?.onAuthoringChange) {
      this.authUnsub = auth.onAuthoringChange(() => this.schedule());
    }
    const sel: any = (ctx.features as any).selection;
    if (sel?.onChange) {
      this.selUnsub = sel.onChange(() => this.schedule());
    }
    this.schedule();
  }

  destroy(): void {
    this.unsubGesture?.();
    this.unsubGesture = null;
    this.authUnsub?.();
    this.selUnsub?.();
    (window as any).__obsWallHandlesActive = false;
    this.wrap?.remove();
    this.wrap = null;
    this.svg = null;
    this.dimG = null;
    this.hG = null;
    this.installed = false;
  }

  private schedule(): void {
    if (this.rafScheduled) return;
    this.rafScheduled = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.rafScheduled = false;
      this.render();
    });
  }

  private ensureOverlay(): void {
    if (this.svg) return;
    const host = ctx.rightHost;
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.id = "obs-wall-handles";
    wrap.style.cssText =
      "position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:45;overflow:hidden";
    const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
    svg.style.cssText = "position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block";
    const dimG = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
    const hG = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
    svg.append(dimG, hG);
    wrap.appendChild(svg);
    host.appendChild(wrap);
    this.wrap = wrap;
    this.svg = svg;
    this.dimG = dimG;
    this.hG = hG;
  }

  private activeWall(): ActiveWall | null {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    if (!auth) return null;
    const ids: string[] = auth.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
    if (ids.length !== 1) return null;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = auth.getElementById?.(ids[0]) ?? null;
    if (!el) return null;
    if (!WALL_LIKE_TYPES.has(el.type)) return null;
    if (!el.params.start || !el.params.end) return null;
    if (el.properties?.pinned) return null;
    return { id: el.id, el };
  }

  private activeWallById(id: string): ActiveWall | null {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = auth?.getElementById?.(id) ?? null;
    if (!el || !el.params.start || !el.params.end) return null;
    return { id: el.id, el };
  }

  private project(x: number, y: number, z: number): ScreenPt | null {
    try {
      const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
      const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) return null;
      const v = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).project(cam);
      if (!isFinite(v.x) || !isFinite(v.y)) return null;
      return {
        x: (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.width,
        y: (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.height,
        visible: v.z >= -1 && v.z <= 1,
      };
    } catch { return null; }
  }

  private clearAll(): void {
    while (this.dimG?.firstChild) this.dimG.removeChild(this.dimG.firstChild);
    while (this.hG?.firstChild) this.hG.removeChild(this.hG.firstChild);
  }

  private render(): void {
    if (!this.svg || !this.dimG || !this.hG) return;
    this.clearAll();
    this.handlePos = { start: null, end: null, mid: null };

    const wall = this.drag
      ? this.activeWallById(this.drag.wallId)
      : this.activeWall();
    if (!wall) return;

    const p = wall.el.params;
    if (!p.start || !p.end) return;

    const y = p.elevation + 0.02;
    const sx = (this.drag?.which === "start") ? this.drag.currentWorld.x : p.start[0];
    const sz = (this.drag?.which === "start") ? this.drag.currentWorld.z : p.start[1];
    const ex = (this.drag?.which === "end") ? this.drag.currentWorld.x : p.end[0];
    const ez = (this.drag?.which === "end") ? this.drag.currentWorld.z : p.end[1];

    const s = this.project(sx, y, sz);
    const e = this.project(ex, y, ez);
    if (!s || !e) return;
    this.handlePos.start = s;
    this.handlePos.end = e;

    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    this.svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${rect.width} ${rect.height}`);

    const dx = e.x - s.x;
    const dy = e.y - s.y;
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const ux = dx / len;
    const uy = dy / len;
    const nx = -uy;
    const ny = ux;

    this.line(this.dimG, s.x, s.y, e.x, e.y, "#2563eb", 1.2, "6 3", 0.7);

    const mx = (s.x + e.x) / 2;
    const my = (s.y + e.y) / 2;
    this.handlePos.mid = { x: mx, y: my, visible: s.visible && e.visible };

    const ao = 15;
    for (const sign of [1, -1]) {
      const tipX = mx + nx * (ao - 7) * sign;
      const tipY = my + ny * (ao - 7) * sign;
      const b1x = mx + nx * (ao + 5) * sign + ux * 5;
      const b1y = my + ny * (ao + 5) * sign + uy * 5;
      const b2x = mx + nx * (ao + 5) * sign - ux * 5;
      const b2y = my + ny * (ao + 5) * sign - uy * 5;
      this.polygon(this.hG, `${tipX},${tipY} ${b1x},${b1y} ${b2x},${b2y}`,
        "#38bdf8", "#0b0d12", 1, { flip: "1" });
    }

    this.circle(this.hG, s.x, s.y, HANDLE_RADIUS_PX, "#2563eb", "#ffffff", 2, { handle: "start" });
    this.circle(this.hG, e.x, e.y, HANDLE_RADIUS_PX, "#2563eb", "#ffffff", 2, { handle: "end" });
    this.circle(this.hG, s.x, s.y, HANDLE_RADIUS_PX * 0.42, "#bae6fd", "none", 0, {});
    this.circle(this.hG, e.x, e.y, HANDLE_RADIUS_PX * 0.42, "#bae6fd", "none", 0, {});

    if (this.drag) {
      const length = Math.hypot(ex - sx, ez - sz);
      const text = units.formatLength(length, { precision: 0 });
      const w1x = s.x + nx * DIM_OFFSET_PX;
      const w1y = s.y + ny * DIM_OFFSET_PX;
      const w2x = e.x + nx * DIM_OFFSET_PX;
      const w2y = e.y + ny * DIM_OFFSET_PX;
      this.line(this.dimG, s.x, s.y, w1x, w1y, "#2563eb", 1, null, 0.6);
      this.line(this.dimG, e.x, e.y, w2x, w2y, "#2563eb", 1, null, 0.6);
      this.line(this.dimG, w1x, w1y, w2x, w2y, "#2563eb", 1, null, 1);
      for (const h of [[w1x, w1y], [w2x, w2y]] as Array<[number, number]>) {
        this.line(this.dimG,
          h[0] - ux * 4 - nx * 4, h[1] - uy * 4 - ny * 4,
          h[0] + ux * 4 + nx * 4, h[1] + uy * 4 + ny * 4,
          "#2563eb", 1.2, null, 1);
      }
      const tw = text.length * 7.2 + 12;
      const tcx = (w1x + w2x) / 2;
      const tcy = (w1y + w2y) / 2;
      this.rect(this.dimG, tcx - tw / 2, tcy - 10, tw, 20, 4, "#f8fafc", "#2563eb", 1);
      this.text(this.dimG, tcx, tcy + 4, text, "#1e3a8a", 12, "600");

      if (this.drag.snapTarget) {
        const sp = this.project(this.drag.snapTarget.x, y, this.drag.snapTarget.z);
        if (sp) this.rect(this.hG, sp.x - 6, sp.y - 6, 12, 12, 0, "#f59e0b", "#0b0d12", 1.5);
      }
    }
  }

  private line(parent: SVGGElement, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number,
               stroke: string, width: number, dash: string | null, opacity: number): void {
    const l = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
    l.setAttribute("x1", String(x1)); l.setAttribute("y1", String(y1));
    l.setAttribute("x2", String(x2)); l.setAttribute("y2", String(y2));
    l.setAttribute("stroke", stroke); l.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(width));
    if (dash) l.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", dash);
    l.setAttribute("opacity", String(opacity));
    parent.appendChild(l);
  }
  private circle(parent: SVGGElement, cx: number, cy: number, r: number,
                 fill: string, stroke: string, sw: number, data: Record<string, string>): void {
    const c = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
    c.setAttribute("cx", String(cx)); c.setAttribute("cy", String(cy));
    c.setAttribute("r", String(r)); c.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    if (stroke !== "none") { c.setAttribute("stroke", stroke); c.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(sw)); }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) c.setAttribute(`data-${k}`, v);
    parent.appendChild(c);
  }
  private polygon(parent: SVGGElement, points: string, fill: string,
                  stroke: string, sw: number, data: Record<string, string>): void {
    const p = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "polygon");
    p.setAttribute("points", points);
    p.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    if (stroke !== "none") { p.setAttribute("stroke", stroke); p.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(sw)); }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) p.setAttribute(`data-${k}`, v);
    parent.appendChild(p);
  }
  private rect(parent: SVGGElement, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number,
               fill: string, stroke: string, sw: number): void {
    const rc = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
    rc.setAttribute("x", String(x)); rc.setAttribute("y", String(y));
    rc.setAttribute("width", String(w)); rc.setAttribute("height", String(h));
    if (r > 0) rc.setAttribute("rx", String(r));
    rc.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    if (stroke !== "none") { rc.setAttribute("stroke", stroke); rc.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(sw)); }
    parent.appendChild(rc);
  }
  private text(parent: SVGGElement, x: number, y: number, txt: string,
               fill: string, size: number, weight: string): void {
    const t = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    t.setAttribute("x", String(x)); t.setAttribute("y", String(y));
    t.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    t.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
    t.setAttribute("font-size", String(size));
    t.setAttribute("font-weight", weight);
    t.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    t.textContent = txt;
    parent.appendChild(t);
  }

  private hitTest(e: { clientX: number; clientY: number }): "start" | "end" | "flip" | null {
    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const py = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const { start, end, mid } = this.handlePos;
    const d = (a: ScreenPt | null) => a ? Math.hypot(px - a.x, py - a.y) : Infinity;
    const ds = d(start);
    const de = d(end);
    const dm = d(mid);
    if (ds <= HANDLE_HIT_RADIUS_PX && ds <= de) return "start";
    if (de <= HANDLE_HIT_RADIUS_PX) return "end";
    if (dm <= FLIP_HIT_RADIUS_PX) return "flip";
    return null;
  }

  private handle = (g: Gesture): boolean => {
    if (this.drag) {
      if (g.kind === "drag-move") { this.updateDrag(g.event); return true; }
      if (g.kind === "drag-end") { this.commitDrag(); return true; }
      if (g.kind === "click") { return true; }
    }
    if (g.kind === "drag-start" && g.button === 0) {
      const hit = this.hitTest(g.event);
      if (hit === "start" || hit === "end") return this.startDrag(hit, g.event);
      if (hit === "flip") {
        const w = this.activeWall();
        if (w) { this.flipWall(w); return true; }
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (g.kind === "click" && g.button === 0) {
      const hit = this.hitTest(g.event);
      if (hit === "flip") {
        const w = this.activeWall();
        if (w) { this.flipWall(w); return true; }
      }
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  };

  private startDrag(which: "start" | "end", e: PointerEvent): boolean {
    const w = this.activeWall();
    if (!w) return false;
    const p = w.el.params;
    if (!p.start || !p.end) return false;
    const groundY = p.elevation;
    const cur = which === "start"
      ? { x: p.start[0], z: p.start[1] }
      : { x: p.end[0], z: p.end[1] };
    this.drag = {
      wallId: w.id,
      which,
      baseline: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)) as AuthoredElement["params"],
      groundY,
      currentWorld: cur,
      snapTarget: null,
    };
    this.updateDrag(e);
    return true;
  }

  private groundPoint(e: PointerEvent): { x: number; z: number } | null {
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width < 1) return null;
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
      ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
      -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
    );
    const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
    ray.setFromCamera(ndc, cam);
    const y = this.drag?.groundY ?? 0;
    const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), -y);
    const hit = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (!ray.ray.intersectPlane(plane, hit)) return null;
    return { x: hit.x, z: hit.z };
  }

  private findSnap(px: number, pz: number): { x: number; z: number } | null {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = this.drag?.groundY ?? 0;
    const project = (x: number, z: number) => {
      const v = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).project(cam);
      return { x: (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.width, y: (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.height };
    };
    const pointer = project(px, pz);
    let best: { x: number; z: number; d: number } | null = null;
    const els: AuthoredElement[] = auth?.getElements?.() ?? [];
    const selfId = this.drag?.wallId;
    for (const el of els) {
      if (el.id === selfId) continue;
      if (!el.params.start || !el.params.end) continue;
      for (const pt of [el.params.start, el.params.end]) {
        const sp = project(pt[0], pt[1]);
        const d = Math.hypot(sp.x - pointer.x, sp.y - pointer.y);
        if (d < SNAP_SCREEN_TOL_PX && (!best || d < best.d)) {
          best = { x: pt[0], z: pt[1], d };
        }
      }
    }
    return best ? { x: best.x, z: best.z } : null;
  }

  private updateDrag(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!this.drag) return;
    const g = this.groundPoint(e);
    if (!g) return;
    const snap = this.findSnap(g.x, g.z);
    if (snap) {
      this.drag.snapTarget = snap;
      this.drag.currentWorld = snap;
    } else {
      this.drag.snapTarget = null;
      this.drag.currentWorld = g;
    }
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = auth?.getElementById?.(this.drag.wallId) ?? null;
    if (!el) return;
    const p = el.params;
    if (this.drag.which === "start") {
      p.start = [this.drag.currentWorld.x, this.drag.currentWorld.z];
    } else {
      p.end = [this.drag.currentWorld.x, this.drag.currentWorld.z];
    }
    auth?.rebuildAuthored?.();
    this.schedule();
  }

  private commitDrag(): void {
    const d = this.drag;
    this.drag = null;
    if (!d) return;
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = auth?.getElementById?.(d.wallId) ?? null;
    if (!el) return;
    const after = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.params)) as AuthoredElement["params"];
    if (JSON.stringify(after) === JSON.stringify(d.baseline)) { this.schedule(); return; }
    el.params = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.baseline));
    auth?.rebuildAuthored?.();
    const apply = (params: AuthoredElement["params"]) => {
      const live: AuthoredElement | null = auth?.getElementById?.(d.wallId) ?? null;
      if (!live) return;
      live.params = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(params));
      auth?.rebuildAuthored?.();
      try { auth?.migrateMepFittingRadii?.(); } catch { /* */ }
      try { (ctx.features as any).projects?.markDirty?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    history.push({
      label: "Stretch " + el.name,
      apply: () => apply(after),
      revert: () => apply(d.baseline),
    });
    apply(after);
    notify("success", "Stretched " + el.name);
    this.schedule();
  }

  private flipWall(w: ActiveWall): void {
    const p = w.el.params;
    if (!p.start || !p.end) return;
    const before = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)) as AuthoredElement["params"];
    const after = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)) as AuthoredElement["params"];
    const tmp = after.start!;
    after.start = after.end!;
    after.end = tmp;
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const apply = (params: AuthoredElement["params"]) => {
      const live: AuthoredElement | null = auth?.getElementById?.(w.id) ?? null;
      if (!live) return;
      live.params = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(params));
      auth?.rebuildAuthored?.();
      try { (ctx.features as any).projects?.markDirty?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    history.push({
      label: "Flip " + w.el.name,
      apply: () => apply(after),
      revert: () => apply(before),
    });
    apply(after);
    notify("success", "Flipped " + w.el.name);
    this.schedule();
  }
}

export const wallHandles = new WallHandlesManager();

export function setupWallHandles(): void {
  wallHandles.init();
  (ctx.features as any).wallHandles = {
    destroy: () => wallHandles.destroy(),
  };
  try { (window as any).__obsWallHandles = wallHandles; } catch { /* */ }
  console.log("[wall-handles] setup complete");
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:workspace-boot
//
// Wires every dockable panel in ctx.features into the workspace-layout
// store, plus the Advanced / Critical Gaps toolbar which uses a
// window global. Runs as the very last boot step in main.ts, after
// every panel's setup function has already populated ctx.features.

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  registerWorkspacePanel,
  restoreWorkspace,
  saveWorkspace,
  resetWorkspace,
  showAllWorkspace,
  installWorkspaceUnloadHook,
  listWorkspacePanels,
} from "../modules/workspace-layout";
import { registerCommand } from "./command-palette";

interface PanelFeature {
  isVisible?: () => boolean;
  open?: () => void;
  close?: () => void;
  toggle?: () => void;
}

function asVisible(F: PanelFeature): boolean {
  try { return typeof F.isVisible === "function" && !!F.isVisible(); }
  catch { return false; }
}

function setVisible(F: PanelFeature, on: boolean): void {
  const now = asVisible(F);
  if (now === on) return;
  if (on && typeof F.open === "function") { F.open(); return; }
  if (!on && typeof F.close === "function") { F.close(); return; }
  if (typeof F.toggle === "function") F.toggle();
}

function reg(featureKey: string, label: string, defaultOpen = false): boolean {
  const F = (ctx.features as any)[featureKey] as PanelFeature | undefined;
  if (!F) return false;
  registerWorkspacePanel({
    key: featureKey,
    label,
    defaultOpen,
    isVisible: () => asVisible(F),
    setVisible: (on: boolean) => setVisible(F, on),
  });
  return true;
}

export function setupWorkspaceLayout(): void {
  // Dockable panels -- all closed by default. Panels without a
  // ctx.features handle are silently skipped; the workspace system is
  // best-effort and never throws on a missing panel.
  reg("projectBrowser",   "Project Browser");
  reg("propertyPalette",  "Properties");
  reg("modelTreePanel",   "Model Categories");
  reg("familyBrowser",    "Family Browser");
  reg("bimToolbox",       "BIM Command Center");
  reg("bimObjectStudio",  "BIM Object Studio");
  reg("schedulesPanel",   "Schedules");
  reg("sheetsPanel",      "Sheets");
  reg("sheets2dPanel",    "Sheets (2D)");
  reg("issuesPanel",      "Issues / BCF");
  reg("idsPanel",         "IDS Validation");
  reg("timelinePanel",    "Timeline 4D");
  reg("costPanel",        "5D Cost");
  reg("savedViews",       "Saved Views");
  reg("modelHealthPanel", "Model Health");
  reg("cdePanel",         "Common Data Environment");
  reg("standardsPanel",   "Standards");
  reg("planView",         "Floor Plan");
  reg("viewsPanel",       "Views");
  reg("navigationBar",    "Navigation Bar");
  reg("systemBrowser",    "System Browser");
  reg("mepFabrication",   "MEP Fabrication Parts");
  reg("pidModeler",       "P&ID Modeler");
  reg("aiChat",           "AI Assistant");

  // Critical Gaps / Advanced toolbar (window global, not ctx.features).
  registerWorkspacePanel({
    key: "criticalGapsToolbar",
    label: "Advanced Toolbar",
    defaultOpen: false,
    isVisible: () => {
      try { return !!(window as any).__obsCriticalGapsUI?.isVisible?.(); }
      catch { return false; }
    },
    setVisible: (on: boolean) => {
      const api = (window as any).__obsCriticalGapsUI;
      if (!api) return;
      if (on) { api.show?.(); } else { api.hide?.(); }
    },
  });

  installWorkspaceUnloadHook();
  restoreWorkspace();

  // Expose the API for tests and DevTools.
  (window as any).__obsWorkspace = {
    save: saveWorkspace,
    restore: restoreWorkspace,
    reset: resetWorkspace,
    showAll: showAllWorkspace,
    list: () => listWorkspacePanels().map((p) => ({
      key: p.key, label: p.label, visible: p.isVisible(),
    })),
  };

  // Command palette entries.
  try {
    registerCommand({
      id: "workspace.reset",
      label: "Reset Workspace Layout",
      category: "View",
      hint: "Close every panel and return to the clean default",
      run: () => resetWorkspace(),
    });
    registerCommand({
      id: "workspace.save",
      label: "Save Workspace Layout",
      category: "View",
      hint: "Persist the current panel layout",
      run: () => {
        saveWorkspace();
        try {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
            detail: { message: "Workspace saved", kind: "success" },
          }));
        } catch { /* */ }
      },
    });
    registerCommand({
      id: "workspace.showAll",
      label: "Show All Panels",
      category: "View",
      hint: "Open every registered panel",
      run: () => showAllWorkspace(),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[workspace-boot] command registration failed", err);
  }

  console.log(
    "[workspace-boot] ready - " +
    listWorkspacePanels().length + " panel(s) registered",
  );
}
```

--- FILE: src/main.ts ---
```ts
import "./critical-gaps-boot";
/**
 * Open BIM Studio v52 â€” main entry point.
 *
 * Heavy-duty open BIM production platform:
 * parametric-ready authoring, sheets/production docs, 4D simulation,
 * clash detective, IDS, schedules, 5D cost, automation rules, materials,
 * BCF, AI â€” engineered to compete with Revit, Navisworks, Bentley,
 * BricsCAD BIM, Forma and Renga as the open standards monster of AEC.
 */
import { setupViewer } from "./core/setup";
import { setupInputRouter } from "./core/input-router";
import { setupDiagnostics } from "./core/diagnostics";
import { setupOptions } from "./core/options-registry";
import { setupNavigation } from "./features/navigation";
import { setupSelectionOrbit } from "./features/selection-orbit";
import { setupDblclickFit } from "./features/dblclick-fit";
import { setupCameraTools, computeSceneBounds } from "./features/camera-tools";
import { setupMeasure } from "./features/measure";
import { setupDrawing } from "./features/drawing";
import { setupSection } from "./features/section";
import { setupImporter } from "./features/importer";
import { ctx } from "./core/context";
import { setupClash } from "./features/clash";
import { setupClashReview } from "./features/clash-review";
import { setupModelAlign } from "./features/model-align";
import { setupViewCube } from "./features/viewcube";
import { setupContextMenu } from "./features/context-menu";
import { setupProjects } from "./modules/projects/projects";
import { setupAuthoring } from "./features/authoring";
import { setupFamilies } from "./modules/families";
import { setupFamilyBrowser } from "./features/family-browser";
import { setupIssues } from "./modules/issues/issues";
import { setupBcf } from "./modules/issues/bcf";
import { setupIssuesPanel } from "./features/issues-panel";
import { setupCost } from "./modules/cost/cost";
import { setupCostPanel } from "./features/cost-panel";
import { setupCdePanel } from "./features/cde-panel";
import { setupStandardsPanel } from "./features/standards-panel";
import { setupPanelWiring } from "./features/panel-wiring";
import { setupFileInterop } from "./features/file-interop";
import { setupFileMenu } from "./shell/file-menu";
import { setupViewsPanel } from "./features/views-panel";
import { setupSheets2dPanel } from "./features/sheets-2d-panel";
import { setupShell } from "./shell/shell";
import { buildPanel } from "./features/panel";

import { history } from "./features/history";
import { selection, setupClickToSelect } from "./features/selection";
import { snapping } from "./features/snapping";
import { gizmo } from "./features/gizmo";
import { shortcuts } from "./features/shortcuts";
import { setupViewportToolbar } from "./shell/viewport-toolbar";
import { registerDefaultShortcuts } from "./shell/default-shortcuts";
import { setupUserInterfaceMenu } from "./features/user-interface-menu";
import { setupNavigationBar } from "./features/navigation-bar";
import { setupSystemBrowser } from "./features/system-browser";
import { setupMepFabrication } from "./features/mep-fabrication";
import { setupPidModeler } from "./features/pid-modeler";
import { registerUiItems } from "./features/ui-items-register";
```
