```ts
const errOverlay = document.createElement("div");
errOverlay.style.cssText =
  "position:fixed;inset:auto 12px 12px 12px;z-index:99999;display:none;" +
  "background:#3b0d0d;color:#ffd7d7;border:1px solid #ef4444;border-radius:8px;" +
  "padding:10px 14px;font:12px/1.5 monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:45vh;overflow:auto";
document.body.appendChild(errOverlay);

const BENIGN = [
  /Fragments\s*:?\s*Model not found/i,
  /ResizeObserver loop/i,
  /Loading CSS chunk/i,
  /Script error\.?/i,
  /cancelled/i,
  /AbortError/i,
];

function isBenign(msg: string) {
  return BENIGN.some((re) => re.test(msg));
}

function showError(title: string, err: unknown) {
  const msg = err instanceof Error ? `${err.message}\n${err.stack ?? ""}` : String(err);
  if (isBenign(msg)) {
    console.warn(`[suppressed] ${title}: ${msg.split("\n")[0]}`);
    return;
  }
  console.error(`[OpenBIMStudio] ${title}`, err);
  errOverlay.style.display = "block";
  errOverlay.innerHTML = "";
  const pre = document.createElement("pre");
  pre.style.cssText = "margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;font:inherit";
  pre.textContent = `âœ– ${title}\n${msg}`;
  const dismiss = document.createElement("button");
  dismiss.textContent = "Dismiss";
  dismiss.style.cssText =
    "margin-top:8px;background:#7f1d1d;color:#fecaca;border:1px solid #ef4444;" +
    "border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;cursor:pointer;font:12px system-ui";
  dismiss.onclick = () => { errOverlay.style.display = "none"; errOverlay.innerHTML = ""; };
  errOverlay.append(pre, dismiss);
}

window.addEventListener("error", (e) => {
  const msg = String(e.error?.message ?? e.message ?? "");
  if (isBenign(msg)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  showError("Unhandled error", e.error ?? e.message);
});

window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e: PromiseRejectionEvent) => {
  const reason: any = e.reason;
  const msg =
    reason instanceof Error ? reason.message
    : typeof reason === "string" ? reason
    : String(reason?.message ?? reason ?? "");
  if (isBenign(msg)) {
    console.warn("[suppressed benign] " + msg);
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  // Production: show once, do not cascade crash the app
  e.preventDefault();
  showError("Background task failed (app continues)", reason);
});

function step(name: string, fn: () => unknown | Promise<unknown>) {
  return (async () => {
    try {
      await fn();
      console.log(`[TOC boot] âœ“ ${name}`);
    } catch (err) {
      showError(`Step failed: ${name} (viewer continues without it)`, err);
    }
  })();
}

await step("setupViewer (core)", async () => {
  if (!document.getElementById("app")) {
    throw new Error('index.html has no <div id="app"> â€” check your HTML entry.');
  }
  try {
    await setupViewer();
    setupExtras();
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    const isWorker = /worker|wasm|fragments/i.test(message);
    renderBootFailure({
      title: "Open BIM Studio failed to start",
      message: "The application could not initialize. This is usually a build or environment problem, not a bug in your models.",
      hint: isWorker
        ? "The Fragments worker failed to load. This is often caused by COEP/CORS headers being missing on the dev server, or by the wasm file being served as HTML (a 404). Restart Vite after `npm install` and check the browser Network tab for `web-ifc.wasm`."
        : "Check the browser console for the full stack trace. If you just pulled new code, run `npm install && npm run dev` again.",
      details: err instanceof Error ? (err.stack ?? message) : message,
    });
    throw err;
  }
});

if (!ctx.world) {
  console.error("[Open BIM Studio] Viewer failed to initialize â€” aborting remaining boot steps.");
  throw new Error("Boot aborted: viewer is not available.");
}
```

```tsx
// src/main.tsx
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Provider } from 'react-redux';
import { configureStore, createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import { MainRibbon } from '../src/ui/MainRibbon';
import { Viewport } from '../src/components/Viewport';
import { ProjectTree } from '../src/components/ProjectTree';
import { PropertyPanel } from '../src/components/PropertyPanel';
import { loadPlugins } from '../src/plugins/loader';
import './styles.css';
import * as THREE from 'three';

// ---------- Store ----------
interface BIMState {
  ifcAPI: IfcAPI | null;
  modelID: number | null;
  selectedId: number | null;
  commandLog: any[];
  undoStack: any[];
  redoStack: any[];
}
const initialState: BIMState = {
  ifcAPI: null,
  modelID: null,
  selectedId: null,
  commandLog: [],
  undoStack: [],
  redoStack: [],
};

const bimSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'bim',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setAPI(state, action: PayloadAction<IfcAPI>) { state.ifcAPI = action.payload; },
    setModel(state, action: PayloadAction<number>) { state.modelID = action.payload; },
    select(state, action: PayloadAction<number | null>) { state.selectedId = action.payload; },
    pushCommand(state, action: PayloadAction<any>) { state.commandLog.push(action.payload); state.undoStack.push(action.payload); state.redoStack = []; },
    undo(state) { const cmd = state.undoStack.pop(); if (cmd) { cmd.undo?.(); state.redoStack.push(cmd); } },
    redo(state) { const cmd = state.redoStack.pop(); if (cmd) { cmd.execute?.(); state.undoStack.push(cmd); } },
  },
});
export const { setAPI, setModel, select, pushCommand, undo, redo } = bimSlice.actions;
export const store = configureStore({ reducer: { bim: bimSlice.reducer } });
export type RootState = ReturnType<typeof store.getState>;
export type AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch;

// ---------- Bootstrap ----------
async function bootstrap() {
  // Initialize a mock IFC API – real wasm loading is omitted for this demo
  const ifc: any = {
    // Minimal stubs for required methods
    CreateAxis2Placement3D: async () => ({ /* placement */ }),
    CreateIfcShapeRepresentation: async () => ({ /* shape */ }),
    CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy: async () => ({ id: Math.floor(Math.random()*1000) }),
    DeleteEntity: async () => {},
    GetLine: () => ({}),
    GetAllLines: () => [],
    GetModelID: () => 0,
    GetGeometry: () => ({ geometry: new THREE.BoxGeometry() }),
    OpenModel: () => 0,
  } as any;
  // No real model ID – using placeholder 0
  store.dispatch(setAPI(ifc));
  store.dispatch(setModel(0));

  await loadPlugins();
  const container = document.getElementById('app')!;
  const root = createRoot(container);
  root.render(
    <Provider store={store}>
      <div className="app-layout">
        <MainRibbon />
        <div className="main-area">
          <ProjectTree />
          <Viewport />
          <PropertyPanel />
        </div>
      </div>
    </Provider>
  );
}
bootstrap();
```

```ts
/**
 * Automation Rules Engine — rule-based AEC automation.
 *
 * Lightweight competitor to Dynamo / Grasshopper for common production tasks:
 * colour by parameter, isolate by category, assign phase, rename, tag, etc.
 */
import type { AutomationRule } from "../projects/types";

const uid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `rule-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

let rules: AutomationRule[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notify() {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
}

export function onRulesChange(fn: () => void) {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => listeners.delete(fn);
}

export function listRules(): AutomationRule[] {
  return rules.slice();
}

export function addRule(partial?: Partial<AutomationRule>): AutomationRule {
  const rule: AutomationRule = {
    id: uid(),
    name: partial?.name ?? "New rule",
    enabled: partial?.enabled ?? true,
    trigger: partial?.trigger ?? "manual",
    condition: partial?.condition,
    actions: partial?.actions ?? [{ type: "log", params: { message: "Rule fired" } }],
  };
  rules.push(rule);
  notify();
  return rule;
}

export function updateRule(id: string, patch: Partial<AutomationRule>) {
  const r = rules.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!r) return;
  Object.assign(r, patch);
  notify();
}

export function removeRule(id: string) {
  rules = rules.filter((r) => r.id !== id);
  notify();
}

export function ensureDefaultRules() {
  if (rules.length) return;
  addRule({
    name: "Colour walls by height > 3m",
    trigger: "manual",
    condition: "category=wall AND height>3",
    actions: [{ type: "set-color", params: { color: "#ef4444" } }],
  });
  addRule({
    name: "Isolate structural elements",
    trigger: "manual",
    condition: "category=column OR category=beam OR category=brace",
    actions: [{ type: "isolate", params: {} }],
  });
  addRule({
    name: "Assign selection to Foundations phase",
    trigger: "manual",
    condition: "category=footing OR category=strip",
    actions: [{ type: "assign-phase", params: { phaseName: "Foundations" } }],
  });
  addRule({
    name: "On import — run IDS check reminder",
    trigger: "on-import",
    actions: [{ type: "toast", params: { message: "Remember to run IDS validation on new models." } }],
  });
}

/** Execute a rule (best-effort — actions are extensible hooks). */
export async function runRule(id: string, context?: { selectionIds?: string[] }) {
  const rule = rules.find((r) => r.id === id);
  if (!rule || !rule.enabled) return { ok: false, message: "Rule not found or disabled" };

  const results: string[] = [];
  for (const action of rule.actions) {
    switch (action.type) {
      case "log":
        console.log(`[automation] ${action.params.message ?? rule.name}`);
        results.push("logged");
        break;
      case "toast":
        results.push(String(action.params.message ?? "Rule executed"));
        break;
      case "set-color":
        results.push(`set-color → ${action.params.color}`);
        // Hook point: authoring / fragment colour APIs can be called here
        break;
      case "isolate":
        results.push("isolate selection/filter");
        break;
      case "assign-phase":
        results.push(`assign-phase → ${action.params.phaseName}`);
        break;
      default:
        results.push(`unknown action: ${action.type}`);
    }
  }

  // Fire a custom event so UI / other modules can react
  window.dispatchEvent(
    new CustomEvent("obs-automation-run", {
      detail: { ruleId: id, ruleName: rule.name, results, context },
    }),
  );

  return { ok: true, message: results.join("; ") };
}

export function runRulesByTrigger(trigger: AutomationRule["trigger"]) {
  const matched = rules.filter((r) => r.enabled && r.trigger === trigger);
  return Promise.all(matched.map((r) => runRule(r.id)));
}

export function loadRulesFromProject(list: AutomationRule[] | undefined) {
  rules = list?.length ? list.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
  if (!rules.length) ensureDefaultRules();
  notify();
}

export function getRulesForSave(): AutomationRule[] {
  return rules.map((r) => ({ ...r }));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * CAD Engine - AutoCAD-class 2D drafting operations on screen-space entities.
 *
 * Works with the existing drafting-2d overlay (screen SVG) and adds:
 *   polyline, arc, offset, erase-last, move, copy, mirror, layers, ortho, grid
 *
 * Coordinates are screen pixels (same as drafting-2d). World export is handled
 * by drafting-bridge.
 */

export type CadPt = { x: number; y: number };

export type CadEntityKind =
  | "line"
  | "polyline"
  | "rect"
  | "circle"
  | "arc"
  | "text";

export interface CadEntity {
  id: string;
  kind: CadEntityKind;
  /** Primary point / center / start */
  a: CadPt;
  /** End point / opposite corner */
  b?: CadPt;
  /** Polyline vertices (includes start) */
  points?: CadPt[];
  /** Circle / arc radius */
  r?: number;
  /** Arc end angle (radians), start inferred from a-first ray or startAngle */
  startAngle?: number;
  endAngle?: number;
  text?: string;
  color: string;
  strokeWidth: number;
  layer: string;
}

export type CadTool =
  | "line"
  | "polyline"
  | "rect"
  | "circle"
  | "arc"
  | "text"
  | "offset"
  | "erase"
  | "move"
  | "copy"
  | "mirror"
  | "trim"
  | "extend"
  | "fillet"
  | "distance"
  | null;

export interface CadLayer {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  visible: boolean;
  locked: boolean;
}

function uid(prefix = "cad"): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

function dist(a: CadPt, b: CadPt): number {
  return Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
}

function mid(a: CadPt, b: CadPt): CadPt {
  return { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
}

function offsetPoint(p: CadPt, dx: number, dy: number): CadPt {
  return { x: p.x + dx, y: p.y + dy };
}

/** Offset a line segment by distance (left of direction). */
function offsetSegment(a: CadPt, b: CadPt, d: number): [CadPt, CadPt] {
  const len = dist(a, b) || 1;
  const nx = -(b.y - a.y) / len;
  const ny = (b.x - a.x) / len;
  return [
    { x: a.x + nx * d, y: a.y + ny * d },
    { x: b.x + nx * d, y: b.y + ny * d },
  ];
}

function mirrorPoint(p: CadPt, a: CadPt, b: CadPt): CadPt {
  const dx = b.x - a.x;
  const dy = b.y - a.y;
  const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
  const t = ((p.x - a.x) * dx + (p.y - a.y) * dy) / len2;
  const proj = { x: a.x + t * dx, y: a.y + t * dy };
  return { x: 2 * proj.x - p.x, y: 2 * proj.y - p.y };
}

type Listener = () => void;

class CadEngine {
  private entities: CadEntity[] = [];
  private redoStack: CadEntity[] = [];
  private layers: CadLayer[] = [
    { id: "0", name: "0", color: "#38bdf8", visible: true, locked: false },
    { id: "defpoints", name: "Defpoints", color: "#64748b", visible: true, locked: false },
    { id: "annotation", name: "Annotation", color: "#fbbf24", visible: true, locked: false },
  ];
  private activeLayerId = "0";
  private tool: CadTool = null;
  private ortho = false;
  private grid = false;
  private gridSize = 20; // px
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private color = "#38bdf8";
  private strokeWidth = 1.5;

  // Multi-step tool state
  private polyPoints: CadPt[] = [];
  private pending: CadPt | null = null;

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try {
        cb();
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent("obs:cad-changed", {
          detail: { count: this.entities.length, tool: this.tool },
        }),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  /* -- Layers ------------------------------------------------------- */

  listLayers(): CadLayer[] {
    return this.layers.map((l) => ({ ...l }));
  }

  getActiveLayer(): CadLayer {
    return this.layers.find((l) => l.id === this.activeLayerId) ?? this.layers[0];
  }

  setActiveLayer(id: string): void {
    if (this.layers.some((l) => l.id === id)) {
      this.activeLayerId = id;
      const layer = this.getActiveLayer();
      this.color = layer.color;
      this.emit();
    }
  }

  addLayer(name: string, color = "#94a3b8"): CadLayer {
    const layer: CadLayer = {
      id: uid("layer"),
      name,
      color,
      visible: true,
      locked: false,
    };
    this.layers.push(layer);
    this.emit();
    return layer;
  }

  setLayerVisible(id: string, visible: boolean): void {
    const l = this.layers.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (l) {
      l.visible = visible;
      this.emit();
    }
  }

  /* -- Tool / options ----------------------------------------------- */

  getTool(): CadTool {
    return this.tool;
  }

  setTool(tool: CadTool): void {
    this.tool = tool;
    this.polyPoints = [];
    this.pending = null;
    this.emit();
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent("obs:cad-tool-changed", { detail: { tool } }),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  isOrtho(): boolean {
    return this.ortho;
  }

  setOrtho(on: boolean): void {
    this.ortho = on;
    this.emit();
  }

  toggleOrtho(): boolean {
    this.ortho = !this.ortho;
    this.emit();
    return this.ortho;
  }

  isGrid(): boolean {
    return this.grid;
  }

  setGrid(on: boolean): void {
    this.grid = on;
    this.emit();
  }

  toggleGrid(): boolean {
    this.grid = !this.grid;
    this.emit();
    return this.grid;
  }

  getGridSize(): number {
    return this.gridSize;
  }

  setColor(c: string): void {
    this.color = c;
  }

  getColor(): string {
    return this.color;
  }

  /* -- Snap helpers ------------------------------------------------- */

  applyOrtho(from: CadPt, to: CadPt): CadPt {
    if (!this.ortho) return to;
    const dx = Math.abs(to.x - from.x);
    const dy = Math.abs(to.y - from.y);
    if (dx >= dy) return { x: to.x, y: from.y };
    return { x: from.x, y: to.y };
  }

  applyGrid(p: CadPt): CadPt {
    if (!this.grid) return p;
    const s = this.gridSize;
    return {
      x: Math.round(p.x / s) * s,
      y: Math.round(p.y / s) * s,
    };
  }

  snapPoint(from: CadPt | null, raw: CadPt): CadPt {
    let p = this.applyGrid(raw);
    if (from) p = this.applyOrtho(from, p);
    return p;
  }

  /* -- Entity CRUD -------------------------------------------------- */

  listEntities(): CadEntity[] {
    return this.entities
      .filter((e) => {
        const layer = this.layers.find((l) => l.id === e.layer);
        return !layer || layer.visible;
      })
      .map((e) => ({ ...e, points: e.points ? e.points.map((p) => ({ ...p })) : undefined }));
  }

  getAllEntities(): CadEntity[] {
    return this.entities.map((e) => ({
      ...e,
      points: e.points ? e.points.map((p) => ({ ...p })) : undefined,
    }));
  }

  getCount(): number {
    return this.entities.length;
  }

  private push(ent: CadEntity): void {
    this.entities.push(ent);
    this.redoStack = [];
    this.emit();
  }

  addLine(a: CadPt, b: CadPt): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      id: uid("line"),
      kind: "line",
      a: { ...a },
      b: { ...b },
      color: this.color,
      strokeWidth: this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  addRect(a: CadPt, b: CadPt): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      id: uid("rect"),
      kind: "rect",
      a: { ...a },
      b: { ...b },
      color: this.color,
      strokeWidth: this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  addCircle(center: CadPt, r: number): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      id: uid("circle"),
      kind: "circle",
      a: { ...center },
      r: Math.max(0.5, r),
      color: this.color,
      strokeWidth: this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  addPolyline(points: CadPt[]): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      id: uid("pline"),
      kind: "polyline",
      a: { ...points[0] },
      b: points.length > 1 ? { ...points[points.length - 1] } : undefined,
      points: points.map((p) => ({ ...p })),
      color: this.color,
      strokeWidth: this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  addArc(center: CadPt, r: number, startAngle: number, endAngle: number): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      id: uid("arc"),
      kind: "arc",
      a: { ...center },
      r: Math.max(0.5, r),
      startAngle,
      endAngle,
      color: this.color,
      strokeWidth: this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  addText(at: CadPt, text: string): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      id: uid("text"),
      kind: "text",
      a: { ...at },
      text,
      color: this.color,
      strokeWidth: this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  undo(): boolean {
    const last = this.entities.pop();
    if (!last) return false;
    this.redoStack.push(last);
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  redo(): boolean {
    const next = this.redoStack.pop();
    if (!next) return false;
    this.entities.push(next);
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.entities = [];
    this.redoStack = [];
    this.polyPoints = [];
    this.pending = null;
    this.emit();
  }

  eraseLast(): boolean {
    return this.undo();
  }

  /** Offset the last line/polyline by distance (screen px). */
  offsetLast(distance: number): CadEntity | null {
    const last = this.entities[this.entities.length - 1];
    if (!last) return null;

    if (last.kind === "line" && last.b) {
      const [a, b] = offsetSegment(last.a, last.b, distance);
      return this.addLine(a, b);
    }
    if (last.kind === "polyline" && last.points && last.points.length >= 2) {
      const pts: CadPt[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < last.points.length - 1; i++) {
        const [oa] = offsetSegment(last.points[i], last.points[i + 1], distance);
        pts.push(oa);
      }
      const lastSeg = last.points.length - 2;
      const [, ob] = offsetSegment(
        last.points[lastSeg],
        last.points[lastSeg + 1],
        distance,
      );
      pts.push(ob);
      return this.addPolyline(pts);
    }
    if (last.kind === "circle" && last.r != null) {
      return this.addCircle(last.a, last.r + distance);
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** Copy last entity by delta. */
  copyLast(dx: number, dy: number): CadEntity | null {
    const last = this.entities[this.entities.length - 1];
    if (!last) return null;
    return this.transformClone(last, (p) => offsetPoint(p, dx, dy));
  }

  /** Mirror last entity across a line from a-b. */
  mirrorLast(axisA: CadPt, axisB: CadPt): CadEntity | null {
    const last = this.entities[this.entities.length - 1];
    if (!last) return null;
    return this.transformClone(last, (p) => mirrorPoint(p, axisA, axisB));
  }

  private transformClone(
    src: CadEntity,
    map: (p: CadPt) => CadPt,
  ): CadEntity {
    const ent: CadEntity = {
      ...src,
      id: uid(src.kind),
      a: map(src.a),
      b: src.b ? map(src.b) : undefined,
      points: src.points ? src.points.map(map) : undefined,
    };
    this.push(ent);
    return ent;
  }

  /* -- Multi-click tool helpers (polyline / arc) -------------------- */

  getPolyPoints(): CadPt[] {
    return this.polyPoints.map((p) => ({ ...p }));
  }

  addPolyVertex(raw: CadPt): void {
    const from = this.polyPoints.length
      ? this.polyPoints[this.polyPoints.length - 1]
      : null;
    const p = this.snapPoint(from, raw);
    this.polyPoints.push(p);
    this.emit();
  }

  finishPolyline(): CadEntity | null {
    if (this.polyPoints.length < 2) {
      this.polyPoints = [];
      this.emit();
      return null;
    }
    const ent = this.addPolyline(this.polyPoints);
    this.polyPoints = [];
    this.emit();
    return ent;
  }

  cancelPoly(): void {
    this.polyPoints = [];
    this.pending = null;
    this.emit();
  }

  /* -- Sync with drafting-2d simple entities ------------------------- */

  /** Push a simple line/rect/circle/text into CAD store (from drafting-2d). */
  importDraftEntity(d: {
    id?: string;
    kind: string;
    a: CadPt;
    b?: CadPt;
    r?: number;
    text?: string;
    color?: string;
    strokeWidth?: number;
  }): void {
    const base = {
      color: d.color ?? this.color,
      strokeWidth: d.strokeWidth ?? this.strokeWidth,
      layer: this.activeLayerId,
    };
    if (d.kind === "line" && d.b) {
      this.entities.push({ id: d.id ?? uid("line"), kind: "line", a: d.a, b: d.b, ...base });
    } else if (d.kind === "rect" && d.b) {
      this.entities.push({ id: d.id ?? uid("rect"), kind: "rect", a: d.a, b: d.b, ...base });
    } else if (d.kind === "circle") {
      this.entities.push({
        id: d.id ?? uid("circle"),
        kind: "circle",
        a: d.a,
        r: d.r ?? 0,
        ...base,
      });
    } else if (d.kind === "text") {
      this.entities.push({
        id: d.id ?? uid("text"),
        kind: "text",
        a: d.a,
        text: d.text,
        ...base,
      });
    }
    this.emit();
  }

  /** Export entities that drafting-2d understands (line/rect/circle/text). */
  toDraftEntities(): Array<{
    id: string;
    kind: "line" | "rect" | "circle" | "text";
    a: CadPt;
    b?: CadPt;
    r?: number;
    text?: string;
    color: string;
    strokeWidth: number;
  }> {
    const out: ReturnType<CadEngine["toDraftEntities"]> = [];
    for (const e of this.listEntities()) {
      if (e.kind === "line" || e.kind === "rect" || e.kind === "circle" || e.kind === "text") {
        out.push({
          id: e.id,
          kind: e.kind,
          a: e.a,
          b: e.b,
          r: e.r,
          text: e.text,
          color: e.color,
          strokeWidth: e.strokeWidth,
        });
      } else if (e.kind === "polyline" && e.points) {
        for (let i = 0; i < e.points.length - 1; i++) {
          out.push({
            id: `${e.id}-${i}`,
            kind: "line",
            a: e.points[i],
            b: e.points[i + 1],
            color: e.color,
            strokeWidth: e.strokeWidth,
          });
        }
      } else if (e.kind === "arc" && e.r != null && e.startAngle != null && e.endAngle != null) {
        // Approximate arc as polyline segments for drafting-2d
        const segs = 24;
        const pts: CadPt[] = [];
        let a0 = e.startAngle;
        let a1 = e.endAngle;
        if (a1 < a0) a1 += Math.PI * 2;
        for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
          const t = a0 + ((a1 - a0) * i) / segs;
          pts.push({
            x: e.a.x + e.r * Math.cos(t),
            y: e.a.y + e.r * Math.sin(t),
          });
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
          out.push({
            id: `${e.id}-${i}`,
            kind: "line",
            a: pts[i],
            b: pts[i + 1],
            color: e.color,
            strokeWidth: e.strokeWidth,
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }


  /* -- Geometry helpers for TRIM / EXTEND / FILLET ------------------- */

  private lineSegs(): Array<{ id: string; a: CadPt; b: CadPt; index: number }> {
    const out: Array<{ id: string; a: CadPt; b: CadPt; index: number }> = [];
    this.entities.forEach((e, index) => {
      if (e.kind === "line" && e.b) {
        out.push({ id: e.id, a: e.a, b: e.b, index });
      } else if (e.kind === "polyline" && e.points) {
        for (let i = 0; i < e.points.length - 1; i++) {
          out.push({
            id: `${e.id}:${i}`,
            a: e.points[i],
            b: e.points[i + 1],
            index,
          });
        }
      }
    });
    return out;
  }

  private static segIntersect(
    a1: CadPt,
    a2: CadPt,
    b1: CadPt,
    b2: CadPt,
  ): { x: number; y: number; t: number; u: number } | null {
    const dax = a2.x - a1.x;
    const day = a2.y - a1.y;
    const dbx = b2.x - b1.x;
    const dby = b2.y - b1.y;
    const den = dax * dby - day * dbx;
    if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) return null;
    const t = ((b1.x - a1.x) * dby - (b1.y - a1.y) * dbx) / den;
    const u = ((b1.x - a1.x) * day - (b1.y - a1.y) * dax) / den;
    return { x: a1.x + t * dax, y: a1.y + t * day, t, u };
  }

  private nearestSeg(p: CadPt): { id: string; a: CadPt; b: CadPt; index: number; t: number; dist: number } | null {
    let best: ReturnType<CadEngine["nearestSeg"]> = null;
    for (const s of this.lineSegs()) {
      const dx = s.b.x - s.a.x;
      const dy = s.b.y - s.a.y;
      const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
      let t = ((p.x - s.a.x) * dx + (p.y - s.a.y) * dy) / len2;
      t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
      const proj = { x: s.a.x + t * dx, y: s.a.y + t * dy };
      const d = Math.hypot(p.x - proj.x, p.y - proj.y);
      if (!best || d < best.dist) {
        best = { ...s, t, dist: d };
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  /**
   * TRIM: pick a cutting segment near `cutterPt`, then a target near `targetPt`.
   * Removes the portion of the target beyond the intersection (the side you click).
   */
  trimAt(cutterPt: CadPt, targetPt: CadPt, pickRadius = 30): boolean {
    const cutter = this.nearestSeg(cutterPt);
    const target = this.nearestSeg(targetPt);
    if (!cutter || !target || cutter.id === target.id) return false;
    if (cutter.dist > pickRadius || target.dist > pickRadius) return false;

    const hit = CadEngine.segIntersect(cutter.a, cutter.b, target.a, target.b);
    if (!hit) return false;
    // Allow slight extension of cutter as infinite-ish within segment param 0..1 for target
    if (hit.u < -0.05 || hit.u > 1.05) return false;

    const ent = this.entities[target.index];
    if (!ent || (ent.kind !== "line" && ent.kind !== "polyline")) return false;

    // For simple lines: keep the side opposite the click (standard CAD: click side is removed)
    if (ent.kind === "line" && ent.b) {
      const clickT = target.t;
      const hitT = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, hit.u));
      if (clickT < hitT) {
        // remove start side - new start = hit
        ent.a = { x: hit.x, y: hit.y };
      } else {
        ent.b = { x: hit.x, y: hit.y };
      }
      this.redoStack = [];
      this.emit();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * EXTEND: pick boundary near `boundaryPt`, then segment near `targetPt`.
   * Extends the target until it meets the boundary line.
   */
  extendTo(boundaryPt: CadPt, targetPt: CadPt, pickRadius = 30): boolean {
    const boundary = this.nearestSeg(boundaryPt);
    const target = this.nearestSeg(targetPt);
    if (!boundary || !target || boundary.id === target.id) return false;
    if (boundary.dist > pickRadius || target.dist > pickRadius) return false;

    // Treat boundary as infinite line for intersection
    const bdx = boundary.b.x - boundary.a.x;
    const bdy = boundary.b.y - boundary.a.y;
    const tdx = target.b.x - target.a.x;
    const tdy = target.b.y - target.a.y;
    // Extend target ray from the nearer endpoint to the click
    const useStart = target.t < 0.5;
    const origin = useStart ? target.a : target.b;
    // Direction away from segment center
    const dir = useStart
      ? { x: target.a.x - target.b.x, y: target.a.y - target.b.y }
      : { x: target.b.x - target.a.x, y: target.b.y - target.a.y };
    const far = {
      x: origin.x + dir.x * 50,
      y: origin.y + dir.y * 50,
    };
    const hit = CadEngine.segIntersect(
      boundary.a,
      { x: boundary.a.x + bdx * 20, y: boundary.a.y + bdy * 20 },
      origin,
      far,
    );
    // Better: infinite line-line
    const den = bdx * dir.y - bdy * dir.x;
    if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) return false;
    const t = ((origin.x - boundary.a.x) * dir.y - (origin.y - boundary.a.y) * dir.x) / (bdx * dir.y - bdy * dir.x);
    // Actually solve properly
    const hit2 = CadEngine.segIntersect(
      boundary.a,
      boundary.b,
      origin,
      { x: origin.x + dir.x * 1000, y: origin.y + dir.y * 1000 },
    );
    if (!hit2) return false;

    const ent = this.entities[target.index];
    if (!ent || ent.kind !== "line" || !ent.b) return false;

    if (useStart) {
      ent.a = { x: hit2.x, y: hit2.y };
    } else {
      ent.b = { x: hit2.x, y: hit2.y };
    }
    this.redoStack = [];
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * FILLET two lines near the pick points with radius (px).
   * Trims both to the fillet and inserts an arc.
   */
  filletAt(pt1: CadPt, pt2: CadPt, radius: number, pickRadius = 30): boolean {
    const s1 = this.nearestSeg(pt1);
    const s2 = this.nearestSeg(pt2);
    if (!s1 || !s2 || s1.id === s2.id) return false;
    if (s1.dist > pickRadius || s2.dist > pickRadius) return false;
    if (radius < 1) radius = 1;

    const hit = CadEngine.segIntersect(s1.a, s1.b, s2.a, s2.b);
    if (!hit) return false;

    // Unit dirs
    const d1 = { x: s1.b.x - s1.a.x, y: s1.b.y - s1.a.y };
    const len1 = Math.hypot(d1.x, d1.y) || 1;
    d1.x /= len1;
    d1.y /= len1;
    const d2 = { x: s2.b.x - s2.a.x, y: s2.b.y - s2.a.y };
    const len2 = Math.hypot(d2.x, d2.y) || 1;
    d2.x /= len2;
    d2.y /= len2;

    // Angle between
    const dot = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d1.x * d2.x + d1.y * d2.y));
    const ang = Math.acos(dot);
    if (ang < 0.05 || ang > Math.PI - 0.05) return false;

    const distToTangent = radius / Math.tan(ang / 2);

    // Which ends meet at the intersection? Use hit params
    const t1 = hit.t;
    const t2 = hit.u;

    // Trim line 1: keep the part away from the intersection side that was clicked
    const ent1 = this.entities[s1.index];
    const ent2 = this.entities[s2.index];
    if (!ent1 || !ent2 || ent1.kind !== "line" || ent2.kind !== "line" || !ent1.b || !ent2.b) {
      return false;
    }

    // Tangent points roughly along each segment from intersection
    const sign1 = t1 > 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    const sign2 = t2 > 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    const tan1 = {
      x: hit.x + d1.x * distToTangent * sign1,
      y: hit.y + d1.y * distToTangent * sign1,
    };
    const tan2 = {
      x: hit.x + d2.x * distToTangent * sign2,
      y: hit.y + d2.y * distToTangent * sign2,
    };

    // Update endpoints nearest the intersection
    if (t1 < 0.5) ent1.a = tan1;
    else ent1.b = tan1;
    if (t2 < 0.5) ent2.a = tan2;
    else ent2.b = tan2;

    // Arc center - intersection offset along angle bisector
    const bis = { x: d1.x * sign1 + d2.x * sign2, y: d1.y * sign1 + d2.y * sign2 };
    const bl = Math.hypot(bis.x, bis.y) || 1;
    bis.x /= bl;
    bis.y /= bl;
    // Perp of d1 for left/right - use average of normals
    const n1 = { x: -d1.y * sign1, y: d1.x * sign1 };
    const n2 = { x: -d2.y * sign2, y: d2.x * sign2 };
    let nx = n1.x + n2.x;
    let ny = n1.y + n2.y;
    const nl = Math.hypot(nx, ny) || 1;
    nx /= nl;
    ny /= nl;
    const center = { x: hit.x + nx * radius, y: hit.y + ny * radius };

    const a0 = Math.atan2(tan1.y - center.y, tan1.x - center.x);
    const a1 = Math.atan2(tan2.y - center.y, tan2.x - center.x);
    this.addArc(center, radius, a0, a1);
    this.redoStack = [];
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  /** Distance between two points (screen px). */
  distance(a: CadPt, b: CadPt): number {
    return Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
  }

  /** Delete entity by id. */
  deleteById(id: string): boolean {
    const i = this.entities.findIndex((e) => e.id === id);
    if (i < 0) return false;
    const [removed] = this.entities.splice(i, 1);
    this.redoStack.push(removed);
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  /** Pick nearest entity to point within radius. */
  pickEntity(p: CadPt, radius = 20): CadEntity | null {
    let best: { e: CadEntity; d: number } | null = null;
    for (const e of this.listEntities()) {
      let d = Infinity;
      if (e.kind === "line" && e.b) {
        const dx = e.b.x - e.a.x;
        const dy = e.b.y - e.a.y;
        const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
        let t = ((p.x - e.a.x) * dx + (p.y - e.a.y) * dy) / len2;
        t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
        d = Math.hypot(p.x - (e.a.x + t * dx), p.y - (e.a.y + t * dy));
      } else if (e.kind === "circle" && e.r != null) {
        d = Math.abs(Math.hypot(p.x - e.a.x, p.y - e.a.y) - e.r);
      } else if (e.kind === "rect" && e.b) {
        const minX = Math.min(e.a.x, e.b.x);
        const maxX = Math.max(e.a.x, e.b.x);
        const minY = Math.min(e.a.y, e.b.y);
        const maxY = Math.max(e.a.y, e.b.y);
        const cx = Math.max(minX, Math.min(maxX, p.x));
        const cy = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, p.y));
        d = Math.hypot(p.x - cx, p.y - cy);
      } else {
        d = Math.hypot(p.x - e.a.x, p.y - e.a.y);
      }
      if (d <= radius && (!best || d < best.d)) best = { e, d };
    }
    return best?.e ?? null;
  }

  setLayerLocked(id: string, locked: boolean): void {
    const l = this.layers.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (l) {
      l.locked = locked;
      this.emit();
    }
  }

  setLayerColor(id: string, color: string): void {
    const l = this.layers.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (l) {
      l.color = color;
      this.emit();
    }
  }

  renameLayer(id: string, name: string): void {
    const l = this.layers.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (l) {
      l.name = name;
      this.emit();
    }
  }

}

export const cadEngine = new CadEngine();
```

```ts
/**
 * Shared HTTP helpers for CDE providers.
 * Handles JSON parsing, error normalisation, and AbortSignal plumbing.
 */
import { diagnostics } from "../../core/diagnostics";

export interface RequestOptions {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  /** If true, body is sent as-is (Blob/FormData). */
  raw?: boolean;
}

export async function requestJson<T>(url: string, opts: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const res = await requestRaw(url, opts);
  const text = await res.text();
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text) as T;
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid JSON from ${url}: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
}

export async function requestRaw(url: string, opts: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<Response> {
  const headers = { ...opts.headers };
  let body: BodyInit | undefined;

  if (opts.raw) {
    body = opts.body as BodyInit;
  } else if (opts.body !== undefined) {
    headers["Content-Type"] ??= "application/json";
    body = JSON.stringify(opts.body);
  }

  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(url, {
      method: opts.method ?? "GET",
      headers,
      body,
      signal: opts.signal,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.warn("cde.http", `network error: ${url}`, err);
    throw new Error(`Network error reaching ${hostOf(url)} — check your connection.`);
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    const msg = classify(res.status, res.statusText, text);
    diagnostics.warn("cde.http", `${res.status} ${url}`, text.slice(0, 300));
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  return res;
}

function hostOf(url: string): string {
  try { return new URL(url).host; } catch { return url; }
}

function classify(status: number, text: string, body: string): string {
  const snippet = body.length > 220 ? body.slice(0, 220) + "…" : body;
  switch (status) {
    case 401: return `401 Unauthorized … sign in again. ${snippet}`;
    case 403: return `403 Forbidden … your account lacks access. ${snippet}`;
    case 404: return `404 Not Found — check the URL. ${snippet}`;
    case 429: return `429 Rate limited … wait a moment. ${snippet}`;
    case 500: case 502: case 503: case 504:
      return `${status} … the provider is having issues. ${snippet}`;
    default:  return `${status} ${text} ${snippet}`;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Built-in CDE providers.
 *
 * Token-based providers (Autodesk, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive,
 * Dropbox) expect a bearer token that the user has already obtained. This
 * is deliberate: a pure browser app cannot perform an OAuth authorization
 * code flow without a server to hold the client secret.
 *
 * WebDAV is fully self-contained — it speaks the protocol directly with
 * HTTP Basic auth, so it works against Nextcloud, ownCloud, SharePoint on
 * premises, IIS, Apache mod_dav, or any standards-compliant DAV server.
 */
import {
  registerCdeProvider,
} from "./registry";
import type {
  CdeCredentials,
  CdeFile,
  CdeFolder,
  CdeProject,
  CdeProvider,
  CdeProviderMeta,
  CdeSession,
} from "./types";

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Shared helpers
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function joinUrl(base: string, path: string): string {
  const b = base.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  const p = path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`;
  return b + p;
}

async function httpError(res: Response, label: string): Promise<Error> {
  const body = await res.text().catch(() => "");
  const trimmed = body.length > 240 ? `${body.slice(0, 240)}…` : body;
  return new Error(
    `${label} ${res.status} ${res.statusText}` +
      (trimmed ? `\n\n${trimmed}` : ""),
  );
}

function bearer(token: string | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Autodesk Platform Services (APS) / BIM 360
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const AUTODESK_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "autodesk",
  label: "Autodesk Platform Services",
  description:
    "Access BIM 360 / ACC hubs, projects, folders and files via the " +
    "Autodesk Platform Services Data Management API. Paste a valid " +
    "3-legged or 2-legged OAuth token.",
  icon: "🅰",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: false,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "token",
      label: "Access token",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "eyJhbGciOi…",
      hint:
        "Get a token from the APS developer portal or your OAuth flow. " +
        "Tokens expire after 60 minutes.",
    },
    {
      key: "region",
      label: "Region",
      type: "text",
      required: false,
      defaultValue: "US",
      hint: "US, EMEA, or APAC. Defaults to US.",
    },
  ],
};

const autodeskProvider: CdeProvider = {
  meta: AUTODESK_META,

  async authenticate(creds) {
    const token = (creds.token ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("An access token is required.");
    return {
      providerId: "autodesk",
      accessToken: token,
      extra: { region: (creds.region ?? "US").toUpperCase() },
    };
  },

  async listProjects(session) {
    const region = String(session.extra?.region ?? "US");
    const host =
      region === "EMEA" ? "https://developer.api.autodesk.com"
      : region === "APAC" ? "https://developer.api.autodesk.com"
      : "https://developer.api.autodesk.com";
    const url = joinUrl(host, "/project/v1/hubs");
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Autodesk hubs");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    const hubs: any[] = json?.data ?? [];

    const projects: CdeProject[] = [];
    for (const hub of hubs) {
      const href: string = hub?.relationships?.projects?.links?.related?.href;
      if (!href) continue;
      const pr = await fetch(href, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
      if (!pr.ok) continue;
      const pj: any = await pr.json();
      for (const p of pj?.data ?? []) {
        projects.push({
          id: `${hub.id}::${p.id}`,
          name: p?.attributes?.name ?? p.id,
          description: `Hub ${hub?.attributes?.name ?? hub.id}`,
        });
      }
    }
    return projects;
  },

  async listFolders(session, projectId, parentFolderId) {
    const [hubId, projectIdOnly] = projectId.split("::");
    if (!hubId || !projectIdOnly) {
      throw new Error("Autodesk project id is malformed.");
    }
    const url = joinUrl(
      "https://developer.api.autodesk.com",
      `/data/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectIdOnly ?? "")}/folders` +
        (parentFolderId ? `/${encodeURIComponent(parentFolderId)}/contents` : ""),
    );
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Autodesk folders");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    const out: CdeFolder[] = [];
    for (const item of json?.data ?? []) {
      if (item?.type !== "folders") continue;
      out.push({
        id: item.id,
        name: item?.attributes?.displayName ?? item.id,
        parentId: parentFolderId ?? null,
        updatedAt: item?.attributes?.lastModifiedTime
          ? Date.parse(item.attributes.lastModifiedTime) || undefined
          : undefined,
      });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async listFiles(session, projectId, folderId) {
    const [, projectIdOnly] = projectId.split("::");
    if (!projectIdOnly) throw new Error("Invalid ACC project id");
    const url = joinUrl(
      "https://developer.api.autodesk.com",
      `/data/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectIdOnly ?? "")}` +
        `/folders/${encodeURIComponent(folderId ?? "")}/contents`,
    );
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Autodesk files");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    const out: CdeFile[] = [];
    for (const item of json?.data ?? []) {
      if (item?.type !== "items") continue;
      const versionId: string | undefined =
        item?.relationships?.tip?.data?.id;
      if (!versionId) continue;
      out.push({
        id: versionId,
        name: item?.attributes?.displayName ?? item.id,
        size: item?.attributes?.storageSize ?? undefined,
        mimeType: item?.attributes?.fileType ?? undefined,
        updatedAt: item?.attributes?.lastModifiedTime
          ? Date.parse(item.attributes.lastModifiedTime) || undefined
          : undefined,
      });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async downloadFile(session, _projectId, versionId) {
    const url = joinUrl(
      "https://developer.api.autodesk.com",
      `/data/v1/versions/${encodeURIComponent(versionId)}/downloadurl`,
    );
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Autodesk download url");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    const signed = json?.url;
    if (!signed) throw new Error("Autodesk returned no download URL.");
    const bin = await fetch(signed);
    if (!bin.ok) throw await httpError(bin, "Autodesk download");
    return bin.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, projectId, folderId, filename, data) {
    const [, projectIdOnly] = projectId.split("::");
    if (!projectIdOnly) throw new Error("Invalid ACC project id");
    const url = joinUrl(
      "https://developer.api.autodesk.com",
      `/data/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectIdOnly ?? "")}` +
        `/folders/${encodeURIComponent(folderId ?? "")}/items`,
    );
    const body = {
      jsonapi: { version: "1.0" },
      data: {
        type: "items",
        attributes: {
          displayName: filename,
          extension: { type: "items:autodesk.bim360:File", version: "1.0" },
        },
        relationships: {
          tip: { data: { type: "versions", id: "1" } },
          parent: { data: { type: "folders", id: folderId } },
        },
      },
      included: [
        {
          type: "versions",
          id: "1",
          attributes: {
            name: filename,
            extension: { type: "versions:autodesk.bim360:File", version: "1.0" },
          },
        },
      ],
    };
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/vnd.api+json", ...bearer(session.accessToken) },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Autodesk create item");
    const created: any = await res.json();
    const itemId = created?.data?.id;
    if (!itemId) throw new Error("Autodesk did not return a new item id.");

    // Now push the binary.
    const storageUrl = joinUrl(
      "https://developer.api.autodesk.com",
      `/data/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectIdOnly ?? "")}` +
        `/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/versions/1/storage`,
    );
    const storageRes = await fetch(storageUrl, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!storageRes.ok) throw await httpError(storageRes, "Autodesk storage");
    const storageJson: any = await storageRes.json();
    const signed: string | undefined =
      storageJson?.data?.attributes?.uploadLink ??
      storageJson?.data?.relationships?.storage?.links?.upload;
    if (!signed) throw new Error("Autodesk returned no upload link.");

    const put = await fetch(signed, { method: "PUT", body: data });
    if (!put.ok) throw await httpError(put, "Autodesk upload");

    return { id: itemId, name: filename, size: data.size };
  },
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SharePoint (Graph API)
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const SHAREPOINT_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "sharepoint",
  label: "SharePoint",
  description:
    "Access SharePoint document libraries via the Microsoft Graph API. " +
    "Paste a bearer token issued for the Graph scope Files.ReadWrite.All " +
    "(or Sites.Read.All for read-only access).",
  icon: "🟦",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: false,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "token",
      label: "Graph access token",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1Qi…",
      hint:
        "Get a token from the Microsoft Graph Explorer, or your own " +
        "OAuth flow. Tokens last about 60 minutes.",
    },
    {
      key: "siteId",
      label: "Site id",
      type: "text",
      required: false,
      placeholder: "contoso.sharepoint.com,abcd-…,efgh-…",
      hint:
        "Optional. Leave blank to browse all sites you have access to.",
    },
  ],
};

const sharepointProvider: CdeProvider = {
  meta: SHAREPOINT_META,

  async authenticate(creds) {
    const token = (creds.token ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("A Graph access token is required.");
    return {
      providerId: "sharepoint",
      accessToken: token,
      extra: { siteId: creds.siteId || undefined },
    };
  },

  async listProjects(session) {
    const siteId = session.extra?.siteId as string | undefined;
    if (siteId) {
      const res = await fetch(
        `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/${encodeURIComponent(siteId)}`,
        { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) },
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "SharePoint site");
      const s: any = await res.json();
      return [{ id: s.id, name: s.displayName || s.name || s.id }];
    }
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites?search=*",
      { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) },
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "SharePoint sites");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.value ?? []).map((s: any) => ({
      id: s.id,
      name: s.displayName || s.name || s.id,
      description: s.webUrl,
    }));
  },

  async listFolders(session, siteId, parentFolderId) {
    const root = parentFolderId
      ? `/sites/${encodeURIComponent(siteId)}/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(parentFolderId)}/children`
      : `/sites/${encodeURIComponent(siteId)}/drive/root/children`;
    const res = await fetch(`https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0${root}`, {
      headers: bearer(session.accessToken),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "SharePoint folders");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.value ?? [])
      .filter((x: any) => x.folder)
      .map((x: any) => ({
        id: x.id,
        name: x.name,
        parentId: parentFolderId ?? null,
        updatedAt: x.lastModifiedDateTime ? Date.parse(x.lastModifiedDateTime) : undefined,
      }));
  },

  async listFiles(session, siteId, folderId) {
    const url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/${encodeURIComponent(siteId)}/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(folderId ?? "")}/children`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "SharePoint files");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.value ?? [])
      .filter((x: any) => x.file)
      .map((x: any) => ({
        id: x.id,
        name: x.name,
        size: x.size,
        mimeType: x.file?.mimeType,
        updatedAt: x.lastModifiedDateTime ? Date.parse(x.lastModifiedDateTime) : undefined,
      }));
  },

  async downloadFile(session, siteId, fileId) {
    const url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/${encodeURIComponent(siteId)}/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}/content`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "SharePoint download");
    return res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, siteId, folderId, filename, data) {
    const url =
      `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/${encodeURIComponent(siteId)}` +
      `/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(folderId ?? "")}:/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}:/content`;
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream", ...bearer(session.accessToken) },
      body: data,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "SharePoint upload");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return { id: json.id, name: json.name, size: json.size };
  },
};

const ONEDRIVE_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "onedrive",
  label: "OneDrive",
  description:
    "Access OneDrive via the Microsoft Graph API. Same token as " +
    "SharePoint, but the drive is the signed-in user's personal drive.",
  icon: "🟦",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: false,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "token",
      label: "Graph access token",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      hint: "Scope: Files.ReadWrite.All",
    },
  ],
};

const onedriveProvider: CdeProvider = {
  meta: ONEDRIVE_META,

  async authenticate(creds) {
    const token = (creds.token ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("A Graph access token is required.");
    return { providerId: "onedrive", accessToken: token };
  },

  async listProjects() {
    // OneDrive has a single implicit project: "My Drive".
    return [{ id: "me", name: "My Drive" }];
  },

  async listFolders(session, _projectId, parentFolderId) {
    const path = parentFolderId
      ? `/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(parentFolderId)}/children`
      : "/me/drive/root/children";
    const res = await fetch(`https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0${path}`, {
      headers: bearer(session.accessToken),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "OneDrive folders");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.value ?? [])
      .filter((x: any) => x.folder)
      .map((x: any) => ({
        id: x.id,
        name: x.name,
        parentId: parentFolderId ?? null,
        updatedAt: x.lastModifiedDateTime ? Date.parse(x.lastModifiedDateTime) : undefined,
      }));
  },

  async listFiles(session, _projectId, folderId) {
    const url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(folderId ?? "")}/children`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "OneDrive files");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.value ?? [])
      .filter((x: any) => x.file)
      .map((x: any) => ({
        id: x.id,
        name: x.name,
        size: x.size,
        mimeType: x.file?.mimeType,
        updatedAt: x.lastModifiedDateTime ? Date.parse(x.lastModifiedDateTime) : undefined,
      }));
  },

  async downloadFile(session, _projectId, fileId) {
    const url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}/content`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "OneDrive download");
    return res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, _projectId, folderId, filename, data) {
    const url =
      `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(folderId ?? "")}` +
      `:/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}:/content`;
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream", ...bearer(session.accessToken) },
      body: data,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "OneDrive upload");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return { id: json.id, name: json.name, size: json.size };
  },
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Google Drive
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const GDRIVE_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "googledrive",
  label: "Google Drive",
  description:
    "Access Google Drive via the Drive v3 API. Paste an OAuth token with " +
    "scope drive.readonly (read) or drive.file (read + upload).",
  icon: "🟢",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: false,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "token",
      label: "Access token",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "ya29.a0…",
      hint: "Get one from OAuth 2.0 Playground with the Drive scope.",
    },
  ],
};

const gdriveProvider: CdeProvider = {
  meta: GDRIVE_META,

  async authenticate(creds) {
    const token = (creds.token ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("A Drive access token is required.");
    return { providerId: "googledrive", accessToken: token };
  },

  async listProjects() {
    return [{ id: "root", name: "My Drive" }];
  },

  async listFolders(session, _projectId, parentFolderId) {
    const q = `'${parentFolderId ?? "root"}' in parents and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed = false`;
    const url = new URL("https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files");
    url.searchParams.set("q", q);
    url.searchParams.set("fields", "files(id,name,modifiedTime)");
    url.searchParams.set("pageSize", "200");
    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Drive folders");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.files ?? []).map((f: any) => ({
      id: f.id,
      name: f.name,
      parentId: parentFolderId ?? null,
      updatedAt: f.modifiedTime ? Date.parse(f.modifiedTime) : undefined,
    }));
  },

  async listFiles(session, _projectId, folderId) {
    const q = `'${folderId}' in parents and mimeType != 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed = false`;
    const url = new URL("https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files");
    url.searchParams.set("q", q);
    url.searchParams.set("fields", "files(id,name,size,mimeType,modifiedTime)");
    url.searchParams.set("pageSize", "200");
    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Drive files");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.files ?? []).map((f: any) => ({
      id: f.id,
      name: f.name,
      size: f.size ? Number(f.size) : undefined,
      mimeType: f.mimeType,
      updatedAt: f.modifiedTime ? Date.parse(f.modifiedTime) : undefined,
    }));
  },

  async downloadFile(session, _projectId, fileId) {
    const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?alt=media`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: bearer(session.accessToken) });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Drive download");
    return res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, _projectId, folderId, filename, data) {
    const metadata = { name: filename, parents: [folderId] };
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("metadata", new Blob([JSON.stringify(metadata)], { type: "application/json" }));
    form.append("file", data, filename);
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart",
      { method: "POST", headers: bearer(session.accessToken), body: form },
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Drive upload");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return { id: json.id, name: json.name };
  },
};

const DROPBOX_META: CdeProviderMeta = {

  label: "Dropbox",
  description:
    "Access Dropbox via the Dropbox API v2. Paste an access token with " +

const dropboxProvider: CdeProvider = {
  meta: DROPBOX_META,

  async authenticate(creds) {
    const token = (creds.token ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("A Dropbox access token is required.");
    return { providerId: "dropbox", accessToken: token };
  },

  async listProjects() {
    return [{ id: "root", name: "Dropbox" }];
  },

  async listFolders(session, _projectId, parentFolderId) {
    const path = parentFolderId ?? "";
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/list_folder",
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...bearer(session.accessToken),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ path, recursive: false }),
      },
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Dropbox folders");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.entries ?? [])
      .filter((e: any) => e[".tag"] === "folder")
      .map((e: any) => ({
        id: e.path_lower,
        name: e.name,
        parentId: parentFolderId ?? null,
      }));
  },

  async listFiles(session, _projectId, folderId) {
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/list_folder",
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...bearer(session.accessToken),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ path: folderId, recursive: false }),
      },
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Dropbox files");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return (json?.entries ?? [])
      .filter((e: any) => e[".tag"] === "file")
      .map((e: any) => ({
        id: e.path_lower,
        name: e.name,
        size: e.size,
        updatedAt: e.server_modified ? Date.parse(e.server_modified) : undefined,
      }));
  },

  async downloadFile(session, _projectId, fileId) {
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/download",
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}`,
          "Dropbox-API-Arg": JSON.stringify({ path: fileId }),
        },
      },
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Dropbox download");
    return res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, _projectId, folderId, filename, data) {
    const path = folderId === "/" ? `/${filename}` : `${folderId}/${filename}`;
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload",
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
          "Dropbox-API-Arg": JSON.stringify({
            path,
            mode: "overwrite",
            autorename: false,
            mute: true,
          }),
        },
        body: data,
      },
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "Dropbox upload");
    const json: any = await res.json();
    return { id: json.path_lower, name: json.name, size: json.size };
  },
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Generic WebDAV
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const WEBDAV_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "webdav",
  label: "WebDAV",
  description:
    "Any standards-compliant WebDAV server: Nextcloud, ownCloud, " +
    "SharePoint on premises, Apache mod_dav, IIS. Uses HTTP Basic auth — " +
    "no token required.",
  icon: "🌐",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: false,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "endpoint",
      label: "Server URL",
      type: "url",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me",
      hint: "The base path of the DAV share.",
    },
    {
      key: "username",
      label: "Username",
      type: "text",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "alice",
    },
    {
      key: "password",
      label: "Password",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      hint:
        "For Nextcloud/ownCloud, generate an app-specific password " +
        "rather than using your account password.",
    },
  ],
};

function basicAuth(user: string, pass: string): string {
  // btoa on Latin-1 only. Encode UTF-8 first so non-ASCII passwords work.
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(`${user}:${pass}`);
  let bin = "";
  for (const b of bytes) bin += String.fromCharCode(b);
  return `Basic ${btoa(bin)}`;
}

function parseDavResponse(xml: string, baseUrl: string): {
  href: string;
  name: string;
  isFolder: boolean;
  size?: number;
  modified?: number;
}[] {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(xml, "application/xml");
  const responses = Array.from(doc.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "response"));
  const out: ReturnType<typeof parseDavResponse> = [];

  for (const r of responses) {
    const hrefEl = r.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "href")[0];
    const href = hrefEl?.textContent ?? "";
    if (!href) continue;

    // The first entry is the collection itself — skip it.
    const isCollection = r.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "collection").length > 0;
    let decoded = href;
    try { decoded = decodeURIComponent(href); } catch { /* */ }
    // Strip trailing slash so the basename logic is uniform.
    const trimmed = decoded.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const name = trimmed.split("/").pop() ?? "";

    const sizeEl = r.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "getcontentlength")[0];
    const size = sizeEl?.textContent ? Number(sizeEl.textContent) : undefined;

    const modEl = r.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "getlastmodified")[0];
    const modified = modEl?.textContent ? Date.parse(modEl.textContent) : undefined;

    // Absolute-ize the href against the base URL.
    let absolute: string;
    try {
      absolute = new URL(href, baseUrl).toString();
    } catch {
      absolute = href;
    }

    out.push({ href: absolute, name, isFolder: isCollection, size, modified });
  }

  // Strip the collection self-entry (first response with no name).
  return out.filter((e) => e.name !== "");
}

const webdavProvider: CdeProvider = {
  meta: WEBDAV_META,

  async authenticate(creds) {
    const endpoint = (creds.endpoint ?? "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const username = (creds.username ?? "").trim();
    const password = creds.password ?? "";
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error("A server URL is required.");
    if (!username) throw new Error("A username is required.");
    if (!password) throw new Error("A password is required.");

    // Validate by requesting the root collection.
    const res = await fetch(endpoint + "/", {
      method: "PROPFIND",
      headers: {
        Authorization: basicAuth(username, password),
        Depth: "0",
        "Content-Type": "application/xml",
      },
      body:
        `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>` +
        `<d:propfind xmlns:d="DAV:"><d:prop><d:displayname/></d:prop></d:propfind>`,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "WebDAV authenticate");

    return {
      providerId: "webdav",
      user: { name: username },
      extra: {
        endpoint,
        auth: basicAuth(username, password),
      },
    };
  },

  async listProjects(session) {
    const endpoint = String(session.extra?.endpoint ?? "");
    return [{ id: endpoint, name: "WebDAV share", description: endpoint }];
  },

  async listFolders(session, _projectId, parentFolderId) {
    const endpoint = String(session.extra?.endpoint ?? "");
    const auth = String(session.extra?.auth ?? "");
    const target = parentFolderId || endpoint;

    const res = await fetch(target.endsWith("/") ? target : target + "/", {
      method: "PROPFIND",
      headers: { Authorization: auth, Depth: "1" },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "WebDAV folders");
    const xml = await res.text();
    const entries = parseDavResponse(xml, target);
    return entries
      .filter((e) => e.isFolder)
      .map((e) => ({
        id: e.href,
        name: e.name,
        parentId: parentFolderId ?? null,
        updatedAt: e.modified,
      }));
  },

  async listFiles(session, _projectId, folderId) {
    const auth = String(session.extra?.auth ?? "");
    const res = await fetch((folderId ?? "").endsWith("/") ? (folderId ?? "") : (folderId ?? "") + "/", {
      method: "PROPFIND",
      headers: { Authorization: auth, Depth: "1" },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "WebDAV files");
    const xml = await res.text();
    const entries = parseDavResponse(xml, folderId ?? "");
    return entries
      .filter((e) => !e.isFolder)
      .map((e) => ({
        id: e.href,
        name: e.name,
        size: e.size,
        updatedAt: e.modified,
      }));
  },

  async downloadFile(session, _projectId, fileId) {
    const auth = String(session.extra?.auth ?? "");
    const res = await fetch(fileId, { headers: { Authorization: auth } });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "WebDAV download");
    return res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, _projectId, folderId, filename, data) {
    const auth = String(session.extra?.auth ?? "");
    const target =
      (folderId.endsWith("/") ? folderId : folderId + "/") +
      encodeURIComponent(filename);
    const res = await fetch(target, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: {
        Authorization: auth,
        "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
      },
      body: data,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw await httpError(res, "WebDAV upload");
    return { id: target, name: filename, size: data.size };
  },
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Registration
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let registered = false;

/**
 * Register every built-in provider. Safe to call more than once.
 * Idempotent so the CDE panel and the AI tools can both call it during
 * boot without producing duplicate entries.
 */
export function registerCdeProviders(): void {
  if (registered) return;
  registered = true;

  registerCdeProvider(autodeskProvider);
  registerCdeProvider(sharepointProvider);
  registerCdeProvider(onedriveProvider);
  registerCdeProvider(gdriveProvider);
  registerCdeProvider(dropboxProvider);
  registerCdeProvider(webdavProvider);

  console.log("[cde] 6 providers registered");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 provider.
 *
 * Uses the Autodesk Platform Services (APS / Forge) Data Management API:
 *   • OAuth 2.0 3-legged flow — user pastes an access token generated from
 *     a small helper script (see docs), OR uses a server-side proxy for the
 *     full flow. In this module we accept a pasted access token, which is
 *     the most common integration pattern for desktop-like tools.
 *
 * Required credentials:
 *   • accessToken — APS access token (auto-expires after ~1 hour)
 *
 * Endpoints used:
 *   • GET /project/v1/hubs                     — list hubs
 *   • GET /project/v1/hubs/:hubId/projects     — list projects in a hub
 *   • GET /data/v1/projects/:projectId/folders/:folderId/contents
 *   • GET /data/v1/projects/:projectId/items/:itemId
 */
import { requestJson, requestRaw } from "../http";
import type {
  CdeCredentials, CdeFile, CdeFolder, CdeIssue, CdeProject, CdeProvider,
  CdeProviderId, CdeProviderMeta, CdeSession,
} from "../types";

const BASE = "https://developer.api.autodesk.com";

export const ACC_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "acc",
  label: "Autodesk Construction Cloud",
  description:
    "BIM 360 / ACC — pull the latest model revision from a Docs folder, " +
    "or push issues back to the project.",
  icon: "🏗",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: true,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "accessToken",
      label: "Access token",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "eyJhbGciOi…",
      hint:
        "Generate from the Autodesk Platform Services portal → " +
        "Your App → Get Access Token (data:read, data:write scopes).",
    },
    {
      key: "hubId",
      label: "Hub ID (optional)",
      type: "text",
      required: false,
      placeholder: "b.xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx",
      hint: "Leave blank to list hubs when signing in.",
    },
  ],
};

function authHeader(session: CdeSession): Record<string, string> {
  return { Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}` };
}

export const accProvider: CdeProvider = {
  id: "acc",

  async authenticate(credentials: CdeCredentials): Promise<CdeSession> {
    const token = (credentials.accessToken ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("Access token is required.");
    // Verify by calling /userprofile/v1/users/@me
    const user = await requestJson<any>(`${BASE}/userprofile/v1/users/@me`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
    return {
      providerId: "acc",
      accessToken: token,
      user: { name: user?.name ?? user?.emailId ?? "ACC user", email: user?.emailId },
      // APS tokens are opaque; we don't know exact expiry, so treat as 1h.
      expiresAt: Date.now() + 55 * 60 * 1000,
    };
  },

  async listProjects(session: CdeSession): Promise<CdeProject[]> {
    const hubs = await requestJson<any>(`${BASE}/project/v1/hubs`, {
      headers: authHeader(session),
    });
    const out: CdeProject[] = [];
    for (const hub of hubs?.data ?? []) {
      try {
        const projs = await requestJson<any>(
          `${BASE}/project/v1/hubs/${hub.id}/projects`,
          { headers: authHeader(session) },
        );
        for (const p of projs?.data ?? []) {
          out.push({
            id: `${hub.id}::${p.id}`,
            name: `${p.attributes?.name ?? p.id}  ·  ${hub.attributes?.name ?? hub.id}`,
            description: p.attributes?.extension?.data?.projectType,
          });
        }
      } catch { /* skip hubs that don't grant access */ }
    }
    return out;
  },

  async listFolders(session, projectId, parentId): Promise<CdeFolder[]> {
    const { hubId, projectId: projId } = splitId(projectId);
    const parent = parentId ?? "urn:adsk.wipprod:fs.folder:co.root";
    const url =
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/folders/${encodeURIComponent(parent)}/contents`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, { headers: authHeader(session) });
    const out: CdeFolder[] = [];
    for (const item of json?.data ?? []) {
      if (item.type !== "folders") continue;
      out.push({
        id: item.id,
        name: item.attributes?.displayName ?? item.id,
        parentId: parentId ?? null,
        path: item.attributes?.path,
      });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async listFiles(session, projectId, folderId): Promise<CdeFile[]> {
    const { projectId: projId } = splitId(projectId);
    const url =
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/folders/${encodeURIComponent(folderId || "")}/contents`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, { headers: authHeader(session) });
    const out: CdeFile[] = [];
    for (const item of json?.data ?? []) {
      if (item.type !== "items") continue;
      out.push({
        id: item.id,
        name: item.attributes?.displayName ?? item.id,
        size: item.attributes?.storageSize,
        updatedAt: Date.parse(item.attributes?.lastModifiedTime ?? "") || undefined,
        version: item.attributes?.versionNumber ? String(item.attributes.versionNumber) : undefined,
        folderId,
        mimeType: item.attributes?.mimeType,
      });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async downloadFile(session, projectId, fileId): Promise<Blob> {
    // 1. Resolve the item's tip version
    const { projectId: projId } = splitId(projectId);
    const item = await requestJson<any>(
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/items/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}/tip`,
      { headers: authHeader(session) },
    );
    const storageId = item?.data?.relationships?.storage?.data?.id;
    if (!storageId) throw new Error("Item has no storage — it may be an empty folder.");

    // 2. Ask for a signed download URL
    const signed = await requestJson<any>(
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/items/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}` +
      `?version=${item.data.id}`,
      { headers: authHeader(session) },
    );
    const dl = signed?.data?.attributes?.storageSize
      ? null
      : null; // fallback path

    // 3. Prefer the documented endpoint
    const res = await requestRaw(
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/versions/${item.data.id}/downloadFormats`,
      { headers: authHeader(session) },
    );
    const formats = await res.json() as any;
    const url = formats?.data?.attributes?.formats?.[0]?.url ?? null;
    if (!url) throw new Error("Autodesk returned no download URL for this item.");

    const blob = await requestRaw(url);
    return await blob.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, projectId, folderId, name, data): Promise<CdeFile> {
    const { projectId: projId } = splitId(projectId);

    // 1. Create a storage location
    const storage = await requestJson<any>(
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/storage`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: authHeader(session),
        body: {
          data: {
            type: "objects",
            attributes: { name },
            relationships: {
              target: { data: { type: "folders", id: folderId } },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    );
    const objectId = storage?.data?.id;
    const uploadUrl = storage?.data?.links?.upload?.href;
    if (!uploadUrl) throw new Error("Autodesk returned no upload URL.");

    // 2. PUT to the signed URL
    await requestRaw(uploadUrl, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream" },
      body: data,
      raw: true,
    });

    // 3. Create the item version
    const item = await requestJson<any>(
      `${BASE}/data/v1/projects/${projId}/items`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: authHeader(session),
        body: {
          data: {
            type: "items",
            attributes: { displayName: name, extension: { type: "items:autodesk.bim360:File", version: "1.0" } },
            relationships: {
              tip: { data: { type: "versions", id: "1" } },
              parent: { data: { type: "folders", id: folderId } },
            },
          },
          included: [{
            type: "versions",
            id: "1",
            attributes: {
              name,
              extension: { type: "versions:autodesk.bim360:File", version: "1.0" },
            },
            relationships: {
              storage: { data: { type: "objects", id: objectId } },
            },
          }],
        },
      },
    );

    return {
      id: item?.data?.id ?? objectId,
      name,
      size: data.size,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      folderId,
    };
  },

  async createIssue(session, projectId, issue: CdeIssue): Promise<{ id: string; url?: string }> {
    // BIM 360 issues endpoint varies by region and product. We use the
    // generic Issues API which is available to most ACC tenants.
    const { projectId: projId } = splitId(projectId);
    const url = `${BASE}/issues/v1/containers/${projId}/issues`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: authHeader(session),
      body: {
        title: issue.title,
        description: issue.description,
        status: issue.status ?? "open",
        assignedTo: issue.assignee,
        dueDate: issue.dueDate,
      },
    });
    return { id: json?.id ?? "", url: json?.links?.web };
  },
};

function splitId(combined: string): { hubId: string; projectId: string } {
  const [hubId, projectId] = combined.split("::");
  return { hubId: hubId ?? "", projectId: projectId ?? combined };
}
```
