```ts
/**
 * Dalux provider.
 *
 * Dalux uses a REST API with API keys (Dalux Field / Dalux Box).
 * The user pastes:
 *   • API key (from Dalux → Account → Integrations)
 *   • Base URL (usually https://field.dalux.com/service/api)
 *
 * Documentation: https://docs.dalux.com/
 */
import { requestJson, requestRaw } from "../http";
import type {
  CdeCredentials, CdeFile, CdeFolder, CdeIssue, CdeProject, CdeProvider,
  CdeProviderId, CdeProviderMeta, CdeSession,
} from "../types";

export const DALUX_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "dalux",
  label: "Dalux",
  description:
    "Dalux Field / Dalux Box — pull models and push coordination issues.",
  icon: "◆",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: true,
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "apiKey",
      label: "API key",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      placeholder: "paste your Dalux API key",
      hint: "Dalux → Admin → Integrations → API Keys.",
    },
    {
      key: "baseUrl",
      label: "Base URL",
      type: "url",
      required: true,
      defaultValue: "https://field.dalux.com/service/api",
    },
  ],
};

function headers(session: CdeSession): Record<string, string> {
  return { "X-API-KEY": session.accessToken ?? "" };
}

function base(session: CdeSession): string {
  return session.refreshToken ?? "https://field.dalux.com/service/api";
}

export const daluxProvider: CdeProvider = {
  id: "dalux",

  async authenticate(credentials): Promise<CdeSession> {
    const key = (credentials.apiKey ?? "").trim();
    const baseUrl = (credentials.baseUrl ?? "").trim() || DALUX_META.credentialFields[1].defaultValue!;
    if (!key) throw new Error("API key is required.");
    // Verify by hitting /users/me
    const me = await requestJson<any>(`${baseUrl}/users/me`, {
      headers: { "X-API-KEY": key },
    });
    return {
      providerId: "dalux",
      accessToken: key,
      refreshToken: baseUrl,
      user: {
        name: me?.name ?? me?.displayName ?? "Dalux user",
        email: me?.email,
      },
    };
  },

  async listProjects(session): Promise<CdeProject[]> {
    const json = await requestJson<any>(`${base(session)}/projects`, {
      headers: headers(session),
    });
    return (json?.data ?? json ?? []).map((p: any) => ({
      id: String(p.id ?? p.projectId),
      name: p.name ?? p.title ?? String(p.id),
      description: p.description,
    }));
  },

  async listFolders(session, projectId, parentId): Promise<CdeFolder[]> {
    const url = parentId
      ? `${base(session)}/projects/${projectId}/folders/${parentId}`
      : `${base(session)}/projects/${projectId}/folders`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, { headers: headers(session) });
    return (json?.data ?? json ?? []).map((f: any) => ({
      id: String(f.id ?? f.folderId),
      name: f.name ?? f.title ?? String(f.id),
      parentId,
    }));
  },

  async listFiles(session, projectId, folderId): Promise<CdeFile[]> {
    const url = `${base(session)}/projects/${projectId}/folders/${folderId}/files`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, { headers: headers(session) });
    return (json?.data ?? json ?? []).map((f: any) => ({
      id: String(f.id ?? f.fileId),
      name: f.name ?? f.fileName ?? String(f.id),
      size: Number(f.size ?? f.fileSize) || undefined,
      updatedAt: Date.parse(f.updated ?? f.modified ?? "") || undefined,
      folderId,
    }));
  },

  async downloadFile(session, projectId, fileId): Promise<Blob> {
    const url = `${base(session)}/projects/${projectId}/files/${fileId}/download`;
    const res = await requestRaw(url, { headers: headers(session) });
    return await res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, projectId, folderId, name, data): Promise<CdeFile> {
    const url = `${base(session)}/projects/${projectId}/folders/${folderId}/files`;
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("file", data, name);
    const res = await requestRaw(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(session),
      body: form,
      raw: true,
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    return {
      id: String(json?.id ?? ""),
      name,
      size: data.size,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      folderId,
    };
  },

  async createIssue(session, projectId, issue): Promise<{ id: string; url?: string }> {
    const url = `${base(session)}/projects/${projectId}/issues`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(session),
      body: {
        title: issue.title,
        description: issue.description,
        status: issue.status ?? "New",
        assignee: issue.assignee,
        dueDate: issue.dueDate,
      },
    });
    return { id: String(json?.id ?? ""), url: json?.url };
  },
};
```

--- FILE: src/modules/cde/providers/sharepoint.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * SharePoint / OneDrive provider (Microsoft Graph).
 *
 * Uses delegated permissions. The user pastes an OAuth access token for
 * the Microsoft Graph API with `Files.ReadWrite.All` scope.
 *
 * To obtain a token interactively, use the Microsoft Graph Explorer
 * (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) and sign in with the
 * account that owns the SharePoint site.
 *
 * Required credentials:
 *   • accessToken — Graph API token
 *   • siteId      — SharePoint site ID (e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com,<guid>,<guid>)
 *                   Leave blank to use the signed-in user's OneDrive.
 */
import { requestJson, requestRaw } from "../http";
import type {
  CdeCredentials, CdeFile, CdeFolder, CdeIssue, CdeProject, CdeProvider,
  CdeProviderId, CdeProviderMeta, CdeSession,
} from "../types";

const GRAPH = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0";

export const SHAREPOINT_META: CdeProviderMeta = {
  id: "sharepoint",
  label: "SharePoint / OneDrive",
  description:
    "Microsoft Graph — pull and push files via SharePoint document libraries " +
    "or OneDrive for Business. Issues are written as .bcfzip attachments.",
  icon: "◈",
  pushEnabled: true,
  issuesEnabled: false, // issues are pushed as BCF files, not native issues
  credentialFields: [
    {
      key: "accessToken",
      label: "Graph access token",
      type: "password",
      required: true,
      hint:
        "From graph.microsoft.com → Graph Explorer → sign in → copy the " +
        "access token. Scope: Files.ReadWrite.All",
    },
    {
      key: "siteId",
      label: "SharePoint site ID",
      type: "text",
      required: false,
      placeholder: "contoso.sharepoint.com,abc…,def…",
      hint: "Leave blank to use the user's personal OneDrive.",
    },
  ],
};

function auth(session: CdeSession): Record<string, string> {
  return { Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}` };
}

function driveRoot(session: CdeSession): string {
  const siteId = session.refreshToken;
  return siteId
    ? `${GRAPH}/sites/${siteId}/drive`
    : `${GRAPH}/me/drive`;
}

export const sharepointProvider: CdeProvider = {
  id: "sharepoint",

  async authenticate(credentials: CdeCredentials): Promise<CdeSession> {
    const token = (credentials.accessToken ?? "").trim();
    const siteId = (credentials.siteId ?? "").trim();
    if (!token) throw new Error("Graph access token is required.");
    const me = await requestJson<any>(`${GRAPH}/me`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
    return {
      providerId: "sharepoint",
      accessToken: token,
      refreshToken: siteId || undefined,
      user: {
        name: me?.displayName ?? "Graph user",
        email: me?.mail ?? me?.userPrincipalName,
      },
      expiresAt: Date.now() + 55 * 60 * 1000,
    };
  },

  async listProjects(session): Promise<CdeProject[]> {
    // Every SharePoint site's default drive is treated as a "project".
    if (session.refreshToken) {
      // single site
      const site = await requestJson<any>(
        `${GRAPH}/sites/${session.refreshToken}`,
        { headers: auth(session) },
      );
      return [{
        id: site.id,
        name: site.displayName ?? site.name ?? site.id,
        description: site.webUrl,
      }];
    }
    // List sites the user has access to
    const sites = await requestJson<any>(`${GRAPH}/sites?search=*`, {
      headers: auth(session),
    });
    const out: CdeProject[] = [];
    for (const s of sites?.value ?? []) {
      out.push({ id: s.id, name: s.displayName ?? s.name ?? s.id, description: s.webUrl });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async listFolders(session, projectId, parentId): Promise<CdeFolder[]> {
    const root = parentId
      ? `${GRAPH}/sites/${projectId}/drive/items/${parentId}/children`
      : `${GRAPH}/sites/${projectId}/drive/root/children`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(root, { headers: auth(session) });
    const out: CdeFolder[] = [];
    for (const item of json?.value ?? []) {
      if (!item.folder) continue;
      out.push({
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        parentId: parentId ?? null,
        path: item.parentReference?.path,
      });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async listFiles(session, projectId, folderId): Promise<CdeFile[]> {
    const url = folderId
      ? `${GRAPH}/sites/${projectId}/drive/items/${folderId}/children`
      : `${GRAPH}/sites/${projectId}/drive/root/children`;
    const json = await requestJson<any>(url, { headers: auth(session) });
    const out: CdeFile[] = [];
    for (const item of json?.value ?? []) {
      if (!item.file) continue;
      out.push({
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        size: item.size,
        updatedAt: Date.parse(item.lastModifiedDateTime ?? "") || undefined,
        folderId,
        mimeType: item.file.mimeType,
      });
    }
    return out;
  },

  async downloadFile(session, projectId, fileId): Promise<Blob> {
    const url = `${GRAPH}/sites/${projectId}/drive/items/${fileId}/content`;
    const res = await requestRaw(url, { headers: auth(session) });
    return await res.blob();
  },

  async uploadFile(session, projectId, folderId, name, data): Promise<CdeFile> {
    // Simple upload supports files up to 4 MB. For larger, we would need an
    // upload session — kept simple here for the common .ifc / .obs.json case.
    if (data.size > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw new Error(
        `File is ${(data.size / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB. Graph simple upload ` +
        `supports up to 4 MB. Split or compress the file first.`,
      );
    }
    const url = `${GRAPH}/sites/${projectId}/drive/items/${folderId}:/${encodeURIComponent(name)}:/content`;
    const res = await requestRaw(url, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { ...auth(session), "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream" },
      body: data,
      raw: true,
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    return {
      id: json?.id ?? "",
      name: json?.name ?? name,
      size: json?.size ?? data.size,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      folderId,
    };
  },
};
```

```ts
import type {
  CdeProvider, CdeProviderId, CdeProviderMeta,
} from "./types";

const PROVIDERS = new Map<CdeProviderId, CdeProvider>();
const METAS = new Map<CdeProviderId, CdeProviderMeta>();

export function registerCdeProvider(p: CdeProvider, m?: CdeProviderMeta): void {
  const meta = m ?? p.meta;
  if (!meta) throw new Error("Provider must have meta");
  PROVIDERS.set(meta.id, p);
  METAS.set(meta.id, meta);
}

export function getCdeProvider(id: CdeProviderId): CdeProvider | null {
  return PROVIDERS.get(id) ?? null;
}

export function getCdeProviderMeta(id: CdeProviderId): CdeProviderMeta | null {
  return METAS.get(id) ?? null;
}

export function listCdeProviders(): CdeProviderMeta[] {
  return [...METAS.values()];
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/cde/store.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Persistence for CDE credentials + session, keyed by provider id.
 *
 * Credentials are stored in localStorage for convenience. That is a
 * deliberate trade-off: this app runs entirely in the browser, and asking
 * the user to re-type an API token every page reload is unusable. If you
 * ship this to a shared machine, wipe the storage on logout (see
 * clearCdeConfig) or move to the Web Crypto encrypted vault in a later
 * hardening pass.
 */
import type {
  CdeCredentials,
  CdeProviderId,
  CdeSession,
  CdeStoredConfig,
} from "./types";

const PREFIX = "obs.cde.";

function keyFor(providerId: CdeProviderId): string {
  return `${PREFIX}${providerId}`;
}

export function loadCdeConfig(
  providerId: CdeProviderId,
): { credentials: CdeCredentials; session: CdeSession | null } | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(keyFor(providerId));
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as CdeStoredConfig;
    if (parsed?.providerId !== providerId) return null;
    return {
      credentials: parsed.credentials ?? {},
      session: parsed.session ?? null,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function saveCdeConfig(
  config: Omit<CdeStoredConfig, "updatedAt">,
): boolean {
  try {
    const payload: CdeStoredConfig = { ...config, updatedAt: Date.now() };
    localStorage.setItem(keyFor(config.providerId), JSON.stringify(payload));
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[cde] save failed", err);
    return false;
  }
}

export function clearCdeConfig(providerId: CdeProviderId): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(keyFor(providerId));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export function clearAllCdeConfig(): void {
  try {
    const toRemove: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
      const k = localStorage.key(i);
      if (k && k.startsWith(PREFIX)) toRemove.push(k);
    }
    for (const k of toRemove) localStorage.removeItem(k);
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export function listStoredProviders(): CdeProviderId[] {
  const out: CdeProviderId[] = [];
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
      const k = localStorage.key(i);
      if (!k || !k.startsWith(PREFIX)) continue;
      out.push(k.slice(PREFIX.length) as CdeProviderId);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
/**

 */

export type CdeProviderId =
  | "acc"
  | "autodesk"
  | "dalux"
  | "sharepoint"
  | "onedrive"
  | "googledrive"
  | "dropbox"

  | "bimplus"
  | "a360"
  | "box"
  | "custom";

export type CdeCredentials = Record<string, string>;

export interface CdeProject {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  region?: string;
  createdAt?: number;
  updatedAt?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface CdeFolder {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  parentId: string | null;
  path?: string;
  fileCount?: number;
  folderCount?: number;
  updatedAt?: number;
}

export interface CdeFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version?: string;
  size?: number;
  mimeType?: string;
  updatedAt?: number;
  createdAt?: number;
  parentId?: string | null;
  folderId?: string;
  downloadUrl?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface CdeIssue {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status?: "open" | "closed" | "in-progress" | string;
  priority?: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical" | string;
  assignee?: string;
  dueDate?: number | string;
  url?: string;
  createdAt?: number;
  updatedAt?: number;
  extra?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface CdeSession {
  providerId: CdeProviderId;
  accessToken?: string;
  refreshToken?: string;
  expiresAt?: number;
  user?: { name: string; email?: string };
  extra?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface CdeCredentialField {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  type: "text" | "password" | "url";
  required: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  hint?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
}

export interface CdeProviderMeta {
  id: CdeProviderId;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon?: string;
  pushEnabled: boolean;
  issuesEnabled: boolean;
  credentialFields: CdeCredentialField[];
}

export interface CdeProvider {
  id?: CdeProviderId;
  meta?: CdeProviderMeta;
  credentialFields?: CdeCredentialField[];

  authenticate(
    credentials: CdeCredentials,
    existing?: CdeSession,
  ): Promise<CdeSession>;

  listProjects(session: CdeSession): Promise<CdeProject[]>;

  listFolders(
    session: CdeSession,
    projectId: string,
    parentId?: string | null,
  ): Promise<CdeFolder[]>;

  listFiles(
    session: CdeSession,
    projectId: string,
    folderId?: string,
  ): Promise<CdeFile[]>;

  downloadFile(
    session: CdeSession,
    projectId: string,
    fileId: string,
  ): Promise<Blob>;

  uploadFile?(
    session: CdeSession,
    projectId: string,
    folderId: string,
    filename: string,
    body: Blob,
  ): Promise<CdeFile>;

  listIssues?(session: CdeSession, projectId: string): Promise<CdeIssue[]>;

  createIssue?(
    session: CdeSession,
    projectId: string,
    issue: Omit<CdeIssue, "id"> | CdeIssue,
  ): Promise<CdeIssue | { id: string; url?: string }>;
}

export interface CdeStoredConfig {
  providerId: CdeProviderId;
  credentials: CdeCredentials;
  session: CdeSession | null;
  updatedAt?: number;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/clash/clash-core.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Pure clash math — geometry only, no I/O, no DOM, no Fragments.
 *
 * Imported by both the main-thread engine and the Web Worker.
 * Must not reference `ctx`, `window`, `document`, or Fragments runtime types.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { PointCloudConvex, gjk } from "./gjk";
import { meshFaceClash, meshFaceClashBVH, type Tri } from "./geometry";
import { TriangleBVH } from "./triangle-bvh";
import { SpatialHash } from "../../core/spatial-hash";

/* ── Public types (serializable) ─────────────────────────────────────── */
export type ClashKind = "intersect" | "touching" | "clearance" | "duplicate";

export type ClashPrecision =
  | "triangles" | "bbox" | "hull" | "sphere" | "center" | "duplicate" | "depth";

export type ClashMethod =
  | "hard-triangle" | "hard-conservative" | "convex-gjk" | "sphere"
  | "center-in-volume" | "clearance" | "duplicates" | "penetration-depth";

export interface ClashRules {
  tolerance: number;
  clearance: number;
  lowerBound: number;
  minVolume: number;
  ignoreIdentical: boolean;
  ignoreSameCategory: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_CLASH_RULES: ClashRules = {
  tolerance: 0.005,
  clearance: 0,
  lowerBound: 0,
  minVolume: 1e-6,
  ignoreIdentical: false,
  ignoreSameCategory: false,
};

export interface ClashItemRef {
  modelId: string;
  localId: number;
  name: string;
  cat: string;
}

export interface ElementClash {
  a: ClashItemRef;
  b: ClashItemRef;
  kind: ClashKind;
  method: ClashMethod;
  precision: ClashPrecision;
  depthVol: number;
  triPairs: number;
  minGap: number;
  boxA: THREE.Box3;
  boxB: THREE.Box3;
  point: THREE.Vector3 | null;
}

export interface ClashCoreItem {
  modelId: string;
  localId: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  box: THREE.Box3;
  /** Optional pre-extracted triangles (world space, 9 floats per tri). */
  tris?: Tri[] | null;
}

export interface ClashProgress {
  phase: "broadphase" | "narrowphase" | "done";
  current: number;
  total: number;
  found: number;
}

export interface ClashCoreOptions {
  rules: ClashRules;
  method: ClashMethod;
  /** Pre-partitioned groups of item indices to test. */
  groups: number[][];
  /** When true, also test every item against the other items in its own group. */
  selfPairs: boolean;
  onProgress?: (p: ClashProgress) => void;
  shouldCancel?: () => boolean;
  yieldEvery?: number;
  yield?: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface ClashMethodInfo {
  id: ClashMethod;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  usesTolerance: boolean;
  usesClearance: boolean;
}

export const CLASH_METHODS: ClashMethodInfo[] = [
  { id: "hard-triangle",     label: "Hard · Triangle (most accurate)", description: "True triangle-triangle intersection with BVH acceleration.", usesTolerance: true,  usesClearance: false },
  { id: "hard-conservative", label: "Hard · Conservative (bbox)",       description: "Bounding-box intersection. Fast, over-reports.",              usesTolerance: true,  usesClearance: false },
  { id: "convex-gjk",        label: "Convex Hull (GJK)",                description: "Convex hull tested with GJK distance.",                       usesTolerance: true,  usesClearance: false },
  { id: "sphere",            label: "Bounding Sphere (fastest)",        description: "Sphere-vs-sphere. Instantaneous, heavily over-reports.",      usesTolerance: true,  usesClearance: false },
  { id: "center-in-volume",  label: "Center in Volume",                 description: "One AABB centre inside the other AABB.",                      usesTolerance: false, usesClearance: false },
  { id: "clearance",         label: "Clearance Band",                   description: "Close but not intersecting, within the clearance band.",      usesTolerance: false, usesClearance: true  },
  { id: "duplicates",        label: "Duplicates",                       description: "Identical bounding boxes within tolerance.",                  usesTolerance: true,  usesClearance: false },
  { id: "penetration-depth", label: "Penetration Depth",                description: "Overlap whose thinnest axis exceeds tolerance.",              usesTolerance: true,  usesClearance: false },
];

/* ── Scratch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const _inter = new THREE.Box3();
const _isize = new THREE.Vector3();
const _expanded = new THREE.Box3();
const _centerA = new THREE.Vector3();
const _centerB = new THREE.Vector3();

interface RuntimeItem extends ClashCoreItem {
  tris: Tri[] | null;
  bvh: TriangleBVH | null;
  hull: PointCloudConvex | null;
}

export function boxDistance(a: THREE.Box3, b: THREE.Box3): number {
  if (a.intersectsBox(b)) return 0;
  const dx = Math.max(0, Math.max(a.min.x - b.max.x, b.min.x - a.max.x));
  const dy = Math.max(0, Math.max(a.min.y - b.max.y, b.min.y - a.max.y));
  const dz = Math.max(0, Math.max(a.min.z - b.max.z, b.min.z - a.max.z));
  return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
}

export function overlapVolume(a: THREE.Box3, b: THREE.Box3): number {
  if (!a.intersectsBox(b)) return 0;
  _inter.copy(a).intersect(b);
  if (_inter.isEmpty()) return 0;
  _inter.getSize(_isize);
  return Math.max(0, _isize.x * _isize.y * _isize.z);
}

function ensureBVH(it: RuntimeItem): void {
  if (it.bvh !== null) return;
  if (!it.tris || !it.tris.length) return;
  try { it.bvh = new TriangleBVH(it.tris); }
  catch { it.bvh = null; }
}

function ensureHull(it: RuntimeItem): void {
  if (it.hull !== null) return;
  if (!it.tris || !it.tris.length) return;
  try { it.hull = PointCloudConvex.fromTriangles(it.tris); }
  catch { it.hull = null; }
}

interface DetectionResult {
  kind: ClashKind | null;
  precision: ClashPrecision;
  triPairs: number;
  minGap: number;
  depthVol: number;
  point: THREE.Vector3 | null;
}

function detectPair(
  ea: RuntimeItem,
  eb: RuntimeItem,
  method: ClashMethod,
  rules: ClashRules,
): DetectionResult {
  const tol = Math.max(0, rules.tolerance);
  const clearance = Math.max(0, rules.clearance);
  const minVol = Math.max(0, rules.minVolume);

  const boxGap = boxDistance(ea.box, eb.box);
  const depthVol = overlapVolume(ea.box, eb.box);

  const out: DetectionResult = {
    kind: null, precision: "bbox", triPairs: 0, minGap: boxGap, depthVol, point: null,
  };

  switch (method) {
    case "hard-triangle": {
      if (!ea.tris?.length || !eb.tris?.length) {
        out.precision = "bbox";
        if (depthVol > minVol) out.kind = "intersect";
        else if (boxGap <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
        return out;
      }
      out.precision = "triangles";
      ensureBVH(ea); ensureBVH(eb);
      let usedBVH = false;
      if (ea.bvh && eb.bvh) {
        try {
          const t = meshFaceClashBVH(ea.bvh, eb.bvh, tol);
          out.triPairs = t.pairs; out.point = t.point; usedBVH = true;
        } catch { /* fall through */ }
      }
      if (!usedBVH) {
        try {
          const t = meshFaceClash(ea.tris, eb.tris, ea.box, eb.box, tol);
          out.triPairs = t.pairs; out.point = t.point;
        } catch { /* */ }
      }
      if (out.triPairs > 0) { out.kind = "intersect"; out.minGap = 0; }
      else if (tol > 0 && boxGap <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
      return out;
    }

    case "hard-conservative":
      out.precision = "bbox";
      if (depthVol > minVol) { out.kind = "intersect"; out.triPairs = 1; out.minGap = 0; }
      else if (boxGap <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
      return out;

    case "convex-gjk": {
      ensureHull(ea); ensureHull(eb);
      out.precision = "hull";
      if (ea.hull && eb.hull) {
        try {
          const g = gjk(ea.hull, eb.hull);
          out.minGap = g.intersect ? 0 : g.distance;
          if (g.intersect) { out.kind = "intersect"; out.triPairs = 1; }
          else if (g.distance <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
          return out;
        } catch { /* */ }
      }
      out.precision = "bbox";
      if (depthVol > minVol) { out.kind = "intersect"; out.triPairs = 1; }
      else if (boxGap <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
      return out;
    }

    case "sphere": {
      out.precision = "sphere";
      ea.box.getCenter(_centerA);
      eb.box.getCenter(_centerB);
      const sa = new THREE.Vector3(); ea.box.getSize(sa);
      const sb = new THREE.Vector3(); eb.box.getSize(sb);
      const rA = sa.length() * 0.5;
      const rB = sb.length() * 0.5;
      const centerDist = _centerA.distanceTo(_centerB);
      const sphereGap = centerDist - (rA + rB);
      out.minGap = Math.max(0, sphereGap);
      if (sphereGap <= 0) { out.kind = "intersect"; out.triPairs = 1; }
      else if (sphereGap <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
      return out;
    }

    case "center-in-volume": {
      out.precision = "center";
      ea.box.getCenter(_centerA);
      eb.box.getCenter(_centerB);
      const aInB = eb.box.containsPoint(_centerA);
      const bInA = ea.box.containsPoint(_centerB);
      if (aInB || bInA) {
        out.kind = "intersect"; out.triPairs = 1; out.minGap = 0;
        out.point = (aInB ? _centerA : _centerB).clone();
      }
      return out;
    }

    case "clearance": {
      if (clearance <= 0 && tol <= 0) return out;
      ensureHull(ea); ensureHull(eb);
      let gap = boxGap;
      out.precision = "bbox";
      if (ea.hull && eb.hull) {
        try {
          const g = gjk(ea.hull, eb.hull);
          out.precision = "hull";
          if (g.intersect) {
            out.kind = "intersect"; out.triPairs = 1; out.minGap = 0;
            return out;
          }
          gap = g.distance;
        } catch { /* */ }
      }
      out.minGap = gap;
      if (gap <= tol) out.kind = "touching";
      else if (gap <= clearance) out.kind = "clearance";
      return out;
    }

    case "duplicates": {
      out.precision = "duplicate";
      ea.box.getCenter(_centerA);
      eb.box.getCenter(_centerB);
      const sizeA = new THREE.Vector3(); ea.box.getSize(sizeA);
      const sizeB = new THREE.Vector3(); eb.box.getSize(sizeB);
      const centerDist = _centerA.distanceTo(_centerB);
      const sizeDiff =
        Math.abs(sizeA.x - sizeB.x) +
        Math.abs(sizeA.y - sizeB.y) +
        Math.abs(sizeA.z - sizeB.z);
      const matchTol = Math.max(tol, 0.001);
      if (centerDist <= matchTol && sizeDiff <= matchTol * 3) {
        out.kind = "duplicate"; out.triPairs = 1; out.minGap = 0;
        out.point = _centerA.clone().add(_centerB).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      }
      return out;
    }

    case "penetration-depth": {
      out.precision = "depth";
      if (depthVol <= 0) return out;
      _inter.copy(ea.box).intersect(eb.box);
      _inter.getSize(_isize);
      const depth = Math.min(_isize.x, _isize.y, _isize.z);
      out.triPairs = 1; out.minGap = 0;
      if (depth >= tol) out.kind = "intersect";
      else if (depth > 0) out.kind = "touching";
      return out;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ── Broadphase + narrowphase loop ──────────────────────────────────── */
export async function runClashCore(
  rawItems: ClashCoreItem[],
  opts: ClashCoreOptions,
): Promise<ElementClash[]> {
  const results: ElementClash[] = [];
  const rules = opts.rules;
  const method = opts.method;
  const onProg = opts.onProgress ?? (() => {});
  const shouldCancel = opts.shouldCancel ?? (() => false);
  const yieldEvery = opts.yieldEvery ?? 512;
  const yieldFn = opts.yield ?? (() => Promise.resolve());

  const items: RuntimeItem[] = rawItems.map((it) => ({
    ...it,
    tris: it.tris ?? null,
    bvh: null,
    hull: null,
  }));

  const reach = Math.max(
    Math.max(0, rules.tolerance),
    Math.max(0, rules.clearance),
    method === "sphere" ? 1e9 : 0,
  );

  const cellSize = SpatialHash.suggestCellSize(items.map((it) => it.box));
  const hash = new SpatialHash(cellSize);
  for (const it of items) hash.insert(it.box);

  const groupOf = new Map<number, number>();
  opts.groups.forEach((g, gi) => {
    for (const idx of g) groupOf.set(idx, gi);
  });

  let tested = 0;
  let found = 0;
  const candidates = new Set<number>();
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  let totalEstimate = 0;
  for (const _idx of groupOf.keys()) totalEstimate++;
  onProg({ phase: "broadphase", current: 0, total: totalEstimate, found: 0 });

  const maxItemIdx = items.length;

  for (let ai = 0; ai < maxItemIdx; ai++) {
    if (shouldCancel()) return results;
    const ea = items[ai];
    if (!ea) continue;

    const groupA = groupOf.get(ai);
    if (groupA === undefined) continue;

    const maxA = Math.max(
      ea.box.max.x - ea.box.min.x,
      ea.box.max.y - ea.box.min.y,
      ea.box.max.z - ea.box.min.z,
    );
    if (rules.lowerBound > 0 && maxA < rules.lowerBound) continue;

    _expanded.copy(ea.box).expandByScalar(reach);
    hash.query(_expanded, candidates, ai);

    for (const bi of candidates) {
      if (bi <= ai) continue;
      const eb = items[bi];
      if (!eb) continue;

      const groupB = groupOf.get(bi);
      if (groupB === undefined) continue;

      const sameGroup = groupA === groupB;
      if (sameGroup && !opts.selfPairs) continue;

      const key = `${ai}:${bi}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);

      tested++;

      if ((tested & (yieldEvery - 1)) === 0) {
        onProg({
          phase: "broadphase",
          current: tested,
          total: Math.min(Math.max(totalEstimate, tested), tested * 2),
          found,
        });
        await yieldFn();
        if (shouldCancel()) return results;
      }

      const maxB = Math.max(
        eb.box.max.x - eb.box.min.x,
        eb.box.max.y - eb.box.min.y,
        eb.box.max.z - eb.box.min.z,
      );
      if (rules.lowerBound > 0 && maxB < rules.lowerBound) continue;

      if (method !== "sphere" && method !== "duplicates") {
        _expanded.copy(ea.box).expandByScalar(reach);
        if (!_expanded.intersectsBox(eb.box)) continue;
      }

      if (rules.ignoreIdentical && ea.name && ea.name === eb.name) continue;
      if (
        rules.ignoreSameCategory &&
        ea.category === eb.category &&
        ea.category !== "Unknown"
      ) continue;

      const d = detectPair(ea, eb, method, rules);
      if (!d.kind) continue;

      found++;
      results.push({
        a: { modelId: ea.modelId, localId: ea.localId, name: ea.name, cat: ea.category },
        b: { modelId: eb.modelId, localId: eb.localId, name: eb.name, cat: eb.category },
        kind: d.kind,
        method,
        precision: d.precision,
        depthVol: d.depthVol,
        triPairs: d.triPairs,
        minGap: d.minGap,
        boxA: ea.box.clone(),
        boxB: eb.box.clone(),
        point: d.point,
      });
    }
  }

  onProg({
    phase: "done",
    current: tested,
    total: tested,
    found: results.length,
  });
  return results;
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:v3:applied -- do not re-apply the earlier fix scripts
/** Precise geometry: per-element world triangles + Möller triangle-triangle intersection. */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { TriangleBVH } from "./triangle-bvh";

export type Tri = Float32Array; // 9 floats: ax,ay,az, bx,by,bz, cx,cy,cz

const MAX_TRIS_PER_ITEM = 2500;

const cacheByModel = new WeakMap<object, Map<number, Tri[] | null>>();

function getIdRanges(mesh: any): Map<number, { start: number; end: number }> | null {
  const cands: any[] = [mesh.geometry?.userData, mesh.userData, mesh];
  const keys = ["idRanges", "idsRanges", "idMap", "ranges"];
  for (const ud of cands) {
    if (!ud || typeof ud !== "object") continue;
    for (const k of keys) {
      const r = ud[k];
      if (!r) continue;
      if (r instanceof Map) {
        if (r.size) return r as any;
      } else if (typeof r === "object") {
        const m = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();
        let ok = true;
        for (const [kk, vv] of Object.entries(r as Record<string, any>)) {
          const start = vv?.start ?? vv?.indexStart ?? vv?.[0];
          const end = vv?.end ?? vv?.indexEnd ?? vv?.[1];
          if (typeof start !== "number" || typeof end !== "number") {
            ok = false;
            break;
          }
          m.set(Number(kk), { start, end });
        }
        if (ok && m.size) return m;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Extract world-space triangles for one element (null → fall back to bbox). */
export function getElementTriangles(modelObj: any, localId: number): Tri[] | null {
  if (!modelObj) return null;
  let cache = cacheByModel.get(modelObj);
  if (!cache) {
    cache = new Map();
    cacheByModel.set(modelObj, cache);
  }
  if (cache.has(localId)) return cache.get(localId) ?? null;

  try {
    ctx.world.scene.three.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  const out: Tri[] = [];
  const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
  const v = new THREE.Vector3();

  modelObj.traverse((obj: any) => {
    if (!obj?.isMesh) return;
    const geo = obj.geometry;
    if (!geo?.attributes?.position) return;

    const ranges = getIdRanges(obj);
    const pos = geo.attributes.position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
    const idx = geo.index as THREE.BufferAttribute | null;

    const pushTri = (i0: number, i1: number, i2: number) => {
      const t = new Float32Array(9);
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const vi = k === 0 ? i0 : k === 1 ? i1 : i2;
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos, vi).applyMatrix4(m);
        t[k * 3] = v.x;
        t[k * 3 + 1] = v.y;
        t[k * 3 + 2] = v.z;
      }
      out.push(t);
    };

    m.copy(obj.matrixWorld);

    if (ranges) {
      let range = ranges.get(localId);
      if (!range) {
        const alt = ranges.get(localId + 1);
        if (alt) {
          // openbim-fix: clash/geometry.ts -- 1-based idRanges fallback
          console.warn("[geometry] 1-based idRanges fallback for localId=" + localId);
          range = alt;
        }
      }
      if (!range) return;
      const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(range.start));
      const end = Math.min(idx ? idx.count : pos.count, Math.ceil(range.end));
      const total = end - start;
      if (total < 3) return;
      const stride =
        total > MAX_TRIS_PER_ITEM * 3
          ? 3 * Math.ceil(total / (MAX_TRIS_PER_ITEM * 3))
          : 3;
      if (idx) {
        for (let i = start; i + 2 < end; i += stride) {
          pushTri(idx.getX(i), idx.getX(i + 1), idx.getX(i + 2));
        }
      } else {
        for (let i = start; i + 2 < end; i += stride) {
          pushTri(i, i + 1, i + 2);
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    // Fallback for exporters that bake one element per mesh (no idRanges).
    const triCount = idx ? idx.count / 3 : pos.count / 3;
    if (triCount <= MAX_TRIS_PER_ITEM) {
      if (idx) {
        for (let i = 0; i + 2 < idx.count; i += 3) {
          pushTri(idx.getX(i), idx.getX(i + 1), idx.getX(i + 2));
        }
      } else {
        for (let i = 0; i + 2 < pos.count; i += 3) {
          pushTri(i, i + 1, i + 2);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  const result = out.length ? out : null;
  cache.set(localId, result);
  return result;
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BVH cache — lives alongside the triangle cache, same lifecycle.
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const bvhByModel = new WeakMap<object, Map<number, TriangleBVH | null>>();

/**
 * Build (or reuse) the triangle BVH for one element.
 * Returns null when triangles cannot be extracted (bbox-only fallback).
 */
export function getElementBVH(modelObj: any, localId: number): TriangleBVH | null {
  if (!modelObj) return null;
  const tris = getElementTriangles(modelObj, localId);
  if (!tris || !tris.length) return null;

  let cache = bvhByModel.get(modelObj);
  if (!cache) {
    cache = new Map();
    bvhByModel.set(modelObj, cache);
  }
  if (cache.has(localId)) return cache.get(localId) ?? null;

  let bvh: TriangleBVH | null = null;
  try {
    bvh = new TriangleBVH(tris);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[geometry] BVH build failed", err);
    bvh = null;
  }
  cache.set(localId, bvh);
  return bvh;
}

/** Clear triangle + BVH caches (after models change). */
export function clearTriangleCache() {
  // WeakMaps clear with GC; no strong refs to clear.
}

// ── vector helpers ──
type V3 = [number, number, number];
const sub = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const cross = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [
  a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
  a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
  a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
];
const dot = (a: V3, b: V3) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
const eps = 1e-8;
const tv = (t: Tri, i: 0 | 1 | 2): V3 => [t[i * 3], t[i * 3 + 1], t[i * 3 + 2]];

function dominantAxis(n: V3): 0 | 1 | 2 {
  const ax = Math.abs(n[0]);
  const ay = Math.abs(n[1]);
  const az = Math.abs(n[2]);
  if (ax >= ay && ax >= az) return 0;
  if (ay >= az) return 1;
  return 2;
}

function pointInTri2D(
  p: [number, number],
  a: [number, number],
  b: [number, number],
  c: [number, number],
) {
  const sign = (p1: [number, number], p2: [number, number], p3: [number, number]) =>
    (p1[0] - p3[0]) * (p2[1] - p3[1]) - (p2[0] - p3[0]) * (p1[1] - p3[1]);
  const b1 = sign(p, a, b) < 0;
  const b2 = sign(p, b, c) < 0;
  const b3 = sign(p, c, a) < 0;
  return b1 === b2 && b2 === b3;
}

function edgesIntersect2D(
  a: [number, number],
  b: [number, number],
  c: [number, number],
  d: [number, number],
) {
  const orient = (p: [number, number], q: [number, number], r: [number, number]) =>
    Math.sign((q[1] - p[1]) * (r[0] - q[0]) - (q[0] - p[0]) * (r[1] - q[1]));
  const o1 = orient(a, b, c);
  const o2 = orient(a, b, d);
  const o3 = orient(c, d, a);
  const o4 = orient(c, d, b);
  return o1 !== o2 && o3 !== o4;
}

function coplanar(T1: Tri, T2: Tri): boolean {
  const p1 = tv(T1, 0);
  const q1 = tv(T1, 1);
  const r1 = tv(T1, 2);
  const N = cross(sub(q1, p1), sub(r1, p1));
  const drop = dominantAxis(N);
  const proj = (p: V3): [number, number] => {
    if (drop === 0) return [p[1], p[2]];
    if (drop === 1) return [p[0], p[2]];
    return [p[0], p[1]];
  };
  const A = [proj(tv(T1, 0)), proj(tv(T1, 1)), proj(tv(T1, 2))] as [
    [number, number],
    [number, number],
    [number, number],
  ];
  const B = [proj(tv(T2, 0)), proj(tv(T2, 1)), proj(tv(T2, 2))] as [
    [number, number],
    [number, number],
    [number, number],
  ];
  for (const p of A) if (pointInTri2D(p, B[0], B[1], B[2])) return true;
  for (const p of B) if (pointInTri2D(p, A[0], A[1], A[2])) return true;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const a0 = A[i];
    const a1 = A[(i + 1) % 3];
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
      if (edgesIntersect2D(a0, a1, B[j], B[(j + 1) % 3])) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function edgePlaneHit(
  a: V3,
  b: V3,
  c: V3,
  da: number,
  db: number,
  dc: number,
): V3 | null {
  if (Math.abs(da) < eps && Math.abs(db) < eps) return null;
  const pick = (P: V3, Q: V3, dp: number, dq: number): V3 => {
    const t = dp / (dp - dq + 1e-30);
    return [P[0] + t * (Q[0] - P[0]), P[1] + t * (Q[1] - P[1]), P[2] + t * (Q[2] - P[2])];
  };
  if ((da >= 0 && db < 0) || (da < 0 && db >= 0)) return pick(a, b, da, db);
  if ((da >= 0 && dc < 0) || (da < 0 && dc >= 0)) return pick(a, c, da, dc);
  if ((db >= 0 && dc < 0) || (db < 0 && dc >= 0)) return pick(b, c, db, dc);
  return null;
}

/** Möller-style triangle–triangle intersection (includes coplanar overlap). */
export function triTriIntersect(T1: Tri, T2: Tri): boolean {
  const p1 = tv(T1, 0);
  const q1 = tv(T1, 1);
  const r1 = tv(T1, 2);
  const p2 = tv(T2, 0);
  const q2 = tv(T2, 1);
  const r2 = tv(T2, 2);

  const N1 = cross(sub(q1, p1), sub(r1, p1));
  const d1 = -dot(N1, p1);
  const du0 = dot(N1, p2) + d1;
  const du1 = dot(N1, q2) + d1;
  const du2 = dot(N1, r2) + d1;
  if (Math.abs(du0) < eps && Math.abs(du1) < eps && Math.abs(du2) < eps) return false;
  if (du0 * du1 > 0 && du0 * du2 > 0) return false;

  const N2 = cross(sub(q2, p2), sub(r2, p2));
  const d2 = -dot(N2, p2);
  const dv0 = dot(N2, p1) + d2;
  const dv1 = dot(N2, q1) + d2;
  const dv2 = dot(N2, r1) + d2;
  if (dv0 * dv1 > 0 && dv0 * dv2 > 0) return false;

  const s1 = edgePlaneHit(p1, q1, r1, dv0, dv1, dv2);
  const s2 = edgePlaneHit(p1, r1, q1, dv0, dv2, dv1);
  const s3 = edgePlaneHit(p2, q2, r2, du0, du1, du2);
  const s4 = edgePlaneHit(p2, r2, q2, du0, du2, du1);
  if (!s1 || !s2 || !s3 || !s4) return false;

  const D = cross(N1, N2);
  const ax = Math.abs(D[0]);
  const ay = Math.abs(D[1]);
  const az = Math.abs(D[2]);
  const key = ax >= ay && ax >= az ? 0 : ay >= az ? 1 : 2;
  const i1 = Math.min(s1[key], s2[key]);
  const i2 = Math.max(s1[key], s2[key]);
  const j1 = Math.min(s3[key], s4[key]);
  const j2 = Math.max(s3[key], s4[key]);
  return i1 <= j2 + eps && j1 <= i2 + eps;
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Narrowphase — brute force (kept for compatibility) and BVH (preferred)
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Face-accurate clash WITHOUT BVH. O(n·m). Kept for backward compatibility.
 * New code should call meshFaceClashBVH.
 */
export function meshFaceClash(
  trisA: Tri[],
  trisB: Tri[],
  boxA: THREE.Box3,
  boxB: THREE.Box3,
  expand = 0,
): { hit: boolean; pairs: number; point: THREE.Vector3 | null } {
  const ba = boxA.clone();
  const bb = boxB.clone();
  if (expand > 0) {
    ba.expandByScalar(expand);
    bb.expandByScalar(expand);
  }
  if (!ba.intersectsBox(bb)) return { hit: false, pairs: 0, point: null };

  const tBox = (t: Tri) => {
    const b = new THREE.Box3();
    b.min.set(
      Math.min(t[0], t[3], t[6]),
      Math.min(t[1], t[4], t[7]),
      Math.min(t[2], t[5], t[8]),
    );
    b.max.set(
      Math.max(t[0], t[3], t[6]),
      Math.max(t[1], t[4], t[7]),
      Math.max(t[2], t[5], t[8]),
    );
    return b;
  };

  let pairs = 0;
  let point: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
  const maxPairsReport = 50;

  for (let i = 0; i < trisA.length; i++) {
    const ta = trisA[i];
    const baT = tBox(ta);
    if (expand > 0) baT.expandByScalar(expand);
    if (!baT.intersectsBox(bb)) continue;
    for (let j = 0; j < trisB.length; j++) {
      const tb = trisB[j];
      const bbT = tBox(tb);
      if (expand > 0) bbT.expandByScalar(expand);
      if (!baT.intersectsBox(bbT)) continue;
      if (triTriIntersect(ta, tb)) {
        pairs++;
        if (!point) {
          point = new THREE.Vector3(
            (ta[0] + ta[3] + ta[6]) / 3,
            (ta[1] + ta[4] + ta[7]) / 3,
            (ta[2] + ta[5] + ta[8]) / 3,
          );
        }
        if (pairs >= maxPairsReport) return { hit: true, pairs, point };
      }
    }
  }
  return { hit: pairs > 0, pairs, point };
}

/**
 * Face-accurate clash WITH BVH traversal. This is what the clash engine
 * uses. The BVH prunes the O(n·m) grid down to a small candidate set —
 * typically a 100–1,000× reduction in tri-tri tests.
 */
export function meshFaceClashBVH(
  bvhA: TriangleBVH,
  bvhB: TriangleBVH,
  tolerance = 0,
  maxPairs = 50,
): { hit: boolean; pairs: number; point: THREE.Vector3 | null } {
  let pairs = 0;
  let point: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
  const A = bvhA.tris;
  const B = bvhB.tris;

  bvhA.visitCandidatePairs(bvhB, tolerance, (ia, ib) => {
    const ta = A[ia];
    const tb = B[ib];
    if (!triTriIntersect(ta, tb)) return true;
    pairs++;
    if (!point) {
      point = new THREE.Vector3(
        (ta[0] + ta[3] + ta[6]) / 3,
        (ta[1] + ta[4] + ta[7]) / 3,
        (ta[2] + ta[5] + ta[8]) / 3,
      );
    }
    return pairs < maxPairs;
  });

  return { hit: pairs > 0, pairs, point };
}

/**
 * Extract all available triangles for a single fragment element without the
 * normal clash-detection decimation cap. This is intentionally used by the
 * Native Twin reconstruction workflow, where geometry fidelity is preferred
 * over clash-query performance.
 */
export function getElementTrianglesExact(modelObj: any, localId: number): Tri[] | null {
  if (!modelObj) return null;
  try { ctx.world.scene.three.updateMatrixWorld(true); } catch { /* */ }

  const out: Tri[] = [];
  const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
  const v = new THREE.Vector3();

  modelObj.traverse((obj: any) => {
    if (!obj?.isMesh) return;
    const geo = obj.geometry;
    if (!geo?.attributes?.position) return;

    const ranges = getIdRanges(obj);
    const pos = geo.attributes.position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
    const idx = geo.index as THREE.BufferAttribute | null;
    m.copy(obj.matrixWorld);

    const pushTri = (i0: number, i1: number, i2: number) => {
      const t = new Float32Array(9);
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const vi = k === 0 ? i0 : k === 1 ? i1 : i2;
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos, vi).applyMatrix4(m);
        t[k * 3] = v.x;
        t[k * 3 + 1] = v.y;
        t[k * 3 + 2] = v.z;
      }
      out.push(t);
    };

    if (ranges) {
      let range = ranges.get(localId);
      if (!range) {
        const alt = ranges.get(localId + 1);
        if (alt) {
          // openbim-fix: clash/geometry.ts -- 1-based idRanges fallback
          console.warn("[geometry] 1-based idRanges fallback for localId=" + localId);
          range = alt;
        }
      }
      if (!range) return;
      const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(range.start));
      const end = Math.min(idx ? idx.count : pos.count, Math.ceil(range.end));
      if (idx) {
        for (let i = start; i + 2 < end; i += 3) pushTri(idx.getX(i), idx.getX(i + 1), idx.getX(i + 2));
      } else {
        for (let i = start; i + 2 < end; i += 3) pushTri(i, i + 1, i + 2);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Conservative fallback: only use a one-mesh model when there are no
    // element ranges. This prevents accidentally cloning the entire model.
    const meshLocalIds = obj.userData?.localId ?? obj.userData?.itemId ?? obj.userData?.expressID;
    if (meshLocalIds != null && Number(meshLocalIds) !== localId && Number(meshLocalIds) !== localId + 1) return;
    if (meshLocalIds == null && obj.parent?.children?.filter?.((c: any) => c?.isMesh)?.length > 1) return;

    if (idx) {
      for (let i = 0; i + 2 < idx.count; i += 3) pushTri(idx.getX(i), idx.getX(i + 1), idx.getX(i + 2));
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i + 2 < pos.count; i += 3) pushTri(i, i + 1, i + 2);
    }
  });

  return out.length ? out : null;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * GJK (Gilbert–Johnson–Keerthi) for convex shapes in 3D.
 * - Intersection test
 * - Approximate minimum distance (when separated)
 * - Support mapping from triangle soups (convex hull of vertices)
 *
 * Used as mid-phase clash: AABB → GJK(convex) → optional triangle refine.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import type { Tri } from "./geometry";

export type Vec3 = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

const EPS = 1e-8;
const MAX_ITER = 32;

// ── vector ops ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function v3(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0): Vec3 {
  return { x, y, z };
}
function copy(a: Vec3): Vec3 {
  return { x: a.x, y: a.y, z: a.z };
}
function set(out: Vec3, x: number, y: number, z: number): Vec3 {
  out.x = x;
  out.y = y;
  out.z = z;
  return out;
}
function add(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, out: Vec3 = v3()): Vec3 {
  return set(out, a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
}
function sub(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, out: Vec3 = v3()): Vec3 {
  return set(out, a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
}
function scale(a: Vec3, s: number, out: Vec3 = v3()): Vec3 {
  return set(out, a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s);
}
function dot(a: Vec3, b: Vec3): number {
  return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}
function cross(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, out: Vec3 = v3()): Vec3 {
  return set(
    out,
    a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
    a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
    a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x
  );
}
function lenSq(a: Vec3): number {
  return dot(a, a);
}
function len(a: Vec3): number {
  return Math.sqrt(lenSq(a));
}
function normalize(a: Vec3, out: Vec3 = v3()): Vec3 {
  const l = len(a);
  if (l < EPS) return set(out, 0, 0, 0);
  return scale(a, 1 / l, out);
}
function neg(a: Vec3, out: Vec3 = v3()): Vec3 {
  return scale(a, -1, out);
}
function sameDir(a: Vec3, b: Vec3): boolean {
  return dot(a, b) > 0;
}

// ── Support mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface ConvexShape {
  /** Support point in direction d (world space). */
  support(d: Vec3): Vec3;
}

/** Convex hull of a vertex set (e.g. triangle soup vertices). */
export class PointCloudConvex implements ConvexShape {
  readonly points: Vec3[];

  constructor(points: Vec3[]) {
    this.points = points.length ? points : [v3()];
  }

  static fromTriangles(tris: Tri[]): PointCloudConvex {
    const pts: Vec3[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const key = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
      `${x.toFixed(5)},${y.toFixed(5)},${z.toFixed(5)}`;
    for (const t of tris) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const x = t[i * 3],
          y = t[i * 3 + 1],
          z = t[i * 3 + 2];
        const k = key(x, y, z);
        if (seen.has(k)) continue;
        seen.add(k);
        pts.push(v3(x, y, z));
      }
    }
    return new PointCloudConvex(pts);
  }

  static fromBox(box: THREE.Box3): PointCloudConvex {
    const min = box.min,
      max = box.max;
    return new PointCloudConvex([
      v3(min.x, min.y, min.z),
      v3(max.x, min.y, min.z),
      v3(min.x, max.y, min.z),
      v3(max.x, max.y, min.z),
      v3(min.x, min.y, max.z),
      v3(max.x, min.y, max.z),
      v3(min.x, max.y, max.z),
      v3(max.x, max.y, max.z),
    ]);
  }

  support(d: Vec3): Vec3 {
    let best = this.points[0];
    let bestDot = -Infinity;
    for (const p of this.points) {
      const dd = dot(p, d);
      if (dd > bestDot) {
        bestDot = dd;
        best = p;
      }
    }
    return copy(best);
  }
}

/** Minkowski difference support: S_A(d) - S_B(-d). */
function supportDiff(a: ConvexShape, b: ConvexShape, d: Vec3): Vec3 {
  const pa = a.support(d);
  const pb = b.support(neg(d));
  return sub(pa, pb);
}

// ── Simplex ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type Simplex = Vec3[];

/**
 * Evolve simplex toward origin. Returns true if origin is inside simplex (intersection).
 * Updates `dir` to the next search direction.
 */
function doSimplex(simplex: Simplex, dir: Vec3): boolean {
  const n = simplex.length;

  if (n === 2) {
    // Line: A = last, B = previous
    const A = simplex[1];
    const B = simplex[0];
    const AB = sub(B, A);
    const AO = neg(A);
    if (sameDir(AB, AO)) {
      cross(cross(AB, AO), AB, dir);
    } else {
      simplex.splice(0, 1); // keep A
      set(dir, AO.x, AO.y, AO.z);
    }
    if (lenSq(dir) < EPS) return true;
    return false;
  }

  if (n === 3) {
    // Triangle
    const A = simplex[2];
    const B = simplex[1];
    const C = simplex[0];
    const AB = sub(B, A);
    const AC = sub(C, A);
    const AO = neg(A);
    const ABC = cross(AB, AC);

    const abPerp = cross(ABC, AB);
    if (sameDir(abPerp, AO)) {
      // AB edge region
      if (sameDir(AB, AO)) {
        simplex.splice(0, 1); // remove C → [B,A] wait indices: C=0,B=1,A=2 → keep B,A
        simplex.splice(0, 1); // remove C, left [B,A]
        cross(cross(AB, AO), AB, dir);
      } else {
        simplex.splice(0, 2); // keep A
        set(dir, AO.x, AO.y, AO.z);
      }
      return false;
    }

    const acPerp = cross(AC, ABC);
    if (sameDir(acPerp, AO)) {
      if (sameDir(AC, AO)) {
        // keep C, A → remove B
        simplex.splice(1, 1);
        cross(cross(AC, AO), AC, dir);
      } else {
        simplex.splice(0, 2);
        set(dir, AO.x, AO.y, AO.z);
      }
      return false;
    }

    // Above or below triangle
    if (sameDir(ABC, AO)) {
      set(dir, ABC.x, ABC.y, ABC.z);
    } else {
      // flip winding: swap B and C
      const tmp = simplex[0];
      simplex[0] = simplex[1];
      simplex[1] = tmp;
      set(dir, -ABC.x, -ABC.y, -ABC.z);
    }
    return false;
  }

  if (n === 4) {
    // Tetrahedron: D=0, C=1, B=2, A=3 (A newest)
    const A = simplex[3];
    const B = simplex[2];
    const C = simplex[1];
    const D = simplex[0];
    const AO = neg(A);
    const AB = sub(B, A);
    const AC = sub(C, A);
    const AD = sub(D, A);

    const ABC = cross(AB, AC);
    const ACD = cross(AC, AD);
    const ADB = cross(AD, AB);

    if (sameDir(ABC, AO)) {
      simplex.splice(0, 1); // remove D → [C,B,A]
      set(dir, ABC.x, ABC.y, ABC.z);
      return false;
    }
    if (sameDir(ACD, AO)) {
      // keep D,C,A → remove B: [D,C,A]
      simplex.splice(2, 1);
      set(dir, ACD.x, ACD.y, ACD.z);
      return false;
    }
    if (sameDir(ADB, AO)) {
      // keep D,B,A → remove C
      simplex.splice(1, 1);
      set(dir, ADB.x, ADB.y, ADB.z);
      return false;
    }
    // Origin inside tetrahedron
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

export interface GjkResult {
  /** True if convex shapes intersect. */
  intersect: boolean;
  /** Iterations used. */
  iterations: number;
  /**
   * When separated: approximate distance between shapes (from simplex closest point to origin).
   * When intersecting: 0.
   */
  distance: number;
  /** Closest point on Minkowski difference to origin (≈ 0 if intersecting). */
  closest: Vec3;
}

/**
 * GJK intersection + distance between two convex shapes.
 */
export function gjk(a: ConvexShape, b: ConvexShape): GjkResult {
  // Initial direction: difference of centers approximated by support along X then arbitrary
  let dir = v3(1, 0, 0);
  const simplex: Simplex = [];

  // First support
  let p = supportDiff(a, b, dir);
  simplex.push(p);
  if (lenSq(p) < EPS) {
    return { intersect: true, iterations: 1, distance: 0, closest: v3() };
  }
  dir = neg(p);

  let iterations = 1;
  for (; iterations < MAX_ITER; iterations++) {
    p = supportDiff(a, b, dir);
    if (dot(p, dir) < 0) {
      // No intersection — compute approx distance from simplex to origin
      const closest = closestPointOnSimplex(simplex);
      return {
        intersect: false,
        iterations,
        distance: len(closest),
        closest,
      };
    }
    simplex.push(p);
    if (doSimplex(simplex, dir)) {
      return { intersect: true, iterations, distance: 0, closest: v3() };
    }
    if (lenSq(dir) < EPS) {
      return { intersect: true, iterations, distance: 0, closest: v3() };
    }
  }

  const closest = closestPointOnSimplex(simplex);
  return {
    intersect: len(closest) < 1e-5,
    iterations,
    distance: len(closest),
    closest,
  };
}

/** Closest point on current simplex to origin (for separation distance). */
function closestPointOnSimplex(simplex: Simplex): Vec3 {
  if (simplex.length === 0) return v3();
  if (simplex.length === 1) return copy(simplex[0]);

  if (simplex.length === 2) {
    const A = simplex[0],
      B = simplex[1];
    const AB = sub(B, A);
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -dot(A, AB) / (lenSq(AB) + EPS)));
    return add(A, scale(AB, t));
  }

  // Triangle or tetra: project origin onto triangle of last 3 points
  const A = simplex[simplex.length - 1];
  const B = simplex[simplex.length - 2];
  const C = simplex[simplex.length - 3];
  return closestPointOnTriangle(v3(), A, B, C);
}

function closestPointOnTriangle(p: Vec3, a: Vec3, b: Vec3, c: Vec3): Vec3 {
  // Ericson — Real-Time Collision Detection
  const ab = sub(b, a);
  const ac = sub(c, a);
  const ap = sub(p, a);
  const d1 = dot(ab, ap);
  const d2 = dot(ac, ap);
  if (d1 <= 0 && d2 <= 0) return copy(a);

  const bp = sub(p, b);
  const d3 = dot(ab, bp);
  const d4 = dot(ac, bp);
  if (d3 >= 0 && d4 <= d3) return copy(b);

  const vc = d1 * d4 - d3 * d2;
  if (vc <= 0 && d1 >= 0 && d3 <= 0) {
    const v = d1 / (d1 - d3 + EPS);
    return add(a, scale(ab, v));
  }

  const cp = sub(p, c);
  const d5 = dot(ab, cp);
  const d6 = dot(ac, cp);
  if (d6 >= 0 && d5 <= d6) return copy(c);

  const vb = d5 * d2 - d1 * d6;
  if (vb <= 0 && d2 >= 0 && d6 <= 0) {
    const w = d2 / (d2 - d6 + EPS);
    return add(a, scale(ac, w));
  }

  const va = d3 * d6 - d5 * d4;
  if (va <= 0 && d4 - d3 >= 0 && d5 - d6 >= 0) {
    const w = (d4 - d3) / (d4 - d3 + d5 - d6 + EPS);
    return add(b, scale(sub(c, b), w));
  }

  const denom = 1 / (va + vb + vc + EPS);
  const v = vb * denom;
  const w = vc * denom;
  return add(a, add(scale(ab, v), scale(ac, w)));
}

/**
 * Convenience: GJK between two triangle soups treated as convex hulls.
 */
export function gjkTriangles(
  trisA: Tri[],
  trisB: Tri[]
): GjkResult {
  const a = PointCloudConvex.fromTriangles(trisA);
  const b = PointCloudConvex.fromTriangles(trisB);
  return gjk(a, b);
}

/**
 * GJK between two AABB boxes (convex).
 */
export function gjkBoxes(boxA: THREE.Box3, boxB: THREE.Box3): GjkResult {
  return gjk(PointCloudConvex.fromBox(boxA), PointCloudConvex.fromBox(boxB));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Clash grouping via union-find.
 *
 * Two clashes belong to the same group when they share an element
 * (Navisworks-style grouping).
 */
import type { ElementClash, ClashItemRef } from "./clash-core";

class DisjointSet {
  private parent: number[];
  private rank: number[];

  constructor(size: number) {
    this.parent = new Array(size);
    this.rank = new Array(size).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) this.parent[i] = i;
  }

  find(x: number): number {
    let root = x;
    while (this.parent[root] !== root) root = this.parent[root];
    let cur = x;
    while (this.parent[cur] !== cur) {
      const next = this.parent[cur];
      this.parent[cur] = root;
      cur = next;
    }
    return root;
  }

  union(a: number, b: number): void {
    const ra = this.find(a);
    const rb = this.find(b);
    if (ra === rb) return;
    if (this.rank[ra] < this.rank[rb]) this.parent[ra] = rb;
    else if (this.rank[ra] > this.rank[rb]) this.parent[rb] = ra;
    else { this.parent[rb] = ra; this.rank[ra]++; }
  }
}

export interface ClashGroup {
  id: string;
  head: ClashItemRef;
  members: ElementClash[];
  kinds: { intersect: number; touching: number; clearance: number; duplicate: number };
  metric: { totalOverlap_m3: number; minGap_m: number };
  worstPrecision: string;
  methods: string[];
}

function elementKey(ref: ClashItemRef): string {
  return `${ref.modelId}::${ref.localId}`;
}

export function groupClashes(
  clashes: readonly ElementClash[],
  opts: { preferLargerHead?: boolean } = {},
): ClashGroup[] {
  const n = clashes.length;
  if (n === 0) return [];

  const ds = new DisjointSet(n);
  const firstSeen = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const c = clashes[i];
    for (const ref of [c.a, c.b]) {
      const k = elementKey(ref);
      const prev = firstSeen.get(k);
      if (prev === undefined) firstSeen.set(k, i);
      else ds.union(prev, i);
    }
  }

  const buckets = new Map<number, ElementClash[]>();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const root = ds.find(i);
    const arr = buckets.get(root);
    if (arr) arr.push(clashes[i]);
    else buckets.set(root, [clashes[i]]);
  }

  const groups: ClashGroup[] = [];
  for (const members of buckets.values()) {
    groups.push(buildGroup(members, opts));
  }

  groups.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.kinds.intersect !== b.kinds.intersect) return b.kinds.intersect - a.kinds.intersect;
    if (a.kinds.touching !== b.kinds.touching) return b.kinds.touching - a.kinds.touching;
    return b.metric.totalOverlap_m3 - a.metric.totalOverlap_m3;
  });

  return groups;
}

function buildGroup(
  members: ElementClash[],
  opts: { preferLargerHead?: boolean },
): ClashGroup {
  const counts = new Map<string, { ref: ClashItemRef; count: number }>();
  for (const c of members) {
    for (const ref of [c.a, c.b]) {
      const k = elementKey(ref);
      const e = counts.get(k);
      if (e) e.count++;
      else counts.set(k, { ref, count: 1 });
    }
  }

  let headRef: ClashItemRef | null = null;
  if (opts.preferLargerHead) {
    let bestVol = -Infinity;
    for (const [k, { ref }] of counts) {
      const member = members.find((c) => elementKey(c.a) === k || elementKey(c.b) === k);
      if (!member) continue;
      const box = elementKey(member.a) === k ? member.boxA : member.boxB;
      const size = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
      try {
        const s = box.getSize({ x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 } as any);
        size.x = s.x; size.y = s.y; size.z = s.z;
      } catch {
        size.x = box.max.x - box.min.x;
        size.y = box.max.y - box.min.y;
        size.z = box.max.z - box.min.z;
      }
      const vol = size.x * size.y * size.z;
      if (vol > bestVol) { bestVol = vol; headRef = ref; }
    }
  } else {
    let best = -1;
    for (const [, { ref, count }] of counts) {
      if (count > best) { best = count; headRef = ref; }
    }
  }
  if (!headRef) headRef = members[0].a;

  const kinds = { intersect: 0, touching: 0, clearance: 0, duplicate: 0 };
  let totalOverlap = 0;
  let minGap = Infinity;
  const methods = new Set<string>();
  const precisionRank: Record<string, number> = {
    triangles: 5, hull: 4, sphere: 3, bbox: 2, depth: 2, center: 1, duplicate: 1,
  };
  let worstPrecision = "bbox";
  let worstRank = -1;

  for (const c of members) {
    kinds[c.kind]++;
    totalOverlap += c.depthVol;
    if (c.kind !== "intersect" && Number.isFinite(c.minGap)) {
      if (c.minGap < minGap) minGap = c.minGap;
    }
    methods.add(c.method);
    const r = precisionRank[c.precision] ?? 0;
    if (r > worstRank) { worstRank = r; worstPrecision = c.precision; }
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(minGap)) minGap = 0;

  members.sort((a, b) => {
    const order: Record<string, number> = { intersect: 0, touching: 1, clearance: 2, duplicate: 3 };
    const d = (order[a.kind] ?? 9) - (order[b.kind] ?? 9);
    if (d !== 0) return d;
    if (a.kind === "intersect") return b.depthVol - a.depthVol;
    return a.minGap - b.minGap;
  });

  return {
    id: `grp-${elementKey(headRef).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, "-")}`,
    head: headRef,
    members,
    kinds,
    metric: { totalOverlap_m3: totalOverlap, minGap_m: minGap },
    worstPrecision,
    methods: [...methods],
  };
}

export function flattenGroups(groups: readonly ClashGroup[]): ElementClash[] {
  const out: ElementClash[] = [];
  for (const g of groups) for (const c of g.members) out.push(c);
  return out;
}

export function summarizeGroups(groups: readonly ClashGroup[]): {
  groupCount: number;
  clashCount: number;
  intersectCount: number;
  touchingCount: number;
  clearanceCount: number;
  duplicateCount: number;
  largestGroup: { id: string; size: number } | null;
} {
  let clashCount = 0;
  let intersect = 0, touching = 0, clearance = 0, duplicate = 0;
  let largest: { id: string; size: number } | null = null;
  for (const g of groups) {
    clashCount += g.members.length;
    intersect += g.kinds.intersect;
    touching += g.kinds.touching;
    clearance += g.kinds.clearance;
    duplicate += g.kinds.duplicate;
    if (!largest || g.members.length > largest.size) {
      largest = { id: g.id, size: g.members.length };
    }
  }
  return {
    groupCount: groups.length,
    clashCount,
    intersectCount: intersect,
    touchingCount: touching,
    clearanceCount: clearance,
    duplicateCount: duplicate,
    largestGroup: largest,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Per-element triangle BVH.
 *
 * Purpose: replace the O(n·m) double loop in meshFaceClash with an
 * O(n log n + k) traversal where k is the number of candidate pairs that
 * actually overlap in space. On two 2,500-triangle elements this is
 * typically a 100–1,000× reduction in tri-tri tests.
 *
 * Median split on the longest centroid axis. Iterative traversal.
 * Node bounds are NOT expanded by tolerance — the caller expands when
 * comparing, because tolerance is a per-query parameter, not a per-tree one.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import type { Tri } from "./geometry";

interface BVHNode {
  box: THREE.Box3;
  left: BVHNode | null;
  right: BVHNode | null;
  /** Leaf range: [start, end). Internal nodes have start === end === 0. */
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

const MAX_LEAF = 8;

/** Scratch — used only inside build and traversal; never escapes. */
const _tmpA = new THREE.Box3();
const _tmpB = new THREE.Box3();
const _v = new THREE.Vector3();

export class TriangleBVH {
  /** Public so meshFaceClashBVH can index triangles without a copy. */
  readonly tris: Tri[];
  private order: number[];
  private root: BVHNode;

  constructor(tris: Tri[]) {
    this.tris = tris;
    this.order = new Array(tris.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < tris.length; i++) this.order[i] = i;
    this.root = this.build(0, tris.length);
  }

  get triCount(): number {
    return this.tris.length;
  }

  /** Depth-first triple count — useful for diagnostics. */
  stats(): { triangles: number; depth: number; nodes: number; leaves: number } {
    let depth = 0, nodes = 0, leaves = 0;
    const walk = (n: BVHNode, d: number) => {
      nodes++;
      if (d > depth) depth = d;
      if (!n.left && !n.right) {
        leaves++;
        return;
      }
      if (n.left) walk(n.left, d + 1);
      if (n.right) walk(n.right, d + 1);
    };
    walk(this.root, 0);
    return { triangles: this.tris.length, depth, nodes, leaves };
  }

  /**
   * Visit every candidate (i, j) triangle pair whose world-space AABBs
   * overlap within `tolerance` (expanded symmetrically on each side).
   *
   * `cb` returns true to continue, false to stop immediately.
   */
  visitCandidatePairs(
    other: TriangleBVH,
    tolerance: number,
    cb: (i: number, j: number) => boolean,
  ): void {
    const half = tolerance > 0 ? tolerance / 2 : 0;
    const stack: Array<[BVHNode | null, BVHNode | null]> = [[this.root, other.root]];

    while (stack.length) {
      const top = stack.pop()!;
      const a = top[0];
      const b = top[1];
      if (!a || !b) continue;

      // Bounds-overlap test with tolerance on each side.
      _tmpA.copy(a.box);
      _tmpB.copy(b.box);
      if (half > 0) {
        _tmpA.expandByScalar(half);
        _tmpB.expandByScalar(half);
      }
      if (!_tmpA.intersectsBox(_tmpB)) continue;

      const aLeaf = !a.left && !a.right;
      const bLeaf = !b.left && !b.right;

      if (aLeaf && bLeaf) {
        // Emit every pair; per-triangle AABB test is cheap and further
        // prunes before Möller.
        for (let i = a.start; i < a.end; i++) {
          const ia = this.order[i];
          const ta = this.tris[ia];
          const aMinX = Math.min(ta[0], ta[3], ta[6]);
          const aMaxX = Math.max(ta[0], ta[3], ta[6]);
          const aMinY = Math.min(ta[1], ta[4], ta[7]);
          const aMaxY = Math.max(ta[1], ta[4], ta[7]);
          const aMinZ = Math.min(ta[2], ta[5], ta[8]);
          const aMaxZ = Math.max(ta[2], ta[5], ta[8]);
          for (let j = b.start; j < b.end; j++) {
            const ib = other.order[j];
            const tb = other.tris[ib];
            const bMinX = Math.min(tb[0], tb[3], tb[6]);
            const bMaxX = Math.max(tb[0], tb[3], tb[6]);
            if (bMaxX + half < aMinX - half || aMaxX + half < bMinX - half) continue;
            const bMinY = Math.min(tb[1], tb[4], tb[7]);
            const bMaxY = Math.max(tb[1], tb[4], tb[7]);
            if (bMaxY + half < aMinY - half || aMaxY + half < bMinY - half) continue;
            const bMinZ = Math.min(tb[2], tb[5], tb[8]);
            const bMaxZ = Math.max(tb[2], tb[5], tb[8]);
            if (bMaxZ + half < aMinZ - half || aMaxZ + half < bMinZ - half) continue;
            if (!cb(ia, ib)) return;
          }
        }
      } else if (aLeaf) {
        stack.push([a, b.left]);
        stack.push([a, b.right]);
      } else if (bLeaf) {
        stack.push([a.left, b]);
        stack.push([a.right, b]);
      } else {
        // Descend the larger node first to balance work.
        const volA = a.box.getSize(_v).lengthSq();
        const volB = b.box.getSize(_v).lengthSq();
        if (volA >= volB) {
          stack.push([a.left, b]);
          stack.push([a.right, b]);
        } else {
          stack.push([a, b.left]);
          stack.push([a, b.right]);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  private triBox(i: number, out: THREE.Box3): THREE.Box3 {
    const t = this.tris[i];
    out.min.set(
      Math.min(t[0], t[3], t[6]),
      Math.min(t[1], t[4], t[7]),
      Math.min(t[2], t[5], t[8]),
    );
    out.max.set(
      Math.max(t[0], t[3], t[6]),
      Math.max(t[1], t[4], t[7]),
      Math.max(t[2], t[5], t[8]),
    );
    return out;
  }

  private build(start: number, end: number): BVHNode {
    const box = new THREE.Box3();
    const node: BVHNode = { box, left: null, right: null, start: 0, end: 0 };

    // Compute aggregate bounds and centroid extent.
    const centroidBox = new THREE.Box3();
    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
      const t = this.tris[this.order[i]];
      box.expandByPoint(_v.set(t[0], t[1], t[2]));
      box.expandByPoint(_v.set(t[3], t[4], t[5]));
      box.expandByPoint(_v.set(t[6], t[7], t[8]));
      _v.set(
        (t[0] + t[3] + t[6]) / 3,
        (t[1] + t[4] + t[7]) / 3,
        (t[2] + t[5] + t[8]) / 3,
      );
      centroidBox.expandByPoint(_v);
    }

    const count = end - start;
    if (count <= MAX_LEAF) {
      node.start = start;
      node.end = end;
      return node;
    }

    // Split on the longest centroid axis.
    const size = centroidBox.getSize(_v);
    let axis: 0 | 1 | 2 = 0;
    if (size.y > size.x) axis = 1;
    if (size.z > (axis === 0 ? size.x : size.y)) axis = 2;

    // Sort the subrange by centroid on `axis`. We only sort the slice
    // needed at this node, keeping the global `order` array mutated
    // in place. This is the standard approach for BVH build.
    const sub = this.order.slice(start, end);
    const key = (idx: number) => {
      const t = this.tris[idx];
      return (t[axis * 3] + t[axis * 3 + 3] + t[axis * 3 + 6]) / 3;
    };
    sub.sort((a, b) => key(a) - key(b));
    for (let i = 0; i < sub.length; i++) this.order[start + i] = sub[i];

    const mid = start + (count >> 1);
    node.left = this.build(start, mid);
    node.right = this.build(mid, end);
    return node;
  }
}
```

```ts
const API_BASE = String(
  (globalThis as any).__OPENBIM_COLLAB_API__ ||
    "http://localhost:4000/api",
);

type Any = Record<string, any>;

export interface PresenceUser {
  clientId: string;
  name: string;
  cursor?: Any | null;
  updatedAt?: number;
}

export interface RemoteChange {
  id?: string;
  clientId: string;
  type: string;
  payload?: Any;
  at?: string;
}

class RealtimeClient {
  roomId = "";
  clientId = "";
  name = "Guest";
  connected = false;

  private es: EventSource | null = null;
  private hb: number | null = null;

  async join(roomId: string, name = "Guest"): Promise<boolean> {
    this.stop();

    this.roomId = String(roomId || "").trim();
    this.name = String(name || "Guest").trim() || "Guest";
    this.clientId =
      this.clientId ||
      `u-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

    if (!this.roomId) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      await fetch(`${API_BASE}/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(this.roomId)}/join`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientId: this.clientId,
          name: this.name,
        }),
      });
    } catch {
      // Server may be offline; still attempt SSE.
    }

    const url = `${API_BASE}/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(this.roomId)}/events`;

    try {
      this.es = new EventSource(url);
    } catch {
      this.connected = false;
      return false;
    }

    this.es.onopen = () => {
      this.connected = true;
      this.dispatch("obs:live-connected", { roomId: this.roomId });
    };

    this.es.onerror = () => {
      this.connected = false;
      this.dispatch("obs:live-disconnected", { roomId: this.roomId });
    };

    this.es.addEventListener("presence", (ev: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const presence = JSON.parse(String(ev.data || "[]")) as PresenceUser[];
        this.dispatch("obs:presence", { presence, roomId: this.roomId });
      } catch {
        // ignore malformed event
      }
    });

    this.es.addEventListener("change", (ev: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const change = JSON.parse(String(ev.data || "{}")) as RemoteChange;

        if (change.clientId === this.clientId) {
          return;
        }

        this.dispatch("obs:remote-change", { change, roomId: this.roomId });
      } catch {
        // ignore malformed event
      }
    });

    this.hb = window.setInterval(() => {
      void fetch(
        `${API_BASE}/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(this.roomId)}/heartbeat`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            clientId: this.clientId,
            name: this.name,
          }),
        },
      ).catch(() => {
        // offline tolerant
      });
    }, 10000);

    return true;
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (this.hb !== null) {
      window.clearInterval(this.hb);
      this.hb = null;
    }

    if (this.es) {
      try {
        this.es.close();
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }

      this.es = null;
    }

    if (this.roomId && this.clientId) {
      void fetch(
        `${API_BASE}/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(this.roomId)}/leave`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ clientId: this.clientId }),
        },
      ).catch(() => {
        // offline tolerant
      });
    }

    this.connected = false;
    this.dispatch("obs:live-disconnected", { roomId: this.roomId });
  }

  async sendChange(type: string, payload: Any = {}): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.roomId || !this.clientId) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE}/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(this.roomId)}/change`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            clientId: this.clientId,
            type,
            payload,
          }),
        },
      );

      return res.ok;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  getPresenceUrl(): string {
    return `${API_BASE}/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(this.roomId)}`;
  }

  private dispatch(name: string, detail: Any): void {
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name, { detail }));
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }
}

export const realtimeClient = new RealtimeClient();

(globalThis as Any).__obsRealtimeClient = realtimeClient;

export function setupRealtimeClient(): void {
  console.log("[realtime-client] ready. Use __obsRealtimeClient.join(roomId, name)");
}
```

```ts
const API_BASE = "http://localhost:4000/api";

export interface WorkshareProject {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  data?: any;
  updatedAt?: string;
}

export const workshareClient = {
  baseUrl: API_BASE,

  async syncProject(project: WorkshareProject): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!project?.id) return false;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(project.id)}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(project),
      });
      return res.ok;
    } catch { return false; }
  },

  async pullProject(id: string): Promise<WorkshareProject | null> {
    if (!id) return null;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      return (await res.json()) as WorkshareProject;
    } catch { return null; }
  },
};
```
