```ts
/**
 * Copy / Monitor - track elements from a linked (federated) model and
 * optionally copy them into the host, with change detection (Revit-style).
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";

export type MonitorStatus = "ok" | "new" | "modified" | "deleted" | "orphaned";

export interface MonitoredElement {
  id: string;
  /** Source model id in the federation. */
  sourceModelId: string;
  /** Source local / express id. */
  sourceLocalId: number | string;
  /** Category / IFC type. */
  category: string;
  name: string;
  /** Fingerprint of geometry + key properties at last sync. */
  fingerprint: string;
  /** Host authored element id if copied. */
  hostElementId?: string;
  status: MonitorStatus;
  lastChecked: number;
}

export interface CopyMonitorRule {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  sourceModelId: string;
  /** Category filter (regex string). Empty = all. */
  categoryFilter: string;
  /** Automatically copy new elements into host. */
  autoCopy: boolean;
  /** Stop monitoring demolished source elements. */
  stopOnDelete: boolean;
}

const STORAGE = "obs.copy-monitor.v1";
type Listener = () => void;

function uid(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

function fingerprint(item: {
  name?: string;
  category?: string;
  box?: number[];
  props?: Record<string, unknown>;
}): string {
  const raw = JSON.stringify({
    n: item.name ?? "",
    c: item.category ?? "",
    b: (item.box ?? []).map((v) => Math.round(v * 1000)),
    p: item.props ?? {},
  });
  // Simple hash
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
    h = (Math.imul(31, h) + raw.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return h.toString(36);
}

class CopyMonitorStore {
  private rules: CopyMonitorRule[] = [];
  private monitored = new Map<string, MonitoredElement>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
      if (raw) {
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        this.rules = data.rules ?? [];
        for (const m of data.monitored ?? []) {
          this.monitored.set(m.id, m);
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE,
        JSON.stringify({
          rules: this.rules,
          monitored: [...this.monitored.values()],
        }),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  listRules(): CopyMonitorRule[] {
    return [...this.rules];
  }

  listMonitored(): MonitoredElement[] {
    return [...this.monitored.values()];
  }

  addRule(input: {
    name: string;
    sourceModelId: string;
    categoryFilter?: string;
    autoCopy?: boolean;
  }): CopyMonitorRule {
    const rule: CopyMonitorRule = {
      id: uid("cmr"),
      name: input.name,
      sourceModelId: input.sourceModelId,
      categoryFilter: input.categoryFilter ?? "",
      autoCopy: input.autoCopy ?? false,
      stopOnDelete: true,
    };
    this.rules.push(rule);
    this.persist();
    return rule;
  }

  removeRule(id: string): boolean {
    const n = this.rules.length;
    this.rules = this.rules.filter((r) => r.id !== id);
    // Drop monitored entries for this rule's model if no other rules cover it
    const still = new Set(this.rules.map((r) => r.sourceModelId));
    for (const [mid, m] of this.monitored) {
      if (!still.has(m.sourceModelId)) this.monitored.delete(mid);
    }
    if (this.rules.length !== n) {
      this.persist();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Scan federated models and update monitored status.
   * `scanItems` yields current items from a linked model.
   */
  sync(
    scanItems: (
      modelId: string,
    ) => Array<{
      localId: number | string;
      name: string;
      category: string;
      box?: number[];
      props?: Record<string, unknown>;
    }>,
  ): { new: number; modified: number; deleted: number; ok: number } {
    const counts = { new: 0, modified: 0, deleted: 0, ok: 0 };
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const now = Date.now();

    for (const rule of this.rules) {
      let items: ReturnType<typeof scanItems> = [];
      try {
        items = scanItems(rule.sourceModelId) ?? [];
      } catch {
        continue;
      }

      const catRe = rule.categoryFilter
        ? new RegExp(rule.categoryFilter, "i")
        : null;

      for (const item of items) {
        if (catRe && !catRe.test(item.category)) continue;
        const key = `${rule.sourceModelId}:${item.localId}`;
        seen.add(key);
        const fp = fingerprint(item);
        const existing = this.monitored.get(key);

        if (!existing) {
          const m: MonitoredElement = {
            id: key,
            sourceModelId: rule.sourceModelId,
            sourceLocalId: item.localId,
            category: item.category,
            name: item.name,
            fingerprint: fp,
            status: "new",
            lastChecked: now,
          };
          this.monitored.set(key, m);
          counts.new++;
        } else if (existing.fingerprint !== fp) {
          existing.fingerprint = fp;
          existing.name = item.name;
          existing.category = item.category;
          existing.status = "modified";
          existing.lastChecked = now;
          counts.modified++;
        } else {
          existing.status = "ok";
          existing.lastChecked = now;
          counts.ok++;
        }
      }
    }

    // Mark missing as deleted
    for (const [key, m] of this.monitored) {
      if (!seen.has(key)) {
        if (m.status !== "deleted") {
          m.status = "deleted";
          m.lastChecked = now;
          counts.deleted++;
        }
      }
    }

    this.persist();
    return counts;
  }

  /** Summary for UI badge. */
  summary(): { total: number; new: number; modified: number; deleted: number } {
    let neu = 0, mod = 0, del = 0;
    for (const m of this.monitored.values()) {
      if (m.status === "new") neu++;
      else if (m.status === "modified") mod++;
      else if (m.status === "deleted") del++;
    }
    return { total: this.monitored.size, new: neu, modified: mod, deleted: del };
  }

  acknowledge(id: string): void {
    const m = this.monitored.get(id);
    if (!m) return;
    if (m.status === "deleted") {
      this.monitored.delete(id);
    } else {
      m.status = "ok";
    }
    this.persist();
  }

  acknowledgeAll(): number {
    let n = 0;
    for (const [id, m] of [...this.monitored]) {
      if (m.status === "ok") continue;
      if (m.status === "deleted") this.monitored.delete(id);
      else m.status = "ok";
      n++;
    }
    if (n) this.persist();
    return n;
  }
}

export const copyMonitorStore = new CopyMonitorStore();

export function setupCopyMonitor(): typeof copyMonitorStore {
  copyMonitorStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).copyMonitor = copyMonitorStore;
  (window as any).__obsCopyMonitor = copyMonitorStore;
  console.log("[copy-monitor] ready -", copyMonitorStore.listRules().length, "rules");
  return copyMonitorStore;
}

/** Helper: run sync against federation fragment list if available. */
export async function runCopyMonitorSync(): Promise<ReturnType<CopyMonitorStore["sync"]>> {
  const scan = (modelId: string) => {
    const fragments = (ctx as any).fragments?.list as Map<string, any> | undefined;
    if (!fragments) return [];
    const model = fragments.get(modelId);
    if (!model) return [];
    // Best-effort: if model exposes a simple item list
    const items: Array<{
      localId: number | string;
      name: string;
      category: string;
      box?: number[];
    }> = [];
    try {
      if (typeof model.getItemsOfCategories === "function") {
        // Can't fully await here in sync callback; return empty and rely on caller
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    return items;
  };

  const result = copyMonitorStore.sync(scan);
  const s = copyMonitorStore.summary();
  if (s.new + s.modified + s.deleted > 0) {
    notify(
      "info",
      `Copy/Monitor: ${s.new} new, ${s.modified} modified, ${s.deleted} deleted`,
      { timeout: 3000 },
    );
  } else {
    notify("success", "Copy/Monitor: all monitored elements OK", { timeout: 1800 });
  }
  return result;
}
```

```ts
/** Cost state: items, assignments, computations. Persisted via projects module. */
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { emptyCostData, type CostAssignment, type CostData, type CostItem, type CostUnit, type TakeoffRow } from "./types";

let data: CostData = emptyCostData();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function onCostChanged(cb: () => void) { listeners.add(cb); }
function notify() { for (const cb of listeners) { try { cb(); } catch { /* */ } } }
function touch() { data.updatedAt = Date.now(); notify(); }

export function getCostData(): CostData { return data; }
export function setCostData(d: CostData | undefined | null) { data = d && typeof d === "object" ? d : emptyCostData(); data.assignments ??= {}; data.items ??= []; notify(); }

// ── Cost items CRUD ──
export function getItems(): CostItem[] { return data.items; }

export function addCostItem(patch: Partial<CostItem> = {}): CostItem {
  const item: CostItem = {
    id: (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `ci-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
    code: patch.code ?? `C-${String(data.items.length + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
    name: patch.name ?? "New cost item",
    unit: (patch.unit ?? "m3") as CostUnit,
    rate: patch.rate ?? 0,
    category: patch.category ?? "General",
  };
  data.items.push(item);
  touch();
  return item;
}

export function updateCostItem(id: string, patch: Partial<CostItem>) {
  const it = data.items.find((i) => i.id === id);
  if (!it) return;
  Object.assign(it, patch);
  touch();
}

export function deleteCostItem(id: string) {
  data.items = data.items.filter((i) => i.id !== id);
  for (const [k, a] of Object.entries(data.assignments)) {
    if (a.costItemId === id) data.assignments[k].costItemId = null;
  }
  touch();
}

// ── Assignments ──
export function getAssignment(rowKey: string): CostAssignment {
  return data.assignments[rowKey] ?? { rowKey, costItemId: null, qtyOverride: null };
}
export function setAssignment(rowKey: string, costItemId: string | null) {
  const a = getAssignment(rowKey);
  a.costItemId = costItemId;
  data.assignments[rowKey] = a;
  touch();
}
export function setQtyOverride(rowKey: string, qty: number | null) {
  const a = getAssignment(rowKey);
  a.qtyOverride = qty;
  data.assignments[rowKey] = a;
  touch();
}

// ── Computation ──
export function qtyForUnit(row: TakeoffRow, unit: CostUnit): number {
  switch (unit) {
    case "pcs": return row.count;
    case "m": return row.length;
    case "m2": return row.area;
    case "m3": return row.volume;
  }
  return 0;
}

export function computeLine(row: TakeoffRow): { qty: number; rate: number; lineCost: number; item: CostItem | null } {
  const a = getAssignment(row.key);
  const item = a.costItemId ? data.items.find((i) => i.id === a.costItemId) ?? null : null;
  if (!item) return { qty: 0, rate: 0, lineCost: 0, item: null };
  const qty = a.qtyOverride != null && Number.isFinite(a.qtyOverride) ? a.qtyOverride : qtyForUnit(row, item.unit);
  const lineCost = qty * (item.rate || 0);
  return { qty, rate: item.rate || 0, lineCost, item };
}

export interface Totals {
  grand: number;
  byCategory: { name: string; total: number }[];
  byItem: { item: CostItem; total: number }[];
  assignedRows: number;
  totalRows: number;
}

export function computeTotals(rows: TakeoffRow[]): Totals {
  const grand = { v: 0 };
  const byCat = new Map<string, number>();
  const byItem = new Map<string, number>();
  let assignedRows = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const { lineCost, item } = computeLine(row);
    if (!item) continue;
    assignedRows++;
    grand.v += lineCost;
    byCat.set(item.category || "General", (byCat.get(item.category || "General") ?? 0) + lineCost);
    byItem.set(item.id, (byItem.get(item.id) ?? 0) + lineCost);
  }
  return {
    grand: grand.v,
    byCategory: [...byCat.entries()].map(([name, total]) => ({ name, total })).sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total),
    byItem: [...byItem.entries()].map(([id, total]) => ({ item: data.items.find((i) => i.id === id)!, total })).filter((x) => x.item).sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total),
    assignedRows,
    totalRows: rows.length,
  };
}

// ── Setup ──
export function setupCost() {
  ctx.features.cost = {
    getCostData, setCostData, getItems, addCostItem, updateCostItem, deleteCostItem,
    getAssignment, setAssignment, setQtyOverride, computeLine, computeTotals, onCostChanged,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Takeoff engine v3.1.
 *
 * Authored elements: exact quantities from parametric definitions.
 *   - Doors, windows, and fittings are billed by the piece (count = 1).
 *   - Linear elements (walls, beams, pipes, ducts) report length + area + volume.
 *   - Slabs and footings report area + volume.
 *
 * IFC elements: reads Qto_*BaseQuantities psets when present (author-provided
 * numbers) and computes geometric values in parallel from triangle soups.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { getElements } from "../../features/authoring";
import { getElementTriangles, type Tri } from "../clash/geometry";
import type { TakeoffRow } from "./types";

let rows: TakeoffRow[] = [];
export function getRows(): TakeoffRow[] {
  return rows;
}

export function shortCat(cat: string) {
  return cat.replace(/^IFC/i, "").replace(/STANDARDCASE$/i, "") || cat;
}

function r3(n: number) {
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n * 1000) / 1000 : 0;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Geometry math
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function signedVolume(tris: Tri[]): number {
  let v = 0;
  for (const t of tris) {
    const ax = t[0], ay = t[1], az = t[2];
    const bx = t[3], by = t[4], bz = t[5];
    const cx = t[6], cy = t[7], cz = t[8];
    const crX = by * cz - bz * cy;
    const crY = bz * cx - bx * cz;
    const crZ = bx * cy - by * cx;
    v += (ax * crX + ay * crY + az * crZ) / 6;
  }
  return Math.abs(v);
}

function surfaceArea(tris: Tri[]): number {
  let s = 0;
  for (const t of tris) {
    const ux = t[3] - t[0];
    const uy = t[4] - t[1];
    const uz = t[5] - t[2];
    const vx = t[6] - t[0];
    const vy = t[7] - t[1];
    const vz = t[8] - t[2];
    const nx = uy * vz - uz * vy;
    const ny = uz * vx - ux * vz;
    const nz = ux * vy - uy * vx;
    s += 0.5 * Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz);
  }
  return s;
}

function principalLength(tris: Tri[], iterations = 24): number {
  let n = 0;
  let cx = 0, cy = 0, cz = 0;
  for (const t of tris) {
    cx += t[0] + t[3] + t[6];
    cy += t[1] + t[4] + t[7];
    cz += t[2] + t[5] + t[8];
    n += 3;
  }
  if (!n) return 0;
  cx /= n; cy /= n; cz /= n;

  let xx = 0, xy = 0, xz = 0, yy = 0, yz = 0, zz = 0;
  for (const t of tris) {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const dx = t[k * 3] - cx;
      const dy = t[k * 3 + 1] - cy;
      const dz = t[k * 3 + 2] - cz;
      xx += dx * dx; xy += dx * dy; xz += dx * dz;
      yy += dy * dy; yz += dy * dz; zz += dz * dz;
    }
  }

  let vx = 1, vy = 1, vz = 1;
  for (let it = 0; it < iterations; it++) {
    const nx = xx * vx + xy * vy + xz * vz;
    const ny = xy * vx + yy * vy + yz * vz;
    const nz = xz * vx + yz * vy + zz * vz;
    const len = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) || 1;
    vx = nx / len; vy = ny / len; vz = nz / len;
  }

  let min = Infinity, max = -Infinity;
  for (const t of tris) {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const p = t[k * 3] * vx + t[k * 3 + 1] * vy + t[k * 3 + 2] * vz;
      if (p < min) min = p;
      if (p > max) max = p;
    }
  }
  return Math.max(0, max - min);
}

function trustedVolume(tris: Tri[], boxVolume: number): number {
  const v = signedVolume(tris);
  if (!Number.isFinite(v) || v <= 0) return boxVolume;
  if (boxVolume > 0 && v > boxVolume * 1.05) return boxVolume;
  if (boxVolume > 0 && v < boxVolume * 0.02) return Math.min(v, boxVolume * 0.95);
  return v;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Qto extraction from IFC psets
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface QtoData {
  length: number;
  area: number;
  volume: number;
  found: boolean;
  sourceSet?: string;
}

function num(v: any): number | null {
  if (v == null) return null;
  const inner = typeof v === "object" && "value" in v ? (v as any).value : v;
  if (typeof inner === "number" && Number.isFinite(inner)) return inner;
  if (typeof inner === "string") {
    const n = parseFloat(inner);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }
  return null;
}

const AREA_KEYS = [
  "NetSideArea", "GrossSideArea", "NetArea", "GrossArea",
  "NetFloorArea", "GrossFloorArea",
  "NetFootprintArea", "GrossFootprintArea",
  "OuterSurfaceArea", "CrossSectionArea", "Area",
];
const VOLUME_KEYS = ["NetVolume", "GrossVolume", "Volume"];
const LENGTH_KEYS = ["Length", "Width", "Span"];

function pick(props: Record<string, any>, keys: string[]): number | null {
  for (const k of keys) {
    const v = num(props[k]);
    if (v != null) return v;
  }
  return null;
}

function extractQtoFromPsets(
  psets: Record<string, Record<string, any>>,
): QtoData | null {
  let length = 0, area = 0, volume = 0, found = false;
  let sourceSet: string | undefined;

  for (const [psName, props] of Object.entries(psets)) {
    if (!/^Qto_/i.test(psName)) continue;
    if (!props || typeof props !== "object") continue;

    const L = pick(props, LENGTH_KEYS);
    const A = pick(props, AREA_KEYS);
    const V = pick(props, VOLUME_KEYS);

    if (L != null) { length += L; found = true; sourceSet = psName; }
    if (A != null) { area += A; found = true; sourceSet = psName; }
    if (V != null) { volume += V; found = true; sourceSet = psName; }
  }

  return found ? { length, area, volume, found, sourceSet } : null;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Authored elements (exact, parametric)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function shoelaceArea(poly: [number, number][]): number {
  let s = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) {
    const [x1, z1] = poly[i];
    const [x2, z2] = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length];
    s += x1 * z2 - x2 * z1;
  }
  return Math.abs(s) / 2;
}

function authoredRows(): TakeoffRow[] {
  const out: TakeoffRow[] = [];
  for (const el of getElements()) {
    const p = el.params;
    let length = 0, area = 0, volume = 0;
    let detailSuffix = "exact";

    if ((el.type === "wall" || el.type === "strip") && p.start && p.end) {
      const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
      length = L;
      area = L * p.height * 2;
      volume = L * p.height * p.thickness;
    } else if (el.type === "slab" && p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 3) {
      const A = shoelaceArea(p.polygon);
      area = A;
      volume = A * p.height;
    } else if (el.type === "column" && p.point) {
      const w = p.thickness;
      const d = p.depth ?? p.thickness;
      length = p.height;
      area = 2 * (w + d) * p.height;
      volume = w * d * p.height;
    } else if (el.type === "beam" && p.start && p.end) {
      const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
      length = L;
      volume = L * p.height * p.thickness;
      area = 2 * L * (p.height + p.thickness);
    } else if (el.type === "brace" && p.start && p.end) {
      const L = Math.hypot(
        p.end[0] - p.start[0],
        p.end[1] - p.start[1],
        p.height,
      );
      length = L;
      volume = L * p.thickness * p.thickness;
    } else if (el.type === "truss" && p.start && p.end) {
      const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
      const t = p.thickness;
      const panels = Math.max(2, Number(el.properties?.panels ?? 4));
      const topChord = 2 * Math.hypot(L / 2, p.height);
      const posts = (panels - 1) * p.height * 0.6;
      const totalLen = L + topChord + posts;
      length = totalLen;
      volume = totalLen * t * t;
    } else if (el.type === "footing" && p.point) {
      const w = p.thickness;
      const d = p.depth ?? p.thickness;
      volume = w * d * p.height;
      area = 2 * (w * d) + 2 * (w + d) * p.height;
    } else if (el.type === "mline") {
      length =
        p.start && p.end
          ? Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1])
          : 0;
    } else if (el.type === "door" || el.type === "window") {
      // Doors and windows are counted by the piece.
      detailSuffix = `unit (${p.width ?? 0.9} × ${p.height} m)`;
    } else if (el.type === "fitting") {
      // Fittings are counted by the piece — they inherit their parent's
      // profile but the profile itself is not a separately billable
      // length / area / volume in a QS takeoff.
      const parent = (p.parentType as string) || "run";
      const profileLabel =
        parent === "pipe" || parent === "conduit"
          ? `Ø ${(p.thickness * 1000).toFixed(0)} mm`
          : `${(p.thickness * 1000).toFixed(0)} × ${(p.height * 1000).toFixed(0)} mm`;
      detailSuffix = `${parent} fitting (${profileLabel})`;
    }

    out.push({
      key: `authored:${el.id}`,
      source: "authored",
      label: el.name,
      detail: `${el.type} (authored, ${detailSuffix})`,
      count: 1,
      length: r3(length),
      area: r3(area),
      volume: r3(volume),
      primarySource: "authored",
    });
  }
  return out;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// IFC aggregation
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const LINEAR_CAT =
  /^(WALL|BEAM|COLUMN|MEMBER|PILE|PIPESEGMENT|PIPEFITTING|DUCTSEGMENT|DUCTFITTING|CABLECARRIERSEGMENT|CABLETRAY|CONDUIT|RAILING|CURTAINWALL|PLATE)/i;

interface Agg {
  count: number;
  qto: { length: number; area: number; volume: number; elements: number };
  geom: { length: number; area: number; volume: number; elements: number };
  bboxOnly: number;
}

async function readQtoBatches(
  model: any,
  ids: number[],
): Promise<Map<number, QtoData>> {
  const out = new Map<number, QtoData>();
  const CHUNK = 500;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const batch = ids.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    try {
      const data = await model.getItemsData(batch, {
        attributesDefault: false,
        psetsDefault: true,
      } as any);
      for (let j = 0; j < batch.length; j++) {
        const d = (data as any[])?.[j];
        const psets = d?.psets;
        if (!psets || typeof psets !== "object") continue;
        const q = extractQtoFromPsets(psets);
        if (q) out.set(batch[j], q);
      }
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
  }
  return out;
}

async function ifcRows(): Promise<TakeoffRow[]> {
  const out: TakeoffRow[] = [];

  for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    try {
      const ids: number[] = await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry();
      if (!ids?.length) continue;

      const boxes = await model.getBoxes(ids);
      let cats: Record<string, number[]> = {};
      try {
        cats = await model.getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      } catch { /* */ }
      const idToCat = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats)) {
        for (const id of (list as number[]) || []) idToCat.set(String(id), cat);
      }

      const qtoMap = await readQtoBatches(model, ids);

      const agg = new Map<string, Agg>();
      const s = new THREE.Vector3();

      for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        const b = boxes[i];
        if (!b || b.isEmpty()) continue;

        const localId = ids[i];
        const rawCat = idToCat.get(String(localId)) ?? "Other";
        const shortName = shortCat(rawCat);
        const key = `ifc:${modelId}:${shortName}`;

        let a = agg.get(key);
        if (!a) {
          a = {
            count: 0,
            qto: { length: 0, area: 0, volume: 0, elements: 0 },
            geom: { length: 0, area: 0, volume: 0, elements: 0 },
            bboxOnly: 0,
          };
          agg.set(key, a);
        }
        a.count++;

        const q = qtoMap.get(localId);
        if (q?.found) {
          a.qto.elements++;
          a.qto.length += q.length;
          a.qto.area += q.area;
          a.qto.volume += q.volume;
        }

        b.getSize(s);
        const boxVol = Math.abs(s.x * s.y * s.z);
        let tris: Tri[] | null = null;
        try {
          tris = getElementTriangles(model.object, localId);
        } catch {
          tris = null;
        }

        if (tris && tris.length) {
          a.geom.elements++;
          a.geom.volume += trustedVolume(tris, boxVol);
          a.geom.area += surfaceArea(tris);
          if (LINEAR_CAT.test(shortName)) {
            a.geom.length += principalLength(tris);
          }
        } else {
          a.bboxOnly++;
          a.geom.elements++;
          a.geom.volume += boxVol;
          a.geom.area += 2 * (s.x * s.y + s.x * s.z + s.y * s.z);
          if (LINEAR_CAT.test(shortName)) {
            a.geom.length += Math.max(s.x, s.y, s.z);
          }
        }
      }

      for (const [key, a] of agg) {
        const parts = key.split(":");
        const cat = parts.slice(2).join(":");

        const qtoShare = a.count > 0 ? a.qto.elements / a.count : 0;
        const primarySource: TakeoffRow["primarySource"] =
          qtoShare >= 0.5 ? "qto" : "geometry";
        const primary = primarySource === "qto" ? a.qto : a.geom;

        const variancePct =
          a.qto.volume > 0 && a.geom.volume > 0
            ? (Math.abs(a.qto.volume - a.geom.volume) / a.geom.volume) * 100
            : undefined;

        const precision =
          a.bboxOnly === 0
            ? "exact geometry"
            : a.bboxOnly === a.geom.elements
              ? "≈ bbox"
              : `≈ mixed (${a.geom.elements - a.bboxOnly} geo · ${a.bboxOnly} bbox)`;

        const detail =
          `${a.count} elements · model "${modelId}" · ${precision}` +
          (a.qto.elements ? ` · Qto ${a.qto.elements}/${a.count}` : "");

        out.push({
          key,
          source: "ifc",
          label: cat,
          detail,
          count: a.count,
          length: r3(primary.length),
          area: r3(primary.area),
          volume: r3(primary.volume),
          qto: a.qto.elements
            ? {
                length: r3(a.qto.length),
                area: r3(a.qto.area),
                volume: r3(a.qto.volume),
                elements: a.qto.elements,
              }
            : undefined,
          geom: a.geom.elements
            ? {
                length: r3(a.geom.length),
                area: r3(a.geom.area),
                volume: r3(a.geom.volume),
                elements: a.geom.elements,
              }
            : undefined,
          primarySource,
          variancePct,
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[cost] takeoff failed for model:", modelId, e);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Public
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export async function computeTakeoff(): Promise<TakeoffRow[]> {
  const authored = authoredRows();
  const ifc = await ifcRows();
  rows = [...authored, ...ifc];
  return rows;
}

export function r3Compat(n: number) {
  return r3(n);
}
```

```ts
export type CostUnit = "m" | "m2" | "m3" | "pcs";

export interface CostItem {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  unit: CostUnit;
  rate: number;
  category: string;
}

/** Aggregate of one quantity kind (length / area / volume) with element count. */
export interface QtoBundle {
  length: number;
  area: number;
  volume: number;
  /** Number of elements that contributed to this bundle. */
  elements: number;
}

export type TakeoffSource = "authored" | "qto" | "geometry" | "bbox";

export interface TakeoffRow {
  /** "authored:<elementId>" | "ifc:<modelId>:<category>" */
  key: string;
  source: "authored" | "ifc";
  label: string;
  detail: string;
  count: number;
  /** Primary values — Qto when present and majority, else geometry. */
  length: number;
  area: number;
  volume: number;

  /** Author-provided quantities from Qto_*BaseQuantities psets (IFC only). */
  qto?: QtoBundle;
  /** Geometric extraction from triangle soups (IFC only). */
  geom?: QtoBundle;
  /** Where the primary values came from. */
  primarySource?: TakeoffSource;
  /** |qto.volume − geom.volume| / geom.volume × 100 (when both present). */
  variancePct?: number;
}

export interface CostAssignment {
  rowKey: string;
  costItemId: string | null;
  qtyOverride: number | null;
}

export interface CostData {
  items: CostItem[];
  /** Keyed by TakeoffRow.key. */
  assignments: Record<string, CostAssignment>;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export function emptyCostData(): CostData {
  return { items: [], assignments: {}, updatedAt: 0 };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Curtain Wall System - grid of mullions + panels (Revit-style).
 *
 * Defines a rectangular curtain wall on a vertical plane, subdivided by
 * horizontal and vertical grid lines. Generates mullion boxes + panel faces.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export interface CurtainWallParams {
  /** Width along local X (m). */
  width: number;
  /** Height along local Y (m). */
  height: number;
  /** Origin (bottom-left of wall in world). */
  origin: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  /** Facing angle in XZ (radians). */
  angle: number;
  /** Number of vertical divisions (columns of panels). */
  vDivisions: number;
  /** Number of horizontal divisions (rows of panels). */
  hDivisions: number;
  /** Mullion depth (projection from plane). */
  mullionDepth: number;
  /** Mullion thickness. */
  mullionThickness: number;
  /** Panel thickness. */
  panelThickness: number;
  /** Optional custom V-grid positions 0-1 (overrides even divisions). */
  vGrid?: number[];
  /** Optional custom H-grid positions 0-1. */
  hGrid?: number[];
}

export interface CurtainWallResult {
  panelCount: number;
  mullionCount: number;
  object: THREE.Object3D;
  panels: Array<{
    u0: number; u1: number; v0: number; v1: number;
    center: THREE.Vector3;
  }>;
}

const DEFAULTS: CurtainWallParams = {
  width: 6,
  height: 3.5,
  origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
  angle: 0,
  vDivisions: 4,
  hDivisions: 2,
  mullionDepth: 0.12,
  mullionThickness: 0.05,
  panelThickness: 0.02,
};

function gridLines(count: number, custom?: number[]): number[] {
  if (custom && custom.length >= 2) {
    return [...custom].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  const lines: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) lines.push(i / count);
  return lines;
}

export function buildCurtainWall(input: Partial<CurtainWallParams> = {}): CurtainWallResult {
  const p: CurtainWallParams = {
    ...DEFAULTS,
    ...input,
    origin: { ...DEFAULTS.origin, ...input.origin },
  };

  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = "obs-curtain-wall";

  const cos = Math.cos(p.angle);
  const sin = Math.sin(p.angle);
  // Local axes: U along width, V along height, N outward
  const uAxis = new THREE.Vector3(cos, 0, sin);
  const vAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const nAxis = new THREE.Vector3(-sin, 0, cos);

  const vLines = gridLines(p.vDivisions, p.vGrid);
  const hLines = gridLines(p.hDivisions, p.hGrid);

  const mullionMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x64748b });
  const panelMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
    color: 0x7dd3fc,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.35,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  });

  let mullionCount = 0;
  const origin = new THREE.Vector3(p.origin.x, p.origin.y, p.origin.z);

  // Vertical mullions
  for (const u of vLines) {
    const base = origin.clone().addScaledVector(uAxis, u * p.width);
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.mullionThickness, p.height, p.mullionDepth);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mullionMat);
    mesh.position.copy(base).addScaledVector(vAxis, p.height / 2).addScaledVector(nAxis, p.mullionDepth / 2);
    mesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
    group.add(mesh);
    mullionCount++;
  }

  // Horizontal mullions
  for (const v of hLines) {
    const base = origin.clone().addScaledVector(vAxis, v * p.height);
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.mullionThickness, p.mullionDepth);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mullionMat);
    mesh.position.copy(base).addScaledVector(uAxis, p.width / 2).addScaledVector(nAxis, p.mullionDepth / 2);
    mesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
    group.add(mesh);
    mullionCount++;
  }

  // Panels
  const panels: CurtainWallResult["panels"] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < vLines.length - 1; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < hLines.length - 1; j++) {
      const u0 = vLines[i];
      const u1 = vLines[i + 1];
      const v0 = hLines[j];
      const v1 = hLines[j + 1];
      const pw = (u1 - u0) * p.width - p.mullionThickness;
      const ph = (v1 - v0) * p.height - p.mullionThickness;
      if (pw <= 0.01 || ph <= 0.01) continue;

      const cu = (u0 + u1) / 2;
      const cv = (v0 + v1) / 2;
      const center = origin
        .clone()
        .addScaledVector(uAxis, cu * p.width)
        .addScaledVector(vAxis, cv * p.height)
        .addScaledVector(nAxis, p.panelThickness / 2);

      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(pw, ph, p.panelThickness);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, panelMat);
      mesh.position.copy(center);
      mesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
      mesh.userData.curtainPanel = { row: j, col: i };
      group.add(mesh);

      panels.push({ u0, u1, v0, v1, center });
    }
  }

  return {
    panelCount: panels.length,
    mullionCount,
    object: group,
    panels,
  };
}

/** Insert a grid line at normalized position (0-1). */
export function insertGridLine(
  lines: number[],
  position: number,
): number[] {
  const t = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(0.99, position));
  if (lines.some((l) => Math.abs(l - t) < 0.01)) return lines;
  return [...lines, t].sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

export function setupCurtainWall(): void {
  (ctx.features as any).curtainWall = { buildCurtainWall, insertGridLine };
  (window as any).__obsCurtainWall = { buildCurtainWall, insertGridLine };
  console.log("[curtain-wall] system ready");
}
```

```ts
// src/modules/curtainWall/panelTypes.ts
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import * as THREE from 'three';

/**
 * Generate a curtain‑wall panel of a given type.
 * Types could be "solid", "glazed", "perforated" etc.
 * This stub returns an IfcWindow representing a panel.
 */
export async function createCurtainWallPanel(api: IfcAPI, type: string, width: number, height: number): Promise<number> {
  let geometry: THREE.Mesh;
  if (type === 'glazed') {
    geometry = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, 0.02), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x9fd9ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3 }));
  } else if (type === 'solid') {
    geometry = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, 0.1), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x777777 }));
  } else {
    // default simple panel
    geometry = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, 0.05), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xaaaaaa }));
  }
  const placement = await api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
  const shape = await api.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation({
    ContextOfItems: 0,
    RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
    RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
    Items: [{ type: 'IfcFacetedBrep', geometry }],
  });
  const panel = await api!.CreateIfcWindow!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
  return panel.id;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Design Options - Revit-style alternative design sets.
 *
 * Elements tagged with a designOptionId are visible only when that option
 * is active (or when viewing the primary/main model).
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export type OptionSetId = string;
export type OptionId = string;

export interface DesignOption {
  id: OptionId;
  name: string;
  /** Primary option within its set (the "main model" for that set). */
  isPrimary: boolean;
}

export interface DesignOptionSet {
  id: OptionSetId;
  name: string;
  options: DesignOption[];
  /** Currently active option for this set (drives viewport filter). */
  activeOptionId: OptionId | null;
}

const STORAGE = "obs.design-options.v1";
type Listener = () => void;

function uid(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

class DesignOptionsStore {
  private sets = new Map<OptionSetId, DesignOptionSet>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
      if (raw) {
        for (const s of JSON.parse(raw) as DesignOptionSet[]) {
          this.sets.set(s.id, s);
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify([...this.sets.values()]));
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  listSets(): DesignOptionSet[] {
    return [...this.sets.values()];
  }

  getSet(id: OptionSetId): DesignOptionSet | null {
    return this.sets.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  createSet(name: string): DesignOptionSet {
    const primary: DesignOption = {
      id: uid("opt"),
      name: "Primary",
      isPrimary: true,
    };
    const set: DesignOptionSet = {
      id: uid("oset"),
      name,
      options: [primary],
      activeOptionId: primary.id,
    };
    this.sets.set(set.id, set);
    this.persist();
    return set;
  }

  addOption(setId: OptionSetId, name: string): DesignOption | null {
    const set = this.sets.get(setId);
    if (!set) return null;
    const opt: DesignOption = { id: uid("opt"), name, isPrimary: false };
    set.options.push(opt);
    this.persist();
    return opt;
  }

  setActive(setId: OptionSetId, optionId: OptionId): boolean {
    const set = this.sets.get(setId);
    if (!set) return false;
    if (!set.options.find((o) => o.id === optionId)) return false;
    set.activeOptionId = optionId;
    this.persist();
    return true;
  }

  removeOption(setId: OptionSetId, optionId: OptionId): boolean {
    const set = this.sets.get(setId);
    if (!set) return false;
    const opt = set.options.find((o) => o.id === optionId);
    if (!opt || opt.isPrimary) return false;
    set.options = set.options.filter((o) => o.id !== optionId);
    if (set.activeOptionId === optionId) {
      set.activeOptionId = set.options.find((o) => o.isPrimary)?.id ?? null;
    }
    this.persist();
    return true;
  }

  removeSet(setId: OptionSetId): boolean {
    const ok = this.sets.delete(setId);
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  /**
   * Visibility test for an element tagged with designOptionId.
   * null / undefined - always visible (main model).
   */
  isVisible(designOptionId: string | null | undefined): boolean {
    if (!designOptionId) return true;
    for (const set of this.sets.values()) {
      const opt = set.options.find((o) => o.id === designOptionId);
      if (!opt) continue;
      // Visible if this option is active, or if it's primary and nothing else is forced
      if (set.activeOptionId === opt.id) return true;
      if (opt.isPrimary && set.activeOptionId == null) return true;
      return false;
    }
    // Unknown option id - show (don't hide orphaned tags)
    return true;
  }

  /** All currently active option ids across sets. */
  activeOptionIds(): Set<string> {
    const ids = new Set<string>();
    for (const set of this.sets.values()) {
      if (set.activeOptionId) ids.add(set.activeOptionId);
    }
    return ids;
  }
}

export const designOptionsStore = new DesignOptionsStore();

export function setupDesignOptions(): typeof designOptionsStore {
  designOptionsStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).designOptions = designOptionsStore;
  (window as any).__obsDesignOptions = designOptionsStore;
  console.log("[design-options] ready -", designOptionsStore.listSets().length, "sets");
  return designOptionsStore;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/drawings/dwg-engine.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Drawings Engine - DXF/DWG import-export + bridge to CAD engine & THREE.
 *
 * DXF: pure TypeScript parse + write (always available).
 * DWG: optional via dynamic import of `@mlightcad/libredwg-web` if installed;
 *      otherwise offers "convert externally / export DXF" path and accepts
 *      DXF that was converted from DWG.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import type { DxfDocument, DxfEntity, DxfLayer, DxfPoint } from "./dxf-types";
import { parseDxf, parseDxfFile } from "./dxf-reader";
import { writeDxf, downloadDxf } from "./dxf-writer";
import { cadEngine, type CadEntity, type CadPt } from "../cad/cad-engine";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

export interface DrawingDocument {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  format: "dxf" | "dwg" | "internal";
  doc: DxfDocument;
  loadedAt: number;
}

const drawings = new Map<string, DrawingDocument>();
let activeId: string | null = null;
let threeGroup: THREE.Group | null = null;

function uid(): string {
  return `dwg-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

function toast(kind: string, message: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { kind, message, timeout: 2500 } }),
    );
  } catch {
    console.log(`[drawings] ${kind}: ${message}`);
  }
}

/** ACI index - hex (subset). */
export function aciToHex(aci: number): string {
  const table: Record<number, string> = {
    1: "#ff0000",
    2: "#ffff00",
    3: "#00ff00",
    4: "#00ffff",
    5: "#0000ff",
    6: "#ff00ff",
    7: "#ffffff",
    8: "#808080",
    9: "#c0c0c0",
  };
  if (table[aci]) return table[aci];
  // AutoCAD ACI approximate
  const idx = ((aci % 255) + 255) % 255;
  const h = (idx * 37) % 360;
  return `hsl(${h} 70% 55%)`;
}

/* -- CAD - DXF conversion -------------------------------------------------- */

export function cadToDxfDocument(): DxfDocument {
  const layers = cadEngine.listLayers().map((l, i) => ({
    name: l.name,
    color: 7 - (i % 6),
  }));
  if (!layers.length) layers.push({ name: "0", color: 7 });

  const entities: DxfEntity[] = [];
  for (const e of cadEngine.getAllEntities()) {
    const layer = cadEngine.listLayers().find((l) => l.id === e.layer)?.name ?? "0";
    if (e.kind === "line" && e.b) {
      entities.push({
        type: "LINE",
        layer,
        start: { x: e.a.x, y: -e.a.y },
        end: { x: e.b.x, y: -e.b.y },
      });
    } else if (e.kind === "rect" && e.b) {
      const x0 = e.a.x, y0 = -e.a.y, x1 = e.b.x, y1 = -e.b.y;
      entities.push({
        type: "LWPOLYLINE",
        layer,
        closed: true,
        points: [
          { x: x0, y: y0 },
          { x: x1, y: y0 },
          { x: x1, y: y1 },
          { x: x0, y: y1 },
        ],
      });
    } else if (e.kind === "circle" && e.r != null) {
      entities.push({
        type: "CIRCLE",
        layer,
        center: { x: e.a.x, y: -e.a.y },
        radius: e.r,
      });
    } else if (e.kind === "arc" && e.r != null && e.startAngle != null && e.endAngle != null) {
      // SVG/screen Y is flipped; angles need care - export degrees
      entities.push({
        type: "ARC",
        layer,
        center: { x: e.a.x, y: -e.a.y },
        radius: e.r,
        startAngle: (-e.endAngle * 180) / Math.PI,
        endAngle: (-e.startAngle * 180) / Math.PI,
      });
    } else if (e.kind === "polyline" && e.points) {
      entities.push({
        type: "LWPOLYLINE",
        layer,
        points: e.points.map((p) => ({ x: p.x, y: -p.y })),
        closed: false,
      });
    } else if (e.kind === "text") {
      entities.push({
        type: "TEXT",
        layer,
        position: { x: e.a.x, y: -e.a.y },
        height: 14,
        value: e.text ?? "",
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    layers,
    entities,
    units: "mm",
    sourceFormat: "cad-engine",
  };
}

export function loadDxfIntoCad(
  doc: DxfDocument,
  opts: { clear?: boolean; scale?: number; offset?: CadPt } = {},
): number {
  const scale = opts.scale ?? 1;
  const ox = opts.offset?.x ?? 40;
  const oy = opts.offset?.y ?? 40;
  if (opts.clear !== false) cadEngine.clear();

  // Ensure layers
  for (const l of doc.layers) {
    const existing = cadEngine.listLayers().find((x) => x.name === l.name);
    if (!existing) {
      cadEngine.addLayer(l.name, aciToHex(l.color));
    }
  }

  const mapLayer = (name: string): string => {
    const found = cadEngine.listLayers().find((l) => l.name === name);
    if (found) {
      cadEngine.setActiveLayer(found.id);
      return found.id;
    }
    return cadEngine.getActiveLayer().id;
  };

  const toScreen = (p: DxfPoint): CadPt => ({
    x: p.x * scale + ox,
    y: -p.y * scale + oy, // DXF Y-up - screen Y-down
  });

  let n = 0;
  for (const e of doc.entities) {
    mapLayer(e.layer);
    if (e.type === "LINE") {
      cadEngine.addLine(toScreen(e.start), toScreen(e.end));
      n++;
    } else if (e.type === "CIRCLE") {
      cadEngine.addCircle(toScreen(e.center), e.radius * scale);
      n++;
    } else if (e.type === "ARC") {
      const c = toScreen(e.center);
      const a0 = (-e.startAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
      const a1 = (-e.endAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
      cadEngine.addArc(c, e.radius * scale, a0, a1);
      n++;
    } else if (e.type === "LWPOLYLINE") {
      const pts = e.points.map(toScreen);
      if (e.closed && pts.length) pts.push({ ...pts[0] });
      cadEngine.addPolyline(pts);
      n++;
    } else if (e.type === "TEXT") {
      cadEngine.addText(toScreen(e.position), e.value);
      n++;
    }
  }
  return n;
}

/* -- THREE preview group --------------------------------------------------- */

function ensureThreeGroup(): THREE.Group | null {
  const scene = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three as THREE.Scene | undefined;
  if (!scene) return null;
  if (!threeGroup) {
    threeGroup = new THREE.Group();
    threeGroup.name = "obs-drawings-dxf";
    scene.add(threeGroup);
  }
  return threeGroup;
}

export function loadDxfIntoScene(doc: DxfDocument, opts: { scale?: number } = {}): number {
  const group = ensureThreeGroup();
  if (!group) return 0;
  while (group.children.length) {
    const ch = group.children[0];
    group.remove(ch);
    (ch as Any).geometry?.dispose?.();
  }

  const scale = opts.scale ?? 0.001; // mm - m default
  const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8 });
  let n = 0;

  const addLine = (a: DxfPoint, b: DxfPoint, color?: number) => {
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
      new THREE.Vector3(a.x * scale, (a.z ?? 0) * scale, -a.y * scale),
      new THREE.Vector3(b.x * scale, (b.z ?? 0) * scale, -b.y * scale),
    ]);
    const m = color != null ? new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(aciToHex(color)) }) : mat;
    group!.add(new THREE.Line(geo, m));
    n++;
  };

  for (const e of doc.entities) {
    if (e.type === "LINE") addLine(e.start, e.end, e.color);
    else if (e.type === "CIRCLE") {
      const curve = new THREE.EllipseCurve(
        0, 0, e.radius, e.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2, false, 0,
      );
      const pts = curve.getPoints(48).map(
        (p) =>
          new THREE.Vector3(
            (e.center.x + p.x) * scale,
            (e.center.z ?? 0) * scale,
            -(e.center.y + p.y) * scale,
          ),
      );
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
      group.add(new THREE.LineLoop(geo, mat));
      n++;
    } else if (e.type === "LWPOLYLINE") {
      for (let i = 0; i < e.points.length - 1; i++) {
        addLine(e.points[i], e.points[i + 1], e.color);
      }
      if (e.closed && e.points.length > 1) {
        addLine(e.points[e.points.length - 1], e.points[0], e.color);
      }
    } else if (e.type === "ARC") {
      const a0 = (e.startAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
      const a1 = (e.endAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
      const curve = new THREE.EllipseCurve(
        0, 0, e.radius, e.radius, a0, a1, false, 0,
      );
      const pts = curve.getPoints(32).map(
        (p) =>
          new THREE.Vector3(
            (e.center.x + p.x) * scale,
            (e.center.z ?? 0) * scale,
            -(e.center.y + p.y) * scale,
          ),
      );
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
      group.add(new THREE.Line(geo, mat));
      n++;
    }
  }
  return n;
}

/* -- Import / export API --------------------------------------------------- */

export async function importDxfText(
  text: string,
  name = "drawing.dxf",
  opts?: { intoCad?: boolean; intoScene?: boolean; clearCad?: boolean },
): Promise<DrawingDocument> {
  const doc = parseDxf(text);
  const id = uid();
  const drawing: DrawingDocument = {
    id,
    name,
    format: "dxf",
    doc,
    loadedAt: Date.now(),
  };
  drawings.set(id, drawing);
  activeId = id;

  if (opts?.intoCad !== false) {
    const n = loadDxfIntoCad(doc, { clear: opts?.clearCad !== false });
    toast("success", `DXF - CAD: ${n} entities`);
  }
  if (opts?.intoScene) {
    const n = loadDxfIntoScene(doc);
    toast("info", `DXF - 3D: ${n} objects`);
  }
  return drawing;
}

export async function importDxfFile(
  file: File,
  opts?: { intoCad?: boolean; intoScene?: boolean },
): Promise<DrawingDocument> {
  const text = await file.text();
  return importDxfText(text, file.name, opts);
}

/**
 * Try DWG via optional @mlightcad/libredwg-web.
 * If not installed, returns null and caller should prompt for DXF.
 */
export async function tryImportDwg(file: File): Promise<DrawingDocument | null> {
  try {
    // Optional peer dependency - may not be installed
    // Optional peer; not listed in package.json - dynamic string avoids TS2307
    const pkg = "@mlightcad/" + "libredwg-web";
    // @ts-ignore optional dependency
    const mod: Any = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ pkg);
    const LibreDwg = mod.LibreDwg ?? mod.default?.LibreDwg;
    const Dwg_File_Type = mod.Dwg_File_Type ?? mod.default?.Dwg_File_Type;
    if (!LibreDwg?.create) {
      console.warn("[dwg-engine] libredwg-web loaded but API mismatch");
      return null;
    }
    const lib = await LibreDwg.create();
    const buf = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const raw = lib.dwg_read_data(buf, Dwg_File_Type?.DWG ?? 0);
    const db = lib.convert?.(raw) ?? raw;

    // Best-effort extract entities from converted DB
    const entities: DxfEntity[] = [];
    const layers: DxfLayer[] = [{ name: "0", color: 7 }];
    const ents = db?.entities ?? db?.modelSpace?.entities ?? [];
    for (const e of ents) {
      const type = String(e.type ?? e.entityType ?? "").toUpperCase();
      const layer = e.layer ?? e.layerName ?? "0";
      if (type.includes("LINE") && e.start && e.end) {
        entities.push({
          type: "LINE",
          layer,
          start: { x: e.start.x, y: e.start.y, z: e.start.z },
          end: { x: e.end.x, y: e.end.y, z: e.end.z },
        });
      } else if (type.includes("CIRCLE") && e.center && e.radius != null) {
        entities.push({
          type: "CIRCLE",
          layer,
          center: { x: e.center.x, y: e.center.y },
          radius: e.radius,
        });
      }
    }

    const doc: DxfDocument = {
      layers,
      entities,
      sourceFormat: "dwg",
    };
    const id = uid();
    const drawing: DrawingDocument = {
      id,
      name: file.name,
      format: "dwg",
      doc,
      loadedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    drawings.set(id, drawing);
    activeId = id;
    loadDxfIntoCad(doc);
    loadDxfIntoScene(doc);
    toast("success", `DWG imported: ${entities.length} entities`);
    return drawing;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[dwg-engine] DWG import unavailable:", err);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function importDrawingFile(file: File): Promise<DrawingDocument | null> {
  const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
  if (name.endsWith(".dxf")) {
    return importDxfFile(file, { intoCad: true, intoScene: true });
  }
  if (name.endsWith(".dwg")) {
    const result = await tryImportDwg(file);
    if (result) return result;
    toast(
      "warn",
      "DWG needs @mlightcad/libredwg-web - export DXF from CAD, or: npm i @mlightcad/libredwg-web",
    );
    return null;
  }
  toast("warn", "Use .dxf or .dwg files");
  return null;
}

export function exportActiveDxf(filename?: string): void {
  const doc =
    (activeId && drawings.get(activeId)?.doc) || cadToDxfDocument();
  downloadDxf(doc, filename ?? drawings.get(activeId!)?.name ?? "drawing.dxf");
  toast("success", "DXF exported");
}

export function exportCadAsDxf(filename = "cad-export.dxf"): void {
  downloadDxf(cadToDxfDocument(), filename);
  toast("success", "CAD - DXF exported");
}

export function listDrawings(): DrawingDocument[] {
  return [...drawings.values()];
}

export function getActiveDrawing(): DrawingDocument | null {
  return activeId ? drawings.get(activeId) ?? null : null;
}

export function clearDrawingsScene(): void {
  if (threeGroup) {
    while (threeGroup.children.length) {
      const ch = threeGroup.children[0];
      threeGroup.remove(ch);
    }
  }
}

export function setupDwgEngine(): void {
  (ctx.features as Any).drawings = {
    importDxfText,
    importDxfFile,
    importDrawingFile,
    exportActiveDxf,
    exportCadAsDxf,
    cadToDxfDocument,
    loadDxfIntoCad,
    loadDxfIntoScene,
    listDrawings,
    getActiveDrawing,
    clearDrawingsScene,
    parseDxf,
    writeDxf,
  };
  (window as Any).__obsDrawings = (ctx.features as Any).drawings;
  console.log("[dwg-engine] Drawings DXF/DWG engine ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * DXF ASCII reader - LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, TEXT, POINT, LAYER.
 * Pure TypeScript, no deps.
 */

import type { DxfDocument, DxfEntity, DxfLayer, DxfPoint } from "./dxf-types";

interface Pair {
  code: number;
  value: string;
}

function tokenize(text: string): Pair[] {
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/\r/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const pairs: Pair[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < lines.length; i += 2) {
    const code = Number(lines[i].trim());
    const value = lines[i + 1] ?? "";
    if (!Number.isFinite(code)) continue;
    pairs.push({ code, value: value.trimEnd() });
  }
  return pairs;
}

function num(v: string): number {
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

/** Parse DXF ASCII into a document. */
export function parseDxf(text: string): DxfDocument {
  const pairs = tokenize(text);
  const layers: DxfLayer[] = [];
  const entities: DxfEntity[] = [];
  let section = "";
  let table = "";
  let i = 0;

  const takeEntity = (type: string, start: number): number => {
    const data = new Map<number, string[]>();
    const push = (code: number, value: string) => {
      const arr = data.get(code) ?? [];
      arr.push(value);
      data.set(code, arr);
    };
    let j = start;
    // current type pair already consumed by caller conceptually - start at first data
    while (j < pairs.length) {
      const p = pairs[j];
      if (p.code === 0) break;
      push(p.code, p.value);
      j++;
    }

    const layer = data.get(8)?.[0] ?? "0";
    const color = data.get(62) ? num(data.get(62)![0]) : undefined;
    const get = (c: number, idx = 0) => data.get(c)?.[idx];
    const pt = (xCode: number, yCode: number, zCode: number, idx = 0): DxfPoint => ({
      x: num(get(xCode, idx) ?? "0"),
      y: num(get(yCode, idx) ?? "0"),
      z: num(get(zCode, idx) ?? "0"),
    });

    if (type === "LINE") {
      entities.push({
        type: "LINE",
        layer,
        color,
        start: pt(10, 20, 30),
        end: pt(11, 21, 31),
      });
    } else if (type === "CIRCLE") {
      entities.push({
        type: "CIRCLE",
        layer,
        color,
        center: pt(10, 20, 30),
        radius: num(get(40) ?? "0"),
      });
    } else if (type === "ARC") {
      entities.push({
        type: "ARC",
        layer,
        color,
        center: pt(10, 20, 30),
        radius: num(get(40) ?? "0"),
        startAngle: num(get(50) ?? "0"),
        endAngle: num(get(51) ?? "360"),
      });
    } else if (type === "LWPOLYLINE") {
      const xs = data.get(10) ?? [];
      const ys = data.get(20) ?? [];
      const points: DxfPoint[] = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < xs.length; k++) {
        points.push({ x: num(xs[k]), y: num(ys[k] ?? "0") });
      }
      const flags = num(get(70) ?? "0");
      entities.push({
        type: "LWPOLYLINE",
        layer,
        color,
        points,
        closed: (flags & 1) === 1,
      });
    } else if (type === "TEXT" || type === "MTEXT") {
      entities.push({
        type: "TEXT",
        layer,
        color,
        position: pt(10, 20, 30),
        height: num(get(40) ?? "2.5"),
        value: get(1) ?? "",
        rotation: get(50) ? num(get(50)!) : undefined,
      });
    } else if (type === "POINT") {
      entities.push({
        type: "POINT",
        layer,
        color,
        position: pt(10, 20, 30),
      });
    }
    // Skip VERTEX/SEQEND of old POLYLINE - basic support via collecting
    return j;
  };

  while (i < pairs.length) {
    const p = pairs[i];
    if (p.code === 0 && p.value === "SECTION") {
      i++;
      if (pairs[i]?.code === 2) {
        section = pairs[i].value;
        i++;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (p.code === 0 && p.value === "ENDSEC") {
      section = "";
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (p.code === 0 && p.value === "TABLE") {
      i++;
      if (pairs[i]?.code === 2) {
        table = pairs[i].value;
        i++;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (p.code === 0 && p.value === "ENDTAB") {
      table = "";
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (p.code === 0 && p.value === "EOF") break;

    if (section === "TABLES" && table === "LAYER" && p.code === 0 && p.value === "LAYER") {
      i++;
      let name = "0";
      let color = 7;
      let frozen = false;
      while (i < pairs.length && pairs[i].code !== 0) {
        if (pairs[i].code === 2) name = pairs[i].value;
        if (pairs[i].code === 62) color = num(pairs[i].value);
        if (pairs[i].code === 70) frozen = (num(pairs[i].value) & 1) === 1;
        i++;
      }
      layers.push({ name, color, frozen });
      continue;
    }

    if (section === "ENTITIES" && p.code === 0) {
      const type = p.value;
      i++;
      i = takeEntity(type, i);
      continue;
    }

    i++;
  }

  if (!layers.some((l) => l.name === "0")) {
    layers.unshift({ name: "0", color: 7 });
  }

  return {
    layers,
    entities,
    sourceFormat: "dxf",
  };
}

export async function parseDxfFile(file: File | Blob): Promise<DxfDocument> {
  const text = await file.text();
  return parseDxf(text);
}
```

```ts
/** Shared types for the Drawings / DXF / DWG engine. */

export interface DxfPoint {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z?: number;
}

export interface DxfLayer {
  name: string;
  color: number; // ACI color index 1-255
  lineType?: string;
  frozen?: boolean;
  locked?: boolean;
}

export type DxfEntity =
  | {
      type: "LINE";
      layer: string;
      start: DxfPoint;
      end: DxfPoint;
      color?: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "CIRCLE";
      layer: string;
      center: DxfPoint;
      radius: number;
      color?: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "ARC";
      layer: string;
      center: DxfPoint;
      radius: number;
      startAngle: number; // degrees
      endAngle: number;
      color?: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "LWPOLYLINE";
      layer: string;
      points: DxfPoint[];
      closed?: boolean;
      color?: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "TEXT";
      layer: string;
      position: DxfPoint;
      height: number;
      value: string;
      rotation?: number;
      color?: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "POINT";
      layer: string;
      position: DxfPoint;
      color?: number;
    };

export interface DxfDocument {
  layers: DxfLayer[];
  entities: DxfEntity[];
  /** Drawing extents (model space). */
  extents?: { min: DxfPoint; max: DxfPoint };
  units?: "unitless" | "mm" | "m" | "in" | "ft";
  sourceFormat?: "dxf" | "dwg" | "cad-engine" | "unknown";
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/drawings/dxf-writer.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * DXF ASCII writer (AutoCAD R2010 / AC1024 compatible subset).
 * Pure TypeScript - no native deps.
 */

import type { DxfDocument, DxfEntity, DxfLayer, DxfPoint } from "./dxf-types";

function pair(code: number, value: string | number): string {
  return `${code}\n${value}\n`;
}

function writePoint(codes: [number, number, number], p: DxfPoint): string {
  return (
    pair(codes[0], p.x) +
    pair(codes[1], p.y) +
    pair(codes[2], p.z ?? 0)
  );
}

function layerTable(layers: DxfLayer[]): string {
  let s = "";
  s += pair(0, "TABLE");
  s += pair(2, "LAYER");
  s += pair(5, "2");
  s += pair(100, "AcDbSymbolTable");
  s += pair(70, layers.length);
  for (const layer of layers) {
    s += pair(0, "LAYER");
    s += pair(5, Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xfffff).toString(16));
    s += pair(100, "AcDbSymbolTableRecord");
    s += pair(100, "AcDbLayerTableRecord");
    s += pair(2, layer.name);
    s += pair(70, layer.frozen ? 1 : 0);
    s += pair(62, layer.color || 7);
    s += pair(6, layer.lineType || "Continuous");
  }
  s += pair(0, "ENDTAB");
  return s;
}

function writeEntity(e: DxfEntity): string {
  let s = "";
  const layer = e.layer || "0";
  const color = e.color ?? 256; // ByLayer

  if (e.type === "LINE") {
    s += pair(0, "LINE");
    s += pair(8, layer);
    s += pair(62, color);
    s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], e.start);
    s += writePoint([11, 21, 31], e.end);
  } else if (e.type === "CIRCLE") {
    s += pair(0, "CIRCLE");
    s += pair(8, layer);
    s += pair(62, color);
    s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], e.center);
    s += pair(40, e.radius);
  } else if (e.type === "ARC") {
    s += pair(0, "ARC");
    s += pair(8, layer);
    s += pair(62, color);
    s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], e.center);
    s += pair(40, e.radius);
    s += pair(50, e.startAngle);
    s += pair(51, e.endAngle);
  } else if (e.type === "LWPOLYLINE") {
    s += pair(0, "LWPOLYLINE");
    s += pair(8, layer);
    s += pair(62, color);
    s += pair(90, e.points.length);
    s += pair(70, e.closed ? 1 : 0);
    for (const p of e.points) {
      s += pair(10, p.x);
      s += pair(20, p.y);
    }
  } else if (e.type === "TEXT") {
    s += pair(0, "TEXT");
    s += pair(8, layer);
    s += pair(62, color);
    s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], e.position);
    s += pair(40, e.height);
    s += pair(1, e.value);
    if (e.rotation != null) s += pair(50, e.rotation);
  } else if (e.type === "POINT") {
    s += pair(0, "POINT");
    s += pair(8, layer);
    s += pair(62, color);
    s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], e.position);
  }
  return s;
}

function computeExtents(entities: DxfEntity[]): { min: DxfPoint; max: DxfPoint } {
  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  const add = (p: DxfPoint) => {
    minX = Math.min(minX, p.x);
    minY = Math.min(minY, p.y);
    maxX = Math.max(maxX, p.x);
    maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.y);
  };
  for (const e of entities) {
    if (e.type === "LINE") {
      add(e.start);
      add(e.end);
    } else if (e.type === "CIRCLE" || e.type === "ARC") {
      add({ x: e.center.x - e.radius, y: e.center.y - e.radius });
      add({ x: e.center.x + e.radius, y: e.center.y + e.radius });
    } else if (e.type === "LWPOLYLINE") {
      e.points.forEach(add);
    } else if (e.type === "TEXT" || e.type === "POINT") {
      add(e.position);
    }
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(minX)) {
    return { min: { x: 0, y: 0 }, max: { x: 100, y: 100 } };
  }
  return { min: { x: minX, y: minY }, max: { x: maxX, y: maxY } };
}

/** Serialize a document to DXF R2010 ASCII. */
export function writeDxf(doc: DxfDocument): string {
  const layers =
    doc.layers.length > 0
      ? doc.layers
      : [{ name: "0", color: 7 }];
  const extents = doc.extents ?? computeExtents(doc.entities);

  let s = "";
  // HEADER
  s += pair(0, "SECTION");
  s += pair(2, "HEADER");
  s += pair(9, "$ACADVER");
  s += pair(1, "AC1024");
  s += pair(9, "$INSUNITS");
  const unitsMap: Record<string, number> = {
    unitless: 0,
    in: 1,
    ft: 2,
    mm: 4,
    m: 6,
  };
  s += pair(70, unitsMap[doc.units ?? "mm"] ?? 4);
  s += pair(9, "$EXTMIN");
  s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], extents.min);
  s += pair(9, "$EXTMAX");
  s += writePoint([10, 20, 30], extents.max);
  s += pair(0, "ENDSEC");

  // TABLES
  s += pair(0, "SECTION");
  s += pair(2, "TABLES");
  // LTYPE
  s += pair(0, "TABLE");
  s += pair(2, "LTYPE");
  s += pair(5, "1");
  s += pair(100, "AcDbSymbolTable");
  s += pair(70, 1);
  s += pair(0, "LTYPE");
  s += pair(5, "10");
  s += pair(100, "AcDbSymbolTableRecord");
  s += pair(100, "AcDbLinetypeTableRecord");
  s += pair(2, "Continuous");
  s += pair(70, 0);
  s += pair(3, "Solid line");
  s += pair(72, 65);
  s += pair(73, 0);
  s += pair(40, 0);
  s += pair(0, "ENDTAB");
  s += layerTable(layers);
  s += pair(0, "ENDSEC");

  // ENTITIES
  s += pair(0, "SECTION");
  s += pair(2, "ENTITIES");
  for (const e of doc.entities) {
    s += writeEntity(e);
  }
  s += pair(0, "ENDSEC");

  s += pair(0, "EOF");
  return s;
}

/** Download a DXF string as a file in the browser. */
export function downloadDxf(doc: DxfDocument, filename = "drawing.dxf"): void {
  const text = writeDxf(doc);
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: "application/dxf" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename.endsWith(".dxf") ? filename : `${filename}.dxf`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
```
