--- FILE: src/modules/drawings/plan-generator.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Plan view generator.
 *
 * Cut plane at `levelElevation + cutHeight`. Looks down (bird's eye).
 * Fragment geometry: per-element triangle edges, filtered to the cut band,
 * projected to XZ, deduplicated at 1 mm resolution.
 *
 * Authored elements (walls, doors, windows, columns, beams, slabs) generate
 * parametric 2D symbols — real Revit-style plan representations, not
 * bounding boxes.
 *
 * Screen convention inside the plan: `screenX = worldX`, `screenY = -worldZ`.
 * The panel handles the flip when rendering SVG.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { getElementTriangles } from "../clash/geometry";
import {
  getElements,
  getGrids,
  getLevels,
} from "../../features/authoring";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import type {
  PlanArc, PlanGenerationOptions, PlanSegment, PlanText, PlanView,
} from "./plan-types";

const EDGE_ROUND = 1000; // 1 mm dedup
const MIN_EDGE_LEN = 0.005; // 5 mm — kill degenerate projections

function key2(x: number, z: number): string {
  return `${Math.round(x * EDGE_ROUND)},${Math.round(z * EDGE_ROUND)}`;
}

function edgeKey(x1: number, z1: number, x2: number, z2: number): string {
  const a = key2(x1, z1);
  const b = key2(x2, z2);
  return a < b ? `${a}|${b}` : `${b}|${a}`;
}

export async function generatePlanView(
  opts: PlanGenerationOptions,
): Promise<PlanView> {
  // Revit-like view range: Top is above the cut plane; Bottom and View Depth
  // control how far below the associated level the plan can see. Legacy cutDepth
  // remains the fallback for callers that only provide the original API.
  const lowDepth = Math.max(
    Math.abs(opts.viewRangeBottom ?? 0),
    Math.abs(opts.viewDepth ?? opts.cutDepth),
  );
  const highDepth = Math.max(opts.cutHeight, Math.abs(opts.viewRangeTop ?? opts.cutHeight));
  const bandLow = opts.levelElevation - lowDepth;
  const bandHigh = opts.levelElevation + highDepth;
  const cutElevation = opts.levelElevation + opts.cutHeight;

  const segments: PlanSegment[] = [];
  const arcs: PlanArc[] = [];
  const texts: PlanText[] = [];
  let truncated = false;
  const edgeSeen = new Set<string>();

  const pushSeg = (s: PlanSegment) => {
    if (segments.length >= opts.maxSegments) {
      truncated = true;
      return;
    }
    const len = Math.hypot(s.x2 - s.x1, s.z2 - s.z1);
    if (len < MIN_EDGE_LEN) return;
    segments.push(s);
  };

  // ── 1. Authored elements (all modeling categories) ───────────────────
  const authored = getElements();
  // Include every authored element; symbol layer chooses cut / overhead / below
  const authoredInBand = authored.filter((el) => {
    const elev = el.params.elevation ?? 0;
    const h = el.params.height ?? 0.1;
    // Always include linear MEP / structure even if slightly outside band
    if (["duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit", "beam", "brace", "truss", "mline", "strip"].includes(el.type)) {
      return elev <= bandHigh + 3 && elev + h >= bandLow - 1;
    }
    return elev <= bandHigh && elev + h >= bandLow;
  });

  // Build door/window map by host wall
  const hostedByWall = new Map<string, AuthoredElement[]>();
  for (const el of authored) {
    if ((el.type === "door" || el.type === "window") && el.hostId) {
      if (!hostedByWall.has(el.hostId)) hostedByWall.set(el.hostId, []);
      hostedByWall.get(el.hostId)!.push(el);
    }
  }

  for (const el of authoredInBand) {
    if (opts.signal?.cancelled) break;
    emitAuthoredSymbol(el, segments, arcs, texts, pushSeg, hostedByWall, cutElevation, bandLow, bandHigh);
  }

  // ── 2. Fragments (triangle edge extraction) ──────────────────────────
  opts.onProgress?.({ phase: "Reading models", current: 0, total: ctx.fragments.list.size });

  let mi = 0;
  let fragmentElements = 0;
  let fragmentEdgeCount = 0;
  for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    mi++;
    opts.onProgress?.({ phase: `Model: ${modelId}`, current: mi, total: ctx.fragments.list.size });
    if (opts.signal?.cancelled) break;

    let ids: number[] = [];
    let boxes: THREE.Box3[] = [];
    try {
      ids = (await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry()) ?? [];
      boxes = await model.getBoxes(ids);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }

    try {
      model.object.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    } catch { /* */ }
    const mw: THREE.Matrix4 = model.object.matrixWorld?.clone?.() ?? new THREE.Matrix4();

    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      if (opts.signal?.cancelled) break;
      if (truncated && segments.length >= opts.maxSegments) break;

      const b = boxes[i];
      if (!b || b.isEmpty()) continue;
      const world = b.clone().applyMatrix4(mw);
      // Quick reject: box outside the cut band
      if (world.max.y < bandLow || world.min.y > bandHigh) continue;

      fragmentElements++;

      let tris: any[] | null = null;
      try {
        tris = getElementTriangles(model.object, ids[i]);
      } catch {
        tris = null;
      }

      if (!tris || !tris.length) {
        // Fallback — footprint of the bounding box
        emitBoxFootprint(world, pushSeg, "cut");
        continue;
      }

      for (const t of tris) {
        const y0 = t[1], y1 = t[4], y2 = t[7];
        const minY = Math.min(y0, y1, y2);
        const maxY = Math.max(y0, y1, y2);
        if (maxY < bandLow || minY > bandHigh) continue;

        const verts = [
          [t[0], t[1], t[2]],
          [t[3], t[4], t[5]],
          [t[6], t[7], t[8]],
        ];
        for (let e = 0; e < 3; e++) {
          const a = verts[e];
          const b2 = verts[(e + 1) % 3];
          const k = edgeKey(a[0], a[2], b2[0], b2[2]);
          if (edgeSeen.has(k)) continue;
          edgeSeen.add(k);
          fragmentEdgeCount++;
          pushSeg({ x1: a[0], z1: a[2], x2: b2[0], z2: b2[2], kind: "cut" });
        }
      }
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
  }

  // ── 3. Grid lines ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  for (const gr of getGrids()) {
    // Extend grid to just past the plan bounds (will be clamped later)
    const dx = gr.end[0] - gr.start[0];
    const dz = gr.end[1] - gr.start[1];
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (len < 0.01) continue;
    const ux = dx / len, uz = dz / len;
    const pad = 3.0;
    const x1 = gr.start[0] - ux * pad;
    const z1 = gr.start[1] - uz * pad;
    const x2 = gr.end[0] + ux * pad;
    const z2 = gr.end[1] + uz * pad;
    pushSeg({ x1, z1, x2, z2, kind: "grid" });
    // Bubble at end
    texts.push({
      x: x2 + ux * 0.5,
      z: z2 + uz * 0.5,
      text: gr.label,
      kind: "grid",
      anchor: "middle",
      size: 0.6,
    });
  }

  // ── 4. Level text annotation ─────────────────────────────────────────
  texts.push({
    x: 0, z: 0,
    text: `${opts.levelName}  (+${opts.levelElevation.toFixed(2)} m)`,
    kind: "level",
    anchor: "start",
    size: 0.5,
  });

  // ── 5. Compute bounds ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let minX = Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
  const consider = (x: number, z: number) => {
    if (x < minX) minX = x;
    if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
    if (z < minZ) minZ = z;
    if (z > maxZ) maxZ = z;
  };
  for (const s of segments) { consider(s.x1, s.z1); consider(s.x2, s.z2); }
  for (const a of arcs) { consider(a.cx - a.r, a.cz - a.r); consider(a.cx + a.r, a.cz + a.r); }
  if (!Number.isFinite(minX)) { minX = 0; minZ = 0; maxX = 10; maxZ = 10; }

  return {
    level: { name: opts.levelName, elevation: opts.levelElevation },
    cutElevation,
    segments,
    arcs,
    texts,
    bounds: { minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ },
    generatedAt: Date.now(),
    truncated,
    stats: {
      authoredElements: authoredInBand.length,
      fragmentElements,
      segments: segments.length,
      fragmentEdgeCount,
    },
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Authored element plan symbols
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function emitLinearThick(
  push: (s: PlanSegment) => void,
  el: AuthoredElement,
  kind: "cut" | "overhead" | "below",
  thickness: number,
): void {
  const p = el.params;
  if (!p.start || !p.end) return;
  const [ax, az] = p.start;
  const [bx, bz] = p.end;
  const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L < 0.02) return;
  const ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L;
  const nx = -uz, nz = ux;
  const t2 = Math.max(0.02, thickness / 2);
  push({ x1: ax + nx * t2, z1: az + nz * t2, x2: bx + nx * t2, z2: bz + nz * t2, kind, source: el.id });
  push({ x1: ax - nx * t2, z1: az - nz * t2, x2: bx - nx * t2, z2: bz - nz * t2, kind, source: el.id });
  push({ x1: ax + nx * t2, z1: az + nz * t2, x2: ax - nx * t2, z2: az - nz * t2, kind, source: el.id });
  push({ x1: bx + nx * t2, z1: bz + nz * t2, x2: bx - nx * t2, z2: bz - nz * t2, kind, source: el.id });
}

function emitAuthoredSymbol(
  el: AuthoredElement,
  segments: PlanSegment[],
  arcs: PlanArc[],
  texts: PlanText[],
  push: (s: PlanSegment) => void,
  hostedByWall: Map<string, AuthoredElement[]>,
  cutElevation: number,
  bandLow = 0,
  bandHigh = 3,
): void {
  const p = el.params;
  const elev = p.elevation ?? 0;
  const elevKind: "cut" | "overhead" | "below" =
    elev > cutElevation + 0.05 ? "overhead" : elev + (p.height ?? 0) < bandLow ? "below" : "cut";

  switch (el.type) {
    // miter-linear-v4
    // Only wall / beam / brace / strip share the mitered plan footprint.
    // MEP types use flat thickness so the corner is filled by the elbow
    // fitting — matching Revit.
    case "wall":
    case "beam":
    case "brace":
    case "strip": {
      // Revit-style linear join v2 - robust thickness, wider tolerance,
      // perpendicularity preference, wider miter cap. Applies to walls
      // and beams; both miter identically at L-corners.
      if (!p.start || !p.end) return;
      const [ax, az] = p.start;
      const [bx, bz] = p.end;
      const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (L < 0.05) return;
      const ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L;
      const nx = -uz, nz = ux;
      const rawThick = Number(p.thickness);
      const wallThick = Number.isFinite(rawThick) && rawThick > 0.001 ? rawThick : 0.2;
      const t2 = wallThick / 2;
      const joinStat = String((el as any).properties?.joinStatus ?? "allow");

      const endTol = Math.max(0.20, t2 * 4);

      const findCornerPartner = (px: number, pz: number): AuthoredElement | null => {
        if (joinStat === "disallow" || joinStat === "butt") return null;
        let best: AuthoredElement | null = null;
        let bestScore = -Infinity;
        for (const o of getElements()) {
          if (o.id === el.id || o.type !== el.type || !o.params.start || !o.params.end) continue;
          const otherJoin = String((o as any).properties?.joinStatus ?? "allow");
          if (otherJoin === "disallow" || otherJoin === "butt") continue;
          const dS = Math.hypot(o.params.start[0] - px, o.params.start[1] - pz);
          const dE = Math.hypot(o.params.end[0] - px, o.params.end[1] - pz);
          const dMin = Math.min(dS, dE);
          if (dMin > endTol) continue;
          const odx = o.params.end[0] - o.params.start[0];
          const odz = o.params.end[1] - o.params.start[1];
          const oL = Math.hypot(odx, odz) || 1;
          const oux = odx / oL, ouz = odz / oL;
          const cross = Math.abs(ux * ouz - uz * oux);
          const score = cross * 100 - dMin * 5;
          if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = o; }
        }
        return best;
      };

      const lineHit = (
        px: number, pz: number, dx_: number, dz_: number,
        qx: number, qz: number, ex_: number, ez_: number,
      ): { x: number; z: number } | null => {
        const det = dx_ * ez_ - dz_ * ex_;
        if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-9) return null;
        const t = ((qx - px) * ez_ - (qz - pz) * ex_) / det;
        return { x: px + t * dx_, z: pz + t * dz_ };
      };

      const faceEndsAt = (
        endX: number, endZ: number,
      ): { left: { x: number; z: number }; right: { x: number; z: number }; joined: boolean } => {
        const plainL = { x: endX + nx * t2, z: endZ + nz * t2 };
        const plainR = { x: endX - nx * t2, z: endZ - nz * t2 };
        const nb = findCornerPartner(endX, endZ);
        if (!nb || !nb.params.start || !nb.params.end) {
          return { left: plainL, right: plainR, joined: false };
        }
        const [sx, sz] = nb.params.start;
        const [ex, ez] = nb.params.end;
        const ndx = ex - sx, ndz = ez - sz;
        const nL = Math.hypot(ndx, ndz) || 1;
        const nux = ndx / nL, nuz = ndz / nL;
        const nnx = -nuz, nnz = nux;
        const nbThick = Number(nb.params.thickness);
        const nt2 = Math.max(0.01, (Number.isFinite(nbThick) && nbThick > 0.001 ? nbThick : 0.2) / 2);

        const nLeftX = sx + nnx * nt2, nLeftZ = sz + nnz * nt2;
        const nRightX = sx - nnx * nt2, nRightZ = sz - nnz * nt2;

        const LL = lineHit(plainL.x, plainL.z, ux, uz, nLeftX, nLeftZ, nux, nuz);
        const LR = lineHit(plainL.x, plainL.z, ux, uz, nRightX, nRightZ, nux, nuz);
        const RL = lineHit(plainR.x, plainR.z, ux, uz, nLeftX, nLeftZ, nux, nuz);
        const RR = lineHit(plainR.x, plainR.z, ux, uz, nRightX, nRightZ, nux, nuz);

        // miter-pair-LL-RR-v4
        // Revit-style miter: for a perpendicular L-corner, the outer
        // corner is always on the same "side" for both walls (both left
        // faces, or both right faces). Therefore the correct pairing is
        // ALWAYS left → LL, right → RR. The previous turn-sign logic
        // mis-paired right-hand turns (e.g. wall going east meeting a
        // wall going south).
        const maxMiter = Math.max(t2, nt2) * 8;
        const leftCandidate  = LL;
        const rightCandidate = RR;

        const leftOK  = !!leftCandidate  && Math.hypot(leftCandidate.x  - endX, leftCandidate.z  - endZ) <= maxMiter;
        const rightOK = !!rightCandidate && Math.hypot(rightCandidate.x - endX, rightCandidate.z - endZ) <= maxMiter;

        return {
          left:  leftOK  ? leftCandidate!  : plainL,
          right: rightOK ? rightCandidate! : plainR,
          joined: true,
        };
      };

      const startFaces = faceEndsAt(ax, az);
      const endFaces = faceEndsAt(bx, bz);

      const hosts = (hostedByWall.get(el.id) ?? []).filter(
        (h) => h.type === "door" || h.type === "window",
      );
      const openings: { start: number; end: number; el: AuthoredElement }[] = [];
      for (const h of hosts) {
        const w = h.params.width ?? 0.9;
        const off = h.params.offsetAlongHost ?? L / 2;
        openings.push({ start: Math.max(0, off - w / 2), end: Math.min(L, off + w / 2), el: h });
      }
      openings.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);

      const merged: { start: number; end: number; el?: AuthoredElement }[] = [];
      for (const o of openings) {
        if (merged.length && o.start <= merged[merged.length - 1].end + 0.01) {
          merged[merged.length - 1].end = Math.max(merged[merged.length - 1].end, o.end);
        } else {
          merged.push({ ...o });
        }
      }

      const emitSides = (from: number, to: number) => {
        if (to - from < 0.02) return;
        const t0 = from / L, t1 = to / L;
        const l1x = startFaces.left.x + (endFaces.left.x - startFaces.left.x) * t0;
        const l1z = startFaces.left.z + (endFaces.left.z - startFaces.left.z) * t0;
        const l2x = startFaces.left.x + (endFaces.left.x - startFaces.left.x) * t1;
        const l2z = startFaces.left.z + (endFaces.left.z - startFaces.left.z) * t1;
        const r1x = startFaces.right.x + (endFaces.right.x - startFaces.right.x) * t0;
        const r1z = startFaces.right.z + (endFaces.right.z - startFaces.right.z) * t0;
        const r2x = startFaces.right.x + (endFaces.right.x - startFaces.right.x) * t1;
        const r2z = startFaces.right.z + (endFaces.right.z - startFaces.right.z) * t1;
        push({ x1: l1x, z1: l1z, x2: l2x, z2: l2z, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
        push({ x1: r1x, z1: r1z, x2: r2x, z2: r2z, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      };

      let cursor = 0;
      for (const o of merged) {
        emitSides(cursor, o.start);
        cursor = o.end;
      }
      emitSides(cursor, L);

      if (!startFaces.joined) {
        push({
          x1: startFaces.left.x, z1: startFaces.left.z,
          x2: startFaces.right.x, z2: startFaces.right.z,
          kind: elevKind, source: el.id,
        });
      }
      if (!endFaces.joined) {
        push({
          x1: endFaces.left.x, z1: endFaces.left.z,
          x2: endFaces.right.x, z2: endFaces.right.z,
          kind: elevKind, source: el.id,
        });
      }

      for (const o of merged) {
        const openingEl = openings.find((x) => x.start === o.start)?.el;
        if (openingEl?.type === "door") {
          const hingeX = ax + ux * o.start;
          const hingeZ = az + uz * o.start;
          const w = o.end - o.start;
          arcs.push({
            cx: hingeX, cz: hingeZ, r: w,
            start: Math.atan2(nz, nx),
            end: Math.atan2(uz, ux),
            kind: "door-swing",
          });
          push({
            x1: hingeX, z1: hingeZ,
            x2: hingeX + nx * w, z2: hingeZ + nz * w,
            kind: "cut", source: openingEl.id,
          });
        } else if (openingEl?.type === "window") {
          const l1x = ax + ux * o.start, l1z = az + uz * o.start;
          const l2x = ax + ux * o.end, l2z = az + uz * o.end;
          push({ x1: l1x + nx * t2, z1: l1z + nz * t2, x2: l1x - nx * t2, z2: l1z - nz * t2, kind: "cut" });
          push({ x1: l2x + nx * t2, z1: l2z + nz * t2, x2: l2x - nx * t2, z2: l2z - nz * t2, kind: "cut" });
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case "column":
    case "equipment":
    case "footing": {
      if (!p.point) return;
      const w = p.thickness;
      const d = p.depth ?? p.thickness;
      const x = p.point[0], z = p.point[1];
      const hw = w / 2, hd = d / 2;
      push({ x1: x - hw, z1: z - hd, x2: x + hw, z2: z - hd, kind: "cut", source: el.id });
      push({ x1: x + hw, z1: z - hd, x2: x + hw, z2: z + hd, kind: "cut", source: el.id });
      push({ x1: x + hw, z1: z + hd, x2: x - hw, z2: z + hd, kind: "cut", source: el.id });
      push({ x1: x - hw, z1: z + hd, x2: x - hw, z2: z - hd, kind: "cut", source: el.id });
      break;
    }

    case "slab": {
      if (!p.polygon || p.polygon.length < 3) return;
      const poly = p.polygon;
      for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) {
        const a = poly[i];
        const b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length];
        push({ x1: a[0], z1: a[1], x2: b[0], z2: b[1], kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      }
      break;
    }

    case "truss":
    case "mline":
      emitLinearThick(push, el, elevKind, p.thickness ?? 0.2);
      break;

    // MEP categories — flat thickness, fitting covers the corner
    case "duct":
      emitLinearThick(push, el, elevKind, p.thickness ?? 0.6);
      break;
    case "pipe":
      emitLinearThick(push, el, elevKind, Math.max(0.08, p.thickness ?? 0.1));
      break;
    case "cable-tray":
      emitLinearThick(push, el, elevKind, p.thickness ?? 0.3);
      break;
    case "conduit":
      emitLinearThick(push, el, elevKind, Math.max(0.05, p.thickness ?? 0.05));
      break;
    case "fitting": {
      // MEP elbow v1: render the fitting as two concentric arcs matching
      // the 3D buildFitting geometry. Revit draws duct/pipe elbows as
      // clean quarter (or half) circles in plan — not the tiny box the
      // previous placeholder produced.
      const cxF = p.point?.[0];
      const czF = p.point?.[1];
      if (cxF == null || czF == null) {
        // Legacy line-based fitting fallback: small box.
        if (p.start && p.end) {
          const x = (p.start[0] + p.end[0]) / 2;
          const z = (p.start[1] + p.end[1]) / 2;
          const s = (p.thickness ?? 0.3) / 2;
          push({ x1: x - s, z1: z - s, x2: x + s, z2: z - s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
          push({ x1: x + s, z1: z - s, x2: x + s, z2: z + s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
          push({ x1: x + s, z1: z + s, x2: x - s, z2: z + s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
          push({ x1: x - s, z1: z + s, x2: x - s, z2: z - s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
        }
        break;
      }

      const parentType = String((p as any).parentType || "duct");
      const kind = String((p as any).fittingKind || "elbow");
      const aIn = p.angleIn ?? 0;
      const aOut = p.angleOut ?? Math.PI / 2;
      const t = p.thickness ?? 0.3;
      const t2 = Math.max(0.02, t / 2);
      const isRound = parentType === "pipe" || parentType === "conduit";
      // Enforce Revit-style minimum: centerline bend radius >= duct width.
      const ductWidth = Math.max(t, 0.05);
      const baseR = Number(p.bendRadius);
      const r = Math.max(ductWidth, Number.isFinite(baseR) && baseR > 0
        ? baseR
        : ductWidth);

      if (kind === "elbow") {
        // MEP elbow v2 — correct circular-arc construction.
        //
        // Geometry, in order:
        //   • Corner C is where the two centerlines meet.
        //   • Tangent points T1, T2 sit r units back along each duct:
        //         T1 = C − dir(aIn) * r
        //         T2 = C + dir(aOut) * r
        //   • Bend center O is r units from T1 perpendicular to aIn,
        //     on the side that faces the outgoing duct. Because it is
        //     also r units from T2 perpendicular to aOut, the two
        //     perpendiculars intersect exactly at O.
        //   • The outer boundary arc is at radius r + t/2 from O,
        //     the inner boundary at r − t/2.
        const inX  = cxF - Math.cos(aIn)  * r;
        const inZ  = czF - Math.sin(aIn)  * r;
        const outX = cxF + Math.cos(aOut) * r;
        const outZ = czF + Math.sin(aOut) * r;

        // Perpendicular unit vectors to aIn:
        const perpA = { x: Math.sin(aIn), z: -Math.cos(aIn) };
        const perpB = { x: -Math.sin(aIn), z: Math.cos(aIn) };
        // Pick the perpendicular that points from T1 toward T2.
        const toOut = { x: outX - inX, z: outZ - inZ };
        const useA = (toOut.x * perpA.x + toOut.z * perpA.z) > 0;
        const perp = useA ? perpA : perpB;

        const CbX = inX + perp.x * r;
        const CbZ = inZ + perp.z * r;

        // Angles on the bend circle. Normalise sweep to (−π, π].
        const inletAngle = Math.atan2(inZ - CbZ, inX - CbX);
        let sweep = aOut - aIn;
        while (sweep > Math.PI)  sweep -= 2 * Math.PI;
        while (sweep < -Math.PI) sweep += 2 * Math.PI;
        const arcEnd = inletAngle + sweep;

        const rOuter = r + t2;
        const rInner = Math.max(0.02, r - t2);

        arcs.push({
          cx: CbX, cz: CbZ, r: rOuter,
          start: inletAngle, end: arcEnd,
          kind: "fitting",
        });
        arcs.push({
          cx: CbX, cz: CbZ, r: rInner,
          start: inletAngle, end: arcEnd,
          kind: "fitting",
        });
        break;
      }

      // Tee / cross / cap / transition: small box fallback
      const s = t / 2;
      push({ x1: cxF - s, z1: czF - s, x2: cxF + s, z2: czF - s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      push({ x1: cxF + s, z1: czF - s, x2: cxF + s, z2: czF + s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      push({ x1: cxF + s, z1: czF + s, x2: cxF - s, z2: czF + s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      push({ x1: cxF - s, z1: czF + s, x2: cxF - s, z2: czF - s, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      break;
    }

    case "door":
    case "window":
      // Handled by host wall projection
      break;

    default: {
      // Any other category: linear if start/end, point if point, else skip
      if (p.start && p.end) {
        emitLinearThick(push, el, elevKind, p.thickness ?? 0.2);
      } else if (p.point) {
        const w = p.thickness ?? 0.3;
        const d = p.depth ?? w;
        const x = p.point[0], z = p.point[1];
        const hw = w / 2, hd = d / 2;
        push({ x1: x - hw, z1: z - hd, x2: x + hw, z2: z - hd, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
        push({ x1: x + hw, z1: z - hd, x2: x + hw, z2: z + hd, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
        push({ x1: x + hw, z1: z + hd, x2: x - hw, z2: z + hd, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
        push({ x1: x - hw, z1: z + hd, x2: x - hw, z2: z - hd, kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
      } else if (p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 2) {
        for (let i = 0; i < p.polygon.length; i++) {
          const a = p.polygon[i];
          const b = p.polygon[(i + 1) % p.polygon.length];
          push({ x1: a[0], z1: a[1], x2: b[0], z2: b[1], kind: elevKind, source: el.id });
        }
      }
      break;
    }
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Fallback: box footprint
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function emitBoxFootprint(
  box: THREE.Box3,
  push: (s: PlanSegment) => void,
  kind: "cut" | "overhead" | "below",
): void {
  const minX = box.min.x, minZ = box.min.z, maxX = box.max.x, maxZ = box.max.z;
  push({ x1: minX, z1: minZ, x2: maxX, z2: minZ, kind });
  push({ x1: maxX, z1: minZ, x2: maxX, z2: maxZ, kind });
  push({ x1: maxX, z1: maxZ, x2: minX, z2: maxZ, kind });
  push({ x1: minX, z1: maxZ, x2: minX, z2: minZ, kind });
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Convenience: generate a default plan from the current levels
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export function listAvailableLevels(): { name: string; elevation: number }[] {
  const user = getLevels().map((l) => ({ name: l.name, elevation: l.elevation }));
  if (user.length) return user;
  // Fallback set if no levels defined
  return [
    { name: "Level 0", elevation: 0 },
    { name: "Level 1", elevation: 3 },
    { name: "Level 2", elevation: 6 },
  ];
}
```

```ts
/** Plan view types. */

export type PlanLineKind =
  | "cut"        // element cut by the plan plane
  | "overhead"   // element above the cut plane (dashed)
  | "below"      // element below (dashed, lighter)
  | "grid"       // grid line
  | "dimension"  // dimension line
  | "title";     // title-block line

export interface PlanSegment {
  x1: number; z1: number;
  x2: number; z2: number;
  kind: PlanLineKind;
  source?: string;
}

export interface PlanArc {
  cx: number; cz: number;
  r: number;
  start: number; // radians
  end: number;
  // "door-swing" → dashed thin indicator
  // "fitting"    → solid MEP elbow outer/inner boundary arc
  kind: "door-swing" | "fitting";
}

export interface PlanText {
  x: number; z: number;
  text: string;
  kind: "grid" | "level" | "room" | "title";
  rotation?: number;   // degrees
  anchor?: "start" | "middle" | "end";
  size?: number;       // metres (approximate)
}

export interface PlanView {
  level: { name: string; elevation: number };
  cutElevation: number;
  segments: PlanSegment[];
  arcs: PlanArc[];
  texts: PlanText[];
  bounds: { minX: number; minZ: number; maxX: number; maxZ: number };
  generatedAt: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  stats: {
    authoredElements: number;
    fragmentElements: number;
    segments: number;
    fragmentEdgeCount: number;
  };
}

export interface PlanGenerationOptions {
  levelName: string;
  levelElevation: number;
  /** Cut height above level (metres). Revit default: 1.2. */
  cutHeight: number;
  /** Depth below level to include (metres). Revit default: 0.5. */
  cutDepth: number;
  /** Optional Revit-like view-range offsets relative to the associated level. */
  viewRangeTop?: number;
  viewRangeBottom?: number;
  viewDepth?: number;
  /** Include elements above the cut in dashed lines. */
  includeOverhead: boolean;
  /** Include elements below the level. */
  includeBelow: boolean;
  /** Hard cap on generated segments; stops extraction if exceeded. */
  maxSegments: number;
  onProgress?: (p: { phase: string; current: number; total: number }) => void;
  signal?: { cancelled: boolean };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * BCF 2.1 writer.
 *
 * Produces a real BCF 2.1 archive (ZIP) with:
 *   bcf.version
 *   project.bcfp
 *   <guid>/markup.bcf
 *   <guid>/viewpoint-*.bcfv      (optional — requires camera state)
 *   <guid>/snapshot.png          (optional)
 *
 * Both clash violations and standards violations can be written to the
 * same archive, distinguished by TopicType.
 */
import JSZip from "jszip";
import type { ElementClash, ClashKind } from "../../features/clash-engine";
import { getClashState, listClashes, testNameInput, type ClashStatus } from "../../features/clash";
import { getAuthor } from "../issues/issues";

const BCF_VERSION = "2.1";

export interface BcfStandardsViolation {
  ruleId: string;
  ruleName: string;
  standard: string;
  jurisdiction: string;
  severity: "info" | "warning" | "error";
  category: string;
  elementId: number;
  elementName: string;
  elementCategory: string;
  message: string;
  actual?: string;
  required?: string;
  modelId?: string;
}

export interface BcfCameraState {
  position: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  direction: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  up: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  fieldOfView?: number;
  aspect?: number;
}

export interface BcfComponentRef {
  ifcGuid?: string;
  authoringToolId?: string;
  originatingSystem?: string;
}

export interface BcfTopic {
  guid: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  topicType: string;
  topicStatus: string;
  priority?: string;
  assignedTo?: string;
  labels?: string[];
  createdBy: string;
  createdAt: number;
  modifiedAt?: number;
  modifiedBy?: string;
  comments?: Array<{ author: string; date: number; text: string; guid?: string }>;
  selection?: BcfComponentRef[];
  visibilityExceptions?: BcfComponentRef[];
  camera?: BcfCameraState;
  snapshotDataUrl?: string;
}

export interface BcfWriteOptions {
  projectName?: string;
  projectId?: string;
  author?: string;
  /** Include standards violations as topics. Default true. */
  includeClashes?: boolean;
  includeStandards?: boolean;
  standardsViolations?: BcfStandardsViolation[];
  /** If set, this is used as the "originating system" on components. */
  originatingSystem?: string;
  /** Optional resolver for element GlobalIds (fragments model id + express id → guid). */
  resolveGuid?: (modelId: string, localId: number) => string | undefined;
  /** Optional camera state provider for the current view. */
  getCamera?: () => BcfCameraState | undefined;
  /** Optional snapshot data URL provider. */
  getSnapshot?: () => string | undefined;
}

/* ── Utilities ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function uid(): string {
  return (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ??
    "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
      const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
      const v = c === "x" ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
      return v.toString(16);
    });
}

function xmlEscape(s: string): string {
  return String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&apos;" } as any)[c]);
}

function isoDate(t: number): string {
  const d = new Date(t);
  // BCF requires a full local ISO-8601 with offset.
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const off = -d.getTimezoneOffset();
  const sign = off >= 0 ? "+" : "-";
  const oh = Math.floor(Math.abs(off) / 60);
  const om = Math.abs(off) % 60;
  return (
    `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}` +
    `T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}` +
    `${sign}${pad(oh)}:${pad(om)}`
  );
}

/* ── Topic builders ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function clashTopicType(k: ClashKind): string {
  switch (k) {
    case "intersect": return "Hard Clash";
    case "touching": return "Touching";
    case "clearance": return "Clearance";
    case "duplicate": return "Duplicate";
  }
}

function clashTopicStatus(s: ClashStatus): string {
  switch (s) {
    case "new": return "Open";
    case "active": return "In Progress";
    case "reviewed": return "Resolved";
    case "approved": return "Closed";
    case "resolved": return "Closed";
  }
}

export function clashToTopic(
  c: ElementClash,
  index: number,
  opts: BcfWriteOptions,
): BcfTopic {
  const state = getClashState(c);
  const author = opts.author ?? getAuthor();
  const guid = uid();
  const createdAt = state.updatedAt || Date.now();
  const modAt = state.updatedAt || undefined;

  const selection: BcfComponentRef[] = [];
  const pushRef = (modelId: string, localId: number) => {
    const ifcGuid = opts.resolveGuid?.(modelId, localId);
    selection.push({
      ifcGuid,
      authoringToolId: String(localId),
      originatingSystem: opts.originatingSystem ?? modelId,
    });
  };
  pushRef(c.a.modelId, c.a.localId);
  pushRef(c.b.modelId, c.b.localId);

  const overlapText =
    c.kind === "intersect" ? `Overlap volume: ${(c.depthVol * 1e6).toFixed(2)} cm³`
    : c.kind === "duplicate" ? `Identical bounding box (Δ ≤ ${(c.minGap * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm)`
    : `Minimum gap: ${(c.minGap * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`;

  const description = [
    `Clash #${index + 1} — ${c.kind.toUpperCase()}`,
    ``,
    `A: ${c.a.name} [${c.a.cat}] (${c.a.modelId} / #${c.a.localId})`,
    `B: ${c.b.name} [${c.b.cat}] (${c.b.modelId} / #${c.b.localId})`,
    ``,
    overlapText,
    `Method: ${c.method} · Precision: ${c.precision}${c.triPairs ? ` · ${c.triPairs} tri pair(s)` : ""}`,
  ].join("\n");

  const labels = ["clash", c.kind, c.method];

  return {
    guid,
    title: `[${c.kind.toUpperCase()}] ${c.a.name} × ${c.b.name}`,
    description,
    topicType: clashTopicType(c.kind),
    topicStatus: clashTopicStatus(state.status),
    priority: c.kind === "intersect" ? "High" : "Normal",
    assignedTo: state.assignee,
    labels,
    createdBy: author,
    createdAt,
    modifiedAt: modAt,
    modifiedBy: state.comments.length ? author : undefined,
    comments: state.comments.map((cm) => ({
      author: cm.author, date: cm.date, text: cm.text, guid: cm.id,
    })),
    selection,
    camera: opts.getCamera?.(),
    snapshotDataUrl: opts.getSnapshot?.(),
  };
}

export function standardsViolationToTopic(
  v: BcfStandardsViolation,
  index: number,
  opts: BcfWriteOptions,
): BcfTopic {
  const author = opts.author ?? getAuthor();
  const guid = uid();
  const createdAt = Date.now();

  const selection: BcfComponentRef[] = [];
  if (v.modelId) {
    const ifcGuid = opts.resolveGuid?.(v.modelId, v.elementId);
    selection.push({
      ifcGuid,
      authoringToolId: String(v.elementId),
      originatingSystem: opts.originatingSystem ?? v.modelId,
    });
  }

  const description = [
    `Standard: ${v.standard} (${v.jurisdiction})`,
    `Rule: ${v.ruleName} [${v.ruleId}]`,
    ``,
    v.message,
    v.actual ? `Actual:   ${v.actual}` : "",
    v.required ? `Required: ${v.required}` : "",
    ``,
    `Element: ${v.elementName} [${v.elementCategory}] #${v.elementId}`,
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");

  return {
    guid,
    title: `[${v.severity.toUpperCase()}] ${v.ruleName} — ${v.elementName}`,
    description,
    topicType: "Code Compliance",
    topicStatus: v.severity === "error" ? "Open" : "In Progress",
    priority: v.severity === "error" ? "High" : v.severity === "warning" ? "Normal" : "Low",
    labels: ["standards", v.standard, v.category, v.severity],
    createdBy: author,
    createdAt,
    modifiedAt: createdAt,
    modifiedBy: author,
    selection,
    camera: opts.getCamera?.(),
    snapshotDataUrl: opts.getSnapshot?.(),
  };
}

/* ── XML writers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function writeBcfVersion(): string {
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Version VersionId="${BCF_VERSION}" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="version.xsd"/>
`;
}

function writeProjectBcfp(projectName: string, projectGuid: string): string {
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ProjectExtension xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="project.xsd">
  <Project ProjectId="${xmlEscape(projectGuid)}">
    <Name>${xmlEscape(projectName)}</Name>
  </Project>
  <ExtensionSchema>extensions.xsd</ExtensionSchema>
</ProjectExtension>
`;
}

function writeExtensions(): string {
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Extensions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="extensions.xsd">
  <TopicTypes>
    <TopicType>Hard Clash</TopicType>
    <TopicType>Touching</TopicType>
    <TopicType>Clearance</TopicType>
    <TopicType>Duplicate</TopicType>
    <TopicType>Code Compliance</TopicType>
    <TopicType>Issue</TopicType>
  </TopicTypes>
  <TopicStatuses>
    <TopicStatus>Open</TopicStatus>
    <TopicStatus>In Progress</TopicStatus>
    <TopicStatus>Resolved</TopicStatus>
    <TopicStatus>Closed</TopicStatus>
  </TopicStatuses>
  <Priorities>
    <Priority>Low</Priority>
    <Priority>Normal</Priority>
    <Priority>High</Priority>
  </Priorities>
  <TopicLabels>
    <TopicLabel>clash</TopicLabel>
    <TopicLabel>intersect</TopicLabel>
    <TopicLabel>touching</TopicLabel>
    <TopicLabel>clearance</TopicLabel>
    <TopicLabel>duplicate</TopicLabel>
    <TopicLabel>standards</TopicLabel>
  </TopicLabels>
</Extensions>
`;
}

function writeMarkupBcf(t: BcfTopic, viewpointFile?: string): string {
  const comments = (t.comments ?? []).map((c) => `
    <Comment Guid="${xmlEscape(c.guid ?? uid())}">
      <Date>${isoDate(c.date)}</Date>
      <Author>${xmlEscape(c.author)}</Author>
      <Comment>${xmlEscape(c.text)}</Comment>
    </Comment>`).join("");

  const labels = (t.labels ?? []).length
    ? `<Labels>${t.labels!.map((l) => xmlEscape(l)).join(", ")}</Labels>`
    : "";

  const viewpoint = viewpointFile
    ? `<Viewpoints Guid="${xmlEscape(uid())}">${xmlEscape(viewpointFile)}</Viewpoints>`
    : "";

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Markup xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="markup.xsd">
  <Header>
    <File IfcProject="" IfcSpatialStructureElement="" IsExternal="false">
      <Filename>Open BIM Studio</Filename>
      <Date>${isoDate(t.createdAt)}</Date>
      <Reference>Open BIM Studio coordination</Reference>
    </File>
  </Header>
  <Topic Guid="${xmlEscape(t.guid)}" TopicType="${xmlEscape(t.topicType)}" TopicStatus="${xmlEscape(t.topicStatus)}">
    <Title>${xmlEscape(t.title)}</Title>
    ${t.priority ? `<Priority>${xmlEscape(t.priority)}</Priority>` : ""}
    ${labels}
    <CreationDate>${isoDate(t.createdAt)}</CreationDate>
    <CreationAuthor>${xmlEscape(t.createdBy)}</CreationAuthor>
    ${t.modifiedAt ? `<ModifiedDate>${isoDate(t.modifiedAt)}</ModifiedDate>` : ""}
    ${t.modifiedBy ? `<ModifiedAuthor>${xmlEscape(t.modifiedBy)}</ModifiedAuthor>` : ""}
    ${t.assignedTo ? `<AssignedTo>${xmlEscape(t.assignedTo)}</AssignedTo>` : ""}
    ${t.description ? `<Description>${xmlEscape(t.description)}</Description>` : ""}
    ${comments}
    ${viewpoint}
  </Topic>
</Markup>
`;
}

function writeViewpointBcfv(t: BcfTopic): string | null {
  const hasSelection = (t.selection?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  const hasCamera = !!t.camera;
  if (!hasSelection && !hasCamera) return null;

  const components = hasSelection
    ? `<Components>
    <Selection>
${t.selection!.map((c) =>
  `      <Component${c.ifcGuid ? ` IfcGuid="${xmlEscape(c.ifcGuid)}"` : ""}` +
  `${c.authoringToolId ? ` AuthoringToolId="${xmlEscape(c.authoringToolId)}"` : ""}` +
  `${c.originatingSystem ? ` OriginatingSystem="${xmlEscape(c.originatingSystem)}"` : ""}/>`
).join("\n")}
    </Selection>
    <Visibility DefaultVisibility="false">
      <Exceptions>
${t.selection!.map((c) =>
  `        <Component${c.ifcGuid ? ` IfcGuid="${xmlEscape(c.ifcGuid)}"` : ""}/>`
).join("\n")}
      </Exceptions>
    </Visibility>
    <ViewSetupHints SpacesVisible="false" SpaceBoundariesVisible="false" OpeningsVisible="false"/>
  </Components>`
    : `<Components><Visibility DefaultVisibility="true"/></Components>`;

  const camera = hasCamera
    ? `<PerspectiveCamera>
    <CameraViewPoint>
      <X>${t.camera!.position.x.toFixed(4)}</X>
      <Y>${t.camera!.position.y.toFixed(4)}</Y>
      <Z>${t.camera!.position.z.toFixed(4)}</Z>
    </CameraViewPoint>
    <CameraDirection>
      <X>${t.camera!.direction.x.toFixed(4)}</X>
      <Y>${t.camera!.direction.y.toFixed(4)}</Y>
      <Z>${t.camera!.direction.z.toFixed(4)}</Z>
    </CameraDirection>
    <CameraUpVector>
      <X>${t.camera!.up.x.toFixed(4)}</X>
      <Y>${t.camera!.up.y.toFixed(4)}</Y>
      <Z>${t.camera!.up.z.toFixed(4)}</Z>
    </CameraUpVector>
    <FieldOfView>${(t.camera!.fieldOfView ?? 60).toFixed(2)}</FieldOfView>
    <AspectRatio>${(t.camera!.aspect ?? 1.7777).toFixed(4)}</AspectRatio>
  </PerspectiveCamera>`
    : "";

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<VisualizationInfo xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="visinfo.xsd" Guid="${xmlEscape(uid())}">
  ${components}
  ${camera}
</VisualizationInfo>
`;
}

/* ── Data URL → Uint8Array ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function dataUrlToBytes(dataUrl: string): Uint8Array | null {
  const m = /^data:([^;]+);base64,(.*)$/.exec(dataUrl);
  if (!m) return null;
  try {
    const bin = atob(m[2]);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/* ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface BcfBuildResult {
  blob: Blob;
  topicCount: number;
  filename: string;
}

export async function buildBcf21(
  topics: BcfTopic[],
  opts: BcfWriteOptions = {},
): Promise<BcfBuildResult> {
  const zip = new JSZip();
  const projectGuid = opts.projectId ?? uid();
  const projectName = opts.projectName ?? "Open BIM Studio Project";

  zip.file("bcf.version", writeBcfVersion());
  zip.file("project.bcfp", writeProjectBcfp(projectName, projectGuid));
  zip.file("extensions.xsd", writeExtensions());

  for (const t of topics) {
    const folder = zip.folder(t.guid)!;
    let viewpointFile: string | undefined;
    const bcfv = writeViewpointBcfv(t);
    if (bcfv) {
      viewpointFile = "viewpoint.bcfv";
      folder.file(viewpointFile, bcfv);
    }
    if (t.snapshotDataUrl) {
      const bytes = dataUrlToBytes(t.snapshotDataUrl);
      if (bytes) folder.file("snapshot.png", bytes);
    }
    folder.file("markup.bcf", writeMarkupBcf(t, viewpointFile));
  }

  const blob = await zip.generateAsync({
    type: "blob",
    compression: "DEFLATE",
    compressionOptions: { level: 6 },
    mimeType: "application/zip",
  });

  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  return {
    blob,
    topicCount: topics.length,
    filename: `coordination-${stamp}.bcfzip`,
  };
}

export async function downloadBcf21(
  topics: BcfTopic[],
  opts: BcfWriteOptions = {},
): Promise<void> {
  const { blob, filename } = await buildBcf21(topics, opts);
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

/* ── Convenience: export the current clash results ─────────────────────── */

export async function exportClashesBcf(
  opts: BcfWriteOptions = {},
): Promise<void> {
  const clashes = listClashes();
  if (!clashes.length) {
    alert("No clash results to export. Run a clash test first.");
    return;
  }
  const testName = testNameInput.value || "Clash Test";
  const topics = clashes.map((c, i) => clashToTopic(c, i, opts));
  await downloadBcf21(topics, { ...opts, projectName: opts.projectName ?? testName });
}

/* ── Convenience: export standards violations ──────────────────────────── */

export async function exportStandardsBcf(
  violations: BcfStandardsViolation[],
  opts: BcfWriteOptions = {},
): Promise<void> {
  if (!violations.length) {
    alert("No standards violations to export.");
    return;
  }
  const topics = violations.map((v, i) => standardsViolationToTopic(v, i, opts));
  await downloadBcf21(topics, {
    ...opts,
    projectName: opts.projectName ?? "Standards Compliance",
  });
}

/* ── Convenience: both in one file ─────────────────────────────────────── */

export async function exportCombinedBcf(
  violations: BcfStandardsViolation[] | undefined,
  opts: BcfWriteOptions = {},
): Promise<void> {
  const topics: BcfTopic[] = [];
  if (opts.includeClashes !== false) {
    listClashes().forEach((c, i) => topics.push(clashToTopic(c, i, opts)));
  }
  if (opts.includeStandards !== false && violations?.length) {
    violations.forEach((v, i) => topics.push(standardsViolationToTopic(v, i, opts)));
  }
  if (!topics.length) {
    alert("Nothing to export — run a clash test or a standards check first.");
    return;
  }
  await downloadBcf21(topics, {
    ...opts,
    projectName: opts.projectName ?? "Coordination",
  });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * COBie 2.4 worksheet emitter.
 *
 * Two output modes:
 *   • "xls"  — one HTML workbook, one <table> per worksheet. Excel/Numbers
 *              open it natively and preserve the sheet names via the

/* ── Gather from the running scene ─────────────────────────────────────── */

function attrToString(v: any): string {
  if (v == null) return "";
  if (typeof v === "object") {
    if ("value" in v) return String(v.value ?? "");
    return "";
  }
  return String(v);
}

function guessUnits(): { linear: string; area: string; volume: string } {
  // The current unit config from units service; fall back to SI.
  try {
    const u: any = (ctx.features as any).units;
    const cfg = u?.getConfig?.();
    if (cfg) {
      return {
        linear: `${{ mm: "millimeters", cm: "centimeters", m: "meters", ft: "feet", in: "inches", "ft-in": "feet and inches" }[cfg.length as string] ?? "meters"}`,
        area: `${{ mm2: "square millimeters", cm2: "square centimeters", m2: "square meters", ft2: "square feet", in2: "square inches" }[cfg.area as string] ?? "square meters"}`,
        volume: `${{ mm3: "cubic millimeters", cm3: "cubic centimeters", m3: "cubic meters", ft3: "cubic feet", in3: "cubic inches", l: "liters" }[cfg.volume as string] ?? "cubic meters"}`,
      };
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return { linear: "meters", area: "square meters", volume: "cubic meters" };
}

async function gatherFromFragments(ds: CobieDataset): Promise<void> {
  const typeCache = new Map<string, CobieType>();

  for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    let categories: Record<string, number[]> = {};
    try {
      categories = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[cobie] categories failed", modelId, err);
      continue;
    }

    for (const [cat, ids] of Object.entries(categories)) {
      const ifcCat = String(cat);
      const shortCat = ifcCat.replace(/^IFC/i, "");

      let data: any[] = [];
      try {
        data = await (model as any).getItemsData(ids, {
          attributesDefault: true,
          psetsDefault: false,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("[cobie] getItemsData failed", modelId, shortCat, err);
        continue;
      }

      if (ifcCat === "IFCBUILDINGSTOREY") {
        for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
          const d = data[i] ?? {};
          ds.Floor.push({
            Name: attrToString(d.Name) || `${modelId}-Level-${ids[i]}`,
            Category: shortCat,
            Description: attrToString(d.Description),
            Elevation: attrToString(d.Elevation),
            Height: "",
          });
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (ifcCat === "IFCSPACE") {
        for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
          const d = data[i] ?? {};
          ds.Space.push({
            Name: attrToString(d.Name) || `Space-${ids[i]}`,
            FloorName: "",
            Description: attrToString(d.Description),
            RoomTag: attrToString(d.LongName),
            UsableHeight: "",
            GrossArea: "",
            NetArea: "",
            Category: shortCat,
          });
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (ifcCat === "IFCZONE") {
        for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
          const d = data[i] ?? {};
          ds.Zone.push({
            Name: attrToString(d.Name) || `Zone-${ids[i]}`,
            Category: shortCat,
            SpaceNames: "",
            Description: attrToString(d.Description),
          });
        }
        continue;
      }

      // IfcTypeObject subclasses → COBie Type
      if (/TYPE$/.test(ifcCat) || ifcCat === "IFCFURNITURETYPE") {
        for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
          const d = data[i] ?? {};
          const name = attrToString(d.Name) || `${shortCat}-${ids[i]}`;
          if (typeCache.has(name)) continue;
          const t: CobieType = {
            Name: name, Category: shortCat,
            Description: attrToString(d.Description),
            AssetType: "Fixed", Manufacturer: "", ModelNumber: "",
            WarrantyGuarantorParts: "", WarrantyDurationParts: "",
            WarrantyGuarantorLabor: "", WarrantyDurationLabor: "",
            WarrantyDurationUnit: "years",
            ReplacementCost: "", ExpectedLife: "", DurationUnit: "years",
            NominalLength: "", NominalWidth: "", NominalHeight: "",
            Shape: "", Size: "", Color: "", Finish: "", Grade: "",
            Material: "", Constituents: "", Features: "",
            AccessibilityPerformance: "", CodePerformance: "",
            SustainabilityPerformance: "",
          };
          typeCache.set(name, t);
          ds.Type.push(t);
        }
        continue;
      }

      // Physical products → COBie Component
      if (/^(IFC(WALL|SLAB|DOOR|WINDOW|COLUMN|BEAM|MEMBER|FOOTING|PILE|RAMP|RAILING|STAIR|ROOF|COVERING|CURTAINWALL|PLATE|PIPE|DUCT|CABLECARRIER|CABLESEGMENT|CONDUIT|AIRTERMINAL|SANITARYTERMINAL|ELECTRIC|LIGHTING|FURNITURE|FURNISHING|FLOW|VALVE|PUMP|FAN|COIL|CHILLER|BOILER|TANK|SPACEHEATER|OUTLET|SWITCH|SENSOR|ALARM|CONTROLLER|ACTUATOR|PROTECTIVEDEVICE|TRANSFORMER|MOTOR|GENERATOR|CONVEYOR|VEHICLE|ELEMENTASSEMBLY|BUILDINGELEMENTPROXY|ELEMENTCOMPONENT))/i.test(ifcCat)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
          const d = data[i] ?? {};
          const name = attrToString(d.Name) || `${shortCat}-${ids[i]}`;
          ds.Component.push({
            Name: name,
            TypeName: "",
            Space: "",
            Description: attrToString(d.Description),
            InstallationDate: "",
            WarrantyStartDate: "",
            TagNumber: attrToString(d.Tag),
            BarCode: "",
            AssetIdentifier: attrToString(d.GlobalId),
            SerialNumber: "",
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function gatherFromAuthored(ds: CobieDataset): void {
  for (const el of getAuthoredElements()) {
    const cat = (el.type ?? "generic").replace(/^./, (c: string) => c.toUpperCase());
    if (el.nativeGeometry && el.ifc) {
      // Native twin — emit as a Component with a link to its source.
      ds.Component.push({
        Name: el.name,
        TypeName: "",
        Space: "",
        Description: `Native twin of ${el.ifc.entity} ${el.ifc.sourceGlobalId ?? el.ifc.globalId ?? ""}`.trim(),
        InstallationDate: "",
        WarrantyStartDate: "",
        TagNumber: String(el.ifc.tag ?? ""),
        BarCode: "",
        AssetIdentifier: String(el.ifc.globalId ?? ""),
        SerialNumber: "",
      });
    } else {
      ds.Component.push({
        Name: el.name,
        TypeName: cat,
        Space: "",
        Description: "",
        InstallationDate: "",
        WarrantyStartDate: "",
        TagNumber: "",
        BarCode: "",
        AssetIdentifier: el.id,
        SerialNumber: "",
      });
    }
  }
}

function gatherIssues(ds: CobieDataset): void {
  try {
    const issues = getIssues();
    for (const it of issues) {
      ds.Issue.push({
        Name: it.title,
        CreatedBy: it.author ?? "",
        CreatedOn: it.createdAt ? new Date(it.createdAt).toISOString() : "",
        Type: "Coordination",
        Risk: it.priority ?? "",
        Chance: "",
        Impact: "",
        Status: it.status ?? "Open",
        Description: it.description ?? "",
        Owner: it.assignee ?? "",
        Mitigation: "",
        ExtSystem: "Open BIM Studio",
        ExtObject: "Issue",
        ExtIdentifier: it.id,
      });
    }
  } catch { /* issues module optional */ }
}

export async function gatherCobieDataset(
  opts: CobieBuildOptions = {},
): Promise<CobieDataset> {
  const ds = emptyCobieDataset();
  const units = guessUnits();
  const facilityName = opts.projectName ?? "Open BIM Studio Project";
  const author = opts.authorName ?? "";

  ds.Facility.push({
    Name: facilityName,
    Category: "Facility",
    ProjectName: facilityName,
    SiteName: opts.siteName ?? "",
    LinearUnits: units.linear,
    AreaUnits: units.area,
    VolumeUnits: units.volume,
    CurrencyUnit: getCurrencyCode(),
    AreaMeasurement: "NRM",
    LinearMeasurement: "NRM",
    VolumeMeasurement: "NRM",
    Description: opts.description ?? "",
    ProjectDescription: "",
    SiteDescription: "",
    Phase: opts.phase ?? "Design",
  });

  if (opts.includeAuthor !== false && (author || opts.authorEmail)) {
    ds.Contact.push({
      Email: opts.authorEmail ?? "",
      GivenName: author.split(" ")[0] ?? "",
      FamilyName: author.split(" ").slice(1).join(" ") ?? "",
      Company: "Open BIM Studio",
      Phone: "",
    });
  }

  await gatherFromFragments(ds);
  gatherFromAuthored(ds);
  gatherIssues(ds);

  // Coordinates: one row per model root.
  let i = 0;
  for (const [modelId] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    ds.Coordinate.push({
      Name: `Origin-${i++}`,
      Category: "Model",
      SheetName: "Facility",
      RowName: facilityName,
      CoordinateXAxis: "0",
      CoordinateYAxis: "0",
      CoordinateZAxis: "0",
      ExtSystem: "Open BIM Studio",
      ExtObject: "Model",
      ExtIdentifier: modelId,
    });
  }

  return ds;
}

function getCurrencyCode(): string {
  try { return localStorage.getItem("obs.currency") ?? "USD"; }
  catch { return "USD"; }
}

/* ── Sheet writers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

const SHEETS: Array<{ name: keyof CobieDataset; columns: string[] }> = [
  { name: "Facility",   columns: ["Name","Category","ProjectName","SiteName","LinearUnits","AreaUnits","VolumeUnits","CurrencyUnit","AreaMeasurement","LinearMeasurement","VolumeMeasurement","Description","ProjectDescription","SiteDescription","Phase"] },
  { name: "Floor",      columns: ["Name","Category","Description","Elevation","Height"] },
  { name: "Space",      columns: ["Name","FloorName","Description","RoomTag","UsableHeight","GrossArea","NetArea","Category"] },
  { name: "Zone",       columns: ["Name","Category","SpaceNames","Description"] },
  { name: "Type",       columns: ["Name","Category","Description","AssetType","Manufacturer","ModelNumber","WarrantyGuarantorParts","WarrantyDurationParts","WarrantyGuarantorLabor","WarrantyDurationLabor","WarrantyDurationUnit","ReplacementCost","ExpectedLife","DurationUnit","NominalLength","NominalWidth","NominalHeight","Shape","Size","Color","Finish","Grade","Material","Constituents","Features","AccessibilityPerformance","CodePerformance","SustainabilityPerformance"] },
  { name: "Component",  columns: ["Name","TypeName","Space","Description","InstallationDate","WarrantyStartDate","TagNumber","BarCode","AssetIdentifier","SerialNumber"] },
  { name: "System",     columns: ["Name","ComponentNames","Description","Category"] },
  { name: "Assembly",   columns: ["Name","AssemblyType","SheetName","ParentName","ComponentNames","ExtSystem","ExtObject","ExtIdentifier","Description"] },
  { name: "Contact",    columns: ["Email","GivenName","FamilyName","Company","Phone"] },
  { name: "Coordinate", columns: ["Name","Category","SheetName","RowName","CoordinateXAxis","CoordinateYAxis","CoordinateZAxis","ExtSystem","ExtObject","ExtIdentifier"] },
  { name: "Attribute",  columns: ["Name","SheetName","RowName","Value","Unit","ExtSystem","ExtObject","ExtIdentifier","Description"] },
  { name: "Issue",      columns: ["Name","CreatedBy","CreatedOn","Type","Risk","Chance","Impact","Status","Description","Owner","Mitigation","ExtSystem","ExtObject","ExtIdentifier"] },
];

function csvEscape(v: unknown): string {
  const s = String(v ?? "");
  if (/[",\n]/.test(s)) return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  return s;
}

function toCsv(rows: Record<string, string>[], columns: string[]): string {
  const header = columns.map(csvEscape).join(",");
  const lines = rows.map((r) => columns.map((c) => csvEscape(r[c] ?? "")).join(","));
  return "\ufeff" + [header, ...lines].join("\n");
}

function xmlSheetName(name: string): string {
  return name.replace(/[^\w]/g, "_");
}

/* ── Exporters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export function cobieToWorkbookHtml(ds: CobieDataset, projectName: string): string {
  let html = `<!doctype html>
<html xmlns:x="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>${projectName} — COBie ${COBIE_VERSION}</title>
<!--[if gte mso 9]><xml>
<x:ExcelWorkbook>
  <x:ExcelWorksheets>
    ${SHEETS.map((s) => `<x:ExcelWorksheet><x:Name>${xmlSheetName(s.name)}</x:Name></x:ExcelWorksheet>`).join("")}
  </x:ExcelWorksheets>
</x:ExcelWorkbook>
</xml><![endif]-->
<style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 16px; }
  h1 { font-size: 16px; }
  h2 { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 22px; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px; margin: 6px 0 20px; }
  th { background: #f0f2f5; text-align: left; padding: 4px 8px;
       border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
  td { padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; }
  .meta { color: #6b7280; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .count { color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>${projectName} — COBie ${COBIE_VERSION}</h1>
<div class="meta">Generated ${new Date().toLocaleString()}</div>
`;

  for (const sheet of SHEETS) {
    const rows = ds[sheet.name] as Record<string, any>[];
    html += `<h2>${sheet.name} <span class="count">(${rows.length})</span></h2>`;
    if (!rows.length) {
      html += `<div class="meta">No ${sheet.name} rows.</div>`;
      continue;
    }
    html += `<table><thead><tr>${sheet.columns.map((c) => `<th>${c}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>`;
    for (const row of rows) {
      html += `<tr>${sheet.columns.map((c) => `<td>${String(row[c] ?? "").replace(/[&<>]/g, (x) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;" } as any)[x])}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`;
    }
    html += `</tbody></table>`;
  }

  html += `</body></html>`;
  return html;
}

function download(blob: Blob, name: string): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

export function exportCobieXls(ds: CobieDataset, projectName: string): void {
  const html = cobieToWorkbookHtml(ds, projectName);
  const blob = new Blob([html], { type: "application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8" });
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  download(blob, `cobie-${projectName.replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}-${stamp}.xls`);
}

export async function exportCobieZip(ds: CobieDataset, projectName: string): Promise<void> {
  const zip = new JSZip();
  for (const sheet of SHEETS) {
    const rows = ds[sheet.name] as Record<string, any>[];
    zip.file(`${sheet.name}.csv`, toCsv(rows, sheet.columns));
  }
  const blob = await zip.generateAsync({
    type: "blob",
    compression: "DEFLATE",
    mimeType: "application/zip",
  });
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  download(blob, `cobie-${projectName.replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}-${stamp}.zip`);
}

/* ── One-shot convenience ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export async function exportCobie(
  opts: CobieBuildOptions & { format?: "xls" | "zip" } = {},
): Promise<void> {
  const ds = await gatherCobieDataset(opts);
  const name = opts.projectName ?? "Open BIM Studio Project";
  if (opts.format === "zip") await exportCobieZip(ds, name);
  else exportCobieXls(ds, name);
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:v3:applied
/**
 * Minimal IFC4 SPF writer for Native Twins.
 *
 * Produces a standalone IFC file with one IfcBuildingElementProxy (or the
 * source entity if known), triangulated geometry, placement, and property sets.
 */
/** Minimal twin shape needed for IFC export (avoids cycle with frag-edit). */
export interface TwinIfcSource {
  name?: string;
  description?: string;
  nativeEntity?: string;
  sourceEntity?: string;
  sourceGlobalId?: string;
  nativeId?: string;
  modelId: string;
  position: [number, number, number];
  quaternion: [number, number, number, number];
  propertySets?: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
  overrides?: Record<string, unknown>;
  geometry?: { positions?: number[] | Float32Array };
}


function esc(s: string): string {
  return String(s ?? "")
    .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")
    .replace(/'/g, "\\'");
}

function guid(): string {
  // IFC GlobalId is 22-char compressed — for simplicity emit a readable id.
  const raw = (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && (crypto as any).randomUUID)
    ? (crypto as any).randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "")
    : `${Date.now().toString(16)}${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
  return raw.slice(0, 22).padEnd(22, "0");
}

function num(n: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "0.";
  const s = n.toFixed(6);
  return s.replace(/\.?0+$/, "") || "0";
}

/**
 * Write a minimal IFC4 SPF string for one native twin.
 */
export function writeNativeTwinIfc(edit: TwinIfcSource): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let id = 1;
  const next = () => id++;

  const entity = (edit.nativeEntity || edit.sourceEntity || "IfcBuildingElementProxy").replace(/^Ifc/, "Ifc");
  const ifcEntity = entity.startsWith("Ifc") ? entity : `Ifc${entity}`;
  // Fall back to proxy for obscure entity types that need more attributes.
  const safeEntity = [
    "IfcBuildingElementProxy", "IfcWall", "IfcSlab", "IfcBeam", "IfcColumn",
    "IfcDoor", "IfcWindow", "IfcMember", "IfcPlate", "IfcFooting", "IfcPile",
    "IfcRailing", "IfcStair", "IfcRamp", "IfcFurnishingElement", "IfcFlowSegment",
    "IfcFlowTerminal", "IfcFlowFitting", "IfcDistributionElement",
  ].includes(ifcEntity) ? ifcEntity : "IfcBuildingElementProxy";

  const name = esc(edit.name || "NativeTwin");
  const globalId = esc(edit.sourceGlobalId || edit.nativeId || guid());
  const description = esc(edit.description || `Native twin of ${edit.sourceEntity || "element"}`);

  lines.push("ISO-10303-21;");
  lines.push("HEADER;");
  lines.push("FILE_DESCRIPTION(('ViewDefinition [CoordinationView]'),'2;1');");
  lines.push(`FILE_NAME('native-twin.ifc','${new Date().toISOString()}',('Open BIM Studio'),('Open BIM Studio'),'Open BIM Studio','Open BIM Studio','');`);
  lines.push("FILE_SCHEMA(('IFC4'));");
  lines.push("ENDSEC;");
  lines.push("DATA;");

  // Units / project structure
  const person = next();
  lines.push(`#${person}=IFCPERSON($,$,'OBS',$,$,$,$,$);`);
  const org = next();
  lines.push(`#${org}=IFCORGANIZATION($,'Open BIM Studio',$,$,$);`);
  const personOrg = next();
  lines.push(`#${personOrg}=IFCPERSONANDORGANIZATION(#${person},#${org},$);`);

  const app = next();
  lines.push(`#${app}=IFCAPPLICATION(#${personOrg},'Open BIM Studio','Open BIM Studio','OBS');`);

  const owner = next();
  lines.push(`#${owner}=IFCOWNERHISTORY(#${personOrg},#${app},$,.ADDED.,$,$,$,${Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)});`);

  const lengthUnit = next();
  const areaUnit   = next();
  const volumeUnit = next();
  const angleUnit  = next();
  const unitAssign = next();

  const project = next();
  const site = next();
  const building = next();
  const storey = next();
  const localOrigin = next();
  const axis2 = next();
  const cartPt = next();
  const dirZ = next();
  const dirX = next();

  lines.push(`#${cartPt}=IFCCARTESIANPOINT((0.,0.,0.));`);
  lines.push(`#${dirZ}=IFCDIRECTION((0.,0.,1.));`);
  lines.push(`#${dirX}=IFCDIRECTION((1.,0.,0.));`);
  lines.push(`#${axis2}=IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D(#${cartPt},#${dirZ},#${dirX});`);
  lines.push(`#${localOrigin}=IFCLOCALPLACEMENT($,#${axis2});`);

  lines.push(`#${lengthUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.LENGTHUNIT.,$,.METRE.);`);
  lines.push(`#${areaUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.AREAUNIT.,$,.SQUARE_METRE.);`);
  lines.push(`#${volumeUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.VOLUMEUNIT.,$,.CUBIC_METRE.);`);
  lines.push(`#${angleUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.PLANEANGLEUNIT.,$,.RADIAN.);`);
  lines.push(`#${unitAssign}=IFCUNITASSIGNMENT((#${lengthUnit},#${areaUnit},#${volumeUnit},#${angleUnit}));`);
  lines.push(`#${project}=IFCPROJECT('${guid()}',#${owner},'Native Twin Export',$,$,$,$,(#${unitAssign}),$);`);


  lines.push(`#${site}=IFCSITE('${guid()}',#${owner},'Site',$,$,#${localOrigin},$,$,.ELEMENT.,$,$,$,$,$);`);
  lines.push(`#${building}=IFCBUILDING('${guid()}',#${owner},'Building',$,$,#${localOrigin},$,$,.ELEMENT.,$,$,$);`);
  lines.push(`#${storey}=IFCBUILDINGSTOREY('${guid()}',#${owner},'Level 0',$,$,#${localOrigin},$,$,.ELEMENT.,0.);`);

  const relAgg1 = next();
  const relAgg2 = next();
  const relAgg3 = next();
  lines.push(`#${relAgg1}=IFCRELAGGREGATES('${guid()}',#${owner},$,$,#${project},(#${site}));`);
  lines.push(`#${relAgg2}=IFCRELAGGREGATES('${guid()}',#${owner},$,$,#${site},(#${building}));`);
  lines.push(`#${relAgg3}=IFCRELAGGREGATES('${guid()}',#${owner},$,$,#${building},(#${storey}));`);

  // Placement from twin transform (position + quaternion → axis placement)
  const [px, py, pz] = edit.position;
  const [qx, qy, qz, qw] = edit.quaternion;
  // Rotation matrix from quaternion
  const xx = qx * qx, yy = qy * qy, zz = qz * qz;
  const xy = qx * qy, xz = qx * qz, yz = qy * qz;
  const wx = qw * qx, wy = qw * qy, wz = qw * qz;
  const r00 = 1 - 2 * (yy + zz);
  const r01 = 2 * (xy - wz);
  const r02 = 2 * (xz + wy);
  const r10 = 2 * (xy + wz);
  const r11 = 1 - 2 * (xx + zz);
  const r12 = 2 * (yz - wx);
  const r20 = 2 * (xz - wy);
  const r21 = 2 * (yz + wx);
  const r22 = 1 - 2 * (xx + yy);

  const elPt = next();
  const elDirZ = next();
  const elDirX = next();
  const elAxis = next();
  const elPlace = next();
  lines.push(`#${elPt}=IFCCARTESIANPOINT((${num(px)},${num(py)},${num(pz)}));`);
  lines.push(`#${elDirZ}=IFCDIRECTION((${num(r02)},${num(r12)},${num(r22)}));`);
  lines.push(`#${elDirX}=IFCDIRECTION((${num(r00)},${num(r10)},${num(r20)}));`);
  lines.push(`#${elAxis}=IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D(#${elPt},#${elDirZ},#${elDirX});`);
  lines.push(`#${elPlace}=IFCLOCALPLACEMENT(#${localOrigin},#${elAxis});`);

  // Geometry: triangulated face set from twin-local positions
  const positions = edit.geometry?.positions ?? [];
  let shapeRepRef = 0;
  if (positions.length >= 9) {
    const coordList: string[] = [];
    const faceList: string[] = [];
    const nVerts = Math.floor(positions.length / 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < nVerts; i++) {
      const x = positions[i * 3];
      const y = positions[i * 3 + 1];
      const z = positions[i * 3 + 2];
      coordList.push(`(${num(x)},${num(y)},${num(z)})`);
    }
    const nTris = Math.floor(nVerts / 3);
    for (let t = 0; t < nTris; t++) {
      const a = t * 3 + 1;
      const b = t * 3 + 2;
      const c = t * 3 + 3;
      faceList.push(`((${a},${b},${c}))`);
    }

    const coords = next();
    lines.push(`#${coords}=IFCCARTESIANPOINTLIST3D((${coordList.join(",")}));`);
    const faces = next();
    lines.push(`#${faces}=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET(#${coords},$,.F.,(${faceList.join(",")}),$);`);
    // IFC4 uses IfcTriangulatedFaceSet
    lines[lines.length - 1] = `#${faces}=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET(#${coords},$,.F.,(${faceList.join(",")}),$);`;

    const bodyStyle = next();
    const bodyRep = next();
    const shapeRep = next();
    lines.push(`#${bodyStyle}=IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION($,'Body','Tessellation',(#${faces}));`);
    lines.push(`#${bodyRep}=IFCPRODUCTDEFINITIONSHAPE($,$,(#${bodyStyle}));`);
    shapeRepRef = bodyRep;
  }

  const el = next();
  const shapeArg = shapeRepRef ? `#${shapeRepRef}` : "$";
  if (safeEntity === "IfcBuildingElementProxy") {
    lines.push(`#${el}=IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY('${globalId}',#${owner},'${name}','${description}',$,#${elPlace},${shapeArg},$,.NOTDEFINED.);`);
  } else {
    // Generic single-attribute form — many entities accept similar args; proxy is safest
    lines.push(`#${el}=IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY('${globalId}',#${owner},'${name}','${description}',$,#${elPlace},${shapeArg},$,.NOTDEFINED.);`);
  }

  const relCont = next();
  lines.push(`#${relCont}=IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE('${guid()}',#${owner},$,$,(#${el}),#${storey});`);

  // Property sets from source + overrides
  const psets = { ...(edit.propertySets ?? {}), ...(edit.overrides ? { NativeOverrides: edit.overrides } : {}) };
  for (const [psetName, props] of Object.entries(psets)) {
    if (!props || typeof props !== "object") continue;
    const propIds: number[] = [];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(props as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (v == null) continue;
      const pid = next();
      propIds.push(pid);
      if (typeof v === "number") {
        lines.push(`#${pid}=IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE('${esc(k)}',$,IFCREAL(${num(v)}),$);`);
      } else if (typeof v === "boolean") {
        lines.push(`#${pid}=IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE('${esc(k)}',$,IFCBOOLEAN(.${v ? "T" : "F"}.),$);`);
      } else {
        lines.push(`#${pid}=IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE('${esc(k)}',$,IFCLABEL('${esc(String(v))}'),$);`);
      }
    }
    if (!propIds.length) continue;
    const psid = next();
    lines.push(`#${psid}=IFCPROPERTYSET('${guid()}',#${owner},'${esc(psetName)}',$,(${propIds.map((x) => `#${x}`).join(",")}));`);
    const rel = next();
    lines.push(`#${rel}=IFCRELDEFINESBYPROPERTIES('${guid()}',#${owner},$,$,(#${el}),#${psid});`);
  }

  // Lineage
  const linPid = next();
  lines.push(`#${linPid}=IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE('SourceGlobalId',$,IFCLABEL('${esc(edit.sourceGlobalId || "")}'),$);`);
  const linPid2 = next();
  lines.push(`#${linPid2}=IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE('SourceEntity',$,IFCLABEL('${esc(edit.sourceEntity || "")}'),$);`);
  const linPid3 = next();
  lines.push(`#${linPid3}=IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE('SourceModelId',$,IFCLABEL('${esc(edit.modelId)}'),$);`);
  const linPs = next();
  lines.push(`#${linPs}=IFCPROPERTYSET('${guid()}',#${owner},'Pset_NativeTwinLineage',$,(#${linPid},#${linPid2},#${linPid3}));`);
  const linRel = next();
  lines.push(`#${linRel}=IFCRELDEFINESBYPROPERTIES('${guid()}',#${owner},$,$,(#${el}),#${linPs});`);

  lines.push("ENDSEC;");
  lines.push("END-ISO-10303-21;");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

/** Download an IFC file for the given twin edit. */
export function downloadNativeTwinIfc(edit: TwinIfcSource, filename?: string): void {
  const text = writeNativeTwinIfc(edit);
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: "application/x-step" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename || `${(edit.name || "native-twin").replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/gi, "_")}.ifc`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * PDF export - converts a Scene2D to a pdf-lib PDF page.
 *
 * pdf-lib does not have canvas-style stateful setters (setStrokeColor etc).
 * Stroke / fill / dash are passed as options on every drawing call.
 */

import { PDFDocument, PDFPage, PDFFont, StandardFonts, rgb } from "pdf-lib";
import type { Scene2D, SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../views/scene";

const PT_PER_INCH = 72;
const MM_PER_INCH = 25.4;
export const MM_TO_PT = PT_PER_INCH / MM_PER_INCH;   // ~= 2.8346

interface PdfPageContext {
  page: PDFPage;
  font: PDFFont;
  boldFont: PDFFont;
  worldToPt: number;
  originX: number;
  originY: number;
}

function hexToRgb(hex: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number } {
  const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex);
  if (!m) return { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0 };
  const n = parseInt(m[1], 16);
  return {
    r: ((n >> 16) & 255) / 255,
    g: ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255,
    b: (n & 255) / 255,
  };
}

interface StrokeOpts {
  color: ReturnType<typeof rgb>;
  thickness: number;
  dashArray?: number[];
}

function strokeOptions(stroke: StrokeStyle): StrokeOpts {
  const c = hexToRgb(stroke.color);
  const opts: StrokeOpts = {
    color: rgb(c.r, c.g, c.b),
    thickness: Math.max(0.1, stroke.widthPt),
  };
  if (stroke.dash && stroke.dash.length) {
    opts.dashArray = stroke.dash.map((d) => d * MM_TO_PT);
  }
  return opts;
}

function worldToPdf(ctx: PdfPageContext, worldX: number, worldY: number): [number, number] {
  return [
    ctx.originX + worldX * ctx.worldToPt,
    ctx.originY + worldY * ctx.worldToPt,
  ];
}

export function drawScene2DToPdf(
  page: PDFPage,
  font: PDFFont,
  boldFont: PDFFont | null,
  scene: Scene2D,
  worldToPt: number,
  originX: number,
  originY: number,
): void {
  const ctx: PdfPageContext = {
    page,
    font,
    boldFont: boldFont ?? font,
    worldToPt,
    originX,
    originY,
  };

  const layers: Array<{ name: string; entities: SceneEntity[] }> = [
    { name: "below",      entities: scene.layers.below },
    { name: "grid",       entities: scene.layers.grid },
    { name: "project",    entities: scene.layers.project },
    { name: "overhead",   entities: scene.layers.overhead },
    { name: "cut",        entities: scene.layers.cut },
    { name: "symbols",    entities: scene.layers.symbols },
    { name: "annotation", entities: scene.layers.annotation },
  ];

  for (const layer of layers) {
    for (const e of layer.entities) {
      drawEntity(ctx, e);
    }
  }
}

function drawEntity(ctx: PdfPageContext, e: SceneEntity): void {
  switch (e.kind) {
    case "line": {
      const [x1, y1] = worldToPdf(ctx, e.x1, -e.z1);
      const [x2, y2] = worldToPdf(ctx, e.x2, -e.z2);
      const s = strokeOptions(e.stroke);
      ctx.page.drawLine({
        start: { x: x1, y: y1 },
        end: { x: x2, y: y2 },
        thickness: s.thickness,
        color: s.color,
        dashArray: s.dashArray,
      });
      break;
    }
    case "polyline": {
      const pts = e.points.map(([x, z]) => worldToPdf(ctx, x, -z));
      if (pts.length < 2) return;
      const s = strokeOptions(e.stroke);

      // Fill first (if any) - draw as a filled SVG path
      if (e.fill && pts.length >= 3) {
        const c = hexToRgb(e.fill.color);
        const d =
          pts.map((p, i) => (i === 0 ? "M " : "L ") + p[0].toFixed(3) + " " + p[1].toFixed(3)).join(" ") +
          (e.closed ? " Z" : "");
        ctx.page.drawSvgPath(d, {
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          color: rgb(c.r, c.g, c.b),
          opacity: e.fill.opacity ?? 1,
        });
      }

      // Outline strokes
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        ctx.page.drawLine({
          start: { x: pts[i][0], y: pts[i][1] },
          end: { x: pts[i + 1][0], y: pts[i + 1][1] },
          thickness: s.thickness,
          color: s.color,
          dashArray: s.dashArray,
        });
      }
      if (e.closed && pts.length >= 3) {
        ctx.page.drawLine({
          start: { x: pts[pts.length - 1][0], y: pts[pts.length - 1][1] },
          end: { x: pts[0][0], y: pts[0][1] },
          thickness: s.thickness,
          color: s.color,
          dashArray: s.dashArray,
        });
      }
      break;
    }
    case "arc": {
      const s = strokeOptions(e.stroke);
      const steps = Math.max(8, Math.floor(Math.abs(e.a1 - e.a0) / 0.15));
      const pts: Array<[number, number]> = [];
      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const a = e.a0 + (e.a1 - e.a0) * (i / steps);
        const wx = e.cx + Math.cos(a) * e.r;
        const wz = e.cz + Math.sin(a) * e.r;
        pts.push(worldToPdf(ctx, wx, -wz));
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        ctx.page.drawLine({
          start: { x: pts[i][0], y: pts[i][1] },
          end: { x: pts[i + 1][0], y: pts[i + 1][1] },
          thickness: s.thickness,
          color: s.color,
          dashArray: s.dashArray,
        });
      }
      break;
    }
    case "circle": {
      const [cx, cy] = worldToPdf(ctx, e.cx, -e.cz);
      const rPt = e.r * ctx.worldToPt;
      const s = strokeOptions(e.stroke);
      const opts: any = {
        x: cx,
        y: cy,
        xScale: rPt,
        yScale: rPt,
        borderWidth: s.thickness,
        borderColor: s.color,
      };
      if (e.fill) {
        const c = hexToRgb(e.fill.color);
        opts.color = rgb(c.r, c.g, c.b);
        opts.opacity = e.fill.opacity ?? 1;
      }
      if (s.dashArray) opts.borderDashArray = s.dashArray;
      ctx.page.drawEllipse(opts);
      break;
    }
    case "text": {
      const [tx, ty] = worldToPdf(ctx, e.x, -e.z);
      const fontSize = Math.max(4, e.sizePt * MM_TO_PT);
      const c = hexToRgb(e.color);
      const anchor = e.anchor ?? "start";
      const textWidth = ctx.font.widthOfTextAtSize(e.text, fontSize);
      let drawX = tx;
      if (anchor === "middle") drawX = tx - textWidth / 2;
      else if (anchor === "end") drawX = tx - textWidth;
      ctx.page.drawText(e.text, {
        x: drawX,
        y: ty - fontSize / 3,
        size: fontSize,
        font: ctx.font,
        color: rgb(c.r, c.g, c.b),
      });
      break;
    }
    default:
      break;
  }
}

export async function createPdfDocument(): Promise<{
  doc: PDFDocument;
  regular: PDFFont;
  bold: PDFFont;
}> {
  const doc = await PDFDocument.create();
  doc.setCreator("Open BIM Studio");
  doc.setProducer("Open BIM Studio PDF exporter");
  const regular = await doc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica);
  const bold = await doc.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);
  return { doc, regular, bold };
}

export async function savePdfBytes(doc: PDFDocument): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  return await doc.save();
}

export async function downloadPdf(doc: PDFDocument, filename: string): Promise<void> {
  const bytes = await doc.save();
  const blob = new Blob([bytes as unknown as BlobPart], { type: "application/pdf" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}
```
