```ts
// openbim-step1:family-foundation
// Family system foundation - registry that ties store + geometry + params.

import * as THREE from "three";
import { familyStore } from "./store";
import { buildParametricGeometry, registerCustomBuilder } from "./parametric-geometry";
import { evaluateParameters } from "./formula-engine";
import type {
  CustomGeometryBuilder,
  FamilyDefinition,
  FamilyParameter,
  FamilyService,
  FamilyType,
} from "./types";

/** Resolve parameters for a family/type, applying instance overrides last. */
function resolveParameters(
  family: FamilyDefinition,
  type: FamilyType | null,
  overrides: Record<string, any> | undefined,
): Record<string, any> {
  const values: Record<string, any> = {};

  // 1. Family defaults.
  for (const p of family.parameters) {
    values[p.name] = p.default;
  }

  // 2. Type-scope overrides.
  if (type) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(type.values)) {
      values[k] = v;
    }
  }

  // 3. Instance overrides.
  if (overrides) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(overrides)) {
      values[k] = v;
    }
  }

  // 4. Formula pass -- delegated to the formula engine so a formula that
  //    references a later-declared parameter, or a cycle, or a typo, is
  //    surfaced instead of silently dropped.
  const result = evaluateParameters(family.parameters, values);
  if (result.errors.length) {
    for (const e of result.errors) {
      console.warn(
        "[families] formula error -- " + e.parameter + ": " + e.message,
      );
    }
  }
  return result.values;
}

export function createFamilyService(): FamilyService {
  const svc: FamilyService = {
    list: () => familyStore.list(),
    get: (id) => familyStore.get(id),
    getByElementType: (et) => familyStore.getByElementType(et),

    create: (def) => familyStore.create(def),
    update: (id, patch) => familyStore.update(id, patch),
    remove: (id) => familyStore.remove(id),
    duplicate: (id, name) => familyStore.duplicate(id, name),

    createType: (fid, name, values) => familyStore.createType(fid, name, values),
    updateType: (fid, tid, patch) => familyStore.updateType(fid, tid, patch),
    removeType: (fid, tid) => familyStore.removeType(fid, tid),

    resolveParams: (fid, tid, overrides) => {
      const fam = familyStore.get(fid);
      if (!fam) return null;
      const type = tid ? fam.types.find((t) => t.id === tid) ?? null : null;
      return resolveParameters(fam, type, overrides);
    },

    buildGeometry: (fid, tid, overrides) => {
      const fam = familyStore.get(fid);
      if (!fam) return null;
      const type = tid ? fam.types.find((t) => t.id === tid) ?? null : null;
      const params = resolveParameters(fam, type, overrides);
      const obj = buildParametricGeometry(fam.geometry, params);
      if (!obj) return null;
      obj.userData.familyId = fam.id;
      obj.userData.familyTypeId = tid;
      obj.userData.familyParams = params;
      return obj;
    },

    registerCustomBuilder: (name, fn) => registerCustomBuilder(name, fn),

    onChange: (cb) => familyStore.onChange(cb),
    reset: () => familyStore.reset(),
  };
  return svc;
}

/** Type-guard helper used by built-in family definitions. */
export function isFamilyParameter(v: any): v is FamilyParameter {
  return v && typeof v === "object" && typeof v.name === "string" && typeof v.type === "string";
}

/** Expose the raw geometry builder for tests / editor previews. */
export { buildParametricGeometry, resolveParameters };

/** Convenience: build a bare THREE.Group from a family + type. */
export function buildFamilyPreview(
  svc: FamilyService,
  familyId: string,
  typeId: string | null,
): THREE.Object3D | null {
  return svc.buildGeometry(familyId, typeId, undefined);
}

// Re-export the register hook so modules can install custom builders without
// importing parametric-geometry directly.
export type { CustomGeometryBuilder };
```

```ts
/**
 * Parametric-aware family service wrapper.
 *
 * Drop-in enhancement of createFamilyService() that routes geometry builds
 * through the full parametric engine (formulas - constraints - nested /
 * array / sweep / revolve / conditional visibility).
 *
 * Usage in index.ts:
 *   import { createParametricFamilyService } from "./registry-parametric";
 *   const svc = createParametricFamilyService();
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { familyStore } from "./store";
import { registerCustomBuilder } from "./parametric-geometry";
import {
  buildParametricFamily,
  resolveParametricValues,
  propagateTypeChange,
  collectReportingValues,
  type ParametricBuildOptions,
  type InstanceParamBinding,
} from "./parametric-engine";
import type {
  CustomGeometryBuilder,
  FamilyDefinition,
  FamilyService,
  FamilyType,
} from "./types";
import type { Constraint } from "./constraint-graph";

export interface ParametricFamilyService extends FamilyService {
  /** Full parametric build with constraints / nested / arrays. */
  buildParametric(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    options?: ParametricBuildOptions,
  ): ReturnType<typeof buildParametricFamily>;

  /** Resolve params with formula + constraint pipeline. */
  resolveParametric(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    options?: ParametricBuildOptions,
  ): Record<string, any> | null;

  /** Propagate a type-parameter edit to all bound instances. */
  propagateType(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string,
    instances: InstanceParamBinding[],
    options?: ParametricBuildOptions,
  ): Map<string, Record<string, any>>;

  /** Collect reporting (schedule) values for an instance. */
  reportingValues(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    overrides?: Record<string, any>,
  ): Record<string, any> | null;

  /** Attach dimensional constraints to a family (persisted in memory). */
  setConstraints(familyId: string, constraints: Constraint[]): boolean;
  getConstraints(familyId: string): Constraint[];
}

/** Per-family constraint store (not in FamilyDefinition schema yet). */
const constraintMap = new Map<string, Constraint[]>();

export function createParametricFamilyService(): ParametricFamilyService {
  const familyLookup = (id: string) => familyStore.get(id);
  const typeLookup = (fid: string, tid: string) => {
    const f = familyStore.get(fid);
    return f?.types.find((t) => t.id === tid) ?? null;
  };

  const baseOptions = (): ParametricBuildOptions => ({
    familyLookup,
    typeLookup,
  });

  const svc: ParametricFamilyService = {
    list: () => familyStore.list(),
    get: (id) => familyStore.get(id),
    getByElementType: (et) => familyStore.getByElementType(et),

    create: (def) => familyStore.create(def),
    update: (id, patch) => familyStore.update(id, patch),
    remove: (id) => {
      constraintMap.delete(id);
      return familyStore.remove(id);
    },
    duplicate: (id, name) => familyStore.duplicate(id, name),

    createType: (fid, name, values) => familyStore.createType(fid, name, values),
    updateType: (fid, tid, patch) => familyStore.updateType(fid, tid, patch),
    removeType: (fid, tid) => familyStore.removeType(fid, tid),

    resolveParams: (fid, tid, overrides) => {
      return svc.resolveParametric(fid, tid, { overrides });
    },

    buildGeometry: (fid, tid, overrides) => {
      const result = svc.buildParametric(fid, tid, { overrides });
      return result.object;
    },

    registerCustomBuilder: (name, fn) => registerCustomBuilder(name, fn),

    onChange: (cb) => familyStore.onChange(cb),
    reset: () => {
      constraintMap.clear();
      familyStore.reset();
    },

    // -- Parametric extensions --------------------------------------

    buildParametric(familyId, typeId, options = {}) {
      const fam = familyStore.get(familyId);
      if (!fam) {
        return {
          object: null,
          params: {},
          formula: { values: {}, computed: new Set(), errors: [], order: [] },
          constraints: null,
          errors: [`Family not found: ${familyId}`],
          warnings: [],
        };
      }
      const type = typeId
        ? fam.types.find((t) => t.id === typeId) ?? null
        : null;
      const constraints = constraintMap.get(familyId);
      return buildParametricFamily(fam, type, {
        ...baseOptions(),
        ...options,
        constraints: options.constraints ?? constraints,
      });
    },

    resolveParametric(familyId, typeId, options = {}) {
      const fam = familyStore.get(familyId);
      if (!fam) return null;
      const type = typeId
        ? fam.types.find((t) => t.id === typeId) ?? null
        : null;
      const constraints = constraintMap.get(familyId);
      const { values } = resolveParametricValues(fam, type, {
        ...baseOptions(),
        ...options,
        constraints: options.constraints ?? constraints,
      });
      return values;
    },

    propagateType(familyId, typeId, instances, options = {}) {
      const fam = familyStore.get(familyId);
      if (!fam) return new Map();
      const type = fam.types.find((t) => t.id === typeId);
      if (!type) return new Map();
      return propagateTypeChange(fam, type, instances, {
        ...baseOptions(),
        ...options,
        constraints: constraintMap.get(familyId),
      });
    },

    reportingValues(familyId, typeId, overrides) {
      const values = svc.resolveParametric(familyId, typeId, { overrides });
      if (!values) return null;
      const fam = familyStore.get(familyId);
      if (!fam) return null;
      return collectReportingValues(fam, values);
    },

    setConstraints(familyId, constraints) {
      if (!familyStore.get(familyId)) return false;
      constraintMap.set(familyId, constraints);
      return true;
    },

    getConstraints(familyId) {
      return constraintMap.get(familyId) ?? [];
    },
  };

  return svc;
}

export type { CustomGeometryBuilder, InstanceParamBinding };
```

```ts
/**
 * Sample parametric door family - demonstrates formulas, constraints,
 * conditional geometry, and arrays. Seed this via familyStore.create()
 * or merge into createBuiltInFamilies().
 */

import type { FamilyDefinition } from "./types";
import type { ExtendedGeometrySpec } from "./types-extended";
import type { Constraint } from "./constraint-graph";

const REF = (name: string) => ({ ref: name });
const CONST = (n: number) => ({ const: n });

export const PARAMETRIC_DOOR_CONSTRAINTS: Constraint[] = [
  // Panel height tracks overall height minus frame
  { kind: "offset", a: "PanelHeight", b: "Height", delta: -0.08, priority: 10 },
  // Panel width tracks leaf count
  // (formula also handles this; constraint is a safety net)
  { kind: "ratio", a: "MullionSpacing", b: "Width", k: 0.5, priority: 5 },
];

export function createParametricDoorFamily(): FamilyDefinition {
  const geometry: any = {
    kind: "composed",
    parts: [
      // Outer frame (extruded rectangle with hole for leaf)
      {
        kind: "extrusion",
        profile: { kind: "rect", w: REF("Width"), h: REF("Height") },
        depth: REF("FrameDepth"),
        holes: [
          {
            kind: "rect",
            w: REF("OpeningWidth"),
            h: REF("OpeningHeight"),
          },
        ],
      },
      // Single leaf
      {
        kind: "conditional",
        when: "IsSingle",
        then: {
          kind: "box",
          w: REF("PanelWidth"),
          d: REF("PanelThickness"),
          h: REF("PanelHeight"),
          transform: {
            translate: [CONST(0), CONST(0), REF("PanelOffset")],
          },
        },
      },
      // Double leaf - left
      {
        kind: "conditional",
        when: "IsDouble",
        then: {
          kind: "box",
          w: REF("HalfPanelWidth"),
          d: REF("PanelThickness"),
          h: REF("PanelHeight"),
          transform: {
            translate: [REF("LeftPanelX"), CONST(0), REF("PanelOffset")],
          },
        },
      },
      // Double leaf - right
      {
        kind: "conditional",
        when: "IsDouble",
        then: {
          kind: "box",
          w: REF("HalfPanelWidth"),
          d: REF("PanelThickness"),
          h: REF("PanelHeight"),
          transform: {
            translate: [REF("RightPanelX"), CONST(0), REF("PanelOffset")],
          },
        },
      },
      // Optional vision panel (glazed rectangle on leaf)
      {
        kind: "conditional",
        when: "HasVision",
        then: {
          kind: "box",
          w: REF("VisionWidth"),
          d: CONST(0.02),
          h: REF("VisionHeight"),
          transform: {
            translate: [CONST(0), CONST(0), REF("VisionZ")],
          },
        },
      },
      // Handle cylinder
      {
        kind: "cylinder",
        r: CONST(0.015),
        h: CONST(0.08),
        transform: {
          translate: [REF("HandleX"), CONST(0), REF("HandleZ")],
          rotate: [CONST(Math.PI / 2), CONST(0), CONST(0)],
        },
      },
    ],
  };

  return {
    id: "parametric-door-v1",
    name: "Parametric Door",
    category: "door",
    ifcEntity: "IfcDoor",
    schemaVersion: 2,
    sourceElementType: "door",
    builtIn: true,
    group: "Architecture",
    parameters: [
      // -- Dimensions ----------------------------------------------
      {
        name: "Width",
        type: "length",
        scope: "type",
        default: 0.9,
        editable: true,
        min: 0.5,
        max: 3.0,
        unit: "m",
        group: "Dimensions",
        description: "Overall door width",
      },
      {
        name: "Height",
        type: "length",
        scope: "type",
        default: 2.1,
        editable: true,
        min: 1.8,
        max: 3.5,
        unit: "m",
```

```ts
// openbim-step1:family-foundation
// Family system foundation - in-memory store with localStorage persistence.
//
// Mirrors the pattern used by core/options-registry.ts. Every mutation
// notifies subscribers so the UI (or verify scripts) can react.

import type { FamilyDefinition, FamilyType } from "./types";

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.families.v1";

function uid(): string {
  return (crypto as any).randomUUID?.()
    ?? ("fam-" + Date.now().toString(36) + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8));
}

class FamilyStore {
  private byId = new Map<string, FamilyDefinition>();
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(seedBuiltIns: FamilyDefinition[]): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;

    let restored: FamilyDefinition[] | null = null;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) restored = parsed;
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    if (restored && restored.length) {
      for (const d of restored) this.byId.set(d.id, d);
    } else {
      for (const d of seedBuiltIns) this.byId.set(d.id, d);
      this.persist();
    }
  }

  list(): FamilyDefinition[] {
    return [...this.byId.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }

  get(id: string): FamilyDefinition | null {
    return this.byId.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  getByElementType(elementType: string): FamilyDefinition | null {
    for (const d of this.byId.values()) {
      if (d.sourceElementType === elementType) return d;
    }
    return null;
  }

  create(def: Omit<FamilyDefinition, "id" | "schemaVersion" | "builtIn">): FamilyDefinition {
    const family: FamilyDefinition = {
      ...def,
      id: uid(),
      schemaVersion: 1,
      builtIn: false,
    };
    this.byId.set(family.id, family);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return family;
  }

  update(id: string, patch: Partial<FamilyDefinition>): FamilyDefinition | null {
    const cur = this.byId.get(id);
    if (!cur) return null;
    const next: FamilyDefinition = { ...cur, ...patch, id: cur.id };
    this.byId.set(id, next);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return next;
  }

  remove(id: string): boolean {
    const cur = this.byId.get(id);
    if (!cur) return false;
    if (cur.builtIn) return false;
    const ok = this.byId.delete(id);
    if (ok) { this.persist(); this.emit(); }
    return ok;
  }

  duplicate(id: string, newName: string): FamilyDefinition | null {
    const cur = this.byId.get(id);
    if (!cur) return null;
    const clone: FamilyDefinition = {
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cur)),
      id: uid(),
      name: newName,
      builtIn: false,
    };
    this.byId.set(clone.id, clone);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return clone;
  }

  createType(familyId: string, name: string, values: Record<string, any> = {}): FamilyType | null {
    const fam = this.byId.get(familyId);
    if (!fam) return null;
    const t: FamilyType = { id: uid(), name, values };
    fam.types.push(t);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return t;
  }

  updateType(familyId: string, typeId: string, patch: Partial<FamilyType>): FamilyType | null {
    const fam = this.byId.get(familyId);
    if (!fam) return null;
    const idx = fam.types.findIndex((t) => t.id === typeId);
    if (idx < 0) return null;
    fam.types[idx] = { ...fam.types[idx], ...patch, id: typeId };
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return fam.types[idx];
  }

  removeType(familyId: string, typeId: string): boolean {
    const fam = this.byId.get(familyId);
    if (!fam) return false;
    const before = fam.types.length;
    fam.types = fam.types.filter((t) => t.id !== typeId);
    if (fam.types.length === before) return false;
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.byId.clear();
    this.booted = false;
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch { /* */ }
  }

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) { try { cb(); } catch { /* */ } }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      const arr = [...this.byId.values()];
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[families] persist failed", err);
    }
  }
}

export const familyStore = new FamilyStore();

```

```ts
// openbim-step1:family-foundation
// Family system foundation - type definitions.
//
// A FamilyDefinition is a data-driven, user-extensible description of a
// parametric BIM family: named parameters, a geometry recipe, and one or
// more named types. Nothing in this file imports runtime code, so it is
// safe to use as a type-only dependency from services.ts.

import type * as THREE from "three";

export type FamilyCategory =
  | "wall" | "slab" | "column" | "beam" | "brace" | "truss" | "footing"
  | "strip" | "mline" | "door" | "window" | "duct" | "pipe"
  | "cable-tray" | "conduit" | "equipment" | "fitting"
  | "curtain-wall" | "stairs" | "railing" | "ramp" | "roof" | "ceiling"
  | "generic";

export type ParameterType =
  | "length" | "angle" | "number" | "integer" | "text"
  | "area" | "volume"
  | "boolean" | "material" | "colour" | "family-type";

export type ParameterScope = "instance" | "type";

export interface FamilyParameter {
  name: string;
  /** Human-readable label for the UI. Falls back to `name` when absent. */
  label?: string;
  type: ParameterType;
  scope: ParameterScope;
  default: any;
  editable: boolean;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  unit?: string;
  group?: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Formula referencing other parameter names, evaluated in declaration order. */
  formula?: string;
}

export interface FamilyType {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Type-scope parameter overrides. */
  values: Record<string, any>;
}

export type NumberRef =
  | { ref: string }
  | { const: number }
  /**
   * Safe arithmetic over parameter names, e.g. "thickness / 2" or
   * "(width + height) * 0.5". Evaluated by the same expression engine that
   * powers family parameter formulas -- see modules/families/formula-engine.
   */
  | { expr: string };

export type ProfileSpec =
  | { kind: "rect"; w: NumberRef; h: NumberRef }
  | { kind: "circle"; r: NumberRef; segments?: number }
  | { kind: "polygon"; points: [number, number][] };

export interface TransformSpec {
  /** Translation in metres, [x, y, z]. */
  translate?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
  /** Rotation in radians, [x, y, z]. */
  rotate?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
  /** Scale, [x, y, z]. */
  scale?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
}

export type FamilyGeometrySpec =
  | { kind: "box"; w: NumberRef; d: NumberRef; h: NumberRef; transform?: TransformSpec }
  | { kind: "cylinder"; r: NumberRef; h: NumberRef; segments?: number; transform?: TransformSpec }
  | { kind: "extrusion"; profile: ProfileSpec; depth: NumberRef; holes?: ProfileSpec[]; transform?: TransformSpec }
  | { kind: "composed"; parts: FamilyGeometrySpec[] }
  | { kind: "custom"; builder: string };

export interface FamilyDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: FamilyCategory;
  /** IFC entity this family maps to on export. E.g. "IfcWall". */
  ifcEntity: string;
  /** Schema version for future migration. */
  schemaVersion: number;
  /** The element type in the current hardcoded system this family mirrors. */
  sourceElementType?: string;
  parameters: FamilyParameter[];
  geometry: FamilyGeometrySpec;
  types: FamilyType[];
  /** Optional grouping in the browser. */
  group?: string;
  /** Whether this family was shipped with the app. */
  builtIn: boolean;
}

export type CustomGeometryBuilder = (
  params: Record<string, any>,
  resolveNumber: (ref: NumberRef) => number,
  resolveTransform: (t: TransformSpec | undefined) => THREE.Object3D,
) => THREE.Object3D | null;

/** Public family service contract. */
export interface FamilyService {
  list(): FamilyDefinition[];
  get(id: string): FamilyDefinition | null;
  getByElementType(elementType: string): FamilyDefinition | null;

  create(def: Omit<FamilyDefinition, "id" | "schemaVersion" | "builtIn">): FamilyDefinition;
  update(id: string, patch: Partial<FamilyDefinition>): FamilyDefinition | null;
  remove(id: string): boolean;
  duplicate(id: string, newName: string): FamilyDefinition | null;

  createType(familyId: string, name: string, values?: Record<string, any>): FamilyType | null;
  updateType(familyId: string, typeId: string, patch: Partial<FamilyType>): FamilyType | null;
  removeType(familyId: string, typeId: string): boolean;

  resolveParams(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    overrides?: Record<string, any>,
  ): Record<string, any> | null;

  buildGeometry(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    overrides?: Record<string, any>,
  ): THREE.Object3D | null;

  registerCustomBuilder(name: string, fn: CustomGeometryBuilder): void;

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void;
  reset(): void;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Additive type extensions for the Revit-competitive parametric engine.
 * Import alongside ./types - does not break existing FamilyDefinition consumers.
 */

import type {
  FamilyGeometrySpec,
  NumberRef,
  ProfileSpec,
  TransformSpec,
} from "./types";
import type { Constraint } from "./constraint-graph";

/** Extended geometry kinds that the parametric engine understands. */
export type ExtendedGeometrySpec =
  | FamilyGeometrySpec
  | SweepSpec
  | RevolveSpec
  | LoftSpec
  | VoidSpec
  | ConditionalSpec
  | NestedSpec
  | ArrayGeomSpec;

export interface SweepSpec {
  kind: "sweep";
  profile: ProfileSpec;
  path: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef][];
  closed?: boolean;
  transform?: TransformSpec;
  visibleWhen?: string;
}

export interface RevolveSpec {
  kind: "revolve";
  profile: ProfileSpec;
  axis: "x" | "y" | "z";
  angle: NumberRef;
  segments?: number;
  transform?: TransformSpec;
  visibleWhen?: string;
}

export interface LoftSpec {
  kind: "loft";
  profiles: ProfileSpec[];
  segments?: number;
  transform?: TransformSpec;
  visibleWhen?: string;
}

export interface VoidSpec {
  kind: "void";
  solid: FamilyGeometrySpec;
  transform?: TransformSpec;
  visibleWhen?: string;
}

export interface ConditionalSpec {
  kind: "conditional";
  when: string;
  then: FamilyGeometrySpec | ExtendedGeometrySpec;
  else?: FamilyGeometrySpec | ExtendedGeometrySpec;
}

export interface NestedSpec {
  kind: "nested";
  familyId: string;
  typeId?: string;
  paramMap?: Record<string, NumberRef | string>;
  transform?: TransformSpec;
  visibleWhen?: string;
  shared?: boolean;
}

export interface ArrayGeomSpec {
  kind: "array";
  of: FamilyGeometrySpec | ExtendedGeometrySpec;
  count: NumberRef;
  step: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
  rotateStep?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
  visibleWhen?: string;
}

/**
 * Optional constraint set stored on a FamilyDefinition (via extension field).
 * Existing families without constraints continue to work unchanged.
 */
export interface FamilyConstraints {
  constraints?: Constraint[];
}

/**
 * Shared / project parameter definition (Revit Shared Parameter analogue).
 * Stored at project level; bound onto families by name.
 */
export interface SharedParameter {
  guid: string;
  name: string;
  type: import("./types").ParameterType;
  group: string;
  description?: string;
  /** When true, appears in schedules as a project parameter. */
  instance: boolean;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Federation manager.
 *
 * Single source of truth for how multiple loaded fragment models are
 * displayed. Applies transforms, colors, opacity and visibility through
 * the Fragments runtime.
 *
 * Reacts to:
 *   • fragments.list.onItemSet / onItemDeleted — auto-registers new models
 *   • project load — restores the persisted federation
 *
 * Emits:
 *   • "obs-federation-changed" on any mutation
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { diagnostics } from "../../core/diagnostics";
import { markDirty } from "../projects/projects";
import {
  DISCIPLINE_COLORS,
  type Discipline,
  type FederationEntry,
  type FederationState,
} from "./types";

const DISCIPLINE_GUESSERS: Array<{ re: RegExp; discipline: Discipline }> = [
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(arc|arch|architecture|architectural)/i,     discipline: "ARC" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(str|struct|structural|structure)/i,          discipline: "STR" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(mech|mechanical|hvac|supply|return)/i,       discipline: "MEP-M" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(elec|electrical|lighting|power)/i,           discipline: "MEP-E" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(plumb|plumbing|sanitary|domestic)/i,         discipline: "MEP-P" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(fire|sprinkler|suppression)/i,               discipline: "MEP-F" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(elv|ict|telecom|data|cctv|security|av)/i,    discipline: "ELV" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(fab|fabrication|steel|ductwork)/i,           discipline: "FAB" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(land|landscape|planting)/i,                  discipline: "LAND" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(site|topograph|topography)/i,                discipline: "SITE" },
  { re: /(^|[_\-\s])(civil|infra|infrastructure|road|rail)/i,     discipline: "CIVIL" },
];

export function guessDiscipline(name: string): Discipline {
  for (const g of DISCIPLINE_GUESSERS) {
    if (g.re.test(name)) return g.discipline;
  }
  return "OTHER";
}

class FederationManager {
  private entries = new Map<string, FederationEntry>();
  private isolated = new Set<string>();
  private strategy: FederationState["strategy"] = "discipline";
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private initialized = false;

  /* ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  init(): void {
    if (this.initialized) return;
    this.initialized = true;

    // Auto-register models that arrive after setup.
    try {
      ctx.fragments.list.onItemSet.add(({ key, value }: any) => {
        this.registerModel(String(key), this.nameFor(value) ?? String(key));
      });
      ctx.fragments.list.onItemDeleted.add((evt: any) => {
        const key = typeof evt === "object" && evt !== null && "key" in evt ? evt.key : evt;
        this.entries.delete(String(key));
        this.isolated.delete(String(key));
        this.emit();
      });
    } catch (err) {
      diagnostics.warn("federation.init", "listener attach failed", err);
    }

    // Boot: scan current models.
    try {
      for (const [id, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
        this.registerModel(String(id), this.nameFor(model) ?? String(id));
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    console.log(`[federation] ready · ${this.entries.size} model(s)`);
  }

  private nameFor(model: any): string | null {
    return model?.name ?? model?.modelName ?? null;
  }

  /* ── Mutation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  registerModel(modelId: string, name: string): FederationEntry {
    const existing = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (existing) return existing;

    const discipline = guessDiscipline(name);
    const entry: FederationEntry = {
      modelId,
      name,
      discipline,
      transform: null,
      priority: this.entries.size,
      visible: true,
      opacity: 1,
      addedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.entries.set(modelId, entry);
    this.applyEntry(entry);
    this.emit();
    return entry;
  }

  unregisterModel(modelId: string): void {
    if (this.entries.delete(modelId)) {
      this.isolated.delete(modelId);
      this.emit();
    }
  }

  setDiscipline(modelId: string, discipline: Discipline): void {
    const e = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (!e) return;
    e.discipline = discipline;
    this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
    markDirty();
  }

  setColor(modelId: string, color: string | null): void {
    const e = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (!e) return;
    e.color = color ?? undefined;
    this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
    markDirty();
  }

  setVisible(modelId: string, visible: boolean): void {
    const e = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (!e) return;
    e.visible = visible;
    this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
    markDirty();
  }

  setOpacity(modelId: string, opacity: number): void {
    const e = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (!e) return;
    e.opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, opacity));
    this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
    markDirty();
  }

  setPriority(modelId: string, priority: number): void {
    const e = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (!e) return;
    e.priority = priority;
    this.applyOrdering();
    this.emit();
    markDirty();
  }

  setTransform(modelId: string, transform: number[] | null): void {
    const e = this.entries.get(modelId);
    if (!e) return;
    e.transform = transform ? [...transform] : null;
    this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
    markDirty();
  }

  resetTransform(modelId: string): void {
    this.setTransform(modelId, null);
  }

  /** Align two models by their AABB centers. */
  alignToModel(sourceId: string, targetId: string): void {
    const src = ctx.fragments.list.get(sourceId) as any;
    const tgt = ctx.fragments.list.get(targetId) as any;
    if (!src || !tgt) return;
    const b1 = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(src.object);
    const b2 = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(tgt.object);
    if (b1.isEmpty() || b2.isEmpty()) return;
    const c1 = b1.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
    const c2 = b2.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
    const dx = c2.x - c1.x, dy = c2.y - c1.y, dz = c2.z - c1.z;
    const m = new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(dx, dy, dz);
    this.setTransform(sourceId, Array.from(m.elements));
  }

  setStrategy(strategy: FederationState["strategy"]): void {
    this.strategy = strategy;
    for (const e of this.entries.values()) this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
  }

  isolate(modelIds: string[]): void {
    this.isolated = new Set(modelIds);
    for (const e of this.entries.values()) this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
  }

  clearIsolation(): void {
    this.isolated.clear();
    for (const e of this.entries.values()) this.applyEntry(e);
    this.emit();
  }

  /* ── Apply to scene ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  private applyEntry(e: FederationEntry): void {
    const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(e.modelId) as any;
    if (!model?.object) return;
    const obj = model.object as THREE.Object3D;

    // Visibility
    obj.visible = e.visible &&
      (this.isolated.size === 0 || this.isolated.has(e.modelId));

    // Transform
    if (e.transform) {
      const m = new THREE.Matrix4().fromArray(e.transform);
      obj.matrixAutoUpdate = false;
      obj.matrix.copy(m);
      obj.matrix.decompose(obj.position, obj.quaternion, obj.scale);
    } else {
      obj.matrixAutoUpdate = true;
    }

    // Colour strategy
    const targetColor = this.pickColor(e);
    if (this.strategy === "discipline" || this.strategy === "model") {
      applyColorToModel(model, targetColor, e.opacity);
    } else {
      applyColorToModel(model, null, e.opacity);
    }
  }

  private pickColor(e: FederationEntry): string | null {
    if (this.strategy === "neutral") return null;
    if (e.color) return e.color;
    if (this.strategy === "discipline") return DISCIPLINE_COLORS[e.discipline];
    // model strategy — deterministic hash-based
    return hashColor(e.modelId);
  }

  private applyOrdering(): void {
    const sorted = [...this.entries.values()].sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
    for (const e of sorted) {
      const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(e.modelId) as any;
      if (!model?.object) continue;
      ctx.world.scene.three.remove(model.object);
      ctx.world.scene.three.add(model.object);
    }
  }

  /* ── Serialization ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  serialize(): FederationState {
    return {
      entries: [...this.entries.values()].map((e) => ({
        ...e,
        transform: e.transform ? [...e.transform] : null,
      })),
      isolated: [...this.isolated],
      strategy: this.strategy,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  deserialize(state: FederationState | null | undefined): void {
    if (!state) return;
    this.entries.clear();
    this.isolated = new Set(state.isolated ?? []);
    this.strategy = state.strategy ?? "discipline";
    for (const e of state.entries ?? []) {
      this.entries.set(e.modelId, { ...e });
    }
    // Reapply to any model currently loaded.
    for (const [id, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      if (!this.entries.has(String(id))) {
        this.registerModel(String(id), this.nameFor(model) ?? String(id));
      }
    }
    for (const e of this.entries.values()) this.applyEntry(e);
    this.applyOrdering();
    this.emit();
  }

  /* ── Queries + events ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

  list(): FederationEntry[] {
    return [...this.entries.values()].sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
  }

  get(modelId: string): FederationEntry | null {
    return this.entries.get(modelId) ?? null;
  }

  getIsolated(): string[] { return [...this.isolated]; }

  getStrategy(): FederationState["strategy"] { return this.strategy; }

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-federation-changed"));
    } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

/* ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function hashColor(seed: string): string {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) {
    h ^= seed.charCodeAt(i);
    h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
  }
  const hue = h % 360;
  return hslToHex(hue, 45, 65);
}

function hslToHex(h: number, s: number, l: number): string {
  s /= 100; l /= 100;
  const k = (n: number) => (n + h / 30) % 12;
  const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
  const f = (n: number) => l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k(n) - 3, Math.min(9 - k(n), 1)));
  const toHex = (v: number) => Math.round(v * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  return `#${toHex(f(0))}${toHex(f(8))}${toHex(f(4))}`;
}

/**
 * Apply a global colour and opacity to every material of a fragment model.
 * The fragments runtime stores a per-material handle; overriding at the
 * object level is safe because fragment materials are shared per model.
 */
function applyColorToModel(model: any, color: string | null, opacity: number): void {
  const obj: THREE.Object3D | undefined = model?.object;
  if (!obj) return;
  const tint = color ? new THREE.Color(color) : null;

  obj.traverse((child: any) => {
    if (!child.isMesh && !child.isPoints && !child.isLine) return;
    const mats = Array.isArray(child.material) ? child.material : [child.material];
    for (const m of mats) {
      if (!m) continue;
      if (!m.userData.__obsFedOrig) {
        m.userData.__obsFedOrig = {
          color: m.color ? m.color.getHex() : null,
          opacity: m.opacity,
          transparent: m.transparent,
        };
      }
      const orig = m.userData.__obsFedOrig;
      if (tint && m.color) m.color.copy(tint);
      else if (!tint && m.color && orig.color != null) m.color.setHex(orig.color);

      if (opacity < 1) {
        m.transparent = true;
        m.opacity = opacity;
      } else {
        m.opacity = orig.opacity;
        m.transparent = orig.transparent;
      }
      m.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  });
}

export const federation = new FederationManager();
```

```ts
/**
 * Federation persistence — lives inside the current project document so a
 * project reload restores the federation exactly as the user left it.
 */
import type { FederationState } from "./types";

const KEY = "obs.federation.v1";

/** Session-level fallback when no project is active. */
let sessionCache: FederationState | null = null;

export function saveFederationState(state: FederationState | null): void {
  sessionCache = state;
  try {
    if (state) {
      localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export function loadFederationState(): FederationState | null {
  if (sessionCache) return sessionCache;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as FederationState;
    if (!parsed?.entries || !Array.isArray(parsed.entries)) return null;
    sessionCache = parsed;
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Federation types.
 *
 * A Federation is an ordered list of loaded models with:
 *   • a discipline tag (ARC, STR, MEP-M, MEP-E, …)
 *   • a display colour
 *   • a transform override (to fix shared-coordinate drift)
 *   • a priority (affects render order / greying)
 *
 * The federation is persisted with the project; reloading a project restores
 * the federation tree, colours, and transforms.
 */

export type Discipline =
  | "ARC"
  | "STR"
  | "MEP-M"    // mechanical
  | "MEP-E"    // electrical
  | "MEP-P"    // plumbing
  | "MEP-F"    // fire
  | "ELV"      // low voltage / ICT
  | "FAB"      // fabrication
  | "LAND"     // landscape
  | "SITE"
  | "CIVIL"
  | "OTHER";

export const DISCIPLINES: Discipline[] = [
  "ARC", "STR", "MEP-M", "MEP-E", "MEP-P", "MEP-F", "ELV",
  "FAB", "LAND", "SITE", "CIVIL", "OTHER",
];

export const DISCIPLINE_COLORS: Record<Discipline, string> = {
  ARC:      "#cbd5e1",
  STR:      "#8ea3b8",
  "MEP-M":  "#38bdf8",
  "MEP-E":  "#f59e0b",
  "MEP-P":  "#22c55e",
  "MEP-F":  "#ef4444",
  ELV:      "#a855f7",
  FAB:      "#c084fc",
  LAND:     "#84cc16",
  SITE:     "#94a3b8",
  CIVIL:    "#f97316",
  OTHER:    "#6b7280",
};

export const DISCIPLINE_LABELS: Record<Discipline, string> = {
  ARC:      "Architecture",
  STR:      "Structure",
  "MEP-M":  "MEP · Mechanical",
  "MEP-E":  "MEP · Electrical",
  "MEP-P":  "MEP · Plumbing",
  "MEP-F":  "MEP · Fire",
  ELV:      "ELV / ICT",
  FAB:      "Fabrication",
  LAND:     "Landscape",
  SITE:     "Site",
  CIVIL:    "Civil",
  OTHER:    "Other",
};

export interface FederationEntry {
  modelId: string;
  /** Original file name. */
  name: string;
  discipline: Discipline;
  /** Colour override. Falls back to DISCIPLINE_COLORS[discipline]. */
  color?: string;
  /** 4×4 column-major transform. null → identity. */
  transform: number[] | null;
  /** Render priority; higher = drawn last / on top. */
  priority: number;
  /** Layer visibility toggle. */
  visible: boolean;
  /** Transparency: 0 = opaque, 1 = fully transparent. */
  opacity: number;
  /** Optional description shown in the tree. */
  description?: string;
  /** Added timestamp for stable ordering. */
  addedAt: number;
}

export interface FederationState {
  entries: FederationEntry[];
  /** Currently active isolate-set (model IDs). Empty = show all. */
  isolated: string[];
  /** Colour strategy. */
  strategy: "discipline" | "model" | "neutral";
  updatedAt: number;
}

export interface FederationDraft {
  modelId: string;
  name: string;
  discipline?: Discipline;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * World-space AABB helper for Fragments models.
 *
 * The SDK's `model.getBoxes()` does not consistently return boxes in the
 * same coordinate system that Three.js renders. Depending on the SDK
 * version and on whether the autoCoordinator (or our positioning logic)
 * has moved the model, `getBoxes()` may return:
 *
 *   - local geometry space (untransformed), or
 *   - world space (already aligned), or
 *   - some intermediate space if a coordination matrix is applied only
 *     during rendering.
 *
 * Solution: use the rendered scene graph as ground truth.
 *   visualBox = Box3.setFromObject(model.object)
 * is exactly what Three.js uses to place geometry on screen. We compare
 * the aggregate of the raw boxes to `visualBox` and derive the correct
 * transform by detection, not by assumption.
 *
 * Robustness notes:
 *   • getBoxes() is called in chunks of 5000. A single call with 100k+ ids
 *     can fail (worker message limit, timeout, or SDK-specific caps) and
 *     silently return fewer boxes than requested.
 *   • Any chunk failure is logged. Partial results are still used; only
 *     a total wipeout returns [].
 *   • All SDK calls are wrapped. When the worker no longer has the model,
 *     we log once and return an empty result instead of throwing
 *     "Fragments: Model not found" into the console forever.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export interface WorldBox {
  id: number;
  box: THREE.Box3;
  center: THREE.Vector3;
}

const NOT_FOUND = /Fragments\s*:?\s*Model not found/i;
const pruned = new Set<string>();

/** Chunk size for getBoxes calls. 5,000 keeps every worker message small. */
const BOX_CHUNK = 5000;

function isNotFound(err: unknown): boolean {
  const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err ?? "");
  return NOT_FOUND.test(msg);
}

function pruneStale(modelId: string): void {
  if (!modelId || modelId === "?") return;
  if (pruned.has(modelId)) return;
  pruned.add(modelId);
  console.warn(
    `[world-box] pruning stale model "${modelId}" — worker no longer has it`,
  );
  try {
    (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(modelId);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    if (ctx.fragments.list.has(modelId)) {
      (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(modelId);
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/**
 * Read the world-space boxes of a set of elements.
 *
 * @param model   A `FragmentsModel` (has `.object` and `.getBoxes()`).
 * @param ids     Local fragment ids.
 * @param modelId Optional. When omitted, we try `model.modelId`, then
 *                `model.id`. Used to prune stale entries when the worker
 *                rejects the request.
 */
export async function getElementWorldBoxes(
  model: any,
  ids: number[],
  modelId?: string,
): Promise<WorldBox[]> {
  if (!model || !ids?.length) return [];

  const mid: string =
    modelId ?? (model as any)?.modelId ?? (model as any)?.id ?? "?";

  try {
    model.object?.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // ── 1. Raw boxes from the SDK — chunked to survive large models ──
  const slots: (THREE.Box3 | null)[] = new Array(ids.length).fill(null);
  let chunkFailures = 0;
  let firstError: unknown = null;

  for (let start = 0; start < ids.length; start += BOX_CHUNK) {
    const end = Math.min(start + BOX_CHUNK, ids.length);
    const slice = ids.slice(start, end);
    let boxes: any;
    try {
      boxes = await model.getBoxes(slice);
    } catch (err) {
      if (isNotFound(err)) {
        pruneStale(mid);
        return [];
      }
      chunkFailures++;
      if (!firstError) firstError = err;
      console.error(
        `[world-box] getBoxes failed · model "${mid}" · ` +
          `chunk ${start}..${end} (${slice.length} id(s)):`,
        err,
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(boxes)) {
      chunkFailures++;
      if (!firstError) firstError = new Error(`getBoxes returned ${typeof boxes}`);
      console.warn(
        `[world-box] getBoxes returned non-array · model "${mid}" · chunk ${start}`,
      );
      continue;
    }
    const n = Math.min(slice.length, boxes.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const b = boxes[i];
      if (b && b.isBox3 !== false) slots[start + i] = b;
    }
    if (boxes.length < slice.length) {
      console.warn(
        `[world-box] getBoxes returned ${boxes.length} of ${slice.length} ` +
          `boxes · model "${mid}" · chunk ${start}`,
      );
    }
  }

  if (chunkFailures > 0) {
    console.warn(
      `[world-box] model "${mid}": ${chunkFailures} chunk(s) failed. ` +
        `First error: ${firstError instanceof Error ? firstError.message : firstError}`,
    );
  }

  // Compact down to ids that actually got a box.
  const alignedIds: number[] = [];
  const alignedBoxes: THREE.Box3[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    const b = slots[i];
    if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
      alignedIds.push(ids[i]);
      alignedBoxes.push(b);
    }
  }

  if (!alignedBoxes.length) {
    console.warn(
      `[world-box] model "${mid}": no boxes returned for ${ids.length} id(s) — ` +
        `the model will contribute nothing to any spatial query`,
    );
    return [];
  }

  // ── 2. Aggregate of all raw boxes ──
  const rawAgg = new THREE.Box3();
  for (const b of alignedBoxes) rawAgg.union(b);
  if (rawAgg.isEmpty()) return [];

  // ── 3. Visual box — the ground truth ──
  let visualBox = new THREE.Box3();
  try {
    visualBox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model.object);
  } catch {
    visualBox = new THREE.Box3();
  }

  // ── 4. Decide the transform by detection ──
  let resolved: THREE.Box3[];

  if (visualBox.isEmpty()) {
    const mw: THREE.Matrix4 =
      model.object?.matrixWorld?.clone?.() ?? new THREE.Matrix4();
    resolved = alignedBoxes.map((b) => b.clone().applyMatrix4(mw));
  } else {
    const rawCenter = rawAgg.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
    const visCenter = visualBox.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
    const gap = rawCenter.distanceTo(visCenter);

    const rawSize = new THREE.Vector3();
    const visSize = new THREE.Vector3();
    rawAgg.getSize(rawSize);
    visualBox.getSize(visSize);
    const sizeDiff =
      Math.abs(rawSize.x - visSize.x) +
      Math.abs(rawSize.y - visSize.y) +
      Math.abs(rawSize.z - visSize.z);
    const referenceSize = Math.max(rawSize.length(), visSize.length(), 0.001);

    if (gap < 0.05) {
      // Raw boxes already match the rendered position — no transform.
      resolved = alignedBoxes.map((b) => b.clone());
    } else if (sizeDiff < referenceSize * 0.05) {
      // Same size, different position: pure translation.
      const delta = visCenter.clone().sub(rawCenter);
      resolved = alignedBoxes.map((b) => b.clone().translate(delta));
    } else {
      // Sizes differ — rotation or scale is involved. Use matrixWorld.
      const mw: THREE.Matrix4 =
        model.object?.matrixWorld?.clone?.() ?? new THREE.Matrix4();
      resolved = alignedBoxes.map((b) => b.clone().applyMatrix4(mw));
    }
  }

  // ── 5. Emit per-id ──
  const out: WorldBox[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < alignedIds.length; i++) {
    const b = resolved[i];
    if (!b || b.isEmpty()) continue;
    out.push({
      id: alignedIds[i],
      box: b,
      center: b.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()),
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Convenience: a single element's world box. */
export async function getElementWorldBox(
  model: any,
  id: number,
  modelId?: string,
): Promise<THREE.Box3 | null> {
  const r = await getElementWorldBoxes(model, [id], modelId);
  return r[0]?.box ?? null;
}

/** Reset the pruned-model tracking (call after a successful model load). */
export function clearPrunedCache(): void {
  pruned.clear();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Model Groups - Revit-style element groups.
 *
 * A group is a named set of authored element ids. Editing one instance
 * can optionally propagate to all instances of the same group type
 * (shared group behaviour).
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export type GroupId = string;
export type GroupTypeId = string;

export interface GroupType {
  id: GroupTypeId;
  name: string;
  /** Canonical member element ids (template). */
  memberIds: string[];
  /** When true, edits to any instance update the type. */
  shared: boolean;
}

export interface GroupInstance {
  id: GroupId;
  typeId: GroupTypeId;
  name: string;
  /** Element ids belonging to this instance. */
  memberIds: string[];
  /** Origin offset applied when placing additional instances. */
  origin: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  phaseId?: string | null;
  designOptionId?: string | null;
}

const STORAGE = "obs.groups.v1";
type Listener = () => void;

function uid(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

class GroupsStore {
  private types = new Map<GroupTypeId, GroupType>();
  private instances = new Map<GroupId, GroupInstance>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
      if (raw) {
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        for (const t of data.types ?? []) this.types.set(t.id, t);
        for (const i of data.instances ?? []) this.instances.set(i.id, i);
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE,
        JSON.stringify({
          types: [...this.types.values()],
          instances: [...this.instances.values()],
        }),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  listTypes(): GroupType[] {
    return [...this.types.values()];
  }

  listInstances(): GroupInstance[] {
    return [...this.instances.values()];
  }

  getType(id: GroupTypeId): GroupType | null {
    return this.types.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  getInstance(id: GroupId): GroupInstance | null {
    return this.instances.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  /** Create a group type + first instance from a selection of element ids. */
  createFromSelection(
    name: string,
    memberIds: string[],
    shared = true,
  ): { type: GroupType; instance: GroupInstance } | null {
    if (!memberIds.length) return null;
    const type: GroupType = {
      id: uid("gtype"),
      name,
      memberIds: [...memberIds],
      shared,
    };
    const instance: GroupInstance = {
      id: uid("ginst"),
      typeId: type.id,
      name: `${name} 1`,
      memberIds: [...memberIds],
      origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
    };
    this.types.set(type.id, type);
    this.instances.set(instance.id, instance);
    this.persist();
    return { type, instance };
  }

  /** Place another instance of an existing group type (empty members - authoring fills geometry). */
  placeInstance(
    typeId: GroupTypeId,
    origin: { x: number; y: number; z: number },
    memberIds: string[] = [],
  ): GroupInstance | null {
    const type = this.types.get(typeId);
    if (!type) return null;
    const count = [...this.instances.values()].filter((i) => i.typeId === typeId).length;
    const instance: GroupInstance = {
      id: uid("ginst"),
      typeId,
      name: `${type.name} ${count + 1}`,
      memberIds: memberIds.length ? memberIds : [],
      origin: { ...origin },
    };
    this.instances.set(instance.id, instance);
    this.persist();
    return instance;
  }

  /** Ungroup: remove instance, keep members in the model. */
  ungroup(instanceId: GroupId): string[] {
    const inst = this.instances.get(instanceId);
    if (!inst) return [];
    const members = [...inst.memberIds];
    this.instances.delete(instanceId);
    // Drop type if no instances remain
    const remaining = [...this.instances.values()].filter((i) => i.typeId === inst.typeId);
    if (!remaining.length) this.types.delete(inst.typeId);
    this.persist();
    return members;
  }

  removeInstance(id: GroupId): boolean {
    const ok = this.instances.delete(id);
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  /** Find which group instance owns an element (if any). */
  findOwner(elementId: string): GroupInstance | null {
    for (const inst of this.instances.values()) {
      if (inst.memberIds.includes(elementId)) return inst;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** All element ids belonging to any group. */
  allGroupedIds(): Set<string> {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const inst of this.instances.values()) {
      for (const id of inst.memberIds) set.add(id);
    }
    return set;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.types.clear();
    this.instances.clear();
    this.persist();
  }
}

export const groupsStore = new GroupsStore();

export function setupGroups(): typeof groupsStore {
  groupsStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).groups = groupsStore;
  (window as any).__obsGroups = groupsStore;
  console.log(
    "[groups] ready -",
    groupsStore.listTypes().length,
    "types,",
    groupsStore.listInstances().length,
    "instances",
  );
  return groupsStore;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * BCF 2.1 / 3.0 export and import (JSZip).
 *
 * Emits the full Viewpoint schema:
 *   - PerspectiveCamera OR OrthographicCamera (auto-selected from view state)
 *   - CameraUpVector
 *   - Components / Selection / Visibility (IfcGuid-keyed)
 *   - ClippingPlanes
 *   - Snapshot
 *
 * ProjectExtension (project.bcfp) is written when a project is open.
 *
 * Import parses markup.bcf, viewpoint.bcfv (both camera types), Components,
 * and ClippingPlanes. Local fragment IDs are resolved from IfcGuids via a
 * per-model GUID → localId map built lazily and cached.
 */
import JSZip from "jszip";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import type {
  ClippingPlaneState,
  Issue,
  IssueComment,
  IssuePriority,
  IssueStatus,
  IssueViewpoint,
} from "./types";
import { getIssues, setIssues } from "./issues";

const xmlEsc = (s: string) =>
  String(s ?? "").replace(
    /[&<>"']/g,
    (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c],
  );
const guid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ??
  `g-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
const iso = (t: number) => new Date(t || Date.now()).toISOString();
const v = (x: number) => (Number.isFinite(x) ? x.toFixed(6) : "0");

const STATUS_OUT: Record<IssueStatus, string> = {
  open: "Open",
  active: "In Progress",
  resolved: "Resolved",
  closed: "Closed",
};
const PRIORITY_OUT: Record<IssuePriority, string> = {
  low: "Low",
  medium: "Medium",
  high: "High",
};

function statusIn(s?: string | null): IssueStatus {
  const val = (s ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (val.includes("progress") || val.includes("active")) return "active";
  if (val.includes("resolv")) return "resolved";
  if (val.includes("clos")) return "closed";
  return "open";
}
function priorityIn(s?: string | null): IssuePriority {
  const val = (s ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (val.includes("high") || val.includes("critical")) return "high";
  if (val.includes("low")) return "low";
  return "medium";
}

// ── base64 helpers ──
function dataUrlToBytes(dataUrl: string): Uint8Array {
  const b64 = dataUrl.split(",")[1] ?? "";
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}
function bytesToDataUrl(bytes: Uint8Array, mime = "image/png"): string {
  let bin = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) bin += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  return `data:${mime};base64,${btoa(bin)}`;
}

// ── GUID ↔ localId maps (lazy, per model) ──
const guidCache = new Map<string, Map<number, string>>(); // modelId → (localId → guid)
const guidRevCache = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>(); // modelId → (guid → localId)

async function buildGuidMap(modelId: string): Promise<Map<number, string>> {
  if (guidCache.has(modelId)) return guidCache.get(modelId)!;
  const out = new Map<number, string>();
  const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) {
    guidCache.set(modelId, out);
    guidRevCache.set(modelId, new Map());
    return out;
  }
  try {
    const ids = (await (model as any).getItemsIdsWithGeometry()) as number[];
    if (ids?.length) {
      // Batch read GlobalId / Tag
      const data = await (model as any).getItemsData(ids, {
        attributesDefault: false,
        attributes: ["GlobalId", "Tag"],
      });
      for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        const g =
          (data as any)?.[i]?.GlobalId?.value ?? (data as any)?.[i]?.Tag?.value;
        if (typeof g === "string" && g.length) out.set(ids[i], g);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const rev = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const [id, g] of out) rev.set(g, id);
  guidCache.set(modelId, out);
  guidRevCache.set(modelId, rev);
  return out;
}

async function resolveGuids(
  map: Record<string, number[]> | undefined,
): Promise<Record<string, string[]>> {
  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  if (!map) return out;
  for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(map)) {
    const gm = await buildGuidMap(modelId);
    const guids: string[] = [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      const g = gm.get(id);
      if (g) guids.push(g);
    }
    if (guids.length) out[modelId] = guids;
  }
  return out;
}

function guidToLocal(modelId: string, guids: string[]): number[] {
  const rev = guidRevCache.get(modelId);
  if (!rev) return [];
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const g of guids) {
    const local = rev.get(g);
    if (typeof local === "number") out.push(local);
  }
  return out;
}

// ── XML: viewpoint ──
function viewpointXml(vp: IssueViewpoint, vpGuid: string): string {
  const pos = new THREE.Vector3(...vp.cam);
  const tgt = new THREE.Vector3(...vp.target);
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(tgt, pos).normalize();
  const up = vp.up
    ? new THREE.Vector3(...vp.up).normalize()
    : new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const dist = pos.distanceTo(tgt);

  const cameraXml =
    vp.projection === "orthographic"
      ? `<OrthographicCamera>
<CameraViewPoint><X>${v(pos.x)}</X><Y>${v(pos.y)}</Y><Z>${v(pos.z)}</Z></CameraViewPoint>
<CameraDirection><X>${v(dir.x)}</X><Y>${v(dir.y)}</Y><Z>${v(dir.z)}</Z></CameraDirection>
<CameraUpVector><X>${v(up.x)}</X><Y>${v(up.y)}</Y><Z>${v(up.z)}</Z></CameraUpVector>
<ViewToWorldScale>${v(vp.orthoScale ?? dist)}</ViewToWorldScale>
</OrthographicCamera>`
      : `<PerspectiveCamera>
<CameraViewPoint><X>${v(pos.x)}</X><Y>${v(pos.y)}</Y><Z>${v(pos.z)}</Z></CameraViewPoint>
<CameraDirection><X>${v(dir.x)}</X><Y>${v(dir.y)}</Y><Z>${v(dir.z)}</Z></CameraDirection>
<CameraUpVector><X>${v(up.x)}</X><Y>${v(up.y)}</Y><Z>${v(up.z)}</Z></CameraUpVector>
<FieldOfView>60</FieldOfView>
<TargetDistance>${v(dist)}</TargetDistance>
</PerspectiveCamera>`;

  // Components / Selection — GUIDs filled by caller before serialization.
  const componentsXml = (vp as any)._bcfComponentsXml ?? "";

  const clippingXml =
    vp.clippingPlanes?.length
      ? `<ClippingPlanes>${vp.clippingPlanes
          .map(
            (p) =>
              `<ClippingPlane><Location><X>${v(p.location[0])}</X><Y>${v(
                p.location[1],
              )}</Y><Z>${v(p.location[2])}</Z></Location><Direction><X>${v(
                p.direction[0],
              )}</X><Y>${v(p.direction[1])}</Y><Z>${v(
                p.direction[2],
              )}</Z></Direction></ClippingPlane>`,
          )
          .join("")}</ClippingPlanes>`
      : "";

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<VisualizationInfo Guid="${vpGuid}" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
${cameraXml}
${clippingXml}
${componentsXml}
<Snapshot><SnapshotType>png</SnapshotType></Snapshot>
</VisualizationInfo>`;
}

// ── Export ──
export async function exportBCF(
  issueList: Issue[] = getIssues(),
  fileName?: string,
) {
  if (!issueList.length) {
    alert("No issues to export.");
    return;
  }
  const zip = new JSZip();
  zip.file(
    "bcf.version",
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Version VersionId="2.1" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"/>`,
  );

  // Project extension (optional but improves compatibility)
  try {
    const { getCurrentProject } = await import("../projects/projects");
    const proj = getCurrentProject();
    if (proj) {
      zip.file(
        "project.bcfp",
        `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ProjectExtension Guid="${proj.id}" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <Project ProjectId="${xmlEsc(proj.id)}"/>
  <ExtensionSchema>OpenBIMStudio-BCF-3.0</ExtensionSchema>
</ProjectExtension>`,
      );
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  for (const issue of issueList) {
    const folder = zip.folder(issue.id)!;
    const vpGuid = guid();

    // Prepare selection GUIDs for the viewpoint
    const selectionGuids = await resolveGuids(issue.viewpoint.selection);
    let componentsXml = "";
    if (Object.keys(selectionGuids).length) {
      const allGuids: string[] = [];
      for (const arr of Object.values(selectionGuids)) for (const g of arr) allGuids.push(g);
      if (allGuids.length) {
        componentsXml =
          `<Components><Selection>` +
          allGuids
            .map((g) => `<Component IfcGuid="${xmlEsc(g)}"/>`)
            .join("") +
          `</Selection><Visibility DefaultVisibility="true"/></Components>`;
      }
    }
    (issue.viewpoint as any)._bcfComponentsXml = componentsXml;

    // markup.bcf (Topic + Comments)
    const prioAttr = ` Priority="${PRIORITY_OUT[issue.priority] ?? "Medium"}"`;
    const assigneeAttr = issue.assignee
      ? ` AssignedTo="${xmlEsc(issue.assignee)}"`
      : "";
    const dueAttr = issue.dueDate
      ? ` DueDate="${iso(issue.dueDate)}"`
      : "";

    let markup = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Markup xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
<Topic Guid="${issue.id}" TopicType="Issue" TopicStatus="${xmlEsc(
      STATUS_OUT[issue.status] ?? issue.status,
    )}"${prioAttr}${assigneeAttr}${dueAttr} Title="${xmlEsc(
      issue.title,
    )}" CreationDate="${iso(issue.createdAt)}" ModifiedDate="${iso(
      issue.updatedAt,
    )}" Author="${xmlEsc(issue.author)}">
<DescriptionText>${xmlEsc(issue.description ?? "")}</DescriptionText>
</Topic>
`;
    for (const c of issue.comments) {
      markup += `<Comment Guid="${c.id}" Date="${iso(c.date)}" Author="${xmlEsc(
        c.author,
      )}"><Text>${xmlEsc(c.text)}</Text></Comment>\n`;
    }
    markup += `</Markup>`;
    folder.file("markup.bcf", markup);

    // viewpoint.bcfv
    folder.file("viewpoint.bcfv", viewpointXml(issue.viewpoint, vpGuid));

    // snapshot.png
    if (issue.viewpoint.thumbnail) {
      folder.file("snapshot.png", dataUrlToBytes(issue.viewpoint.thumbnail));
    }
    delete (issue.viewpoint as any)._bcfComponentsXml;
  }

  const blob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = fileName ?? "open-bim-studio-issues.bcfzip";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
}

// ── Import ──
function parseVec(el: Element | null, tag: string): THREE.Vector3 {
  const t = el?.querySelector(tag);
  return new THREE.Vector3(
    parseFloat(t?.querySelector("X")?.textContent ?? "0"),
    parseFloat(t?.querySelector("Y")?.textContent ?? "0"),
    parseFloat(t?.querySelector("Z")?.textContent ?? "0"),
  );
}

function parseComponents(
  vis: Element | null,
): { selection: Record<string, string[]>; hidden: Record<string, string[]> } {
  const selection: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const hidden: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  if (!vis) return { selection, hidden };

  const readGuids = (root: Element | null): string[] => {
    if (!root) return [];
    return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("Component"))
      .map((c) => c.getAttribute("IfcGuid") ?? "")
      .filter(Boolean);
  };

  const selComp = vis.querySelector("Components > Selection");
  if (selComp) {
    // All guids go into a synthetic bucket — we resolve them to models below.
    selection["__bcf__"] = readGuids(selComp);
  }
  const visRoot = vis.querySelector("Components > Visibility");
  if (visRoot) {
    const def = visRoot.getAttribute("DefaultVisibility");
    if (def === "true") {
      // Exceptions = hidden
      hidden["__bcf__"] = readGuids(visRoot.querySelector("Exceptions"));
    } else {
      // Exceptions = visible (isolated) — treat as selection
      const visIds = readGuids(visRoot.querySelector("Exceptions"));
      if (visIds.length && !selection["__bcf__"]) selection["__bcf__"] = visIds;
    }
  }
  return { selection, hidden };
}

/**
 * Resolve a flat list of GUIDs to per-model localIds by scanning every loaded
 * model's GUID map. Populates the caches as a side effect.
 */
async function resolveGuidsToModels(
  guids: string[],
): Promise<Record<string, number[]>> {
  const out: Record<string, number[]> = {};
  if (!guids.length) return out;
  const remaining = new Set(guids);

  for (const [modelId] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    const gm = await buildGuidMap(modelId);
    const rev = guidRevCache.get(modelId)!;
    const locals: number[] = [];
    for (const g of Array.from(remaining)) {
      const id = rev.get(g);
      if (typeof id === "number") {
        locals.push(id);
        remaining.delete(g);
      }
    }
    if (locals.length) out[modelId] = locals;
    if (!remaining.size) break;
  }
  return out;
}

export async function importBCF(file: File): Promise<number> {
  const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(file);
  const imported: Issue[] = [];
  const existing = new Set(getIssues().map((i) => i.id));

  const markupPaths: string[] = [];
  zip.forEach((path) => {
    if (/markup\.bcf$/i.test(path)) markupPaths.push(path);
  });
  if (!markupPaths.length) {
    alert("No markup.bcf found in this BCF file.");
    return 0;
  }

  for (const path of markupPaths) {
    const folder = path.split("/")[0];
    try {
      const markupXml = await zip.file(path)!.async("string");
      const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(markupXml, "text/xml");
      const topic = doc.querySelector("Topic");
      if (!topic) continue;

      let id = topic.getAttribute("Guid") || folder;
      while (existing.has(id)) id = guid();
      existing.add(id);

      // ── Viewpoint ──
      let viewpoint: IssueViewpoint = {
        cam: [0, 10, 10],
        target: [0, 0, 0],
        projection: "perspective",
      };
      const vpFile = zip.file(`${folder}/viewpoint.bcfv`);
      if (vpFile) {
        const vdoc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
          await vpFile.async("string"),
          "text/xml",
        );
        const vis = vdoc.querySelector("VisualizationInfo");

        const persp = vis?.querySelector("PerspectiveCamera");
        const ortho = vis?.querySelector("OrthographicCamera");
        const camEl = persp ?? ortho;
        if (camEl) {
          const pos = parseVec(camEl, "CameraViewPoint");
          const dir = parseVec(camEl, "CameraDirection").normalize();
          const up = parseVec(camEl, "CameraUpVector");
          const distRaw = camEl.querySelector("TargetDistance")?.textContent;
          const scaleRaw = camEl.querySelector("ViewToWorldScale")?.textContent;
          const dist = Math.max(
            parseFloat(distRaw ?? scaleRaw ?? "10") || 10,
            0.5,
          );
          const tgt = pos.clone().add(dir.multiplyScalar(dist));
          viewpoint = {
            cam: [pos.x, pos.y, pos.z],
            target: [tgt.x, tgt.y, tgt.z],
            up: [up.x || 0, up.y || 1, up.z || 0],
            projection: ortho ? "orthographic" : "perspective",
          };
          if (ortho && scaleRaw) {
            viewpoint.orthoScale = Math.max(parseFloat(scaleRaw) || dist, 0.001);
          }
        }

        // Components
        const { selection, hidden } = parseComponents(vis);
        const selGuids = selection["__bcf__"] ?? [];
        const hidGuids = hidden["__bcf__"] ?? [];
        if (selGuids.length) {
          const resolved = await resolveGuidsToModels(selGuids);
          if (Object.keys(resolved).length) viewpoint.selection = resolved;
        }
        if (hidGuids.length) {
          const resolved = await resolveGuidsToModels(hidGuids);
          if (Object.keys(resolved).length) viewpoint.hidden = resolved;
        }

        // Clipping planes
        const planeEls = Array.from(
          vis?.querySelectorAll("ClippingPlanes > ClippingPlane") ?? [],
        );
        if (planeEls.length) {
          const planes: ClippingPlaneState[] = [];
          for (const p of planeEls) {
            const loc = parseVec(p, "Location");
            const dir = parseVec(p, "Direction").normalize();
            planes.push({
              location: [loc.x, loc.y, loc.z],
              direction: [dir.x, dir.y, dir.z],
            });
          }
          viewpoint.clippingPlanes = planes;
        }
      }

      const snapFile = zip.file(`${folder}/snapshot.png`);
      if (snapFile) {
        viewpoint.thumbnail = bytesToDataUrl(await snapFile.async("uint8array"));
      }

      // ── Comments ──
      const comments: IssueComment[] = [];
      for (const ce of Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll("Comment"))) {
        comments.push({
          id: ce.getAttribute("Guid") || guid(),
          author: ce.getAttribute("Author") || "Unknown",
          date: Date.parse(ce.getAttribute("Date") ?? "") || Date.now(),
          text: ce.querySelector("Text")?.textContent ?? "",
        });
      }

      imported.push({
        id,
        title: topic.getAttribute("Title") || "Imported issue",
        description: doc.querySelector("DescriptionText")?.textContent ?? "",
        status: statusIn(topic.getAttribute("TopicStatus")),
        priority: priorityIn(topic.getAttribute("Priority")),
        author: topic.getAttribute("Author") || "Imported",
        assignee: topic.getAttribute("AssignedTo") || undefined,
        dueDate: Date.parse(topic.getAttribute("DueDate") ?? "") || undefined,
        createdAt: Date.parse(topic.getAttribute("CreationDate") ?? "") || Date.now(),
        updatedAt: Date.parse(topic.getAttribute("ModifiedDate") ?? "") || Date.now(),
        viewpoint,
        comments,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[bcf] failed to import topic folder:", folder, e);
    }
  }

  if (imported.length) setIssues([...imported, ...getIssues()]);
  return imported.length;
}

export function setupBcf() {
  ctx.features.bcf = { exportBCF, importBCF };
}
```
