```ts
/** Issue state + viewpoint capture/restore. Persisted via the projects module. */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { getProjection, updateClipping } from "../../features/camera-tools";
import type {
  ClippingPlaneState,
  Issue,
  IssueComment,
  IssuePriority,
  IssueStatus,
  IssueViewpoint,
} from "./types";

let issues: Issue[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function onIssuesChanged(cb: () => void) {
  listeners.add(cb);
}
function notify() {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try {
      cb();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
}

export function getIssues() {
  return issues;
}
export function setIssues(list: Issue[] | undefined | null) {
  issues = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
  notify();
}
export function getIssue(id: string) {
  return issues.find((i) => i.id === id);
}

const uid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ??
  `i-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

// ── Author identity ──
export function getAuthor(): string {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem("obs.author") || "Anonymous";
  } catch {
    return "Anonymous";
  }
}
export function setAuthor(name: string) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem("obs.author", name.trim() || "Anonymous");
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

// ── Selection extraction ──
function isNumericSet(v: any): v is Set<number> {
  if (!(v instanceof Set) || v.size === 0) return false;
  for (const x of v) if (typeof x !== "number") return false;
  return true;
}
function scanIdMaps(
  root: any,
  depth = 0,
  out: Record<string, Set<number>> = {},
): Record<string, Set<number>> {
  if (!root || depth > 4) return out;
  if (root instanceof Map) {
    for (const [k, v] of root) {
      if (isNumericSet(v)) out[String(k)] = v;
      else scanIdMaps(v, depth + 1, out);
    }
    return out;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(root)) {
    for (const v of root) scanIdMaps(v, depth + 1, out);
    return out;
  }
  if (typeof root !== "object") return out;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(root)) {
    if (isNumericSet(v)) out[k] = v as Set<number>;
    else if (v && typeof v === "object") scanIdMaps(v, depth + 1, out);
  }
  return out;
}

export function currentSelectionMap(): Record<string, number[]> {
  const maps = scanIdMaps((ctx.highlighter as any)?.selection);
  const plain: Record<string, number[]> = {};
  for (const [k, s] of Object.entries(maps)) plain[k] = Array.from(s as Set<number>);
  return plain;
}

// ── Clipper state (best-effort read) ──
function readClippingPlanes(): ClippingPlaneState[] {
  try {
    const list = (ctx.clipper as any)?.list;
    if (!list) return [];
    const out: ClippingPlaneState[] = [];
    // DataSet-like: iterate Map, or fall back to array
    const iter: any = list[Symbol.iterator] ? list : null;
    if (iter) {
      for (const entry of iter) {
        const item = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[1] : entry;
        const p: THREE.Plane = item?.three ?? item;
        if (!p?.normal || typeof p.constant !== "number") continue;
        const n = p.normal.clone().normalize();
        // Plane equation: n·x + c = 0 → point on plane at -c·n
        const loc = n.clone().multiplyScalar(-p.constant);
        out.push({
          location: [loc.x, loc.y, loc.z],
          direction: [n.x, n.y, n.z],
        });
      }
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

// ── Viewpoint capture / restore ──
export function captureThumbnail(maxW = 260): string {
  const renderer = ctx.world.renderer.three as THREE.WebGLRenderer;
  try {
    renderer.render(ctx.world.scene.three, ctx.world.camera.three);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const src = renderer.domElement;
  const scale = Math.min(1, maxW / Math.max(src.width, 1));
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(src.width * scale));
  c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(src.height * scale));
  c.getContext("2d")!.drawImage(src, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  return c.toDataURL("image/png");
}

export function captureViewpoint(withThumbnail = true): IssueViewpoint {
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const target = new THREE.Vector3();
  try {
    if (controls.target?.isVector3) target.copy(controls.target);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const up = cam.up.clone();
  const vp: IssueViewpoint = {
    cam: [cam.position.x, cam.position.y, cam.position.z],
    target: [target.x, target.y, target.z],
    up: [up.x, up.y, up.z],
    projection: getProjection(),
  };

  // Ortho scale
  if ((cam as any).isOrthographicCamera) {
    const ortho = cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    vp.orthoScale = (ortho.top - ortho.bottom) / Math.max(0.0001, ortho.zoom);
  }

  if (withThumbnail) {
    try {
      vp.thumbnail = captureThumbnail();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  const sel = currentSelectionMap();
  if (Object.keys(sel).length) vp.selection = sel;

  const planes = readClippingPlanes();
  if (planes.length) vp.clippingPlanes = planes;

  return vp;
}

export function goToViewpoint(vp: IssueViewpoint) {
  if (vp.projection && vp.projection !== getProjection()) {
    try {
      (ctx.cam as any).setProjection?.(vp.projection);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  if (vp.up) {
    ctx.world.camera.three.up.set(vp.up[0], vp.up[1], vp.up[2]);
  }
  ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
    vp.cam[0],
    vp.cam[1],
    vp.cam[2],
    vp.target[0],
    vp.target[1],
    vp.target[2],
    true,
  );

  // Restore ortho scale
  if (vp.orthoScale && (ctx.world.camera.three as any).isOrthographicCamera) {
    const ortho = ctx.world.camera.three as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    const height = ortho.top - ortho.bottom;
    ortho.zoom = height / Math.max(0.0001, vp.orthoScale);
    ortho.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  updateClipping();

  // Restore selection
  try {
    const hl: any = ctx.highlighter;
    hl.clear?.("select");
    const map: any = {};
    for (const [mid, ids] of Object.entries(vp.selection ?? {})) {
      map[mid] = new Set(ids);
    }
    if (Object.keys(map).length) hl.highlightByID?.("select", map, true);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Restore clipping planes (best-effort — SDK API varies)
  try {
    if (vp.clippingPlanes?.length) {
      const clipper: any = ctx.clipper;
      if (typeof clipper.deleteAll === "function") clipper.deleteAll();
      if (typeof clipper.createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint === "function") {
        for (const p of vp.clippingPlanes) {
          const normal = new THREE.Vector3(p.direction[0], p.direction[1], p.direction[2]);
          const point = new THREE.Vector3(p.location[0], p.location[1], p.location[2]);
          clipper.createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(ctx.world, normal, point);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

// ── CRUD ──
export function createIssue(
  title: string,
  description = "",
  vp?: IssueViewpoint,
): Issue {
  const issue: Issue = {
    id: uid(),
    title: title.trim() || "Untitled issue",
    description: description.trim(),
    status: "open",
    priority: "medium",
    author: getAuthor(),
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
    viewpoint: vp ?? captureViewpoint(true),
    comments: [],
  };
  issues.unshift(issue);
  notify();
  return issue;
}

export function addComment(
  issueId: string,
  text: string,
  withViewpoint = false,
): IssueComment | null {
  const issue = getIssue(issueId);
  if (!issue || !text.trim()) return null;
  const c: IssueComment = {
    id: uid(),
    author: getAuthor(),
    date: Date.now(),
    text: text.trim(),
    ...(withViewpoint ? { viewpoint: captureViewpoint(true) } : {}),
  };
  issue.comments.push(c);
  issue.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
  return c;
}

export function setStatus(issueId: string, status: IssueStatus) {
  const i = getIssue(issueId);
  if (!i) return;
  i.status = status;
  i.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
}

export function setPriority(issueId: string, priority: IssuePriority) {
  const i = getIssue(issueId);
  if (!i) return;
  i.priority = priority;
  i.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
}

export function setAssignee(issueId: string, name: string) {
  const i = getIssue(issueId);
  if (!i) return;
  i.assignee = name.trim() || undefined;
  i.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
}

export function setDueDate(issueId: string, date: number | undefined) {
  const i = getIssue(issueId);
  if (!i) return;
  i.dueDate = date;
  i.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
}

export function deleteIssue(issueId: string) {
  issues = issues.filter((i) => i.id !== issueId);
  notify();
}

// ── Setup ──
export function setupIssues() {
  ctx.features.issues = {
    getIssues,
    setIssues,
    createIssue,
    addComment,
    setStatus,
    setPriority,
    setAssignee,
    setDueDate,
    deleteIssue,
    captureViewpoint,
    goToViewpoint,
    getAuthor,
    setAuthor,
    onIssuesChanged,
  };
}
```

```ts
export type IssueStatus = "open" | "active" | "resolved" | "closed";
export type IssuePriority = "low" | "medium" | "high";

export interface ClippingPlaneState {
  /** Point on the plane, world coordinates. */
  location: [number, number, number];
  /** Unit normal, world coordinates. */
  direction: [number, number, number];
}

export interface IssueViewpoint {
  cam: [number, number, number];
  target: [number, number, number];
  projection: "perspective" | "orthographic";
  thumbnail?: string; // dataURL png
  /** Selected elements: modelId → localIds. Serialized to BCF as IfcGuids. */
  selection?: Record<string, number[]>;

  // ── BCF 3.0 additions (all optional) ─────────────────────────────────
  /** Up vector; defaults to (0,1,0) if absent. */
  up?: [number, number, number];
  /** Clipping planes active when the viewpoint was captured. */
  clippingPlanes?: ClippingPlaneState[];
  /** Hidden elements: modelId → localIds. */
  hidden?: Record<string, number[]>;
  /** Orthographic view-to-world scale (only meaningful when projection = orthographic). */
  orthoScale?: number;
}

export interface IssueComment {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  date: number;
  text: string;
  viewpoint?: IssueViewpoint;
}

export interface Issue {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: IssueStatus;
  priority: IssuePriority;
  author: string;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
  /** BCF "AssignedTo" field. */
  assignee?: string;
  /** BCF "DueDate". */
  dueDate?: number;
  viewpoint: IssueViewpoint;
  comments: IssueComment[];
}
```

```ts
// openbim-levels:level-driven-modeling
// Level facade over the authoring level array.
//
// Single source of truth is features/authoring.ts (which persists the
// level list into the project document via setLevels/getLevels). This
// module provides a stable, discoverable API for the ribbon, status bar,
// property palette, plan panel, and schedules, so they never reach into
// authoring internals.
//
// Back-compat: getLevels() / setLevels() still return / accept the same
// LevelDatum[] shape, so any pre-existing project document loads
// unchanged. Elements authored before this block have no levelId; that
// is legal (levelId is optional on AuthoredElement).

import {
  getLevels as getAuthoringLevels,
  setLevels as setAuthoringLevels,
  getActiveLevelId as getActiveLevelIdInner,
  setActiveLevelById as setActiveLevelByIdInner,
  onAuthoringChange,
} from "../../features/authoring";
import type { LevelDatum } from "../projects/types";

export type LevelRecord = LevelDatum;

const DEFAULT_LEVELS: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; elevation: number }> = [
  { name: "Level 0", elevation: 0 },
  { name: "Level 1", elevation: 3 },
  { name: "Level 2", elevation: 6 },
];

function uid(): string {
  return (
    (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ??
    `lvl-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`
  );
}

export const levels = {
  /** All levels, sorted by elevation ascending. */
  list(): LevelRecord[] {
    return getAuthoringLevels()
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.elevation - b.elevation);
  },

  get(id: string | null | undefined): LevelRecord | null {
    if (!id) return null;
    return getAuthoringLevels().find((l) => l.id === id) ?? null;
  },

  /** First level whose elevation is within `tol` metres of `elevation`. */
  findByElevation(elevation: number, tol = 0.001): LevelRecord | null {
    for (const l of getAuthoringLevels()) {
      if (Math.abs(l.elevation - elevation) <= tol) return l;
    }
    return null;
  },

  /** Nearest level by |elevation - target|. */
  findNearest(elevation: number): LevelRecord | null {
    const all = getAuthoringLevels();
    if (!all.length) return null;
    let best = all[0];
    let bestD = Math.abs(best.elevation - elevation);
    for (let i = 1; i < all.length; i++) {
      const d = Math.abs(all[i].elevation - elevation);
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = all[i]; }
    }
    return best;
  },

  add(partial: Partial<LevelRecord> = {}): LevelRecord {
    const list = getAuthoringLevels().slice();
    const elevation =
      typeof partial.elevation === "number" && Number.isFinite(partial.elevation)
        ? partial.elevation
        : list.length
          ? list[list.length - 1].elevation + 3
          : 0;
    const record: LevelRecord = {
      id: partial.id || uid(),
      name: partial.name || `Level ${list.length}`,
      elevation,
      color: partial.color,
    };
    list.push(record);
    setAuthoringLevels(list);
    return record;
  },

  update(id: string, patch: Partial<LevelRecord>): LevelRecord | null {
    const list = getAuthoringLevels().slice();
    const i = list.findIndex((l) => l.id === id);
    if (i < 0) return null;
    const next: LevelRecord = { ...list[i], ...patch, id };
    list[i] = next;
    setAuthoringLevels(list);
    return next;
  },

  remove(id: string): boolean {
    const list = getAuthoringLevels().slice();
    const next = list.filter((l) => l.id !== id);
    if (next.length === list.length) return false;
    setAuthoringLevels(next);
    return true;
  },

  /** Seed 3 standard levels when the project has none. Idempotent. */
  ensureSeed(): LevelRecord[] {
    const existing = getAuthoringLevels();
    if (existing.length) return existing.slice();
    const seeded: LevelRecord[] = DEFAULT_LEVELS.map((d) => ({
      id: uid(),
      name: d.name,
      elevation: d.elevation,
    }));
    setAuthoringLevels(seeded);
    return seeded;
  },

  getActiveId(): string | null {
    return getActiveLevelIdInner();
  },

  getActive(): LevelRecord | null {
    const id = getActiveLevelIdInner();
    return id ? (getAuthoringLevels().find((l) => l.id === id) ?? null) : null;
  },

  setActiveId(id: string | null): void {
    setActiveLevelByIdInner(id);
  },

  /** Convenience: activate the level whose elevation matches exactly. */
  setActiveByElevation(elevation: number, tol = 0.001): boolean {
    const hit = this.findByElevation(elevation, tol);
    if (!hit) return false;
    this.setActiveId(hit.id);
    return true;
  },

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    return onAuthoringChange(cb);
  },
};
```

```ts
/**

 */
import type { MaterialDef } from "../projects/types";

const uid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `mat-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

const DEFAULTS: Omit<MaterialDef, "id">[] = [
  { name: "Concrete C25/30", category: "concrete", color: "#9ca3af", density: 2400, costPerUnit: 120, unit: "m³" },
  { name: "Concrete C30/37", category: "concrete", color: "#6b7280", density: 2400, costPerUnit: 135, unit: "m³" },
  { name: "Structural Steel S355", category: "steel", color: "#64748b", density: 7850, costPerUnit: 1.8, unit: "kg" },
  { name: "Rebar B500B", category: "steel", color: "#475569", density: 7850, costPerUnit: 1.2, unit: "kg" },

  { name: "Double Glazing", category: "glass", color: "#38bdf8", density: 20, costPerUnit: 180, unit: "m²" },
  { name: "Mineral Wool", category: "insulation", color: "#fef3c7", density: 40, thermalConductivity: 0.035, costPerUnit: 25, unit: "m²" },
  { name: "Gypsum Board 12.5", category: "finish", color: "#f8fafc", density: 700, costPerUnit: 8, unit: "m²" },
  { name: "Ceramic Tile", category: "finish", color: "#e2e8f0", density: 2000, costPerUnit: 35, unit: "m²" },
  { name: "Copper Pipe", category: "mep", color: "#f59e0b", density: 8960, costPerUnit: 12, unit: "m" },
  { name: "PVC Pipe", category: "mep", color: "#94a3b8", density: 1400, costPerUnit: 4, unit: "m" },
  { name: "Galvanised Duct", category: "mep", color: "#cbd5e1", density: 7850, costPerUnit: 28, unit: "m²" },
];

let materials: MaterialDef[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notify() {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
}

export function onMaterialsChange(fn: () => void) {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => listeners.delete(fn);
}

export function listMaterials(): MaterialDef[] {
  return materials.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

export function ensureDefaultMaterials() {
  if (materials.length) return;
  materials = DEFAULTS.map((m) => ({ ...m, id: uid() }));
  notify();
}

export function addMaterial(partial: Partial<MaterialDef> & { name: string }): MaterialDef {
  const mat: MaterialDef = {
    id: uid(),
    name: partial.name,
    category: partial.category ?? "other",
    color: partial.color ?? "#94a3b8",
    density: partial.density,
    thermalConductivity: partial.thermalConductivity,
    costPerUnit: partial.costPerUnit,
    unit: partial.unit,
  };
  materials.push(mat);
  notify();
  return mat;
}

export function getMaterial(id: string) {
  return materials.find((m) => m.id === id);
}

export function loadMaterialsFromProject(list: MaterialDef[] | undefined) {
  materials = list?.length ? list.map((m) => ({ ...m })) : [];
  if (!materials.length) ensureDefaultMaterials();
  notify();
}

export function getMaterialsForSave(): MaterialDef[] {
  return materials.map((m) => ({ ...m }));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Model tree data layer.
 *
 * Resolves the IFC spatial structure (Site → Building → Storey → elements)
 * from fragments, with graceful fallbacks. The refresh is debounced so the
 * SDK's internal data map is populated before we query it — the alternative
 * is a storm of "Fragments: Model not found" rejections during project load.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Public types
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export type NodeKind = "model" | "spatial" | "category" | "element";

export interface TreeItem {
  id: string;
  kind: NodeKind;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  localId: number;
  modelId: string;
  children: TreeItem[];
  hasGeometry: boolean;
  elementCount: number;
  elevation?: number;
}

export interface ModelTree {
  modelId: string;
  modelName: string;
  root: TreeItem;
  byLocalId: Map<number, TreeItem>;
  categories: string[];
  totalElements: number;
}

let trees: ModelTree[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function onModelTreeChanged(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}
function notify() {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try {
      cb();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
}

export function getTrees(): ModelTree[] {
  return trees;
}
export function getTree(modelId: string): ModelTree | undefined {
  return trees.find((t) => t.modelId === modelId);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Pretty category names
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const PRETTY_CAT: Record<string, string> = {
  IFCWALL: "Walls",
  IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE: "Walls",
  IFCWALLELEMENTEDCASE: "Walls",
  IFCDOOR: "Doors",
  IFCWINDOW: "Windows",
  IFCSLAB: "Slabs",
  IFCBEAM: "Beams",
  IFCCOLUMN: "Columns",
  IFCMEMBER: "Members",
  IFCPLATE: "Plates",
  IFCSTAIR: "Stairs",
  IFCSTAIRFLIGHT: "Stair flights",
  IFCRAILING: "Railings",
  IFCROOF: "Roofs",
  IFCFOOTING: "Footings",
  IFCPILE: "Piles",
  IFCFURNISHINGELEMENT: "Furniture",
  IFCFLOWTERMINAL: "Flow terminals",
  IFCFLOWSEGMENT: "Flow segments",
  IFCFLOWFITTING: "Flow fittings",
  IFCPIPESEGMENT: "Pipe segments",
  IFCPIPEFITTING: "Pipe fittings",
  IFCDUCTSEGMENT: "Duct segments",
  IFCDUCTFITTING: "Duct fittings",
  IFCSPACE: "Spaces",
  IFCCOVERING: "Coverings",
  IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY: "Generic elements",
  IFCOPENINGELEMENT: "Openings",
};

function prettyCategory(cat: string): string {
  const upper = cat.toUpperCase();
  if (PRETTY_CAT[upper]) return PRETTY_CAT[upper];
  const trimmed = cat.replace(/^IFC/i, "").replace(/STANDARDCASE$/i, "");
  return trimmed.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + trimmed.slice(1);
}

/** Sort category keys alphabetically by their pretty name. */
function sortedCatList(iter: Iterable<string>): string[] {
  return Array.from(iter).sort((a, b) =>
    prettyCategory(a).localeCompare(prettyCategory(b)),
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Element data
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function readElementData(
  model: any,
  ids: number[],
  categoryMap: Map<number, string>,
): Promise<Map<number, { name: string; category: string }>> {
  const out = new Map<number, { name: string; category: string }>();
  if (!ids.length) return out;

  let raw: any[] | null = null;
  try {
    raw = await model.getItemsData(ids, {
      attributesDefault: false,
      attributes: ["Name", "ObjectType", "Tag", "PredefinedType"],
    });
  } catch {
    raw = null;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    const id = ids[i];
    const d = (raw as any)?.[i] ?? {};
    const name =
      String(
        d?.Name?.value ?? d?.ObjectType?.value ?? d?.Tag?.value ?? "",
      ).trim() || `#${id}`;
    const cat = categoryMap.get(id) ?? "Other";
    out.set(id, { name, category: cat });
  }
  return out;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Spatial structure attempts
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function tryNativeSpatialStructure(model: any): any[] | null {
  try {
    const m = model as any;
    if (typeof m.getSpatialStructure === "function") {
      const r = m.getSpatialStructure();
      if (Array.isArray(r)) return r;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(m.spatialStructure)) return m.spatialStructure;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return null;
}

function normalizeNativeNode(
  node: any,
  modelId: string,
  depth = 0,
): TreeItem | null {
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return null;

  const localId: number =
    typeof node.localId === "number"
      ? node.localId
      : typeof node.expressID === "number"
        ? node.expressID
        : typeof node.id === "number"
          ? node.id
          : 0;

  const category: string = String(
    node.category ??
      node.type ??
      node.ifcType ??
      node.objectType ??
      (depth === 0 ? "Model" : "Unknown"),
  );

  const name: string = String(
    node.name ?? node.Name ?? node.label ?? (category || `Node ${localId}`),
  );

  const childrenRaw: any[] = Array.isArray(node.children)
    ? node.children
    : Array.isArray(node.nodes)
      ? node.nodes
      : Array.isArray(node.items)
        ? node.items
        : [];

  const children: TreeItem[] = [];
  for (const c of childrenRaw) {
    const n = normalizeNativeNode(c, modelId, depth + 1);
    if (n) children.push(n);
  }

  const kind: NodeKind =
    depth === 0
      ? "model"
      : children.length
        ? "spatial"
        : localId
          ? "element"
          : "spatial";

  const elementCount = children.reduce(
    (s, c) => s + c.elementCount,
    kind === "element" ? 1 : 0,
  );

  return {
    id: `${modelId}:${localId || category}:${depth}:${name}`,
    kind,
    name,
    category,
    localId,
    modelId,
    children,
    hasGeometry: kind === "element" || elementCount > 0,
    elementCount,
  };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Public: build
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export async function buildAllTrees(): Promise<void> {
  trees = [];
  const entries = Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.entries());
  for (const [modelId, model] of entries) {
    try {
      const tree = await buildOneTree(modelId, model);
      if (tree) trees.push(tree);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[model-tree] build failed for", modelId, e);
    }
  }
  notify();
}

async function buildOneTree(modelId: string, model: any): Promise<ModelTree | null> {
  let geomIds: number[] = [];
  try {
    geomIds = (await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry()) ?? [];
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (/Fragments\s*:?\s*Model not found/i.test(msg)) {
      console.warn(
        `[model-tree] pruning stale model "${modelId}" — worker no longer has it`,
      );
      try {
        (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(modelId);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
      return null;
    }
    console.warn("[model-tree] getItemsIdsWithGeometry failed", modelId, err);
    return null;
  }
  if (!geomIds.length) return null;

  const categoryMap = new Map<number, string>();
  try {
    const cats = await model.getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
    for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
      for (const id of (list as number[]) || []) categoryMap.set(id, cat);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (/Fragments\s*:?\s*Model not found/i.test(msg)) {
      try {
        (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(modelId);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
      return null;
    }
    /* fall through — build with "Other" categories */
  }

  const modelName =
    (model as any).name || (model as any).modelName || modelId;

  const native = tryNativeSpatialStructure(model);
  if (native && native.length) {
    const rootChildren: TreeItem[] = [];
    for (const n of native) {
      const norm = normalizeNativeNode(n, modelId);
      if (norm) rootChildren.push(norm);
    }
    if (rootChildren.length) {
      let total = 0;
      const byLocalId = new Map<number, TreeItem>();
      const walk = (it: TreeItem) => {
        if (it.kind === "element" && geomIds.includes(it.localId)) {
          byLocalId.set(it.localId, it);
          total++;
        }
        for (const c of it.children) walk(c);
      };
      for (const c of rootChildren) walk(c);
      if (total > 0) {
        const root: TreeItem = {
          id: `${modelId}:root`,
          kind: "model",
          name: modelName,
          category: "Model",
          localId: 0,
          modelId,
          children: rootChildren,
          hasGeometry: true,
          elementCount: total,
        };
        const categories = Array.from(
          new Set(Array.from(byLocalId.values()).map((it) => it.category)),
        ).sort();
        return {
          modelId,
          modelName,
          root,
          byLocalId,
          categories,
          totalElements: total,
        };
      }
    }
  }

  const elemData = await readElementData(model, geomIds, categoryMap);

  const byCategory = new Map<string, TreeItem[]>();
  for (const id of geomIds) {
    const d = elemData.get(id);
    if (!d) continue;
    const item: TreeItem = {
      id: `${modelId}:${id}`,
      kind: "element",
      name: d.name,
      category: d.category,
      localId: id,
      modelId,
      children: [],
      hasGeometry: true,
      elementCount: 1,
    };
    const bucket = byCategory.get(d.category) ?? [];
    bucket.push(item);
    byCategory.set(d.category, bucket);
  }

  const rootChildren: TreeItem[] = [];
  const byLocalId = new Map<number, TreeItem>();
  const sortedCats = Array.from(byCategory.keys()).sort((a, b) =>
    prettyCategory(a).localeCompare(prettyCategory(b)),
  );

  for (const cat of sortedCats) {
    const items = byCategory.get(cat) ?? [];
    items.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    for (const it of items) byLocalId.set(it.localId, it);
    const catNode: TreeItem = {
      id: `${modelId}:cat:${cat}`,
      kind: "category",
      name: `${prettyCategory(cat)} (${items.length})`,
      category: cat,
      localId: 0,
      modelId,
      children: items,
      hasGeometry: true,
      elementCount: items.length,
    };
    rootChildren.push(catNode);
  }

  const root: TreeItem = {
    id: `${modelId}:root`,
    kind: "model",
    name: modelName,
    category: "Model",
    localId: 0,
    modelId,
    children: rootChildren,
    hasGeometry: true,
    elementCount: geomIds.length,
  };

  return {
    modelId,
    modelName,
    root,
    byLocalId,
    categories: sortedCatList(byCategory.keys()),
    totalElements: geomIds.length,
  };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Search
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface TreeSearchHit {
  item: TreeItem;
  path: string[];
}

export function searchTree(
  tree: ModelTree,
  query: string,
  limit = 200,
): TreeSearchHit[] {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return [];
  const hits: TreeSearchHit[] = [];

  const visit = (it: TreeItem, path: string[]) => {
    if (hits.length >= limit) return;
    const name = it.name.toLowerCase();
    const cat = it.category.toLowerCase();
    if (name.includes(q) || cat.includes(q)) {
      hits.push({ item: it, path: [...path, it.name] });
      if (hits.length >= limit) return;
    }
    for (const c of it.children) visit(c, [...path, it.name]);
  };
  visit(tree.root, []);
  return hits;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helpers for panel
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function collectLocalIds(item: TreeItem): number[] {
  if (item.kind === "element" && item.localId) return [item.localId];
  const out: number[] = [];
  const walk = (it: TreeItem) => {
    if (it.kind === "element" && it.localId) out.push(it.localId);
    for (const c of it.children) walk(c);
  };
  walk(item);
  return out;
}

export function prettyCategoryName(cat: string): string {
  return prettyCategory(cat);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Setup — debounced rebuild
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function setupModelTree() {
  // Same race as the clash panel: list.onItemSet fires before the SDK's
  // internal data map is populated. Debounce to avoid "Model not found".
  let rebuildTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  const scheduleRebuild = () => {
    if (rebuildTimer) clearTimeout(rebuildTimer);
    rebuildTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      rebuildTimer = null;
      void buildAllTrees().catch(() => {
        /* swallowed */
      });
    }, 400);
  };

  ctx.fragments.list.onItemSet.add(scheduleRebuild);
  ctx.fragments.list.onItemDeleted.add(scheduleRebuild);

  ctx.features.modelTree = {
    getTrees,
    getTree,
    buildAllTrees,
    searchTree,
    collectLocalIds,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Phasing - Revit-style construction phases.
 *
 * Every authored element / room can carry phaseCreated + phaseDemolished.
 * Views filter by phase + phase filter (Show Complete / Show New / Show Previous + New).
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export type PhaseId = string;

export interface Phase {
  id: PhaseId;
  name: string;
  /** Sort order (lower = earlier). */
  order: number;
  description?: string;
}

export type PhaseFilter =
  | "show-all"
  | "show-complete"
  | "show-new"
  | "show-previous"
  | "show-previous-and-new"
  | "show-demo";

export interface PhaseAssignment {
  phaseCreated: PhaseId | null;
  phaseDemolished: PhaseId | null;
}

const STORAGE = "obs.phases.v1";

type Listener = () => void;

function uid(): string {
  return `phase-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

class PhasesStore {
  private phases: Phase[] = [];
  private currentPhaseId: PhaseId | null = null;
  private currentFilter: PhaseFilter = "show-complete";
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
      if (raw) {
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        this.phases = data.phases ?? [];
        this.currentPhaseId = data.currentPhaseId ?? null;
        this.currentFilter = data.currentFilter ?? "show-complete";
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    if (!this.phases.length) {
      this.phases = [
        { id: uid(), name: "Existing", order: 0 },
        { id: uid(), name: "New Construction", order: 1 },
      ];
      this.currentPhaseId = this.phases[1].id;
      this.persist();
    }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE,
        JSON.stringify({
          phases: this.phases,
          currentPhaseId: this.currentPhaseId,
          currentFilter: this.currentFilter,
        }),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  list(): Phase[] {
    return [...this.phases].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  }

  get(id: PhaseId): Phase | null {
    return this.phases.find((p) => p.id === id) ?? null;
  }

  create(name: string): Phase {
    const order = this.phases.reduce((m, p) => Math.max(m, p.order), -1) + 1;
    const phase: Phase = { id: uid(), name, order };
    this.phases.push(phase);
    this.persist();
    return phase;
  }

  rename(id: PhaseId, name: string): boolean {
    const p = this.get(id);
    if (!p) return false;
    p.name = name;
    this.persist();
    return true;
  }

  remove(id: PhaseId): boolean {
    if (this.phases.length <= 1) return false;
    const idx = this.phases.findIndex((p) => p.id === id);
    if (idx < 0) return false;
    this.phases.splice(idx, 1);
    if (this.currentPhaseId === id) {
      this.currentPhaseId = this.phases[0]?.id ?? null;
    }
    this.persist();
    return true;
  }

  getCurrent(): Phase | null {
    return this.currentPhaseId ? this.get(this.currentPhaseId) : null;
  }

  setCurrent(id: PhaseId): void {
    if (!this.get(id)) return;
    this.currentPhaseId = id;
    this.persist();
  }

  getFilter(): PhaseFilter {
    return this.currentFilter;
  }

  setFilter(f: PhaseFilter): void {
    this.currentFilter = f;
    this.persist();
  }

  /**
   * Should an element with the given phase assignment be visible
   * given the active view phase + filter?
   */
  isVisible(assignment: PhaseAssignment | null | undefined): boolean {
    if (!assignment) return true;
    const viewPhase = this.getCurrent();
    if (!viewPhase) return true;

    const created = assignment.phaseCreated
      ? this.get(assignment.phaseCreated)
      : null;
    const demo = assignment.phaseDemolished
      ? this.get(assignment.phaseDemolished)
      : null;

    const createdOrder = created?.order ?? -Infinity;
    const demoOrder = demo?.order ?? Infinity;
    const viewOrder = viewPhase.order;

    switch (this.currentFilter) {
      case "show-all":
        return true;
      case "show-complete":
        // Exists at view phase: created <= view and (not demolished or demo > view)
        return createdOrder <= viewOrder && demoOrder > viewOrder;
      case "show-new":
        return createdOrder === viewOrder && demoOrder > viewOrder;
      case "show-previous":
        return createdOrder < viewOrder && demoOrder > viewOrder;
      case "show-previous-and-new":
        return createdOrder <= viewOrder && demoOrder > viewOrder;
      case "show-demo":
        return demoOrder === viewOrder;
      default:
        return true;
    }
  }

  /** Graphic override style for phase display (New / Existing / Demo). */
  graphicOverride(assignment: PhaseAssignment | null | undefined): {
    role: "new" | "existing" | "demo" | "none";
    opacity: number;
    dashed: boolean;
  } {
    if (!assignment || !this.currentPhaseId) {
      return { role: "none", opacity: 1, dashed: false };
    }
    const viewPhase = this.getCurrent();
    if (!viewPhase) return { role: "none", opacity: 1, dashed: false };

    const created = assignment.phaseCreated
      ? this.get(assignment.phaseCreated)
      : null;
    const demo = assignment.phaseDemolished
      ? this.get(assignment.phaseDemolished)
      : null;
    const createdOrder = created?.order ?? -Infinity;
    const demoOrder = demo?.order ?? Infinity;

    if (demoOrder === viewPhase.order) {
      return { role: "demo", opacity: 0.45, dashed: true };
    }
    if (createdOrder === viewPhase.order) {
      return { role: "new", opacity: 1, dashed: false };
    }
    if (createdOrder < viewPhase.order && demoOrder > viewPhase.order) {
      return { role: "existing", opacity: 0.7, dashed: false };
    }
    return { role: "none", opacity: 1, dashed: false };
  }
}

export const phasesStore = new PhasesStore();

export function setupPhases(): typeof phasesStore {
  phasesStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).phases = phasesStore;
  (window as any).__obsPhases = phasesStore;
  console.log("[phases] ready -", phasesStore.list().map((p) => p.name).join(", "));
  return phasesStore;
}
```

```ts
/** Project lifecycle: create/open/save/close + import persistence hook.
 *
 *  Offsets
 *  ───────
 *  Each model has an offset stored in the doc at `models[].position`.
 *  On save we read the live offset from importer; on open we restore it.
 *  If the doc has no offsets (fresh project, or pre-migration), the
 *  saved positioning mode is applied instead.
 */
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { services } from "../../core/services";
import * as store from "./store";
import type { ProjectDoc, ProjectTemplate, ProjectStatus, ProjectUnits } from "./types";
import {
  establishSceneOffset, computeSceneBounds, fitAll,
  resetPlacementState, updateClipping,
} from "../../features/camera-tools";
import {
  setElements, getElements, clearElements,
  getGrids, setGrids, getLevels, setLevels,
} from "../../features/authoring";
import { refreshModelSelectionUI, clearClash } from "../../features/clash";
import { getIssues, setIssues, onIssuesChanged } from "../issues/issues";
import { getCostData, setCostData, onCostChanged } from "../cost/cost";

let current: ProjectDoc | null = null;
let dirty = false;
let detachedModels = 0;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function getCurrentProject() { return current; }
export function isDirty() { return dirty; }
export function getDetachedModelCount() { return detachedModels; }
export function onProjectChanged(cb: () => void) { listeners.add(cb); }
function notify() {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}
export function markDirty() { dirty = true; notify(); }

export type ProjectMetaPatch = Partial<Pick<
  ProjectDoc,
  "name" | "projectNumber" | "client" | "phase" | "description" | "status" | "units" | "owner"
>>;

export function updateProjectMeta(patch: ProjectMetaPatch): void {
  if (!current) return;
  const next = patch.name !== undefined ? String(patch.name).trim() : undefined;
  if (next !== undefined) current.name = next || "Untitled project";
  if (patch.projectNumber !== undefined) current.projectNumber = String(patch.projectNumber).trim() || undefined;
  if (patch.client !== undefined) current.client = String(patch.client).trim() || undefined;
  if (patch.phase !== undefined) current.phase = String(patch.phase).trim() || undefined;
  if (patch.description !== undefined) current.description = String(patch.description).trim() || undefined;
  if (patch.owner !== undefined) current.owner = String(patch.owner).trim() || undefined;
  if (patch.status !== undefined) current.status = patch.status as ProjectStatus;
  if (patch.units !== undefined) current.units = patch.units as ProjectUnits;
  markDirty();
}

function esc(s: string) {
  return String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}

function snapshotAppState() {
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const t: any = (ctx.world.camera.controls as any).target;
  return {
    cam: [cam.position.x, cam.position.y, cam.position.z] as [number, number, number],
    target: t?.isVector3 ? ([t.x, t.y, t.z] as [number, number, number]) : undefined,
  };
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Save
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export async function saveProject(silent = false) {
  if (!current) {
    if (!silent) alert("No project is open.");
    return;
  }
  current.elements = getElements();
  current.grids = getGrids();
  current.levels = getLevels();
  current.issues = getIssues();
  current.cost = getCostData();
  current.appState = snapshotAppState();

  // Persist per-model offset from importer.
  try {
    const importer: any = (ctx.features as any).importer;
    for (const meta of current.models ?? []) {
      const off = importer?.getModelOffset?.(meta.id);
      if (off) meta.position = [off[0], off[1], off[2]];
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[projects] offset persistence failed", e);
  }

  try {
    const m = (ctx.features as any).importer?.getPositioningMode?.();
    if (m) (current as any).positioningMode = m;
  } catch { /* */ }


  // openbim-levels:ui-wired:projects

  try {

    const activeId = (ctx.features as any).authoring?.getActiveLevelId?.() ?? null;

    (current as any).activeLevelId = activeId;

  } catch { /* */ }

  try {
    const serialize = (ctx.features as any).fragEdit?.serialize;
    if (typeof serialize === "function") {
      const edits = serialize();
      (current as any).fragEdits = edits; // v48 legacy compatibility
      (current as any).nativeTwins = edits; // rich Native Twin payload
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  try {
    const clash = services.tryUse("clash");
    (current as any).clashStates = clash?.serializeStates?.() ?? [];
  } catch { /* */ }

  try {
    const annot = await import("../views/annotation-store");
    current.annotations = annot.serializeAll();
  } catch { /* annotations store optional */ }

  current.updatedAt = Date.now();
  await store.putProject(current);
  dirty = false;
  notify();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Scene teardown
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function clearScene() {
  try { await (ctx.highlighter as any).clear?.(); } catch { /* */ }
  try { ctx.clipper.deleteAll(); } catch { /* */ }
  try { await clearClash(); } catch { /* */ }

  try { (ctx.features as any).importer?.clearAllOffsets?.(); } catch { /* */ }

  const ids = Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys());
  for (const id of ids) {
    try { await (ctx.fragments.list.get(id) as any)?.dispose?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    try { (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(id); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  try { (ctx.fragments.list as any).clear?.(); } catch { /* */ }

  clearElements();
  try { (ctx.features as any).fileInterop?.clearAux?.(); } catch { /* */ }
  try { (ctx.features as any).fragEdit?.clearAll?.(); } catch { /* */ }
  resetPlacementState();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Viewpoint pruning
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function pruneViewpoint(vp: any, missing: Set<string>) {
  if (!vp || typeof vp !== "object") return;
  if (vp.selection && typeof vp.selection === "object") {
    for (const k of Object.keys(vp.selection)) if (missing.has(k)) delete vp.selection[k];
  }
  if (vp.hidden && typeof vp.hidden === "object") {
    for (const k of Object.keys(vp.hidden)) if (missing.has(k)) delete vp.hidden[k];
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Worker-probe verification
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function verifyLoadedModels(loadedIds: Set<string>): Promise<string[]> {
  const stale: string[] = [];
  for (const id of Array.from(loadedIds)) {
    if (id.startsWith("aux-")) continue;
    const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(id);
    if (!model) { stale.push(id); continue; }
    try {
      const probe = await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry?.();
      if (!Array.isArray(probe) || probe.length === 0) { stale.push(id); continue; }
    } catch { stale.push(id); }
  }
  for (const id of stale) {
    try { (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(id); } catch { /* */ }
    loadedIds.delete(id);
  }
  return stale;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   New project
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface CreateProjectOptions {
  template?: ProjectTemplate;
  projectNumber?: string;
  client?: string;
  phase?: string;
  units?: ProjectUnits;
  owner?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export async function createProject(name: string, options: CreateProjectOptions = {}) {
  const loader = (ctx.features as any).appLoader;
  loader?.begin?.(`Creating project · ${name || "Untitled"}`, { cancellable: false });
  try {
    loader?.set?.("Clearing current scene…", 0.2);
    await clearScene();
    loader?.set?.("Preparing document…", 0.6);

    const now = Date.now();
    current = {
      id: (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `p-${now}`,
      name: name || "Untitled project",
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      projectNumber: options.projectNumber?.trim() || undefined,
      client: options.client?.trim() || undefined,
      phase: options.phase?.trim() || undefined,
      description: options.description?.trim() || undefined,
      owner: options.owner?.trim() || undefined,
      status: "active",
      units: options.units ?? "metric",
      template: options.template ?? "blank",
      elements: [], models: [], issues: [], cost: undefined,
      grids: [], levels: [], appState: {},
      positioningMode: "origin-to-origin",
    } as ProjectDoc;
    detachedModels = 0;
    setIssues([]); setCostData(null);
    setGrids([]); setLevels([]);
    dirty = false;

    // openbim-levels:ui-wired:projects
    try {
      const levelsMod: any = await import("../levels/levels");
      const seeded = levelsMod.levels.ensureSeed();
      if (seeded.length) levelsMod.levels.setActiveId(seeded[0].id);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[projects] level seed failed", e);
    }

    loader?.set?.("Writing to storage…", 0.85);
    await store.putProject(current);

    computeSceneBounds();
    try { void refreshModelSelectionUI(); } catch { /* */ }
    fitAll();
    loader?.set?.("Done.", 1);
    notify();
  } finally {
    setTimeout(() => loader?.finish?.(), 150);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Open project
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export async function openProject(id: string) {
  const loader = (ctx.features as any).appLoader;
  if (loader?.isActive?.()) return;

  const doc = await store.getProject(id);
  if (!doc) { alert("Project not found."); return; }

  loader?.begin?.(`Opening ${doc.name}…`, { cancellable: false });

  try {
    loader?.set?.("Clearing current scene…", 0.05);
    await clearScene();

    current = doc;
    dirty = false;
    detachedModels = 0;

    loader?.set?.("Reading stored blobs…", 0.12);
    const blobs = await store.getModelBlobs(id);
    const loadedIds = new Set<string>();
    const missingModels: string[] = [];
    const importer = (ctx.features as any).importer;

    for (let i = 0; i < blobs.length; i++) {
      const b = blobs[i];
      const pct = 0.15 + 0.6 * ((i + 1) / Math.max(1, blobs.length));
      loader?.set?.(`Loading model ${i + 1} / ${blobs.length} · ${b.name}`, pct);
      try {
        if (b.modelId.startsWith("aux-")) {
          await (ctx.features as any).fileInterop?.restoreAux?.(b.blob, b.name);
          loadedIds.add(b.modelId);
          continue;
        }
        const buf = await b.blob.arrayBuffer();
        await ctx.fragments.core.load(new Uint8Array(buf), { modelId: b.modelId });

        // Register (default offset 0,0,0) and immediately apply saved offset.
        importer?.registerModel?.(b.modelId);
        const meta = doc.models?.find((m) => m.id === b.modelId);
        if (meta?.position) {
          importer?.setModelOffset?.(b.modelId, meta.position);
          console.log(
            `[projects] applied offset for "${b.modelId}" → ` +
              `(${meta.position[0].toFixed(3)}, ${meta.position[1].toFixed(3)}, ${meta.position[2].toFixed(3)})`,
          );
        }
        establishSceneOffset(b.modelId);
        loadedIds.add(b.modelId);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("[projects] model load failed:", b.name, e);
        try { (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(b.modelId); } catch { /* */ }
        missingModels.push(b.modelId);
      }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
    }

    for (const m of doc.models ?? []) {
      if (!loadedIds.has(m.id) && !missingModels.includes(m.id)) {
        missingModels.push(m.id);
        try { (ctx.fragments.list as any).delete?.(m.id); } catch { /* */ }
      }
    }

    loader?.set?.("Verifying loaded models…", 0.78);
    const stale = await verifyLoadedModels(loadedIds);
    for (const sid of stale) if (!missingModels.includes(sid)) missingModels.push(sid);

    if (missingModels.length) {
      const missing = new Set(missingModels);
      for (const m of doc.models ?? []) if (missing.has(m.id)) (m as any).missing = true;
      for (const issue of doc.issues ?? []) {
        pruneViewpoint(issue.viewpoint, missing);
        for (const c of issue.comments ?? []) if (c.viewpoint) pruneViewpoint(c.viewpoint, missing);
      }
    }

    loader?.set?.("Restoring project data…", 0.82);
    setIssues(doc.issues ?? []);
    setCostData(doc.cost ?? null);
    setGrids(doc.grids ?? []);
    setLevels(doc.levels ?? []);
    setElements(doc.elements ?? []);

    // openbim-levels:ui-wired:projects
    try {
      const levelsMod: any = await import("../levels/levels");
      const seeded = levelsMod.levels.ensureSeed();
      const savedActive = (doc as any).activeLevelId;
      if (savedActive && seeded.some((l: any) => l.id === savedActive)) {
        levelsMod.levels.setActiveId(savedActive);
      } else if (seeded.length) {
        levelsMod.levels.setActiveId(seeded[0].id);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[projects] level restore failed", e);
    }
    try {
      const annot = await import("../views/annotation-store");
      annot.deserializeAll((doc.annotations as any) ?? null);
    } catch { /* */ }

    // If no saved offsets, apply the saved positioning mode instead.
    const hasSavedOffsets = (doc.models ?? []).some(
      (m) => m.position && (Math.abs(m.position[0]) > 1e-6 || Math.abs(m.position[1]) > 1e-6 || Math.abs(m.position[2]) > 1e-6),
    );
    if (!hasSavedOffsets && importer?.applyPositioningMode) {
      const mode = (doc as any).positioningMode ?? "origin-to-origin";
      try { await importer.applyPositioningMode(mode); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
    }

    computeSceneBounds();

    const nativeTwins = Array.isArray((doc as any).nativeTwins)
      ? (doc as any).nativeTwins
      : ((doc as any).fragEdits ?? []);
    if (Array.isArray(nativeTwins) && nativeTwins.length) {
      loader?.set?.(`Restoring ${nativeTwins.length} native twin(s)…`, 0.9);
      try { await (ctx.features as any).fragEdit?.deserializeNativeTwins?.(nativeTwins); } catch {
        try { await (ctx.features as any).fragEdit?.deserialize?.(nativeTwins); } catch { /* */ }
      }
    }

    try {
      const clash = services.tryUse("clash");
      clash?.deserializeStates?.((doc as any).clashStates ?? []);
    } catch { /* */ }

    loader?.set?.("Rebuilding panels…", 0.96);
    setTimeout(() => { try { void refreshModelSelectionUI(); } catch { /* */ } }, 300);

    const st = doc.appState;
    if (st?.cam && st?.target) {
      ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
        st.cam[0], st.cam[1], st.cam[2],
        st.target[0], st.target[1], st.target[2], true,
      );
      updateClipping();
    } else fitAll();

    setTimeout(() => {
      try { (ctx.cam as any)?.recoverView?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    }, 600);

    if (missingModels.length) showMissingModelsBanner(missingModels);

    loader?.set?.("Done.", 1);
    notify();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[projects] openProject failed", err);
    alert(`Could not open project: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}`);
  } finally {
    setTimeout(() => loader?.finish?.(), 180);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Banners
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function showMissingModelsBanner(models: string[]) {
  const id = "obs-missing-models-banner";
  document.getElementById(id)?.remove();
  const banner = document.createElement("div");
  banner.id = id;
  banner.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:52px;z-index:9000;max-width:420px;" +
    "background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--warning,#f59e0b);border-left:3px solid var(--warning,#f59e0b);" +
    "border-radius:6px;padding:12px 14px;font:12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45)";
  banner.innerHTML =
    `<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--warning,#f59e0b)">⚠ ${models.length} linked model(s) not loaded</div>` +
    `<div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:8px;max-height:140px;overflow:auto">` +
      models.map((m) => `<div style="font-family:monospace;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">· ${esc(m)}</div>`).join("") +
    `</div>`;
  const close = document.createElement("button");
  close.textContent = "Dismiss";
  close.style.cssText = "padding:4px 12px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:inherit;" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px";
  close.onclick = () => banner.remove();
  banner.appendChild(close);
  document.body.appendChild(banner);
  setTimeout(() => { if (banner.isConnected) banner.remove(); }, 20_000);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Delete
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export async function deleteProjectById(id: string) {
  await store.deleteProjectRecord(id);
  await store.deleteModelBlobs(id);
  if (current?.id === id) { current = null; notify(); }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Import persistence hook
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function onModelImported(modelId: string, name: string, bytes: Uint8Array | null) {
  if (!current) {
    detachedModels++;
    notify();
    return;
  }
  if (!bytes || !bytes.byteLength) {
    const meta = current.models.find((m) => m.id === modelId);
    if (meta) meta.name = name;
    else current.models.push({ id: modelId, name, bytes: 0 });
    markDirty();
    return;
  }
  const blob = new Blob([bytes as unknown as BlobPart]);
  const sizeMB = blob.size / (1024 * 1024);
  store.putModelBlob(current.id, modelId, name, blob)
    .then(async () => {
      const meta = current!.models.find((m) => m.id === modelId);
      if (meta) { meta.name = name; meta.bytes = blob.size; (meta as any).missing = false; }
      else current!.models.push({ id: modelId, name, bytes: blob.size });
      try { await store.putProject(current!); } catch { /* */ }
    })
    .catch((e) => console.error(`[projects] blob save FAILED for "${name}"`, e));
  markDirty();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupProjects() {
  ctx.features.projects = {
    getCurrentProject, isDirty, createProject, openProject,
    deleteProjectById, saveProject, onModelImported, markDirty,
  };
  onIssuesChanged(() => markDirty());
  onCostChanged(() => markDirty());
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "s") {
      e.preventDefault();
      void saveProject();
    }
  });
  setInterval(() => { if (dirty && current) void saveProject(true); }, 25_000);
}
```

```ts
/** Raw IndexedDB persistence — no dependencies, local-first. */
import type { ProjectDoc, ProjectSummary } from "./types";

const DB_NAME = "open-bim-studio";
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const S_PROJECTS = "projects";
const S_BLOBS = "modelBlobs";

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase> | null = null;

function openDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  if (!dbPromise) {
    dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
      req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        const db = req.result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(S_PROJECTS))
          db.createObjectStore(S_PROJECTS, { keyPath: "id" });
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(S_BLOBS)) {
          const s = db.createObjectStore(S_BLOBS);
          s.createIndex("projectId", "projectId", { unique: false });
        }
      };
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  }
  return dbPromise;
}

function reqAs<T>(req: IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => rej(req.error);
  });
}

export async function putProject(doc: ProjectDoc) {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_PROJECTS, "readwrite");
  await reqAs(t.objectStore(S_PROJECTS).put(doc));
}

export async function getProject(id: string): Promise<ProjectDoc | undefined> {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_PROJECTS, "readonly");
  return reqAs(t.objectStore(S_PROJECTS).get(id));
}

export async function listProjectDocs(): Promise<ProjectDoc[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_PROJECTS, "readonly");
  return reqAs(t.objectStore(S_PROJECTS).getAll());
}

export async function deleteProjectRecord(id: string) {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_PROJECTS, "readwrite");
  await reqAs(t.objectStore(S_PROJECTS).delete(id));
}

export async function putModelBlob(projectId: string, modelId: string, name: string, blob: Blob) {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_BLOBS, "readwrite");
  const key = `${projectId}::${modelId}`;
  await reqAs(t.objectStore(S_BLOBS).put({ key, projectId, modelId, name, blob }, key));
}

export async function getModelBlobs(projectId: string): Promise<{ modelId: string; name: string; blob: Blob }[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_BLOBS, "readonly");
  const idx = t.objectStore(S_BLOBS).index("projectId");
  const recs: any[] = await reqAs(idx.getAll(projectId));
  return recs.map((r) => ({ modelId: r.modelId, name: r.name, blob: r.blob }));
}

export async function deleteModelBlobs(projectId: string) {
  const db = await openDb();
  const t = db.transaction(S_BLOBS, "readwrite");
  const idx = t.objectStore(S_BLOBS).index("projectId");
  const keys: IDBValidKey[] = await reqAs(idx.getAllKeys(projectId));
  const s = t.objectStore(S_BLOBS);
  for (const k of keys) s.delete(k);
}

export function summarize(doc: ProjectDoc): ProjectSummary {
  return {
    id: doc.id,
    name: doc.name,
    createdAt: doc.createdAt,
    updatedAt: doc.updatedAt,
    elementCount: doc.elements?.length ?? 0,
    modelCount: doc.models?.length ?? 0,
    issueCount: doc.issues?.length ?? 0,
    projectNumber: doc.projectNumber,
    client: doc.client,
    phase: doc.phase,
    status: doc.status,
    units: doc.units,
    template: doc.template,
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { Issue } from "../issues/types";
import type { CostData } from "../cost/types";

// ── Geometry / authored element types ─────────────────────────────────────
export type Vec2 = [number, number];

export type ElementType =
  | "wall"
  | "slab"
  | "column"
  | "beam"
  | "brace"
  | "truss"
  | "footing"
  | "strip"
  | "mline"
  | "duct"
  | "pipe"
  | "cable-tray"
  | "conduit"
  | "equipment"
  | "fitting"
  | "door"
  | "window"
  | "roof"
  | "stairs"
  | "railing"
  | "ramp"
  | "room"
  | "area"
  | "ceiling"
  | "curtain-wall"
  | "grid"
  | "level"
  | "generic";

/** Door / window panel variants used by authoring + property palette. */
export type DoorPanelType = "swing" | "double" | "sliding" | "folding" | "pocket";
export type WindowPanelType = "fixed" | "casement" | "sliding" | "awning" | "double";

export interface AuthoredElement {
  id: string;
  type: ElementType;
  name: string;
  color?: string;
  /** For hosted elements (door/window) — the id of the host wall. */
  hostId?: string;
  /** Revit-style: the level this element was placed on. */
  levelId?: string;
  /** Revit-style: the family this element instantiates (optional). */
  familyId?: string;
  /** Revit-style: the family type this element instantiates (optional). */
  familyTypeId?: string;
  params: {
    start?: Vec2;
    end?: Vec2;
    polygon?: Vec2[];
    point?: Vec2;
    width?: number;
    depth?: number;
    height: number;
    thickness: number;
    elevation: number;

    // ── Hosted element (door/window) ──────────────────────────────────
    /** Distance in metres from the host wall's start to the element's centre. */
    offsetAlongHost?: number;
    /** Sill height above the wall's elevation, in metres. */
    sillHeight?: number;
    /** Frame thickness (m). */
    frameThickness?: number;
    /** Door panel type. */
    doorPanel?: "swing" | "double" | "sliding" | "folding" | "pocket";
    /** Window panel type. */
    windowPanel?: "fixed" | "casement" | "sliding" | "awning" | "double";
    /** Whether a window has a horizontal mullion (transom). */
    mullion?: boolean;

    // ── Fitting (auto-generated at chain bends) ───────────────────────
    /** Incoming direction angle in the XZ plane (radians). */
    angleIn?: number;
    /** Outgoing direction angle in the XZ plane (radians). */
    angleOut?: number;
    /** Bend radius for fitting reconstruction (m). */
    bendRadius?: number;

    /** Fitting kind (elbow, tee, cross, ...). */
    fittingKind?: string;

    /** Parent element type that generated this fitting. */
    parentType?: "duct" | "pipe" | "cable-tray" | "conduit";
  };
  properties?: Record<string, unknown>;

  /** Optional exact geometry captured from an imported IFC/FRAG object.
   * Stored as non-indexed triangle positions in the authored project so the
   * reconstructed element becomes a real project object rather than a
   * transient viewport clone.
   */
  nativeGeometry?: { positions: number[] };

  /** IFC semantic identity retained for reconstructed/native elements. */
  ifc?: {
    entity: string;
    globalId?: string;
    sourceGlobalId?: string;
    predefinedType?: string;
    tag?: string;
    description?: string;
    sourceModelId?: string;
    sourceLocalId?: number;
    sourceModelName?: string;
    propertySets?: Record<string, unknown>;
    quantities?: Record<string, unknown>;
  };

  /** World transform of a reconstructed/imported native project object. */
  transform?: {
    position: [number, number, number];
    quaternion: [number, number, number, number];
    scale: [number, number, number];
  };
}

// ── Datum ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface GridDatum {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  start: Vec2;
  end: Vec2;
}

export interface LevelDatum {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  elevation: number;
  /** Optional display colour for datum visibility in the plan / 3D. */
  color?: string;
}

// ── Model metadata ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface ProjectModelMeta {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  bytes: number;
  /** Set when the model's blob was not found during project open. */
  missing?: boolean;

  /**
   * World-space position of the model's root object at save time.
   *
   * Persisting this allows re-opens to reproduce the exact same shared-
   * coordinate placement the user had on screen when they saved.
   *
   * Why: the Fragments autoCoordinator assigns each model a different
   * world position to avoid overlaps. For IFC in shared coordinates that
   * shift is wrong — geometry is authored to sit at the correct relative
   * position. This field + the enforcement guard in projects.ts keep
   * models where the user put them.
   */
  position?: [number, number, number];
}

// ── Positioning (Revit-style linking modes) ───────────────────────────────
export type PositioningMode =
  | "origin-to-origin"
  | "shared-coordinates"
  | "center-to-center"
  | "project-base-to-project-base"
  | "manual";

// ── Element Types / Parameters (Revit-style type system foundation) ───────
export type ParamDataType = "text" | "number" | "integer" | "yesno" | "length" | "area" | "volume" | "angle" | "material";

export interface ParameterDef {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  group: string;
  dataType: ParamDataType;
  unit?: string;
  shared?: boolean;
  defaultValue?: string | number | boolean;
}

export interface ElementTypeDef {
  id: string;
  category: ElementType;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Type parameters (shared across instances of this type). */
  parameters: Record<string, string | number | boolean>;
  materialId?: string;
  color?: string;
}

// ── Materials ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface MaterialDef {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: "concrete" | "steel" | "timber" | "glass" | "insulation" | "finish" | "mep" | "other";
  color: string;
  density?: number; // kg/m³
  thermalConductivity?: number;
  costPerUnit?: number;
  unit?: string;
}

// ── Sheets / Production documentation ─────────────────────────────────────
export interface SheetViewport {
  id: string;
  viewId: string;       // plan view id or saved view id
  viewType: "plan" | "3d" | "elevation" | "section" | "schedule";
  x: number;            // mm on sheet
  y: number;
  width: number;        // mm
  height: number;
  scale: string;        // e.g. "1:100"
  title?: string;
}

export interface SheetDef {
  id: string;
  number: string;       // e.g. "A-101"
  name: string;
  size: "A0" | "A1" | "A2" | "A3" | "A4" | "ANSI-D" | "ANSI-E" | "Arch-D" | "Arch-E";
  orientation: "portrait" | "landscape";
  titleblockId?: string;
  viewports: SheetViewport[];
  annotations?: { id: string; kind: string; text: string; x: number; y: number }[];
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export interface TitleblockDef {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  size: SheetDef["size"];
  fields: { key: string; label: string; value: string }[];
}

// ── Automation rules ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface AutomationRule {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  trigger: "on-selection" | "on-save" | "on-clash" | "manual" | "on-import";
  /** Simple condition expression, e.g. category=IfcWall AND height>3 */
  condition?: string;
  actions: { type: string; params: Record<string, unknown> }[];
}

// ── Project document ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type ProjectStatus = "active" | "on-hold" | "complete" | "archived";
export type ProjectTemplate = "blank" | "coordination" | "mep-delivery" | "documentation" | "construction";
export type ProjectUnits = "metric" | "imperial";

export interface ProjectDoc {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;

  /** Optional enterprise/project-control metadata. */
  projectNumber?: string;
  client?: string;
  phase?: string;
  description?: string;
  status?: ProjectStatus;
  units?: ProjectUnits;
  template?: ProjectTemplate;
  owner?: string;

  elements: AuthoredElement[];
  models: ProjectModelMeta[];

  issues?: Issue[];
  cost?: CostData;
  grids?: GridDatum[];
  levels?: LevelDatum[];

  /** Element type catalog (families / types). */
  elementTypes?: ElementTypeDef[];
  /** Project + shared parameters. */
  parameters?: ParameterDef[];
  /** Material library. */
  materials?: MaterialDef[];
  /** Production sheets. */
  sheets?: SheetDef[];
  titleblocks?: TitleblockDef[];
  /** Automation rules. */
  automationRules?: AutomationRule[];

  appState?: {
    cam?: [number, number, number];
    target?: [number, number, number];
  };

  /** Persisted positioning mode used when linking IFC / FRAG files. */
  positioningMode?: PositioningMode;

  /** Revit-style: the level that was active when the project was saved. */
  activeLevelId?: string | null;

  /** Persisted FRAG/native twin edits (move / rotate / scale + copied BIM data). */
  fragEdits?: FragEditLite[];
  /** Native openBIM reconstructions created from linked IFC/FRAG objects. */
  nativeTwins?: NativeTwinLite[];

  /** Persisted clash review statuses and comments (keyed by clash pair). */
  clashStates?: Array<{
    key: string;
    status: string;
    comments: Array<{ id?: string; author?: string; text: string; at?: number }>;
    assignee?: string;
    updatedAt?: number;
  }>;

  /** Persisted 2D annotations (dimensions, tags, notes) keyed per view. */
  annotations?: {
    dimensions: unknown[];
    tags: unknown[];
    notes: unknown[];
    updatedAt: number;
  };
}


/** A persisted editable twin reconstructed from a linked openBIM element. */
export interface NativeTwinLite extends FragEditLite {
  sourceType: "IFC" | "FRAG" | "openBIM";
  /** New project identity for the editable twin; never reuses the source IFC GlobalId. */
  nativeId?: string;
  nativeEntity?: string;
  sourceGlobalId?: string;
  sourceEntity?: string;
  sourceModelName?: string;
  sourceTag?: string;
  predefinedType?: string;
  description?: string;
  objectPlacement?: number[];
  dimensions: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
    depth: number;
    min: [number, number, number];
    max: [number, number, number];
    center: [number, number, number];
  };
  /** Exact non-indexed triangle positions in twin-local coordinates. */
  geometry?: { positions: number[] };
  /** Full IFC/FRAG attributes and psets copied at reconstruction time. */
  sourceData?: Record<string, unknown>;
  propertySets?: Record<string, unknown>;
  quantities?: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Native overrides edited by the user after reconstruction. */
  overrides?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * Lightweight mirror of `features/frag-edit.ts::FragEdit`.
 * Kept here so this file has no imports from the features layer (avoids
 * circular dependencies), while remaining structurally compatible.
 */
export interface FragEditLite {
  id: string;
  modelId: string;
  localId: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  position: [number, number, number];
  quaternion: [number, number, number, number];
  scale: [number, number, number];
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
}

// ── Project summary (list views) ──────────────────────────────────────────
export interface ProjectSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
  elementCount: number;
  modelCount: number;
  issueCount: number;
  projectNumber?: string;
  client?: string;
  phase?: string;
  status?: ProjectStatus;
  units?: ProjectUnits;
  template?: ProjectTemplate;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Railing Generator - path-based railings with balusters (Revit-style).
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export interface RailingParams {
  /** Path points in world XZ (y used as elevation offset). */
  path: Array<{ x: number; y?: number; z: number }>;
  /** Top rail height above path elevation. */
  height: number;
  /** Baluster spacing (m). */
  balusterSpacing: number;
  /** Baluster cross-section size. */
  balusterSize: number;
  /** Top rail diameter. */
  railDiameter: number;
  /** Number of intermediate horizontal rails (0 = none). */
  intermediateRails: number;
  /** Base elevation. */
  elevation: number;
}

export interface RailingResult {
  balusterCount: number;
  length: number;
  object: THREE.Object3D;
}

const DEFAULTS: RailingParams = {
  path: [
    { x: 0, z: 0 },
    { x: 3, z: 0 },
  ],
  height: 1.1,
  balusterSpacing: 0.12,
  balusterSize: 0.02,
  railDiameter: 0.04,
  intermediateRails: 1,
  elevation: 0,
};

function pathLength(path: RailingParams["path"]): number {
  let len = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
    const a = path[i - 1];
    const b = path[i];
    len += Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
  }
  return len;
}

function pointAt(path: RailingParams["path"], dist: number): { x: number; z: number; tx: number; tz: number } {
  let remaining = dist;
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
    const a = path[i - 1];
    const b = path[i];
    const seg = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (seg < 1e-9) continue;
    if (remaining <= seg) {
      const t = remaining / seg;
      const tx = (b.x - a.x) / seg;
      const tz = (b.z - a.z) / seg;
      return {
        x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,
        z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t,
        tx,
        tz,
      };
    }
    remaining -= seg;
  }
  const last = path[path.length - 1];
  const prev = path[path.length - 2] ?? last;
  const seg = Math.hypot(last.x - prev.x, last.z - prev.z) || 1;
  return {
    x: last.x,
    z: last.z,
    tx: (last.x - prev.x) / seg,
    tz: (last.z - prev.z) / seg,
  };
}

export function buildRailing(input: Partial<RailingParams> = {}): RailingResult {
  const p: RailingParams = {
    ...DEFAULTS,
    ...input,
    path: input.path?.length ? input.path : DEFAULTS.path,
  };

  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = "obs-railing";
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xcbd5e1 });
  const length = pathLength(p.path);

  // Top rail as a tube along the path at height
  const railPts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
  const steps = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(length / 0.25));
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const d = (length * i) / steps;
    const pt = pointAt(p.path, d);
    railPts.push(new THREE.Vector3(pt.x, p.elevation + p.height, pt.z));
  }
  if (railPts.length >= 2) {
    const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(railPts);
    const railGeo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, steps * 2, p.railDiameter / 2, 8, false);
    group.add(new THREE.Mesh(railGeo, mat));
  }

  // Intermediate rails
  for (let r = 1; r <= p.intermediateRails; r++) {
    const h = p.elevation + (p.height * r) / (p.intermediateRails + 1);
    const pts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const d = (length * i) / steps;
      const pt = pointAt(p.path, d);
      pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(pt.x, h, pt.z));
    }
    if (pts.length >= 2) {
      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
      const geo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, steps * 2, p.railDiameter / 3, 6, false);
      group.add(new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat));
    }
  }

  // Balusters
  let balusterCount = 0;
  const spacing = Math.max(0.05, p.balusterSpacing);
  for (let d = 0; d <= length + 1e-6; d += spacing) {
    const pt = pointAt(p.path, Math.min(d, length));
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.balusterSize, p.height, p.balusterSize);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.position.set(pt.x, p.elevation + p.height / 2, pt.z);
    group.add(mesh);
    balusterCount++;
  }

  return { balusterCount, length, object: group };
}

export function setupRailings(): void {
  (ctx.features as any).railings = { buildRailing };
  (window as any).__obsRailings = { buildRailing };
  console.log("[railings] generator ready");
}
```
