```ts
/**
 * Reference Planes & Reference Lines - Revit-style construction geometry.
 *
 * Used as hosts for constraints, alignment targets, and work plane picks.
 * They are non-printing helper objects stored per project.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export type RefPlaneId = string;
export type RefLineId = string;

export interface RefPlane {
  id: RefPlaneId;
  name: string;
  /** Origin point (world metres). */
  origin: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  /** Unit normal. */
  normal: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  /** Extent half-size for display (m). */
  extent: number;
  pinned: boolean;
  /** Associated level if horizontal. */
  levelId?: string | null;
}

export interface RefLine {
  id: RefLineId;
  name: string;
  start: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  end: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  pinned: boolean;
}

const STORAGE = "obs.ref-planes.v1";
type Listener = () => void;

function uid(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

class RefPlanesStore {
  private planes = new Map<RefPlaneId, RefPlane>();
  private lines = new Map<RefLineId, RefLine>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private activeWorkPlaneId: RefPlaneId | null = null;
  private overlay: THREE.Group | null = null;
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
      if (raw) {
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        for (const p of data.planes ?? []) this.planes.set(p.id, p);
        for (const l of data.lines ?? []) this.lines.set(l.id, l);
        this.activeWorkPlaneId = data.activeWorkPlaneId ?? null;
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    // Seed three orthographic planes if empty
    if (!this.planes.size) {
      this.planes.set("rp-xy", {
        id: "rp-xy",
        name: "Floor Plane (XY)",
        origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        normal: { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 },
        extent: 50,
        pinned: true,
      });
      this.planes.set("rp-xz", {
        id: "rp-xz",
        name: "Front Plane (XZ)",
        origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        normal: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 },
        extent: 50,
        pinned: true,
      });
      this.planes.set("rp-yz", {
        id: "rp-yz",
        name: "Side Plane (YZ)",
        origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        normal: { x: 1, y: 0, z: 0 },
        extent: 50,
        pinned: true,
      });
      this.activeWorkPlaneId = "rp-xy";
      this.persist();
    }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE,
        JSON.stringify({
          planes: [...this.planes.values()],
          lines: [...this.lines.values()],
          activeWorkPlaneId: this.activeWorkPlaneId,
        }),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
    this.refreshOverlay();
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  listPlanes(): RefPlane[] {
    return [...this.planes.values()];
  }

  listLines(): RefLine[] {
    return [...this.lines.values()];
  }

  getPlane(id: RefPlaneId): RefPlane | null {
    return this.planes.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  createPlane(input: {
    name: string;
    origin: RefPlane["origin"];
    normal: RefPlane["normal"];
    extent?: number;
    levelId?: string | null;
  }): RefPlane {
    const plane: RefPlane = {
      id: uid("rp"),
      name: input.name,
      origin: { ...input.origin },
      normal: { ...input.normal },
      extent: input.extent ?? 20,
      pinned: false,
      levelId: input.levelId ?? null,
    };
    this.planes.set(plane.id, plane);
    this.persist();
    return plane;
  }

  createLine(input: {
    name: string;
    start: RefLine["start"];
    end: RefLine["end"];
  }): RefLine {
    const line: RefLine = {
      id: uid("rl"),
      name: input.name,
      start: { ...input.start },
      end: { ...input.end },
      pinned: false,
    };
    this.lines.set(line.id, line);
    this.persist();
    return line;
  }

  removePlane(id: RefPlaneId): boolean {
    const p = this.planes.get(id);
    if (!p || p.pinned) return false;
    this.planes.delete(id);
    if (this.activeWorkPlaneId === id) this.activeWorkPlaneId = "rp-xy";
    this.persist();
    return true;
  }

  removeLine(id: RefLineId): boolean {
    const ok = this.lines.delete(id);
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  getActiveWorkPlane(): RefPlane | null {
    return this.activeWorkPlaneId
      ? this.planes.get(this.activeWorkPlaneId) ?? null
      : null;
  }

  setActiveWorkPlane(id: RefPlaneId): void {
    if (!this.planes.has(id)) return;
    this.activeWorkPlaneId = id;
    this.persist();
  }

  /** THREE.Plane for raycasting / placement. */
  toThreePlane(id: RefPlaneId): THREE.Plane | null {
    const p = this.planes.get(id);
    if (!p) return null;
    return new THREE.Plane(
      new THREE.Vector3(p.normal.x, p.normal.y, p.normal.z).normalize(),
      -new THREE.Vector3(p.origin.x, p.origin.y, p.origin.z).dot(
        new THREE.Vector3(p.normal.x, p.normal.y, p.normal.z).normalize(),
      ),
    );
  }

  /** Project a world point onto the active work plane. */
  projectToWorkPlane(point: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 | null {
    const plane = this.activeWorkPlaneId
      ? this.toThreePlane(this.activeWorkPlaneId)
      : null;
    if (!plane) return null;
    const out = new THREE.Vector3();
    plane.projectPoint(point, out);
    return out;
  }

  private refreshOverlay(): void {
    const scene = (ctx as any).world?.scene?.three as THREE.Scene | undefined;
    if (!scene) return;

    if (this.overlay) {
      scene.remove(this.overlay);
      this.overlay.traverse((o: any) => {
        if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose?.();
        if (o.material) {
          if (Array.isArray(o.material)) o.material.forEach((m: any) => m.dispose?.());
          else o.material.dispose?.();
        }
      });
    }

    this.overlay = new THREE.Group();
    this.overlay.name = "obs-ref-planes";
    this.overlay.userData.isHelper = true;

    for (const p of this.planes.values()) {
      if (p.pinned && p.id !== this.activeWorkPlaneId) continue; // only show active orthographic by default
      const size = p.extent;
      const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size * 2, size * 2);
      const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: p.id === this.activeWorkPlaneId ? 0x38bdf8 : 0x64748b,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.08,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        depthWrite: false,
      });
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(p.origin.x, p.origin.y, p.origin.z);
      mesh.lookAt(
        p.origin.x + p.normal.x,
        p.origin.y + p.normal.y,
        p.origin.z + p.normal.z,
      );
      mesh.userData.refPlaneId = p.id;
      this.overlay.add(mesh);

      // Edge outline
      const edges = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geo);
      const line = new THREE.LineSegments(
        edges,
        new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
          color: p.id === this.activeWorkPlaneId ? 0x38bdf8 : 0x475569,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.5,
        }),
      );
      line.position.copy(mesh.position);
      line.quaternion.copy(mesh.quaternion);
      this.overlay.add(line);
    }

    for (const l of this.lines.values()) {
      const pts = [
        new THREE.Vector3(l.start.x, l.start.y, l.start.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(l.end.x, l.end.y, l.end.z),
      ];
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
      const line = new THREE.Line(
        geo,
        new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf59e0b, linewidth: 1 }),
      );
      line.userData.refLineId = l.id;
      this.overlay.add(line);
    }

    scene.add(this.overlay);
  }

  showOverlay(visible: boolean): void {
    if (this.overlay) this.overlay.visible = visible;
  }
}

export const refPlanesStore = new RefPlanesStore();

export function setupRefPlanes(): typeof refPlanesStore {
  refPlanesStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).refPlanes = refPlanesStore;
  (window as any).__obsRefPlanes = refPlanesStore;
  // Deferred overlay attach once scene exists
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    try { (refPlanesStore as any).refreshOverlay?.(); } catch { /* */ }
  }, 800);
  console.log("[ref-planes] ready -", refPlanesStore.listPlanes().length, "planes");
  return refPlanesStore;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * IFC export of the AUTHORED model (walls, slabs, columns, beams, doors,
 * windows, MEP runs, native twins) and rooms -> IfcSpace.
 *
 * Pure TypeScript: no three.js, no DOM, no project imports - it takes plain
 * data and returns the STEP text, so it can be unit-tested in Node.
 *
 * Coordinates
 *   Authored plan coordinates are (x, z) with Y up (three.js). IFC is Z up,
 *   so IFC (X, Y, Z) = (x, -z, y). That is a proper rotation (det = +1), so
 *   triangle winding and handedness are preserved.
 *
 * Schemas
 *   IFC4 (default) and IFC2X3. Revit 2020 reads IFC2X3 everywhere; use that
 *   when an IFC4 file is rejected.
 *
 * What is exported analytically (extruded solids, so Revit/BIM tools can edit
 * them): wall, slab/roof/ceiling polygons, column, footing, beam, brace,
 * duct / pipe / cable-tray / conduit, door + window (with real openings in the
 * host wall), equipment (box proxy), rooms (IfcSpace). Native twins are
 * written as tessellated geometry. Anything else is reported in
 * `stats.skipped` instead of being silently dropped.
 */
import { stableIfcGuid, isValidIfcGuid } from "./ifc-guid";
import { buildElementGeo, m2Quantities } from "./m2-geometry";

export type Vec2 = [number, number];
export type IfcSchema = "IFC4" | "IFC2X3";

export interface IfcElementInput {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  name?: string;
  color?: string;
  hostId?: string;
  levelId?: string;
  familyId?: string;
  familyTypeId?: string;
  params: {
    start?: Vec2; end?: Vec2; polygon?: Vec2[]; point?: Vec2;
    width?: number; depth?: number; height: number; thickness: number; elevation: number;
    offsetAlongHost?: number; sillHeight?: number;
    [k: string]: unknown;
  };
  properties?: Record<string, unknown>;
  nativeGeometry?: { positions: number[] };
  ifc?: { entity?: string; globalId?: string; sourceGlobalId?: string; tag?: string; description?: string; [k: string]: unknown };
  transform?: { position: [number, number, number]; quaternion: [number, number, number, number]; scale: [number, number, number] };
}

export interface IfcLevelInput { id: string; name: string; elevation: number }

export interface IfcSpaceInput {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  number: string;
  levelId: string | null;
  boundary: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>;
  holes?: Array<Array<{ x: number; z: number }>>;
  height: number;
  area?: number;
  department?: string;
}

export interface IfcExportOptions {
  schema?: IfcSchema;
  projectName?: string;
  projectId?: string;
  author?: string;
  organization?: string;
  fileName?: string;
  /** ISO timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS); defaults to now. Pass a fixed value for reproducible output. */
  timestamp?: string;
  levels?: IfcLevelInput[];
  spaces?: IfcSpaceInput[];
}

export interface IfcExportStats {
  schema: IfcSchema;
  storeys: number;
  elements: number;
  openings: number;
  spaces: number;
  byClass: Record<string, number>;
  skipped: Array<{ id: string; type: string; reason: string }>;
}

export interface IfcExportResult { text: string; stats: IfcExportStats }

/* ----------------------------------------------------------- STEP helpers */

function esc(s: string): string {
  let out = "";
  let run = "";
  const flush = () => { if (run) { out += "\\X2\\" + run + "\\X0\\"; run = ""; } };
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 39) { flush(); out += "''"; }
    else if (c === 92) { flush(); out += "\\\\"; }
    else if (c >= 32 && c <= 126) { flush(); out += s[i]; }
    else run += c.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(4, "0");
  }
  flush();
  return out;
}
const S = (s: string | undefined | null): string => (s == null || s === "" ? "$" : `'${esc(String(s))}'`);
function R(n: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "0.";
  let s = (Math.round(n * 1e6) / 1e6).toString();
  if (s.includes("e") || s.includes("E")) s = n.toFixed(9).replace(/0+$/, "");
  if (s === "-0") s = "0";
  if (!s.includes(".")) s += ".";
  return s;
}
const L = (items: string[]): string => `(${items.join(",")})`;

class Spf {
  private lines: string[] = [];
  private pointCache = new Map<string, number>();
  private dirCache = new Map<string, number>();
  add(name: string, args: string[]): number {
    const id = this.lines.length + 1;
    this.lines.push(`#${id}=${name}(${args.join(",")});`);
    return id;
  }
  point3(x: number, y: number, z: number): number {
    const k = `${R(x)}|${R(y)}|${R(z)}`;
    let id = this.pointCache.get(k);
    if (!id) { id = this.add("IFCCARTESIANPOINT", [L([R(x), R(y), R(z)])]); this.pointCache.set(k, id); }
    return id;
  }
  point2(x: number, y: number): number {
    const k = `2|${R(x)}|${R(y)}`;
    let id = this.pointCache.get(k);
    if (!id) { id = this.add("IFCCARTESIANPOINT", [L([R(x), R(y)])]); this.pointCache.set(k, id); }
    return id;
  }
  dir3(x: number, y: number, z: number): number {
    const l = Math.hypot(x, y, z) || 1;
    const k = `${R(x / l)}|${R(y / l)}|${R(z / l)}`;
    let id = this.dirCache.get(k);
    if (!id) { id = this.add("IFCDIRECTION", [L([R(x / l), R(y / l), R(z / l)])]); this.dirCache.set(k, id); }
    return id;
  }
  dir2(x: number, y: number): number {
    const l = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1;
    return this.add("IFCDIRECTION", [L([R(x / l), R(y / l)])]);
  }
  get size(): number { return this.lines.length; }
  body(): string { return this.lines.join("\n"); }
}
const ref = (n: number): string => `#${n}`;

type V3 = [number, number, number];
const norm3 = (a: V3): V3 => { const l = Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]) || 1; return [a[0] / l, a[1] / l, a[2] / l]; };

/** three.js (x, y, z) -> IFC (X, Y, Z). */
const toIfc = (x: number, y: number, z: number): V3 => [x, -z, y];

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- entities */

type Kind =
  | "wall" | "slab" | "covering" | "column" | "beam" | "member" | "footing"
  | "door" | "window" | "duct" | "pipe" | "tray" | "conduit" | "proxy"
  | "stair" | "railing" | "ramp" | "curtain";

interface ClassDef { name: string; tail: string[] }
function classFor(kind: Kind, schema: IfcSchema, hint = ""): ClassDef {
  const v4 = schema === "IFC4";
  switch (kind) {
    case "wall": return v4 ? { name: "IFCWALL", tail: [".STANDARD."] } : { name: "IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE", tail: [] };
    case "slab": return { name: "IFCSLAB", tail: [hint || ".FLOOR."] };
    case "covering": return { name: "IFCCOVERING", tail: [".CEILING."] };
    case "column": return { name: "IFCCOLUMN", tail: v4 ? [".COLUMN."] : [] };
    case "beam": return { name: "IFCBEAM", tail: v4 ? [".BEAM."] : [] };
    case "member": return { name: "IFCMEMBER", tail: v4 ? [".BRACE."] : [] };
    case "footing": return { name: "IFCFOOTING", tail: [hint || ".PAD_FOOTING."] };
    case "duct": return v4 ? { name: "IFCDUCTSEGMENT", tail: [".RIGIDSEGMENT."] } : { name: "IFCFLOWSEGMENT", tail: [] };
    case "pipe": return v4 ? { name: "IFCPIPESEGMENT", tail: [".RIGIDSEGMENT."] } : { name: "IFCFLOWSEGMENT", tail: [] };
    case "tray": return v4 ? { name: "IFCCABLECARRIERSEGMENT", tail: [".CABLETRAYSEGMENT."] } : { name: "IFCFLOWSEGMENT", tail: [] };
    case "conduit": return v4 ? { name: "IFCCABLECARRIERSEGMENT", tail: [".CONDUITSEGMENT."] } : { name: "IFCFLOWSEGMENT", tail: [] };
    case "door": case "window": return { name: kind === "door" ? "IFCDOOR" : "IFCWINDOW", tail: [] }; // tail built by caller
    case "proxy": return { name: "IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY", tail: [v4 ? ".NOTDEFINED." : ".ELEMENT."] };
    case "stair": return { name: "IFCSTAIR", tail: [hint || ".STRAIGHT_RUN_STAIR."] };
    case "railing": return { name: "IFCRAILING", tail: [".GUARDRAIL."] };
    case "ramp": return { name: "IFCRAMP", tail: [".STRAIGHT_RUN_RAMP."] };
    case "curtain": return { name: "IFCCURTAINWALL", tail: v4 ? [".NOTDEFINED."] : [] };
  }
}

const DEFAULT_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  wall: "#d9d4c7", slab: "#9aa0a6", column: "#b0b4ba", beam: "#a9998a", door: "#8b6b4a", window: "#7fb3d5",
  duct: "#6fa8dc", pipe: "#38a169", "cable-tray": "#d69e2e", conduit: "#b7791f", equipment: "#a0aec0",
};

function parseColor(c: string | undefined, fallback: string): [number, number, number] {
  const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec((c || fallback || "").trim());
  const h = m ? m[1] : "cccccc";
  return [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16) / 255, parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16) / 255, parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16) / 255];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- the writer */

export function exportAuthoredToIfc(elementsIn: IfcElementInput[], opts: IfcExportOptions = {}): IfcExportResult {
  const schema: IfcSchema = opts.schema ?? "IFC4";
  const v4 = schema === "IFC4";
  const f = new Spf();
  const projectName = opts.projectName || "OpenBIMStudio project";
  const keyBase = opts.projectId || projectName;
  const stats: IfcExportStats = { schema, storeys: 0, elements: 0, openings: 0, spaces: 0, byClass: {}, skipped: [] };
  const bump = (cls: string) => { stats.byClass[cls] = (stats.byClass[cls] ?? 0) + 1; };

  /* owner history, units, context */
  const person = f.add("IFCPERSON", ["$", S(opts.author || "OpenBIMStudio"), "$", "$", "$", "$", "$", "$"]);
  const org = f.add("IFCORGANIZATION", ["$", S(opts.organization || "OpenBIMStudio"), "$", "$", "$"]);
  const po = f.add("IFCPERSONANDORGANIZATION", [ref(person), ref(org), "$"]);
  const app = f.add("IFCAPPLICATION", [ref(org), S("1.0"), S("OpenBIMStudio IFC writer"), S("OpenBIMStudio")]);
  const nowSec = Math.floor((opts.timestamp ? Date.parse(opts.timestamp + (opts.timestamp.endsWith("Z") ? "" : "Z")) : Date.now()) / 1000);
  const oh = f.add("IFCOWNERHISTORY", [ref(po), ref(app), "$", ".ADDED.", "$", ref(po), ref(app), String(nowSec)]);

  const uLen = f.add("IFCSIUNIT", ["*", ".LENGTHUNIT.", "$", ".METRE."]);
  const uArea = f.add("IFCSIUNIT", ["*", ".AREAUNIT.", "$", ".SQUARE_METRE."]);
  const uVol = f.add("IFCSIUNIT", ["*", ".VOLUMEUNIT.", "$", ".CUBIC_METRE."]);
  const uAng = f.add("IFCSIUNIT", ["*", ".PLANEANGLEUNIT.", "$", ".RADIAN."]);
  const units = f.add("IFCUNITASSIGNMENT", [L([ref(uLen), ref(uArea), ref(uVol), ref(uAng)])]);

  const origin = f.point3(0, 0, 0);
  const wcs = f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(origin), "$", "$"]);
  const ctx = f.add("IFCGEOMETRICREPRESENTATIONCONTEXT", ["$", S("Model"), "3", "1.E-05", ref(wcs), "$"]);
  const bodyCtx = v4
    ? f.add("IFCGEOMETRICREPRESENTATIONSUBCONTEXT", [S("Body"), S("Model"), "*", "*", "*", "*", ref(ctx), "$", ".MODEL_VIEW.", "$"])
    : ctx;

  const guid = (key: string) => stableIfcGuid(keyBase + "|" + key);

  /* project / site / building / storeys */
  const project = f.add("IFCPROJECT", [S(guid("project")), ref(oh), S(projectName), "$", "$", "$", "$", L([ref(ctx)]), ref(units)]);
  const axisAt = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(f.point3(x, y, z)), "$", "$"]);
  const place = (relTo: number | null, axis: number) => f.add("IFCLOCALPLACEMENT", [relTo ? ref(relTo) : "$", ref(axis)]);
  const sitePl = place(null, axisAt(0, 0, 0));
  const site = f.add("IFCSITE", [S(guid("site")), ref(oh), S("Site"), "$", "$", ref(sitePl), "$", "$", ".ELEMENT.", "$", "$", "$", "$", "$"]);
  const bldPl = place(sitePl, axisAt(0, 0, 0));
  const building = f.add("IFCBUILDING", [S(guid("building")), ref(oh), S("Building"), "$", "$", ref(bldPl), "$", "$", ".ELEMENT.", "$", "$", "$"]);
  f.add("IFCRELAGGREGATES", [S(guid("rel:proj-site")), ref(oh), "$", "$", ref(project), L([ref(site)])]);
  f.add("IFCRELAGGREGATES", [S(guid("rel:site-bld")), ref(oh), "$", "$", ref(site), L([ref(building)])]);

  let levels = (opts.levels ?? []).slice().sort((a, b) => a.elevation - b.elevation);
  if (!levels.length) levels = [{ id: "__level0", name: "Level 0", elevation: 0 }];
  const storeys = levels.map((lv) => {
    const pl = place(bldPl, axisAt(0, 0, lv.elevation));
    const id = f.add("IFCBUILDINGSTOREY", [S(guid("storey:" + lv.id)), ref(oh), S(lv.name), "$", "$", ref(pl), "$", S(lv.name), ".ELEMENT.", R(lv.elevation)]);
    return { lv, id, pl, contained: [] as number[], spaces: [] as number[] };
  });
  stats.storeys = storeys.length;
  f.add("IFCRELAGGREGATES", [S(guid("rel:bld-storeys")), ref(oh), "$", "$", ref(building), L(storeys.map((s) => ref(s.id)))]);

  const storeyFor = (levelId: string | null | undefined, elev: number) => {
    if (levelId) { const hit = storeys.find((s) => s.lv.id === levelId); if (hit) return hit; }
    let best = storeys[0];
    for (const s of storeys) if (s.lv.elevation <= elev + 0.01) best = s;
    return best;
  };

  /* styles (cached per colour) */
  const styleCache = new Map<string, number>();
  const styleFor = (rgb: [number, number, number]) => {
    const key = rgb.map((c) => c.toFixed(3)).join(",");
    let id = styleCache.get(key);
    if (!id) {
      const col = f.add("IFCCOLOURRGB", ["$", R(rgb[0]), R(rgb[1]), R(rgb[2])]);
      const rend = f.add("IFCSURFACESTYLERENDERING", [ref(col), "0.", "$", "$", "$", "$", "$", "$", ".NOTDEFINED."]);
      const ss = f.add("IFCSURFACESTYLE", [S("Style " + (styleCache.size + 1)), ".BOTH.", L([ref(rend)])]);
      id = v4 ? ss : f.add("IFCPRESENTATIONSTYLEASSIGNMENT", [L([ref(ss)])]);
      styleCache.set(key, id);
    }
    return id;
  };
  const styled = (item: number, rgb: [number, number, number]) => { f.add("IFCSTYLEDITEM", [ref(item), L([ref(styleFor(rgb))]), "$"]); };

  /* shape builders */
  const rep = (items: number[], type: string) => {
    const sr = f.add("IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION", [ref(bodyCtx), S("Body"), S(type), L(items.map(ref))]);
    return f.add("IFCPRODUCTDEFINITIONSHAPE", ["$", "$", L([ref(sr)])]);
  };
  type Profile =
    | { k: "rect"; cx: number; cy: number; xd: number; yd: number }
    | { k: "circle"; r: number }
    | { k: "poly"; pts: Vec2[]; holes?: Vec2[][] };
  const profileId = (p: Profile): number => {
    const pos2 = (cx: number, cy: number) => f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT2D", [ref(f.point2(cx, cy)), "$"]);
    if (p.k === "rect") return f.add("IFCRECTANGLEPROFILEDEF", [".AREA.", "$", ref(pos2(p.cx, p.cy)), R(p.xd), R(p.yd)]);
    if (p.k === "circle") return f.add("IFCCIRCLEPROFILEDEF", [".AREA.", "$", ref(pos2(0, 0)), R(p.r)]);
    const curve = (pts: Vec2[]) => f.add("IFCPOLYLINE", [L([...pts, pts[0]].map(([x, y]) => ref(f.point2(x, y))))]);
    if (p.holes && p.holes.length) {
      return f.add("IFCARBITRARYPROFILEDEFWITHVOIDS", [".AREA.", "$", ref(curve(p.pts)), L(p.holes.map((h) => ref(curve(h))))]);
    }
    return f.add("IFCARBITRARYCLOSEDPROFILEDEF", [".AREA.", "$", ref(curve(p.pts))]);
  };
  const extrude = (p: Profile, depth: number) => {
    const solidPos = f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(origin), "$", "$"]);
    return f.add("IFCEXTRUDEDAREASOLID", [ref(profileId(p)), ref(solidPos), ref(f.dir3(0, 0, 1)), R(depth)]);
  };

  /* property sets / quantities / materials */
  const relDefines = (obj: number, setId: number, key: string) =>
    f.add("IFCRELDEFINESBYPROPERTIES", [S(guid("relp:" + key)), ref(oh), "$", "$", L([ref(obj)]), ref(setId)]);
  const propertySet = (obj: number, name: string, props: Array<[string, string]>, key: string) => {
    if (!props.length) return;
    const ids = props.map(([n, v]) => f.add("IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE", [S(n), "$", v, "$"]));
    const ps = f.add("IFCPROPERTYSET", [S(guid("pset:" + key + ":" + name)), ref(oh), S(name), "$", L(ids.map(ref))]);
    relDefines(obj, ps, key + ":" + name);
  };
  const quantities = (obj: number, qs: Array<["L" | "A" | "V", string, number]>, key: string) => {
    if (!qs.length) return;
    const ids = qs.map(([k, n, val]) => {
      const nm = S(n);
      if (k === "L") return f.add("IFCQUANTITYLENGTH", v4 ? [nm, "$", "$", R(val), "$"] : [nm, "$", "$", R(val)]);
      if (k === "A") return f.add("IFCQUANTITYAREA", v4 ? [nm, "$", "$", R(val), "$"] : [nm, "$", "$", R(val)]);
      return f.add("IFCQUANTITYVOLUME", v4 ? [nm, "$", "$", R(val), "$"] : [nm, "$", "$", R(val)]);
    });
    const q = f.add("IFCELEMENTQUANTITY", [S(guid("qto:" + key)), ref(oh), S("BaseQuantities"), "$", "$", L(ids.map(ref))]);
    relDefines(obj, q, key + ":qto");
  };
  const customProps = (el: IfcElementInput): Array<[string, string]> => {
    const out: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ["ElementId", `IFCIDENTIFIER('${esc(el.id)}')`],
      ["AuthoredType", `IFCLABEL('${esc(el.type)}')`],
    ];
    if (el.familyId) out.push(["FamilyId", `IFCLABEL('${esc(el.familyId)}')`]);
    if (el.familyTypeId) out.push(["FamilyTypeId", `IFCLABEL('${esc(el.familyTypeId)}')`]);
    if (el.ifc?.entity) out.push(["SourceIfcEntity", `IFCLABEL('${esc(String(el.ifc.entity))}')`]);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(el.properties ?? {})) {
      if (out.length > 60) break;
      const name = k.replace(/[^\w .\-]/g, "_").slice(0, 60);
      if (!name) continue;
      if (typeof v === "string" && v.length <= 200) out.push([name, `IFCTEXT('${esc(v)}')`]);
      else if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) out.push([name, `IFCREAL(${R(v)})`]);
      else if (typeof v === "boolean") out.push([name, `IFCBOOLEAN(${v ? ".T." : ".F."})`]);
    }
    return out;
  };
  const materialCache = new Map<string, number>();
  const materialPending = new Map<number, number[]>();
  const associateMaterial = (obj: number, name: string) => {
    let m = materialCache.get(name);
    if (!m) { m = f.add("IFCMATERIAL", v4 ? [S(name), "$", "$"] : [S(name)]); materialCache.set(name, m); materialPending.set(m, []); }
    materialPending.get(m)!.push(obj);
  };

  /** Triangle soup (three.js axes) -> tessellated representation item in IFC axes, storey-relative Z. */
  const bakeTriangles = (pos: number[], tr: IfcElementInput["transform"] | undefined, storey: { lv: IfcLevelInput }): { item: number; repType: string } | null => {
    const verts: V3[] = [];
    const tris: Array<[number, number, number]> = [];
    const vmap = new Map<string, number>();
    const vid = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => {
      let wx = x, wy = y, wz = z;
      if (tr) {
        const sx = x * tr.scale[0], sy = y * tr.scale[1], sz = z * tr.scale[2];
        const [qx, qy, qz, qw] = tr.quaternion;
        const tx = 2 * (qy * sz - qz * sy), ty = 2 * (qz * sx - qx * sz), tz = 2 * (qx * sy - qy * sx);
        wx = sx + qw * tx + (qy * tz - qz * ty) + tr.position[0];
        wy = sy + qw * ty + (qz * tx - qx * tz) + tr.position[1];
        wz = sz + qw * tz + (qx * ty - qy * tx) + tr.position[2];
      }
      const [ix, iy, iz] = toIfc(wx, wy, wz);
      const v: V3 = [ix, iy, iz - storey.lv.elevation];
      const k = `${R(v[0])}|${R(v[1])}|${R(v[2])}`;
      let i = vmap.get(k);
      if (i === undefined) { i = verts.length; verts.push(v); vmap.set(k, i); }
      return i;
    };
    for (let i = 0; i + 8 < pos.length; i += 9) {
      const a = vid(pos[i], pos[i + 1], pos[i + 2]);
      const b = vid(pos[i + 3], pos[i + 4], pos[i + 5]);
      const c = vid(pos[i + 6], pos[i + 7], pos[i + 8]);
      if (a !== b && b !== c && a !== c) tris.push([a, b, c]);
    }
    if (!tris.length) return null;
    if (v4) {
      const pl = f.add("IFCCARTESIANPOINTLIST3D", [L(verts.map((v) => L(v.map(R))))]);
      return { item: f.add("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET", [ref(pl), "$", "$", L(tris.map((t) => L(t.map((n) => String(n + 1))))), "$"]), repType: "Tessellation" };
    }
    const pts = verts.map((v) => f.point3(v[0], v[1], v[2]));
    const faces = tris.map((t) => {
      const loop = f.add("IFCPOLYLOOP", [L(t.map((n) => ref(pts[n])))]);
      const bound = f.add("IFCFACEOUTERBOUND", [ref(loop), ".T."]);
      return f.add("IFCFACE", [L([ref(bound)])]);
    });
    const shell = f.add("IFCCLOSEDSHELL", [L(faces.map(ref))]);
    return { item: f.add("IFCFACETEDBREP", [ref(shell)]), repType: "Brep" };
  };

  /* element emission */
  const emitted = new Map<string, { id: number; storey: (typeof storeys)[number]; wall?: { start: Vec2; end: Vec2; elev: number; t: number; h: number } }>();
  const skip = (el: IfcElementInput, reason: string) => stats.skipped.push({ id: el.id, type: el.type, reason });

  const baseAttrs = (el: IfcElementInput, key: string, placement: number, shape: number | null, tail: string[], objectType?: string) => [
    S(isValidIfcGuid(el.ifc?.globalId) ? el.ifc!.globalId! : guid("el:" + key)),
    ref(oh),
    S(el.name || el.type),
    S(el.ifc?.description as string | undefined),
    S(objectType ?? el.familyTypeId ?? el.type),
    ref(placement),
    shape ? ref(shape) : "$",
    S(el.ifc?.tag as string | undefined ?? el.id),
    ...tail,
  ];

  const finishProduct = (el: IfcElementInput, id: number, storey: (typeof storeys)[number], cls: string, rgb: [number, number, number] | null, solids: number[]) => {
    storey.contained.push(id);
    bump(cls);
    stats.elements++;
    if (rgb) for (const s of solids) styled(s, rgb);
    propertySet(id, "OpenBIMStudio", customProps(el), el.id);
    const mat = el.properties?.material;
    if (typeof mat === "string" && mat.trim()) associateMaterial(id, mat.trim().slice(0, 80));
  };

  /** Member frame: Z along the member, X = the vertical (or world X for vertical members). */
  const linearFrame = (a: V3, b: V3) => {
    const dir = norm3([b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]]);
    const up: V3 = Math.abs(dir[2]) > 0.98 ? [1, 0, 0] : [0, 0, 1];
    const dot = up[0] * dir[0] + up[1] * dir[1] + up[2] * dir[2];
    const xr = norm3([up[0] - dir[0] * dot, up[1] - dir[1] * dot, up[2] - dir[2] * dot]);
    return { dir, xr };
  };

  const walls = elementsIn.filter((e) => e.type === "wall" && e.params.start && e.params.end);
  const order = [...walls, ...elementsIn.filter((e) => !(e.type === "wall" && e.params.start && e.params.end))];

  for (const el of order) {
    const p = el.params;
    const elev = Number(p.elevation) || 0;
    const H = Number(p.height) || 0;
    const T = Number(p.thickness) || 0;
    const rgb = parseColor(el.color, DEFAULT_COLOR[el.type] ?? "#cccccc");
    try {
      /* ---- native twin: baked triangles ---- */
      if (el.nativeGeometry?.positions && el.nativeGeometry.positions.length >= 9) {
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const baked = bakeTriangles(el.nativeGeometry.positions, el.transform, storey);
        if (!baked) { skip(el, "native geometry has no valid triangles"); continue; }
        const pl = place(storey.pl, axisAt(0, 0, 0));
        const cd = classFor("proxy", schema);
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, pl, rep([baked.item], baked.repType), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, rgb, [baked.item]);
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- M2 types: stairs, railings, ramps, curtain walls, sloped roofs (tessellated from the same generators as the viewport) ---- */
      if (el.type === "stairs" || el.type === "railing" || el.type === "ramp" || el.type === "curtain-wall" || el.type === "roof") {
        const geo = buildElementGeo(el as never);
        if (!geo) { skip(el, "incomplete parameters"); continue; }
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const items: Array<{ item: number; color: [number, number, number] }> = [];
        let repType = "";
        for (const part of geo.parts) {
          const baked = bakeTriangles(part.positions, undefined, storey);
          if (!baked) continue;
          repType = baked.repType;
          items.push({ item: baked.item, color: part.role === "glass" ? [0.49, 0.83, 0.99] : parseColor(el.color, part.color) });
        }
        if (!items.length) { skip(el, "generated geometry is empty"); continue; }
        const shape = String(el.properties?.stairShape ?? "straight");
        const cd = el.type === "stairs" ? classFor("stair", schema, shape === "L" ? ".QUARTER_TURN_STAIR." : shape === "U" ? ".HALF_TURN_STAIR." : ".STRAIGHT_RUN_STAIR.")
          : el.type === "railing" ? classFor("railing", schema)
          : el.type === "ramp" ? classFor("ramp", schema)
          : el.type === "curtain-wall" ? classFor("curtain", schema)
          : classFor("slab", schema, ".ROOF.");
        const pl = place(storey.pl, axisAt(0, 0, 0));
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, pl, rep(items.map((i) => i.item), repType), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, null, []);
        for (const i of items) styled(i.item, i.color);
        const q = m2Quantities(el as never);
        if (q) {
          const qs: Array<["L" | "A" | "V", string, number]> = [];
          if (q.length > 0) qs.push(["L", "Length", q.length]);
          if (q.area > 0) qs.push(["A", "GrossArea", q.area]);
          if (q.volume > 0) qs.push(["V", "GrossVolume", q.volume]);
          quantities(id, qs, el.id);
        }
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- walls ---- */
      if (el.type === "wall" && p.start && p.end) {
        const [ax, az] = p.start, [bx, bz] = p.end;
        const len = Math.hypot(bx - ax, bz - az);
        if (len < 0.05) { skip(el, "wall shorter than 5 cm"); continue; }
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const o = toIfc(ax, elev, az);
        const d = toIfc(bx - ax, 0, bz - az);
        const axis = f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(f.point3(o[0], o[1], o[2] - storey.lv.elevation)), ref(f.dir3(0, 0, 1)), ref(f.dir3(d[0], d[1], 0))]);
        const solid = extrude({ k: "rect", cx: len / 2, cy: 0, xd: len, yd: T }, H);
        const cd = classFor("wall", schema);
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, place(storey.pl, axis), rep([solid], "SweptSolid"), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey, wall: { start: p.start, end: p.end, elev, t: T, h: H } });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, rgb, [solid]);
        quantities(id, [["L", "Length", len], ["L", "Width", T], ["L", "Height", H], ["V", "GrossVolume", len * T * H]], el.id);
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- doors / windows (need an emitted host wall) ---- */
      if (el.type === "door" || el.type === "window") {
        const host = el.hostId ? emitted.get(el.hostId) : undefined;
        if (!host?.wall) { skip(el, "no exported host wall"); continue; }
        const w = Number(p.width) || (el.type === "door" ? 0.9 : 1.2);
        const h = H || (el.type === "door" ? 2.1 : 1.4);
        const sill = Number(p.sillHeight ?? 0) || 0;
        const hw = host.wall;
        const hl = Math.hypot(hw.end[0] - hw.start[0], hw.end[1] - hw.start[1]);
        if (hl < 0.05) { skip(el, "host wall too short"); continue; }
        const half = w / 2;
        const off = Math.max(half, Math.min(hl - half, Number(p.offsetAlongHost ?? hl / 2)));
        const cx = hw.start[0] + ((hw.end[0] - hw.start[0]) / hl) * off;
        const cz = hw.start[1] + ((hw.end[1] - hw.start[1]) / hl) * off;
        const o = toIfc(cx, hw.elev + sill, cz);
        const dd = toIfc(hw.end[0] - hw.start[0], 0, hw.end[1] - hw.start[1]);
        const origZ = o[2] - host.storey.lv.elevation;
        const mkAxis = () => f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(f.point3(o[0], o[1], origZ)), ref(f.dir3(0, 0, 1)), ref(f.dir3(dd[0], dd[1], 0))]);
        // opening (box through the wall) + void/fill relationships
        const openSolid = extrude({ k: "rect", cx: 0, cy: 0, xd: w, yd: hw.t + 0.02 }, h);
        const ocd = { name: "IFCOPENINGELEMENT", tail: v4 ? [".OPENING."] : [] };
        const openId = f.add(ocd.name, [
          S(guid("opening:" + el.id)), ref(oh), S((el.name || el.type) + " opening"), "$", S("Opening"),
          ref(place(host.storey.pl, mkAxis())), ref(rep([openSolid], "SweptSolid")), "$", ...ocd.tail,
        ]);
        stats.openings++;
        f.add("IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT", [S(guid("void:" + el.id)), ref(oh), "$", "$", ref(host.id), ref(openId)]);
        // the door / window itself
        const solid = extrude({ k: "rect", cx: 0, cy: 0, xd: w, yd: Math.max(0.04, hw.t * 0.9) }, h);
        const tail = el.type === "door"
          ? (v4 ? [R(h), R(w), ".DOOR.", ".NOTDEFINED.", "$"] : [R(h), R(w)])
          : (v4 ? [R(h), R(w), ".WINDOW.", ".NOTDEFINED.", "$"] : [R(h), R(w)]);
        const cd = classFor(el.type, schema);
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, place(host.storey.pl, mkAxis()), rep([solid], "SweptSolid"), tail));
        f.add("IFCRELFILLSELEMENT", [S(guid("fill:" + el.id)), ref(oh), "$", "$", ref(openId), ref(id)]);
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey: host.storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, host.storey, cd.name, rgb, [solid]);
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- slab / roof / ceiling polygons ---- */
      if (el.type === "slab" || el.type === "roof" || el.type === "ceiling") {
        if (!p.polygon || p.polygon.length < 3) { skip(el, "polygon missing"); continue; }
        const pts = p.polygon.map(([x, z]) => [x, -z] as Vec2);
        let area2 = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length]; area2 += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }
        if (area2 < 0) pts.reverse();
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const axis = axisAt(0, 0, elev - storey.lv.elevation);
        const solid = extrude({ k: "poly", pts }, H || T || 0.2);
        const name = `${el.name || ""} ${el.familyTypeId || ""} ${el.type}`.toLowerCase();
        const asCeiling = el.type === "ceiling" || /ceiling/.test(name);
        const cd = asCeiling ? classFor("covering", schema) : classFor("slab", schema, /roof/.test(name) ? ".ROOF." : ".FLOOR.");
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, place(storey.pl, axis), rep([solid], "SweptSolid"), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, rgb, [solid]);
        quantities(id, [["L", "Width", H || T], ["A", "GrossArea", Math.abs(area2) / 2], ["V", "GrossVolume", (Math.abs(area2) / 2) * (H || T)]], el.id);
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- point elements: column / footing / equipment ---- */
      if ((el.type === "column" || el.type === "footing" || el.type === "equipment") && p.point) {
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const base = el.type === "footing" ? elev - H : elev;
        const o = toIfc(p.point[0], base, p.point[1]);
        const axis = axisAt(o[0], o[1], o[2] - storey.lv.elevation);
        const sx = T, sy = Number(p.depth) || T;
        const solid = extrude({ k: "rect", cx: 0, cy: 0, xd: sx, yd: sy }, H);
        const cd = el.type === "column" ? classFor("column", schema) : el.type === "footing" ? classFor("footing", schema) : classFor("proxy", schema);
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, place(storey.pl, axis), rep([solid], "SweptSolid"), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, rgb, [solid]);
        quantities(id, [["L", "Height", H], ["V", "GrossVolume", sx * sy * H]], el.id);
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- linear members: beam / strip footing / duct / pipe / tray / conduit ---- */
      if (["beam", "strip", "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit"].includes(el.type) && p.start && p.end) {
        const [ax, az] = p.start, [bx, bz] = p.end;
        const len = Math.hypot(bx - ax, bz - az);
        if (len < 0.05) { skip(el, "run shorter than 5 cm"); continue; }
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const a = toIfc(ax, elev + H / 2, az), b = toIfc(bx, elev + H / 2, bz);
        const { dir, xr } = linearFrame(a, b);
        const axis = f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(f.point3(a[0], a[1], a[2] - storey.lv.elevation)), ref(f.dir3(dir[0], dir[1], dir[2])), ref(f.dir3(xr[0], xr[1], xr[2]))]);
        const round = el.type === "pipe" || el.type === "conduit";
        const solid = extrude(round ? { k: "circle", r: Math.max(T, 0.001) / 2 } : { k: "rect", cx: 0, cy: 0, xd: H, yd: T }, len);
        const kind: Kind = el.type === "beam" ? "beam" : el.type === "strip" ? "footing" : el.type === "duct" ? "duct" : el.type === "pipe" ? "pipe" : el.type === "cable-tray" ? "tray" : "conduit";
        const cd = classFor(kind, schema, ".STRIP_FOOTING.");
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, place(storey.pl, axis), rep([solid], "SweptSolid"), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, rgb, [solid]);
        quantities(id, [["L", "Length", len]], el.id);
        continue;
      }

      /* ---- brace (diagonal) ---- */
      if (el.type === "brace" && p.start && p.end) {
        const storey = storeyFor(el.levelId, elev);
        const a = toIfc(p.start[0], elev, p.start[1]), b = toIfc(p.end[0], elev + H, p.end[1]);
        const len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]);
        if (len < 0.05) { skip(el, "brace shorter than 5 cm"); continue; }
        const { dir, xr } = linearFrame(a, b);
        const axis = f.add("IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D", [ref(f.point3(a[0], a[1], a[2] - storey.lv.elevation)), ref(f.dir3(dir[0], dir[1], dir[2])), ref(f.dir3(xr[0], xr[1], xr[2]))]);
        const solid = extrude({ k: "rect", cx: 0, cy: 0, xd: T, yd: T }, len);
        const cd = classFor("member", schema);
        const id = f.add(cd.name, baseAttrs(el, el.id, place(storey.pl, axis), rep([solid], "SweptSolid"), cd.tail));
        emitted.set(el.id, { id, storey });
        finishProduct(el, id, storey, cd.name, rgb, [solid]);
        continue;
      }

      skip(el, `no analytic IFC exporter for type "${el.type}" yet`);
    } catch (e) {
      skip(el, "exception: " + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
    }
  }

  /* rooms -> IfcSpace */
  for (const sp of opts.spaces ?? []) {
    try {
      if (!sp.boundary || sp.boundary.length < 3) continue;
      const pts = sp.boundary.map((q) => [q.x, -q.z] as Vec2);
      let area2 = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length]; area2 += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }
      if (area2 < 0) pts.reverse();
      const holes = (sp.holes ?? []).filter((h) => h.length >= 3).map((h) => h.map((q) => [q.x, -q.z] as Vec2));
      const storey = storeyFor(sp.levelId, 0);
      const solid = extrude({ k: "poly", pts, holes }, sp.height || 2.7);
      const pl = place(storey.pl, axisAt(0, 0, 0));
      const tail = v4 ? [".ELEMENT.", ".INTERNAL.", "$"] : [".ELEMENT.", ".INTERNAL.", "$"];
      const id = f.add("IFCSPACE", [
        S(guid("space:" + sp.id)), ref(oh), S(sp.number), "$", S("Room"), ref(pl), ref(rep([solid], "SweptSolid")), S(sp.name), ...tail,
      ]);
      styled(solid, [0.55, 0.75, 0.95]);
      storey.spaces.push(id);
      stats.spaces++;
      bump("IFCSPACE");
      const netArea = sp.area ?? Math.abs(area2) / 2;
      propertySet(id, "Pset_SpaceCommon", [["Reference", `IFCIDENTIFIER('${esc(sp.number)}')`]], "space:" + sp.id);
      propertySet(id, "OpenBIMStudio", [["RoomName", `IFCLABEL('${esc(sp.name)}')`], ["RoomNumber", `IFCIDENTIFIER('${esc(sp.number)}')`], ...(sp.department ? ([["Department", `IFCLABEL('${esc(sp.department)}')`]] as Array<[string, string]>) : [])], "space2:" + sp.id);
      quantities(id, [["A", "NetFloorArea", netArea], ["L", "Height", sp.height || 2.7]], "space:" + sp.id);
    } catch (e) {
      stats.skipped.push({ id: sp.id, type: "room", reason: "exception: " + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)) });
    }
  }

  /* spatial containment, materials */
  for (const s of storeys) {
    if (s.contained.length) f.add("IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE", [S(guid("contain:" + s.lv.id)), ref(oh), "$", "$", L(s.contained.map(ref)), ref(s.id)]);
    if (s.spaces.length) f.add("IFCRELAGGREGATES", [S(guid("spaces:" + s.lv.id)), ref(oh), "$", "$", ref(s.id), L(s.spaces.map(ref))]);
  }
  for (const [mat, objs] of materialPending) {
    if (objs.length) f.add("IFCRELASSOCIATESMATERIAL", [S(guid("mat:" + mat)), ref(oh), "$", "$", L(objs.map(ref)), ref(mat)]);
  }

  const ts = (opts.timestamp || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19)).replace(/Z$/, "");
  const fileName = opts.fileName || "model.ifc";
  const view = v4 ? "ViewDefinition [ReferenceView_V1.2]" : "ViewDefinition [CoordinationView_V2.0]";
  const text = [
    "ISO-10303-21;",
    "HEADER;",
    `FILE_DESCRIPTION(('${view}'),'2;1');`,
    `FILE_NAME('${esc(fileName)}','${ts}',('${esc(opts.author || "OpenBIMStudio")}'),('${esc(opts.organization || "OpenBIMStudio")}'),'OpenBIMStudio IFC writer','OpenBIMStudio','');`,
    `FILE_SCHEMA(('${schema}'));`,
    "ENDSEC;",
    "DATA;",
    f.body(),
    "ENDSEC;",
    "END-ISO-10303-21;",
    "",
  ].join("\n");
  return { text, stats };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * IFC GlobalId helpers (buildingSMART "compressed GUID", 22 characters).
 *
 * A valid IFC GlobalId is the 128-bit GUID written as 22 base-64 digits using
 * the alphabet below. The first digit therefore only carries 2 bits and must be
 * one of 0-3. A random hex string is NOT a valid GlobalId.
 */
const CHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_$";

/** 32 hex characters (a UUID without dashes) -> 22-character IFC GlobalId. */
export function compressGuid(hex32: string): string {
  const hex = hex32.replace(/-/g, "").toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(hex)) throw new Error("compressGuid: expected 32 hex digits");
  let n = BigInt("0x" + hex);
  const out: string[] = new Array(22);
  for (let i = 21; i >= 0; i--) {
    out[i] = CHARS[Number(n & 63n)];
    n >>= 6n;
  }
  return out.join("");
}

/** 22-character IFC GlobalId -> 32 hex digits. */
export function decompressGuid(g: string): string {
  if (!isValidIfcGuid(g)) throw new Error("decompressGuid: not a valid IFC GlobalId");
  let n = 0n;
  for (const ch of g) n = (n << 6n) | BigInt(CHARS.indexOf(ch));
  return n.toString(16).padStart(32, "0");
}

export function isValidIfcGuid(g: unknown): g is string {
  if (typeof g !== "string" || g.length !== 22) return false;
  if ("0123".indexOf(g[0]) < 0) return false;
  for (const ch of g) if (CHARS.indexOf(ch) < 0) return false;
  return true;
}

function randomHex32(): string {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  const c: any = (globalThis as any).crypto;
  if (c?.getRandomValues) c.getRandomValues(bytes);
  else for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) bytes[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
  return Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

/** Fresh random GlobalId. */
export function newIfcGuid(): string {
  return compressGuid(randomHex32());
}

/** cyrb128 - small deterministic 128-bit string hash (four 32-bit words). */
function cyrb128(str: string): [number, number, number, number] {
  let h1 = 1779033703, h2 = 3144134277, h3 = 1013904242, h4 = 2773480762;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const k = str.charCodeAt(i);
    h1 = h2 ^ Math.imul(h1 ^ k, 597399067);
    h2 = h3 ^ Math.imul(h2 ^ k, 2869860233);
    h3 = h4 ^ Math.imul(h3 ^ k, 951274213);
    h4 = h1 ^ Math.imul(h4 ^ k, 2716044179);
  }
  h1 = Math.imul(h3 ^ (h1 >>> 18), 597399067);
  h2 = Math.imul(h4 ^ (h2 >>> 22), 2869860233);
  h3 = Math.imul(h1 ^ (h3 >>> 17), 951274213);
  h4 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (h4 >>> 19), 2716044179);
  return [(h1 ^ h2 ^ h3 ^ h4) >>> 0, (h2 ^ h1) >>> 0, (h3 ^ h1) >>> 0, (h4 ^ h1) >>> 0];
}

/**
 * Deterministic GlobalId derived from a stable key (e.g. an authored element
 * id). Re-exporting the same element always yields the same GlobalId, which
 * is what Revit / BCF / change tracking need.
 */
export function stableIfcGuid(key: string): string {
  const [a, b, c, d] = cyrb128("obs:" + key);
  const hex = [a, b, c, d].map((w) => w.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
  return compressGuid(hex);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Milestone 2 - geometry of the "real" authored element types that the app
 * had no mesh for: stairs, railings, curtain walls, ramps, roofs, ceilings.
 *
 * Pure TypeScript (no three.js, no DOM). Every generator returns closed,
 * outward-wound triangle soups in three.js coordinates (x, y up, z). The same
 * output feeds the viewport mesh builder, the IFC exporter (tessellation) and
 * the quantity takeoff, so what you see is what is exported and counted.
 *
 * Authored parameter conventions (so move / copy / rotate / grips / undo work
 * with the existing authoring engine):
 *   stairs        start,end = run line of the first flight; width; height = total rise
 *   railing       polygon   = open path (vertices are grips); height = rail height
 *   ramp          start,end; width; height = rise; thickness = slab
 *   curtain-wall  start,end; height; thickness = mullion depth
 *   roof          polygon;   elevation = eaves level; thickness
 *   ceiling       polygon;   elevation = ceiling level; thickness
 * Everything else lives in element.properties (see readParams below).
 */
export type Vec2 = [number, number];
type V3 = [number, number, number];

export interface Part { positions: number[]; color: string; role: "solid" | "glass"; name: string }
export interface GeoResult { parts: Part[]; info: Record<string, number | string | boolean> }

export interface GeoElement {
  type: string;
  params: { start?: Vec2; end?: Vec2; polygon?: Vec2[]; point?: Vec2; width?: number; depth?: number; height: number; thickness: number; elevation: number; [k: string]: unknown };
  properties?: Record<string, unknown>;
  color?: string;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- soup */

export class Soup {
  p: number[] = [];
  tri(a: V3, b: V3, c: V3): void { this.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], b[0], b[1], b[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  quad(a: V3, b: V3, c: V3, d: V3): void { this.tri(a, b, c); this.tri(a, c, d); }
}
const sub3 = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const add3 = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]];
const mul3 = (a: V3, s: number): V3 => [a[0] * s, a[1] * s, a[2] * s];
const cross3 = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
const dot3 = (a: V3, b: V3): number => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
const len3 = (a: V3): number => Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
const norm3 = (a: V3): V3 => { const l = len3(a) || 1; return [a[0] / l, a[1] / l, a[2] / l]; };
const area2 = (p: Vec2[]): number => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { const a = p[i], b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; s += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; } return s / 2; };

/** Signed volume of a closed triangle soup (positive when wound outward). */
export function signedVolume(pos: number[]): number {
  let v = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i + 8 < pos.length; i += 9) {
    const a: V3 = [pos[i], pos[i + 1], pos[i + 2]], b: V3 = [pos[i + 3], pos[i + 4], pos[i + 5]], c: V3 = [pos[i + 6], pos[i + 7], pos[i + 8]];
    v += dot3(a, cross3(b, c)) / 6;
  }
  return v;
}

/** Every undirected edge must be shared by exactly two triangles, once per direction. */
export function isWatertight(pos: number[], eps = 1e-5): boolean {
  const key = (v: V3) => `${Math.round(v[0] / eps)},${Math.round(v[1] / eps)},${Math.round(v[2] / eps)}`;
  const count = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i + 8 < pos.length; i += 9) {
    const vs: V3[] = [[pos[i], pos[i + 1], pos[i + 2]], [pos[i + 3], pos[i + 4], pos[i + 5]], [pos[i + 6], pos[i + 7], pos[i + 8]]];
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const a = key(vs[k]), b = key(vs[(k + 1) % 3]);
      if (a === b) continue;
      count.set(`${a}>${b}`, (count.get(`${a}>${b}`) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  }
  for (const [k, n] of count) {
    const [a, b] = k.split(">");
    if (n !== 1 || count.get(`${b}>${a}`) !== 1) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------- triangulation (ear clip) */

/** Ear-clip a simple polygon; returns CCW index triples (in the polygon's own axes). */
export function earClip(poly: Vec2[]): Array<[number, number, number]> {
  const n = poly.length;
  if (n < 3) return [];
  const idx = poly.map((_, i) => i);
  if (area2(poly) < 0) idx.reverse();
  const out: Array<[number, number, number]> = [];
  const cr = (a: Vec2, b: Vec2, c: Vec2) => (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0]);
  const inTri = (p: Vec2, a: Vec2, b: Vec2, c: Vec2) => cr(a, b, p) >= -1e-12 && cr(b, c, p) >= -1e-12 && cr(c, a, p) >= -1e-12;
  let guard = 0;
  while (idx.length > 3 && guard++ < 10000) {
    let clipped = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {
      const ia = idx[(i - 1 + idx.length) % idx.length], ib = idx[i], ic = idx[(i + 1) % idx.length];
      const a = poly[ia], b = poly[ib], c = poly[ic];
      if (cr(a, b, c) <= 1e-12) continue; // reflex or collinear
      let ear = true;
      for (const j of idx) {
        if (j === ia || j === ib || j === ic) continue;
        const q = poly[j];
        if ((q[0] === a[0] && q[1] === a[1]) || (q[0] === b[0] && q[1] === b[1]) || (q[0] === c[0] && q[1] === c[1])) continue;
        if (inTri(q, a, b, c)) { ear = false; break; }
      }
      if (!ear) continue;
      out.push([ia, ib, ic]);
      idx.splice(i, 1);
      clipped = true;
      break;
    }
    if (!clipped) { // degenerate input: drop a vertex so we always terminate
      const i = 0;
      out.push([idx[(i - 1 + idx.length) % idx.length], idx[i], idx[(i + 1) % idx.length]]);
      idx.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
  if (idx.length === 3) out.push([idx[0], idx[1], idx[2]]);
  return out.filter(([a, b, c]) => Math.abs(cr(poly[a], poly[b], poly[c])) > 1e-14);
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- primitives */

/** Convex oriented box between two points with a w x h cross-section (winding fixed by centroid test). */
export function orientedBox(a: V3, b: V3, w: number, h: number, soup: Soup, sideHint?: V3): void {
  const axis = norm3(sub3(b, a));
  let side = cross3(axis, [0, 1, 0]);
  if (len3(side) < 1e-6) {
    // vertical member: take the hint (e.g. the wall normal) made perpendicular to the axis, else world X
    const hint = sideHint ?? [1, 0, 0];
    side = sub3(hint, mul3(axis, dot3(hint, axis)));
    if (len3(side) < 1e-6) side = [1, 0, 0];
  }
  side = norm3(side);
  const upv = norm3(cross3(side, axis));
  const corner = (base: V3, sx: number, sy: number): V3 => add3(add3(base, mul3(side, (sx * w) / 2)), mul3(upv, (sy * h) / 2));
  const c: V3[] = [];
  for (const base of [a, b]) for (const sy of [-1, 1]) for (const sx of [-1, 1]) c.push(corner(base, sx, sy));
  // corner index = base*4 + (sy>0)*2 + (sx>0)
  const faces: Array<[number, number, number, number]> = [
    [0, 1, 3, 2], [4, 6, 7, 5], // start / end caps
    [0, 4, 5, 1], [2, 3, 7, 6], // -sy / +sy
    [0, 2, 6, 4], [1, 5, 7, 3], // -sx / +sx
  ];
  const centre = mul3(add3(a, b), 0.5);
  for (const f of faces) {
    const [p, q, r, s] = f.map((i) => c[i]);
    const nrm = cross3(sub3(q, p), sub3(r, p));
    const fc = mul3(add3(add3(p, q), add3(r, s)), 0.25);
    if (dot3(nrm, sub3(fc, centre)) >= 0) soup.quad(p, q, r, s); else soup.quad(s, r, q, p);
  }
}

/** Vertical prism of a plan polygon between y0 and y1 (outward winding for any simple polygon). */
export function prismPlan(poly: Vec2[], y0: number | ((x: number, z: number) => number), y1: number | ((x: number, z: number) => number), soup: Soup): void {
  const pts = area2(poly) < 0 ? poly.slice().reverse() : poly.slice(); // CCW in (x, z) axes
  const f0 = typeof y0 === "function" ? y0 : () => y0;
  const f1 = typeof y1 === "function" ? y1 : () => y1;
  const P = (p: Vec2, f: (x: number, z: number) => number): V3 => [p[0], f(p[0], p[1]), p[1]];
  for (const [a, b, c] of earClip(pts)) {
    soup.tri(P(pts[a], f0), P(pts[b], f0), P(pts[c], f0)); // CCW in (x,z) => normal -Y (bottom)
    soup.tri(P(pts[c], f1), P(pts[b], f1), P(pts[a], f1)); // reversed => normal +Y (top)
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length];
    if (Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) < 1e-9) continue;
    soup.quad(P(b, f0), P(a, f0), P(a, f1), P(b, f1));
  }
}

/**
 * Extrude a (u, h) profile (any simple polygon) along a lateral width.
 * Position = origin + dir*u + up*h + lat*s, s in [-width/2, +width/2].
 */
function extrudeProfile(profile: Vec2[], origin: V3, dir: Vec2, lat: Vec2, width: number, soup: Soup): void {
  const pr = area2(profile) < 0 ? profile.slice().reverse() : profile.slice(); // CCW in (u, h)
  const eu: V3 = [dir[0], 0, dir[1]], eh: V3 = [0, 1, 0], es: V3 = [lat[0], 0, lat[1]];
  const rightHanded = dot3(cross3(eu, eh), es) > 0;
  const at = (q: Vec2, s: number): V3 => [origin[0] + dir[0] * q[0] + lat[0] * s, origin[1] + q[1], origin[2] + dir[1] * q[0] + lat[1] * s];
  const emit = (a: V3, b: V3, c: V3) => (rightHanded ? soup.tri(a, b, c) : soup.tri(a, c, b));
  const hw = width / 2;
  for (const [a, b, c] of earClip(pr)) {
    emit(at(pr[a], hw), at(pr[b], hw), at(pr[c], hw));      // +s cap
    emit(at(pr[c], -hw), at(pr[b], -hw), at(pr[a], -hw));   // -s cap
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < pr.length; i++) {
    const a = pr[i], b = pr[(i + 1) % pr.length];
    emit(at(a, -hw), at(b, -hw), at(b, hw));
    emit(at(a, -hw), at(b, hw), at(a, hw));
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ stairs */

export interface StairParams {
  start: Vec2; end: Vec2; width: number; totalRise: number; elevation: number;
  shape?: "straight" | "L" | "U"; turn?: "left" | "right"; maxRiser?: number;
  waist?: number; landingThickness?: number; run2?: number; gap?: number; color?: string;
}

/**
 * (u, h) profile of one flight: n risers over run length L (n equal treads; the last tread is flush with the
 * landing / upper floor), stepped top, sloped underside leaving `waist` of solid under every inside corner.
 */
export function flightProfile(n: number, L: number, rh: number, waist: number): Vec2[] {
  const td = L / n;
  const top: Vec2[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) top.push([i * td, i * rh], [i * td, (i + 1) * rh]);
  top.push([L, n * rh]);
  const bottom: Vec2[] = [[0, 0]];
  const u0 = waist > 1e-6 ? (waist * td) / rh : 0;
  if (waist > 1e-6 && u0 < L * 0.9) bottom.push([u0, 0], [L, n * rh - waist]);
  else bottom.push([L, 0]);
  const rev = top.slice().reverse(); // starts at (L, n*rh), ends at (0, 0)
  rev.pop();                          // (0, 0) is already the first bottom point
  return [...bottom, ...rev];
}

export interface StairFlight { n: number; run: number; start: Vec2; dir: Vec2; /** height of the flight's floor above the stair base */ h0: number }
export interface StairLayout {
  n: number; riserHeight: number; width: number; flights: StairFlight[];
  /** landing slabs: plan polygon + top height above the stair base */
  landings: Array<{ poly: Vec2[]; top: number }>;
  info: GeoResult["info"];
}

/** Plan layout of a stair (flights, landings, riser count). Shared by the 3D generator and the plan symbol. */
export function stairLayout(p: StairParams): StairLayout {
  const dx = p.end[0] - p.start[0], dz = p.end[1] - p.start[1];
  const L1 = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L1 < 0.3) throw new Error("stair run is shorter than 0.3 m");
  if (!(p.width > 0.1)) throw new Error("stair width must be > 0.1 m");
  if (!(p.totalRise > 0.05)) throw new Error("stair rise must be > 0.05 m");
  const dir: Vec2 = [dx / L1, dz / L1];
  const leftPerp: Vec2 = [dir[1], -dir[0]];
  const rightPerp: Vec2 = [-dir[1], dir[0]];
  const shape = p.shape ?? "straight";
  const w = p.width;
  const maxRiser = p.maxRiser ?? 0.175;
  const info: GeoResult["info"] = {};
  const n = Math.max(shape === "straight" ? 2 : 4, Math.ceil(p.totalRise / maxRiser - 1e-9));
  const rh = p.totalRise / n;
  const flights: StairFlight[] = [];
  const landings: StairLayout["landings"] = [];
  if (shape === "straight") {
    flights.push({ n, run: L1, start: p.start, dir, h0: 0 });
    info.flights = 1; info.treadDepth = L1 / n;
  } else {
    const n1 = Math.floor(n / 2), n2 = n - n1;
    const L2 = Math.max(0.3, p.run2 ?? L1);
    const h1 = n1 * rh;
    const turnDir = (p.turn ?? "left") === "left" ? leftPerp : rightPerp;
    const at = (u: number, s: number, latDir: Vec2): Vec2 => [p.start[0] + dir[0] * u + latDir[0] * s, p.start[1] + dir[1] * u + latDir[1] * s];
    flights.push({ n: n1, run: L1, start: p.start, dir, h0: 0 });
    if (shape === "L") {
      landings.push({ poly: [at(L1, -w / 2, leftPerp), at(L1 + w, -w / 2, leftPerp), at(L1 + w, w / 2, leftPerp), at(L1, w / 2, leftPerp)], top: h1 });
      const c = at(L1 + w / 2, 0, leftPerp);
      flights.push({ n: n2, run: L2, start: [c[0] + turnDir[0] * (w / 2), c[1] + turnDir[1] * (w / 2)], dir: turnDir, h0: h1 });
    } else {
      const gap = p.gap ?? 0.1;
      const a0 = -w / 2, a1 = a0 + w + gap + w; // lateral range measured along turnDir
      landings.push({ poly: [at(L1, a0, turnDir), at(L1 + w, a0, turnDir), at(L1 + w, a1, turnDir), at(L1, a1, turnDir)], top: h1 });
      const off = w + gap;
      flights.push({ n: n2, run: L2, start: [p.start[0] + dir[0] * L1 + turnDir[0] * off, p.start[1] + dir[1] * L1 + turnDir[1] * off], dir: [-dir[0], -dir[1]], h0: h1 });
    }
    info.flights = 2; info.treadDepth = L1 / n1; info.treadDepth2 = L2 / n2; info.landingHeight = h1 + p.elevation;
  }
  info.risers = n; info.riserHeight = rh; info.totalRise = p.totalRise;
  info.pitchDeg = (Math.atan2(rh, info.treadDepth as number) * 180) / Math.PI;
  info.compliant = rh <= 0.19 + 1e-9 && (info.treadDepth as number) >= 0.25 - 1e-9;
  return { n, riserHeight: rh, width: w, flights, landings, info };
}

export function buildStair(p: StairParams): GeoResult {
  const lay = stairLayout(p);
  const waist = Math.max(0, p.waist ?? 0.12);
  const lt = Math.max(0.05, p.landingThickness ?? 0.15);
  const soup = new Soup();
  for (const f of lay.flights) {
    extrudeProfile(flightProfile(f.n, f.run, lay.riserHeight, waist), [f.start[0], p.elevation + f.h0, f.start[1]], f.dir, [f.dir[1], -f.dir[0]], lay.width, soup);
  }
  for (const l of lay.landings) prismPlan(l.poly, p.elevation + l.top - lt, p.elevation + l.top, soup);
  return { parts: [{ positions: soup.p, color: p.color ?? "#b8b2a7", role: "solid", name: "Stair" }], info: lay.info };
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- railings */

export interface RailingParams {
  path: Vec2[]; elevation: number; height?: number; rise?: number; postSpacing?: number; balusterSpacing?: number;
  railSize?: number; postSize?: number; balusters?: boolean; bottomRail?: boolean; color?: string;
}

export function buildRailing(p: RailingParams): GeoResult {
  if (p.path.length < 2) throw new Error("railing needs at least 2 path points");
  const H = p.height ?? 1.0, rise = p.rise ?? 0, rs = p.railSize ?? 0.05, ps = p.postSize ?? 0.05;
  const maxPost = Math.max(0.3, p.postSpacing ?? 1.2), bs = Math.max(0.04, p.balusterSpacing ?? 0.12);
  const seg = [] as Array<{ a: Vec2; b: Vec2; len: number; s0: number }>;
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < p.path.length; i++) {
    const len = Math.hypot(p.path[i + 1][0] - p.path[i][0], p.path[i + 1][1] - p.path[i][1]);
    if (len < 1e-6) continue;
    seg.push({ a: p.path[i], b: p.path[i + 1], len, s0: total });
    total += len;
  }
  if (!seg.length) throw new Error("railing path has zero length");
  const yAt = (s: number) => p.elevation + (total > 0 ? rise * (s / total) : 0);
  const pt = (sg: (typeof seg)[number], t: number, dy: number): V3 => {
    const s = sg.s0 + sg.len * t;
    return [sg.a[0] + (sg.b[0] - sg.a[0]) * t, yAt(s) + dy, sg.a[1] + (sg.b[1] - sg.a[1]) * t];
  };
  const soup = new Soup();
  let posts = 0, bal = 0;
  const post = (v: V3) => { orientedBox(v, [v[0], v[1] + H, v[2]], ps, ps, soup); posts++; };
  for (const sg of seg) {
    orientedBox(pt(sg, 0, H), pt(sg, 1, H), rs * 1.2, rs, soup);                  // top rail
    if (p.bottomRail !== false) orientedBox(pt(sg, 0, 0.12 + rs / 2), pt(sg, 1, 0.12 + rs / 2), rs * 0.8, rs * 0.8, soup);
    const nPosts = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sg.len / maxPost));
    for (let k = 0; k < nPosts; k++) post(pt(sg, k / nPosts, 0));
    if (p.balusters !== false) {
      const nb = Math.floor(sg.len / bs);
      for (let k = 1; k < nb; k++) {
        const t = k / nb;
        if ((t * nPosts) % 1 < 1e-6 || Math.abs((t * nPosts) % 1 - 1) < 1e-6) continue; // do not overlap a post
        const v = pt(sg, t, 0.12 + rs);
        orientedBox(v, [v[0], v[1] + H - 0.12 - rs, v[2]], 0.012, 0.012, soup);
        bal++;
      }
    }
  }
  post(pt(seg[seg.length - 1], 1, 0));
  return { parts: [{ positions: soup.p, color: p.color ?? "#6b7280", role: "solid", name: "Railing" }], info: { length: total, posts, balusters: bal } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ curtain walls */

export interface CurtainParams {
  start: Vec2; end: Vec2; elevation: number; height: number; uSpacing?: number; vSpacing?: number;
  mullionWidth?: number; mullionDepth?: number; panelThickness?: number; color?: string;
}

export function buildCurtainWall(p: CurtainParams): GeoResult {
  const dx = p.end[0] - p.start[0], dz = p.end[1] - p.start[1];
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L < 0.3) throw new Error("curtain wall is shorter than 0.3 m");
  if (!(p.height > 0.3)) throw new Error("curtain wall height must be > 0.3 m");
  const dir: Vec2 = [dx / L, dz / L];
  const nu = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / Math.max(0.3, p.uSpacing ?? 1.5)));
  const nv = Math.max(1, Math.round(p.height / Math.max(0.3, p.vSpacing ?? 1.2)));
  const mw = p.mullionWidth ?? 0.05, md = p.mullionDepth ?? 0.1, pt = p.panelThickness ?? 0.024;
  const frame = new Soup(), glass = new Soup();
  const P = (u: number, y: number): V3 => [p.start[0] + dir[0] * u, p.elevation + y, p.start[1] + dir[1] * u];
  const normal: V3 = [dir[1], 0, -dir[0]]; // horizontal, perpendicular to the wall
  // mullion cross-section: depth (md) across the wall, width (mw) along it
  for (let i = 0; i <= nu; i++) orientedBox(P((L * i) / nu, 0), P((L * i) / nu, p.height), md, mw, frame, normal);  // vertical mullions
  for (let j = 0; j <= nv; j++) {                                                                                    // horizontal mullions
    const y = (p.height * j) / nv;
    const yy = j === 0 ? mw / 2 : j === nv ? p.height - mw / 2 : y;
    orientedBox(P(0, yy), P(L, yy), md, mw, frame, normal);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < nu; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < nv; j++) {
      const u0 = (L * i) / nu + mw / 2, u1 = (L * (i + 1)) / nu - mw / 2;
      const y0 = (p.height * j) / nv + mw / 2, y1 = (p.height * (j + 1)) / nv - mw / 2;
      if (u1 - u0 < 0.02 || y1 - y0 < 0.02) continue;
      const cy = (y0 + y1) / 2;
      // thin pane: axis along the wall; cross-section = thickness (across the wall) x pane height (up)
      orientedBox(P(u0, cy), P(u1, cy), pt, y1 - y0, glass, normal);
    }
  }
  return {
    parts: [
      { positions: frame.p, color: p.color ?? "#374151", role: "solid", name: "Mullions" },
      { positions: glass.p, color: "#7dd3fc", role: "glass", name: "Glazing" },
    ],
    info: { columns: nu, rows: nv, panels: nu * nv, length: L },
  };
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- ramps */

export interface RampParams { start: Vec2; end: Vec2; width: number; rise: number; thickness: number; elevation: number; color?: string }
export function buildRamp(p: RampParams): GeoResult {
  const dx = p.end[0] - p.start[0], dz = p.end[1] - p.start[1];
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L < 0.3) throw new Error("ramp is shorter than 0.3 m");
  if (!(p.width > 0.2)) throw new Error("ramp width must be > 0.2 m");
  const t = Math.max(0.05, p.thickness);
  const dir: Vec2 = [dx / L, dz / L], lat: Vec2 = [dir[1], -dir[0]];
  const soup = new Soup();
  const prof: Vec2[] = [[0, 0], [L, p.rise], [L, p.rise + t], [0, t]];
  extrudeProfile(prof, [p.start[0], p.elevation, p.start[1]], dir, lat, p.width, soup);
  const slope = L > 0 ? p.rise / L : 0;
  return { parts: [{ positions: soup.p, color: p.color ?? "#a8a29e", role: "solid", name: "Ramp" }], info: { length: L, slopePercent: slope * 100, ratio: slope > 0 ? `1:${(1 / slope).toFixed(1)}` : "flat", compliant: slope <= 1 / 12 + 1e-9 } };
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- roofs */

export interface RoofParams { polygon: Vec2[]; elevation: number; thickness: number; slopeDeg: number; roofType?: "gable" | "shed"; dirDeg?: number; color?: string }

function clipHalf(poly: Vec2[], f: (p: Vec2) => number): Vec2[] {
  // keep the part where f(p) >= 0 (Sutherland-Hodgman against one half-plane)
  const out: Vec2[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) {
    const a = poly[i], b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length];
    const fa = f(a), fb = f(b);
    if (fa >= 0) out.push(a);
    if ((fa >= 0) !== (fb >= 0)) { const t = fa / (fa - fb); out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]); }
  }
  return out;
}

export function buildRoof(p: RoofParams): GeoResult {
  if (p.polygon.length < 3) throw new Error("roof needs a footprint polygon");
  const slope = Math.tan((Math.max(1, Math.min(75, p.slopeDeg)) * Math.PI) / 180);
  const t = Math.max(0.03, p.thickness);
  const a = ((p.dirDeg ?? 0) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const s: Vec2 = [Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a)];
  const proj = (q: Vec2) => q[0] * s[0] + q[1] * s[1];
  const ps = p.polygon.map(proj);
  const pmin = Math.min(...ps), pmax = Math.max(...ps), mid = (pmin + pmax) / 2, half = (pmax - pmin) / 2;
  const type = p.roofType ?? "gable";
  const top = (x: number, z: number): number => {
    const d = x * s[0] + z * s[1];
    return p.elevation + slope * (type === "shed" ? d - pmin : half - Math.abs(d - mid));
  };
  const soup = new Soup();
  const pieces = type === "shed" ? [p.polygon] : [clipHalf(p.polygon, (q) => mid - proj(q)), clipHalf(p.polygon, (q) => proj(q) - mid)];
  for (const piece of pieces) {
    if (piece.length >= 3 && Math.abs(area2(piece)) > 1e-6) prismPlan(piece, (x, z) => top(x, z) - t, top, soup);
  }
  const rise = slope * (type === "shed" ? pmax - pmin : half);
  return { parts: [{ positions: soup.p, color: p.color ?? "#9a3412", role: "solid", name: "Roof" }], info: { ridgeHeight: p.elevation + rise, rise, planArea: Math.abs(area2(p.polygon)), surfaceArea: Math.abs(area2(p.polygon)) / Math.cos(Math.atan(slope)) } };
}

export interface CeilingParams { polygon: Vec2[]; elevation: number; thickness: number; color?: string }
export function buildCeiling(p: CeilingParams): GeoResult {
  if (p.polygon.length < 3) throw new Error("ceiling needs a polygon");
  const t = Math.max(0.005, p.thickness);
  const soup = new Soup();
  prismPlan(p.polygon, p.elevation, p.elevation + t, soup);
  return { parts: [{ positions: soup.p, color: p.color ?? "#e5e7eb", role: "solid", name: "Ceiling" }], info: { area: Math.abs(area2(p.polygon)) } };
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------- authored-element glue */

export const M2_TYPES = ["stairs", "railing", "ramp", "curtain-wall", "roof", "ceiling"] as const;
export type M2Type = (typeof M2_TYPES)[number];
export const isM2Type = (t: string): t is M2Type => (M2_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(t);

const num = (v: unknown, d: number): number => (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : d);
const str = <T extends string>(v: unknown, d: T): T => (typeof v === "string" && v ? (v as T) : d);


/** Stair parameters of an authored element (null when the run line is missing). */
export function stairParamsOf(el: GeoElement): StairParams | null {
  const p = el.params, pr = el.properties ?? {};
  if (!p.start || !p.end) return null;
  return {
    start: p.start, end: p.end, width: num(p.width, 1.2), totalRise: num(p.height, 3), elevation: num(p.elevation, 0),
    shape: str(pr.stairShape, "straight"), turn: str(pr.stairTurn, "left"), maxRiser: num(pr.maxRiser, 0.175), waist: num(pr.waist, 0.12),
    landingThickness: num(pr.landingThickness, 0.15), run2: pr.run2 == null ? undefined : num(pr.run2, 0), gap: num(pr.gap, 0.1), color: el.color,
  };
}

/** Geometry for an authored element of an M2 type (null when the type is not M2 or params are incomplete). */
export function buildElementGeo(el: GeoElement): GeoResult | null {
  const p = el.params, pr = el.properties ?? {};
  const color = el.color;
  switch (el.type) {
    case "stairs": {
      const sp = stairParamsOf(el);
      return sp ? buildStair(sp) : null;
    }
    case "railing": {
      const path = p.polygon ?? (p.start && p.end ? [p.start, p.end] : null);
      if (!path || path.length < 2) return null;
      return buildRailing({
        path, elevation: num(p.elevation, 0), height: num(p.height, 1), rise: num(pr.rise, 0), postSpacing: num(pr.postSpacing, 1.2),
        balusterSpacing: num(pr.balusterSpacing, 0.12), railSize: num(p.thickness, 0.05), balusters: pr.balusters !== false, color,
      });
    }
    case "ramp":
      if (!p.start || !p.end) return null;
      return buildRamp({ start: p.start, end: p.end, width: num(p.width, 1.5), rise: num(p.height, 0.6), thickness: num(p.thickness, 0.2), elevation: num(p.elevation, 0), color });
    case "curtain-wall":
      if (!p.start || !p.end) return null;
      return buildCurtainWall({
        start: p.start, end: p.end, elevation: num(p.elevation, 0), height: num(p.height, 3.6), uSpacing: num(pr.uSpacing, 1.5), vSpacing: num(pr.vSpacing, 1.2),
        mullionWidth: num(pr.mullionWidth, 0.05), mullionDepth: num(p.thickness, 0.1), color,
      });
    case "roof":
      if (!p.polygon || p.polygon.length < 3) return null;
      return buildRoof({ polygon: p.polygon, elevation: num(p.elevation, 3), thickness: num(p.thickness, 0.2), slopeDeg: num(pr.slope, 30), roofType: str(pr.roofType, "gable"), dirDeg: num(pr.slopeDirection, 0), color });
    case "ceiling":
      if (!p.polygon || p.polygon.length < 3) return null;
      return buildCeiling({ polygon: p.polygon, elevation: num(p.elevation, 2.7), thickness: num(p.thickness, 0.02), color });
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

export interface M2Quantities { length: number; area: number; volume: number; detail: string }

/** Takeoff quantities for the cost / schedule modules (volume = real mesh volume of the solid parts). */
export function m2Quantities(el: GeoElement): M2Quantities | null {
  let g: GeoResult | null;
  try { g = buildElementGeo(el); } catch { return null; }
  if (!g) return null;
  const solid = g.parts.filter((x) => x.role === "solid").reduce((s, x) => s + signedVolume(x.positions), 0);
  const p = el.params;
  const L = p.start && p.end ? Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]) : 0;
  switch (el.type) {
    case "stairs": return { length: L, area: L * num(p.width, 1.2), volume: solid, detail: `${g.info.risers} risers x ${(num(g.info.riserHeight as number, 0) * 1000).toFixed(0)} mm` };
    case "railing": return { length: num(g.info.length as number, 0), area: 0, volume: solid, detail: `${g.info.posts} posts, ${g.info.balusters} balusters` };
    case "ramp": return { length: L, area: L * num(p.width, 1.5), volume: solid, detail: `slope ${(g.info.slopePercent as number).toFixed(1)} %` };
    case "curtain-wall": return { length: L, area: L * num(p.height, 3.6), volume: solid, detail: `${g.info.panels} panels` };
    case "roof": return { length: 0, area: num(g.info.surfaceArea as number, 0), volume: solid, detail: `slope ${num(el.properties?.slope, 30)} deg` };
    case "ceiling": return { length: 0, area: num(g.info.area as number, 0), volume: solid, detail: "ceiling" };
    default: return null;
  }
}
```
