```ts
/**
 * Milestone 2 registration: makes stairs, railings, ramps, curtain walls, roofs
 * and ceilings first-class authored elements.
 *
 *  - mesh builders: authoring.createMesh() asks window.__obsMeshBuilders[type]
 *    (one anchored line added by the installer) before giving up on a type;
 *  - Properties palette: schemas for the six types (SCHEMAS is a mutable table);
 *  - quantities: window.__obsM2Quantities(el) feeds the cost takeoff (installer patch).
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { SCHEMAS, type ElementSchema, type PropertyField } from "../../features/property-schema";
import { buildElementGeo, m2Quantities, M2_TYPES } from "./m2-geometry";

type Any = Record<string, any>;
const warned = new Set<string>();

export function buildM2Mesh(el: Any): THREE.Object3D | null {
  let geo;
  try { geo = buildElementGeo(el as never); }
  catch (e) {
    if (!warned.has(el.id)) { warned.add(el.id); console.warn(`[revit-gaps] ${el.type} ${el.id}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`); }
    return null;
  }
  if (!geo) return null;
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = `${el.type}:${el.id}`;
  for (const part of geo.parts) {
    if (part.positions.length < 9) continue;
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(part.positions, 3));
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    const glass = part.role === "glass";
    const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(part.color), transparent: glass, opacity: glass ? 0.35 : 1, depthWrite: !glass });
    if (el.type === "roof" || el.type === "ceiling") mat.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(g, mat);
    mesh.userData.elementId = el.id;
    mesh.userData.baseColor = part.color;
    mesh.userData.m2Part = part.name;
    group.add(mesh);
  }
  return group.children.length ? group : null;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- palette schemas */

const D = "Dimensions", C = "Constraints", I = "Identity Data", M = "Materials", K = "Construction";
const num = (key: string, label: string, group: string, step = 0.05, min?: number, max?: number, unit = "m"): PropertyField =>
  ({ key, label, group, type: "number", unit, step, min, max, target: "params" });
const prop = (key: string, label: string, group: string, step = 0.05, min?: number, max?: number, unit = "m", def?: number): PropertyField =>
  ({ key, label, group, type: "number", unit, step, min, max, target: "properties", default: def });
const sel = (key: string, label: string, group: string, options: Array<[string, string]>, def: string): PropertyField =>
  ({ key, label, group, type: "select", target: "properties", options: options.map(([value, l]) => ({ value, label: l })), default: def });
const common = (): PropertyField[] => [
  { key: "name", label: "Name", group: I, type: "text", target: "root" },
  { key: "typeMark", label: "Type mark", group: I, type: "text", target: "properties" },
  { key: "comments", label: "Comments", group: I, type: "text", target: "properties" },
  { key: "color", label: "Color", group: M, type: "color", target: "root" },
];
const elev = (label = "Base elevation") => num("elevation", label, C, 0.1);
const schema = (type: ElementSchema["type"], label: string, icon: string, fields: PropertyField[]): ElementSchema =>
  ({ type, label, icon, groups: [D, C, K, I, M], fields: [...fields, ...common()] });

export function registerM2Schemas(): void {
  const S = SCHEMAS as Any;
  S.stairs = schema("stairs" as never, "Stair", "stairs", [
    num("height", "Total rise", D, 0.05, 0.3), num("width", "Run width", D, 0.05, 0.5), elev(),
    sel("stairShape", "Shape", K, [["straight", "Straight run"], ["L", "L-shape (quarter turn)"], ["U", "U-shape (half turn)"]], "straight"),
    sel("stairTurn", "Turn direction", K, [["left", "Left"], ["right", "Right"]], "left"),
    prop("maxRiser", "Max riser height", K, 0.005, 0.1, 0.25, "m", 0.175), prop("waist", "Waist thickness", K, 0.01, 0, 0.5, "m", 0.12),
    prop("run2", "Second flight length", K, 0.1, 0.5, undefined, "m"), prop("gap", "Gap between flights (U)", K, 0.05, 0, 1, "m", 0.1),
    prop("landingThickness", "Landing thickness", K, 0.01, 0.05, 0.5, "m", 0.15),
  ]);
  S.railing = schema("railing" as never, "Railing", "railing", [
    num("height", "Rail height", D, 0.05, 0.3), num("thickness", "Rail size", D, 0.01, 0.02), elev(),
    prop("rise", "Rise along path", C, 0.05, 0, undefined, "m", 0), prop("postSpacing", "Max post spacing", K, 0.1, 0.3, 4, "m", 1.2),
    prop("balusterSpacing", "Baluster spacing", K, 0.01, 0.04, 0.5, "m", 0.12),
    { key: "balusters", label: "Balusters", group: K, type: "boolean", target: "properties", default: true },
  ]);
  S.ramp = schema("ramp" as never, "Ramp", "ramp", [
    num("height", "Rise", D, 0.05, 0.05), num("width", "Width", D, 0.05, 0.5), num("thickness", "Slab thickness", D, 0.01, 0.05), elev(),
  ]);
  S["curtain-wall"] = schema("curtain-wall" as never, "Curtain wall", "curtain-wall", [
    num("height", "Height", D, 0.1, 0.5), num("thickness", "Mullion depth", D, 0.01, 0.03), elev(),
    prop("uSpacing", "Horizontal grid spacing", K, 0.1, 0.3, 6, "m", 1.5), prop("vSpacing", "Vertical grid spacing", K, 0.1, 0.3, 6, "m", 1.2),
    prop("mullionWidth", "Mullion width", K, 0.005, 0.02, 0.3, "m", 0.05),
  ]);
  S.roof = schema("roof" as never, "Roof", "roof", [
    num("thickness", "Thickness", D, 0.01, 0.03), elev("Eaves elevation"),
    sel("roofType", "Roof type", K, [["gable", "Gable"], ["shed", "Shed (single slope)"]], "gable"),
    prop("slope", "Slope", K, 1, 1, 75, "deg", 30), prop("slopeDirection", "Slope direction (0 = +X)", K, 5, -360, 360, "deg", 0),
  ]);
  S.ceiling = schema("ceiling" as never, "Ceiling", "ceiling", [num("thickness", "Thickness", D, 0.005, 0.005), elev("Ceiling elevation")]);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- setup */

let installed = false;
export function setupM2Register(): { ok: boolean; detail: string } {
  if (installed) return { ok: true, detail: "already installed" };
  installed = true;
  const w = window as Any;
  w.__obsMeshBuilders = w.__obsMeshBuilders ?? {};
  for (const t of M2_TYPES) w.__obsMeshBuilders[t] = buildM2Mesh;
  w.__obsM2Quantities = (el: Any) => m2Quantities(el as never);
  registerM2Schemas();
  // authored data may already contain these types: rebuild once so they appear
  try { (ctx.features as Any).authoring?.rebuildAuthored?.(); } catch { /* */ }
  return { ok: true, detail: `${M2_TYPES.length} element types: mesh builders, palette schemas, quantities` };
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/revit-gaps/m2-tools.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Milestone 2 placement tools (3D view): stairs (straight / L / U), railing,
 * ramp, curtain wall, roof, ceiling, plus "ceilings from rooms".
 *
 * Created elements are ordinary authored elements: they sit on the active level,
 * are saved with the project, selectable, editable through grips and the
 * Properties palette, move / copy / rotate like any other element, appear in the
 * cost takeoff, export to IFC, and every placement is one undo step.
 *
 * Interaction: click points on the level plane. Snaps to existing element
 * end points / vertices (0.25 m) and a 0.05 m grid; hold Shift for orthogonal.
 *   two-point tools (stairs, ramp, curtain wall): click start, click end
 *   polyline tools  (railing, roof, ceiling):     click points, double-click or Enter to finish
 *   Esc cancels.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";
import { history } from "../../features/history";
import { roomsStore } from "../rooms/rooms";
import type { Vec2 } from "./m2-geometry";

type Any = Record<string, any>;
export type M2Kind = "stairs" | "railing" | "ramp" | "curtain-wall" | "roof" | "ceiling";
export type StairShape = "straight" | "L" | "U";

const authoring = (): Any | null => ((ctx.features as Any).authoring ?? null);
const LABEL: Record<M2Kind, string> = { stairs: "Stair", railing: "Railing", ramp: "Ramp", "curtain-wall": "Curtain wall", roof: "Roof", ceiling: "Ceiling" };
const POLY: Record<M2Kind, boolean> = { stairs: false, railing: true, ramp: false, "curtain-wall": false, roof: true, ceiling: true };

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ levels */

interface Lv { id: string | null; elevation: number; above: number | null }
function levelContext(): Lv {
  const a = authoring();
  const levels: Any[] = (a?.getLevels?.() ?? []).slice().sort((x: Any, y: Any) => x.elevation - y.elevation);
  const id: string | null = a?.getActiveLevelId?.() ?? null;
  const cur = levels.find((l) => l.id === id);
  const elevation = cur ? Number(cur.elevation) || 0 : 0;
  const up = levels.find((l) => Number(l.elevation) > elevation + 0.05);
  return { id: cur?.id ?? null, elevation, above: up ? Number(up.elevation) : null };
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- element creation */

const uid = () => "m2-" + Date.now().toString(36) + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

export function defaultsFor(kind: M2Kind, pts: Vec2[], lv: Lv, shape: StairShape): { params: Any; properties: Any } {
  const levelH = lv.above != null ? lv.above - lv.elevation : null;
  switch (kind) {
    case "stairs":
      return { params: { start: pts[0], end: pts[1], width: 1.2, height: levelH ?? 3, thickness: 0.15, elevation: lv.elevation }, properties: { stairShape: shape, stairTurn: "left", maxRiser: 0.175 } };
    case "ramp":
      return { params: { start: pts[0], end: pts[1], width: 1.5, height: 0.5, thickness: 0.2, elevation: lv.elevation }, properties: {} };
    case "curtain-wall":
      return { params: { start: pts[0], end: pts[1], height: levelH ?? 3.6, thickness: 0.1, elevation: lv.elevation }, properties: { uSpacing: 1.5, vSpacing: 1.2 } };
    case "railing":
      return { params: { polygon: pts, height: 1.0, thickness: 0.05, elevation: lv.elevation }, properties: { balusterSpacing: 0.12, postSpacing: 1.2 } };
    case "roof": {
      const xs = pts.map((p) => p[0]), zs = pts.map((p) => p[1]);
      const alongX = Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs) >= Math.max(...zs) - Math.min(...zs);
      return { params: { polygon: pts, height: 0.2, thickness: 0.2, elevation: lv.above ?? lv.elevation + 3 }, properties: { roofType: "gable", slope: 30, slopeDirection: alongX ? 90 : 0 } };
    }
    case "ceiling":
      return { params: { polygon: pts, height: 0.02, thickness: 0.02, elevation: lv.elevation + 2.7 }, properties: {} };
  }
}

function nextName(kind: M2Kind): string {
  const n = ((authoring()?.getElements?.() ?? []) as Any[]).filter((e) => e.type === kind).length + 1;
  return `${LABEL[kind]} ${n}`;
}

/** Create one authored element as a single undo step. */
export function createM2Element(kind: M2Kind, pts: Vec2[], opts: { shape?: StairShape; lv?: Lv } = {}): Any | null {
  const a = authoring();
  if (!a?.getElements || !a.rebuildAuthored) { notify("warn", "Authoring not ready"); return null; }
  const lv = opts.lv ?? levelContext();
  const d = defaultsFor(kind, pts, lv, opts.shape ?? "straight");
  const el: Any = { id: uid(), type: kind, name: nextName(kind), params: d.params, properties: d.properties, levelId: lv.id ?? undefined };
  // validate by building once: a bad request is rejected instead of producing an invisible element
  void history.exec({
    label: `Place ${LABEL[kind]}`,
    apply: () => { const els: Any[] = a.getElements(); if (!els.includes(el)) els.push(el); a.rebuildAuthored(); },
    revert: () => { const els: Any[] = a.getElements(); const i = els.indexOf(el); if (i >= 0) els.splice(i, 1); a.rebuildAuthored(); },
  });
  try { a.setSelectedAuthored?.([el.id]); } catch { /* */ }
  return el;
}

/** One ceiling per room of the active level (skips rooms that already have one). */
export function ceilingsFromRooms(): number {
  const a = authoring();
  if (!a) return 0;
  const lv = levelContext();
  const els: Any[] = a.getElements();
  const inside = (pt: Vec2, poly: Vec2[]) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) { const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j]; if ((yi > pt[1]) !== (yj > pt[1]) && pt[0] < ((xj - xi) * (pt[1] - yi)) / (yj - yi) + xi) c = !c; } return c; };
  const made: Any[] = [];
  for (const r of roomsStore.listRooms()) {
    if (r.levelId !== lv.id || r.boundary.length < 3) continue;
    const poly: Vec2[] = r.boundary.map((p) => [p.x, p.z]);
    const lp = (r.properties?.labelPoint as Vec2 | undefined) ?? poly[0];
    if (els.some((e) => e.type === "ceiling" && e.params?.polygon && inside(lp, e.params.polygon))) continue;
    const d = defaultsFor("ceiling", poly, lv, "straight");
    d.params.elevation = lv.elevation + (r.height || 2.7);
    made.push({ id: uid(), type: "ceiling", name: `Ceiling ${r.number}`, params: d.params, properties: { ...d.properties, roomId: r.id }, levelId: lv.id ?? undefined });
  }
  if (!made.length) { notify("info", roomsStore.listRooms().length ? "Every room on this level already has a ceiling" : "Place rooms first (Room tool)"); return 0; }
  void history.exec({
    label: `Ceilings from ${made.length} room(s)`,
    apply: () => { for (const m of made) if (!els.includes(m)) els.push(m); a.rebuildAuthored(); },
    revert: () => { for (const m of made) { const i = els.indexOf(m); if (i >= 0) els.splice(i, 1); } a.rebuildAuthored(); },
  });
  notify("success", `Placed ${made.length} ceiling(s)`);
  return made.length;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ interactive tool */

interface Session { kind: M2Kind; shape: StairShape; pts: Vec2[]; cursor: Vec2 | null }
let session: Session | null = null;
let detach: (() => void) | null = null;
let preview: THREE.LineSegments | null = null;

function dom(): HTMLElement | undefined { return (ctx as Any).world?.renderer?.three?.domElement; }

function toPlane(e: MouseEvent, y: number): Vec2 | null {
  const el = dom(); const cam: THREE.Camera | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three;
  if (!el || !cam) return null;
  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
  ray.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 2 - 1, -((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 2 + 1), cam);
  const hit = new THREE.Vector3();
  return ray.ray.intersectPlane(new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), -y), hit) ? [hit.x, hit.z] : null;
}

/** Pure snapping: existing end points / vertices within 0.25 m, else a 0.05 m grid; optional ortho from the previous point. */
export function snapPoint(raw: Vec2, anchors: Vec2[], prev: Vec2 | null, ortho: boolean): Vec2 {
  let best: Vec2 | null = null, bd = 0.25;
  for (const a of anchors) { const d = Math.hypot(a[0] - raw[0], a[1] - raw[1]); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = a; } }
  let p: Vec2 = best ? [best[0], best[1]] : [Math.round(raw[0] / 0.05) * 0.05, Math.round(raw[1] / 0.05) * 0.05];
  if (ortho && prev && !best) {
    if (Math.abs(p[0] - prev[0]) >= Math.abs(p[1] - prev[1])) p = [p[0], prev[1]]; else p = [prev[0], p[1]];
  }
  return p;
}

function anchors(): Vec2[] {
  const out: Vec2[] = [];
  for (const e of (authoring()?.getElements?.() ?? []) as Any[]) {
    const p = e.params ?? {};
    if (p.start) out.push(p.start); if (p.end) out.push(p.end); if (p.point) out.push(p.point);
    if (Array.isArray(p.polygon)) for (const v of p.polygon) out.push(v);
  }
  for (const r of roomsStore.listRooms()) for (const b of r.boundary) out.push([b.x, b.z]);
  return out;
}

function drawPreview(): void {
  const scene: THREE.Scene | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three;
  if (!scene) return;
  if (preview) { scene.remove(preview); (preview.geometry as THREE.BufferGeometry).dispose(); (preview.material as THREE.Material).dispose(); preview = null; }
  if (!session || !session.pts.length) return;
  const lv = levelContext();
  const y = lv.elevation + 0.05;
  const pts = session.cursor ? [...session.pts, session.cursor] : session.pts.slice();
  const seg: number[] = [];
  const add = (a: Vec2, b: Vec2) => seg.push(a[0], y, a[1], b[0], y, b[1]);
  if (POLY[session.kind]) {
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < pts.length; i++) add(pts[i], pts[i + 1]);
    if (session.kind !== "railing" && pts.length > 2) add(pts[pts.length - 1], pts[0]);
  } else if (pts.length === 2) {
    const [a, b] = pts;
    add(a, b);
    if (session.kind !== "curtain-wall") {
      const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
      if (L > 1e-6) {
        const w = (session.kind === "ramp" ? 1.5 : 1.2) / 2, nx = ((b[1] - a[1]) / L) * w, nz = (-(b[0] - a[0]) / L) * w;
        const c: Vec2[] = [[a[0] + nx, a[1] + nz], [b[0] + nx, b[1] + nz], [b[0] - nx, b[1] - nz], [a[0] - nx, a[1] - nz]];
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) add(c[i], c[(i + 1) % 4]);
      }
    }
  }
  if (!seg.length) return;
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(seg, 3));
  preview = new THREE.LineSegments(g, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x22c55e, depthTest: false }));
  preview.renderOrder = 1000;
  scene.add(preview);
}

function finish(): void {
  if (!session) return;
  const s = session;
  const min = POLY[s.kind] ? (s.kind === "railing" ? 2 : 3) : 2;
  if (s.pts.length < min) { notify("info", `${LABEL[s.kind]}: need at least ${min} points`); return; }
  const el = createM2Element(s.kind, s.pts, { shape: s.shape });
  if (el) notify("success", `${el.name} placed on ${levelContext().id ? "the active level" : "level 0"}`, { timeout: 2000 });
  cancel();
}

export function cancelM2Tool(): void { cancel(); }
function cancel(): void { detach?.(); detach = null; session = null; drawPreview(); }

export function startM2Tool(kind: M2Kind, shape: StairShape = "straight"): void {
  const el = dom();
  if (!el) { notify("warn", "3D view not ready"); return; }
  cancel();
  try { authoring()?.setAuthoringTool?.("select"); } catch { /* */ }
  session = { kind, shape, pts: [], cursor: null };
  const ps = POLY[kind];
  let down: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
  let lastMove = 0;
  let cachedAnchors: Vec2[] = anchors();

  const point = (e: MouseEvent): Vec2 | null => {
    const lv = levelContext();
    const raw = toPlane(e, lv.elevation);
    if (!raw || !session) return null;
    return snapPoint(raw, cachedAnchors, session.pts.length ? session.pts[session.pts.length - 1] : null, e.shiftKey);
  };
  const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => { down = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; };
  const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
    if (e.button !== 0 || !session) return;
    if (down && Math.hypot(e.clientX - down.x, e.clientY - down.y) > 5) return; // camera drag
    e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault();
    const p = point(e);
    if (!p) return;
    const last = session.pts[session.pts.length - 1];
    if (last && Math.hypot(last[0] - p[0], last[1] - p[1]) < 1e-6) return; // duplicate (double-click)
    session.pts.push(p);
    session.cursor = null;
    if (!ps && session.pts.length === 2) finish(); else drawPreview();
  };
  const onDbl = (e: MouseEvent) => { if (session && ps) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault(); finish(); } };
  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (!session || now - lastMove < 40) return;
    lastMove = now;
    session.cursor = session.pts.length ? point(e) : null;
    drawPreview();
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (!session) return;
    const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.tagName;
    if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA") return;
    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); cancel(); notify("info", `${LABEL[kind]} cancelled`, { timeout: 1200 }); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter" && ps) { e.preventDefault(); finish(); }
  };
  const onTool = () => { const t = authoring()?.getActiveTool?.(); if (session && t && t !== "select") cancel(); };
  const unTool = authoring()?.onAuthoringChange?.(onTool);

  el.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, true);
  el.addEventListener("click", onClick, true);
  el.addEventListener("dblclick", onDbl, true);
  el.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
  el.style.cursor = "crosshair";
  detach = () => {
    el.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, true); el.removeEventListener("click", onClick, true);
    el.removeEventListener("dblclick", onDbl, true); el.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey, true); el.style.cursor = "";
    if (typeof unTool === "function") unTool();
  };
  const hint = ps ? "click points, double-click or Enter to finish, Esc to cancel" : "click start, then end (Shift = orthogonal, Esc = cancel)";
  notify("info", `${LABEL[kind]}${kind === "stairs" && shape !== "straight" ? ` (${shape})` : ""}: ${hint}`, { timeout: 3500 });
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- redirects */

let wrapped = false;
/** Route the legacy tool names (ST / RA / CW / RF / CL, ramp) and the origin-dropping parity buttons to these tools. */
export function installM2Redirects(): void {
  const w = window as Any;
  w.__obsM2 = { start: startM2Tool, cancel: cancelM2Tool, create: createM2Element, ceilingsFromRooms };
  const a = authoring();
  if (!a || wrapped || typeof a.setAuthoringTool !== "function") return;
  wrapped = true;
  const orig = a.setAuthoringTool.bind(a);
  const map: Record<string, M2Kind> = { stairs: "stairs", railing: "railing", ramp: "ramp", "curtain-wall": "curtain-wall", roof: "roof", ceiling: "ceiling" };
  a.setAuthoringTool = (tool: unknown, ...rest: unknown[]) => {
    if (typeof tool === "string" && map[tool]) { startM2Tool(map[tool]); return; }
    cancel();
    return orig(tool, ...rest);
  };
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/revit-gaps/m3-pdf-fill.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Filled polygons for the sheet PDF exporter.
 *
 * modules/export/pdf.ts fills polylines with pdf-lib's drawSvgPath(d, { x: 0, y: 0 }) while
 * passing page coordinates that are already y-up. drawSvgPath treats its path as y-DOWN
 * (it flips the y axis around the given origin), so those fills land below the page and
 * never show: poche, tag bubbles and translucent glazing would be missing from printed
 * sheets. This helper fills the polygon with raw PDF path operators in page coordinates,
 * which is unambiguous. It returns false when pdf-lib's operator API is not available so
 * the caller can fall back to the old path.
 */
import * as PDFLIB from "pdf-lib";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

export function fillPolygonPdf(page: Any, pts: Array<[number, number]>, color: { r: number; g: number; b: number }, opacity: number): boolean {
  const L = PDFLIB as unknown as Any;
  if (pts.length < 3 || typeof page?.pushOperators !== "function") return false;
  for (const name of ["pushGraphicsState", "popGraphicsState", "setFillingRgbColor", "moveTo", "lineTo", "closePath", "fill"]) {
    if (typeof L[name] !== "function") return false;
  }
  const op = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, opacity));
  const mix = (c: number) => 1 - (1 - c) * op; // translucent fills are blended with the white paper
  const ops: unknown[] = [L.pushGraphicsState(), L.setFillingRgbColor(mix(color.r), mix(color.g), mix(color.b)), L.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1])];
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ops.push(L.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]));
  ops.push(L.closePath(), L.fill(), L.popGraphicsState());
  page.pushOperators(...ops);
  return true;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Milestone 3 - plan view content that the plan generator did not draw.
 *
 * The existing plan generator draws outlines for walls, columns, MEP and
 * openings, but nothing for rooms, and the M2 types (stairs, railings, ramps,
 * curtain walls, roofs, ceilings) fell into its generic "linear thick line /
 * closed polygon" branch (a stair became a thin box, a railing a closed loop).
 * This module produces the proper drawing content:
 *   - wall / column poche (walls broken at door and window openings),
 *   - room tags (number, name, area) and optional boundaries,
 *   - stair symbols with riser lines, up arrow and landings, railings, ramps
 *     with slope, curtain walls with mullion ticks, roof outline with ridge,
 *     ceiling outline (reflected ceiling plans only),
 *   - door and window marks (D1, W1 ... or properties.mark).
 *
 * Pure TypeScript. Units follow the existing pipeline: "sizePt" and "widthPt" are
 * millimetres on paper, positions are world metres.
 */
import type { SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../views/scene";
import { paperToWorld } from "../views/scene";
import { stairLayout, stairParamsOf, type Vec2 } from "./m2-geometry";
import { wallOpenings, type SolidElement } from "./m3-solids";

export interface PlanRoom {
  id: string; name: string; number: string; area: number; levelId: string | null;
  boundary: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>; labelPoint?: Vec2;
}

export interface PlanOptions {
  poche: boolean; pocheColor: string; roomTags: boolean; roomBoundaries: boolean;
  doorTags: boolean; stairSymbols: boolean; railingsAndRamps: boolean; curtainWalls: boolean; roofOutline: boolean;
}
export const DEFAULT_PLAN_OPTIONS: PlanOptions = {
  poche: true, pocheColor: "#4b5563", roomTags: true, roomBoundaries: false,
  doorTags: true, stairSymbols: true, railingsAndRamps: true, curtainWalls: true, roofOutline: true,
};

export interface PlanExtrasInput {
  elements: SolidElement[];
  rooms: PlanRoom[];
  cutElevation: number;
  bandLow: number;
  bandHigh: number;
  /** view scale denominator (1:100 -> 100) */
  scale: number;
  kind: "plan" | "rcp";
  options?: Partial<PlanOptions>;
}

export interface PlanExtras {
  /** poche fills: insert at the BOTTOM of the cut layer so outlines stay on top */
  under: SceneEntity[];
  cut: SceneEntity[];
  overhead: SceneEntity[];
  symbols: SceneEntity[];
  /** base-generator geometry of these elements must be removed (their symbols replace it) */
  suppressIds: Set<string>;
  stats: { stairs: number; roomsTagged: number; doorTags: number; pocheWalls: number };
}

const CUT: StrokeStyle = { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.35, dash: null };
const FINE: StrokeStyle = { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.18, dash: null };
const OVER: StrokeStyle = { color: "#6b7280", widthPt: 0.18, dash: [1.2, 0.8] };
const TAG: StrokeStyle = { color: "#0f766e", widthPt: 0.15, dash: null };
const num = (v: unknown, d: number): number => (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : d);
const SUPPRESSED = new Set(["stairs", "railing", "ramp", "curtain-wall", "roof", "ceiling"]);

/** Marks for doors (D1, D2 ...) and windows (W1 ...) in element order; properties.mark wins. */
export function autoMarks(elements: SolidElement[]): Map<string, string> {
  const m = new Map<string, string>();
  let d = 0, w = 0;
  for (const e of elements) {
    if (e.type !== "door" && e.type !== "window") continue;
    const own = e.properties?.mark;
    const auto = e.type === "door" ? `D${++d}` : `W${++w}`;
    m.set(e.id, typeof own === "string" && own.trim() ? own.trim() : auto);
  }
  return m;
}

function rectPoly(a: Vec2, dir: Vec2, u0: number, u1: number, half: number): Array<[number, number]> {
  const n: Vec2 = [-dir[1], dir[0]];
  const P = (u: number, s: number): [number, number] => [a[0] + dir[0] * u + n[0] * s, a[1] + dir[1] * u + n[1] * s];
  return [P(u0, -half), P(u1, -half), P(u1, half), P(u0, half)];
}

function arrow(a: Vec2, b: Vec2, head: number, stroke: StrokeStyle): SceneEntity[] {
  const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
  if (L < 1e-6) return [];
  const d: Vec2 = [(b[0] - a[0]) / L, (b[1] - a[1]) / L], n: Vec2 = [-d[1], d[0]];
  const h = Math.min(head, L * 0.4);
  const p1: Vec2 = [b[0] - d[0] * h + n[0] * h * 0.4, b[1] - d[1] * h + n[1] * h * 0.4];
  const p2: Vec2 = [b[0] - d[0] * h - n[0] * h * 0.4, b[1] - d[1] * h - n[1] * h * 0.4];
  return [
    { kind: "line", x1: a[0], z1: a[1], x2: b[0], z2: b[1], stroke },
    { kind: "line", x1: b[0], z1: b[1], x2: p1[0], z2: p1[1], stroke },
    { kind: "line", x1: b[0], z1: b[1], x2: p2[0], z2: p2[1], stroke },
  ];
}

const outline = (pts: Array<[number, number]>, stroke: StrokeStyle): SceneEntity => ({ kind: "polyline", points: pts, closed: true, stroke });
const seg = (a: Vec2, b: Vec2, stroke: StrokeStyle): SceneEntity => ({ kind: "line", x1: a[0], z1: a[1], x2: b[0], z2: b[1], stroke });
const txt = (x: number, z: number, text: string, sizeMm: number, color = "#111827", anchor: "start" | "middle" | "end" = "middle"): SceneEntity =>
  ({ kind: "text", x, z, text, anchor, sizePt: sizeMm, rotation: 0, color });

/** Where an element of vertical extent [base, top] is drawn: cut by the plane, visible below it, or above it (dashed). */
function classify(out: PlanExtras, base: number, top: number, cutY: number): { layer: SceneEntity[]; heavy: StrokeStyle; fine: StrokeStyle } {
  if (base <= cutY + 1e-6 && top >= cutY - 1e-6) return { layer: out.cut, heavy: CUT, fine: FINE };
  if (top < cutY) return { layer: out.cut, heavy: FINE, fine: FINE };   // wholly below the cut plane: ordinary projected lines
  return { layer: out.overhead, heavy: OVER, fine: OVER };
}

export function planExtras(input: PlanExtrasInput): PlanExtras {
  const o: PlanOptions = { ...DEFAULT_PLAN_OPTIONS, ...(input.options ?? {}) };
  const out: PlanExtras = { under: [], cut: [], overhead: [], symbols: [], suppressIds: new Set(), stats: { stairs: 0, roomsTagged: 0, doorTags: 0, pocheWalls: 0 } };
  const cutY = input.cutElevation;
  const mm = (v: number) => paperToWorld(v, input.scale);
  const hostedBy = new Map<string, SolidElement[]>();
  for (const e of input.elements) if ((e.type === "door" || e.type === "window") && e.hostId) (hostedBy.get(e.hostId) ?? hostedBy.set(e.hostId, []).get(e.hostId)!).push(e);

  for (const el of input.elements) {
    const p = el.params;
    const base = num(p.elevation, 0), H = num(p.height, 0), top = base + H;
    if (base > input.bandHigh || top < input.bandLow) continue;
    const spans = base <= cutY + 1e-6 && top >= cutY - 1e-6;
    if (SUPPRESSED.has(el.type)) out.suppressIds.add(el.id);

    /* ---- poche ---- */
    if (o.poche && el.type === "wall" && p.start && p.end && spans) {
      const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
      if (L > 0.05) {
        const dir: Vec2 = [(p.end[0] - p.start[0]) / L, (p.end[1] - p.start[1]) / L];
        const ops = wallOpenings(el, hostedBy.get(el.id) ?? []).filter((x) => x.y0 <= cutY && x.y1 >= cutY);
        // pieces at the cut height: runs between the openings that the cut plane passes through
        let cursor = 0;
        const runs: Array<[number, number]> = [];
        for (const x of ops) { if (x.u0 - cursor > 1e-6) runs.push([cursor, x.u0]); cursor = Math.max(cursor, x.u1); }
        if (L - cursor > 1e-6) runs.push([cursor, L]);
        for (const [u0, u1] of runs) out.under.push({ kind: "polyline", points: rectPoly(p.start, dir, u0, u1, num(p.thickness, 0.2) / 2), closed: true, stroke: { color: o.pocheColor, widthPt: 0, dash: null }, fill: { color: o.pocheColor, opacity: 1 } });
        out.stats.pocheWalls++;
      }
    }
    if (o.poche && (el.type === "column" || el.type === "footing") && p.point && spans) {
      const t = num(p.thickness, 0.3), d = num(p.depth, t), [x, z] = p.point;
      out.under.push({ kind: "polyline", points: [[x - t / 2, z - d / 2], [x + t / 2, z - d / 2], [x + t / 2, z + d / 2], [x - t / 2, z + d / 2]], closed: true, stroke: { color: o.pocheColor, widthPt: 0, dash: null }, fill: { color: o.pocheColor, opacity: 1 } });
    }

    /* ---- stairs ---- */
    if (el.type === "stairs" && o.stairSymbols) {
      const sp = stairParamsOf(el);
      if (!sp) continue;
      let lay;
      try { lay = stairLayout(sp); } catch { continue; }
      out.stats.stairs++;
      lay.flights.forEach((f, fi) => {
        const half = lay.width / 2;
        const poly = rectPoly(f.start, f.dir, 0, f.run, half);
        const stroke = sp.elevation + f.h0 <= cutY ? CUT : OVER;
        (stroke === CUT ? out.cut : out.overhead).push(outline(poly, stroke));
        const td = f.run / f.n;
        for (let i = 1; i < f.n; i++) {
          const h = f.h0 + i * lay.riserHeight; // top of riser i
          const a: Vec2 = [f.start[0] + f.dir[0] * td * i + -f.dir[1] * -half, f.start[1] + f.dir[1] * td * i + f.dir[0] * -half];
          const b: Vec2 = [f.start[0] + f.dir[0] * td * i + -f.dir[1] * half, f.start[1] + f.dir[1] * td * i + f.dir[0] * half];
          const below = sp.elevation + h <= cutY;
          (below ? out.cut : out.overhead).push(seg(a, b, below ? FINE : OVER));
        }
        // walking line with arrow along the centre line
        const a: Vec2 = [f.start[0] + f.dir[0] * td * 0.5, f.start[1] + f.dir[1] * td * 0.5];
        const b: Vec2 = [f.start[0] + f.dir[0] * (f.run - td * 0.5), f.start[1] + f.dir[1] * (f.run - td * 0.5)];
        out.symbols.push(...arrow(a, b, mm(3), { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.2, dash: null }));
        if (fi === 0) out.symbols.push(txt(a[0] - f.dir[1] * (half * 0.55), a[1] + f.dir[0] * (half * 0.55), "UP", 2.2));
      });
      for (const l of lay.landings) (sp.elevation + l.top <= cutY ? out.cut : out.overhead).push(outline(l.poly.map((q) => [q[0], q[1]] as [number, number]), sp.elevation + l.top <= cutY ? CUT : OVER));
    }

    /* ---- railings and ramps ---- */
    if (el.type === "railing" && o.railingsAndRamps) {
      const path = p.polygon ?? (p.start && p.end ? [p.start, p.end] : null);
      if (path && path.length >= 2) {
        const half = Math.max(0.02, num(p.thickness, 0.05) / 2);
        const { layer, fine: st } = classify(out, base, top, cutY);
        for (let i = 0; i + 1 < path.length; i++) {
          const a = path[i], b = path[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
          if (L < 1e-6) continue;
          const nx = (-(b[1] - a[1]) / L) * half, nz = ((b[0] - a[0]) / L) * half;
          layer.push(seg([a[0] + nx, a[1] + nz], [b[0] + nx, b[1] + nz], st), seg([a[0] - nx, a[1] - nz], [b[0] - nx, b[1] - nz], st));
        }
      }
    }
    if (el.type === "ramp" && o.railingsAndRamps && p.start && p.end) {
      const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
      if (L > 0.1) {
        const dir: Vec2 = [(p.end[0] - p.start[0]) / L, (p.end[1] - p.start[1]) / L];
        const w = num(p.width, 1.5);
        const c = classify(out, base, base + num(p.height, 0.5) + num(p.thickness, 0.2), cutY);
        c.layer.push(outline(rectPoly(p.start, dir, 0, L, w / 2), c.heavy));
        out.symbols.push(...arrow([p.start[0] + dir[0] * 0.2, p.start[1] + dir[1] * 0.2], [p.end[0] - dir[0] * 0.2, p.end[1] - dir[1] * 0.2], mm(3), FINE));
        const slope = num(p.height, 0.5) / L;
        out.symbols.push(txt((p.start[0] + p.end[0]) / 2 - dir[1] * (w * 0.3), (p.start[1] + p.end[1]) / 2 + dir[0] * (w * 0.3), slope > 0 ? `1:${(1 / slope).toFixed(1)}` : "flat", 2.2));
      }
    }

    /* ---- curtain walls ---- */
    if (el.type === "curtain-wall" && o.curtainWalls && p.start && p.end) {
      const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
      if (L > 0.1) {
        const dir: Vec2 = [(p.end[0] - p.start[0]) / L, (p.end[1] - p.start[1]) / L];
        const half = num(p.thickness, 0.1) / 2;
        const nu = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / Math.max(0.3, num(el.properties?.uSpacing, 1.5))));
        const { layer, heavy: st, fine } = classify(out, base, top, cutY);
        const n: Vec2 = [-dir[1], dir[0]];
        const P = (u: number, s: number): Vec2 => [p.start![0] + dir[0] * u + n[0] * s, p.start![1] + dir[1] * u + n[1] * s];
        layer.push(seg(P(0, half), P(L, half), st), seg(P(0, -half), P(L, -half), st));
        for (let i = 0; i <= nu; i++) layer.push(seg(P((L * i) / nu, half), P((L * i) / nu, -half), fine));
        layer.push(seg(P(0, 0), P(L, 0), { color: "#7dd3fc", widthPt: 0.15, dash: null })); // glazing line
      }
    }

    /* ---- roofs and ceilings ---- */
    if (el.type === "roof" && o.roofOutline && input.kind === "plan" && p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 3) {
      const poly = p.polygon.map((q) => [q[0], q[1]] as [number, number]);
      out.overhead.push(outline(poly, OVER));
      const pr = el.properties ?? {};
      const a = (num(pr.slopeDirection, 0) * Math.PI) / 180, s: Vec2 = [Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a)];
      const ps = p.polygon.map((q) => q[0] * s[0] + q[1] * s[1]);
      const mid = (Math.min(...ps) + Math.max(...ps)) / 2, ext = Math.hypot(...[Math.max(...p.polygon.map((q) => q[0])) - Math.min(...p.polygon.map((q) => q[0])), Math.max(...p.polygon.map((q) => q[1])) - Math.min(...p.polygon.map((q) => q[1]))]);
      const cx = p.polygon.reduce((acc, q) => acc + q[0], 0) / p.polygon.length, cz = p.polygon.reduce((acc, q) => acc + q[1], 0) / p.polygon.length;
      const c = cx * s[0] + cz * s[1];
      if (String(pr.roofType ?? "gable") === "gable") {
        const t: Vec2 = [-s[1], s[0]], k = mid - c; // ridge line: perpendicular to the slope direction, through the span midpoint
        out.overhead.push(seg([cx + s[0] * k - t[0] * ext, cz + s[1] * k - t[1] * ext], [cx + s[0] * k + t[0] * ext, cz + s[1] * k + t[1] * ext], { color: "#6b7280", widthPt: 0.25, dash: [3, 0.8] }));
      }
      out.symbols.push(...arrow([cx - s[0] * 0.6, cz - s[1] * 0.6], [cx + s[0] * 0.6, cz + s[1] * 0.6], mm(2.5), FINE));
      out.symbols.push(txt(cx, cz - mm(4), `${num(pr.slope, 30)}\u00B0`, 2.2));
    }
    if (el.type === "ceiling" && input.kind === "rcp" && p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 3) {
      out.cut.push(outline(p.polygon.map((q) => [q[0], q[1]] as [number, number]), CUT));
      const cx = p.polygon.reduce((a, q) => a + q[0], 0) / p.polygon.length, cz = p.polygon.reduce((a, q) => a + q[1], 0) / p.polygon.length;
      out.symbols.push(txt(cx, cz, `CLG ${base.toFixed(2)}`, 2.2));
    }
  }

  /* ---- door / window marks ---- */
  if (o.doorTags) {
    const marks = autoMarks(input.elements);
    const byId = new Map(input.elements.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
    for (const e of input.elements) {
      if ((e.type !== "door" && e.type !== "window") || !e.hostId) continue;
      const host = byId.get(e.hostId);
      if (!host || host.type !== "wall" || !host.params.start || !host.params.end) continue;
      const hp = host.params;
      const base = num(hp.elevation, 0) + num(e.params.sillHeight, 0);
      if (base > input.bandHigh || num(hp.elevation, 0) + num(hp.height, 0) < input.bandLow) continue;
      const L = Math.hypot(hp.end![0] - hp.start![0], hp.end![1] - hp.start![1]);
      if (L < 0.05) continue;
      const dir: Vec2 = [(hp.end![0] - hp.start![0]) / L, (hp.end![1] - hp.start![1]) / L];
      const w = num(e.params.width, e.type === "door" ? 0.9 : 1.2);
      const c = Math.max(w / 2, Math.min(L - w / 2, num(e.params.offsetAlongHost, L / 2)));
      const off = num(hp.thickness, 0.2) / 2 + mm(4.5);
      const x = hp.start![0] + dir[0] * c + -dir[1] * off, z = hp.start![1] + dir[1] * c + dir[0] * off;
      out.symbols.push({ kind: "circle", cx: x, cz: z, r: mm(2.6), stroke: TAG });
      out.symbols.push(txt(x, z, marks.get(e.id) ?? "?", 2.0, "#0f766e"));
      out.stats.doorTags++;
    }
  }

  /* ---- rooms ---- */
  for (const r of input.rooms) {
    if (r.boundary.length < 3) continue;
    if (o.roomBoundaries) out.symbols.push({ kind: "polyline", points: r.boundary.map((b) => [b.x, b.z] as [number, number]), closed: true, stroke: { color: "#2563eb", widthPt: 0.12, dash: [2, 1] } });
    if (!o.roomTags) continue;
    const lp: Vec2 = r.labelPoint ?? [r.boundary.reduce((a, b) => a + b.x, 0) / r.boundary.length, r.boundary.reduce((a, b) => a + b.z, 0) / r.boundary.length];
    const lh = mm(3.4);
    out.symbols.push(txt(lp[0], lp[1] + lh, r.number, 2.8, "#1d4ed8"));
    out.symbols.push(txt(lp[0], lp[1], r.name, 2.4));
    out.symbols.push(txt(lp[0], lp[1] - lh, `${r.area.toFixed(1)} m\u00B2`, 2.0, "#374151"));
    out.stats.roomsTagged++;
  }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Milestone 3 - projecting and cutting solids into Scene2D entities.
 *
 * Elevation: per-component painter's algorithm. Each connected piece of a solid
 * contributes its front-facing triangles; their boundary loops become one filled,
 * outlined polygon (so nearer pieces hide farther ones) and creases become lines.
 *
 * Section: closed solids are clipped by the cut plane; the cap of every cut solid
 * is rebuilt from the intersection segments (loops = poche, holes punched), and
 * what remains beyond the plane is projected like an elevation.
 *
 * View coordinates follow the existing 2D pipeline: scene x = u (to the right),
 * scene z = v (up, elevation). Pure TypeScript (type-only imports).
 */
import type { SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../views/scene";
import type { Solid, V3 } from "./m3-solids";

export interface ViewFrame { origin: V3; right: V3; up: V3; fwd: V3 }

const sub = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const dot = (a: V3, b: V3): number => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
const cross = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
const len = (a: V3): number => Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]);

/** Same u axis as the existing elevation generator (north: u = +x, south: -x, east: +z, west: -z). */
export function elevationFrame(direction: "north" | "south" | "east" | "west"): ViewFrame {
  const [a0, a1]: [number, number] = direction === "north" ? [1, 0] : direction === "south" ? [-1, 0] : direction === "east" ? [0, 1] : [0, -1];
  return { origin: [0, 0, 0], right: [a0, 0, a1], up: [0, 1, 0], fwd: [a1, 0, -a0] };
}

/**
 * Section frame. "right" looks to the right-hand side of the cut line direction
 * (plan with +z up); "left" looks the other way, which reverses u so the drawing
 * is never mirrored.
 */
export function sectionFrame(cut: { x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number }, lookDir: "left" | "right"): ViewFrame {
  const dx = cut.x2 - cut.x1, dz = cut.z2 - cut.z1;
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
  const d: [number, number] = [dx / L, dz / L];
  const s = lookDir === "right" ? 1 : -1;
  return { origin: [cut.x1, 0, cut.z1], right: [s * d[0], 0, s * d[1]], up: [0, 1, 0], fwd: [s * d[1], 0, -s * d[0]] };
}

export function toView(f: ViewFrame, p: V3): V3 {
  const r = sub(p, f.origin);
  return [dot(r, f.right), dot(r, f.up), dot(r, f.fwd)];
}

export interface LineStyles { outline: StrokeStyle; crease: StrokeStyle; cutLine: StrokeStyle; datum: StrokeStyle }
export const DEFAULT_STYLES: LineStyles = {
  outline: { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.25, dash: null },
  crease: { color: "#374151", widthPt: 0.15, dash: null },
  cutLine: { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.5, dash: null },
  datum: { color: "#2563eb", widthPt: 0.12, dash: [3, 1, 0.6, 1] },
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- projection */

interface Tri { v: [V3, V3, V3]; n: V3; ids: [number, number, number] }

const q = (x: number) => Math.round(x * 1e5);
const vkey = (p: V3) => `${q(p[0])},${q(p[1])},${q(p[2])}`;

function trianglesOf(positions: number[]): { tris: Tri[]; verts: V3[] } {
  const ids = new Map<string, number>();
  const verts: V3[] = [];
  const idOf = (p: V3) => { const k = vkey(p); let i = ids.get(k); if (i === undefined) { i = verts.length; verts.push(p); ids.set(k, i); } return i; };
  const tris: Tri[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 8 < positions.length; i += 9) {
    const a: V3 = [positions[i], positions[i + 1], positions[i + 2]], b: V3 = [positions[i + 3], positions[i + 4], positions[i + 5]], c: V3 = [positions[i + 6], positions[i + 7], positions[i + 8]];
    const n = cross(sub(b, a), sub(c, a));
    const l = len(n);
    if (l < 1e-12) continue;
    tris.push({ v: [a, b, c], n: [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l], ids: [idOf(a), idOf(b), idOf(c)] });
  }
  return { tris, verts };
}

/** Connected components of triangles that share an edge. */
function components(tris: Tri[]): number[][] {
  const parent = tris.map((_, i) => i);
  const find = (x: number): number => { while (parent[x] !== x) { parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]; x = parent[x]; } return x; };
  const edgeOwner = new Map<string, number>();
  tris.forEach((t, i) => {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const a = t.ids[k], b = t.ids[(k + 1) % 3];
      const key = a < b ? `${a}:${b}` : `${b}:${a}`;
      const o = edgeOwner.get(key);
      if (o === undefined) edgeOwner.set(key, i); else parent[find(i)] = find(o);
    }
  });
  const groups = new Map<number, number[]>();
  tris.forEach((_, i) => { const r = find(i); (groups.get(r) ?? groups.set(r, []).get(r)!).push(i); });
  return [...groups.values()];
}

export interface ProjectOptions {
  styles?: LineStyles;
  /** Drop geometry deeper than this (view depth, metres). */
  farClip?: number;
  /** Crease angle in degrees: shared edges between front faces bending more than this are drawn. */
  creaseDeg?: number;
  /** Element-type specific fill (default white). */
  fillFor?: (solidType: string, role: "solid" | "glass") => { color: string; opacity: number };
}

interface Piece { entities: SceneEntity[]; minDepth: number }

/** Project solids into painter-ordered entities (far to near). */
export function projectSolids(solids: Solid[], frame: ViewFrame, opts: ProjectOptions = {}): SceneEntity[] {
  const st = opts.styles ?? DEFAULT_STYLES;
  const crease = Math.cos(((opts.creaseDeg ?? 30) * Math.PI) / 180);
  const pieces: Piece[] = [];
  for (const solid of solids) {
    for (const part of solid.parts) {
      const { tris, verts } = trianglesOf(part.positions);
      const vv = verts.map((p) => toView(frame, p));
      for (const comp of components(tris)) {
        const front = comp.filter((i) => dot(tris[i].n, frame.fwd) < -1e-9);
        if (!front.length) continue;
        let minD = Infinity;
        for (const i of front) for (const id of tris[i].ids) minD = Math.min(minD, vv[id][2]);
        if (opts.farClip !== undefined && minD > opts.farClip) continue;
        // directed boundary edges of the front-facing set
        const dir = new Map<string, [number, number]>();
        const edgeTris = new Map<string, number[]>();
        for (const i of front) {
          const t = tris[i];
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            const a = t.ids[k], b = t.ids[(k + 1) % 3];
            dir.set(`${a}>${b}`, [a, b]);
            const key = a < b ? `${a}:${b}` : `${b}:${a}`;
            (edgeTris.get(key) ?? edgeTris.set(key, []).get(key)!).push(i);
          }
        }
        const boundary = [...dir.values()].filter(([a, b]) => !dir.has(`${b}>${a}`));
        const next = new Map<number, number[]>();
        for (const [a, b] of boundary) (next.get(a) ?? next.set(a, []).get(a)!).push(b);
        const used = new Set<string>();
        const entities: SceneEntity[] = [];
        const fill = opts.fillFor?.(solid.type, part.role) ?? (part.role === "glass" ? { color: "#bfdbfe", opacity: 0.35 } : { color: "#ffffff", opacity: 1 });
        for (const [a0, b0] of boundary) {
          if (used.has(`${a0}>${b0}`)) continue;
          const loop: number[] = [a0];
          let a = a0, b = b0, guard = 0;
          while (guard++ < 100000) {
            used.add(`${a}>${b}`);
            if (b === a0) break;
            loop.push(b);
            const cands = (next.get(b) ?? []).filter((c) => !used.has(`${b}>${c}`));
            if (!cands.length) break;
            a = b; b = cands[0];
          }
          if (loop.length < 3) continue;
          const pts: Array<[number, number]> = loop.map((id) => [vv[id][0], vv[id][1]]);
          let area = 0;
          for (let k = 0; k < pts.length; k++) { const p = pts[k], r = pts[(k + 1) % pts.length]; area += p[0] * r[1] - r[0] * p[1]; }
          if (Math.abs(area) < 1e-9) continue;
          entities.push({ kind: "polyline", points: pts, closed: true, stroke: part.role === "glass" ? st.crease : st.outline, fill: area > 0 ? fill : undefined });
        }
        // crease lines between two front faces that bend
        for (const [key, owners] of edgeTris) {
          if (owners.length !== 2) continue;
          if (dot(tris[owners[0]].n, tris[owners[1]].n) > crease) continue;
          const [a, b] = key.split(":").map(Number);
          entities.push({ kind: "line", x1: vv[a][0], z1: vv[a][1], x2: vv[b][0], z2: vv[b][1], stroke: st.crease });
        }
        if (entities.length) pieces.push({ entities, minDepth: minD });
      }
    }
  }
  pieces.sort((a, b) => b.minDepth - a.minDepth);
  return pieces.flatMap((p) => p.entities);
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- sectioning */

export interface CutCap { solidId: string; type: string; loop: Array<[number, number]>; area: number }
export interface SectionResult { far: Solid[]; caps: CutCap[] }

/**
 * Clip every solid by the view plane (d = 0, keeping d >= 0) and rebuild the cap loops
 * from the intersection segments. `area` > 0 marks an outer loop, < 0 a hole.
 */
export function cutSolids(solids: Solid[], frame: ViewFrame): SectionResult {
  const far: Solid[] = [];
  const caps: CutCap[] = [];
  const EPS = 1e-9;
  for (const s of solids) {
    const keptParts: Solid["parts"] = [];
    for (const part of s.parts) {
      const kept: number[] = [];
      const segs: Array<[[number, number], [number, number]]> = [];
      const P = part.positions;
      for (let i = 0; i + 8 < P.length; i += 9) {
        const vs: V3[] = [[P[i], P[i + 1], P[i + 2]], [P[i + 3], P[i + 4], P[i + 5]], [P[i + 6], P[i + 7], P[i + 8]]];
        const d = vs.map((p) => toView(frame, p)[2]);
        if (d.every((x) => x >= -EPS)) { if (d.some((x) => x > EPS)) kept.push(...P.slice(i, i + 9)); continue; }
        if (d.every((x) => x <= EPS)) continue;
        const poly: V3[] = [];
        let exit: V3 | null = null, entry: V3 | null = null;
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
          const a = vs[k], b = vs[(k + 1) % 3], da = d[k], db = d[(k + 1) % 3];
          const inA = da >= 0, inB = db >= 0;
          const X = (): V3 => { const t = da / (da - db); return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t]; };
          if (inA && inB) poly.push(b);
          else if (inA && !inB) { exit = X(); poly.push(exit); }
          else if (!inA && inB) { entry = X(); poly.push(entry, b); }
        }
        for (let k = 1; k + 1 < poly.length; k++) kept.push(...poly[0], ...poly[k], ...poly[k + 1]);
        if (exit && entry) {
          const e = toView(frame, entry), x = toView(frame, exit);
          segs.push([[e[0], e[1]], [x[0], x[1]]]); // cap edge runs entry -> exit (reverse of the mesh edge)
        }
      }
      if (kept.length) keptParts.push({ positions: kept, role: part.role });
      // chain segments into loops
      const key = (p: [number, number]) => `${q(p[0])},${q(p[1])}`;
      const byStart = new Map<string, number[]>();
      segs.forEach((sg, i) => (byStart.get(key(sg[0])) ?? byStart.set(key(sg[0]), []).get(key(sg[0]))!).push(i));
      const used = new Array(segs.length).fill(false);
      for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
        if (used[i]) continue;
        const loop: Array<[number, number]> = [segs[i][0]];
        let cur = i, closed = false, guard = 0;
        while (guard++ < 100000) {
          used[cur] = true;
          const end = segs[cur][1];
          if (key(end) === key(segs[i][0])) { closed = true; break; }
          loop.push(end);
          const nx = (byStart.get(key(end)) ?? []).find((j) => !used[j]);
          if (nx === undefined) break;
          cur = nx;
        }
        if (!closed || loop.length < 3) continue;
        let area = 0;
        for (let k = 0; k < loop.length; k++) { const a = loop[k], b = loop[(k + 1) % loop.length]; area += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }
        area /= 2;
        if (Math.abs(area) > 1e-9 && part.role === "solid") caps.push({ solidId: s.id, type: s.type, loop, area });
      }
    }
    if (keptParts.length) far.push({ id: s.id, type: s.type, parts: keptParts });
  }
  return { far, caps };
}

/** Poche entities for the cut caps: outer loops filled, holes punched, all outlined heavy. */
export function capEntities(caps: CutCap[], pocheFor: (type: string) => string, style: StrokeStyle = DEFAULT_STYLES.cutLine): SceneEntity[] {
  const out: SceneEntity[] = [];
  for (const c of caps.filter((x) => x.area > 0)) out.push({ kind: "polyline", points: c.loop, closed: true, stroke: style, fill: { color: pocheFor(c.type), opacity: 1 } });
  for (const c of caps.filter((x) => x.area < 0)) out.push({ kind: "polyline", points: c.loop, closed: true, stroke: style, fill: { color: "#ffffff", opacity: 1 } });
  return out;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers */

export function entitiesBounds(es: SceneEntity[]): { minX: number; minZ: number; maxX: number; maxZ: number } | null {
  let minX = Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
  const add = (x: number, z: number) => { minX = Math.min(minX, x); maxX = Math.max(maxX, x); minZ = Math.min(minZ, z); maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, z); };
  for (const e of es) {
    if (e.kind === "line") { add(e.x1, e.z1); add(e.x2, e.z2); }
    else if (e.kind === "polyline") for (const [x, z] of e.points) add(x, z);
    else if (e.kind === "circle") { add(e.cx - e.r, e.cz - e.r); add(e.cx + e.r, e.cz + e.r); }
    else if (e.kind === "arc") { add(e.cx - e.r, e.cz - e.r); add(e.cx + e.r, e.cz + e.r); }
  }
  return Number.isFinite(minX) ? { minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ } : null;
}

/** Dashed level datums with labels, spanning the drawing. */
export function datumEntities(levels: Array<{ name: string; elevation: number }>, minX: number, maxX: number, style: StrokeStyle = DEFAULT_STYLES.datum, textSizePt = 3): SceneEntity[] {
  const out: SceneEntity[] = [];
  for (const l of levels) {
    out.push({ kind: "line", x1: minX, z1: l.elevation, x2: maxX, z2: l.elevation, stroke: style });
    out.push({ kind: "text", x: minX, z: l.elevation + 0.05, text: `${l.name}  ${l.elevation >= 0 ? "+" : "-"}${Math.abs(l.elevation).toFixed(2)}`, anchor: "start", sizePt: textSizePt, rotation: 0, color: "#1d4ed8" });
  }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Milestone 3 registration: real plan content, true elevations and sections, PDF fills.
 *
 * Installs window.__obsViewExt, which three anchored lines (added by the installer) in
 * modules/views/generators/{plan,section,elevation}.ts call:
 *   planFilter(planView, def)  drop the base generator's geometry for elements that now get proper symbols
 *   plan(def, scene)           add poche, room tags, symbols, door marks
 *   section(def) / elevation(def)  replace the bounding-rectangle projections with real ones
 * and window.__obsM3FillPolygon, used by the PDF exporter (see m3-pdf-fill.ts).
 */
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";
import { roomsStore } from "../rooms/rooms";
import { listViews, updateView } from "../views/store";
import { elementSolids, type SolidElement } from "./m3-solids";
import { cutSolids, capEntities, datumEntities, elevationFrame, entitiesBounds, projectSolids, sectionFrame, DEFAULT_STYLES } from "./m3-project";
import { DEFAULT_PLAN_OPTIONS, planExtras, type PlanExtras, type PlanOptions, type PlanRoom } from "./m3-plan";
import { fillPolygonPdf } from "./m3-pdf-fill";

type Any = Record<string, any>;
const authoring = (): Any | null => ((ctx.features as Any).authoring ?? null);
const KEY = "obs.m3.planOptions";

export function getPlanOptions(): PlanOptions {
  try { return { ...DEFAULT_PLAN_OPTIONS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "{}") }; } catch { return { ...DEFAULT_PLAN_OPTIONS }; }
}
export function setPlanOption<K extends keyof PlanOptions>(k: K, v: PlanOptions[K]): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ ...getPlanOptions(), [k]: v })); } catch { /* */ }
}

function elements(): SolidElement[] { return (authoring()?.getElements?.() ?? []) as SolidElement[]; }
function levels(): Array<{ name: string; elevation: number }> {
  return ((authoring()?.getLevels?.() ?? []) as Any[]).map((l) => ({ name: String(l.name), elevation: Number(l.elevation) || 0 })).sort((a, b) => a.elevation - b.elevation);
}
function levelElevation(levelId: string | null): number {
  if (!levelId) return 0;
  return Number(((authoring()?.getLevels?.() ?? []) as Any[]).find((l) => l.id === levelId)?.elevation) || 0;
}

/** Same view range arithmetic as modules/drawings/plan-generator.ts. */
function planBand(def: Any): { cut: number; low: number; high: number } {
  const pl = def.plan;
  const lowDepth = Math.max(Math.abs(pl.bottomDepth ?? 0), Math.abs(pl.viewDepth ?? pl.bottomDepth ?? 0));
  const highDepth = Math.max(pl.cutHeight, Math.abs(pl.topHeight ?? pl.cutHeight));
  return { cut: pl.levelElevation + pl.cutHeight, low: pl.levelElevation - lowDepth, high: pl.levelElevation + highDepth };
}

function roomsFor(def: Any): PlanRoom[] {
  const elev = def.plan.levelElevation;
  return roomsStore.listRooms()
    .filter((r) => Math.abs(levelElevation(r.levelId) - elev) < 0.05)
    .map((r) => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, number: r.number, area: r.area, levelId: r.levelId, boundary: r.boundary, labelPoint: r.properties?.labelPoint as [number, number] | undefined }));
}

export function computePlanExtras(def: Any): PlanExtras | null {
  if (!def?.plan) return null;
  const b = planBand(def);
  return planExtras({ elements: elements(), rooms: roomsFor(def), cutElevation: b.cut, bandLow: b.low, bandHigh: b.high, scale: def.scale || 100, kind: def.kind === "rcp" ? "rcp" : "plan", options: getPlanOptions() });
}

const POCHE: Record<string, string> = { wall: "#6b7280", slab: "#6b7280", roof: "#6b7280", column: "#6b7280", footing: "#6b7280" };
const pocheFor = (type: string) => POCHE[type] ?? "#9ca3af";
const LIGHT = { ...DEFAULT_STYLES, outline: { color: "#374151", widthPt: 0.18, dash: null }, crease: { color: "#6b7280", widthPt: 0.12, dash: null } };

function finishScene(scene: Any, extra: Any[]): void {
  const b = entitiesBounds([...scene.layers.project, ...scene.layers.cut, ...extra]);
  if (b) scene.bounds = b;
  scene.generatedAt = Date.now();
}

async function sectionScene(def: Any): Promise<Any | null> {
  if (!def.section) return null;
  const solids = elementSolids(elements());
  if (!solids.length) return null;
  const frame = sectionFrame(def.section.cutLine, def.section.lookDir === "left" ? "left" : "right");
  const { far, caps } = cutSolids(solids, frame);
  const scene: Any = { bounds: { minX: 0, minZ: 0, maxX: 10, maxZ: 10 }, layers: { cut: [], project: [], overhead: [], below: [], grid: [], annotation: [], symbols: [] }, generatedAt: Date.now() };
  scene.layers.project.push(...projectSolids(far, frame, { styles: LIGHT, farClip: def.section.farClip ?? 60 }));
  scene.layers.cut.push(...capEntities(caps, pocheFor));
  const b = entitiesBounds([...scene.layers.project, ...scene.layers.cut]);
  if (!b) return null;
  const lv = levels().filter((l) => l.elevation >= (def.section.bottom ?? -1e9) - 0.01 && l.elevation <= (def.section.top ?? 1e9) + 0.01);
  scene.layers.annotation.push(...datumEntities(lv, b.minX - 0.5, b.maxX + 0.5));
  finishScene(scene, scene.layers.annotation);
  return scene;
}

async function elevationScene(def: Any): Promise<Any | null> {
  if (!def.elevation) return null;
  const solids = elementSolids(elements());
  if (!solids.length) return null;
  const frame = elevationFrame(def.elevation.direction);
  const scene: Any = { bounds: { minX: 0, minZ: 0, maxX: 10, maxZ: 10 }, layers: { cut: [], project: [], overhead: [], below: [], grid: [], annotation: [], symbols: [] }, generatedAt: Date.now() };
  scene.layers.project.push(...projectSolids(solids, frame, { farClip: def.elevation.farClip ?? 100 }));
  const b = entitiesBounds(scene.layers.project);
  if (!b) return null;
  scene.layers.annotation.push(...datumEntities(levels().filter((l) => l.elevation >= b.minZ - 0.5 && l.elevation <= b.maxZ + 0.5), b.minX - 0.5, b.maxX + 0.5));
  finishScene(scene, scene.layers.annotation);
  return scene;
}

/** Force every saved view to regenerate (sheets cache scenes by view update time). */
export async function refreshViews(): Promise<void> {
  for (const v of listViews()) updateView(v.id, { updatedAt: Date.now() });
}

let installed = false;
export function setupM3(): { ok: boolean; detail: string } {
  if (installed) return { ok: true, detail: "already installed" };
  installed = true;
  const w = window as Any;
  w.__obsViewExt = {
    planFilter(planView: Any, def: Any) {
      const extras = computePlanExtras(def);
      def.__m3 = extras;
      if (!extras || !extras.suppressIds.size) return;
      planView.segments = planView.segments.filter((s: Any) => !s.source || !extras.suppressIds.has(s.source));
    },
    plan(def: Any, scene: Any) {
      const x: PlanExtras | null = def.__m3 ?? computePlanExtras(def);
      delete def.__m3;
      if (!x) return;
      scene.layers.cut.unshift(...x.under);
      scene.layers.cut.push(...x.cut);
      scene.layers.overhead.push(...x.overhead);
      scene.layers.symbols.push(...x.symbols);
      const b = entitiesBounds([...scene.layers.cut, ...scene.layers.overhead, ...scene.layers.symbols]);
      if (b) scene.bounds = { minX: Math.min(scene.bounds.minX, b.minX), minZ: Math.min(scene.bounds.minZ, b.minZ), maxX: Math.max(scene.bounds.maxX, b.maxX), maxZ: Math.max(scene.bounds.maxZ, b.maxZ) };
    },
    section: sectionScene,
    elevation: elevationScene,
  };
  w.__obsM3FillPolygon = fillPolygonPdf;
  w.__obsM3 = { getPlanOptions, setPlanOption, refreshViews };
  return { ok: true, detail: "plan content, true sections / elevations, PDF fills" };
}

export function togglePlanOption(k: keyof PlanOptions, label: string): void {
  const cur = getPlanOptions();
  const next = !cur[k];
  setPlanOption(k, next as never);
  void refreshViews();
  notify("info", `${label}: ${next ? "on" : "off"}`, { timeout: 1500 });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Milestone 3 - elements as closed solids for drawing production.
 *
 * Elevation and section views need real geometry, not bounding rectangles:
 * walls with their door / window openings, glazing, sloped roofs, stairs.
 * This module turns authored elements into closed, outward-wound triangle
 * soups (three.js axes) that m3-project.ts can project and cut.
 *
 * Pure TypeScript: no three.js, no DOM.
 */
import { Soup, orientedBox, prismPlan, buildElementGeo, isM2Type, type GeoElement, type Vec2 } from "./m2-geometry";

export type V3 = [number, number, number];

export interface SolidPart { positions: number[]; role: "solid" | "glass" }
export interface Solid { id: string; type: string; parts: SolidPart[] }

export interface SolidElement extends GeoElement {
  id: string;
  hostId?: string;
  levelId?: string;
  name?: string;
}

const num = (v: unknown, d: number): number => (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : d);

export interface Opening { id: string; kind: "door" | "window"; u0: number; u1: number; y0: number; y1: number }

/** Door / window openings of a wall in wall coordinates (u along the wall, y absolute). */
export function wallOpenings(wall: SolidElement, hosted: SolidElement[]): Opening[] {
  const p = wall.params;
  if (!p.start || !p.end) return [];
  const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
  const base = num(p.elevation, 0);
  const out: Opening[] = [];
  for (const h of hosted) {
    if (h.type !== "door" && h.type !== "window") continue;
    const w = num(h.params.width, h.type === "door" ? 0.9 : 1.2);
    const ht = num(h.params.height, h.type === "door" ? 2.1 : 1.4);
    const sill = h.type === "door" ? num(h.params.sillHeight, 0) : num(h.params.sillHeight, 0.9);
    const c = Math.max(w / 2, Math.min(L - w / 2, num(h.params.offsetAlongHost, L / 2)));
    out.push({ id: h.id, kind: h.type, u0: c - w / 2, u1: c + w / 2, y0: base + sill, y1: base + sill + ht });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.u0 - b.u0);
}

/** The wall as boxes around its openings (full-height runs, lintels, sills). */
export function wallPieces(wall: SolidElement, openings: Opening[]): Array<{ u0: number; u1: number; y0: number; y1: number }> {
  const p = wall.params;
  const L = Math.hypot(p.end![0] - p.start![0], p.end![1] - p.start![1]);
  const y0 = num(p.elevation, 0), y1 = y0 + num(p.height, 3);
  const pieces: Array<{ u0: number; u1: number; y0: number; y1: number }> = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const o of openings) {
    const a = Math.max(o.u0, cursor), b = Math.min(o.u1, L);
    if (a - cursor > 1e-6) pieces.push({ u0: cursor, u1: a, y0, y1 });
    if (b > a + 1e-6) {
      if (o.y0 > y0 + 1e-6) pieces.push({ u0: a, u1: b, y0, y1: Math.min(o.y0, y1) });   // below a window
      if (o.y1 < y1 - 1e-6) pieces.push({ u0: a, u1: b, y0: Math.max(o.y1, y0), y1 });   // lintel
    }
    cursor = Math.max(cursor, b);
  }
  if (L - cursor > 1e-6) pieces.push({ u0: cursor, u1: L, y0, y1 });
  return pieces.filter((q) => q.u1 - q.u0 > 1e-6 && q.y1 - q.y0 > 1e-6);
}

function hbox(soup: Soup, start: Vec2, dir: Vec2, u0: number, u1: number, y0: number, y1: number, across: number): void {
  const yc = (y0 + y1) / 2;
  orientedBox([start[0] + dir[0] * u0, yc, start[1] + dir[1] * u0], [start[0] + dir[0] * u1, yc, start[1] + dir[1] * u1], across, y1 - y0, soup);
}

/** Door / window leaf and frame boxes inside an opening. */
function infill(op: Opening, wall: SolidElement, dir: Vec2): { solid: Soup; glass: Soup } {
  const p = wall.params;
  const start = p.start!, t = num(p.thickness, 0.2);
  const solid = new Soup(), glass = new Soup();
  const fw = 0.05, fd = Math.min(0.12, t * 0.9);
  const { u0, u1, y0, y1 } = op;
  hbox(solid, start, dir, u0, u0 + fw, y0, y1, fd);                 // left jamb
  hbox(solid, start, dir, u1 - fw, u1, y0, y1, fd);                 // right jamb
  hbox(solid, start, dir, u0 + fw, u1 - fw, y1 - fw, y1, fd);       // head
  if (op.kind === "window") {
    hbox(solid, start, dir, u0 + fw, u1 - fw, y0, y0 + fw, fd);     // sill
    hbox(glass, start, dir, u0 + fw, u1 - fw, y0 + fw, y1 - fw, 0.012);
  } else {
    hbox(solid, start, dir, u0 + fw, u1 - fw, y0, y1 - fw, 0.04);   // leaf
  }
  return { solid, glass };
}

/** Closed solids for every drawable element. Hosted doors / windows become infill of their host wall. */
export function elementSolids(elements: SolidElement[], filter?: (el: SolidElement) => boolean): Solid[] {
  const hostedBy = new Map<string, SolidElement[]>();
  for (const e of elements) if ((e.type === "door" || e.type === "window") && e.hostId) {
    const arr = hostedBy.get(e.hostId) ?? []; arr.push(e); hostedBy.set(e.hostId, arr);
  }
  const out: Solid[] = [];
  const push = (id: string, type: string, parts: SolidPart[]) => { const ps = parts.filter((x) => x.positions.length >= 9); if (ps.length) out.push({ id, type, parts: ps }); };

  for (const el of elements) {
    if (filter && !filter(el)) continue;
    const p = el.params;
    const elev = num(p.elevation, 0), H = num(p.height, 0), T = num(p.thickness, 0.2);
    try {
      if (el.type === "door" || el.type === "window") continue; // emitted with the host wall
      if (isM2Type(el.type)) {
        const g = buildElementGeo(el);
        if (g) push(el.id, el.type, g.parts.map((x) => ({ positions: x.positions, role: x.role })));
        continue;
      }
      if (el.type === "wall" && p.start && p.end) {
        const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
        if (L < 0.05) continue;
        const dir: Vec2 = [(p.end[0] - p.start[0]) / L, (p.end[1] - p.start[1]) / L];
        const ops = wallOpenings(el, hostedBy.get(el.id) ?? []);
        const body = new Soup();
        for (const q of wallPieces(el, ops)) hbox(body, p.start, dir, q.u0, q.u1, q.y0, q.y1, T);
        const parts: SolidPart[] = [{ positions: body.p, role: "solid" }];
        push(el.id, "wall", parts);
        for (const op of ops) {
          const f = infill(op, el, dir);
          push(op.id, op.kind, [{ positions: f.solid.p, role: "solid" }, { positions: f.glass.p, role: "glass" }]);
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (el.type === "slab" && p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 3) {
        const s = new Soup(); prismPlan(p.polygon, elev, elev + (H || T || 0.2), s);
        push(el.id, "slab", [{ positions: s.p, role: "solid" }]);
        continue;
      }
      if ((el.type === "column" || el.type === "footing" || el.type === "equipment") && p.point) {
        const s = new Soup();
        const base = el.type === "footing" ? elev - H : elev;
        orientedBox([p.point[0], base, p.point[1]], [p.point[0], base + H, p.point[1]], T, num(p.depth, T), s, [1, 0, 0]);
        push(el.id, el.type, [{ positions: s.p, role: "solid" }]);
        continue;
      }
      if (["beam", "strip", "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit"].includes(el.type) && p.start && p.end) {
        const L = Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
        if (L < 0.05) continue;
        const s = new Soup();
        orientedBox([p.start[0], elev + H / 2, p.start[1]], [p.end[0], elev + H / 2, p.end[1]], T, H, s);
        push(el.id, el.type, [{ positions: s.p, role: "solid" }]);
        continue;
      }
      if (el.type === "brace" && p.start && p.end) {
        const s = new Soup();
        orientedBox([p.start[0], elev, p.start[1]], [p.end[0], elev + H, p.end[1]], T, T, s);
        push(el.id, "brace", [{ positions: s.p, role: "solid" }]);
      }
    } catch { /* an element with unusable parameters is simply not drawn */ }
  }
  return out;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/revit-gaps/project-scope.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Per-project persistence for the "Revit parity" stores.
 *
 * Problem this fixes: rooms, areas, phases, design options, groups, reference
 * planes, shared / project parameters and copy-monitor rules were saved only in
 * global localStorage keys. They leaked between projects and were missing from
 * the saved project and the Project JSON export.
 *
 * How it works (no edits to the stores or to projects.ts):
 *   - the stores keep using their localStorage keys as a working cache;
 *   - every store change copies those keys into `project.revitStores`
 *     (the live project document, so saveProject() persists it);
 *   - when the open project changes (new / open), the keys are replaced with
 *     that project's data (or emptied) and every store is re-booted.
 * The very first time it runs, the data currently in localStorage is ADOPTED by
 * the open project so nothing already modelled is lost.
 */
import { roomsStore } from "../rooms/rooms";
import { phasesStore } from "../phases/phases";
import { designOptionsStore } from "../design-options/design-options";
import { groupsStore } from "../groups/groups";
import { refPlanesStore } from "../ref-planes/ref-planes";
import { sharedParamsStore } from "../shared-params/shared-params";
import { copyMonitorStore } from "../copy-monitor/copy-monitor";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

const KEYS = [
  "obs.rooms.v1", "obs.areas.v1", "obs.phases.v1", "obs.design-options.v1", "obs.groups.v1",
  "obs.ref-planes.v1", "obs.shared-params.v1", "obs.project-params.v1", "obs.copy-monitor.v1",
];
const STORES: Any[] = [roomsStore, phasesStore, designOptionsStore, groupsStore, refPlanesStore, sharedParamsStore, copyMonitorStore];
const ADOPTED_FLAG = "obs.revit-gaps.scope-adopted";

export interface RevitStoresPayload { v: 1; data: Record<string, string> }

let hydrating = false;
let lastProjectId: string | null | undefined;
let P: { getCurrentProject(): Any | null; markDirty(): void; onProjectChanged(cb: () => void): void } | null = null;

export function snapshotStores(): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const k of KEYS) {
    try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); if (v != null) out[k] = v; } catch { /* */ }
  }
  return out;
}

function resetStore(store: Any): void {
  for (const k of Object.keys(store)) {
    const v = store[k];
    if (v instanceof Map) v.clear();
    else if (Array.isArray(v)) v.length = 0;
  }
  if ("currentPhaseId" in store) store.currentPhaseId = null;
  if ("currentFilter" in store) store.currentFilter = "show-complete";
  if ("activeWorkPlaneId" in store) store.activeWorkPlaneId = null;
  store.booted = false;
}

/** Replace the working cache with `data` (null = empty project) and re-boot every store. */
export function hydrateStores(data: Record<string, string> | null): void {
  hydrating = true;
  try {
    for (const k of KEYS) {
      try { if (data && data[k] != null) localStorage.setItem(k, data[k]); else localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch { /* */ }
    }
    for (const s of STORES) {
      try {
        resetStore(s);
        s.boot?.();
        s.persist?.(); // idempotent; also notifies panels listening to the store
      } catch (e) { console.warn("[project-scope] store hydrate failed", e); }
    }
  } finally {
    hydrating = false;
  }
}

function syncToProject(): void {
  if (hydrating || !P) return;
  const doc = P.getCurrentProject();
  if (!doc) return;
  const snap = snapshotStores();
  const prev = (doc.revitStores as RevitStoresPayload | undefined)?.data;
  if (prev && JSON.stringify(prev) === JSON.stringify(snap)) return;
  doc.revitStores = { v: 1, data: snap } satisfies RevitStoresPayload;
  P.markDirty();
}

function onProject(): void {
  if (!P) return;
  const doc = P.getCurrentProject();
  const id: string | null = doc?.id ?? null;
  if (id === lastProjectId) return;
  const first = lastProjectId === undefined;
  lastProjectId = id;
  if (!doc) return;
  const payload = doc.revitStores as RevitStoresPayload | undefined;
  if (payload?.data) { hydrateStores(payload.data); return; }
  let adopted = false;
  try { adopted = localStorage.getItem(ADOPTED_FLAG) === "1"; } catch { /* */ }
  if (first && !adopted) {
    // Migration: the first project we ever see keeps the data that was already in localStorage.
    try { localStorage.setItem(ADOPTED_FLAG, "1"); } catch { /* */ }
    doc.revitStores = { v: 1, data: snapshotStores() } satisfies RevitStoresPayload;
    P.markDirty();
  } else {
    hydrateStores(null); // a project that has no saved data starts empty instead of inheriting another project's
  }
}

let installed = false;
export async function setupProjectScope(): Promise<{ ok: boolean; detail: string }> {
  if (installed) return { ok: true, detail: "already installed" };
  installed = true;
  const mod: Any = await import("../projects/projects");
  P = { getCurrentProject: mod.getCurrentProject, markDirty: mod.markDirty, onProjectChanged: mod.onProjectChanged };
  for (const s of STORES) { try { s.boot?.(); s.onChange?.(syncToProject); } catch { /* */ } }
  P.onProjectChanged(onProject);
  onProject();
  return { ok: true, detail: `${STORES.length} stores scoped to the open project` };
}

```
