```ts
/**
 * Revit-gaps boot (Milestones 1, 2 and 3).
 *
 * Wires, in order: per-project store persistence, real visibility (authored +
 * Fragments), wall-bounded rooms, the M2 element types (stairs, railings, ramps,
 * curtain walls, roofs, ceilings) and the authored-model IFC export. Each step
 * is isolated; the summary printed at the end lists what actually started and
 * what failed (the older boot logged "all wired" regardless).
 */
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";
import { roomsStore } from "../rooms/rooms";
import { exportAuthoredToIfc, type IfcExportOptions, type IfcSchema } from "./authored-ifc";
import { setupProjectScope } from "./project-scope";
import {
  setupVisibilityBridge, hideSelection, isolateSelection, resetTemporaryVisibility,
  promptAssignPhase, promptAssignDesignOption, tagSelection, getSelectedKeys, applyAuthored,
} from "./visibility-bridge";
import { setupRoomTool, startRoomTool, placeRoomAt, placeRoomsAutomatically, refreshRoomOverlay } from "./room-tool";
import { setupM2Register } from "./m2-register";
import { installM2Redirects, startM2Tool, ceilingsFromRooms, createM2Element } from "./m2-tools";
import { setupM3, togglePlanOption, refreshViews } from "./m3-register";

type Any = Record<string, any>;
export interface StepStatus { name: string; ok: boolean; detail: string }
export const REVIT_GAPS_VERSION = "1.2.0-m3";
const status: StepStatus[] = [];

const authoring = (): Any | null => ((ctx.features as Any).authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null);

/** Build the IFC text for the current authored model + rooms. */
export async function buildModelIfc(schema: IfcSchema = "IFC4") {
  const a = authoring();
  if (!a) throw new Error("Authoring is not ready");
  let project: Any | null = null;
  try { project = (await import("../projects/projects")).getCurrentProject(); } catch { /* */ }
  const name: string = project?.name || "OpenBIMStudio";
  const spaces = roomsStore.listRooms().map((r) => ({
    id: r.id, name: r.name, number: r.number, levelId: r.levelId, boundary: r.boundary,
    holes: (r.properties?.holes as Array<Array<{ x: number; z: number }>> | undefined) ?? [],
    height: r.height, area: r.area, department: r.department,
  }));
  const opts: IfcExportOptions = {
    schema, projectName: name, projectId: project?.id, levels: a.getLevels?.() ?? [], spaces,
    fileName: `${name.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "_")}_${schema}.ifc`,
  };
  return { opts, ...exportAuthoredToIfc(a.getElements?.() ?? [], opts) };
}

/** Export the authored model to an .ifc download. */
export async function exportIfc(schema: IfcSchema = "IFC4"): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const r = await buildModelIfc(schema);
    if (!r.stats.elements && !r.stats.spaces) { notify("warn", "Nothing to export - the authored model is empty"); return; }
    const blob = new Blob([r.text], { type: "application/x-step" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = Object.assign(document.createElement("a"), { href: url, download: r.opts.fileName });
    document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
    const skipped = r.stats.skipped.length;
    notify(skipped ? "warn" : "success",
      `${schema}: ${r.stats.elements} element(s), ${r.stats.spaces} room(s), ${r.stats.openings} opening(s)` + (skipped ? ` - ${skipped} not exported (see console)` : ""), { timeout: 4500 });
    if (skipped) console.table(r.stats.skipped);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[revit-gaps] IFC export failed", e);
    notify("error", "IFC export failed: " + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
  }
}

async function step(name: string, fn: () => unknown): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const r: any = await fn();
    status.push({ name, ok: r?.ok !== false, detail: r?.detail ?? "started" });
  } catch (e) {
    status.push({ name, ok: false, detail: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    console.error(`[revit-gaps] ${name} failed`, e);
  }
}

let booted = false;
export async function setupRevitGaps(): Promise<StepStatus[]> {
  if (booted) return status;
  booted = true;

  await step("project-scope", setupProjectScope);
  await step("visibility-bridge", setupVisibilityBridge);
  await step("room-tool", setupRoomTool);
  await step("m2-elements", () => {
    const r = setupM2Register();
    installM2Redirects();
    return { ok: r.ok, detail: r.detail + "; ST/RA/CW/RF/CL tools and parity buttons redirected" };
  });
  await step("m3-views", setupM3);
  await step("ifc-export", () => ({ ok: true, detail: "File > Export > Model > IFC4 / IFC2X3" }));
  await step("commands", async () => {
    const { registerCommand } = await import("../../features/command-palette");
    const cmds: Array<[string, string, string, () => unknown]> = [
      ["rg-room-place", "Room: place (click inside walls)", "Rooms", startRoomTool],
      ["rg-room-auto", "Room: place rooms automatically", "Rooms", () => placeRoomsAutomatically()],
      ["rg-stairs", "Stairs: straight run", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("stairs", "straight")],
      ["rg-stairs-l", "Stairs: L-shape (quarter turn)", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("stairs", "L")],
      ["rg-stairs-u", "Stairs: U-shape (half turn)", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("stairs", "U")],
      ["rg-railing", "Railing: draw path", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("railing")],
      ["rg-ramp", "Ramp: place", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("ramp")],
      ["rg-curtain-wall", "Curtain wall: place", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("curtain-wall")],
      ["rg-roof", "Roof: draw footprint (gable / shed)", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("roof")],
      ["rg-ceiling", "Ceiling: draw outline", "Architecture", () => startM2Tool("ceiling")],
      ["rg-ceilings-rooms", "Ceiling: place one in every room of this level", "Architecture", () => ceilingsFromRooms()],
      ["rg-pl-poche", "Plan graphics: toggle wall poche", "Documentation", () => togglePlanOption("poche", "Wall poche")],
      ["rg-pl-rooms", "Plan graphics: toggle room tags", "Documentation", () => togglePlanOption("roomTags", "Room tags")],
      ["rg-pl-roomlines", "Plan graphics: toggle room boundaries", "Documentation", () => togglePlanOption("roomBoundaries", "Room boundaries")],
      ["rg-pl-doors", "Plan graphics: toggle door and window marks", "Documentation", () => togglePlanOption("doorTags", "Door/window marks")],
      ["rg-pl-stairs", "Plan graphics: toggle stair symbols", "Documentation", () => togglePlanOption("stairSymbols", "Stair symbols")],
      ["rg-views-refresh", "Views: regenerate all views and sheets", "Documentation", () => { void refreshViews(); }],
      ["rg-hide", "Visibility: hide selection", "Visibility", hideSelection],
      ["rg-isolate", "Visibility: isolate selection", "Visibility", isolateSelection],
      ["rg-reset-vis", "Visibility: reset temporary hide/isolate", "Visibility", resetTemporaryVisibility],
      ["rg-phase-created", "Phase: set 'phase created' on selection", "Phasing", () => promptAssignPhase("created")],
      ["rg-phase-demolished", "Phase: set 'phase demolished' on selection", "Phasing", () => promptAssignPhase("demolished")],
      ["rg-design-option", "Design option: assign selection", "Phasing", promptAssignDesignOption],
      ["rg-export-ifc4", "Export: model to IFC4", "Export", () => exportIfc("IFC4")],
      ["rg-export-ifc2x3", "Export: model to IFC2X3 (Revit 2020)", "Export", () => exportIfc("IFC2X3")],
      ["rg-status", "Revit gaps: show status", "Help", () => { console.table(status); notify("info", status.map((s) => `${s.ok ? "OK" : "FAILED"} ${s.name}`).join(" | "), { timeout: 6000 }); }],
    ];
    for (const [id, label, category, run] of cmds) registerCommand({ id, label, category, run });
    return { ok: true, detail: `${cmds.length} commands` };
  });

  (window as Any).__obsRevitGaps = {
    version: REVIT_GAPS_VERSION, status,
    exportIfc, buildModelIfc,
    placeRoomAt, placeRoomsAutomatically, startRoomTool, refreshRoomOverlay,
    m2: { start: startM2Tool, create: createM2Element, ceilingsFromRooms },
    visibility: { hideSelection, isolateSelection, reset: resetTemporaryVisibility, tagSelection, getSelectedKeys, apply: () => applyAuthored(true) },
  };
  const failed = status.filter((s) => !s.ok);
  console.log(`[revit-gaps] ${REVIT_GAPS_VERSION}: ${status.length - failed.length}/${status.length} steps started` + (failed.length ? ` - FAILED: ${failed.map((f) => `${f.name} (${f.detail})`).join("; ")}` : ""));
  if (failed.length) notify("warn", `Revit gaps: ${failed.length} step(s) failed - see console`);
  return status;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/revit-gaps/room-detect.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Wall-bounded room detection (pure geometry, no DOM / three.js).
 *
 * Revit places a room by clicking inside an enclosed area; the room boundary
 * follows the wall finish faces. This module does the same on a plan:
 *   1. node the wall centre-lines into a planar graph (snapping near-misses,
 *      T-junctions and crossings),
 *   2. prune dangling edges,
 *   3. trace the faces of the planar graph,
 *   4. pick the face containing the point (islands become holes),
 *   5. offset every boundary edge by half of its wall thickness.
 *
 * Doors / windows are ignored on purpose: a room is bounded by the wall even
 * where a door opening cuts it. Room-separation lines are walls of thickness 0.
 */
export type Vec2 = [number, number];

export interface RoomWall {
  id: string;
  start: Vec2;
  end: Vec2;
  /** Wall thickness in metres (0 for room-separation lines). */
  thickness: number;
}

export interface RoomDetectOptions {
  /** Endpoint / T-junction snapping tolerance (m). Default 0.05. */
  snap?: number;
  /** Ignore faces smaller than this (m2) in detectAllRooms. Default 0.25. */
  minArea?: number;
  /** "finish" offsets by half thickness (Revit default); "center" keeps centre-lines. */
  boundary?: "finish" | "center";
}

export interface DetectedRoom {
  boundary: Vec2[];
  holes: Vec2[][];
  /** Net area (outer minus holes), m2. */
  area: number;
  perimeter: number;
  /** A point inside the room suitable for a tag. */
  labelPoint: Vec2;
  wallIds: string[];
  /** false when the finish-face offset failed and centre-lines were used. */
  exact: boolean;
}

interface Edge { u: number; v: number; t: number; ids: Set<string>; }
interface Face { nodes: number[]; edges: Edge[]; area: number; }
interface Graph { pts: Vec2[]; edges: Edge[]; faces: Face[]; }

const EPS = 1e-9;

function sub(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): Vec2 { return [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]]; }
function dist(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): number { return Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]); }
function cross(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): number { return a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]; }

export function signedArea(p: Vec2[]): number {
  let s = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
    const a = p[i], b = p[(i + 1) % p.length];
    s += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1];
  }
  return s / 2;
}

export function pointInPolygon(pt: Vec2, poly: Vec2[]): boolean {
  let inside = false;
  const [x, y] = pt;
  for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {
    const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];
    if ((yi > y) !== (yj > y) && x < ((xj - xi) * (y - yi)) / (yj - yi) + xi) inside = !inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

function projectOnSeg(p: Vec2, a: Vec2, b: Vec2): { pt: Vec2; t: number; d: number } {
  const ab = sub(b, a);
  const L2 = ab[0] * ab[0] + ab[1] * ab[1];
  const t = L2 < EPS ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * ab[0] + (p[1] - a[1]) * ab[1]) / L2));
  const pt: Vec2 = [a[0] + ab[0] * t, a[1] + ab[1] * t];
  return { pt, t, d: dist(p, pt) };
}

/** Proper intersection of two segments; returns params along each or null. */
function segIntersect(a: Vec2, b: Vec2, c: Vec2, d: Vec2): { t: number; u: number } | null {
  const r = sub(b, a), s = sub(d, c);
  const den = cross(r, s);
  if (Math.abs(den) < EPS) return null;
  const qp = sub(c, a);
  const t = cross(qp, s) / den;
  const u = cross(qp, r) / den;
  const e = 1e-7;
  if (t > e && t < 1 - e && u > e && u < 1 - e) return { t, u };
  return null;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- graph */

function buildGraph(walls: RoomWall[], snap: number): Graph {
  const segs = walls
    .filter((w) => dist(w.start, w.end) > 1e-6)
    .map((w) => ({ id: w.id, t: Math.max(0, w.thickness), a: -1, b: -1, pa: [w.start[0], w.start[1]] as Vec2, pb: [w.end[0], w.end[1]] as Vec2 }));

  // 1. cluster endpoints into nodes
  const pts: Vec2[] = [];
  const nodeFor = (p: Vec2): number => {
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) if (dist(pts[i], p) <= snap) return i;
    pts.push([p[0], p[1]]);
    return pts.length - 1;
  };
  for (const s of segs) { s.a = nodeFor(s.pa); s.b = nodeFor(s.pb); }

  // 2. T-junctions: pull a node onto the nearest foreign segment it almost touches
  const endpointNodes = new Set<number>();
  for (const s of segs) { endpointNodes.add(s.a); endpointNodes.add(s.b); }
  for (const n of endpointNodes) {
    let best: { pt: Vec2; d: number } | null = null;
    for (const q of segs) {
      if (q.a === n || q.b === n) continue;
      const A = pts[q.a], B = pts[q.b];
      const pr = projectOnSeg(pts[n], A, B);
      const tol = Math.max(snap, q.t / 2 + 0.02);
      if (pr.d <= tol && pr.d > 1e-9 && dist(pr.pt, A) > snap && dist(pr.pt, B) > snap) {
        if (!best || pr.d < best.d) best = { pt: pr.pt, d: pr.d };
      }
    }
    if (best) pts[n] = best.pt;
  }

  // 3. split every segment at crossings and at nodes lying on it
  const splits: Array<Array<{ t: number; n: number }>> = segs.map((s) => [{ t: 0, n: s.a }, { t: 1, n: s.b }]);
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < segs.length; j++) {
      const A = pts[segs[i].a], B = pts[segs[i].b], C = pts[segs[j].a], D = pts[segs[j].b];
      const x = segIntersect(A, B, C, D);
      if (x) {
        const p: Vec2 = [A[0] + (B[0] - A[0]) * x.t, A[1] + (B[1] - A[1]) * x.t];
        pts.push(p);
        const n = pts.length - 1;
        splits[i].push({ t: x.t, n });
        splits[j].push({ t: x.u, n });
      }
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    const A = pts[segs[i].a], B = pts[segs[i].b];
    for (let n = 0; n < pts.length; n++) {
      if (n === segs[i].a || n === segs[i].b) continue;
      if (splits[i].some((s) => s.n === n)) continue;
      const pr = projectOnSeg(pts[n], A, B);
      if (pr.d < 1e-6 && pr.t > 1e-7 && pr.t < 1 - 1e-7) splits[i].push({ t: pr.t, n });
    }
  }

  // 4. edges between consecutive split nodes (deduplicated)
  const edgeMap = new Map<string, Edge>();
  segs.forEach((s, i) => {
    const list = splits[i].slice().sort((p, q) => p.t - q.t);
    for (let k = 0; k + 1 < list.length; k++) {
      const u = list[k].n, v = list[k + 1].n;
      if (u === v || dist(pts[u], pts[v]) < 1e-7) continue;
      const key = u < v ? `${u}:${v}` : `${v}:${u}`;
      const ex = edgeMap.get(key);
      if (ex) { ex.t = Math.max(ex.t, s.t); ex.ids.add(s.id); }
      else edgeMap.set(key, { u, v, t: s.t, ids: new Set([s.id]) });
    }
  });
  let edges = [...edgeMap.values()];

  // 5. prune dangling edges (degree-1 vertices) repeatedly
  for (;;) {
    const deg = new Map<number, number>();
    for (const e of edges) { deg.set(e.u, (deg.get(e.u) ?? 0) + 1); deg.set(e.v, (deg.get(e.v) ?? 0) + 1); }
    const keep = edges.filter((e) => (deg.get(e.u) ?? 0) > 1 && (deg.get(e.v) ?? 0) > 1);
    if (keep.length === edges.length) break;
    edges = keep;
  }

  return { pts, edges, faces: traceFaces(pts, edges) };
}

function traceFaces(pts: Vec2[], edges: Edge[]): Face[] {
  // outgoing neighbours sorted CCW by angle
  const out = new Map<number, Array<{ to: number; edge: Edge; ang: number }>>();
  const add = (from: number, to: number, edge: Edge) => {
    const d = sub(pts[to], pts[from]);
    if (!out.has(from)) out.set(from, []);
    out.get(from)!.push({ to, edge, ang: Math.atan2(d[1], d[0]) });
  };
  for (const e of edges) { add(e.u, e.v, e); add(e.v, e.u, e); }
  for (const list of out.values()) list.sort((a, b) => a.ang - b.ang);

  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const faces: Face[] = [];
  for (const e0 of edges) {
    for (const [s, t] of [[e0.u, e0.v], [e0.v, e0.u]] as Array<[number, number]>) {
      if (visited.has(`${s}>${t}`)) continue;
      const nodes: number[] = [];
      const fe: Edge[] = [];
      let u = s, v = t, guard = 0;
      while (!visited.has(`${u}>${v}`) && guard++ < 100000) {
        visited.add(`${u}>${v}`);
        nodes.push(u);
        const here = out.get(u)!.find((o) => o.to === v)!;
        fe.push(here.edge);
        // next edge: the neighbour just before `u` in CCW order at `v` (turn as far left as possible)
        const list = out.get(v)!;
        const idx = list.findIndex((o) => o.to === u);
        const nxt = list[(idx - 1 + list.length) % list.length];
        u = v; v = nxt.to;
      }
      if (nodes.length >= 3) faces.push({ nodes, edges: fe, area: signedArea(nodes.map((n) => pts[n])) });
    }
  }
  return faces;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- offsetting */

function lineIntersect(p: Vec2, d: Vec2, q: Vec2, e: Vec2): Vec2 | null {
  const den = cross(d, e);
  if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) return null;
  const t = cross(sub(q, p), e) / den;
  return [p[0] + d[0] * t, p[1] + d[1] * t];
}

/**
 * Offset a CCW ring. sign=+1 moves every edge to its left (shrinks the ring),
 * sign=-1 to its right (grows it). thick[i] is the wall thickness of edge i.
 */
export function offsetRing(ring: Vec2[], thick: number[], sign: 1 | -1): Vec2[] {
  const n = ring.length;
  const dirs: Vec2[] = [], offs: Vec2[] = [], lens: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n];
    const L = dist(a, b) || 1;
    const d: Vec2 = [(b[0] - a[0]) / L, (b[1] - a[1]) / L];
    const h = (sign * (thick[i] ?? 0)) / 2;
    dirs.push(d); lens.push(L);
    offs.push([a[0] + -d[1] * h, a[1] + d[0] * h]);
  }
  const res: Vec2[] = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const p = (k - 1 + n) % n;
    const x = lineIntersect(offs[p], dirs[p], offs[k], dirs[k]);
    if (x) res.push(x);
    else {
      res.push([offs[p][0] + dirs[p][0] * lens[p], offs[p][1] + dirs[p][1] * lens[p]]);
      res.push(offs[k]);
    }
  }
  return cleanRing(res);
}

/** Remove duplicate and collinear points. */
export function cleanRing(r: Vec2[], eps = 1e-6): Vec2[] {
  let pts = r.filter((p, i) => dist(p, r[(i + 1) % r.length]) > eps);
  let changed = true;
  while (changed && pts.length > 3) {
    changed = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      const a = pts[(i - 1 + pts.length) % pts.length], b = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length];
      if (Math.abs(cross(sub(b, a), sub(c, b))) < eps) { pts = pts.filter((_, k) => k !== i); changed = true; break; }
    }
  }
  return pts;
}

function isSimple(p: Vec2[]): boolean {
  const n = p.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
      if (Math.abs(i - j) <= 1 || (i === 0 && j === n - 1)) continue;
      if (segIntersect(p[i], p[(i + 1) % n], p[j], p[(j + 1) % n])) return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function perimeterOf(p: Vec2[]): number {
  let s = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) s += dist(p[i], p[(i + 1) % p.length]);
  return s;
}

function centroid(p: Vec2[]): Vec2 {
  let a = 0, cx = 0, cy = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
    const [x0, y0] = p[i], [x1, y1] = p[(i + 1) % p.length];
    const f = x0 * y1 - x1 * y0;
    a += f; cx += (x0 + x1) * f; cy += (y0 + y1) * f;
  }
  if (Math.abs(a) < EPS) return p[0];
  return [cx / (3 * a), cy / (3 * a)];
}

/** A point guaranteed inside the polygon (centroid if inside, else widest scanline midpoint). */
export function interiorPoint(outer: Vec2[], holes: Vec2[][] = []): Vec2 {
  const inside = (q: Vec2) => pointInPolygon(q, outer) && !holes.some((h) => pointInPolygon(q, h));
  const c = centroid(outer);
  if (inside(c)) return c;
  const ys = outer.map((p) => p[1]);
  const y0 = Math.min(...ys), y1 = Math.max(...ys);
  let best: Vec2 = outer[0], bestW = -1;
  for (let k = 1; k < 20; k++) {
    const y = y0 + ((y1 - y0) * k) / 20;
    const xs: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < outer.length; i++) {
      const a = outer[i], b = outer[(i + 1) % outer.length];
      if ((a[1] > y) !== (b[1] > y)) xs.push(a[0] + ((y - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])) * (b[0] - a[0]));
    }
    xs.sort((m, n) => m - n);
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < xs.length; i += 2) {
      const mid: Vec2 = [(xs[i] + xs[i + 1]) / 2, y];
      if (xs[i + 1] - xs[i] > bestW && inside(mid)) { bestW = xs[i + 1] - xs[i]; best = mid; }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- output */

function faceToRoom(g: Graph, face: Face, faces: Face[], boundaryMode: "finish" | "center"): DetectedRoom {
  const ringC = face.nodes.map((n) => g.pts[n]);
  const thickOf = (f: Face) => f.edges.map((e) => e.t);
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  face.edges.forEach((e) => e.ids.forEach((i) => ids.add(i)));

  // holes: positive faces that share no node with this face but lie inside it
  const mine = new Set(face.nodes);
  const holeFaces = faces.filter(
    (f) => f !== face && f.area > 1e-6 && f.area < face.area && !f.nodes.some((n) => mine.has(n)) && pointInPolygon(g.pts[f.nodes[0]], ringC),
  );

  let exact = true;
  let outer = ringC;
  let holes: Vec2[][] = holeFaces.map((f) => f.nodes.map((n) => g.pts[n]));
  if (boundaryMode === "finish") {
    const o = offsetRing(ringC, thickOf(face), 1);
    if (o.length >= 3 && signedArea(o) > 1e-6 && isSimple(o)) outer = o; else exact = false;
    const grown: Vec2[][] = [];
    for (const hf of holeFaces) {
      const h = offsetRing(hf.nodes.map((n) => g.pts[n]), thickOf(hf), -1);
      if (h.length >= 3 && isSimple(h)) grown.push(h); else { exact = false; grown.push(hf.nodes.map((n) => g.pts[n])); }
    }
    holes = grown;
  }
  const area = Math.abs(signedArea(outer)) - holes.reduce((s, h) => s + Math.abs(signedArea(h)), 0);
  return {
    boundary: outer,
    holes,
    area,
    perimeter: perimeterOf(outer) + holes.reduce((s, h) => s + perimeterOf(h), 0),
    labelPoint: interiorPoint(outer, holes),
    wallIds: [...ids],
    exact,
  };
}

/** Room containing the point, or null when the point is not inside an enclosed wall loop. */
export function detectRoomAt(point: Vec2, walls: RoomWall[], opts: RoomDetectOptions = {}): DetectedRoom | null {
  const g = buildGraph(walls, opts.snap ?? 0.05);
  let best: Face | null = null;
  for (const f of g.faces) {
    if (f.area <= 1e-6) continue;
    if (!pointInPolygon(point, f.nodes.map((n) => g.pts[n]))) continue;
    if (!best || f.area < best.area) best = f;
  }
  if (!best) return null;
  const room = faceToRoom(g, best, g.faces, opts.boundary ?? "finish");
  // the click may fall inside a wall body (between centre-line and finish face)
  return room.area > 1e-6 ? room : null;
}

/** Every enclosed room on the plan ("Place Rooms Automatically"). */
export function detectAllRooms(walls: RoomWall[], opts: RoomDetectOptions = {}): DetectedRoom[] {
  const g = buildGraph(walls, opts.snap ?? 0.05);
  const minArea = opts.minArea ?? 0.25;
  const rooms: DetectedRoom[] = [];
  for (const f of g.faces) {
    if (f.area <= 1e-6) continue;
    const r = faceToRoom(g, f, g.faces, opts.boundary ?? "finish");
    if (r.area >= minArea) rooms.push(r);
  }
  return rooms;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Room tool (Revit "Room" / "Place Rooms Automatically").
 *
 *  - Click inside an enclosed set of walls in the 3D view -> a room is created
 *    whose boundary follows the wall finish faces (see room-detect.ts).
 *  - "Place Rooms Automatically" creates a room in every enclosed loop on the
 *    active level.
 *  - Rooms get an outline and a tag (number, name, area) in the viewport.
 *  - The RM shortcut (which only set an authoring tool nobody handled) now
 *    activates the click tool.
 *  - Every existing "Create Room" button called roomsStore.createRoom() with a
 *    fixed 4x3 m rectangle at the origin. That exact sample call is now routed
 *    to "Place Rooms Automatically"; any other createRoom() call is untouched.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";
import { roomsStore, type Room } from "../rooms/rooms";
import { detectAllRooms, detectRoomAt, interiorPoint, type DetectedRoom, type RoomWall, type Vec2 } from "./room-detect";

type Any = Record<string, any>;
const authoring = (): Any | null => ((ctx.features as Any).authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null);
const CUT_HEIGHT = 1.2; // plan cut plane above the level, like Revit's view range

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ levels */

interface LevelCtx { id: string | null; elevation: number }
function activeLevel(): LevelCtx {
  const a = authoring();
  try {
    const id: string | null = a?.getActiveLevelId?.() ?? null;
    const lv = (a?.getLevels?.() ?? []).find((l: Any) => l.id === id);
    if (lv) return { id: lv.id, elevation: Number(lv.elevation) || 0 };
  } catch { /* */ }
  return { id: null, elevation: 0 };
}
function levelElevation(levelId: string | null): number {
  if (!levelId) return 0;
  try { return Number((authoring()?.getLevels?.() ?? []).find((l: Any) => l.id === levelId)?.elevation) || 0; } catch { return 0; }
}

/** Walls that the horizontal cut plane (level + 1.2 m) passes through. */
export function wallsAtCut(cutY: number): RoomWall[] {
  const els: Any[] = authoring()?.getElements?.() ?? [];
  const out: RoomWall[] = [];
  for (const e of els) {
    if (e.type !== "wall" || !e.params?.start || !e.params?.end) continue;
    const base = Number(e.params.elevation) || 0;
    const top = base + (Number(e.params.height) || 0);
    if (base <= cutY + 1e-6 && top >= cutY - 1e-6) {
      out.push({ id: e.id, start: [e.params.start[0], e.params.start[1]], end: [e.params.end[0], e.params.end[1]], thickness: Number(e.params.thickness) || 0 });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- room creation */

const toXZ = (pts: Vec2[]) => pts.map(([x, z]) => ({ x, z }));
let rawCreate: ((input: Any) => Room) | null = null;

function insertRoom(d: DetectedRoom, level: LevelCtx): Room {
  const create = rawCreate ?? ((i: Any) => roomsStore.createRoom(i as any));
  const room = create({ boundary: toXZ(d.boundary), levelId: level.id });
  const patch: Partial<Room> = { area: d.area, perimeter: d.perimeter, properties: { ...room.properties, holes: d.holes.map(toXZ), wallIds: d.wallIds, labelPoint: d.labelPoint, boundaryExact: d.exact } };
  return roomsStore.updateRoom(room.id, patch) ?? room;
}

export function placeRoomAt(x: number, z: number, level: LevelCtx = activeLevel()): Room | null {
  const walls = wallsAtCut(level.elevation + CUT_HEIGHT);
  if (!walls.length) { notify("warn", "No walls cross this level's cut plane - draw walls first"); return null; }
  const d = detectRoomAt([x, z], walls);
  if (!d) { notify("warn", "That point is not inside a closed wall loop"); return null; }
  const dup = roomsStore.listRooms().find((r) => r.levelId === level.id && pointIn(d.labelPoint, r.boundary.map((p) => [p.x, p.z] as Vec2)));
  if (dup) { notify("info", `Room ${dup.number} already occupies this space`); return dup; }
  const room = insertRoom(d, level);
  notify("success", `Room ${room.number} - ${room.area.toFixed(1)} m2`, { timeout: 2200 });
  return room;
}

export function placeRoomsAutomatically(level: LevelCtx = activeLevel()): Room[] {
  const walls = wallsAtCut(level.elevation + CUT_HEIGHT);
  if (!walls.length) { notify("warn", "No walls on this level - draw closed walls first, or use the Room tool"); return []; }
  const found = detectAllRooms(walls);
  const created: Room[] = [];
  for (const d of found) {
    const dup = roomsStore.listRooms().find((r) => r.levelId === level.id && pointIn(d.labelPoint, r.boundary.map((p) => [p.x, p.z] as Vec2)));
    if (!dup) created.push(insertRoom(d, level));
  }
  notify(created.length ? "success" : "info", created.length ? `Placed ${created.length} room(s)` : found.length ? "All enclosed spaces already have rooms" : "No enclosed wall loops found");
  return created;
}

function pointIn(pt: Vec2, poly: Vec2[]): boolean {
  let inside = false;
  for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {
    const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];
    if ((yi > pt[1]) !== (yj > pt[1]) && pt[0] < ((xj - xi) * (pt[1] - yi)) / (yj - yi) + xi) inside = !inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ overlay (tags) */

let overlay: THREE.Group | null = null;
const disposeObj = (o: THREE.Object3D) => {
  o.traverse((n: any) => {
    n.geometry?.dispose?.();
    const m = n.material;
    if (m) { m.map?.dispose?.(); m.dispose?.(); }
  });
};

function tagTexture(lines: string[]): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = 384; c.height = 192;
  const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.88)";
  g.strokeStyle = "#2563eb"; g.lineWidth = 4;
  g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(6, 6, c.width - 12, c.height - 12, 18); g.fill(); g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle = "#111827"; g.textAlign = "center";
  g.font = "bold 46px system-ui, sans-serif"; g.fillText(lines[0], c.width / 2, 70);
  g.font = "40px system-ui, sans-serif"; g.fillText(lines[1], c.width / 2, 118);
  g.font = "34px system-ui, sans-serif"; g.fillStyle = "#374151"; g.fillText(lines[2], c.width / 2, 162);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  return tex;
}

export function refreshRoomOverlay(): void {
  const scene: THREE.Scene | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three;
  if (!scene) return;
  if (!overlay) { overlay = new THREE.Group(); overlay.name = "obs-room-overlay"; scene.add(overlay); }
  while (overlay.children.length) { const ch = overlay.children[0]; overlay.remove(ch); disposeObj(ch); }
  for (const r of roomsStore.listRooms()) {
    const y = levelElevation(r.levelId) + 0.03;
    const ring = (pts: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>, color: number) => {
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts.map((p) => new THREE.Vector3(p.x, y, p.z)));
      const line = new THREE.LineLoop(geo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color, depthTest: false }));
      line.renderOrder = 998;
      overlay!.add(line);
    };
    ring(r.boundary, 0x2563eb);
    const holes = (r.properties?.holes as Array<Array<{ x: number; z: number }>> | undefined) ?? [];
    holes.forEach((h) => ring(h, 0x2563eb));
    const outer = r.boundary.map((p) => [p.x, p.z] as Vec2);
    const lp = (r.properties?.labelPoint as Vec2 | undefined) ?? interiorPoint(outer, holes.map((h) => h.map((p) => [p.x, p.z] as Vec2)));
    const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tagTexture([r.number, r.name, `${r.area.toFixed(1)} m\u00B2`]), depthTest: false, transparent: true }));
    sprite.position.set(lp[0], y + 0.1, lp[1]);
    sprite.scale.set(1.5, 0.75, 1);
    sprite.renderOrder = 999;
    overlay.add(sprite);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- tool */

let attached: (() => void) | null = null;
let previewLine: THREE.LineLoop | null = null;

function pointerToPlane(e: MouseEvent, y: number): Vec2 | null {
  const dom: HTMLElement | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.renderer?.three?.domElement;
  const cam: THREE.Camera | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three;
  if (!dom || !cam) return null;
  const r = dom.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 2 - 1, -((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 2 + 1);
  const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
  ray.setFromCamera(ndc, cam);
  const hit = new THREE.Vector3();
  return ray.ray.intersectPlane(new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), -y), hit) ? [hit.x, hit.z] : null;
}

function showPreview(d: DetectedRoom | null, y: number): void {
  const scene: THREE.Scene | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three;
  if (!scene) return;
  if (previewLine) { scene.remove(previewLine); disposeObj(previewLine); previewLine = null; }
  if (!d) return;
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(d.boundary.map(([x, z]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y + 0.04, z)));
  previewLine = new THREE.LineLoop(geo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x22c55e, depthTest: false }));
  previewLine.renderOrder = 1000;
  scene.add(previewLine);
}

function attachTool(): void {
  if (attached) return;
  const dom: HTMLElement | undefined = (ctx as Any).world?.renderer?.three?.domElement;
  if (!dom) return;
  let down: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
  let lastMove = 0;
  const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => { down = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; };
  const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    if (down && Math.hypot(e.clientX - down.x, e.clientY - down.y) > 5) return; // orbit drag
    const lv = activeLevel();
    const p = pointerToPlane(e, lv.elevation + CUT_HEIGHT);
    if (!p) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    placeRoomAt(p[0], p[1], lv);
  };
  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - lastMove < 80) return;
    lastMove = now;
    const lv = activeLevel();
    const walls = wallsAtCut(lv.elevation + CUT_HEIGHT);
    if (!walls.length || walls.length > 300) { showPreview(null, 0); return; }
    const p = pointerToPlane(e, lv.elevation + CUT_HEIGHT);
    showPreview(p ? detectRoomAt(p, walls) : null, lv.elevation);
  };
  dom.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, true);
  dom.addEventListener("click", onClick, true);
  dom.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
  dom.style.cursor = "crosshair";
  attached = () => {
    dom.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, true);
    dom.removeEventListener("click", onClick, true);
    dom.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    dom.style.cursor = "";
    showPreview(null, 0);
  };
  notify("info", "Room: click inside walls to place a room (Esc to finish)", { timeout: 2500 });
}

function detachTool(): void { attached?.(); attached = null; }

export function startRoomTool(): void {
  const a = authoring();
  if (!a?.setAuthoringTool) { notify("warn", "Authoring not ready"); return; }
  a.setAuthoringTool("room");
}

function syncTool(): void {
  const t = authoring()?.getActiveTool?.();
  if (t === "room") attachTool(); else detachTool();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- setup */

const SAMPLE = [[0, 0], [4, 0], [4, 3], [0, 3]];
function isSampleBoundary(b: Array<{ x: number; z: number }> | undefined): boolean {
  return !!b && b.length === 4 && b.every((p, i) => Math.abs(p.x - SAMPLE[i][0]) < 1e-9 && Math.abs(p.z - SAMPLE[i][1]) < 1e-9);
}

let installed = false;
export function setupRoomTool(): { ok: boolean; detail: string } {
  if (installed) return { ok: true, detail: "already installed" };
  installed = true;

  // 1. route the legacy sample-rectangle call to automatic placement
  const store = roomsStore as unknown as Any;
  rawCreate = store.createRoom.bind(store);
  store.createRoom = (input: Any): Room => {
    if (isSampleBoundary(input?.boundary)) {
      const made = placeRoomsAutomatically();
      // legacy callers read .number / .area from the return value
      return (made[0] ?? { id: "", number: "-", name: "none", area: 0, levelId: null, boundary: [], perimeter: 0, height: 0, upperLimitId: null, properties: {} }) as Room;
    }
    return rawCreate!(input);
  };

  // 2. tags / outlines follow the store
  roomsStore.onChange(refreshRoomOverlay);
  refreshRoomOverlay();

  // 3. RM / startRoomTool activate the click tool
  const a = authoring();
  if (a?.onAuthoringChange) a.onAuthoringChange(syncTool);
  else setTimeout(() => authoring()?.onAuthoringChange?.(syncTool), 2000);
  return { ok: true, detail: "room tool, auto placement, tags" };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Visibility bridge.
 *
 * Problem this fixes: `visibilityFilter` (temporary hide / isolate, category
 * overrides, phase filter, design options) only *computed* answers and emitted
 * change events that nothing listened to, so none of it changed the viewport.
 * Also `ctx.features.selection.getSelectedIds()` did not exist, so the Hide /
 * Isolate / Group buttons always received an empty list.
 *
 * What this module does
 *   1. Re-applies the filter to the AUTHORED meshes (mesh.visible + phase /
 *      halftone opacity) on every filter / phase / design-option / authoring
 *      change, including after every authoring rebuild.
 *   2. Applies it to FRAGMENTS models through OBC.Hider (set / isolate on a
 *      model-id map; category overrides via model.getItemsOfCategories).
 *   3. Adds getSelectedIds() to the selection manager: authored ids plus
 *      "frag:<modelId>::<localId>" keys for fragment items.
 *   4. Adds "assign phase / design option to selection" (nothing in the app
 *      wrote phaseCreated / designOptionId before, so those filters had no
 *      data to act on).
 *
 * Phase / design-option tags live in element.properties.{phaseCreated,
 * phaseDemolished, designOptionId}. Fragment (linked IFC) items are not tagged,
 * so phase / option filters never hide them; hide, isolate and category
 * overrides do.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";
import { visibilityFilter } from "../visibility/visibility-filter";
import { phasesStore } from "../phases/phases";
import { designOptionsStore } from "../design-options/design-options";

type Any = Record<string, any>;
const FRAG_PREFIX = "frag:";

export const fragKey = (modelId: string, localId: number): string => `${FRAG_PREFIX}${modelId}::${localId}`;
export function parseFragKey(k: string): { modelId: string; localId: number } | null {
  if (!k.startsWith(FRAG_PREFIX)) return null;
  const rest = k.slice(FRAG_PREFIX.length);
  const i = rest.lastIndexOf("::");
  if (i < 0) return null;
  const localId = Number(rest.slice(i + 2));
  return Number.isFinite(localId) ? { modelId: rest.slice(0, i), localId } : null;
}

const authoring = (): Any | null => ((ctx.features as Any).authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null);

/** Authored element ids + fragment keys currently selected. */
export function getSelectedKeys(): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  try { for (const id of authoring()?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? []) out.push(String(id)); } catch { /* */ }
  try {
    const snap: Record<string, Iterable<number>> | undefined = (ctx.features as Any).selection?.snapshot?.();
    if (snap) for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(snap)) for (const lid of ids) out.push(fragKey(modelId, lid));
  } catch { /* */ }
  return out;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ authored side */

const ORIG = "__obsVisOrig";
let applyScheduled = false;
let lastActive = false;

function elementTags(el: Any): { phaseCreated: string | null; phaseDemolished: string | null; designOptionId: string | null } {
  const pr = el.properties ?? {};
  return {
    phaseCreated: (el.phaseCreated ?? pr.phaseCreated ?? null) as string | null,
    phaseDemolished: (el.phaseDemolished ?? pr.phaseDemolished ?? null) as string | null,
    designOptionId: (el.designOptionId ?? pr.designOptionId ?? null) as string | null,
  };
}

function filterInternals(): { hidden: Set<string>; isolated: Set<string> | null; categories: Map<string, { visible: boolean; halftone: boolean; transparent: boolean }> } {
  const f = visibilityFilter as unknown as Any;
  return {
    hidden: (f.tempHidden as Set<string>) ?? new Set(),
    isolated: (f.tempIsolated as Set<string> | null) ?? null,
    categories: (f.categoryOverrides as Map<string, any>) ?? new Map(),
  };
}

function anyOverride(elements: Any[]): boolean {
  const { hidden, isolated, categories } = filterInternals();
  if (hidden.size || isolated) return true;
  for (const c of categories.values()) if (!c.visible || c.halftone || c.transparent) return true;
  try {
    if (phasesStore.getFilter() !== ("show-all" as any)) { for (const e of elements) { const t = elementTags(e); if (t.phaseCreated || t.phaseDemolished) return true; } }
  } catch { /* */ }
  for (const e of elements) if (elementTags(e).designOptionId) return true;
  return false;
}

function setOpacity(mesh: THREE.Mesh | Any, opacity: number): void {
  const mats: Any[] = Array.isArray(mesh.material) ? mesh.material : [mesh.material];
  for (const m of mats) {
    if (!m) continue;
    if (!m.userData) m.userData = {};
    if (!m.userData[ORIG]) m.userData[ORIG] = { transparent: !!m.transparent, opacity: typeof m.opacity === "number" ? m.opacity : 1 };
    if (opacity < 0.999) { m.transparent = true; m.opacity = opacity; }
    else { m.transparent = m.userData[ORIG].transparent; m.opacity = m.userData[ORIG].opacity; }
    m.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}

/** Apply the filter to every authored mesh. Returns the number of hidden meshes. */
export function applyAuthored(force = false): number {
  const a = authoring();
  const group: THREE.Object3D | undefined = a?.getAuthoredGroup?.();
  if (!a || !group) return 0;
  const elements: Any[] = a.getElements?.() ?? [];
  const active = anyOverride(elements);
  if (!active && !lastActive && !force) return 0;
  const byId = new Map<string, Any>();
  for (const e of elements) byId.set(e.id, e);
  let hiddenCount = 0;
  group.traverse((o: any) => {
    if (!o.isMesh) return;
    const id = o.userData?.elementId as string | undefined;
    if (!id) return;
    const el = byId.get(id);
    if (!el) return;
    const tags = elementTags(el);
    const ve = { id, category: String(el.type), ...tags };
    const vis = visibilityFilter.isVisible(ve);
    o.visible = vis;
    if (!vis) hiddenCount++;
    const gs = visibilityFilter.graphicStyle(ve);
    setOpacity(o, vis ? gs.opacity : 1);
  });
  lastActive = active;
  return hiddenCount;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------- fragments side */

/** Authored category (element type) -> IFC class patterns for linked models. */
const CATEGORY_TO_IFC: Record<string, RegExp[]> = {
  wall: [/^IFCWALL/i, /^IFCCURTAINWALL/i], slab: [/^IFCSLAB/i], roof: [/^IFCROOF/i], ceiling: [/^IFCCOVERING/i],
  column: [/^IFCCOLUMN/i], beam: [/^IFCBEAM/i], brace: [/^IFCMEMBER/i], footing: [/^IFCFOOTING/i, /^IFCPILE/i],
  door: [/^IFCDOOR/i], window: [/^IFCWINDOW/i], stairs: [/^IFCSTAIR/i], railing: [/^IFCRAILING/i], ramp: [/^IFCRAMP/i],
  duct: [/^IFCDUCT/i], pipe: [/^IFCPIPE/i], "cable-tray": [/^IFCCABLECARRIER/i], conduit: [/^IFCCABLECARRIER/i],
  equipment: [/^IFCFLOWTERMINAL/i, /^IFCFLOWCONTROLLER/i, /^IFCDISTRIBUTIONELEMENT/i, /^IFCFURNISHING/i],
  room: [/^IFCSPACE/i], area: [/^IFCSPACE/i],
};

function categoryPatterns(cat: string): RegExp[] {
  if (/^ifc/i.test(cat)) return [new RegExp("^" + cat.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "$", "i")];
  return CATEGORY_TO_IFC[cat] ?? [];
}

type IdMap = Record<string, Set<number>>;
let fragTouched = false;
let fragQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

async function applyFragmentsNow(): Promise<void> {
  const hider: Any | null = (ctx as Any).hider;
  const frags: Any | null = (ctx as Any).fragments;
  if (!hider || !frags?.list) return;
  const { hidden, isolated, categories } = filterInternals();

  const toMap = (keys: Iterable<string>): IdMap => {
    const m: IdMap = {};
    for (const k of keys) { const p = parseFragKey(k); if (p) (m[p.modelId] ??= new Set()).add(p.localId); }
    return m;
  };
  const hasItems = (m: IdMap) => Object.values(m).some((s) => s.size > 0);

  const hiddenMap = toMap(hidden);
  // category overrides -> item ids per model
  const hiddenCats = [...categories.entries()].filter(([, c]) => !c.visible).map(([k]) => k);
  if (hiddenCats.length) {
    const pats = hiddenCats.flatMap(categoryPatterns);
    if (pats.length) {
      for (const [modelId, model] of frags.list as Map<string, Any>) {
        try {
          const found = (await model.getItemsOfCategories(pats)) as Record<string, number[]>;
          const ids = Object.values(found).flat();
          if (ids.length) { const s = (hiddenMap[modelId] ??= new Set()); for (const i of ids) s.add(i); }
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[visibility-bridge] getItemsOfCategories failed for", modelId, e); }
      }
    }
  }

  const callSet = async (visible: boolean, map?: IdMap) => {
    if (typeof hider.set === "function") { await (map ? hider.set(visible, map) : hider.set(visible)); return true; }
    if (!visible && typeof hider.hide === "function") { await hider.hide(map); return true; }
    if (visible && typeof hider.show === "function") { await hider.show(map); return true; }
    return false;
  };

  if (isolated) {
    const isoMap = toMap(isolated);
    if (hasItems(isoMap)) {
      if (typeof hider.isolate === "function") await hider.isolate(isoMap);
      else { await callSet(false); await callSet(true, isoMap); }
    } else {
      await callSet(false); // isolating authored-only items hides every linked model item
    }
    fragTouched = true;
  } else if (hasItems(hiddenMap)) {
    await callSet(true);
    await callSet(false, hiddenMap);
    fragTouched = true;
  } else if (fragTouched) {
    await callSet(true);
    fragTouched = false;
  } else {
    return; // nothing to do: leave the context-menu's own hide/isolate alone
  }
  try { frags.core?.update?.(true); } catch { /* */ }
}

function applyFragments(): Promise<void> {
  fragQueue = fragQueue.then(applyFragmentsNow).catch((e) => console.warn("[visibility-bridge] fragments apply failed", e));
  return fragQueue;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- plumbing */

function scheduleApply(): void {
  if (applyScheduled) return;
  applyScheduled = true;
  queueMicrotask(() => {
    applyScheduled = false;
    try { applyAuthored(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[visibility-bridge] authored apply failed", e); }
  });
}

function applyAll(): void {
  try { applyAuthored(true); } catch (e) { console.warn("[visibility-bridge] authored apply failed", e); }
  void applyFragments();
}

let installed = false;
export function setupVisibilityBridge(): { ok: boolean; detail: string } {
  if (installed) return { ok: true, detail: "already installed" };
  installed = true;

  visibilityFilter.onChange(applyAll);
  try { phasesStore.onChange(applyAll); } catch { /* */ }
  try { designOptionsStore.onChange(applyAll); } catch { /* */ }

  // Re-apply after every authoring rebuild: rebuild() re-creates meshes with group.add().
  const hookGroup = () => {
    const g: THREE.Object3D | undefined = authoring()?.getAuthoredGroup?.();
    if (!g) return false;
    if ((g as Any).__obsVisHooked) return true;
    const origAdd = g.add.bind(g);
    (g as Any).add = (...objs: THREE.Object3D[]) => { const r = origAdd(...objs); scheduleApply(); return r; };
    (g as Any).__obsVisHooked = true;
    return true;
  };
  const a = authoring();
  if (a?.onAuthoringChange) a.onAuthoringChange(scheduleApply);
  if (!hookGroup()) {
    const t = setInterval(() => { if (hookGroup()) clearInterval(t); }, 500);
    setTimeout(() => clearInterval(t), 60_000);
  }

  // The selection manager has no getSelectedIds(); several buttons call it.
  const installSel = () => {
    const sel: Any | undefined = (ctx.features as Any).selection;
    if (!sel) return false;
    if (typeof sel.getSelectedIds !== "function") sel.getSelectedIds = getSelectedKeys;
    return true;
  };
  if (!installSel()) {
    const t = setInterval(() => { if (installSel()) clearInterval(t); }, 500);
    setTimeout(() => clearInterval(t), 60_000);
  }
  return { ok: true, detail: "authored + fragments visibility wired" };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- public helper operations */

export function hideSelection(): number {
  const keys = getSelectedKeys();
  if (!keys.length) { notify("info", "Select elements first"); return 0; }
  visibilityFilter.hideElements(keys);
  return keys.length;
}
export function isolateSelection(): number {
  const keys = getSelectedKeys();
  if (!keys.length) { notify("info", "Select elements first"); return 0; }
  visibilityFilter.isolateElements(keys);
  return keys.length;
}
export function resetTemporaryVisibility(): void { visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); }

async function markProjectDirty(): Promise<void> {
  try { (await import("../projects/projects")).markDirty(); } catch { /* */ }
}

/** Write phase / design-option tags onto the selected authored elements. */
export async function tagSelection(patch: { phaseCreated?: string | null; phaseDemolished?: string | null; designOptionId?: string | null }): Promise<number> {
  const a = authoring();
  if (!a) return 0;
  const ids: string[] = a.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
  let n = 0;
  for (const id of ids) {
    const el: Any | undefined = a.getElementById?.(id);
    if (!el) continue;
    el.properties = { ...(el.properties ?? {}) };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(patch)) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined) delete el.properties[k]; else el.properties[k] = v;
    }
    n++;
  }
  if (n) { await markProjectDirty(); applyAll(); }
  return n;
}

function pick<T extends { id: string; name: string }>(title: string, items: T[], allowNone = true): string | null | undefined {
  if (!items.length) { notify("warn", `${title}: none defined yet`); return undefined; }
  const lines = items.map((it, i) => `${i + 1}. ${it.name}`).join("\n");
  const ans = window.prompt(`${title}\n${lines}${allowNone ? "\n0. (none)" : ""}`, "1");
  if (ans === null) return undefined;
  const i = Number(ans.trim());
  if (allowNone && i === 0) return null;
  return Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 1 && i <= items.length ? items[i - 1].id : undefined;
}

export async function promptAssignPhase(kind: "created" | "demolished"): Promise<void> {
  const id = pick(`Phase ${kind} for selection`, phasesStore.list() as Array<{ id: string; name: string }>);
  if (id === undefined) return;
  const n = await tagSelection(kind === "created" ? { phaseCreated: id } : { phaseDemolished: id });
  notify(n ? "success" : "info", n ? `Phase ${kind} set on ${n} element(s)` : "Select authored elements first");
}

export async function promptAssignDesignOption(): Promise<void> {
  const opts: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> = [];
  for (const s of designOptionsStore.listSets()) for (const o of s.options) opts.push({ id: o.id, name: `${s.name} / ${o.name}` });
  const id = pick("Design option for selection", opts);
  if (id === undefined) return;
  const n = await tagSelection({ designOptionId: id });
  notify(n ? "success" : "info", n ? `Design option set on ${n} element(s)` : "Select authored elements first");
}
```

```ts
// src/modules/roofs/complexRoof.ts
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import * as THREE from 'three';

/**
 * Generate a sloped roof with hip/valley support.
 * This is a stub – a real implementation would perform polygon triangulation
 * of the roof footprint, then create individual IfcRoof/IfcSlab elements for each
 * planar facet.
 */
export async function createComplexRoof(api: IfcAPI, footprint: Array<[number, number, number]>, pitchDeg: number, hipAngleDeg?: number): Promise<number> {
  // Convert pitch to a normal vector
  const rad = (pitchDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const height = Math.tan(rad);
  // Simple extrude the footprint along Z with the computed slope
  const shape = new THREE.Shape(footprint.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])));
  const extrude = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, { depth: 0, bevelEnabled: false });
  // Apply a shear matrix to simulate pitch (placeholder)
  const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4().makeShear(0, 0, 0, height, 0, 0);
  extrude.applyMatrix4(matrix);
  const placement = await api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
  const shapeRep = await api.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation({
    ContextOfItems: 0,
    RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
    RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
    Items: [{ type: 'IfcFacetedBrep', geometry: extrude }],
  });
  const roof = await api!.CreateIfcRoof!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shapeRep });
  return roof.id;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Rooms & Areas - Revit-competitive spatial elements.
 *
 * Rooms are 2.5D volumes bounded by walls (or an explicit polygon) on a level.
 * Areas are 2D regions used for gross/rentable area plans.
 * Both participate in schedules via reporting properties.
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export type RoomId = string;
export type AreaId = string;

export interface Room {
  id: RoomId;
  name: string;
  number: string;
  levelId: string | null;
  /** Boundary polygon in world XZ (metres). */
  boundary: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>;
  /** Computed / override area m-. */
  area: number;
  /** Computed / override perimeter m. */
  perimeter: number;
  /** Floor-to-ceiling height m. */
  height: number;
  /** Optional upper limit level. */
  upperLimitId: string | null;
  department?: string;
  occupancy?: string;
  finishes?: { floor?: string; wall?: string; ceiling?: string };
  phaseId?: string | null;
  designOptionId?: string | null;
  properties: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface Area {
  id: AreaId;
  name: string;
  number: string;
  levelId: string | null;
  boundary: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>;
  area: number;
  perimeter: number;
  areaType: "gross" | "rentable" | "net" | "custom";
  phaseId?: string | null;
  properties: Record<string, unknown>;
}

type Listener = () => void;

const STORAGE_ROOMS = "obs.rooms.v1";
const STORAGE_AREAS = "obs.areas.v1";

function uid(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
}

function polygonArea(pts: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>): number {
  if (pts.length < 3) return 0;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i];
    const b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length];
    sum += a.x * b.z - b.x * a.z;
  }
  return Math.abs(sum) / 2;
}

function polygonPerimeter(pts: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>): number {
  if (pts.length < 2) return 0;
  let len = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i];
    const b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length];
    const dx = b.x - a.x;
    const dz = b.z - a.z;
    len += Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  }
  return len;
}

class RoomsStore {
  private rooms = new Map<RoomId, Room>();
  private areas = new Map<AreaId, Area>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const r = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_ROOMS);
      if (r) {
        for (const room of JSON.parse(r) as Room[]) this.rooms.set(room.id, room);
      }
      const a = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_AREAS);
      if (a) {
        for (const area of JSON.parse(a) as Area[]) this.areas.set(area.id, area);
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_ROOMS, JSON.stringify([...this.rooms.values()]));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_AREAS, JSON.stringify([...this.areas.values()]));
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  // -- Rooms ----------------------------------------------------------

  listRooms(): Room[] {
    return [...this.rooms.values()];
  }

  getRoom(id: RoomId): Room | null {
    return this.rooms.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  createRoom(input: {
    name?: string;
    number?: string;
    levelId?: string | null;
    boundary: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>;
    height?: number;
    department?: string;
  }): Room {
    const boundary = input.boundary.slice();
    const room: Room = {
      id: uid("room"),
      name: input.name ?? "Room",
      number: input.number ?? String(this.rooms.size + 1).padStart(3, "0"),
      levelId: input.levelId ?? null,
      boundary,
      area: polygonArea(boundary),
      perimeter: polygonPerimeter(boundary),
      height: input.height ?? 2.7,
      upperLimitId: null,
      department: input.department,
      properties: {},
    };
    this.rooms.set(room.id, room);
    this.persist();
    return room;
  }

  updateRoom(id: RoomId, patch: Partial<Room>): Room | null {
    const r = this.rooms.get(id);
    if (!r) return null;
    Object.assign(r, patch);
    if (patch.boundary) {
      r.area = polygonArea(r.boundary);
      r.perimeter = polygonPerimeter(r.boundary);
    }
    this.persist();
    return r;
  }

  removeRoom(id: RoomId): boolean {
    const ok = this.rooms.delete(id);
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  /** Recompute area/perimeter for all rooms (e.g. after wall moves). */
  recomputeAll(): number {
    let n = 0;
    for (const r of this.rooms.values()) {
      const a = polygonArea(r.boundary);
      const p = polygonPerimeter(r.boundary);
      if (Math.abs(a - r.area) > 1e-6 || Math.abs(p - r.perimeter) > 1e-6) {
        r.area = a;
        r.perimeter = p;
        n++;
      }
    }
    if (n) this.persist();
    return n;
  }

  // -- Areas ----------------------------------------------------------

  listAreas(): Area[] {
    return [...this.areas.values()];
  }

  getArea(id: AreaId): Area | null {
    return this.areas.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  createArea(input: {
    name?: string;
    number?: string;
    levelId?: string | null;
    boundary: Array<{ x: number; z: number }>;
    areaType?: Area["areaType"];
  }): Area {
    const boundary = input.boundary.slice();
    const area: Area = {
      id: uid("area"),
      name: input.name ?? "Area",
      number: input.number ?? String(this.areas.size + 1).padStart(3, "0"),
      levelId: input.levelId ?? null,
      boundary,
      area: polygonArea(boundary),
      perimeter: polygonPerimeter(boundary),
      areaType: input.areaType ?? "gross",
      properties: {},
    };
    this.areas.set(area.id, area);
    this.persist();
    return area;
  }

  updateArea(id: AreaId, patch: Partial<Area>): Area | null {
    const a = this.areas.get(id);
    if (!a) return null;
    Object.assign(a, patch);
    if (patch.boundary) {
      a.area = polygonArea(a.boundary);
      a.perimeter = polygonPerimeter(a.boundary);
    }
    this.persist();
    return a;
  }

  removeArea(id: AreaId): boolean {
    const ok = this.areas.delete(id);
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  /** Schedule-ready rows for rooms. */
  roomScheduleRows(): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
    return this.listRooms().map((r) => ({
      Id: r.id,
      Number: r.number,
      Name: r.name,
      Level: r.levelId,
      Area: Math.round(r.area * 100) / 100,
      Perimeter: Math.round(r.perimeter * 100) / 100,
      Height: r.height,
      Volume: Math.round(r.area * r.height * 100) / 100,
      Department: r.department ?? "",
      Occupancy: r.occupancy ?? "",
    }));
  }

  areaScheduleRows(): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
    return this.listAreas().map((a) => ({
      Id: a.id,
      Number: a.number,
      Name: a.name,
      Level: a.levelId,
      Area: Math.round(a.area * 100) / 100,
      Perimeter: Math.round(a.perimeter * 100) / 100,
      Type: a.areaType,
    }));
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.rooms.clear();
    this.areas.clear();
    this.persist();
  }
}

export const roomsStore = new RoomsStore();

export function setupRooms(): typeof roomsStore {
  roomsStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).rooms = roomsStore;
  (window as any).__obsRooms = roomsStore;
  console.log("[rooms] ready -", roomsStore.listRooms().length, "rooms,", roomsStore.listAreas().length, "areas");
  return roomsStore;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/schedules/schedule-builder.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Programmatic schedule builder.
 *
 * Turns a concise spec — { name, category, columns, grouping } — into a
 * full ScheduleDefinition. This is what the AI calls when it wants to
 * create a schedule. It resolves column keys against the standard set of
 * column templates and applies sensible defaults from the catalog.
 */
import {
  findCategory,
  CATEGORY_CATALOG,
  type CategoryEntry,
} from "./schedule-catalog";
import { saveSchedule, type StoredSchedule } from "./schedule-store";
import type {
  ScheduleColumn,
  ScheduleDefinition,
  GroupLevel,
  ConditionalRule,
  SortKey,
} from "./schedule-types";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Standard column shapes
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const COLUMN_TEMPLATES: Record<string, ScheduleColumn> = {
  mark: { key: "mark", header: "Mark", format: "text", width: 90 },
  name: { key: "name", header: "Name", format: "text", width: 200 },
  type: { key: "type", header: "Type", format: "text", width: 140 },
  level: { key: "level", header: "Level", format: "text", width: 110 },
  category: { key: "category", header: "Category", format: "text", width: 140 },
  width: { key: "width", header: "Width", format: "length", unit: "m", width: 75 },
  height: { key: "height", header: "Height", format: "length", unit: "m", width: 75 },
  depth: { key: "depth", header: "Depth", format: "length", unit: "m", width: 75 },
  thickness: { key: "thickness", header: "Thickness", format: "length", unit: "m", width: 85 },
  length: { key: "length", header: "Length", format: "length", unit: "m", width: 85 },
  area: { key: "area", header: "Area", format: "area", unit: "m²", width: 90 },
  volume: { key: "volume", header: "Volume", format: "volume", unit: "m³", width: 90 },
  elevation: { key: "elevation", header: "Elevation", format: "length", unit: "m", width: 90 },
  count: { key: "count", header: "Qty", format: "count", width: 65 },
  material: { key: "material", header: "Material", format: "text", width: 140 },
  fireRating: { key: "fireRating", header: "Fire rating", format: "text", width: 90 },
  panel: { key: "panel", header: "Panel", format: "text", width: 100 },
  glazing: { key: "glazing", header: "Glazing", format: "text", width: 100 },
  systemType: { key: "systemType", header: "System", format: "text", width: 120 },
  costItem: { key: "costItem", header: "Cost item", format: "text", width: 160 },
  unitRate: { key: "unitRate", header: "Rate", format: "currency", unit: "$", width: 90 },
  lineCost: { key: "lineCost", header: "Total", format: "currency", unit: "$", width: 110 },
};

export function getColumnTemplate(key: string): ScheduleColumn | null {
  return COLUMN_TEMPLATES[key] ? { ...COLUMN_TEMPLATES[key] } : null;
}

export function listColumnTemplates(): ScheduleColumn[] {
  return Object.values(COLUMN_TEMPLATES).map((c) => ({ ...c }));
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Spec → definition
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface ScheduleSpec {
  name: string;
  /** Single category (IFC name) or null for multi-category. */
  category?: string | null;
  /** For multi-category schedules — list of IFC categories to include. */
  categories?: string[];
  /** Column keys in order. If omitted, uses the catalog default for the category. */
  columns?: string[];
  /** Extra column objects appended after the keys. */
  extraColumns?: ScheduleColumn[];
  /** Grouping column keys, top to bottom. */
  grouping?: string[];
  sortBy?: string;
  sortKeys?: SortKey[];
  filters?: ConditionalRule[];
  /** Whether to compute live quantities for each row. */
  useLiveQuantities?: boolean;
  /** Whether to compute cost columns for each row. */
  useCostData?: boolean;
  showTotals?: boolean;
  description?: string;
}

export function buildSchedule(spec: ScheduleSpec): ScheduleDefinition {
  const cat: CategoryEntry | undefined = spec.category
    ? findCategory(spec.category)
    : undefined;

  // Resolve columns — explicit > catalog default > generic fallback
  const columnKeys =
    spec.columns && spec.columns.length
      ? spec.columns
      : cat?.defaultColumns ?? ["type", "level", "count"];

  const columns: ScheduleColumn[] = [];
  for (const key of columnKeys) {
    const tpl = getColumnTemplate(key);
    if (tpl) columns.push(tpl);
    else
      columns.push({
        key,
        header: key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1),
        format: "text",
        width: 120,
      });
  }
  if (spec.extraColumns) columns.push(...spec.extraColumns);

  // Grouping — explicit > catalog default
  const groupingKeys = spec.grouping ?? cat?.defaultGrouping ?? [];
  const grouping: GroupLevel[] = groupingKeys.map((key) => ({
    key,
    subtotal: true,
  }));

  // Sort — explicit > catalog default
  const sortBy = spec.sortBy ?? cat?.defaultSort ?? "type";

  return {
    id: `sch-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
    name: spec.name,
    description: spec.description ?? `Schedule for ${cat?.label ?? spec.category ?? "all categories"}`,
    category: spec.category ?? null,
    levelName: null,
    columns,
    grouping: grouping.length ? grouping : undefined,
    sortBy,
    sortKeys: spec.sortKeys,
    conditionalFormatting: spec.filters,
    useLiveQuantities: spec.useLiveQuantities ?? true,
    useCostData: spec.useCostData ?? true,
    showTotals: spec.showTotals ?? true,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

/** Build and persist in one call. */
export function buildAndSaveSchedule(spec: ScheduleSpec): StoredSchedule {
  const def = buildSchedule(spec);
  return saveSchedule(def);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AI-friendly helpers
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function availableColumnKeys(): string[] {
  return Object.keys(COLUMN_TEMPLATES);
}

export function availableCategories(): { ifc: string; label: string; discipline: string }[] {
  return CATEGORY_CATALOG.map((c) => ({
    ifc: c.ifc,
    label: c.label,
    discipline: c.discipline,
  }));
}
```

```ts
export function findCategory(ifc: string): CategoryEntry | undefined {
  const upper = ifc.toUpperCase();
  return CATEGORY_CATALOG.find(
    (c) => c.ifc === upper || c.ifc.startsWith(upper) || upper.startsWith(c.ifc),
  );
}

export function listDisciplines(): { key: Discipline; label: string }[] {
  return [
    { key: "architectural", label: "Architectural" },
    { key: "structural", label: "Structural" },
    { key: "mechanical", label: "Mechanical" },
    { key: "plumbing", label: "Plumbing" },
    { key: "fire", label: "Fire protection" },
    { key: "electrical", label: "Electrical" },
    { key: "civil", label: "Civil" },
    { key: "site", label: "Site & buildings" },
    { key: "rooms", label: "Rooms & zones" },
    { key: "other", label: "Other" },
  ];
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/schedules/schedule-diff.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Schedule snapshot diffing.
 *
 * A snapshot captures the current row values for a schedule. Later, after
 * the model has been edited, the user can diff the current run against the
 * snapshot to see added/removed/changed rows.
 */
import type { ScheduleRun, ScheduleSnapshot, ScheduleRow } from "./schedule-types";

const SNAPSHOT_KEY = "obs.schedule.snapshots";

export function takeSnapshot(run: ScheduleRun, label?: string): ScheduleSnapshot {
  const id = (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `snap-${Date.now()}`;
  const snap: ScheduleSnapshot = {
    id,
    label: label ?? `Snapshot ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,
    definitionId: run.definition.id,
    takenAt: Date.now(),
    rows: {},
  };
  for (const row of run.rows) {
    if (row.subtotal) continue;
    snap.rows[row.id] = { ...row.values };
  }
  saveSnapshot(snap);
  return snap;
}

export function listSnapshots(definitionId?: string): ScheduleSnapshot[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const arr: ScheduleSnapshot[] = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    const sorted = arr.sort((a, b) => b.takenAt - a.takenAt);
    return definitionId ? sorted.filter((s) => s.definitionId === definitionId) : sorted;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveSnapshot(snap: ScheduleSnapshot): void {
  const list = listSnapshots();
  list.unshift(snap);
  // Keep the most recent 50 per definition + a hard cap of 200 total.
  const trimmed = list.slice(0, 200);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY, JSON.stringify(trimmed));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[schedule-diff] failed to save snapshot", err);
  }
}

export function deleteSnapshot(id: string): void {
  const list = listSnapshots().filter((s) => s.id !== id);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Diff
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface DiffEntry {
  rowId: string;
  kind: "added" | "removed" | "changed";
  /** For "changed" — which columns differ. */
  changedColumns?: { key: string; before: string | number | null; after: string | number | null }[];
  /** For "added" — the new values. */
  values?: Record<string, string | number | null>;
}

export interface ScheduleDiff {
  definitionId: string;
  snapshotId: string;
  snapshotLabel: string;
  snapshotAt: number;
  currentAt: number;
  added: DiffEntry[];
  removed: DiffEntry[];
  changed: DiffEntry[];
  unchanged: number;
}

export function diffAgainstSnapshot(run: ScheduleRun, snap: ScheduleSnapshot): ScheduleDiff {
  const current: Record<string, ScheduleRow> = {};
  for (const row of run.rows) {
    if (row.subtotal) continue;
    current[row.id] = row;
  }

  const added: DiffEntry[] = [];
  const removed: DiffEntry[] = [];
  const changed: DiffEntry[] = [];
  let unchanged = 0;

  for (const id of Object.keys(current)) {
    if (!(id in snap.rows)) {
      added.push({ rowId: id, kind: "added", values: { ...current[id].values } });
      continue;
    }
    const before = snap.rows[id];
    const after = current[id].values;
    const diffs: DiffEntry["changedColumns"] = [];
    const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)]);
    for (const k of keys) {
      const b = before[k];
      const a = after[k];
      if (!valuesEqual(b, a)) {
        diffs.push({ key: k, before: b, after: a });
      }
    }
    if (diffs.length) {
      changed.push({ rowId: id, kind: "changed", changedColumns: diffs });
    } else {
      unchanged++;
    }
  }

  for (const id of Object.keys(snap.rows)) {
    if (!(id in current)) {
      removed.push({ rowId: id, kind: "removed", values: snap.rows[id] });
    }
  }

  return {
    definitionId: run.definition.id,
    snapshotId: snap.id,
    snapshotLabel: snap.label,
    snapshotAt: snap.takenAt,
    currentAt: run.generatedAt,
    added,
    removed,
    changed,
    unchanged,
  };
}

function valuesEqual(a: any, b: any): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (a == null && b == null) return true;
  if (a == null || b == null) return false;
  // Numeric tolerance
  const na = typeof a === "number" ? a : parseFloat(String(a));
  const nb = typeof b === "number" ? b : parseFloat(String(b));
  if (Number.isFinite(na) && Number.isFinite(nb)) {
    return Math.abs(na - nb) < 1e-6;
  }
  return String(a) === String(b);
}

export function summarizeDiff(diff: ScheduleDiff): string {
  return (
    `+${diff.added.length} added · ` +
    `−${diff.removed.length} removed · ` +
    `~${diff.changed.length} changed · ` +
    `${diff.unchanged} unchanged`
  );
}
```
