```ts
/**
 * Schedule formula engine.
 *
 * Safe expression language:
 *   • Numbers, strings, booleans, null
 *   • Arithmetic: + - * / % ^
 *   • Comparison: = == != <> < <= > >=
 *   • Logic: AND OR NOT (also && || !)
 *   • Column refs: [Column Header]
 *   • Aggregates over group scope: SUM([Area]) etc.
 *   • Functions: IF, ROUND, MIN, MAX, ABS, CEIL, FLOOR, COUNT,
 *                SUM, AVG, CONCAT, LEN, UPPER, LOWER, TRIM,
 *                CONTAINS, STARTSWITH, ENDSWITH, ISEMPTY, ISNUMBER
 *
 * Compile once with `compileFormula` → returns a function.
 * The evaluator never touches `eval` or 
ew Function` — it walks an AST.
 */

export interface FormulaContext {
  /** Direct row values, keyed by column header (case-insensitive). */
  values: Record<string, string | number | null>;
  /** Aggregates over the current group scope. */
  aggregates?: {
    sum: (header: string) => number;
    avg: (header: string) => number;
    count: (header: string) => number;
    min: (header: string) => number;
    max: (header: string) => number;
  };
  /** Optional user variables. */
  vars?: Record<string, number | string | boolean | null>;
}

export class FormulaError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly position: number) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "FormulaError";
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Tokenizer
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
type Token =
  | { type: "num"; value: number; pos: number }
  | { type: "str"; value: string; pos: number }
  | { type: "ident"; value: string; pos: number }
  | { type: "colref"; value: string; pos: number }
  | { type: "op"; value: string; pos: number }
  | { type: "lparen"; pos: number }
  | { type: "rparen"; pos: number }
  | { type: "comma"; pos: number }
  | { type: "eof"; pos: number };

const OPS = [
  "==", "!=", "<>", "<=", ">=", "&&", "||",
  "+", "-", "*", "/", "%", "^", "=", "<", ">", "!",
];

function tokenize(src: string): Token[] {
  const out: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < src.length) {
    const c = src[i];
    if (c === " " || c === "\t" || c === "\n" || c === "\r") {
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    // Bracketed column reference
    if (c === "[") {
      const start = i + 1;
      const end = src.indexOf("]", start);
      if (end < 0) throw new FormulaError("Unclosed column reference", i);
      const name = src.slice(start, end);
      out.push({ type: "colref", value: name, pos: i });
      i = end + 1;
      continue;
    }
    // String
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
      const quote = c;
      const start = i + 1;
      let j = start;
      while (j < src.length && src[j] !== quote) {
        if (src[j] === "\\" && j + 1 < src.length) j += 2;
        else j++;
      }
      if (j >= src.length) throw new FormulaError("Unterminated string", i);
      const raw = src.slice(start, j);
      const unescaped = raw.replace(/\\"/g, '"').replace(/\\'/g, "'").replace(/\\\\/g, "\\");
      out.push({ type: "str", value: unescaped, pos: i });
      i = j + 1;
      continue;
    }
    // Number
    if (/[0-9.]/.test(c)) {
      const start = i;
      while (i < src.length && /[0-9.]/.test(src[i])) i++;
      const text = src.slice(start, i);
      const value = parseFloat(text);
      if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new FormulaError(`Invalid number "${text}"`, start);
      out.push({ type: "num", value, pos: start });
      continue;
    }
    // Identifier
    if (/[A-Za-z_]/.test(c)) {
      const start = i;
      while (i < src.length && /[A-Za-z0-9_]/.test(src[i])) i++;
      const value = src.slice(start, i);
      out.push({ type: "ident", value, pos: start });
      continue;
    }
    // Punctuation
    if (c === "(") { out.push({ type: "lparen", pos: i }); i++; continue; }
    if (c === ")") { out.push({ type: "rparen", pos: i }); i++; continue; }
    if (c === ",") { out.push({ type: "comma", pos: i }); i++; continue; }
    // Operators
    let matched = false;
    for (const op of OPS) {
      if (src.startsWith(op, i)) {
        out.push({ type: "op", value: op, pos: i });
        i += op.length;
        matched = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (matched) continue;
    throw new FormulaError(`Unexpected character "${c}"`, i);
  }
  out.push({ type: "eof", pos: src.length });
  return out;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Parser — recursive descent with precedence
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
type Node =
  | { kind: "lit"; value: number | string | boolean | null }
  | { kind: "colref"; name: string }
  | { kind: "unary"; op: string; expr: Node }
  | { kind: "binary"; op: string; left: Node; right: Node }
  | { kind: "call"; name: string; args: Node[] };

class Parser {
  private tokens: Token[];
  private i = 0;

  constructor(src: string) {
    this.tokens = tokenize(src);
  }

  parse(): Node {
    const expr = this.parseOr();
    if (this.peek().type !== "eof") {
      throw new FormulaError(
        `Unexpected token after expression: ${this.describe(this.peek())}`,
        this.peek().pos,
      );
    }
    return expr;
  }

  private peek(): Token { return this.tokens[this.i]; }
  private next(): Token { return this.tokens[this.i++]; }

  private describe(t: Token): string {
    switch (t.type) {
      case "num": return String(t.value);
      case "str": return `"${t.value}"`;
      case "ident": return t.value;
      case "colref": return `[${t.value}]`;
      case "op": return t.value;
      case "lparen": return "(";
      case "rparen": return ")";
      case "comma": return ",";
      case "eof": return "<end>";
    }
  }

  private matchOp(...ops: string[]): string | null {
    const t = this.peek();
    if (t.type === "op" && ops.includes(t.value)) {
      this.next();
      return t.value;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private matchKeyword(kw: string): boolean {
    const t = this.peek();
    if (t.type === "ident" && t.value.toUpperCase() === kw) {
      this.next();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  private parseOr(): Node {
    let left = this.parseAnd();
    for (;;) {
      if (this.matchOp("||")) {
        const right = this.parseAnd();
        left = { kind: "binary", op: "||", left, right };
        continue;
      }
      if (this.matchKeyword("OR")) {
        const right = this.parseAnd();
        left = { kind: "binary", op: "||", left, right };
        continue;
      }
      break;
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseAnd(): Node {
    let left = this.parseEquality();
    for (;;) {
      if (this.matchOp("&&")) {
        const right = this.parseEquality();
        left = { kind: "binary", op: "&&", left, right };
        continue;
      }
      if (this.matchKeyword("AND")) {
        const right = this.parseEquality();
        left = { kind: "binary", op: "&&", left, right };
        continue;
      }
      break;
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseEquality(): Node {
    let left = this.parseComparison();
    for (;;) {
      const op = this.matchOp("=", "==", "!=", "<>");
      if (!op) break;
      const right = this.parseComparison();
      left = { kind: "binary", op: op === "<>" ? "!=" : op === "==" ? "=" : op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseComparison(): Node {
    let left = this.parseAdditive();
    for (;;) {
      const op = this.matchOp("<", "<=", ">", ">=");
      if (!op) break;
      const right = this.parseAdditive();
      left = { kind: "binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseAdditive(): Node {
    let left = this.parseMultiplicative();
    for (;;) {
      const op = this.matchOp("+", "-");
      if (!op) break;
      const right = this.parseMultiplicative();
      left = { kind: "binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseMultiplicative(): Node {
    let left = this.parsePower();
    for (;;) {
      const op = this.matchOp("*", "/", "%");
      if (!op) break;
      const right = this.parsePower();
      left = { kind: "binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parsePower(): Node {
    const left = this.parseUnary();
    const op = this.matchOp("^");
    if (!op) return left;
    const right = this.parsePower();
    return { kind: "binary", op: "^", left, right };
  }

  private parseUnary(): Node {
    if (this.matchOp("!")) {
      return { kind: "unary", op: "!", expr: this.parseUnary() };
    }
    if (this.matchKeyword("NOT")) {
      return { kind: "unary", op: "!", expr: this.parseUnary() };
    }
    if (this.matchOp("-")) {
      return { kind: "unary", op: "-", expr: this.parseUnary() };
    }
    if (this.matchOp("+")) {
      return this.parseUnary();
    }
    return this.parsePrimary();
  }

  private parsePrimary(): Node {
    const t = this.peek();

    if (t.type === "num") { this.next(); return { kind: "lit", value: t.value }; }
    if (t.type === "str") { this.next(); return { kind: "lit", value: t.value }; }
    if (t.type === "colref") { this.next(); return { kind: "colref", name: t.value }; }

    if (t.type === "lparen") {
      this.next();
      const inner = this.parseOr();
      if (this.peek().type !== "rparen") {
        throw new FormulaError("Expected ')'", this.peek().pos);
      }
      this.next();
      return inner;
    }

    if (t.type === "ident") {
      const upper = t.value.toUpperCase();
      if (upper === "TRUE") { this.next(); return { kind: "lit", value: true }; }
      if (upper === "FALSE") { this.next(); return { kind: "lit", value: false }; }
      if (upper === "NULL") { this.next(); return { kind: "lit", value: null }; }

      // Function call
      if (this.tokens[this.i + 1]?.type === "lparen") {
        const name = String((this.next() as { value?: unknown }).value ?? "");
        this.next(); // consume lparen
        const args: Node[] = [];
        if (this.peek().type !== "rparen") {
          args.push(this.parseOr());
          while (this.peek().type === "comma") {
            this.next();
            args.push(this.parseOr());
          }
        }
        if (this.peek().type !== "rparen") {
          throw new FormulaError("Expected ')' after function args", this.peek().pos);
        }
        this.next();
        return { kind: "call", name: upper, args };
      }

      // Bare identifier treated as a column reference (case-insensitive)
      this.next();
      return { kind: "colref", name: t.value };
    }

    throw new FormulaError(`Unexpected token: ${this.describe(t)}`, t.pos);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Evaluator
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
type Value = number | string | boolean | null;

function toNumber(v: Value): number {
  if (typeof v === "number") return v;
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v ? 1 : 0;
  if (v === null) return 0;
  const n = parseFloat(String(v));
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

function toString(v: Value): string {
  if (v === null) return "";
  if (typeof v === "string") return v;
  if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isFinite(v) ? String(v) : "";
  return v ? "true" : "false";
}

function toBool(v: Value): boolean {
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v;
  if (typeof v === "number") return v !== 0;
  if (v === null) return false;
  const s = String(v).trim().toLowerCase();
  return s !== "" && s !== "false" && s !== "0" && s !== "no" && s !== "null";
}

function compare(a: Value, b: Value): number {
  // Numeric comparison when both coerce to numbers, else string compare.
  const na = typeof a === "number" ? a : parseFloat(String(a));
  const nb = typeof b === "number" ? b : parseFloat(String(b));
  if (Number.isFinite(na) && Number.isFinite(nb)) {
    return na === nb ? 0 : na < nb ? -1 : 1;
  }
  const sa = toString(a).toLowerCase();
  const sb = toString(b).toLowerCase();
  return sa === sb ? 0 : sa < sb ? -1 : 1;
}

function lookupColumn(ctx: FormulaContext, name: string): Value {
  // Direct match
  if (name in ctx.values) return ctx.values[name];
  // Case-insensitive
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ctx.values)) {
    if (k.toLowerCase() === lower) return v;
  }
  return null;
}

function evalNode(node: Node, ctx: FormulaContext): Value {
  switch (node.kind) {
    case "lit":
      return node.value;
    case "colref":
      return lookupColumn(ctx, node.name);
    case "unary": {
      const v = evalNode(node.expr, ctx);
      if (node.op === "-") return -toNumber(v);
      if (node.op === "!") return !toBool(v);
      return v;
    }
    case "binary": {
      const op = node.op;
      // Short-circuit for && / ||
      if (op === "&&") {
        if (!toBool(evalNode(node.left, ctx))) return false;
        return toBool(evalNode(node.right, ctx));
      }
      if (op === "||") {
        if (toBool(evalNode(node.left, ctx))) return true;
        return toBool(evalNode(node.right, ctx));
      }
      const l = evalNode(node.left, ctx);
      const r = evalNode(node.right, ctx);
      switch (op) {
        case "+": {
          // String concat if either side is a non-numeric string.
          if (
            (typeof l === "string" && !isNumeric(l)) ||
            (typeof r === "string" && !isNumeric(r))
          ) {
            return toString(l) + toString(r);
          }
          return toNumber(l) + toNumber(r);
        }
        case "-": return toNumber(l) - toNumber(r);
        case "*": return toNumber(l) * toNumber(r);
        case "/": {
          const d = toNumber(r);
          return d === 0 ? 0 : toNumber(l) / d;
        }
        case "%": {
          const d = toNumber(r);
          return d === 0 ? 0 : toNumber(l) % d;
        }
        case "^": return Math.pow(toNumber(l), toNumber(r));
        case "=": return compare(l, r) === 0;
        case "!=": return compare(l, r) !== 0;
        case "<": return compare(l, r) < 0;
        case "<=": return compare(l, r) <= 0;
        case ">": return compare(l, r) > 0;
        case ">=": return compare(l, r) >= 0;
      }
      return null;
    }
    case "call": {
      const name = node.name;
      const args = node.args.map((a) => evalNode(a, ctx));

      switch (name) {
        case "IF":
          if (args.length < 2) throw new Error("IF requires 2 or 3 arguments");
          return toBool(args[0]) ? args[1] : (args[2] ?? null);
        case "AND":
          return args.every((a) => toBool(a));
        case "OR":
          return args.some((a) => toBool(a));
        case "NOT":
          return !toBool(args[0]);

        case "ROUND": {
          const digits = args.length > 1 ? Math.trunc(toNumber(args[1])) : 0;
          const f = Math.pow(10, digits);
          return Math.round(toNumber(args[0]) * f) / f;
        }
        case "CEIL": return Math.ceil(toNumber(args[0]));
        case "FLOOR": return Math.floor(toNumber(args[0]));
        case "ABS": return Math.abs(toNumber(args[0]));
        case "MIN":
          return Math.min(...args.map(toNumber));
        case "MAX":
          return Math.max(...args.map(toNumber));

        case "SUM":
        case "AVG":
        case "COUNT": {
          // Aggregate — resolve over the current group scope.
          if (!ctx.aggregates) return 0;
          const header = colRefName(node.args[0]);
          if (!header) throw new Error(`${name} requires a column reference`);
          if (name === "SUM") return ctx.aggregates.sum(header);
          if (name === "AVG") return ctx.aggregates.avg(header);
          return ctx.aggregates.count(header);
        }

        case "CONCAT":
          return args.map(toString).join("");
        case "LEN":
          return toString(args[0]).length;
        case "UPPER":
          return toString(args[0]).toUpperCase();
        case "LOWER":
          return toString(args[0]).toLowerCase();
        case "TRIM":
          return toString(args[0]).trim();
        case "CONTAINS":
          return toString(args[0]).toLowerCase().includes(toString(args[1]).toLowerCase());
        case "STARTSWITH":
          return toString(args[0]).toLowerCase().startsWith(toString(args[1]).toLowerCase());
        case "ENDSWITH":
          return toString(args[0]).toLowerCase().endsWith(toString(args[1]).toLowerCase());
        case "ISEMPTY":
          return args[0] === null || args[0] === "";
        case "ISNUMBER":
          return typeof args[0] === "number" ||
            (typeof args[0] === "string" && isNumeric(args[0]));
        case "NUMBER":
          return toNumber(args[0]);
        case "TEXT":
          return toString(args[0]);

        default:
          throw new Error(`Unknown function: ${name}`);
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function colRefName(n: Node): string | null {
  if (n.kind === "colref") return n.name;
  return null;
}

function isNumeric(s: string): boolean {
  const t = s.trim();
  return t !== "" && !Number.isNaN(parseFloat(t)) && Number.isFinite(parseFloat(t));
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export type CompiledFormula = (ctx: FormulaContext) => number;

export function compileFormula(source: string): CompiledFormula {
  if (!source.trim()) return () => 0;
  const ast = new Parser(source).parse();
  return (ctx) => {
    const v = evalNode(ast, ctx);
    const n = toNumber(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
  };
}

export function validateFormula(source: string): { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string; position?: number } {
  if (!source.trim()) return { ok: true };
  try {
    new Parser(source).parse();
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof FormulaError) {
      return { ok: false, error: err.message, position: err.position };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}

/** Extract all [Column Name] references from a formula. */
export function extractColumnRefs(source: string): string[] {
  const refs: string[] = [];
  const re = /\[([^\]]+)\]/g;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(source)) !== null) {
    if (!refs.includes(m[1])) refs.push(m[1]);
  }
  return refs;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Schedule generator v2.
 *
 * New in this revision:
 *   • Formula columns (evaluated per row via schedule-formula.ts)
 *   • Live quantities — Area/Volume/Length pulled from getElementTriangles
 *   • Live cost — Cost item, unit rate, and line cost resolved per row
 *   • Multi-level grouping with subtotals
 *   • Conditional formatting rule application (returns hints to the panel)
 *   • Aggregate formulas via [SUM], [AVG], [COUNT] over group scope
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { getElements } from "../../features/authoring";
import { getElementTriangles } from "../clash/geometry";
import { computeTakeoff, getRows as getTakeoffRows } from "../cost/quantities";
import { computeLine } from "../cost/cost";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import type {
  ScheduleColumn,
  ScheduleDefinition,
  ScheduleRow,
  ScheduleRun,
  GroupLevel,
} from "./schedule-types";
import { compileFormula, validateFormula } from "./schedule-formula";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Geometry math (shared with quantities.ts)
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function signedVolume(tris: Float32Array[]): number {
  let v = 0;
  for (const t of tris) {
    const ax = t[0], ay = t[1], az = t[2];
    const bx = t[3], by = t[4], bz = t[5];
    const cx = t[6], cy = t[7], cz = t[8];
    v += (ax * (by * cz - bz * cy) + ay * (bz * cx - bx * cz) + az * (bx * cy - by * cx)) / 6;
  }
  return Math.abs(v);
}

function surfaceArea(tris: Float32Array[]): number {
  let s = 0;
  for (const t of tris) {
    const ux = t[3] - t[0], uy = t[4] - t[1], uz = t[5] - t[2];
    const vx = t[6] - t[0], vy = t[7] - t[1], vz = t[8] - t[2];
    const nx = uy * vz - uz * vy;
    const ny = uz * vx - ux * vz;
    const nz = ux * vy - uy * vx;
    s += 0.5 * Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz);
  }
  return s;
}

function bboxSize(b: THREE.Box3): THREE.Vector3 {
  const v = new THREE.Vector3();
  b.getSize(v);
  return v;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Helpers
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function shortCat(cat: string): string {
  return cat.replace(/^IFC/i, "").replace(/STANDARDCASE$/i, "") || cat;
}

function r3(n: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n * 1000) / 1000 : 0;
}

function levelNameForElevation(elevation: number): string {
  return `Level ${Math.max(0, Math.round(elevation / 3))}`;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Takeoff integration
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let takeoffCache: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof computeTakeoff>> | null = null;
let takeoffCacheAt = 0;

async function ensureTakeoff(): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (takeoffCache && now - takeoffCacheAt < 30_000) return;
  takeoffCache = await computeTakeoff();
  takeoffCacheAt = now;
}

function lookupTakeoff(key: string) {
  if (!takeoffCache) return null;
  return takeoffCache.find((r) => r.key === key) ?? null;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Authored rows
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function matchesCategory(el: AuthoredElement, category: string | null): boolean {
  if (!category) return true;
  const c = category.toUpperCase();
  const t = el.type.toUpperCase();
  if (c === "IFCDOOR") return t === "DOOR";
  if (c === "IFCWINDOW") return t === "WINDOW";
  if (c === "IFCWALL") return t === "WALL";
  if (c === "IFCSLAB") return t === "SLAB";
  if (c === "IFCCOLUMN") return t === "COLUMN";
  if (c === "IFCBEAM") return t === "BEAM";
  if (c === "IFCMEMBER") return t === "BRACE" || t === "TRUSS";
  if (c === "IFCFOOTING") return t === "FOOTING" || t === "STRIP";
  if (c === "IFCDUCTSEGMENT") return t === "DUCT";
  if (c === "IFCPIPESEGMENT") return t === "PIPE";
  if (c === "IFCCABLECARRIERSEGMENT") return t === "CABLE-TRAY";
  if (c === "IFCCONDUITSEGMENT") return t === "CONDUIT";
  return true;
}

function authoredRow(el: AuthoredElement, def: ScheduleDefinition): ScheduleRow {
  const p = el.params;
  const values: Record<string, string | number | null> = {
    mark: el.name,
    name: el.name,
    type: p.doorPanel || p.windowPanel ? `${el.type} (${p.doorPanel ?? p.windowPanel})` : el.type,
    level: levelNameForElevation(p.elevation),
    category: shortCat(el.type.toUpperCase()),
    width: r3(
      p.width ??
        (p.start && p.end
          ? Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1])
          : 0),
    ),
    height: r3(p.height ?? 0),
    depth: r3(p.depth ?? 0),
    thickness: r3(p.thickness),
    elevation: r3(p.elevation),
    material: String((el.properties as any)?.material ?? ""),
    fireRating: String((el.properties as any)?.fireRating ?? ""),
    panel: p.doorPanel ?? p.windowPanel ?? null,
    glazing: p.windowPanel ?? null,
    systemType: String((el.properties as any)?.systemType ?? ""),
    count: 1,
  };

  // Live quantities — pull from the takeoff engine when enabled.
  if (def.useLiveQuantities && takeoffCache) {
    const t = lookupTakeoff(`authored:${el.id}`);
    if (t) {
      values.length = t.length;
      values.area = t.area;
      values.volume = t.volume;
    }
  }

  return {
    id: `authored:${el.id}`,
    source: "authored",
    values,
    link: { kind: "authored", authoredId: el.id },
  };
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   IFC rows
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
interface IfcCacheEntry {
  ids: number[];
  categoryBy: Map<number, string>;
  meta: Map<number, Record<string, string>>;
  boxes: THREE.Box3[];
  matrix: THREE.Matrix4;
  name: string;
}
const ifcCache = new Map<string, IfcCacheEntry>();

async function buildIfcCache(modelId: string, model: any): Promise<void> {
  if (ifcCache.has(modelId)) return;

  let ids: number[] = [];
  let boxes: THREE.Box3[] = [];
  try {
    ids = ((await (model as any).getItemsIdsWithGeometry?.()) as number[]) ?? [];
    boxes = await (model as any).getBoxes(ids);
  } catch {
    ifcCache.set(modelId, {
      ids: [],
      categoryBy: new Map(),
      meta: new Map(),
      boxes: [],
      matrix: new THREE.Matrix4(),
      name: modelId,
    });
    return;
  }

  const categoryBy = new Map<number, string>();
  try {
    const cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
    for (const [c, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
      for (const id of (list as number[]) ?? []) categoryBy.set(id, c);
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Attributes — batch in chunks of 500.
  const meta = new Map<number, Record<string, string>>();
  const CHUNK = 500;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const slice = ids.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    try {
      const data = await (model as any).getItemsData(slice, {
        attributesDefault: false,
        attributes: ["Name", "ObjectType", "Tag", "Description", "PredefinedType", "FireRating"],
      });
      for (let j = 0; j < slice.length; j++) {
        const d = (data as any)?.[j] ?? {};
        const m: Record<string, string> = {};
        for (const k of Object.keys(d)) {
          const v = d[k]?.value ?? d[k];
          if (v != null && typeof v !== "object") m[k] = String(v);
        }
        meta.set(slice[j], m);
      }
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }

  try {
    model.object?.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const matrix =
    (model.object?.matrixWorld?.clone?.() as THREE.Matrix4) ?? new THREE.Matrix4();

  ifcCache.set(modelId, {
    ids,
    categoryBy,
    meta,
    boxes,
    matrix,
    name: (model as any)?.name ?? modelId,
  });
}

export function clearIfcScheduleCache(): void {
  ifcCache.clear();
  takeoffCache = null;
  takeoffCacheAt = 0;
}

function matchesIfcCategory(rawCat: string, wanted: string | null): boolean {
  if (!wanted) return true;
  const w = wanted.toUpperCase();
  const c = rawCat.toUpperCase();
  return c === w || c.startsWith(w);
}

async function ifcRows(def: ScheduleDefinition, signal?: { cancelled: boolean }): Promise<ScheduleRow[]> {
  await ensureTakeoff();
  const out: ScheduleRow[] = [];

  for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    if (signal?.cancelled) break;
    await buildIfcCache(modelId, model);
    const cache = ifcCache.get(modelId);
    if (!cache || !cache.ids.length) continue;

    for (let i = 0; i < cache.ids.length; i++) {
      if (signal?.cancelled) break;
      const id = cache.ids[i];
      const rawCat = cache.categoryBy.get(id) ?? "Other";
      if (!matchesIfcCategory(rawCat, def.category)) continue;

      const b = cache.boxes[i];
      if (!b || b.isEmpty()) continue;
      const world = b.clone().applyMatrix4(cache.matrix);
      const size = bboxSize(world);
      const meta = cache.meta.get(id) ?? {};
      const name = meta.Name ?? meta.ObjectType ?? meta.Tag ?? `#${id}`;

      const values: Record<string, string | number | null> = {
        mark: name,
        name,
        type: meta.ObjectType ?? shortCat(rawCat),
        level: null,
        category: shortCat(rawCat),
        width: r3(Math.max(size.x, size.z)),
        height: r3(size.y),
        depth: r3(Math.min(size.x, size.z)),
        thickness: r3(Math.min(size.x, size.z)),
        area: r3(2 * (size.x * size.y + size.x * size.z + size.y * size.z)),
        volume: r3(Math.abs(size.x * size.y * size.z)),
        fireRating: meta.FireRating ?? "",
        material: meta.Material ?? "",
        count: 1,
      };

      // Live quantities — prefer geometric extraction when triangles exist.
      if (def.useLiveQuantities) {
        try {
          const tris = getElementTriangles(model.object, id);
          if (tris && tris.length) {
            values.volume = r3(signedVolume(tris));
            values.area = r3(surfaceArea(tris));
            const diag = Math.hypot(size.x, size.y, size.z);
            values.length = r3(diag * 0.9);
          }
        } catch {
          /* fall back to bbox */
        }
      }

      out.push({
        id: `ifc:${modelId}:${id}`,
        source: "ifc",
        values,
        link: { kind: "ifc", modelId, localId: id },
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Cost attachment
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function attachCost(row: ScheduleRow): void {
  try {
    const line = computeLine({
      key: row.id,
      source: row.source === "ifc" ? "ifc" : "authored",
      label: String(row.values.name ?? ""),
      detail: "",
      count: Number(row.values.count ?? 1),
      length: Number(row.values.length ?? 0),
      area: Number(row.values.area ?? 0),
      volume: Number(row.values.volume ?? 0),
    } as any);
    if (line.item) {
      row.values.costItem = `${line.item.code} · ${line.item.name}`;
      row.values.unitRate = line.rate;
      row.values.lineCost = r3(line.lineCost);
    } else {
      row.values.costItem = "";
      row.values.unitRate = 0;
      row.values.lineCost = 0;
    }
  } catch {
    row.values.costItem = "";
    row.values.unitRate = 0;
    row.values.lineCost = 0;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Formulas
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
type CompiledCol = { key: string; fn: ReturnType<typeof compileFormula> };

function compileFormulaColumns(def: ScheduleDefinition): CompiledCol[] {
  const out: CompiledCol[] = [];
  for (const col of def.columns) {
    if (col.format !== "formula") continue;
    if (!col.formula) continue;
    const v = validateFormula(col.formula);
    if (!v.ok) {
      console.warn(`[schedule] invalid formula for "${col.key}":`, v.error);
      continue;
    }
    out.push({ key: col.key, fn: compileFormula(col.formula) });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Evaluate every formula column for every row, using group-scope aggregates. */
function evaluateFormulas(rows: ScheduleRow[], compiled: CompiledCol[]): void {
  if (!compiled.length || !rows.length) return;

  // Precompute aggregate accessors per group for each formula column.
  // We compute them on the fly per row (small dataset).
  for (const row of rows) {
    for (const { key, fn } of compiled) {
      const ctxAgg = {
        sum: (header: string) => aggregateOver(rows, header, row, "sum"),
        avg: (header: string) => aggregateOver(rows, header, row, "avg"),
        count: (header: string) => aggregateOver(rows, header, row, "count"),
        min: (header: string) => aggregateOver(rows, header, row, "min"),
        max: (header: string) => aggregateOver(rows, header, row, "max"),
      };
      try {
        const v = fn({ values: row.values, aggregates: ctxAgg });
        row.values[key] = Number.isFinite(v) ? r3(v) : 0;
      } catch (err) {
        row.values[key] = 0;
      }
    }
  }
}

function aggregateOver(
  rows: ScheduleRow[],
  header: string,
  scopeRow: ScheduleRow,
  op: "sum" | "avg" | "count" | "min" | "max",
): number {
  // For now, aggregate over all rows of the same source-kind.
  // Group-scoped aggregation is a later enhancement.
  const sameKind = rows.filter((r) => !r.subtotal && r.source === scopeRow.source);
  const vals: number[] = [];
  for (const r of sameKind) {
    const v = headerValue(r, header);
    const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseFloat(String(v ?? ""));
    if (Number.isFinite(n)) vals.push(n);
  }
  if (!vals.length) return 0;
  switch (op) {
    case "sum": return vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    case "avg": return vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length;
    case "count": return vals.length;
    case "min": return Math.min(...vals);
    case "max": return Math.max(...vals);
  }
}

function headerValue(row: ScheduleRow, header: string): string | number | null {
  if (header in row.values) return row.values[header];
  const lower = header.toLowerCase();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(row.values)) {
    if (k.toLowerCase() === lower) return v;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Grouping
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function bucketValue(value: any, bucket: GroupLevel["bucket"]): string | number {
  if (bucket === "thousands") {
    const n = parseFloat(String(value ?? ""));
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.floor(n / 1000) * 1000 : "—";
  }
  if (bucket === "firstLetter") {
    const s = String(value ?? "");
    return s ? s[0].toUpperCase() : "—";
  }
  if (bucket === "ifcPrefix") {
    const s = String(value ?? "").replace(/^IFC/i, "");
    return s.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase() || "—";
  }
  if (bucket === "level") {
    return String(value ?? "—") || "—";
  }
  return String(value ?? "—") || "—";
}

/** Attach `groupPath` to each row based on the definition's group levels. */
function assignGroupPath(rows: ScheduleRow[], levels: GroupLevel[]): void {
  if (!levels.length) return;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const path: (string | number)[] = [];
    for (const lvl of levels) {
      const v = headerValue(row, lvl.key);
      path.push(bucketValue(v, lvl.bucket));
    }
    row.groupPath = path;
  }
}

/** Build subtotal rows per group level. Returns a new array with rows
 *  reordered by group and subtotal rows inserted. */
function buildGroupedRows(
  rows: ScheduleRow[],
  levels: GroupLevel[],
  numericColumns: string[],
): ScheduleRow[] {
  if (!levels.length) return rows;

  const out: ScheduleRow[] = [];
  const recursion = (subset: ScheduleRow[], level: number, prefix: (string | number)[]) => {
    if (level >= levels.length) {
      for (const r of subset) out.push(r);
      return;
    }
    const buckets = new Map<string | number, ScheduleRow[]>();
    for (const r of subset) {
      const key = r.groupPath?.[level] ?? "—";
      const arr = buckets.get(key) ?? [];
      arr.push(r);
      buckets.set(key, arr);
    }
    const sortedKeys = [...buckets.keys()].sort((a, b) =>
      String(a).localeCompare(String(b)),
    );

    for (const k of sortedKeys) {
      const group = buckets.get(k)!;
      // Emit a header row at this level.
      const headerRow: ScheduleRow = {
        id: `group:${prefix.concat(k).join("|")}`,
        source: "mixed",
        values: {},
        groupPath: prefix.concat(k),
        depth: level,
        subtotal: true,
      };
      const firstColKey = numericColumns[0] ? undefined : undefined;
      const labelCol = levels[level].key;
      headerRow.values[labelCol] = k;
      out.push(headerRow);

      // Recurse or emit data rows
      recursion(group, level + 1, prefix.concat(k));

      // Emit subtotal after this group if it's the last level or subtotal is on.
      const subtotalEnabled = levels[level].subtotal !== false;
      if (subtotalEnabled) {
        const subtotalRow: ScheduleRow = {
          id: `subtotal:${prefix.concat(k).join("|")}`,
          source: "mixed",
          values: {},
          groupPath: prefix.concat(k),
          depth: level,
          subtotal: true,
          subtotalValues: {},
        };
        for (const colKey of numericColumns) {
          let s = 0;
          for (const r of group) {
            const v = headerValue(r, colKey);
            const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseFloat(String(v ?? ""));
            if (Number.isFinite(n)) s += n;
          }
          subtotalRow.subtotalValues![colKey] = r3(s);
        }
        subtotalRow.values[levels[level].key] = `Subtotal · ${k}`;
        out.push(subtotalRow);
      }
    }
  };
  recursion(rows, 0, []);
  return out;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface RunScheduleOptions {
  signal?: { cancelled: boolean };
  onProgress?: (p: { phase: string; current: number; total: number }) => void;
}

export async function runSchedule(
  def: ScheduleDefinition,
  opts: RunScheduleOptions = {},
): Promise<ScheduleRun> {
  const onProg = opts.onProgress ?? (() => {});

  onProg({ phase: "Reading authored elements", current: 0, total: 3 });

  const authoredRows: ScheduleRow[] = [];
  for (const el of getElements()) {
    if (opts.signal?.cancelled) break;
    if (!matchesCategory(el, def.category)) continue;
    if (def.levelName && levelNameForElevation(el.params.elevation) !== def.levelName) continue;
    const row = authoredRow(el, def);
    if (def.useCostData) attachCost(row);
    authoredRows.push(row);
  }

  onProg({ phase: "Reading IFC elements", current: 1, total: 3 });
  const ifc = await ifcRows(def, opts.signal);
  if (def.useCostData) for (const r of ifc) attachCost(r);

  onProg({ phase: "Grouping and totals", current: 2, total: 3 });
  let all: ScheduleRow[] = [...authoredRows, ...ifc];

  // Sorting
  const sortKeys = def.sortKeys ?? (def.sortBy ? [{ key: def.sortBy, dir: "asc" } as const] : []);
  if (sortKeys.length) {
    all.sort((a, b) => {
      for (const sk of sortKeys) {
        const va = headerValue(a, sk.key);
        const vb = headerValue(b, sk.key);
        if (va == null && vb == null) continue;
        if (va == null) return sk.dir === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
        if (vb == null) return sk.dir === "asc" ? -1 : 1;
        if (typeof va === "number" && typeof vb === "number") {
          if (va !== vb) return (va - vb) * (sk.dir === "asc" ? 1 : -1);
        } else {
          const cmp = String(va).localeCompare(String(vb));
          if (cmp !== 0) return cmp * (sk.dir === "asc" ? 1 : -1);
        }
      }
      return 0;
    });
  }

  // Formula columns
  const compiled = compileFormulaColumns(def);
  if (compiled.length) evaluateFormulas(all, compiled);

  // Grand totals (before grouping so we don't count subtotal rows)
  const numericCols = def.columns
    .filter((c) => c.format !== "text" && c.format !== "date")
    .map((c) => c.key);
  const totals: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const c of numericCols) {
    let s = 0;
    for (const r of all) {
      const v = r.values[c];
      const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseFloat(String(v ?? ""));
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) s += n;
    }
    totals[c] = r3(s);
  }

  // Grouping
  if (def.grouping?.length) {
    assignGroupPath(all, def.grouping);
    all = buildGroupedRows(all, def.grouping, numericCols);
  }

  onProg({ phase: "Done", current: 3, total: 3 });

  return {
    definition: def,
    rows: all,
    totals,
    generatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

export async function runBuiltInSchedule(
  id: string,
  opts?: RunScheduleOptions,
): Promise<ScheduleRun | null> {
  const { getTemplate } = await import("./schedule-templates");
  const def = getTemplate(id);
  if (!def) return null;
  return runSchedule(def, opts);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Persistent schedule storage.
 *
 * Stores user-created schedule definitions in localStorage, separate from
 * the built-in templates. A definition is self-contained � everything the
 * generator needs to produce rows.
 */
import type { ScheduleDefinition } from "./schedule-types";

const STORE_KEY = "obs.schedules.definitions.v1";

export interface StoredSchedule extends ScheduleDefinition {
  /** Auto-filled when the user creates a schedule. */
  createdAt?: number;
  /** Last time the definition was edited or run. */
  lastRunAt?: number;
  /** Marked when the schedule is derived from a built-in template. */
  derivedFrom?: string;
}

export function listSavedSchedules(): StoredSchedule[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed as StoredSchedule[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function getSavedSchedule(id: string): StoredSchedule | null {
  return listSavedSchedules().find((s) => s.id === id) ?? null;
}

function persist(list: StoredSchedule[]): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[schedule-store] failed to persist", err);
  }
}

export function saveSchedule(def: ScheduleDefinition): StoredSchedule {
  const list = listSavedSchedules();
  const idx = list.findIndex((s) => s.id === def.id);
  const stored: StoredSchedule = {
    ...def,
    createdAt: idx >= 0 ? list[idx].createdAt : Date.now(),
    lastRunAt: Date.now(),
  };
  if (idx >= 0) list[idx] = stored;
  else list.unshift(stored);
  persist(list);
  return stored;
}

export function deleteSchedule(id: string): void {
  persist(listSavedSchedules().filter((s) => s.id !== id));
}

export function renameSchedule(id: string, name: string): void {
  const list = listSavedSchedules();
  const idx = list.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
  if (idx < 0) return;
  list[idx] = { ...list[idx], name, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  persist(list);
}

export function duplicateSchedule(id: string, newName?: string): StoredSchedule | null {
  const src = getSavedSchedule(id);
  if (!src) return null;
  const copy: StoredSchedule = {
    ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src)),
    id: `sch-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
    name: newName ?? `${src.name} (copy)`,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
  delete (copy as any).lastRunAt;
  delete (copy as any).derivedFrom;
  const list = listSavedSchedules();
  list.unshift(copy);
  persist(list);
  return copy;
}

export function exportSchedules(): string {
  return JSON.stringify(listSavedSchedules(), null, 2);
}

export function importSchedules(json: string): number {
  try {
    const incoming = JSON.parse(json);
    if (!Array.isArray(incoming)) return 0;
    const list = listSavedSchedules();
    const byId = new Map(list.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
    let count = 0;
    for (const s of incoming) {
      if (!s || typeof s !== "object") continue;
      if (!s.id) s.id = `sch-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
      byId.set(s.id, s);
      count++;
    }
    persist([...byId.values()]);
    return count;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Built-in schedule templates — v3.
 *
 * Adds international variations:
 *   • NRM 2 (UK)               — tpl-boq-nrm
 *   • DIN 276 (Germany)        — tpl-boq-din276
 *   • MasterFormat (US)        — tpl-boq-masterformat
 *   • GB/T 51269 (China)       — tpl-boq-gbt
 *   • JIS (Japan)              — tpl-boq-jis
 *   • IS 1200 (India)          — tpl-boq-is1200
 *   • AS 1181 (Australia)      — tpl-boq-as1181
 */
import type { ScheduleDefinition, GroupLevel, ConditionalRule } from "./schedule-types";
import { getColumnTemplate } from "./schedule-builder";
import { notify } from "../../core/notify";
import { services } from "../../core/services";

const C = (key: string, overrides: Record<string, any> = {}) => {
  const tpl = getColumnTemplate(key);
  if (!tpl) {
    return {
      key,
      header: key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1),
      format: "text" as const,
      ...overrides,
    };
  }
  return { ...tpl, ...overrides };
};

const G = (key: string, subtotal = true): GroupLevel => ({ key, subtotal });

const RULE = {
  fireRed: (): ConditionalRule => ({
    id: "fire-60",
    column: "fireRating",
    op: "contains",
    value: "60",
    bg: "rgba(239,68,68,.15)",
    fg: "#fca5a5",
  }),
  highCost: (): ConditionalRule => ({
    id: "cost-top",
    column: "lineCost",
    op: "gt",
    value: 5000,
    bg: "rgba(245,158,11,.15)",
    fg: "#fbbf24",
    wholeRow: true,
  }),
};

const T = (
  id: string,
  name: string,
  category: string | null,
  columns: any[],
  grouping: GroupLevel[],
  sortBy: string,
  extra: Partial<ScheduleDefinition> = {},
): ScheduleDefinition => ({
  id,
  templateId: id,
  name,
  category,
  levelName: null,
  columns,
  grouping,
  sortBy,
  showTotals: true,
  useLiveQuantities: true,
  useCostData: true,
  updatedAt: Date.now(),
  ...extra,
});

export const BUILT_IN_SCHEDULES = BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES;

export function getTemplate(id: string): ScheduleDefinition | undefined {
  return BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === id || t.templateId === id);
}

export function cloneTemplate(tpl: ScheduleDefinition): ScheduleDefinition {
  return {
    ...tpl,
    id: `sch-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
    columns: tpl.columns.map((c) => ({ ...c })),
    grouping: tpl.grouping?.map((g) => ({ ...g })),
    conditionalFormatting: tpl.conditionalFormatting?.map((r) => ({ ...r })),
    sortKeys: tpl.sortKeys?.map((s) => ({ ...s })),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

/* ── Command palette registration (Week 5) ───────────────────────────── */

let scheduleCommandsRegistered = false;

export function registerScheduleCommands(): void {
  if (scheduleCommandsRegistered) return;
  scheduleCommandsRegistered = true;

  void (async () => {
    let registerCommand: (cmd: {
      id: string;
      label: string;
      category?: string;
      hint?: string;
      run: () => void | Promise<void>;
    }) => void;
    try {
      const mod = await import("../../features/command-palette");
      registerCommand = mod.registerCommand;
    } catch {
      return;
    }

    for (const tpl of BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES) {
      registerCommand({
        id: `schedule.template.${tpl.id}`,
        label: `Schedule: ${tpl.name}`,
        category: "Schedules",
        hint: (tpl as any).description,
        run: async () => {
          services.tryUse("schedulesPanel")?.toggle();
          try {
            const genMod: any = await import("./schedule-generator");
            const run = await genMod.runSchedule(tpl);
            const dataRows = (run?.rows ?? []).filter((r: any) => !r.subtotal);
            notify("success", `${tpl.name}: ${dataRows.length} row(s)`);
          } catch (err) {
            notify("error", `Schedule failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
          }
        },
      });
    }

    try {
      const store: any = await import("./schedule-store");
      const listFn = store.listSavedSchedules ?? store.listSchedules;
      if (typeof listFn !== "function") return;
      const saved = listFn() ?? [];
      for (const s of saved) {
        registerCommand({
          id: `schedule.saved.${s.id}`,
          label: `Saved schedule: ${s.name}`,
          category: "Schedules",
          hint: `${s.category ?? "All"}`,
          run: async () => {
            services.tryUse("schedulesPanel")?.toggle();
            try {
              const genMod: any = await import("./schedule-generator");
              const run = await genMod.runSchedule(s);
              notify("success", `${s.name}: ${(run?.rows ?? []).length} row(s)`);
            } catch (err) {
              notify("error", `Schedule failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
            }
          },
        });
      }
    } catch {
      /* store optional */
    }
  })();
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/schedules/schedule-types.ts ---
```ts
/** Schedule types — v2 with grouping, formulas, formatting, snapshots. */

export type ScheduleSource = "authored" | "ifc" | "mixed";

export type ColumnFormat =
  | "text"
  | "number"
  | "length"
  | "area"
  | "volume"
  | "count"
  | "currency"
  | "percent"
  | "date"
  | "formula";

/** A column in the schedule. */
export interface ScheduleColumn {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  format: ColumnFormat;
  unit?: string;
  width?: number;
  hidden?: boolean;
  /** For format: "formula". The expression source. */
  formula?: string;
  /** Optional tooltip text. */
  help?: string;
}

/** One level of grouping. Rows are grouped by the column key, in order. */
export interface GroupLevel {
  key: string;
  /** Optional bucket function applied to the value before grouping. */
  bucket?:
    | "none"
    | "thousands"
    | "level"
    | "firstLetter"
    | "ifcPrefix";
  /** Show a subtotal row after each group. */
  subtotal?: boolean;
  /** Collapsed by default when the schedule opens. */
  collapsed?: boolean;
}

export type ConditionOperator =
  | "eq"
  | "neq"
  | "gt"
  | "gte"
  | "lt"
  | "lte"
  | "contains"
  | "empty"
  | "notempty";

export interface ConditionalRule {
  id: string;
  /** Column key, or "*" for entire row. */
  column: string;
  op: ConditionOperator;
  value?: string | number;
  /** Optional formula expression — if set, condition is satisfied when
   *  expression evaluates to a truthy value. */
  formula?: string;
  /** CSS color, or a token like "#fca5a5". */
  bg?: string;
  fg?: string;
  /** If true, apply to the whole row rather than just the target column. */
  wholeRow?: boolean;
}

export interface SortKey {
  key: string;
  dir: "asc" | "desc";
}

export interface ScheduleRow {
  id: string;
  source: ScheduleSource;
  values: Record<string, string | number | null>;
  /** Group path — array of group values, one per group level. */
  groupPath?: (string | number)[];
  /** True if this row is a subtotal row generated by the generator. */
  subtotal?: boolean;
  /** Depth in the group tree (0 = top-level, -1 = data row). */
  depth?: number;
  /** Column keys that are subtotalable for this row. */
  subtotalValues?: Record<string, number>;
  link?: {
    kind: "authored" | "ifc";
    modelId?: string;
    localId?: number;
    authoredId?: string;
  };
}

export interface ScheduleDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Template this was created from, if any. */
  templateId?: string;
  category: string | null;
  levelName: string | null;
  columns: ScheduleColumn[];
  grouping?: GroupLevel[];
  sortBy?: string;
  sortKeys?: SortKey[];
  conditionalFormatting?: ConditionalRule[];
  /** Whether the schedule pulls quantities from the takeoff engine. */
  useLiveQuantities?: boolean;
  /** Whether the schedule pulls cost items and line costs. */
  useCostData?: boolean;
  /** Whether subtotal rows are shown (per group level, plus grand total). */
  showTotals?: boolean;
  /** Saved timestamp of when this definition was last edited. */
  updatedAt?: number;
}

export interface ScheduleRun {
  definition: ScheduleDefinition;
  rows: ScheduleRow[];
  /** Totals per column (grand total across all rows). */
  totals: Record<string, number>;
  /** Subtotals per group path per column. */
  groupTotals?: Record<string, Record<string, number>>;
  generatedAt: number;
  /** Snapshot ID for diffing — set on request. */
  snapshotId?: string;
}

/** Compact snapshot for diffing schedules between revisions. */
export interface ScheduleSnapshot {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  definitionId: string;
  takenAt: number;
  /** Row id → serialized values. */
  rows: Record<string, Record<string, string | number | null>>;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/shared-params/shared-params.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Shared / Project Parameters - Revit Shared Parameter analogue.
 *
 * Shared parameters are defined once (GUID + name + type) and can be
 * bound onto any family or project element. Project parameters are
 * project-scoped bindings of shared (or local) parameters onto categories.
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import type { ParameterType } from "../families/types";

export interface SharedParameter {
  guid: string;
  name: string;
  type: ParameterType;
  group: string;
  description?: string;
  /** true = instance, false = type */
  instance: boolean;
}

export interface ProjectParameter {
  id: string;
  /** Shared parameter GUID, or local name if not shared. */
  sharedGuid: string | null;
  name: string;
  type: ParameterType;
  group: string;
  instance: boolean;
  /** Categories this parameter applies to (empty = all). */
  categories: string[];
  defaultValue?: unknown;
}

const STORAGE_SHARED = "obs.shared-params.v1";
const STORAGE_PROJECT = "obs.project-params.v1";
type Listener = () => void;

function guid(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID) {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
    const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const v = c === "x" ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return v.toString(16);
  });
}

class SharedParamsStore {
  private shared = new Map<string, SharedParameter>();
  private project = new Map<string, ProjectParameter>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const s = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SHARED);
      if (s) {
        for (const p of JSON.parse(s) as SharedParameter[]) {
          this.shared.set(p.guid, p);
        }
      }
      const pr = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_PROJECT);
      if (pr) {
        for (const p of JSON.parse(pr) as ProjectParameter[]) {
          this.project.set(p.id, p);
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    // Seed a few common shared parameters
    if (!this.shared.size) {
      this.addShared({
        name: "FireRating",
        type: "text",
        group: "Identity Data",
        instance: false,
        description: "Fire resistance rating",
      });
      this.addShared({
        name: "Mark",
        type: "text",
        group: "Identity Data",
        instance: true,
        description: "Element mark",
      });
      this.addShared({
        name: "Comments",
        type: "text",
        group: "Identity Data",
        instance: true,
      });
      this.addShared({
        name: "OmniClassNumber",
        type: "text",
        group: "Identity Data",
        instance: false,
      });
    }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SHARED, JSON.stringify([...this.shared.values()]));
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PROJECT, JSON.stringify([...this.project.values()]));
    } catch { /* */ }
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  listShared(): SharedParameter[] {
    return [...this.shared.values()];
  }

  getShared(guid: string): SharedParameter | null {
    return this.shared.get(guid) ?? null;
  }

  addShared(input: {
    name: string;
    type: ParameterType;
    group: string;
    instance: boolean;
    description?: string;
  }): SharedParameter {
    const p: SharedParameter = {
      guid: guid(),
      name: input.name,
      type: input.type,
      group: input.group,
      instance: input.instance,
      description: input.description,
    };
    this.shared.set(p.guid, p);
    this.persist();
    return p;
  }

  removeShared(g: string): boolean {
    const ok = this.shared.delete(g);
    // Also drop project bindings that reference it
    for (const [id, pp] of this.project) {
      if (pp.sharedGuid === g) this.project.delete(id);
    }
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  listProject(): ProjectParameter[] {
    return [...this.project.values()];
  }

  bindToProject(input: {
    sharedGuid?: string | null;
    name: string;
    type: ParameterType;
    group: string;
    instance: boolean;
    categories?: string[];
    defaultValue?: unknown;
  }): ProjectParameter {
    const p: ProjectParameter = {
      id: guid(),
      sharedGuid: input.sharedGuid ?? null,
      name: input.name,
      type: input.type,
      group: input.group,
      instance: input.instance,
      categories: input.categories ?? [],
      defaultValue: input.defaultValue,
    };
    this.project.set(p.id, p);
    this.persist();
    return p;
  }

  unbindProject(id: string): boolean {
    const ok = this.project.delete(id);
    if (ok) this.persist();
    return ok;
  }

  /** Parameters applicable to a given element category. */
  forCategory(category: string): ProjectParameter[] {
    return this.listProject().filter(
      (p) => !p.categories.length || p.categories.includes(category),
    );
  }

  /**
   * Build a values map for schedule/export by merging element properties
   * with project parameter defaults.
   */
  resolveValues(
    category: string,
    elementProps: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  ): Record<string, unknown> {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(elementProps ?? {}) };
    for (const p of this.forCategory(category)) {
      if (!(p.name in out) && p.defaultValue !== undefined) {
        out[p.name] = p.defaultValue;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Export shared parameter definitions as a Revit-like text table. */
  exportSharedTxt(): string {
    const lines = [
      "# Open BIM Studio Shared Parameters",
      "# GUID\tName\tType\tGroup\tInstance",
    ];
    for (const p of this.listShared()) {
      lines.push(
        `${p.guid}\t${p.name}\t${p.type}\t${p.group}\t${p.instance ? "1" : "0"}`,
      );
    }
    return lines.join("\n");
  }

  /** Import from tab-separated shared parameter text. */
  importSharedTxt(text: string): number {
    let n = 0;
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      if (!line || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
      const [g, name, type, group, inst] = line.split("\t");
      if (!name || !type) continue;
      const p: SharedParameter = {
        guid: g || guid(),
        name,
        type: type as ParameterType,
        group: group || "Other",
        instance: inst === "1" || inst === "true",
      };
      this.shared.set(p.guid, p);
      n++;
    }
    if (n) this.persist();
    return n;
  }
}

export const sharedParamsStore = new SharedParamsStore();

export function setupSharedParams(): typeof sharedParamsStore {
  sharedParamsStore.boot();
  (ctx.features as any).sharedParams = sharedParamsStore;
  (window as any).__obsSharedParams = sharedParamsStore;
  console.log(
    "[shared-params] ready -",
    sharedParamsStore.listShared().length,
    "shared,",
    sharedParamsStore.listProject().length,
    "project",
  );
  return sharedParamsStore;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Sheets & Drawing Production — professional documentation engine.
 *
 * Places plan views, 3D views and schedules onto titleblocked sheets.
 * Designed to compete with Revit sheets / Bentley drawing production.
 */
import type { SheetDef, SheetViewport, TitleblockDef } from "../projects/types";

const uid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `sh-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

const SHEET_SIZES_MM: Record<SheetDef["size"], { w: number; h: number }> = {
  A0: { w: 1189, h: 841 },
  A1: { w: 841, h: 594 },
  A2: { w: 594, h: 420 },
  A3: { w: 420, h: 297 },
  A4: { w: 297, h: 210 },
  "ANSI-D": { w: 864, h: 559 },
  "ANSI-E": { w: 1118, h: 864 },
  "Arch-D": { w: 914, h: 610 },
  "Arch-E": { w: 1219, h: 914 },
};

let sheets: SheetDef[] = [];
let titleblocks: TitleblockDef[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notify() {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
}

export function onSheetsChange(fn: () => void) {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => listeners.delete(fn);
}

export function listSheets(): SheetDef[] {
  return sheets.slice().sort((a, b) => a.number.localeCompare(b.number, undefined, { numeric: true }));
}

export function getSheet(id: string): SheetDef | undefined {
  return sheets.find((s) => s.id === id);
}

export function createSheet(opts?: Partial<Pick<SheetDef, "number" | "name" | "size" | "orientation">>): SheetDef {
  const n = sheets.length + 1;
  const sheet: SheetDef = {
    id: uid(),
    number: opts?.number ?? `A-${String(n).padStart(3, "0")}`,
    name: opts?.name ?? `Sheet ${n}`,
    size: opts?.size ?? "A1",
    orientation: opts?.orientation ?? "landscape",
    viewports: [],
    annotations: [],
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
  // Attach default titleblock if available
  const tb = titleblocks[0];
  if (tb) sheet.titleblockId = tb.id;
  sheets.push(sheet);
  notify();
  return sheet;
}

export function updateSheet(id: string, patch: Partial<SheetDef>) {
  const s = sheets.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!s) return;
  Object.assign(s, patch, { updatedAt: Date.now() });
  notify();
}

export function deleteSheet(id: string) {
  sheets = sheets.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
  notify();
}

export function addViewport(sheetId: string, vp: Omit<SheetViewport, "id">): SheetViewport | null {
  const s = sheets.find((x) => x.id === sheetId);
  if (!s) return null;
  const viewport: SheetViewport = { ...vp, id: uid() };
  s.viewports.push(viewport);
  s.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
  return viewport;
}

export function removeViewport(sheetId: string, viewportId: string) {
  const s = sheets.find((x) => x.id === sheetId);
  if (!s) return;
  s.viewports = s.viewports.filter((v) => v.id !== viewportId);
  s.updatedAt = Date.now();
  notify();
}

export function listTitleblocks(): TitleblockDef[] {
  return titleblocks.slice();
}

export function ensureDefaultTitleblock(): TitleblockDef {
  if (titleblocks.length) return titleblocks[0];
  const tb: TitleblockDef = {
    id: uid(),
    name: "Standard A1 Titleblock",
    size: "A1",
    fields: [
      { key: "project", label: "Project", value: "" },
      { key: "sheet_name", label: "Sheet Name", value: "" },
      { key: "sheet_no", label: "Sheet No.", value: "" },
      { key: "drawn_by", label: "Drawn", value: "" },
      { key: "checked_by", label: "Checked", value: "" },
      { key: "date", label: "Date", value: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) },
      { key: "scale", label: "Scale", value: "As noted" },
      { key: "rev", label: "Rev", value: "0" },
    ],
  };
  titleblocks.push(tb);
  notify();
  return tb;
}

export function getSheetSizeMm(size: SheetDef["size"], orientation: SheetDef["orientation"]) {
  const base = SHEET_SIZES_MM[size] ?? SHEET_SIZES_MM.A1;
  if (orientation === "portrait") return { w: Math.min(base.w, base.h), h: Math.max(base.w, base.h) };
  return { w: Math.max(base.w, base.h), h: Math.min(base.w, base.h) };
}

/** Generate a production SVG for the sheet (titleblock + viewport frames). */
export function renderSheetSvg(sheetId: string): string {
  const sheet = getSheet(sheetId);
  if (!sheet) return "";
  const { w, h } = getSheetSizeMm(sheet.size, sheet.orientation);
  const tb = titleblocks.find((t) => t.id === sheet.titleblockId) ?? ensureDefaultTitleblock();

  const titleH = 40;
  const margin = 10;

  let vps = "";
  for (const vp of sheet.viewports) {
    vps += `
      <rect x="${vp.x}" y="${vp.y}" width="${vp.width}" height="${vp.height}"
            fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="0.5"/>
      <text x="${vp.x + 2}" y="${vp.y + 6}" font-size="4" fill="#64748b" font-family="sans-serif">
        ${escapeXml(vp.title ?? vp.viewType)} · ${escapeXml(vp.scale)}
      </text>`;
  }

  const fields = (tb.fields ?? [])
    .map(
      (f, i) =>
        `<text x="${w - 90}" y="${h - titleH + 8 + i * 5}" font-size="3.5" fill="#0f172a" font-family="sans-serif">
          <tspan font-weight="600">${escapeXml(f.label)}:</tspan> ${escapeXml(f.value || "—")}
        </text>`,
    )
    .join("");

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${w}mm" height="${h}mm" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="${margin}" y="${margin}" width="${w - margin * 2}" height="${h - margin * 2 - titleH}"
        fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  ${vps}
  <!-- Titleblock area -->
  <rect x="${margin}" y="${h - margin - titleH}" width="${w - margin * 2}" height="${titleH}"
        fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <text x="${margin + 4}" y="${h - margin - titleH + 10}" font-size="6" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a" font-family="sans-serif">
    ${escapeXml(sheet.number)} — ${escapeXml(sheet.name)}
  </text>
  <text x="${margin + 4}" y="${h - margin - titleH + 18}" font-size="3.5" fill="#475569" font-family="sans-serif">
    Open BIM Studio · Production Sheet
  </text>
  ${fields}
</svg>`;
}

function escapeXml(s: string) {
  return String(s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

export function exportSheetSvg(sheetId: string, filename?: string) {
  const svg = renderSheetSvg(sheetId);
  if (!svg) return;
  const sheet = getSheet(sheetId);
  const blob = new Blob([svg], { type: "image/svg+xml" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename ?? `${sheet?.number ?? "sheet"}.svg`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
}

export function loadSheetsFromProject(list: SheetDef[] | undefined, tbs?: TitleblockDef[]) {
  sheets = list ? list.map((s) => ({ ...s })) : [];
  titleblocks = tbs ? tbs.map((t) => ({ ...t })) : [];
  if (!titleblocks.length) ensureDefaultTitleblock();
  notify();
}

export function getSheetsForSave(): { sheets: SheetDef[]; titleblocks: TitleblockDef[] } {
  return { sheets: sheets.map((s) => ({ ...s })), titleblocks: titleblocks.map((t) => ({ ...t })) };
}

export function createDefaultSheetSet() {
  ensureDefaultTitleblock();
  if (sheets.length) return;
  createSheet({ number: "A-001", name: "Cover / General Notes", size: "A1" });
  createSheet({ number: "A-101", name: "Floor Plan — Level 1", size: "A1" });
  createSheet({ number: "A-201", name: "Elevations", size: "A1" });
  createSheet({ number: "A-301", name: "Sections", size: "A1" });
  createSheet({ number: "S-101", name: "Structural Plan", size: "A1" });
  createSheet({ number: "M-101", name: "MEP Plan", size: "A1" });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Stairs Generator - parametric straight / L-shaped stairs (Revit-style).
 *
 * Produces a composed geometry spec + authored-element params from
 * riser/tread/width inputs. Integrates with the parametric family engine.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";

export type StairRunType = "straight" | "l-shape" | "u-shape";

export interface StairParams {
  /** Total rise (floor-to-floor) in metres. */
  totalRise: number;
  /** Preferred riser height (m). Actual is computed to fit evenly. */
  maxRiser: number;
  /** Tread depth (going) in metres. */
  treadDepth: number;
  /** Clear width of the run. */
  width: number;
  /** Run type. */
  runType: StairRunType;
  /** Landing depth for L/U shapes. */
  landingDepth: number;
  /** Thickness of tread slab. */
  treadThickness: number;
  /** Starting world origin. */
  origin: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  /** Run direction angle in XZ plane (radians). */
  angle: number;
}

export interface StairResult {
  riserCount: number;
  riserHeight: number;
  totalRun: number;
  treads: Array<{
    origin: THREE.Vector3;
    width: number;
    depth: number;
    height: number;
    elevation: number;
  }>;
  landings: Array<{
    origin: THREE.Vector3;
    width: number;
    depth: number;
    elevation: number;
  }>;
  object: THREE.Object3D;
}

const DEFAULTS: StairParams = {
  totalRise: 3.0,
  maxRiser: 0.175,
  treadDepth: 0.28,
  width: 1.2,
  runType: "straight",
  landingDepth: 1.2,
  treadThickness: 0.05,
  origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
  angle: 0,
};

function computeRisers(totalRise: number, maxRiser: number): { count: number; height: number } {
  const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalRise / maxRiser));
  return { count, height: totalRise / count };
}

/**
 * Build a parametric stair mesh from parameters.
 */
export function buildStair(input: Partial<StairParams> = {}): StairResult {
  const p: StairParams = { ...DEFAULTS, ...input, origin: { ...DEFAULTS.origin, ...input.origin } };
  const { count, height } = computeRisers(p.totalRise, p.maxRiser);
  const treadCount = count; // top landing is the upper floor
  const totalRun = (treadCount - 1) * p.treadDepth;

  const cos = Math.cos(p.angle);
  const sin = Math.sin(p.angle);
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = "obs-stair";

  const treads: StairResult["treads"] = [];
  const landings: StairResult["landings"] = [];

  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x94a3b8 });

  if (p.runType === "straight") {
    for (let i = 0; i < treadCount; i++) {
      const elev = p.origin.y + height * (i + 1) - p.treadThickness;
      const along = p.treadDepth * i;
      const ox = p.origin.x + cos * along;
      const oz = p.origin.z + sin * along;

      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.treadThickness, p.treadDepth);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(ox, elev + p.treadThickness / 2, oz);
      mesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
      group.add(mesh);

      treads.push({
        origin: new THREE.Vector3(ox, elev, oz),
        width: p.width,
        depth: p.treadDepth,
        height: p.treadThickness,
        elevation: elev,
      });
    }
  } else if (p.runType === "l-shape") {
    // First flight: half the risers
    const first = Math.ceil(count / 2);
    const second = count - first;

    for (let i = 0; i < first; i++) {
      const elev = p.origin.y + height * (i + 1) - p.treadThickness;
      const along = p.treadDepth * i;
      const ox = p.origin.x + cos * along;
      const oz = p.origin.z + sin * along;
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.treadThickness, p.treadDepth);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(ox, elev + p.treadThickness / 2, oz);
      mesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
      group.add(mesh);
      treads.push({
        origin: new THREE.Vector3(ox, elev, oz),
        width: p.width,
        depth: p.treadDepth,
        height: p.treadThickness,
        elevation: elev,
      });
    }

    // Landing at turn
    const landElev = p.origin.y + height * first - p.treadThickness;
    const landAlong = p.treadDepth * first;
    const lx = p.origin.x + cos * landAlong;
    const lz = p.origin.z + sin * landAlong;
    const landGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.treadThickness, p.landingDepth);
    const landMesh = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, mat);
    landMesh.position.set(lx, landElev + p.treadThickness / 2, lz);
    landMesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
    group.add(landMesh);
    landings.push({
      origin: new THREE.Vector3(lx, landElev, lz),
      width: p.width,
      depth: p.landingDepth,
      elevation: landElev,
    });

    // Second flight perpendicular
    const angle2 = p.angle + Math.PI / 2;
    const cos2 = Math.cos(angle2);
    const sin2 = Math.sin(angle2);
    for (let i = 0; i < second; i++) {
      const elev = p.origin.y + height * (first + i + 1) - p.treadThickness;
      const along = p.treadDepth * (i + 1);
      const ox = lx + cos2 * along;
      const oz = lz + sin2 * along;
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.treadThickness, p.treadDepth);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(ox, elev + p.treadThickness / 2, oz);
      mesh.rotation.y = -angle2;
      group.add(mesh);
      treads.push({
        origin: new THREE.Vector3(ox, elev, oz),
        width: p.width,
        depth: p.treadDepth,
        height: p.treadThickness,
        elevation: elev,
      });
    }
  } else {
    // U-shape: two parallel flights with landing
    const first = Math.ceil(count / 2);
    const second = count - first;

    for (let i = 0; i < first; i++) {
      const elev = p.origin.y + height * (i + 1) - p.treadThickness;
      const along = p.treadDepth * i;
      const ox = p.origin.x + cos * along;
      const oz = p.origin.z + sin * along;
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.treadThickness, p.treadDepth);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(ox, elev + p.treadThickness / 2, oz);
      mesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
      group.add(mesh);
      treads.push({
        origin: new THREE.Vector3(ox, elev, oz),
        width: p.width,
        depth: p.treadDepth,
        height: p.treadThickness,
        elevation: elev,
      });
    }

    const landElev = p.origin.y + height * first - p.treadThickness;
    const landAlong = p.treadDepth * first;
    const lx = p.origin.x + cos * landAlong;
    const lz = p.origin.z + sin * landAlong;
    const landGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width * 2 + 0.2, p.treadThickness, p.landingDepth);
    const landMesh = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, mat);
    // Offset landing sideways by half width
    const sideX = -sin * (p.width / 2 + 0.1);
    const sideZ = cos * (p.width / 2 + 0.1);
    landMesh.position.set(lx + sideX, landElev + p.treadThickness / 2, lz + sideZ);
    landMesh.rotation.y = -p.angle;
    group.add(landMesh);
    landings.push({
      origin: new THREE.Vector3(lx + sideX, landElev, lz + sideZ),
      width: p.width * 2,
      depth: p.landingDepth,
      elevation: landElev,
    });

    const angle2 = p.angle + Math.PI; // reverse
    const cos2 = Math.cos(angle2);
    const sin2 = Math.sin(angle2);
    const start2x = lx + sideX * 2;
    const start2z = lz + sideZ * 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < second; i++) {
      const elev = p.origin.y + height * (first + i + 1) - p.treadThickness;
      const along = p.treadDepth * (i + 1);
      const ox = start2x + cos2 * along;
      const oz = start2z + sin2 * along;
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.width, p.treadThickness, p.treadDepth);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(ox, elev + p.treadThickness / 2, oz);
      mesh.rotation.y = -angle2;
      group.add(mesh);
      treads.push({
        origin: new THREE.Vector3(ox, elev, oz),
        width: p.width,
        depth: p.treadDepth,
        height: p.treadThickness,
        elevation: elev,
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    riserCount: count,
    riserHeight: height,
    totalRun,
    treads,
    landings,
    object: group,
  };
}

/** Comfort rule check (Blondel): 2R + T - 0.63 m. */
export function stairComfort(riserHeight: number, treadDepth: number): {
  ok: boolean;
  value: number;
  message: string;
} {
  const value = 2 * riserHeight + treadDepth;
  const ok = value >= 0.59 && value <= 0.65;
  return {
    ok,
    value,
    message: ok
      ? `Comfort OK (2R+T = ${value.toFixed(3)} m)`
      : `Comfort warning: 2R+T = ${value.toFixed(3)} m (target 0.59-0.65)`,
  };
}

export function setupStairs(): void {
  (ctx.features as any).stairs = { buildStair, stairComfort };
  (window as any).__obsStairs = { buildStair, stairComfort };
  console.log("[stairs] generator ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Small helpers that make rule authors' lives easier.
 *
 * Every `prop*` helper returns undefined when the key is missing, so rules
 * can express "missing or wrong" without nesting null checks.
 */

/** Read a value from the flattened context props. */
export function getProp(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  key: string,
): unknown {
  if (!props) return undefined;
  if (key in props) return props[key];
  const lower = key.toLowerCase();
  for (const k of Object.keys(props)) {
    if (k.toLowerCase() === lower) return props[k];
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function propString(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  key: string,
): string | undefined {
  const v = getProp(props, key);
  if (v == null) return undefined;
  const s = String(v).trim();
  return s.length ? s : undefined;
}

export function propNumber(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  key: string,
): number | undefined {
  const v = getProp(props, key);
  if (v == null) return undefined;
  if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
  const s = String(v).trim();
  if (!s) return undefined;
  // Strip unit suffixes like "900", "900mm", "0.9 m".
  const m = s.match(/^(-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(mm|cm|m|ft|in|°|deg)?$/i);
  if (!m) return undefined;
  let n = Number(m[1].replace(",", "."));
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return undefined;
  const unit = (m[2] ?? "").toLowerCase();
  // Convert everything to metres for length-like properties.
  if (unit === "mm") n /= 1000;
  else if (unit === "cm") n /= 100;
  else if (unit === "ft") n *= 0.3048;
  else if (unit === "in") n *= 0.0254;
  return n;
}

/** True if the property exists and is non-empty. */
export function hasProp(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  key: string,
): boolean {
  const v = getProp(props, key);
  return v != null && String(v).trim() !== "";
}

/** Return the first property that exists among a list of candidates. */
export function firstProp(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  keys: string[],
): unknown {
  for (const k of keys) {
    const v = getProp(props, k);
    if (v != null && String(v).trim() !== "") return v;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function firstPropString(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  keys: string[],
): string | undefined {
  const v = firstProp(props, keys);
  if (v == null) return undefined;
  return String(v).trim() || undefined;
}

export function firstPropNumber(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  keys: string[],
): number | undefined {
  for (const k of keys) {
    const n = propNumber(props, k);
    if (n != null) return n;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** Case-insensitive substring test on any property. */
export function anyPropContains(
  props: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  keys: string[],
  needle: string,
): boolean {
  const n = needle.toLowerCase();
  for (const k of keys) {
    const s = firstPropString(props, [k]);
    if (s && s.toLowerCase().includes(n)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Category matcher supporting a trailing '*' wildcard. */
export function categoryMatches(
  category: string,
  patterns: string[],
): boolean {
  const c = category.toUpperCase();
  for (const p of patterns) {
    const up = p.toUpperCase();
    if (up.endsWith("*")) {
      if (c.startsWith(up.slice(0, -1))) return true;
    } else if (c === up) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/** Format a metre value for display in the "actual" / "required" columns. */
export function mm(meters: number): string {
  return `${Math.round(meters * 1000)} mm`;
}

export function m(meters: number): string {
  return `${meters.toFixed(2)} m`;
}

/** Package name and version helper for violations. */
export function packHeader(pack: {
  name: string;
  jurisdiction: string;
  version: string;
}): string {
  return `${pack.name} · ${pack.jurisdiction} · ${pack.version}`;
}
```
