--- FILE: src/modules/standards/rules/engine.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Standards rule engine.
 *
 * Runs one or more rule packs against a loaded fragment model. Handles:
 *   • Bounded concurrency (rules within a pack run sequentially; packs run
 *     one at a time to avoid starving the render loop)
 *   • Progress + cancellation
 *   • Deduplication across overlapping packs
 *   • Categorising violations by severity for the UI
 */
import { ctx } from "../../../core/context";
import { i18n } from "../../../core/i18n";
import { units } from "../../../core/units";
import { diagnostics } from "../../../core/diagnostics";
import { listPacks, getPack, listRules, getRule } from "./registry";
import type {
  Rule, RuleContext, RulePack, RuleViolation, RunOptions, RunSummary,
} from "./types";

export interface RunResult {
  summary: RunSummary;
  violations: RuleViolation[];
  errorsByRule: Map<string, string>;
}

export async function runRules(opts: RunOptions = {}): Promise<RunResult> {
  const start = Date.now();
  const signal = opts.signal;
  const progress = opts.onProgress ?? (() => {});

  const modelId =
    opts.modelId ??
    (ctx.fragments.list.size ? [...ctx.fragments.list.keys()][0] : null);
  if (!modelId) {
    return emptyResult(start, "No model loaded");
  }
  const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) {
    return emptyResult(start, `Model "${modelId}" not loaded`);
  }

  // Determine the set of rules to run.
  let rules: Rule[] = [];
  if (opts.ruleIds?.length) {
    rules = opts.ruleIds.map((id) => getRule(id)).filter((r): r is Rule => !!r);
  } else if (opts.packIds?.length) {
    for (const pid of opts.packIds) {
      const p = getPack(pid);
      if (p) rules.push(...p.rules);
    }
  } else {
    rules = listRules();
  }

  // De-duplicate by rule id (a rule may be shared by multiple packs).
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  rules = rules.filter((r) => {
    if (seen.has(r.id)) return false;
    seen.add(r.id);
    return true;
  });

  if (!rules.length) {
    return emptyResult(start, "No rules selected");
  }

  // Model category catalogue for early exit filtering.
  let allCats: string[] = [];
  try {
    const cats = await model.getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
    allCats = Object.keys(cats);
  } catch { /* */ }

  const violations: RuleViolation[] = [];
  const errorsByRule = new Map<string, string>();
  const ruleCtx: RuleContext = {
    model,
    modelId,
    locale: i18n.getLocale(),
    unitSystem: units.getSystem(),
    progress: (done: number, total: number, note?: string) => progress(done, total, note),
    isCancelled: () => signal?.cancelled === true,
  };

  let ruleIndex = 0;
  for (const rule of rules) {
    if (signal?.cancelled) break;
    ruleIndex++;
    progress(ruleIndex, rules.length, rule.name);

    if (rule.requiresCategories && !rule.requiresCategories(allCats)) {
      continue;
    }

    try {
      const found = await rule.check(ruleCtx);
      if (Array.isArray(found)) {
        if (found.length) violations.push(...found);
      } else if (found.violations?.length) {
        violations.push(...found.violations);
      } else if (!found.pass) {
        violations.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          ruleName: rule.name,
          standard: rule.standard ?? "Standard",
          jurisdiction: rule.jurisdiction ?? "intl",
          severity: rule.severity,
          category: rule.category ?? "General",
          elementId: 0,
          elementName: "",
          elementCategory: "",
          message: found.message ?? "Rule violation",
          actual: found.actual,
          required: found.required,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      errorsByRule.set(rule.id, msg);
      diagnostics.warn("standards.rules", `rule "${rule.id}" threw: ${msg}`, err);
    }

    // Yield to the render loop between rules.
    await new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
  }

  const finishedAt = Date.now();
  let errors = 0, warnings = 0, infos = 0;
  for (const v of violations) {
    if (v.severity === "error") errors++;
    else if (v.severity === "warning") warnings++;
    else infos++;
  }

  const summary: RunSummary = {
    packCount: opts.packIds?.length ?? listPacks().length,
    ruleCount: rules.length,
    violations: violations.length,
    errors, warnings, infos,
    startedAt: start,
    finishedAt,
    durationMs: finishedAt - start,
    cancelled: signal?.cancelled === true,
  };

  console.log(
    `[standards] ran ${rules.length} rule(s) in ${summary.durationMs} ms · ` +
    `${violations.length} violation(s) · ${errorsByRule.size} rule error(s)`,
  );

  return { summary, violations, errorsByRule };
}

function emptyResult(start: number, reason: string): RunResult {
  console.warn("[standards]", reason);
  const now = Date.now();
  return {
    summary: {
      packCount: 0, ruleCount: 0, violations: 0,
      errors: 0, warnings: 0, infos: 0,
      startedAt: start, finishedAt: now, durationMs: now - start, cancelled: false,
    },
    violations: [],
    errorsByRule: new Map([[reason, reason]]),
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Pure geometry helpers used by rule implementations.
 * Everything is metres / radians; conversion is a caller concern.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";

export interface Pt3 { x: number; y: number; z: number; }

export function distance(a: Pt3, b: Pt3): number {
  const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y, dz = a.z - b.z;
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
}

/** Horizontal distance, ignoring Y. Use for egress travel paths. */
export function distanceXZ(a: Pt3, b: Pt3): number {
  return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.z - b.z);
}

/** Total length of an ordered polyline. */
export function polylineLength(points: Pt3[]): number {
  if (points.length < 2) return 0;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) sum += distanceXZ(points[i - 1], points[i]);
  return sum;
}

/** AABB from min/max arrays returned by Fragments getBoxes(). */
export function boxFromArray(b: number[] | THREE.Box3): THREE.Box3 | null {
  if (b instanceof THREE.Box3) return b;
  if (!Array.isArray(b) || b.length < 6) return null;
  return new THREE.Box3(
    new THREE.Vector3(b[0], b[1], b[2]),
    new THREE.Vector3(b[3], b[4], b[5]),
  );
}

/**
 * Ground-plane footprint from a 3D box: returns the rectangle in XZ and
 * the vertical extent separately. Useful for fire egress and accessibility
 * rules that care about plan geometry.
 */
export function footprint(box: THREE.Box3): {
  minX: number; maxX: number;
  minZ: number; maxZ: number;
  height: number;
  widthX: number;
  widthZ: number;
  centerX: number;
  centerZ: number;
} {
  return {
    minX: box.min.x, maxX: box.max.x,
    minZ: box.min.z, maxZ: box.max.z,
    height: box.max.y - box.min.y,
    widthX: box.max.x - box.min.x,
    widthZ: box.max.z - box.min.z,
    centerX: (box.min.x + box.max.x) / 2,
    centerZ: (box.min.z + box.max.z) / 2,
  };
}

/** Slope in radians from a rise and a run (both metres). */
export function slopeAngle(rise: number, run: number): number {
  if (run <= 1e-9) return Math.PI / 2;
  return Math.atan(rise / Math.abs(run));
}

/** Convert a 4×4 column-major matrix (Three.js) to YXZ euler degrees. */
export function yawFromMatrix(m: number[] | Float32Array): number {
  const m4 = new THREE.Matrix4().fromArray(Array.from(m));
  const e = new THREE.Euler().setFromRotationMatrix(m4, "YXZ");
  return (e.y * 180) / Math.PI;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Standards rule engine -- public barrel.
 *
 * Importing this module gives you:
 *   * Every built-in RulePack (US / UK / DE / CN fire & accessibility,
 *     plus structural QA and model-quality packs).
 *   * A list of every pack, ready to feed to the runner.
 *   * The registry helpers, re-exported from ./registry.
 *
 * IMPORTANT -- this barrel used to keep its OWN Map<string, RulePack>(),
 * parallel to the one in ./registry.ts. standards-panel.ts populated that
 * private Map while engine.ts read from ./registry's Map, so runRules()
 * always saw zero packs and reported "No rules selected". There is now
 * exactly ONE registry, owned by ./registry.ts and re-exported here.
 *
 * To add your own packs, either edit BUILT_IN_PACKS below or call
 * registerPack() from ./registry at boot.
 */
import type { RulePack } from "../types";
import { registerPack, getPack } from "./registry";
import {
  fireEgressPackUS,
  fireEgressPackUK,
  fireEgressPackDE,
  fireEgressPackCN,
} from "./packs/fire-egress";
import {
  accessibilityPackUS,
  accessibilityPackUK,
  accessibilityPackDE,
  accessibilityPackCN,
} from "./packs/accessibility";
import { structuralPack } from "./packs/structural";
import { qaPack } from "./packs/qa";

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Built-in packs
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export const BUILT_IN_PACKS: RulePack[] = [
  fireEgressPackUS,
  fireEgressPackUK,
  fireEgressPackDE,
  fireEgressPackCN,
  accessibilityPackUS,
  accessibilityPackUK,
  accessibilityPackDE,
  accessibilityPackCN,
  structuralPack,
  qaPack,
];

/**
 * Register every built-in pack with the shared registry.
 * Idempotent: already-present packs are skipped silently.
 */
export function registerStandardPacks(): void {
  for (const pack of BUILT_IN_PACKS) {
    if (!getPack(pack.id)) registerPack(pack);
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Re-exports
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export * from "../types";
export * from "../framework";
export * from "./registry";

export {
  fireEgressPackUS,
  fireEgressPackUK,
  fireEgressPackDE,
  fireEgressPackCN,
} from "./packs/fire-egress";

export {
  accessibilityPackUS,
  accessibilityPackUK,
  accessibilityPackDE,
  accessibilityPackCN,
} from "./packs/accessibility";

export { structuralPack } from "./packs/structural";
export { qaPack } from "./packs/qa";
```

```ts
/**
 * Accessibility rule packs.
 *
 * ADA (US), Approved Document M (UK), DIN 18040 (Germany), and
 * GB 50763 (China). Focus on the checks a coordination model can actually
 * verify — clear widths, ramp slopes, hardware types, and handrail
 * heights.
 */
import type { Rule, RulePack } from "../../types";
import {
  firstPropNumber, firstPropString, anyPropContains, mm,
} from "../../framework";

/* ── Rule factories ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function accessibleDoorClearWidth(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Accessible doors must have a clear opening width of at least ` +
      `${mm(minMeters)}.`,
    severity: "warning",
    category: "Accessibility",
    appliesTo: ["IFCDOOR", "IFCDOORSTANDARDCASE"],
    check(ctx) {
      const w = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_DoorCommon.ClearWidth",
        "Pset_DoorCommon.Width",
        "OverallWidth",
        "Width",
      ]);
      if (w == null) return { pass: true, message: "Door width not recorded" };
      return {
        pass: w >= minMeters - 1e-4,
        message:
          w >= minMeters - 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Clear width ${mm(w)} is below ${jurisdiction} accessible minimum`,
        actual: mm(w),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} minimum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function accessibleDoorHardware(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  bannedKeywords: string[],
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Accessible doors must not use ${bannedKeywords.join(", ")} hardware.`,
    severity: "warning",
    category: "Accessibility",
    appliesTo: ["IFCDOOR", "IFCDOORSTANDARDCASE"],
    check(ctx) {
      const hw = firstPropString(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_DoorCommon.HardwareType",
        "HardwareType",
        "Pset_DoorCommon.HandleType",
      ]);
      if (!hw) return { pass: true, message: "Door hardware not specified" };
      const lower = hw.toLowerCase();
      const bad = bannedKeywords.find((k) => lower.includes(k.toLowerCase()));
      return {
        pass: !bad,
        message: bad ? `Door hardware "${hw}" is not accessible` : undefined,
        actual: hw,
        required: `No ${bannedKeywords.join(", ")}`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function rampSlope(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  maxRatio: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  // maxRatio: 12 = 1:12
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Accessible ramps must have a slope no steeper than 1:${maxRatio}.`,
    severity: "error",
    category: "Accessibility",
    appliesTo: ["IFCRAMP", "IFCRAMPFLIGHT"],
    check(ctx) {
      const ratio = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_RampCommon.Slope",
        "Pset_RampFlightCommon.Slope",
        "Slope",
      ]);
      if (ratio == null) return { pass: true, message: "Ramp slope not recorded" };
      // Accept either a decimal slope (0.083) or a ratio-as-number (12).
      const asRatio = ratio > 1 ? ratio : 1 / ratio;
      return {
        pass: asRatio >= maxRatio - 1e-3,
        message:
          asRatio >= maxRatio - 1e-3
            ? undefined
            : `Ramp slope 1:${asRatio.toFixed(1)} is steeper than ${jurisdiction} limit`,
        actual: `1:${asRatio.toFixed(2)}`,
        required: `1:${maxRatio} maximum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function handrailHeight(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  maxMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Handrails must be between ${mm(minMeters)} and ${mm(maxMeters)} ` +
      `above the walking surface.`,
    severity: "warning",
    category: "Accessibility",
    appliesTo: ["IFCRAILING", "IFCSTAIR", "IFCRAMP"],
    check(ctx) {
      const h = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_RailingCommon.Height",
        "Height",
        "Pset_StairCommon.HandrailHeight",
      ]);
      if (h == null) return { pass: true, message: "Handrail height not recorded" };
      const ok = h >= minMeters - 1e-4 && h <= maxMeters + 1e-4;
      return {
        pass: ok,
        message: ok
          ? undefined
          : `Handrail ${mm(h)} is outside ${jurisdiction} range`,
        actual: mm(h),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} to ${mm(maxMeters)}`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function routeMinWidth(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Accessible routes must be at least ${mm(minMeters)} wide.`,
    severity: "warning",
    category: "Accessibility",
    appliesTo: ["IFCSPACE"],
    check(ctx) {
      const isAccessible = anyPropContains(
        ctx.props,
        ["Name", "LongName", "ObjectType", "Description"],
        "accessible",
      );
      if (!isAccessible) return { pass: true };
      const w = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_SpaceCommon.Width",
        "Width",
      ]);
      if (w == null) return { pass: true, message: "Route width not recorded" };
      return {
        pass: w >= minMeters - 1e-4,
        message:
          w >= minMeters - 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Route width ${mm(w)} is below ${jurisdiction} minimum`,
        actual: mm(w),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} minimum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

/* ── Pack builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export const accessibilityPackUS: RulePack = {
  id: "accessibility-us",
  name: "Accessibility (US)",
  description:
    "ADA 2010 Standards for Accessible Design: door clear widths, " +
    "hardware, ramp slopes, handrail heights, and accessible route " +
    "widths.",
  jurisdiction: "United States",
  version: "ADA 2010",
  rules: [
    accessibleDoorClearWidth(
      "us.ada.door-width",
      "Door clear width (ADA)",
      0.813,   // 32 inches
      "ADA",
    ),
    accessibleDoorHardware(
      "us.ada.door-hardware",
      "Door hardware (ADA)",
      ["knob", "round handle"],
    ),
    rampSlope("us.ada.ramp-slope", "Ramp slope (ADA)", 12, "ADA"),
    handrailHeight(
      "us.ada.handrail-height",
      "Handrail height (ADA)",
      0.865,   // 34 inches
      0.965,   // 38 inches
      "ADA",
    ),
    routeMinWidth(
      "us.ada.route-width",
      "Accessible route width (ADA)",
      0.915,   // 36 inches
      "ADA",
    ),
  ],
};

export const accessibilityPackUK: RulePack = {
  id: "accessibility-uk",
  name: "Accessibility (UK)",
  description:
    "Approved Document M (Access to and Use of Buildings) 2015: door " +
    "widths, corridor widths, ramp gradients, and handrail heights.",
  jurisdiction: "United Kingdom",
  version: "Part M 2015",
  rules: [
    accessibleDoorClearWidth(
      "uk.m.door-width",
      "Door clear width (Part M)",
      0.775,   // 750 mm door leaf
      "Part M",
    ),
    accessibleDoorHardware(
      "uk.m.door-hardware",
      "Door hardware (Part M)",
      ["knob"],
    ),
    rampSlope("uk.m.ramp-slope", "Ramp slope (Part M)", 12, "Part M"),
    handrailHeight(
      "uk.m.handrail-height",
      "Handrail height (Part M)",
      0.900,
      1.100,
      "Part M",
    ),
    routeMinWidth(
      "uk.m.route-width",
      "Accessible route width (Part M)",
      1.200,
      "Part M",
    ),
  ],
};

export const accessibilityPackDE: RulePack = {
  id: "accessibility-de",
  name: "Accessibility (Germany)",
  description:
    "DIN 18040-1 (Barrierefreies Bauen): door clear widths, ramp " +
    "slopes, handrail heights, and accessible route widths.",
  jurisdiction: "Germany",
  version: "DIN 18040-1",
  rules: [
    accessibleDoorClearWidth(
      "de.access.door-width",
      "Türbreite (DIN 18040)",
      0.900,
      "DIN 18040",
    ),
    accessibleDoorHardware(
      "de.access.door-hardware",
      "Türdrücker (DIN 18040)",
      ["drehknauf"],
    ),
    rampSlope("de.access.ramp-slope", "Rampenneigung (DIN 18040)", 12, "DIN 18040"),
    handrailHeight(
      "de.access.handrail-height",
      "Handlaufhöhe (DIN 18040)",
      0.850,
      0.900,
      "DIN 18040",
    ),

      "de.access.route-width",

export const accessibilityPackCN: RulePack = {
```

--- FILE: src/modules/standards/rules/packs/fire-egress.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Fire & egress rule packs.
 *
 * Rule severity is deliberately soft. A missing property produces an
 * "info" or "warning" rather than an "error", because a coordination model
 * frequently omits psets that the discipline-specific authoring tool
 * carries. Only clear physical violations (a door narrower than the code
 * minimum) produce "error".
 */
import type { Rule, RulePack, RuleContext, RuleCheckResult } from "../../types";
import {
  propNumber, firstPropNumber, anyPropContains, hasProp, mm,
} from "../../framework";

/* ── Rule factories ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function doorMinWidth(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Egress doors must have a clear opening width of at least ` +
      `${mm(minMeters)}.`,
    severity: "error",
    category: "Fire & Egress",
    appliesTo: ["IFCDOOR", "IFCDOORSTANDARDCASE"],
    check(ctx): RuleCheckResult {
      const w = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "OverallWidth",
        "Width",
        "Pset_DoorCommon.Width",
        "Pset_DoorCommon.ClearWidth",
      ]);
      if (w == null) {
        return {
          pass: true,
          message: `Door width not recorded — ${jurisdiction} rule skipped`,
        };
      }
      return {
        pass: w >= minMeters - 1e-4,
        message:
          w >= minMeters - 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Clear width ${mm(w)} is below ${jurisdiction} minimum`,
        actual: mm(w),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} minimum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function doorMinHeight(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Egress doors must have a clear opening height of at least ` +
      `${mm(minMeters)}.`,
    severity: "error",
    category: "Fire & Egress",
    appliesTo: ["IFCDOOR", "IFCDOORSTANDARDCASE"],
    check(ctx): RuleCheckResult {
      const h = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "OverallHeight",
        "Height",
        "Pset_DoorCommon.Height",
      ]);
      if (h == null) return { pass: true, message: "Door height not recorded" };
      return {
        pass: h >= minMeters - 1e-4,
        message:
          h >= minMeters - 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Clear height ${mm(h)} is below ${jurisdiction} minimum`,
        actual: mm(h),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} minimum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function corridorMinWidth(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description: `Corridors must be at least ${mm(minMeters)} wide.`,
    severity: "warning",
    category: "Fire & Egress",
    appliesTo: ["IFCSPACE"],
    check(ctx): RuleCheckResult {
      const isCorridor = anyPropContains(
        ctx.props,
        ["Name", "LongName", "ObjectType", "Pset_SpaceCommon.Category"],
        "corridor",
      );
      if (!isCorridor) return { pass: true };
      const w = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_SpaceCommon.Width",
        "Width",
      ]);
      if (w == null) return { pass: true, message: "Corridor width not recorded" };
      return {
        pass: w >= minMeters - 1e-4,
        message:
          w >= minMeters - 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Corridor width ${mm(w)} is below ${jurisdiction} minimum`,
        actual: mm(w),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} minimum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function fireRatingPresent(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  appliesTo: string[],
  acceptedKeywords: string[],
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Fire-rated assemblies must declare a rating in one of: ` +
      `${acceptedKeywords.join(", ")}.`,
    severity: "warning",
    category: "Fire & Egress",
    appliesTo,
    check(ctx): RuleCheckResult {
      const rating = anyPropContains(
        ctx.props,
        [
          "FireRating",
          "Pset_WallCommon.FireRating",
          "Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating",
          "Pset_SlabCommon.FireRating",
          "Pset_CoveringCommon.FireRating",
          "Pset_BeamCommon.FireRating",
          "Pset_ColumnCommon.FireRating",
        ],
        "fire",
      );
      const value = String(
        firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, []) ??
        (ctx.props?.["FireRating"] ?? ""),
      );
      if (!rating && !value) {
        return {
          pass: true,
          message: "No fire rating declared — assumed non-rated",
        };
      }
      const ok = acceptedKeywords.some((kw) =>
        String(value).toLowerCase().includes(kw.toLowerCase()),
      );
      return {
        pass: ok,
        message: ok ? undefined : `Fire rating "${value}" is not in accepted list`,
        actual: value,
        required: acceptedKeywords.join(" / "),
      };
    },
  };
}

function stairMinWidth(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  minMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description: `Egress stairs must be at least ${mm(minMeters)} wide.`,
    severity: "error",
    category: "Fire & Egress",
    appliesTo: ["IFCSTAIRFLIGHT", "IFCSTAIR"],
    check(ctx): RuleCheckResult {
      const w = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_StairFlightCommon.Width",
        "Width",
        "Pset_StairCommon.Width",
      ]);
      if (w == null) return { pass: true, message: "Stair width not recorded" };
      return {
        pass: w >= minMeters - 1e-4,
        message:
          w >= minMeters - 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Stair width ${mm(w)} is below ${jurisdiction} minimum`,
        actual: mm(w),
        required: `${mm(minMeters)} minimum`,
      };
    },
  };
}

function egressTravelDistanceLimit(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  maxMeters: number,
  jurisdiction: string,
): Rule {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    description:
      `Travel distance to the nearest exit must not exceed ` +
      `${maxMeters} m (dead-end limit).`,
    severity: "info",
    category: "Fire & Egress",
    appliesTo: ["IFCSPACE"],
    check(ctx): RuleCheckResult {
      const d = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
        "Pset_SpaceFireSafetyRequirements.TravelDistanceToExit",
        "TravelDistance",
      ]);
      if (d == null) {
        return {
          pass: true,
          message: "Travel distance not recorded — cannot verify",
        };
      }
      return {
        pass: d <= maxMeters + 1e-4,
        message:
          d <= maxMeters + 1e-4
            ? undefined
            : `Travel distance ${d.toFixed(1)} m exceeds ${jurisdiction} limit`,
        actual: `${d.toFixed(2)} m`,
        required: `${maxMeters} m maximum`,
      };
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Model quality assurance.
 *
 * The bread-and-butter checks every coordination model needs: no
 * duplicate GlobalIds, no unnamed elements, no orphan geometry, no
 * zero-sized boxes, no empty property values.
 */
import type { RulePack, RuleContext } from "../../types";
import {
  hasProp, propString, mm,
} from "../../framework";

export const qaPack: RulePack = {
  id: "model-qa",
  name: "Model Quality Assurance",
  description:
    "Best-practice checks that catch the mistakes every coordination " +
    "model eventually accumulates: missing names, empty properties, " +
    "orphan geometry.",
  jurisdiction: "International",
  version: "OBS 1.0",
  rules: [
    {
      id: "qa.has-name",
      name: "Element has a name",
      description:
        "Every named product should carry a Name attribute. Unnamed " +
        "elements are impossible to select or schedule reliably.",
      severity: "info",
      category: "Model Quality",
      appliesTo: [
        "IFCDOOR", "IFCWINDOW", "IFCWALL", "IFCSLAB", "IFCCOLUMN",
        "IFCBEAM", "IFCFOOTING", "IFCPILE", "IFCFURNITURE",
        "IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY", "IFCSTAIR", "IFCRAILING", "IFCRAMP",
      ],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const name = propString(ctx.props, "Name");
        if (!name) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: "Element has no Name",
            required: "Non-empty Name attribute",
          };
        }
        return { pass: true };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "qa.has-globalid",
      name: "Element has a GlobalId",
      description:
        "Every IfcRoot must carry a GlobalId. Missing GlobalIds break " +
        "change tracking, BCF interchange, and reference resolution.",
      severity: "error",
      category: "Model Quality",
      appliesTo: ["*"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const gid = propString(ctx.props, "GlobalId");
        if (!gid) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: "Element has no GlobalId",
            required: "22-character IFC GlobalId",
          };
        }
        if (gid.length !== 22) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: `GlobalId "${gid}" is not 22 characters long`,
            actual: `${gid.length} characters`,
            required: "22 characters",
          };
        }
        return { pass: true };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "qa.has-description-or-type",
      name: "Element is at least partly described",
      description:
        "An element with no Description and no ObjectType is usually a " +
        "placeholder that was never finished.",
      severity: "info",
      category: "Model Quality",
      appliesTo: [
        "IFCDOOR", "IFCWINDOW", "IFCWALL", "IFCSLAB",
        "IFCCOLUMN", "IFCBEAM", "IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY",
      ],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const desc = propString(ctx.props, "Description");
        const type = propString(ctx.props, "ObjectType");
        if (!desc && !type) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: "Element has neither Description nor ObjectType",
            required: "At least one of Description or ObjectType",
          };
        }
        return { pass: true };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "qa.no-empty-pset",
      name: "Property sets are not empty",
      description:
        "An empty property set adds noise without adding information.",
      severity: "info",
      category: "Model Quality",
      appliesTo: ["*"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const raw = ctx.raw as any;
        if (!raw?.psets) return { pass: true };
        const empties: string[] = [];
        for (const [name, props] of Object.entries(raw.psets as Record<string, any>)) {
          if (!props || typeof props !== "object") continue;
          const keys = Object.keys(props);
          if (!keys.length) empties.push(name);
        }
        if (empties.length) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: `Empty property set(s): ${empties.join(", ")}`,
            required: "Property sets with at least one property",
          };
        }
        return { pass: true };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "qa.no-zero-size",
      name: "Element has non-zero size",
      description:
        "A bounding box smaller than 1 mm on every axis is almost " +
        "certainly a modelling artifact.",
      severity: "warning",
      category: "Model Quality",
      appliesTo: ["*"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        // We do not have the world box in RuleContext, so use the
        // geometric properties the model carries.
        const raw = ctx.raw as any;
        const w = Number(
          raw?.Width?.value ?? raw?.OverallWidth?.value ?? NaN,
        );
        const h = Number(
          raw?.Height?.value ?? raw?.OverallHeight?.value ?? NaN,
        );
        const d = Number(
          raw?.Depth?.value ?? raw?.OverallDepth?.value ?? NaN,
        );
        const all = [w, h, d].filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n));
        if (!all.length) return { pass: true };
        const maxDim = Math.max(...all.map(Math.abs));
        if (maxDim < 0.001) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: `Element bounding dimensions are below 1 mm`,
            actual: mm(maxDim),
            required: "At least 1 mm on one axis",
          };
        }
        return { pass: true };
      },
    },
  ],
};
```

```ts
/**
 * Structural QA rule packs.
 *
 * These are model-quality checks rather than code-compliance rules.
 * They catch the kind of mistakes that survive into a federated model:
 * beams with no section, columns with no height, structural elements
 * with no material.
 */
import type { RulePack, RuleContext } from "../../types";
import {
  hasProp, firstPropNumber, firstPropString, mm,
} from "../../framework";

export const structuralPack: RulePack = {
  id: "structural-qa",
  name: "Structural QA",
  description:
    "Non-code structural coordination checks: section presence, " +
    "sensible heights, and material assignment on load-bearing " +
    "elements.",
  jurisdiction: "International",
  version: "OBS 1.0",
  rules: [
    {
      id: "struct.beam.has-section",
      name: "Beam has a defined section",
      description:
        "Structural beams should declare a profile or section name.",
      severity: "warning",
      category: "Structural",
      appliesTo: ["IFCBEAM", "IFCBEAMSTANDARDCASE"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const section = firstPropString(ctx.props ?? {}, [
          "ObjectType",
          "Pset_BeamCommon.Reference",
          "Reference",
          "ProfileName",
        ]);
        if (!section) {
          return {
            pass: false,
            message: "Beam has no section or profile reference",
            required: "Section name on ObjectType or Pset_BeamCommon",
          };
        }
        return { pass: true };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "struct.column.height",
      name: "Column height is plausible",
      description:
        "Columns must have a height between 0.5 m and 30 m. Values " +
        "outside that range usually mean a missing or mis-scaled " +
        "geometry.",
      severity: "warning",
      category: "Structural",
      appliesTo: ["IFCCOLUMN", "IFCCOLUMNSTANDARDCASE"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const h = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
          "Height",
          "Pset_ColumnCommon.Height",
          "OverallHeight",
        ]);
        if (h == null) {
          return { pass: true, message: "Column height not recorded" };
        }
        return {
          pass: h >= 0.5 && h <= 30,
          message:
            h < 0.5 ? `Column height ${mm(h)} is suspiciously short`
            : h > 30 ? `Column height ${h.toFixed(1)} m is suspiciously tall`
            : undefined,
          actual: h < 1 ? mm(h) : `${h.toFixed(2)} m`,
          required: "0.5 m to 30 m",
        };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "struct.beam.length",
      name: "Beam length is plausible",
      description:
        "Beams should span between 0.5 m and 50 m. Anything else is a " +
        "sign of a modelling error.",
      severity: "warning",
      category: "Structural",
      appliesTo: ["IFCBEAM", "IFCBEAMSTANDARDCASE"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const l = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
          "Length",
          "Pset_BeamCommon.Span",
          "Span",
        ]);
        if (l == null) return { pass: true, message: "Beam length not recorded" };
        return {
          pass: l >= 0.5 && l <= 50,
          message:
            l < 0.5 ? `Beam length ${mm(l)} is suspiciously short`
            : l > 50 ? `Beam length ${l.toFixed(1)} m is suspiciously long`
            : undefined,
          actual: l < 1 ? mm(l) : `${l.toFixed(2)} m`,
          required: "0.5 m to 50 m",
        };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "struct.loadbearing.material",
      name: "Load-bearing element has material",
      description:
        "Walls marked as load-bearing should declare a material.",
      severity: "info",
      category: "Structural",
      appliesTo: ["IFCWALL", "IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const props = ctx.props ?? {};
        const isLoadBearing = String(
          props["Pset_WallCommon.LoadBearing"] ??
          props["LoadBearing"] ??
          "",
        ).toLowerCase();
        if (isLoadBearing !== "true" && isLoadBearing !== "1") {
          return { pass: true };
        }
        const material = firstPropString(props, [
          "Pset_WallCommon.Material",
          "Material",
        ]);
        return {
          pass: !!material,
          message: material ? undefined : "Load-bearing wall has no material assigned",
          required: "Material on IfcWall.Pset_WallCommon",
        };
      },
    },
    {
      id: "struct.slab.thickness",
      name: "Slab thickness is plausible",
      description:
        "Slabs should be between 50 mm and 1 000 mm thick.",
      severity: "info",
      category: "Structural",
      appliesTo: ["IFCSLAB", "IFCSLABSTANDARDCASE", "IFCSLABELEMENTEDCASE"],
      check(ctx: RuleContext) {
        const t = firstPropNumber(ctx.props ?? {}, [
          "Pset_SlabCommon.Thickness",
          "Thickness",
          "OverallThickness",
        ]);
        if (t == null) return { pass: true, message: "Slab thickness not recorded" };
        return {
          pass: t >= 0.05 && t <= 1.0,
          message:
            t < 0.05 ? `Slab thickness ${mm(t)} is suspiciously thin`
            : t > 1.0 ? `Slab thickness ${mm(t)} is suspiciously thick`
            : undefined,
          actual: mm(t),
          required: "50 mm to 1 000 mm",
        };
      },
    },
  ],
};
```

--- FILE: src/modules/standards/rules/properties.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Property readers shared by rule packs.
 *
 * Fragments exposes getItemsData(ids, opts) which returns a heterogeneous
 * object graph. This module flattens it into a simple { key: string } map
 * so rules can do:
 *   const fireRating = props.get(id)?.["Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating"];
 */
import type { RuleContext } from "./types";

export interface FlatProps {
  /** Bare attribute names, e.g. "Name", "GlobalId". */
  [key: string]: string;
}

export async function readProperties(
  ctx: RuleContext,
  ids: number[],
  attributes: string[] = ["Name", "ObjectType", "Tag", "GlobalId", "PredefinedType"],
): Promise<Map<number, FlatProps>> {
  const out = new Map<number, FlatProps>();
  if (!ids.length) return out;

  const CHUNK = 800;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += CHUNK) {
    if (ctx.isCancelled?.()) break;
    const slice = ids.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    let data: any[] = [];
    try {
      data = await (ctx.model as any).getItemsData(slice, {
        attributesDefault: false,
        attributes,
        psetsDefault: true,
        qtosDefault: false,
      });
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < slice.length; j++) {
      out.set(slice[j], flatten(data[j] ?? {}));
    }
    ctx.progress?.(i + slice.length, ids.length);
  }
  return out;
}

function flatten(d: any): FlatProps {
  const out: FlatProps = {};
  if (!d || typeof d !== "object") return out;

  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) {
    if (k === "psets") continue;
    const val = (v as any)?.value ?? v;
    if (val == null) continue;
    if (typeof val === "object") continue;
    out[k] = String(val);
  }

  const psets = (d as any).psets;
  if (psets && typeof psets === "object") {
    for (const [psName, props] of Object.entries(psets)) {
      if (!props || typeof props !== "object") continue;
      for (const [pk, pv] of Object.entries(props as any)) {
        const val = (pv as any)?.value ?? pv;
        if (val == null) continue;
        if (typeof val === "object") continue;
        out[`${psName}.${pk}`] = String(val);
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Case-insensitive property lookup with dotted fallback. */
export function getProp(flat: FlatProps | undefined, name: string): string | undefined {
  if (!flat) return undefined;
  if (flat[name] != null) return flat[name];
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(flat)) {
    if (k.toLowerCase() === lower) return v;
    const bare = k.includes(".") ? k.split(".").pop()! : k;
    if (bare.toLowerCase() === lower) return v;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function getNumber(flat: FlatProps | undefined, ...names: string[]): number | null {
  for (const n of names) {
    const v = getProp(flat, n);
    if (v == null) continue;
    const num = parseFloat(v);
    if (Number.isFinite(num)) return num;
  }
  return null;
}

export function getString(flat: FlatProps | undefined, ...names: string[]): string | null {
  for (const n of names) {
    const v = getProp(flat, n);
    if (v != null && v !== "") return v;
  }
  return null;
}
```

```ts
import { diagnostics } from "../../../core/diagnostics";
import type {
  Jurisdiction, Rule, RulePack,
} from "./types";

const packs = new Map<string, RulePack>();

export function registerPack(pack: RulePack): void {
  if (packs.has(pack.id)) {
    diagnostics.warn("standards.rules", `pack "${pack.id}" already registered — replacing`);
  }
  packs.set(pack.id, pack);
}

export function listPacks(): RulePack[] {
  return [...packs.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

export function listPacksByJurisdiction(j: Jurisdiction): RulePack[] {
  return listPacks().filter((p) => p.jurisdiction === j);
}

export function getPack(id: string): RulePack | null {
  return packs.get(id) ?? null;
}

export function listRules(): Rule[] {
  const out: Rule[] = [];
  for (const p of packs.values()) out.push(...p.rules);
  return out;
}

export function getRule(id: string): Rule | null {
  for (const p of packs.values()) {
    const r = p.rules.find((x: Rule) => x.id === id);
    if (r) return r;
  }
  return null;
}

export function unregisterPack(id: string): boolean {
  return packs.delete(id);
}

export function clearPacks(): void {
  packs.clear();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Standards rule engine — type contracts.
 *
 * These types are deliberately permissive: rule packs across jurisdictions
 * return slightly different result shapes (some return a RuleCheckResult,
 * some return a Violation[] directly). The engine normalises both.
 */

/* ── Jurisdiction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Jurisdictions are open-ended on purpose. Packs use both the ISO code
 * (`"US"`, `"GB"`) and the English name (`"United States"`, `"United Kingdom"`),
 * plus the meta-value `"intl"` / `"International"` for global rules.
 *
 * The `(string & {})` intersection keeps editor autocomplete for the
 * listed values while allowing any other code without a compile error.
 */
export type Jurisdiction =
  | "intl" | "International"
  | "US" | "us" | "United States"
  | "GB" | "gb" | "United Kingdom" | "UK"
  | "DE" | "de" | "Germany"
  | "CN" | "cn" | "China"
  | "FR" | "fr" | "France"
  | "JP" | "jp" | "Japan"
  | "AU" | "au" | "Australia"
  | "IN" | "in" | "India"
  | "CA" | "ca" | "Canada"
  | "NL" | "nl" | "Netherlands"
  | "ES" | "es" | "Spain"
  | "IT" | "it" | "Italy"
  | "BR" | "br" | "Brazil"
  | "RU" | "ru" | "Russia"
  | "ZA" | "za" | "South Africa"
  | (string & {});

export type Severity = "info" | "warning" | "error";

export type ProgressReporter = (
  done: number,
  total: number,
  note?: string,
) => void;



/* ── Violation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface Violation {
  ruleId: string;
  ruleName: string;
  standard: string;
  jurisdiction?: Jurisdiction;
  severity: Severity;
  category: string;
  elementId: number;
  elementName: string;
  elementCategory: string;
  message: string;
  actual?: string;
  required?: string;
  path?: string;
}

/* ── Rule check result ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * A rule may return:
 *   - `{ pass: true }`                            — element is compliant
 *   - `{ pass: false, message, actual, required }` — one violation, engine wraps it
 *   - `{ pass, violations: [...] }`               — explicit violation list
 *   - `Violation[]`                               — shortcut form
 *
 * The engine normalises all four shapes.
 */
export interface RuleCheckResult {
  pass: boolean;
  message?: string;
  actual?: string;
  required?: string;
  /** Optional. When omitted the engine synthesises one from the fields above. */
  violations?: Violation[];
}

/* ── Rule context ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Everything a rule needs about the model and the current element.
 * Fields are optional because the engine populates only what the rule's
 * `appliesTo` / `requiresCategories` gate allows.
 */
export interface RuleContext {
  /** Model handle string, e.g. "model-0". */
  modelId?: string;
  /** The OBC Fragments model object. Rules cast to `any` for getItemsData. */
  model?: any;
  elementId?: number;
  elementName?: string;
  elementCategory?: string;
  /** Flat property map for the current element (Pset.Prop concatenated). */
  props?: Record<string, any>;
  /** Raw line data from the fragments worker. */
  raw?: any;
  /** IFC categories present in the model (e.g. ["IFCDOOR", "IFCWALL"]). */
  categories?: string[];
  units?: {
    length: string;
    area: string;
    volume: string;
  };
  locale?: string;
  unitSystem?: string;
  progress?: ProgressReporter;
  isCancelled?: () => boolean;
  /** All elements in the model, pre-fetched by the engine. */
  elements?: Array<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
    category: string;
    props?: Record<string, any>;
    raw: any;
  }>;
  /** Escape hatch for anything a pack needs beyond the above. */
  [key: string]: any;
}

/* ── Rule ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface Rule {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Standard name, e.g. "IBC 2021", "BS 9999". */
  standard?: string;
  jurisdiction?: Jurisdiction;
  severity: Severity;
  /** Human-readable category, e.g. "Egress", "Fire", "Energy". */
  category?: string;
  /**
   * IFC categories this rule applies to. When omitted, the rule applies to
   * every element the engine iterates.
   */
  appliesTo?: string[];
  /**
   * Gate: only run this rule when at least one of the listed categories
   * exists in the model. Used to skip rules whose target elements are absent
   * without scanning.
   */
  requiresCategories?: (categories: string[]) => boolean;
  check(ctx: RuleContext): RuleCheckResult | Violation[] | Promise<RuleCheckResult | Violation[]>;
}

/* ── Rule pack ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface RulePack {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  jurisdiction?: Jurisdiction;
  version: string;
  rules: Rule[];
}

/* ── Run options and summary ────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface RunOptions {
  /** Restrict to one model. Omit to run against every loaded model. */
  modelId?: string;
  /** Restrict to these packs. Omit to run every registered pack. */
  packIds?: string[];
  /** Restrict to these rules. Takes precedence over packIds when both are set. */
  ruleIds?: string[];
  /** Cooperative cancel — the engine polls `signal.cancelled` between rules. */
  signal?: { cancelled: boolean };
  /** Progress callback: called once per rule with (done, total, note). */
  onProgress?: (done: number, total: number, note?: string) => void;
}

export interface RunSummary {
  packCount: number;
  ruleCount: number;
  violations: number;
  errors: number;
  warnings: number;
  infos: number;
  startedAt: number;
  finishedAt: number;
  durationMs: number;
  cancelled: boolean;
}

/* Legacy aliases — do not remove. */
export type RuleViolation = Violation;
export type RuleSeverity = Severity;
export type StandardPack = RulePack;
```

--- FILE: src/modules/timeline/timeline.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * 4D Construction Simulation — core engine.
 *
 * Links model elements to construction phases and drives visibility /
 * colour over a timeline. Designed as a competitive alternative to
 * Navisworks TimeLiner for openBIM federated models.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import type { Phase, TimelineState } from "./types";
import { DEFAULT_PHASE_COLORS } from "./types";

const uid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `ph-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

let state: TimelineState = {
  phases: [],
  progress: 0,
  playing: false,
  speed: 0.15,
};

const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
let raf = 0;
let lastTs = 0;

/** Original material / visibility snapshots so we can restore. */
const original = new Map<string, { visible: boolean; color?: number; opacity?: number }>();

function notify() {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
}

export function onTimelineChange(fn: () => void) {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => listeners.delete(fn);
}

export function getTimelineState(): Readonly<TimelineState> {
  return state;
}

export function listPhases(): Phase[] {
  return state.phases.slice().sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

export function addPhase(name?: string): Phase {
  const order = state.phases.length
    ? Math.max(...state.phases.map((p) => p.order)) + 1
    : 0;
  const color = DEFAULT_PHASE_COLORS[state.phases.length % DEFAULT_PHASE_COLORS.length];
  const phase: Phase = {
    id: uid(),
    name: name ?? `Phase ${order + 1}`,
    order,
    color,
    elementIds: [],
    beforeMode: "hidden",
    afterMode: "complete",
  };
  state.phases.push(phase);
  notify();
  return phase;
}

export function updatePhase(id: string, patch: Partial<Phase>) {
  const p = state.phases.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!p) return;
  Object.assign(p, patch);
  applyProgress(state.progress);
  notify();
}

export function removePhase(id: string) {
  state.phases = state.phases.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
  applyProgress(state.progress);
  notify();
}

export function assignSelectionToPhase(phaseId: string, ids: string[]) {
  const p = state.phases.find((x) => x.id === phaseId);
  if (!p) return;
  const set = new Set(p.elementIds);
  for (const id of ids) set.add(id);
  p.elementIds = Array.from(set);
  // Remove from other phases
  for (const other of state.phases) {
    if (other.id === phaseId) continue;
    other.elementIds = other.elementIds.filter((x) => !set.has(x));
  }
  applyProgress(state.progress);
  notify();
}

export function clearPhaseElements(phaseId: string) {
  const p = state.phases.find((x) => x.id === phaseId);
  if (!p) return;
  p.elementIds = [];
  applyProgress(state.progress);
  notify();
}

export function setProgress(t: number) {
  state.progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  applyProgress(state.progress);
  notify();
}

export function setPlaying(on: boolean) {
  state.playing = on;
  if (on) {
    lastTs = performance.now();
    if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  } else if (raf) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  }
  notify();
}

export function setSpeed(s: number) {
  state.speed = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(2, s));
  notify();
}

function tick(ts: number) {
  if (!state.playing) {
    raf = 0;
    return;
  }
  const dt = (ts - lastTs) / 1000;
  lastTs = ts;
  const next = state.progress + dt * state.speed;
  if (next >= 1) {
    state.progress = 1;
    state.playing = false;
    applyProgress(1);
    notify();
    raf = 0;
    return;
  }
  state.progress = next;
  applyProgress(next);
  notify();
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

/** Map progress 0..1 onto phase index and apply visibility/colour. */
function applyProgress(t: number) {
  const phases = listPhases();
  if (!phases.length) {
    restoreAll();
    return;
  }

  // Which phase is "current" at progress t
  const idx = Math.min(phases.length - 1, Math.floor(t * phases.length));
  const active = new Set<string>();

  for (let i = 0; i < phases.length; i++) {
    const ph = phases[i];
    const mode =
      i < idx ? ph.afterMode :
      i === idx ? "active" :
      ph.beforeMode;

    for (const eid of ph.elementIds) {
      active.add(eid);
      applyElementStyle(eid, mode, ph.color);
    }
  }

  // Elements not in any phase stay as-is (or we could force visible)
}

function applyElementStyle(
  id: string,
  mode: "hidden" | "ghost" | "visible" | "complete" | "active",
  phaseColor: string,
) {
  // Try authored elements first via a global if present
  const auth = (window as any).__obsAuthoring;
  if (auth?.setElementVisibility) {
    const visible = mode !== "hidden";
    auth.setElementVisibility(id, visible);
    if (mode === "ghost" && auth.setElementOpacity) auth.setElementOpacity(id, 0.25);
    if ((mode === "active" || mode === "complete") && auth.setElementColor) {
      auth.setElementColor(id, mode === "active" ? phaseColor : "#94a3b8");
    }
  }

  // Fragments / scene objects — best-effort via name or userData
  if (!ctx.world?.scene?.three) return;
  ctx.world.scene.three.traverse((obj: THREE.Object3D) => {
    const match =
      obj.name === id ||
      (obj.userData && (obj.userData.expressID === id || obj.userData.id === id || obj.userData.guid === id));
    if (!match) return;

    if (!original.has(id)) {
      const mesh = obj as THREE.Mesh;
      const mat = mesh.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | THREE.MeshLambertMaterial | undefined;
      original.set(id, {
        visible: obj.visible,
        color: mat?.color?.getHex?.(),
        opacity: mat?.opacity,
      });
    }

    if (mode === "hidden") {
      obj.visible = false;
      return;
    }
    obj.visible = true;
    const mesh = obj as THREE.Mesh;
    const mat = mesh.material as any;
    if (!mat) return;
    if (mode === "ghost") {
      mat.transparent = true;
      mat.opacity = 0.2;
      mat.needsUpdate = true;
    } else if (mode === "active") {
      mat.transparent = false;
      mat.opacity = 1;
      if (mat.color) mat.color.set(phaseColor);
      mat.needsUpdate = true;
    } else if (mode === "complete") {
      mat.transparent = false;
      mat.opacity = 1;
      if (mat.color) mat.color.set("#94a3b8");
      mat.needsUpdate = true;
    } else {
      // visible — restore original if we have it
      const o = original.get(id);
      if (o) {
        mat.transparent = (o.opacity ?? 1) < 1;
        mat.opacity = o.opacity ?? 1;
        if (mat.color && o.color != null) mat.color.setHex(o.color);
        mat.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    }
  });
}

function restoreAll() {
  if (!ctx.world?.scene?.three) return;
  for (const [id, o] of original) {
    ctx.world.scene.three.traverse((obj: THREE.Object3D) => {
      const match =
        obj.name === id ||
        (obj.userData && (obj.userData.expressID === id || obj.userData.id === id));
      if (!match) return;
      obj.visible = o.visible;
      const mesh = obj as THREE.Mesh;
      const mat = mesh.material as any;
      if (mat && o.color != null && mat.color) {
        mat.color.setHex(o.color);
        mat.opacity = o.opacity ?? 1;
        mat.transparent = (o.opacity ?? 1) < 1;
        mat.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    });
  }
  original.clear();
}

export function resetTimeline() {
  setPlaying(false);
  state.progress = 0;
  restoreAll();
  notify();
}

export function createDefaultPhases() {
  if (state.phases.length) return;
  const names = ["Site prep", "Foundations", "Structure", "Envelope", "MEP", "Finishes"];
  names.forEach((n) => addPhase(n));
}

export function exportTimelineJson(): string {
  return JSON.stringify({ version: 1, phases: state.phases }, null, 2);
}

export function importTimelineJson(json: string) {
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(json);
    if (Array.isArray(data.phases)) {
      state.phases = data.phases;
      applyProgress(state.progress);
      notify();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[timeline] import failed", e);
  }
}
```

```ts
/** 4D construction simulation types — Navisworks TimeLiner-style. */

export interface Phase {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Sequence order (lower = earlier). */
  order: number;
  /** Optional ISO date string for real calendar simulation. */
  startDate?: string;
  endDate?: string;
  color: string;
  /** Element / fragment IDs belonging to this phase. */
  elementIds: string[];
  /** How elements appear before their phase starts. */
  beforeMode: "hidden" | "ghost" | "visible";
  /** How elements appear after their phase ends. */
  afterMode: "hidden" | "ghost" | "visible" | "complete";
}

export interface TimelineState {
  phases: Phase[];
  /** Current playback position (0 = start, 1 = end). */
  progress: number;
  playing: boolean;
  /** Playback speed (phases per second). */
  speed: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_PHASE_COLORS = [
  "#3b82f6", "#22c55e", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444", "#8b5cf6",
  "#06b6d4", "#ec4899", "#84cc16", "#f97316", "#6366f1",
];
```

--- FILE: src/modules/type-catalog/type-catalog.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Type Catalog - Revit-style .txt type catalogs for family types.
 *
 * Format (tab-separated):
 *   ,Width##length##meters,Height##length##meters,LeafCount##other##
 *   900 x 2100,0.9,2.1,1
 *   1000 x 2100,1.0,2.1,1
 *
 * First column = type name; header row declares parameter names + units.
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import type { FamilyType } from "../families/types";

export interface CatalogColumn {
  name: string;
  unitType: string; // length | other | angle | ...
  unit: string;     // meters | millimeters | ...
}

export interface TypeCatalog {
  familyName: string;
  columns: CatalogColumn[];
  rows: Array<{ typeName: string; values: Record<string, number | string | boolean> }>;
}

function parseHeaderCell(cell: string): CatalogColumn | null {
  // Width##length##meters
  const parts = cell.split("##");
  if (!parts[0] || parts[0].trim() === "") return null;
  return {
    name: parts[0].trim(),
    unitType: (parts[1] ?? "other").trim(),
    unit: (parts[2] ?? "").trim(),
  };
}

function coerce(raw: string, col: CatalogColumn): number | string | boolean {
  const s = raw.trim();
  if (col.unitType === "yesno" || col.unitType === "boolean") {
    return /^(1|true|yes)$/i.test(s);
  }
  if (col.unitType === "length" || col.unitType === "number" || col.unitType === "integer") {
    let n = Number(s);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return s;
    // Convert common units - metres
    const u = col.unit.toLowerCase();
    if (u === "millimeters" || u === "mm") n = n / 1000;
    else if (u === "centimeters" || u === "cm") n = n / 100;
    else if (u === "feet" || u === "ft") n = n * 0.3048;
    else if (u === "inches" || u === "in") n = n * 0.0254;
    if (col.unitType === "integer") n = Math.round(n);
    return n;
  }
  return s;
}

/**
 * Parse a Revit-compatible type catalog text.
 */
export function parseTypeCatalog(text: string, familyName = ""): TypeCatalog {
  const lines = text
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .filter((l) => l.length && !l.startsWith("#"));

  if (!lines.length) {
    return { familyName, columns: [], rows: [] };
  }

  const headerCells = lines[0].split("\t");
  const columns: CatalogColumn[] = [];
  // First header cell is typically empty (type name column)
  for (let i = 1; i < headerCells.length; i++) {
    const col = parseHeaderCell(headerCells[i]);
    if (col) columns.push(col);
  }

  const rows: TypeCatalog["rows"] = [];
  for (let r = 1; r < lines.length; r++) {
    const cells = lines[r].split("\t");
    const typeName = (cells[0] ?? `Type ${r}`).trim();
    const values: Record<string, number | string | boolean> = {};
    for (let c = 0; c < columns.length; c++) {
      const raw = cells[c + 1] ?? "";
      if (raw === "") continue;
      values[columns[c].name] = coerce(raw, columns[c]);
    }
    rows.push({ typeName, values });
  }

  return { familyName, columns, rows };
}

/**
 * Serialize family types to a type catalog text.
 */
export function exportTypeCatalog(
  familyName: string,
  types: FamilyType[],
  columns: CatalogColumn[],
): string {
  const header = [""].concat(
    columns.map((c) => `${c.name}##${c.unitType}##${c.unit}`),
  );
  const lines = [header.join("\t")];
  for (const t of types) {
    const cells = [t.name];
    for (const c of columns) {
      const v = t.values[c.name];
      cells.push(v == null ? "" : String(v));
    }
    lines.push(cells.join("\t"));
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}

/**
 * Apply a catalog to a family: create/update types by name.
 */
export function applyCatalogToFamily(
  catalog: TypeCatalog,
  existingTypes: FamilyType[],
  createType: (name: string, values: Record<string, any>) => FamilyType | null,
  updateType: (typeId: string, values: Record<string, any>) => void,
): { created: number; updated: number } {
  let created = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  const byName = new Map(existingTypes.map((t) => [t.name, t]));

  for (const row of catalog.rows) {
    const existing = byName.get(row.typeName);
    if (existing) {
      updateType(existing.id, { ...existing.values, ...row.values });
      updated++;
    } else {
      const t = createType(row.typeName, row.values);
      if (t) created++;
    }
  }
  return { created, updated };
}

export function setupTypeCatalog(): void {
  const api = { parseTypeCatalog, exportTypeCatalog, applyCatalogToFamily };
  (ctx.features as any).typeCatalog = api;
  (window as any).__obsTypeCatalog = api;
  console.log("[type-catalog] ready");
}

```

```ts
/**
 * UI element registry.
 *
 * Tracks the visibility of every toggleable UI panel or bar. Each item
 * declares how to read its current visibility, how to toggle it, and
 * whether it is available yet. The User Interface menu iterates this
 * registry and renders checkboxes.
 *
 * Adding a new UI element = adding one entry here. No UI code changes.
 */

export interface UiItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Return current visibility. */
  isVisible: () => boolean;
  /** Toggle visibility. Called when the checkbox is clicked. */
  toggle: () => void;
  /** If false, the row is rendered as a disabled placeholder. */
  available: boolean;
  /** Optional tooltip when disabled. */
  unavailableHint?: string;
  /** Section key (used for grouping in the menu). */
  group: "panels" | "bars";
}

const items: UiItem[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function registerUiItem(item: UiItem): void {
  const idx = items.findIndex((x) => x.id === item.id);
  if (idx >= 0) items[idx] = item;
  else items.push(item);
}

export function listUiItems(): UiItem[] {
  return items.slice();
}

export function getUiItem(id: string): UiItem | null {
  return items.find((x) => x.id === id) ?? null;
}

export function onUiRegistryChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

/** Notify the menu that some checkbox changed state externally. */
export function notifyUiChange(): void {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.ui.visibility.v1";

interface StoredVisibility { [id: string]: boolean; }

export function loadStoredVisibility(): StoredVisibility {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function saveStoredVisibility(state: StoredVisibility): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function persistItem(id: string, visible: boolean): void {
  const s = loadStoredVisibility();
  s[id] = visible;
  saveStoredVisibility(s);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Interactive layer for annotations.
 */

import { getElements } from "../../features/authoring";
import {
  getDimensions, getTags, getNotes, updateDimension, updateTag, updateNote,
  setDimensions, setTags, setNotes,
} from "./annotations";
import {
  getSelection, setSelection, clearSelection, deleteAnnotation,
  type AnnotationRef,
} from "./annotation-store";
import { resolveDimension } from "./dimension-engine";
import { resolveTag } from "./tag-engine";
import type { ViewDef } from "./types";
import type { SceneEntity } from "./scene";
import { history } from "../../features/history";

const HIT_TOLERANCE_PX = 8;
const DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX = 4;

interface ResolvedEntity {
  ref: AnnotationRef;
  entities: SceneEntity[];
}

function aabbOfEntities(entities: SceneEntity[]): { minX: number; minZ: number; maxX: number; maxZ: number } | null {
  let minX = Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
  let any = false;
  const consider = (x: number, z: number) => {
    if (x < minX) minX = x;
    if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
    if (z < minZ) minZ = z;
    if (z > maxZ) maxZ = z;
    any = true;
  };
  for (const e of entities) {
    if (e.kind === "line") { consider(e.x1, e.z1); consider(e.x2, e.z2); }
    else if (e.kind === "polyline") { for (const [x, z] of e.points) consider(x, z); }
    else if (e.kind === "arc") { consider(e.cx - e.r, e.cz - e.r); consider(e.cx + e.r, e.cz + e.r); }
    else if (e.kind === "circle") { consider(e.cx - e.r, e.cz - e.r); consider(e.cx + e.r, e.cz + e.r); }
    else if (e.kind === "text" || e.kind === "symbol") { consider(e.x, e.z); }
  }
  return any ? { minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ } : null;
}

function resolveAll(view: ViewDef): ResolvedEntity[] {
  const elements = getElements();
  const out: ResolvedEntity[] = [];
  for (const d of getDimensions(view.id)) {
    const r = resolveDimension(d, elements, view.scale);
    if (r.valid) out.push({ ref: { kind: "dimension", id: d.id, viewId: view.id }, entities: r.entities });
  }
  for (const t of getTags(view.id)) {
    const r = resolveTag(t, elements, view.scale);
    if (r.valid) out.push({ ref: { kind: "tag", id: t.id, viewId: view.id }, entities: r.entities });
  }
  for (const n of getNotes(view.id)) {
    out.push({
      ref: { kind: "note", id: n.id, viewId: view.id },
      entities: [{
        kind: "text", x: n.x, z: n.z, text: n.text,
        anchor: n.anchor, sizePt: n.sizePt, rotation: n.rotation, color: n.color,
      }],
    });
  }
  return out;
}

function hitTest(view: ViewDef, worldX: number, worldZ: number, tolerance: number): AnnotationRef | null {
  const resolved = resolveAll(view);
  let best: { ref: AnnotationRef; dist: number } | null = null;
  for (const r of resolved) {
    const bb = aabbOfEntities(r.entities);
    if (!bb) continue;
    if (worldX < bb.minX - tolerance || worldX > bb.maxX + tolerance) continue;
    if (worldZ < bb.minZ - tolerance || worldZ > bb.maxZ + tolerance) continue;
    const cx = (bb.minX + bb.maxX) / 2;
    const cz = (bb.minZ + bb.maxZ) / 2;
    const d = Math.hypot(worldX - cx, worldZ - cz);
    if (!best || d < best.dist) best = { ref: r.ref, dist: d };
  }
  return best ? best.ref : null;
}

function svgPointToWorld(svg: SVGSVGElement, clientX: number, clientY: number): { x: number; z: number; worldTol: number } | null {
  const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
  const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
  if (!rect.width || !rect.height || !vb.width) return null;
  const px = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * vb.width + vb.x;
  const py = ((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * vb.height + vb.y;
  const worldTol = (vb.width / rect.width) * HIT_TOLERANCE_PX;
  return { x: px, z: -py, worldTol };
}

let ctxMenu: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
function ensureCtxMenu(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (ctxMenu) return ctxMenu;
  ctxMenu = document.createElement("div");
  ctxMenu.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;z-index:9700;display:none;min-width:180px;" +
    "background:#1c1e28;color:#e8eaf0;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
    "border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55);" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;padding:4px 0";
  ctxMenu.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();
  document.body.appendChild(ctxMenu);
  return ctxMenu;
}

function closeCtxMenu(): void {
  if (ctxMenu) ctxMenu.style.display = "none";
}

function mkCtxRow(label: string, onClick: () => void, danger = false): HTMLElement {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.textContent = label;
  row.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;" +
    (danger ? "color:#fca5a5;" : "");
  row.onmouseenter = () => { row.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.14)"; };
  row.onmouseleave = () => { row.style.background = "transparent"; };
  row.onclick = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); closeCtxMenu(); onClick(); };
  return row;
}

function openCtxMenu(ref: AnnotationRef, clientX: number, clientY: number, onRerender: () => void): void {
  const menu = ensureCtxMenu();
  menu.innerHTML = "";
  menu.appendChild(mkCtxRow("Delete", () => {
    deleteAnnotation(ref);
    onRerender();
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: { message: "Annotation deleted", kind: "info" },
    }));
  }, true));
  if (ref.kind === "tag") {
    menu.appendChild(mkCtxRow("Rotate 90", () => {
      const arr = getTags(ref.viewId);
      const tag = arr.find((t) => t.id === ref.id);
      if (tag) {
        const next = ((tag.rotation + 90) % 360) as 0 | 90 | 180 | 270;
        updateTag(ref.viewId, ref.id, { rotation: next });
        onRerender();
      }
    }));
    menu.appendChild(mkCtxRow("Toggle leader", () => {
      const arr = getTags(ref.viewId);
      const tag = arr.find((t) => t.id === ref.id);
      if (tag) {
        updateTag(ref.viewId, ref.id, { leader: !tag.leader });
        onRerender();
      }
    }));
  }
  if (ref.kind === "dimension") {
    menu.appendChild(mkCtxRow("Reset offset (400 mm)", () => {
      updateDimension(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: 400 });
      onRerender();
    }));
  }
  menu.style.left = clientX + "px";
  menu.style.top = clientY + "px";
  menu.style.display = "block";
  const close = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
    if (ctxMenu && !ctxMenu.contains(ev.target as Node)) {
      closeCtxMenu();
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", close, true);
    }
  };
  setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener("mousedown", close, true), 0);
}

let keyHandlerInstalled = false;
function installKeyHandler(onRerender: () => void): void {
  if (keyHandlerInstalled) return;
  keyHandlerInstalled = true;
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
    if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea") return;
    if (e.key !== "Delete" && e.key !== "Backspace") return;
    const ref = getSelection();
    if (!ref) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const snapshot = captureForUndo(ref);
    deleteAnnotation(ref);
    onRerender();
    history.push({
      label: "Delete annotation",
      apply: () => { deleteAnnotation(ref); onRerender(); },
      revert: () => { restoreFromUndo(ref, snapshot); onRerender(); },
    });
  });
}

function captureForUndo(ref: AnnotationRef): any {
  if (ref.kind === "dimension") {
    const d = getDimensions(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
    return d ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d)) : null;
  }
  if (ref.kind === "tag") {
    const t = getTags(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
    return t ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(t)) : null;
  }
  const n = getNotes(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
  return n ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n)) : null;
}

function restoreFromUndo(ref: AnnotationRef, snap: any): void {
  if (!snap) return;
  if (ref.kind === "dimension") {
    const arr = getDimensions(ref.viewId).slice();
    if (!arr.some((d) => d.id === snap.id)) arr.push(snap);
    setDimensions(ref.viewId, arr);
  } else if (ref.kind === "tag") {
    const arr = getTags(ref.viewId).slice();
    if (!arr.some((t) => t.id === snap.id)) arr.push(snap);
    setTags(ref.viewId, arr);
  } else if (ref.kind === "note") {
    const arr = getNotes(ref.viewId).slice();
    if (!arr.some((n) => n.id === snap.id)) arr.push(snap);
    setNotes(ref.viewId, arr);
  }
}

export interface InteractionOptions {
  svg: SVGSVGElement;
  view: ViewDef;
  onRerender: () => void;
}

export function attachAnnotationInteractions(opts: InteractionOptions): void {
  const { svg, view, onRerender } = opts;
  installKeyHandler(onRerender);

  let candidate: { ref: AnnotationRef; startX: number; startY: number } | null = null;
  let dragging = false;
  let startOffsets: { dimOffset?: number; tagOffX?: number; tagOffZ?: number; noteX?: number; noteZ?: number } = {};

  svg.addEventListener("mousedown", (ev) => {
    if (ev.button !== 0) return;
    const p = svgPointToWorld(svg, ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    if (!p) return;
    const ref = hitTest(view, p.x, p.z, p.worldTol);
    if (!ref) return;
    ev.stopPropagation();
    candidate = { ref, startX: ev.clientX, startY: ev.clientY };
    if (ref.kind === "dimension") {
      const d = getDimensions(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
      if (d) startOffsets = { dimOffset: d.offsetMm };
    } else if (ref.kind === "tag") {
      const t = getTags(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
      if (t) startOffsets = { tagOffX: t.offsetMm[0], tagOffZ: t.offsetMm[1] };
    } else if (ref.kind === "note") {
      const n = getNotes(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
      if (n) startOffsets = { noteX: n.x, noteZ: n.z };
    }
  }, true);

  const onMove = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
    if (!candidate) return;
    const dx = ev.clientX - candidate.startX;
    const dy = ev.clientY - candidate.startY;
    if (!dragging && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX) return;
    dragging = true;
    const p = svgPointToWorld(svg, ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    if (!p) return;
    const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const worldPerPx = vb.width / Math.max(1, rect.width);
    const dxWorld = dx * worldPerPx;
    const dyWorld = dy * worldPerPx;
    const ref = candidate.ref;
    if (ref.kind === "dimension" && startOffsets.dimOffset != null) {
      const newOffset = startOffsets.dimOffset + (dyWorld * 1000 / view.scale);
      updateDimension(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: Math.max(-2000, Math.min(2000, newOffset)) });
      onRerender();
    } else if (ref.kind === "tag" && startOffsets.tagOffX != null && startOffsets.tagOffZ != null) {
      const worldToPaper = 1000 / view.scale;
      const newX = startOffsets.tagOffX + dxWorld * worldToPaper;
      const newZ = startOffsets.tagOffZ - dyWorld * worldToPaper;
      updateTag(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: [newX, newZ] });
      onRerender();
    } else if (ref.kind === "note" && startOffsets.noteX != null && startOffsets.noteZ != null) {
      const newX = startOffsets.noteX + dxWorld;
      const newZ = startOffsets.noteZ - dyWorld;
      updateNote(ref.viewId, ref.id, { x: newX, z: newZ });
      onRerender();
    }
  };

  const onUp = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
    if (!candidate) return;
    const ref = candidate.ref;
    if (!dragging) {
      setSelection(ref);
    } else {
      const before = { ...startOffsets };
      let after: any = {};
      if (ref.kind === "dimension") {
        const d = getDimensions(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
        if (d) after = { dimOffset: d.offsetMm };
      } else if (ref.kind === "tag") {
        const t = getTags(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
        if (t) after = { tagOffX: t.offsetMm[0], tagOffZ: t.offsetMm[1] };
      } else if (ref.kind === "note") {
        const n = getNotes(ref.viewId).find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
        if (n) after = { noteX: n.x, noteZ: n.z };
      }
      history.push({
        label: "Move annotation",
        apply: () => {
          if (ref.kind === "dimension" && after.dimOffset != null) updateDimension(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: after.dimOffset });
          else if (ref.kind === "tag" && after.tagOffX != null && after.tagOffZ != null) updateTag(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: [after.tagOffX, after.tagOffZ] });
          else if (ref.kind === "note" && after.noteX != null) updateNote(ref.viewId, ref.id, { x: after.noteX, z: after.noteZ });
          onRerender();
        },
        revert: () => {
          if (ref.kind === "dimension" && before.dimOffset != null) updateDimension(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: before.dimOffset });
          else if (ref.kind === "tag" && before.tagOffX != null && before.tagOffZ != null) updateTag(ref.viewId, ref.id, { offsetMm: [before.tagOffX, before.tagOffZ] });
          else if (ref.kind === "note" && before.noteX != null) updateNote(ref.viewId, ref.id, { x: before.noteX, z: before.noteZ });
          onRerender();
        },
      });
    }
    candidate = null;
    dragging = false;
    startOffsets = {};
    ev.stopPropagation();
  };

  window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", onUp);

  svg.addEventListener("contextmenu", (ev) => {
    const p = svgPointToWorld(svg, ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    if (!p) return;
    const ref = hitTest(view, p.x, p.z, p.worldTol);
    if (!ref) { closeCtxMenu(); return; }
    ev.preventDefault();
    ev.stopPropagation();
    setSelection(ref);
    openCtxMenu(ref, ev.clientX, ev.clientY, onRerender);
  }, true);

  svg.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
    if (candidate || dragging) return;
    const p = svgPointToWorld(svg, ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    if (!p) return;
    const ref = hitTest(view, p.x, p.z, p.worldTol);
    if (!ref) clearSelection();
  }, true);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Annotation layer.
 *
 * Given a view id, gathers the dimensions and tags that belong to that view,
 * resolves each against the current element model, and returns the combined
 * SceneEntity[] for the annotation layer of the view's Scene2D.
 *
 * This is the single integration point between the annotation model and the
 * rendering pipeline. Call it from the view generator, and dims/tags flow
 * through the same SVG renderer as wall lines.
 */

import { getElements } from "../../features/authoring";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import { getDimensions, getTags, getNotes } from "./annotations";
import { resolveDimension } from "./dimension-engine";
import { resolveTag } from "./tag-engine";
import type { SceneEntity } from "./scene";
import { paperToWorld } from "./scene";

export interface AnnotationStats {
  dimensions: number;
  dimensionsInvalid: number;
  tags: number;
  tagsInvalid: number;
  notes: number;
}

export interface AnnotationLayerResult {
  entities: SceneEntity[];
  stats: AnnotationStats;
}

export function buildAnnotationLayer(
  viewId: string,
  viewScale: number,
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[] = getElements(),
): AnnotationLayerResult {
  const entities: SceneEntity[] = [];
  const stats: AnnotationStats = {
    dimensions: 0,
    dimensionsInvalid: 0,
    tags: 0,
    tagsInvalid: 0,
    notes: 0,
  };

  for (const dim of getDimensions(viewId)) {
    const r = resolveDimension(dim, elements, viewScale);
    if (!r.valid) {
      stats.dimensionsInvalid += 1;
      continue;
    }
    stats.dimensions += 1;
    for (const e of r.entities) entities.push(e);
  }

  for (const tag of getTags(viewId)) {
    const r = resolveTag(tag, elements, viewScale);
    if (!r.valid) {
      stats.tagsInvalid += 1;
      continue;
    }
    stats.tags += 1;
    for (const e of r.entities) entities.push(e);
  }

  for (const note of getNotes(viewId)) {
    stats.notes += 1;
    entities.push({
      kind: "text",
      x: note.x,
      z: note.z,
      text: note.text,
      anchor: note.anchor,
      sizePt: note.sizePt,
      rotation: note.rotation,
      color: note.color,
    });
  }

  return { entities, stats };
}
```
