```ts
/**
 * Annotation types â€” dimensions and tags that live in a VIEW, not in the
 * element model. Every annotation references the element(s) it describes
 * through the Reference system so it follows element motion.
 */

import type { Reference } from "./references";

export type DimensionKind =
  | "aligned" | "linear" | "angular" | "radial" | "diameter" | "arc"
  | "spot-elevation" | "spot-coordinate";

export interface DimensionStyle {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  unit: "mm" | "cm" | "m";
  precision: number;
  textSizePt: number;
  color: string;
  tick: "diagonal" | "dot" | "arrow";
}

export const DEFAULT_DIM_STYLES: DimensionStyle[] = [
  { id: "aligned-mm", name: "Aligned 2.5 mm", unit: "mm", precision: 0, textSizePt: 2.5, color: "#1d4ed8", tick: "diagonal" },
  { id: "eng-mm", name: "Engineering 3 mm", unit: "mm", precision: 0, textSizePt: 3, color: "#1e40af", tick: "diagonal" },
  { id: "decimal-m", name: "Decimal meters", unit: "m", precision: 3, textSizePt: 2.5, color: "#1d4ed8", tick: "arrow" },
];

export interface Dimension {
  id: string;
  viewId: string;
  kind: DimensionKind;
  styleId: string;
  ref1: Reference;
  ref2?: Reference;
  vertexRef?: Reference;
  offsetMm: number;
  override?: string;
  label?: string;
  createdAt: number;
}

export type TagKind = "category" | "material" | "room" | "custom";

export interface Tag {
  id: string;
  viewId: string;
  ref: Reference;
  kind: TagKind;
  field?: string;
  offsetMm: [number, number];
  leader: boolean;
  leaderShape: "straight" | "curved" | "none";
  rotation: 0 | 90 | 180 | 270;
  override?: string;
  createdAt: number;
}

export interface TextNote {
  id: string;
  viewId: string;
  x: number;
  z: number;
  text: string;
  sizePt: number;
  color: string;
  rotation: number;
  anchor: "start" | "middle" | "end";
}

const dimensionsByView = new Map<string, Dimension[]>();
const tagsByView = new Map<string, Tag[]>();
const notesByView = new Map<string, TextNote[]>();

export function getDimensions(viewId: string): Dimension[] { return dimensionsByView.get(viewId) ?? []; }

export function setDimensions(viewId: string, arr: Dimension[]): void {
  if (arr.length) dimensionsByView.set(viewId, arr.slice());
  else dimensionsByView.delete(viewId);
}

export function updateDimension(viewId: string, id: string, patch: Partial<Dimension>): boolean {
  const arr = dimensionsByView.get(viewId);
  if (!arr) return false;
  const i = arr.findIndex((d) => d.id === id);
  if (i < 0) return false;
  arr[i] = { ...arr[i], ...patch };
  return true;
}
export function addDimension(d: Dimension): Dimension {
  const arr = dimensionsByView.get(d.viewId) ?? [];
  arr.push(d);
  dimensionsByView.set(d.viewId, arr);
  return d;
}
export function removeDimension(viewId: string, id: string): void {
  const arr = dimensionsByView.get(viewId);
  if (!arr) return;
  dimensionsByView.set(viewId, arr.filter((d) => d.id !== id));
}

export function getTags(viewId: string): Tag[] { return tagsByView.get(viewId) ?? []; }

export function setTags(viewId: string, arr: Tag[]): void {
  if (arr.length) tagsByView.set(viewId, arr.slice());
  else tagsByView.delete(viewId);
}

export function updateTag(viewId: string, id: string, patch: Partial<Tag>): boolean {
  const arr = tagsByView.get(viewId);
  if (!arr) return false;
  const i = arr.findIndex((t) => t.id === id);
  if (i < 0) return false;
  arr[i] = { ...arr[i], ...patch };
  return true;
}
export function addTag(t: Tag): Tag {
  const arr = tagsByView.get(t.viewId) ?? [];
  arr.push(t);
  tagsByView.set(t.viewId, arr);
  return t;
}
export function removeTag(viewId: string, id: string): void {
  const arr = tagsByView.get(viewId);
  if (!arr) return;
  tagsByView.set(viewId, arr.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
}

export function getNotes(viewId: string): TextNote[] { return notesByView.get(viewId) ?? []; }

export function setNotes(viewId: string, arr: TextNote[]): void {
  if (arr.length) notesByView.set(viewId, arr.slice());
  else notesByView.delete(viewId);
}

export function updateNote(viewId: string, id: string, patch: Partial<TextNote>): boolean {
  const arr = notesByView.get(viewId);
  if (!arr) return false;
  const i = arr.findIndex((n) => n.id === id);
  if (i < 0) return false;
  arr[i] = { ...arr[i], ...patch };
  return true;
}
export function addNote(n: TextNote): TextNote {
  const arr = notesByView.get(n.viewId) ?? [];
  arr.push(n);
  notesByView.set(n.viewId, arr);
  return n;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Annotation store - persistence, selection, and change events.
 */

import type { Dimension, Tag, TextNote } from "./annotations";
import {
  getDimensions, getTags, getNotes,
  setDimensions, setTags, setNotes,
  removeDimension, removeTag,
} from "./annotations";
import { listViews } from "./store";

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.views.annotations.v1";

export type AnnotationKind = "dimension" | "tag" | "note";

export interface AnnotationRef {
  kind: AnnotationKind;
  id: string;
  viewId: string;
}

export interface SerializedAnnotations {
  dimensions: Dimension[];
  tags: Tag[];
  notes: TextNote[];
  updatedAt: number;
}

let selection: AnnotationRef | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
let booted = false;

function emit(): void {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

export function onAnnotationChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

export function getSelection(): AnnotationRef | null { return selection; }

export function setSelection(ref: AnnotationRef | null): void {
  const wasSame =
    (ref === null && selection === null) ||
    (ref !== null && selection !== null &&
      ref.kind === selection.kind && ref.id === selection.id);
  if (wasSame) return;
  selection = ref;
  emit();
}

export function clearSelection(): void {
  if (selection) { selection = null; emit(); }
}

export function serializeAll(): SerializedAnnotations {
  const dimensions: Dimension[] = [];
  const tags: Tag[] = [];
  const notes: TextNote[] = [];
  for (const v of listViews()) {
    for (const d of getDimensions(v.id)) dimensions.push(d);
    for (const t of getTags(v.id)) tags.push(t);
    for (const n of getNotes(v.id)) notes.push(n);
  }
  return { dimensions, tags, notes, updatedAt: Date.now() };
}

export function deserializeAll(data: SerializedAnnotations | null | undefined): void {
  for (const v of listViews()) {
    setDimensions(v.id, []);
    setTags(v.id, []);
    setNotes(v.id, []);
  }
  if (!data) { emit(); return; }

  const dims = new Map<string, Dimension[]>();
  const tags = new Map<string, Tag[]>();
  const notes = new Map<string, TextNote[]>();

  for (const d of data.dimensions ?? []) {
    const arr = dims.get(d.viewId) ?? [];
    arr.push(d);
    dims.set(d.viewId, arr);
  }
  for (const t of data.tags ?? []) {
    const arr = tags.get(t.viewId) ?? [];
    arr.push(t);
    tags.set(t.viewId, arr);
  }
  for (const n of data.notes ?? []) {
    const arr = notes.get(n.viewId) ?? [];
    arr.push(n);
    notes.set(n.viewId, arr);
  }

  for (const [viewId, arr] of dims) setDimensions(viewId, arr);
  for (const [viewId, arr] of tags) setTags(viewId, arr);
  for (const [viewId, arr] of notes) setNotes(viewId, arr);

  emit();
}

export function saveToLocalStorage(): void {
  try {
    const data = serializeAll();
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[annotation-store] save failed", err);
  }
}

export function loadFromLocalStorage(): void {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as SerializedAnnotations;
    deserializeAll(parsed);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[annotation-store] load failed", err);
  }
}

export function deleteAnnotation(ref: AnnotationRef): boolean {
  switch (ref.kind) {
    case "dimension":
      removeDimension(ref.viewId, ref.id);
      break;
    case "tag":
      removeTag(ref.viewId, ref.id);
      break;
    case "note":
      removeNoteById(ref.viewId, ref.id);
      break;
  }
  if (selection && selection.kind === ref.kind && selection.id === ref.id) {
    selection = null;
  }
  saveToLocalStorage();
  emit();
  return true;
}

function removeNoteById(viewId: string, id: string): void {
  const arr = getNotes(viewId).filter((n) => n.id !== id);
  setNotes(viewId, arr);
}

export function bootAnnotationStore(): void {
  if (booted) return;
  booted = true;
  loadFromLocalStorage();
  onAnnotationChange(() => saveToLocalStorage());
  console.log("[annotation-store] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Dimension engine.
 *
 * A dimension in the model is a config object. This module turns it into a
 * concrete Scene2D: witness lines, dimension line, tick marks, and text.
 *
 * Every dimension references elements through the Reference system, so when
 * a wall moves the dimension re-resolves automatically. See references.ts.
 */

import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import { resolveReference } from "./references";
import type { Dimension, DimensionStyle } from "./annotations";
import { DEFAULT_DIM_STYLES } from "./annotations";
import type { SceneEntity } from "./scene";
import { paperToWorld } from "./scene";

export interface ResolvedDimension {
  entities: SceneEntity[];
  text: string;
  value: number;
  valid: boolean;
}

export function getDimensionStyle(dim: Dimension): DimensionStyle {
  return DEFAULT_DIM_STYLES.find((s) => s.id === dim.styleId) ?? DEFAULT_DIM_STYLES[0];
}

export function formatDimensionValue(meters: number, style: DimensionStyle): string {
  const factor = style.unit === "m" ? 1 : style.unit === "cm" ? 100 : 1000;
  const value = meters * factor;
  return value.toFixed(style.precision);
}

export function resolveDimension(
  dim: Dimension,
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[],
  viewScale: number,
): ResolvedDimension {
  const style = getDimensionStyle(dim);
  const p1 = resolveReference(dim.ref1, elements);

  if (!p1) {
    return { entities: [], text: "?", value: 0, valid: false };
  }

  // Single-point tools
  if (dim.kind === "spot-elevation" || dim.kind === "spot-coordinate") {
    return resolveSpot(dim, p1, style, viewScale);
  }

  const p2 = dim.ref2 ? resolveReference(dim.ref2, elements) : null;
  if (!p2) {
    return { entities: [], text: "?", value: 0, valid: false };
  }

  if (dim.kind === "angular") {
    return resolveAngular(dim, p1, p2, style, viewScale);
  }
  if (dim.kind === "radial" || dim.kind === "diameter") {
    return resolveRadial(dim, p1, p2, style, viewScale);
  }
  // aligned | linear | arc share the straight-line renderer
  return resolveLinear(dim, p1, p2, style, viewScale);
}

function resolveSpot(
  dim: Dimension,
  p: [number, number, number],
  style: DimensionStyle,
  viewScale: number,
): ResolvedDimension {
  const size = paperToWorld(style.textSizePt, viewScale);
  const leaderLen = paperToWorld(12, viewScale);
  const tickR = paperToWorld(1.2, viewScale);
  const entities: SceneEntity[] = [];

  entities.push({
    kind: "circle", cx: p[0], cz: p[2], r: tickR,
    stroke: { color: style.color, widthPt: 0.18, dash: null },
  });
  entities.push({
    kind: "line",
    x1: p[0], z1: p[2],
    x2: p[0], z2: p[2] + leaderLen,
    stroke: { color: style.color, widthPt: 0.18, dash: null },
  });

  const text = dim.override
    ?? (dim.kind === "spot-elevation"
      ? `EL ${formatDimensionValue(p[1], style)}`
      : `X ${formatDimensionValue(p[0], style)}  Z ${formatDimensionValue(p[2], style)}`);

  entities.push({
    kind: "text",
    x: p[0],
    z: p[2] + leaderLen + size,
    text,
    anchor: "middle",
    sizePt: style.textSizePt,
    rotation: 0,
    color: style.color,
  });

  return { entities, text, value: dim.kind === "spot-elevation" ? p[1] : 0, valid: true };
}

function resolveAngular(
  dim: Dimension,
  p1: [number, number, number],
  p2: [number, number, number],
  style: DimensionStyle,
  viewScale: number,
): ResolvedDimension {
  const vertex = dim.vertexRef
    ? resolveReference(dim.vertexRef, [])
    : null;
  const vx = vertex ? vertex[0] : (p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2;
  const vz = vertex ? vertex[2] : (p1[2] + p2[2]) / 2;

  const a1 = Math.atan2(p1[2] - vz, p1[0] - vx);
  const a2 = Math.atan2(p2[2] - vz, p2[0] - vx);
  let deg = Math.abs((a2 - a1) * 180 / Math.PI);
  if (deg > 180) deg = 360 - deg;

  const r = paperToWorld(14, viewScale);
  const arcPath: SceneEntity = {
    kind: "arc",
    cx: vx, cz: vz, r,
    a0: a1, a1: a2,
    stroke: { color: style.color, widthPt: 0.2, dash: null },
  };
  const text = dim.override ?? `${deg.toFixed(1)}\u00B0`;
  const mid = (a1 + a2) / 2;
  const tx = vx + Math.cos(mid) * (r + paperToWorld(3, viewScale));
  const tz = vz + Math.sin(mid) * (r + paperToWorld(3, viewScale));
  const textEntity: SceneEntity = {
    kind: "text",
    x: tx, z: tz,
    text,
    anchor: "middle",
    sizePt: style.textSizePt,
    rotation: 0,
    color: style.color,
  };

  return { entities: [arcPath, textEntity], text, value: deg, valid: true };
}

function resolveRadial(
  dim: Dimension,
  p1: [number, number, number],
  p2: [number, number, number],
  style: DimensionStyle,
  viewScale: number,
): ResolvedDimension {
  const dx = p2[0] - p1[0];
  const dz = p2[2] - p1[2];
  const r = Math.hypot(dx, dz);

  const entities: SceneEntity[] = [{
    kind: "line",
    x1: p1[0], z1: p1[2],
    x2: p2[0], z2: p2[2],
    stroke: { color: style.color, widthPt: 0.2, dash: null },
  }];

  const text = dim.override ?? (dim.kind === "radial"
    ? `R ${formatDimensionValue(r, style)}`
    : `\u00D8 ${formatDimensionValue(r * 2, style)}`);

  const mx = (p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2;
  const mz = (p1[2] + p2[2]) / 2;
  entities.push({
    kind: "text",
    x: mx, z: mz + paperToWorld(3, viewScale),
    text,
    anchor: "middle",
    sizePt: style.textSizePt,
    rotation: 0,
    color: style.color,
  });

  return { entities, text, value: r, valid: true };
}

function resolveLinear(
  dim: Dimension,
  p1: [number, number, number],
  p2: [number, number, number],
  style: DimensionStyle,
  viewScale: number,
): ResolvedDimension {
  // In 2D views the cut plane is Xâ€“Z. For plan, use X and Z directly. For
  // section, the generators map (along, Y) â†’ (x, z). The dimension engine is
  // view-agnostic â€” it works on the view's 2D coordinates, so the caller is
  // expected to have already swapped the reference to view coordinates when
  // it created the dimension.

  // Force horizontal or vertical for "linear"
  let x2 = p2[0];
  let z2 = p2[2];
  if (dim.kind === "linear") {
    if (Math.abs(x2 - p1[0]) >= Math.abs(z2 - p1[2])) z2 = p1[2];
    else x2 = p1[0];
  }

  const dx = x2 - p1[0];
  const dz = z2 - p1[2];
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L < 1e-9) {
    return { entities: [], text: "?", value: 0, valid: false };
  }

  const ux = dx / L;
  const uz = dz / L;
  const nx = -uz;
  const nz = ux;
  const off = paperToWorld(dim.offsetMm, viewScale);

  const a0x = p1[0] + nx * off;
  const a0z = p1[2] + nz * off;
  const a1x = x2 + nx * off;
  const a1z = z2 + nz * off;

  const stroke = { color: style.color, widthPt: 0.2, dash: null };
  const entities: SceneEntity[] = [];

  // Witness lines from each referenced point to the dim line
  entities.push({
    kind: "line",
    x1: p1[0], z1: p1[2],
    x2: a0x, z2: a0z,
    stroke,
  });
  entities.push({
    kind: "line",
    x1: x2, z1: z2,
    x2: a1x, z2: a1z,
    stroke,
  });

  // Dimension line
  entities.push({
    kind: "line",
    x1: a0x, z1: a0z,
    x2: a1x, z2: a1z,
    stroke,
  });

  // Tick marks at each end
  const tickLen = paperToWorld(2.5, viewScale);
  for (const [px, pz] of [[a0x, a0z], [a1x, a1z]] as Array<[number, number]>) {
    const t1x = px - ux * tickLen * 0.3 - nx * tickLen;
    const t1z = pz - uz * tickLen * 0.3 - nz * tickLen;
    const t2x = px + ux * tickLen * 0.3 + nx * tickLen;
    const t2z = pz + uz * tickLen * 0.3 + nz * tickLen;
    entities.push({
      kind: "line",
      x1: t1x, z1: t1z,
      x2: t2x, z2: t2z,
      stroke: { color: style.color, widthPt: 0.25, dash: null },
    });
  }

  const text = dim.override ?? formatDimensionValue(L, style);
  const mx = (a0x + a1x) / 2 + nx * paperToWorld(2, viewScale);
  const mz = (a0z + a1z) / 2 + nz * paperToWorld(2, viewScale);
  entities.push({
    kind: "text",
    x: mx, z: mz,
    text,
    anchor: "middle",
    sizePt: style.textSizePt,
    rotation: 0,
    color: style.color,
  });

  return { entities, text, value: L, valid: true };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Elevation view generator.
 *
 * Projects authored elements onto a horizontal viewing axis. Produces a
 * silhouette line drawing: each linear element becomes a rectangle outline,
 * each point element becomes a small box.
 */

import { getElements } from "../../../features/authoring";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../../projects/types";
import type { ViewDef } from "../types";
import type { Scene2D, SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../scene";
import { emptyScene } from "../scene";

const OUTLINE: StrokeStyle = { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.25, dash: null };

function axisForDir(dir: string): [number, number] {
  switch (dir) {
    case "north": return [1, 0];
    case "south": return [-1, 0];
    case "east":  return [0, 1];
    case "west":  return [0, -1];
    default:      return [1, 0];
  }
}

export async function generateElevationScene(def: ViewDef): Promise<Scene2D> {
  const scene = emptyScene();
  if (!def.elevation) return scene;

  const axis = axisForDir(def.elevation.direction);
  const elements = getElements();
  const xs: number[] = [];
  const zs: number[] = [];

  for (const el of elements) {
    const shapes = projectElement(el, axis);
    if (!shapes) continue;
    for (const s of shapes) {
      scene.layers.project.push(s);
      if (s.kind === "line") { xs.push(s.x1, s.x2); zs.push(s.z1, s.z2); }
      else if (s.kind === "polyline") { for (const [x, z] of s.points) { xs.push(x); zs.push(z); } }
    }
  }

  if (xs.length) {
    scene.bounds = {
      minX: Math.min(...xs), minZ: Math.min(...zs),
      maxX: Math.max(...xs), maxZ: Math.max(...zs),
    };
  }
  scene.generatedAt = Date.now();
  return scene;
}

function projectElement(el: AuthoredElement, axis: [number, number]): SceneEntity[] | null {
  const p = el.params;
  const out: SceneEntity[] = [];

  if (p.start && p.end) {
    const uA = p.start[0] * axis[0] + p.start[1] * axis[1];
    const uB = p.end[0] * axis[0] + p.end[1] * axis[1];
    const y0 = p.elevation;
    const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
    out.push({
      kind: "polyline", closed: true,
      points: [[uA, y0], [uB, y0], [uB, y1], [uA, y1]],
      stroke: OUTLINE,
    });
  } else if (p.point) {
    const uC = p.point[0] * axis[0] + p.point[1] * axis[1];
    const w = (p.thickness ?? 0.3) / 2;
    const y0 = p.elevation;
    const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
    out.push({
      kind: "polyline", closed: true,
      points: [[uC - w, y0], [uC + w, y0], [uC + w, y1], [uC - w, y1]],
      stroke: OUTLINE,
    });
  } else if (p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 3) {
    const us = p.polygon.map(([x, z]) => x * axis[0] + z * axis[1]);
    const u0 = Math.min(...us);
    const u1 = Math.max(...us);
    const y0 = p.elevation;
    const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
    out.push({
      kind: "polyline", closed: true,
      points: [[u0, y0], [u1, y0], [u1, y1], [u0, y1]],
      stroke: OUTLINE,
    });
  }

  return out.length ? out : null;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Plan view generator â€” wraps the existing plan-generator.ts and adapts
 * its PlanView output to the general Scene2D format.
 */

import { generatePlanView } from "../../drawings/plan-generator";
import type { PlanView } from "../../drawings/plan-types";
import type { ViewDef } from "../types";
import type { Scene2D, SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../scene";
import { emptyScene } from "../scene";

function stroke(color: string, widthPt: number, dash: number[] | null = null): StrokeStyle {
  return { color, widthPt, dash };
}

const STYLE = {
  cut:      stroke("#111827", 0.35, null),
  overhead: stroke("#6b7280", 0.18, [1.2, 0.8]),
  below:    stroke("#9ca3af", 0.15, [0.6, 0.8]),
  grid:     stroke("#b91c1c", 0.20, [3, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6]),
};

export async function generatePlanScene(def: ViewDef): Promise<Scene2D> {
  if (!def.plan) return emptyScene();

  const planView: PlanView = await generatePlanView({
    levelName: def.name,
    levelElevation: def.plan.levelElevation,
    cutHeight: def.plan.cutHeight,
    cutDepth: def.plan.bottomDepth,
    viewRangeTop: def.plan.topHeight,
    viewRangeBottom: def.plan.bottomDepth,
    viewDepth: def.plan.viewDepth,
    includeOverhead: true,
    includeBelow: true,
    maxSegments: 250_000,
  });

  const scene = emptyScene();
  scene.bounds = {
    minX: planView.bounds.minX,
    minZ: planView.bounds.minZ,
    maxX: planView.bounds.maxX,
    maxZ: planView.bounds.maxZ,
  };

  for (const seg of planView.segments) {
    const style = (STYLE as any)[seg.kind] ?? STYLE.cut;
    const entity: SceneEntity = {
      kind: "line", x1: seg.x1, z1: seg.z1, x2: seg.x2, z2: seg.z2, stroke: style,
    };
    if (seg.kind === "grid") scene.layers.grid.push(entity);
    else if (seg.kind === "overhead") scene.layers.overhead.push(entity);
    else if (seg.kind === "below") scene.layers.below.push(entity);
    else scene.layers.cut.push(entity);
  }

  for (const arc of planView.arcs) {
    scene.layers.cut.push({
      kind: "arc", cx: arc.cx, cz: arc.cz, r: arc.r, a0: arc.start, a1: arc.end, stroke: STYLE.cut,
    });
  }

  for (const t of planView.texts) {
    scene.layers.symbols.push({
      kind: "text",
      x: t.x, z: t.z,
      text: t.text,
      anchor: t.anchor ?? "middle",
      sizePt: (t.size ?? 0.4) * 10,
      rotation: t.rotation ?? 0,
      color: t.kind === "grid" ? "#a04a4a" : "#1a1a1a",
    });
  }

  scene.generatedAt = Date.now();
  return scene;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Section view generator â€” analytic vertical cut.
 *
 *   section-2D X = distance along the cut line
 *   section-2D Z = world Y (elevation)
 */

import { getElements } from "../../../features/authoring";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../../projects/types";
import type { ViewDef } from "../types";
import type { Scene2D, SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../scene";
import { emptyScene } from "../scene";

const CUT_STYLE: StrokeStyle = { color: "#111827", widthPt: 0.5, dash: null };
const PROJECT_STYLE: StrokeStyle = { color: "#6b7280", widthPt: 0.2, dash: null };

interface CutPlane {
  origin: [number, number];
  dir: [number, number];
  normal: [number, number];
}

function makePlane(cut: NonNullable<ViewDef["section"]>): CutPlane {
  const { x1, z1, x2, z2 } = cut.cutLine;
  const dx = x2 - x1;
  const dz = z2 - z1;
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
  const dir: [number, number] = [dx / L, dz / L];
  let normal: [number, number] = [-dir[1], dir[0]];
  if (cut.lookDir === "left") normal = [-normal[0], -normal[1]];
  return { origin: [x1, z1], dir, normal };
}

function alongCut(plane: CutPlane, px: number, pz: number): number {
  return (px - plane.origin[0]) * plane.dir[0] + (pz - plane.origin[1]) * plane.dir[1];
}

function signedDist(plane: CutPlane, px: number, pz: number): number {
  return (px - plane.origin[0]) * plane.normal[0] + (pz - plane.origin[1]) * plane.normal[1];
}

export async function generateSectionScene(def: ViewDef): Promise<Scene2D> {
  const scene = emptyScene();
  if (!def.section) return scene;

  const plane = makePlane(def.section);
  const elements = getElements();
  const allX: number[] = [];
  const allZ: number[] = [];

  for (const el of elements) {
    const slice = cutElement(el, plane);
    if (slice) {
      for (const e of slice) { scene.layers.cut.push(e); updateBoundsFromEntity(e, allX, allZ); }
    }
    const projection = projectElement(el, plane, def.section);
    if (projection) {
      for (const e of projection) { scene.layers.project.push(e); updateBoundsFromEntity(e, allX, allZ); }
    }
  }

  if (allX.length) {
    scene.bounds = {
      minX: Math.min(...allX), minZ: Math.min(...allZ),
      maxX: Math.max(...allX), maxZ: Math.max(...allZ),
    };
  }
  scene.generatedAt = Date.now();
  return scene;
}

function cutElement(el: AuthoredElement, plane: CutPlane): SceneEntity[] | null {
  const p = el.params;

  if (p.start && p.end) {
    const [ax, az] = p.start;
    const [bx, bz] = p.end;
    const dA = signedDist(plane, ax, az);
    const dB = signedDist(plane, bx, bz);
    if (Math.sign(dA) !== Math.sign(dB) || Math.abs(dA) < 1e-6 || Math.abs(dB) < 1e-6) {
      const t = dA / (dA - dB);
      const cx = ax + (bx - ax) * t;
      const cz = az + (bz - az) * t;
      const x = alongCut(plane, cx, cz);
      const y0 = p.elevation;
      const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
      const w = (p.thickness ?? 0.2) / 2;
      return [{
        kind: "polyline", closed: true,
        points: [[x - w, y0], [x + w, y0], [x + w, y1], [x - w, y1]],
        stroke: CUT_STYLE,
        fill: { color: "#cbd5e1", opacity: 0.6 },
      }];
    }
    return null;
  }

  if (p.point) {
    const [px, pz] = p.point;
    const d = signedDist(plane, px, pz);
    const w = (p.thickness ?? 0.3) / 2;
    if (Math.abs(d) > w) return null;
    const x = alongCut(plane, px, pz);
    const y0 = p.elevation;
    const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
    const halfW = (p.depth ?? p.thickness ?? 0.3) / 2;
    return [{
      kind: "polyline", closed: true,
      points: [[x - halfW, y0], [x + halfW, y0], [x + halfW, y1], [x - halfW, y1]],
      stroke: CUT_STYLE,
      fill: { color: "#cbd5e1", opacity: 0.6 },
    }];
  }

  if (p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 3) {
    const crossings: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < p.polygon.length; i++) {
      const a = p.polygon[i];
      const b = p.polygon[(i + 1) % p.polygon.length];
      const dA = signedDist(plane, a[0], a[1]);
      const dB = signedDist(plane, b[0], b[1]);
      if (Math.sign(dA) !== Math.sign(dB)) {
        const t = dA / (dA - dB);
        const cx = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t;
        const cz = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t;
        crossings.push(alongCut(plane, cx, cz));
      }
    }
    if (crossings.length >= 2) {
      const x0 = Math.min(...crossings);
      const x1 = Math.max(...crossings);
      const y0 = p.elevation;
      const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
      return [{
        kind: "polyline", closed: true,
        points: [[x0, y0], [x1, y0], [x1, y1], [x0, y1]],
        stroke: CUT_STYLE,
        fill: { color: "#94a3b8", opacity: 0.6 },
      }];
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function projectElement(
  el: AuthoredElement, plane: CutPlane, cfg: NonNullable<ViewDef["section"]>,
): SceneEntity[] | null {
  const p = el.params;
  const out: SceneEntity[] = [];
  if (p.start && p.end) {
    const [ax, az] = p.start;
    const [bx, bz] = p.end;
    const dA = signedDist(plane, ax, az);
    const dB = signedDist(plane, bx, bz);
    if (dA > 0 && dB > 0 && dA <= cfg.farClip && dB <= cfg.farClip) {
      const x0 = alongCut(plane, ax, az);
      const x1 = alongCut(plane, bx, bz);
      const y0 = p.elevation;
      const y1 = p.elevation + p.height;
      out.push({ kind: "line", x1: x0, z1: y0, x2: x0, z2: y1, stroke: PROJECT_STYLE });
      out.push({ kind: "line", x1: x1, z1: y0, x2: x1, z2: y1, stroke: PROJECT_STYLE });
    }
  }
  return out.length ? out : null;
}

function updateBoundsFromEntity(e: SceneEntity, xs: number[], zs: number[]): void {
  if (e.kind === "line") { xs.push(e.x1, e.x2); zs.push(e.z1, e.z2); }
  else if (e.kind === "polyline") { for (const [x, z] of e.points) { xs.push(x); zs.push(z); } }
  else if (e.kind === "arc") { xs.push(e.cx - e.r, e.cx + e.r); zs.push(e.cz - e.r, e.cz + e.r); }
  else if (e.kind === "circle") { xs.push(e.cx - e.r, e.cx + e.r); zs.push(e.cz - e.r, e.cz + e.r); }
  else if (e.kind === "text" || e.kind === "symbol") { xs.push(e.x); zs.push(e.z); }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Hit-testing in the 2D view plane.
 *
 * Given a world-space 2D point (x, z), find the nearest reference-able
 * feature of any element: an endpoint, the center axis, or a face offset.
 * Returns a Reference (see references.ts) or null.
 *
 * Called from the interaction tools. Never called during rendering.
 */

import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import { makeReference, type Reference } from "./references";

export interface PickOptions {
  /** Maximum distance in world metres. */
  tolerance: number;
  /** Which feature kinds to allow. Default: all. */
  kinds?: Array<"endpoint" | "center" | "face">;
}

export function pickReference(
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[],
  x: number,
  z: number,
  opts: PickOptions,
): Reference | null {
  const allowed = new Set(opts.kinds ?? ["endpoint", "center", "face"]);
  const tol = Math.max(0.01, opts.tolerance);

  let best: { ref: Reference; dist: number } | null = null;
  const consider = (ref: Reference, dist: number) => {
    if (dist <= tol && (!best || dist < best.dist)) best = { ref, dist };
  };

  for (const el of elements) {
    const p = el.params;

    if (p.start && p.end) {
      const [ax, az] = p.start;
      const [bx, bz] = p.end;

      if (allowed.has("endpoint")) {
        consider(
          makeReference("element-endpoint", el.id, { endpointIndex: 0 }),
          Math.hypot(x - ax, z - az),
        );
        consider(
          makeReference("element-endpoint", el.id, { endpointIndex: 1 }),
          Math.hypot(x - bx, z - bz),
        );
      }

      const cx = (ax + bx) / 2;
      const cz = (az + bz) / 2;

      if (allowed.has("center")) {
        consider(makeReference("element-center", el.id), Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz));
      }

      if (allowed.has("face")) {
        const dx = bx - ax;
        const dz = bz - az;
        const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        const nx = -dz / L;
        const nz = dx / L;
        const half = (p.thickness ?? 0.2) / 2;
        for (let side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
          const sign = side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
          const fx = cx + nx * half * sign;
          const fz = cz + nz * half * sign;
          consider(
            makeReference("element-face", el.id, { faceIndex: side }),
            Math.hypot(x - fx, z - fz),
          );
        }
      }
    } else if (p.point) {
      if (allowed.has("center")) {
        consider(
          makeReference("element-center", el.id),
          Math.hypot(x - p.point[0], z - p.point[1]),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return best ? (best as { ref: Reference }).ref : null;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Plan-view snap feature detection.
 *
 * Given a cursor position in plan (world) coordinates, find the nearest
 * meaningful feature of any authored element:
 *
 *   endpoint     - a linear element's start or end
 *   corner       - two elements meeting at their endpoints
 *   intersection - two linear elements crossing in X-shape
 *   midpoint     - the middle of a linear element
 *   center       - the center point of a point element
 *   face         - a surface offset from the wall centerline
 *   nearest      - the closest point on any linear element
 *
 * Priority-ordered like Revit: Endpoint (100) > Intersection (95) >
 * Corner (92) > Midpoint (90) > Center (85) > Face (60) > Nearest (50).
 */

import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import type { PlanDimensionRef } from "../../features/plan-view-panel";

export type PlanSnapKind =
  | "endpoint" | "corner" | "intersection" | "midpoint"
  | "center" | "face" | "nearest";

export interface PlanSnapHit {
  x: number;
  z: number;
  kind: PlanSnapKind;
  label: string;
  color: string;
  priority: number;
  ref?: PlanDimensionRef;
  distance: number;
}

const PRIORITY: Record<PlanSnapKind, number> = {
  endpoint:     100,
  intersection:  95,
  corner:        92,
  midpoint:      90,
  center:        85,
  face:          60,
  nearest:       50,
};

const LABEL: Record<PlanSnapKind, string> = {
  endpoint:     "Endpoint",
  intersection: "Intersection",
  corner:       "Corner",
  midpoint:     "Midpoint",
  center:       "Center",
  face:         "Face",
  nearest:      "Nearest",
};

const COLOR: Record<PlanSnapKind, string> = {
  endpoint:     "#F59E0B",
  intersection: "#EF4444",
  corner:       "#FBBF24",
  midpoint:     "#22C55E",
  center:       "#38BDF8",
  face:         "#38BDF8",
  nearest:      "#F59E0B",
};

interface Seg {
  id: string;
  ax: number; az: number;
  bx: number; bz: number;
  thick: number;
  tMid: number;
}

function linearSegments(elements: readonly AuthoredElement[]): Seg[] {
  const out: Seg[] = [];
  for (const el of elements) {
    const p = el.params;
    if (p.start && p.end) {
      out.push({
        id: el.id,
        ax: p.start[0], az: p.start[1],
        bx: p.end[0], bz: p.end[1],
        thick: p.thickness ?? 0.2,
        tMid: 0.5,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

interface Pt { x: number; z: number; d: number; }

function segEndpoints(s: Seg): Pt[] {
  return [
    { x: s.ax, z: s.az, d: 0 },
    { x: s.bx, z: s.bz, d: 0 },
  ];
}

function distanceToSegment(px: number, pz: number, s: Seg): { x: number; z: number; d: number; t: number } {
  const dx = s.bx - s.ax;
  const dz = s.bz - s.az;
  const L2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
  let t = ((px - s.ax) * dx + (pz - s.az) * dz) / L2;
  t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  const x = s.ax + t * dx;
  const z = s.az + t * dz;
  return { x, z, d: Math.hypot(px - x, pz - z), t };
}

/** 2D segment-segment intersection. Returns null if parallel or out of range. */
function intersectSegments(
  a1x: number, a1z: number, a2x: number, a2z: number,
  b1x: number, b1z: number, b2x: number, b2z: number,
): { x: number; z: number } | null {
  const rx = a2x - a1x;
  const rz = a2z - a1z;
  const sx = b2x - b1x;
  const sz = b2z - b1z;
  const denom = rx * sz - rz * sx;
  if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-9) return null;
  const qpx = b1x - a1x;
  const qpz = b1z - a1z;
  const t = (qpx * sz - qpz * sx) / denom;
  const u = (qpx * rz - qpz * rx) / denom;
  if (t < 0 || t > 1 || u < 0 || u > 1) return null;
  return { x: a1x + rx * t, z: a1z + rz * t };
}

/** Nearest corner: two linear elements whose endpoints coincide. */
function findCorner(elements: AuthoredElement[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  const segs = linearSegments(elements);
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < segs.length; j++) {
      const a = segs[i];
      const b = segs[j];
      const aEnds: [number, number, number][] = [[a.ax, a.az, 0], [a.bx, a.bz, 1]];
      const bEnds: [number, number, number][] = [[b.ax, b.az, 0], [b.bx, b.bz, 1]];
      for (const ae of aEnds) {
        for (const be of bEnds) {
          const d = Math.hypot(ae[0] - be[0], ae[1] - be[1]);
          if (d > 0.05) continue;   // not coincident
          const dist = Math.hypot(px - ae[0], pz - ae[1]);
          if (dist > tol) continue;
          if (!best || dist < best.distance) {
            best = {
              x: ae[0], z: ae[1],
              kind: "corner",
              label: LABEL.corner,
              color: COLOR.corner,
              priority: PRIORITY.corner,
              distance: dist,
              ref: { kind: "static-boundary", x: ae[0], z: ae[1] },
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/** Nearest intersection: two linear elements crossing. */
function findIntersection(elements: AuthoredElement[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  const segs = linearSegments(elements);
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < segs.length; j++) {
      const a = segs[i];
      const b = segs[j];
      const hit = intersectSegments(a.ax, a.az, a.bx, a.bz, b.ax, b.az, b.bx, b.bz);
      if (!hit) continue;
      const dist = Math.hypot(px - hit.x, pz - hit.z);
      if (dist > tol) continue;
      if (!best || dist < best.distance) {
        best = {
          x: hit.x, z: hit.z,
          kind: "intersection",
          label: LABEL.intersection,
          color: COLOR.intersection,
          priority: PRIORITY.intersection,
          distance: dist,
          ref: { kind: "static-boundary", x: hit.x, z: hit.z },
        };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/** Nearest endpoint of any linear element. */
function findEndpoint(segs: Seg[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (const s of segs) {
    const ends: [number, number, "start" | "end"][] = [[s.ax, s.az, "start"], [s.bx, s.bz, "end"]];
    for (const [x, z, side] of ends) {
      const d = Math.hypot(px - x, pz - z);
      if (d > tol) continue;
      if (!best || d < best.distance) {
        best = {
          x, z,
          kind: "endpoint",
          label: LABEL.endpoint,
          color: COLOR.endpoint,
          priority: PRIORITY.endpoint,
          distance: d,
          ref: { kind: "linear-cap", elementId: s.id, side, t: side === "start" ? 0 : 1, n: 0 },
        };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/** Nearest midpoint of any linear element. */
function findMidpoint(segs: Seg[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (const s of segs) {
    const mx = (s.ax + s.bx) / 2;
    const mz = (s.az + s.bz) / 2;
    const d = Math.hypot(px - mx, pz - mz);
    if (d > tol) continue;
    if (!best || d < best.distance) {
      best = {
        x: mx, z: mz,
        kind: "midpoint",
        label: LABEL.midpoint,
        color: COLOR.midpoint,
        priority: PRIORITY.midpoint,
        distance: d,
        ref: { kind: "static-boundary", x: mx, z: mz, elementId: s.id },
      };
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/** Nearest point element center (columns, footings). */
function findCenter(elements: AuthoredElement[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (const el of elements) {
    const p = el.params;
    if (!p.point) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(px - p.point[0], pz - p.point[1]);
    if (d > tol) continue;
    if (!best || d < best.distance) {
      best = {
        x: p.point[0], z: p.point[1],
        kind: "center",
        label: LABEL.center,
        color: COLOR.center,
        priority: PRIORITY.center,
        distance: d,
        ref: { kind: "static-boundary", x: p.point[0], z: p.point[1], elementId: el.id },
      };
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/** Nearest wall/MEP face (offset from centerline). */
function findFace(segs: Seg[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (const s of segs) {
    const dx = s.bx - s.ax;
    const dz = s.bz - s.az;
    const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    const nx = -dz / L;
    const nz = dx / L;
    const half = Math.max(0.02, s.thick / 2);
    const proj = distanceToSegment(px, pz, s);
    const sideT = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, proj.t));
    const cx = s.ax + dx * sideT;
    const cz = s.az + dz * sideT;
    for (const sign of [1, -1]) {
      const fx = cx + nx * half * sign;
      const fz = cz + nz * half * sign;
      const d = Math.hypot(px - fx, pz - fz);
      if (d > tol) continue;
      if (!best || d < best.distance) {
        best = {
          x: fx, z: fz,
          kind: "face",
          label: LABEL.face,
          color: COLOR.face,
          priority: PRIORITY.face,
          distance: d,
          ref: {
            kind: "linear-side", elementId: s.id, t: sideT,
            side: sign > 0 ? "left" : "right",
          },
        };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/** Nearest point on any linear element (fallback). */
function findNearest(segs: Seg[], px: number, pz: number, tol: number): PlanSnapHit | null {
  let best: PlanSnapHit | null = null;
  for (const s of segs) {
    const proj = distanceToSegment(px, pz, s);
    if (proj.d > tol) continue;
    if (!best || proj.d < best.distance) {
      best = {
        x: proj.x, z: proj.z,
        kind: "nearest",
        label: LABEL.nearest,
        color: COLOR.nearest,
        priority: PRIORITY.nearest,
        distance: proj.d,
        ref: { kind: "linear-side", elementId: s.id, t: proj.t, side: "left" },
      };
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/**
 * Find the best snap at a cursor position in world coordinates.
 *
 * @param elements  Authored elements to scan
 * @param px        Cursor X in world metres
 * @param pz        Cursor Z in world metres
 * @param tolerance Distance in world metres
 */
/**
 * Filter segments to those whose AABB overlaps the cursor plus `pad`.
 * This is the difference between O(n^2) and instant response.
 */
function segmentsNearCursor(
  segs: Seg[],
  px: number, pz: number,
  pad: number,
): Seg[] {
  const out: Seg[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    const s = segs[i];
    const minX = (s.ax < s.bx ? s.ax : s.bx) - pad;
    const maxX = (s.ax > s.bx ? s.ax : s.bx) + pad;
    const minZ = (s.az < s.bz ? s.az : s.bz) - pad;
    const maxZ = (s.az > s.bz ? s.az : s.bz) + pad;
    if (px >= minX && px <= maxX && pz >= minZ && pz <= maxZ) out.push(s);
  }
  return out;
}

function pointsNearCursor(
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[],
  px: number, pz: number,
  pad: number,
): AuthoredElement[] {
  const out: AuthoredElement[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
    const el = elements[i];
    const p = el.params;
    if (!p.point) continue;
    const dx = p.point[0] - px;
    const dz = p.point[1] - pz;
    if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= pad * pad) out.push(el);
  }
  return out;
}
export function findPlanSnap(
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[],
  px: number,
  pz: number,
  tolerance: number,
): PlanSnapHit | null {
  const allSegs = linearSegments(elements);
  const pad = tolerance + 1;

  // Narrow down to features near the cursor BEFORE any O(n^2) work.
  const segs = segmentsNearCursor(allSegs, px, pz, pad);
  const nearPointEls = pointsNearCursor(elements, px, pz, pad);

  // Fast exit if nothing is nearby.
  if (segs.length === 0 && nearPointEls.length === 0) return null;

  // 1. Endpoint - highest priority, short-circuits everything else.
  const ep = findEndpoint(segs, px, pz, tolerance);
  if (ep) return ep;

  // 2. Intersection - only over the (small) nearby set.
  if (segs.length > 1) {
    const x = findIntersection(segsAsElements(segs), px, pz, tolerance);
    if (x) return x;
  }

  // 3. Corner - only over the (small) nearby set.
  if (segs.length > 1) {
    const c = findCorner(segsAsElements(segs), px, pz, tolerance);
    if (c) return c;
  }

  // 4. Midpoint
  const mid = findMidpoint(segs, px, pz, tolerance);
  if (mid) return mid;

  // 5. Center
  if (nearPointEls.length) {
    const cen = findCenter(nearPointEls, px, pz, tolerance);
    if (cen) return cen;
  }

  // 6. Face
  const face = findFace(segs, px, pz, tolerance);
  if (face) return face;

  // 7. Nearest - fallback.
  return findNearest(segs, px, pz, tolerance);
}

/**
 * Adapt a Seg[] back into the minimal AuthoredElement[] shape that
 * findIntersection / findCorner expect. Cheap - no allocation of the
 * full element, just the fields they read.
 */
function segsAsElements(segs: Seg[]): AuthoredElement[] {
  const out: AuthoredElement[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    const s = segs[i];
    out.push({
      id: s.id,
      type: "wall",
      name: "",
      params: {
        start: [s.ax, s.az],
        end: [s.bx, s.bz],
        height: 0,
        thickness: s.thick,
        elevation: 0,
      },
    } as unknown as AuthoredElement);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Return an SVG string for the snap marker at the given paper size (mm).
 * Coordinates are centered at 0,0; caller wraps in a <g transform="translate(...)">.
 */
export function snapSvgMarkup(kind: PlanSnapKind, paperSize: number): string {
  const s = paperSize;
  const h = s / 2;
  const sw = Math.max(0.15, paperSize * 0.12);
  switch (kind) {
    case "endpoint":
      return '<rect x="' + (-h) + '" y="' + (-h) + '" width="' + s + '" height="' + s + '" fill="#F59E0B" stroke="#0B0D12" stroke-width="' + sw + '"/>';
    case "intersection":
      return '<path d="M' + (-h) + ' ' + (-h) + ' L' + h + ' ' + h + ' M' + h + ' ' + (-h) + ' L' + (-h) + ' ' + h + '" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="' + (sw * 1.6) + '" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
    case "corner":
      return '<path d="M' + (-h) + ' ' + (-h) + ' L' + (-h) + ' ' + h + ' L' + h + ' ' + h + '" stroke="#FBBF24" stroke-width="' + (sw * 1.6) + '" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="' + (-h) + '" cy="' + (-h) + '" r="' + (paperSize * 0.16) + '" fill="#FBBF24"/>';
    case "midpoint":
      return '<polygon points="0,' + (-h) + ' ' + h + ',' + h + ' ' + (-h) + ',' + h + '" fill="#22C55E" stroke="#0B0D12" stroke-width="' + sw + '"/>';
    case "center":
      return '<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="' + h + '" fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="' + (sw * 1.5) + '"/><circle cx="0" cy="0" r="' + (paperSize * 0.13) + '" fill="#38BDF8"/>';
    case "face":
      return '<rect x="' + (-h) + '" y="' + (-h) + '" width="' + s + '" height="' + s + '" fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="' + (sw * 1.5) + '"/><circle cx="0" cy="0" r="' + (paperSize * 0.14) + '" fill="#38BDF8"/>';
    case "nearest":
    default:
      return '<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="' + (h * 0.65) + '" fill="#F59E0B" stroke="#0B0D12" stroke-width="' + (sw * 0.7) + '"/>';
  }
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/views/references.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Reference system â€” the thing that makes Revit dimensions follow walls.
 *
 * A Reference is an abstract pointer to a *feature* of an element:
 *   "the exterior face of Wall-4A"
 *   "the center axis of Column-C3"
 *   "the left end of Beam-B2"
 *
 * Dimensions and tags attach to References, not to coordinates. When the
 * element moves, the reference re-resolves and the annotation follows.
 */

import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";

export type ReferenceKind =
  | "element-face"
  | "element-axis"
  | "element-endpoint"
  | "element-center"
  | "grid"
  | "level"
  | "work-plane"
  | "hosted"
  | "opening";

export interface Reference {
  id: string;
  kind: ReferenceKind;
  elementId: string;
  faceIndex?: number;
  endpointIndex?: 0 | 1;
  side?: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom";
  feature?: string;
  cachedPosition?: [number, number, number];
  cachedDirection?: [number, number, number];
  valid: boolean;
}

let seq = 0;
export function makeReference(
  kind: ReferenceKind,
  elementId: string,
  extra: Partial<Reference> = {},
): Reference {
  seq += 1;
  return {
    id: `ref-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${seq}`,
    kind,
    elementId,
    valid: false,
    ...extra,
  };
}

export function resolveReference(
  ref: Reference,
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[],
): [number, number, number] | null {
  const el = elements.find((e) => e.id === ref.elementId);
  if (!el) {
    ref.valid = false;
    return null;
  }
  const p = el.params;

  if (ref.kind === "element-endpoint" && p.start && p.end) {
    const pt = ref.endpointIndex === 0 ? p.start : p.end;
    return [pt[0], p.elevation, pt[1]];
  }
  if (ref.kind === "element-center") {
    if (p.start && p.end) return [(p.start[0] + p.end[0]) / 2, p.elevation, (p.start[1] + p.end[1]) / 2];
    if (p.point) return [p.point[0], p.elevation, p.point[1]];
  }
  if (ref.kind === "element-axis") {
    if (p.start && p.end) return [(p.start[0] + p.end[0]) / 2, p.elevation, (p.start[1] + p.end[1]) / 2];
    if (p.point) return [p.point[0], p.elevation, p.point[1]];
  }
  if (ref.kind === "element-face" && p.start && p.end) {
    const dx = p.end[0] - p.start[0];
    const dz = p.end[1] - p.start[1];
    const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    const nx = -dz / L;
    const nz = dx / L;
    const half = (p.thickness ?? 0.2) / 2;
    const side = (ref.faceIndex ?? 0) === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const mx = (p.start[0] + p.end[0]) / 2;
    const mz = (p.start[1] + p.end[1]) / 2;
    return [mx + nx * half * side, p.elevation, mz + nz * half * side];
  }
  return null;
}

export function invalidateReferences(refs: Reference[]): void {
  for (const r of refs) {
    r.cachedPosition = undefined;
    r.cachedDirection = undefined;
    r.valid = false;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * SVG renderer for Scene2D.
 */

import type { Scene2D, SceneEntity, StrokeStyle } from "../scene";
import { paperToWorld } from "../scene";

const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

export interface SvgRenderOptions {
  scale: number;
  padding: number;
  widthPx: number;
  heightPx: number;
}

export function renderSceneToSvg(scene: Scene2D, opts: SvgRenderOptions): SVGSVGElement {
  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("xmlns", SVG_NS);
  svg.setAttribute("width", String(opts.widthPx));
  svg.setAttribute("height", String(opts.heightPx));

  const pad = opts.padding;
  const vbMinX = scene.bounds.minX - pad;
  const vbMinY = -(scene.bounds.maxZ + pad);
  const vbW = (scene.bounds.maxX - scene.bounds.minX) + 2 * pad;
  const vbH = (scene.bounds.maxZ - scene.bounds.minZ) + 2 * pad;
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `${vbMinX} ${vbMinY} ${vbW} ${vbH}`);

  const order: Array<[string, SceneEntity[]]> = [
    ["below", scene.layers.below],
    ["grid", scene.layers.grid],
    ["project", scene.layers.project],
    ["overhead", scene.layers.overhead],
    ["cut", scene.layers.cut],
    ["symbols", scene.layers.symbols],
    ["annotation", scene.layers.annotation],
  ];

  for (const [name, entities] of order) {
    const g = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "g");
    g.setAttribute("data-layer", name);
    for (const e of entities) drawEntity(g, e, opts.scale);
    svg.appendChild(g);
  }

  return svg;
}

function drawEntity(parent: SVGGElement, e: SceneEntity, viewScale: number): void {
  switch (e.kind) {
    case "line": {
      const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "line");
      el.setAttribute("x1", String(e.x1));
      el.setAttribute("y1", String(-e.z1));
      el.setAttribute("x2", String(e.x2));
      el.setAttribute("y2", String(-e.z2));
      applyStroke(el, e.stroke, viewScale);
      parent.appendChild(el);
      break;
    }
    case "polyline": {
      const d = e.points.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${p[0]} ${-p[1]}`).join(" ") + (e.closed ? " Z" : "");
      const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "path");
      el.setAttribute("d", d);
      if (e.fill) {
        el.setAttribute("fill", e.fill.color);
        el.setAttribute("fill-opacity", String(e.fill.opacity));
      } else el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      applyStroke(el, e.stroke, viewScale);
      parent.appendChild(el);
      break;
    }
    case "arc": {
      const cx = e.cx;
      const cy = -e.cz;
      const r = e.r;
      const x0 = cx + Math.cos(e.a0) * r;
      const y0 = cy - Math.sin(e.a0) * r;
      const x1 = cx + Math.cos(e.a1) * r;
      const y1 = cy - Math.sin(e.a1) * r;
      const large = Math.abs(e.a1 - e.a0) > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
      const sweep = e.a1 > e.a0 ? 0 : 1;
      const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "path");
      el.setAttribute("d", `M ${x0} ${y0} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${large} ${sweep} ${x1} ${y1}`);
      el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      applyStroke(el, e.stroke, viewScale);
      parent.appendChild(el);
      break;
    }
    case "circle": {
      const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "circle");
      el.setAttribute("cx", String(e.cx));
      el.setAttribute("cy", String(-e.cz));
      el.setAttribute("r", String(e.r));
      el.setAttribute("fill", e.fill ? e.fill.color : "none");
      if (e.fill) el.setAttribute("fill-opacity", String(e.fill.opacity));
      applyStroke(el, e.stroke, viewScale);
      parent.appendChild(el);
      break;
    }
    case "text": {
      const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "text");
      el.setAttribute("x", String(e.x));
      el.setAttribute("y", String(-e.z));
      el.setAttribute("text-anchor", e.anchor);
      el.setAttribute("dominant-baseline", "middle");
      el.setAttribute("fill", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("font-family", "Arial, system-ui, sans-serif");
      el.setAttribute("font-size", String(paperToWorld(e.sizePt, viewScale)));
      if (e.rotation) el.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${e.rotation} ${e.x} ${-e.z})`);
      el.textContent = e.text;
      parent.appendChild(el);
      break;
    }
    default:
      break;
  }
}

function applyStroke(el: SVGElement, stroke: StrokeStyle, viewScale: number): void {
  el.setAttribute("stroke", stroke.color);
  el.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(paperToWorld(stroke.widthPt, viewScale)));
  el.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
  el.setAttribute("stroke-linejoin", "round");
  if (stroke.dash) {
    el.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", stroke.dash.map((d) => paperToWorld(d, viewScale)).join(" "));
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Scene2D â€” renderer-agnostic description of a 2D view.
 *
 * Every view generator produces a Scene2D. Every renderer consumes one.
 * Units are world metres. Stroke widths are paper points â€” converted to
 * world units by paperToWorld() at render time.
 */

export interface StrokeStyle {
  color: string;
  widthPt: number;
  dash: number[] | null;
}

export interface FillStyle {
  color: string;
  opacity: number;
}

export type SceneEntity =
  | { kind: "line"; x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number; stroke: StrokeStyle }
  | { kind: "polyline"; points: Array<[number, number]>; closed: boolean; stroke: StrokeStyle; fill?: FillStyle }
  | { kind: "arc"; cx: number; cz: number; r: number; a0: number; a1: number; stroke: StrokeStyle }
  | { kind: "circle"; cx: number; cz: number; r: number; stroke: StrokeStyle; fill?: FillStyle }
  | { kind: "text"; x: number; z: number; text: string; anchor: "start" | "middle" | "end"; sizePt: number; rotation: number; color: string }
  | { kind: "symbol"; x: number; z: number; name: string; size: number; rotation: number }
  | { kind: "hatch"; polygon: Array<[number, number]>; pattern: string; color: string; scale: number };

export interface SceneLayer {
  cut: SceneEntity[];
  project: SceneEntity[];
  overhead: SceneEntity[];
  below: SceneEntity[];
  grid: SceneEntity[];
  annotation: SceneEntity[];
  symbols: SceneEntity[];
}

export interface Scene2D {
  bounds: { minX: number; minZ: number; maxX: number; maxZ: number };
  layers: SceneLayer;
  generatedAt: number;
}

export function emptyScene(): Scene2D {
  return {
    bounds: { minX: 0, minZ: 0, maxX: 10, maxZ: 10 },
    layers: { cut: [], project: [], overhead: [], below: [], grid: [], annotation: [], symbols: [] },
    generatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

/**
 * Convert paper millimetres to world metres at a given view scale.
 *   paperToWorld(0.18, 100) === 0.018   // 0.18 mm at 1:100 = 18 mm world
 */
export function paperToWorld(paperMm: number, viewScale: number): number {
  return (paperMm / 1000) * viewScale;
}

export function worldToPaper(worldM: number, viewScale: number): number {
  return (worldM / viewScale) * 1000;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/views/sheet-layout.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Sheet layout â€” transforms between scene (world metre) coordinates and
 * sheet millimeter coordinates.
 *
 * A viewport on a sheet has an x/y/width/height in mm. The view inside it
 * is rendered at the viewport's paper scale. The world viewBox width is:
 *
 *   world_width_m = paper_width_mm * scaleDenom / 1000
 */

import type { SheetDef, SheetViewport } from "../projects/types";
import type { ViewDef } from "./types";
import type { Scene2D } from "./scene";

export interface ViewportTransform {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  scaleDenom: number;
  viewBox: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number };
}

export function parseScale(s: string | number | undefined, fallback = 100): number {
  if (typeof s === "number" && Number.isFinite(s) && s > 0) return s;
  if (typeof s === "string") {
    const m = s.match(/1\s*:\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
    if (m) return parseFloat(m[1]);
    const n = parseFloat(s);
    if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) return n;
  }
  return fallback;
}

export function computeViewportTransform(
  viewport: SheetViewport,
  sheet: SheetDef,
  view: ViewDef,
  scene: Scene2D,
): ViewportTransform {
  const scaleDenom = parseScale(viewport.scale, view.scale);
  const widthMm = viewport.width;
  const heightMm = viewport.height;
  const worldW = (widthMm * scaleDenom) / 1000;
  const worldH = (heightMm * scaleDenom) / 1000;

  const cx = (scene.bounds.minX + scene.bounds.maxX) / 2;
  const cz = (scene.bounds.minZ + scene.bounds.maxZ) / 2;
  const vbX = cx - worldW / 2;
  const vbY = -cz - worldH / 2;

  void sheet;
  return {
    x: viewport.x,
    y: viewport.y,
    widthMm,
    heightMm,
    scaleDenom,
    viewBox: { x: vbX, y: vbY, w: worldW, h: worldH },
  };
}

export function formatScale(denom: number): string {
  return `1:${Math.round(denom)}`;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * View store â€” CRUD + persistence for ViewDef.
 */

import type { ViewDef, ViewKind, Discipline } from "./types";

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.views.v1";

let views: ViewDef[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notify(): void {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

function persist(): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(views)); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function bootViewsStore(): void {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) views = parsed;
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  if (!views.length) seedDefaultViews();
  notify();
}

function seedDefaultViews(): void {
  const now = Date.now();
  views = [
    {
      id: "plan-level-0",
      kind: "plan",
      name: "Level 0 Plan",
      scale: 100,
      discipline: "COORD",
      crop: null,
      plan: { levelId: "level-0", levelElevation: 0, cutHeight: 1.2, topHeight: 2.4, bottomDepth: 1.2, viewDepth: 4.0 },
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    },
    {
      id: "plan-level-1",
      kind: "plan",
      name: "Level 1 Plan",
      scale: 100,
      discipline: "COORD",
      crop: null,
      plan: { levelId: "level-1", levelElevation: 3, cutHeight: 1.2, topHeight: 2.4, bottomDepth: 1.2, viewDepth: 4.0 },
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    },
    {
      id: "elev-north",
      kind: "elevation",
      name: "North Elevation",
      scale: 100,
      discipline: "COORD",
      crop: null,
      elevation: { direction: "north", origin: [0, 3, 15], farClip: 60 },
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    },
    {
      id: "section-a",
      kind: "section",
      name: "Section A-A",
      scale: 50,
      discipline: "COORD",
      crop: null,
      section: { cutLine: { x1: -5, z1: 0, x2: 5, z2: 0 }, lookDir: "right", top: 6, bottom: -1, farClip: 30 },
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    },
  ];
}

export function listViews(): ViewDef[] { return views.slice(); }
export function listViewsByKind(kind: ViewKind): ViewDef[] { return views.filter((v) => v.kind === kind); }
export function getView(id: string): ViewDef | null { return views.find((v) => v.id === id) ?? null; }

export function addView(def: ViewDef): ViewDef {
  views.push(def);
  persist();
  notify();
  return def;
}

export function updateView(id: string, patch: Partial<ViewDef>): ViewDef | null {
  const v = views.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!v) return null;
  Object.assign(v, patch, { updatedAt: Date.now() });
  persist();
  notify();
  return v;
}

export function deleteView(id: string): boolean {
  const before = views.length;
  views = views.filter((v) => v.id !== id);
  if (views.length === before) return false;
  persist();
  notify();
  return true;
}

export function createView(kind: ViewKind, name: string, discipline: Discipline = "COORD"): ViewDef {
  const now = Date.now();
  const def: ViewDef = {
    id: `view-${now.toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    kind, name, scale: 100, discipline, crop: null,
    createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  };
  if (kind === "plan" || kind === "rcp") {
    def.plan = { levelId: "level-0", levelElevation: 0, cutHeight: 1.2, topHeight: 2.4, bottomDepth: 1.2, viewDepth: 4.0 };
  }
  if (kind === "section") {
    def.section = { cutLine: { x1: -5, z1: 0, x2: 5, z2: 0 }, lookDir: "right", top: 6, bottom: -1, farClip: 30 };
  }
  if (kind === "elevation") {
    def.elevation = { direction: "south", origin: [0, 3, 15], farClip: 60 };
  }
  return addView(def);
}

export function onViewsChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/views/tag-engine.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Tag engine.
 *
 * A tag is a reference + a field selector. This module reads the field from
 * the referenced element and produces a Scene2D bubble + optional leader.
 */

import type { AuthoredElement } from "../projects/types";
import { resolveReference } from "./references";
import type { Tag } from "./annotations";
import type { SceneEntity } from "./scene";
import { paperToWorld } from "./scene";

export interface ResolvedTag {
  entities: SceneEntity[];
  text: string;
  valid: boolean;
}

const TAG_COLOR = "#0f766e";

export function tagText(
  tag: Tag,
  el: AuthoredElement | null,
): string {
  if (tag.override) return tag.override;
  if (!el) return "\u2014";

  switch (tag.kind) {
    case "category": return el.name;
    case "material": return String(el.properties?.material ?? "\u2014");
    case "room": {
      const n = el.properties?.roomNumber;
      const nm = el.properties?.roomName;
      if (n && nm) return `${n} \u00B7 ${nm}`;
      if (n) return String(n);
      if (nm) return String(nm);
      return "\u2014";
    }
    case "custom": {
      const k = tag.field;
      if (!k) return "\u2014";
      return String(el.properties?.[k] ?? el.params[k as keyof typeof el.params] ?? "\u2014");
    }
  }
}

export function resolveTag(
  tag: Tag,
  elements: readonly AuthoredElement[],
  viewScale: number,
): ResolvedTag {
  const el = elements.find((e) => e.id === tag.ref.elementId) ?? null;
  const text = tagText(tag, el);

  const anchor = resolveReference(tag.ref, elements);
  if (!anchor) {
    return { entities: [], text, valid: false };
  }

  const [ax, , az] = anchor;
  const offX = paperToWorld(tag.offsetMm[0], viewScale);
  const offZ = paperToWorld(tag.offsetMm[1], viewScale);
  const tx = ax + offX;
  const tz = az + offZ;

  const entities: SceneEntity[] = [];

  if (tag.leader && tag.leaderShape !== "none") {
    entities.push({
      kind: "line",
      x1: ax, z1: az,
      x2: tx, z2: tz,
      stroke: { color: TAG_COLOR, widthPt: 0.18, dash: null },
    });
  }

  // Bubble rectangle sized by text length
  const size = paperToWorld(3.0, viewScale);
  const charW = size * 0.55;
  const w = Math.max(size, text.length * charW) + paperToWorld(2, viewScale);
  const h = size * 1.4;

  entities.push({
    kind: "polyline",
    closed: true,
    points: [
      [tx - w / 2, tz - h / 2],
      [tx + w / 2, tz - h / 2],
      [tx + w / 2, tz + h / 2],
      [tx - w / 2, tz + h / 2],
    ],
    stroke: { color: TAG_COLOR, widthPt: 0.15, dash: null },
    fill: { color: "#ecfdf5", opacity: 0.85 },
  });

  entities.push({
    kind: "text",
    x: tx, z: tz,
    text,
    anchor: "middle",
    sizePt: 3.0,
    rotation: tag.rotation,
    color: TAG_COLOR,
  });

  return { entities, text, valid: true };
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/views/tools.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Interactive annotation tools.
 *
 * A tiny state machine that the views panel drives with clicks:
 *
 *   select         -> no-op (used for selection in a future pass)
 *   dim-aligned    -> pick ref1, pick ref2, create aligned dimension
 *   dim-linear     -> pick ref1, pick ref2, create linear dimension
 *   tag-category   -> pick ref, create category tag
 *
 * Click coordinates arrive in the view's own 2D plane (which for plan and
 * section views is world (x, z)). The tool returns a result describing what
 * was created or what feedback the UI should show.
 */

import { getElements } from "../../features/authoring";
import { pickReference } from "./hit-test";
import { addDimension, addTag, DEFAULT_DIM_STYLES } from "./annotations";
import { createView, updateView } from "./store";
import type { Dimension, Tag } from "./annotations";
import type { Reference } from "./references";

export type ActiveTool = "select" | "dim-aligned" | "dim-linear" | "tag-category" | "section-line";

export interface ToolClickResult {
  newSectionViewId?: string;
  created?: Dimension | Tag;
  feedback?: string;
}

class ToolStateImpl {
  active: ActiveTool = "select";
  pendingRef: Reference | null = null;
  pendingPoint: [number, number] | null = null;

  setTool(t: ActiveTool): void {
    this.active = t;
    this.pendingRef = null;
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.pendingRef = null;
  }

  getHint(): string {
    switch (this.active) {
      case "select":
        return "Select mode â€” click a row on the left to switch view.";
      case "dim-aligned":
      case "dim-linear":
        return this.pendingRef
          ? "Pick second reference (endpoint / center / face)."
          : "Pick first reference (endpoint / center / face).";
      case "tag-category":
        return "Pick an element to tag.";
      case "section-line":
        return this.pendingPoint
          ? "Click second point of section cut line."
          : "Click first point of section cut line.";
      default:
        return "Ready.";
    }
  }

  click(
    worldX: number,
    worldZ: number,
    viewId: string,
    _viewScale: number,
    toleranceWorld: number,
    viewKind: string,
  ): ToolClickResult {
    if (viewKind !== "plan" && viewKind !== "rcp") {
      return { feedback: "Dimensions and tags are enabled in plan views only." };
    }
    if (this.active === "select") {
      return { feedback: this.getHint() };
    }

    const elements = getElements();
    const ref = pickReference(elements, worldX, worldZ, { tolerance: toleranceWorld });
    if (!ref) {
      return { feedback: "No reference nearby â€” click closer to an element." };
    }

    if (this.active === "section-line") {
      if (viewKind !== "plan" && viewKind !== "rcp") {
        return { feedback: "Switch to a plan view first, then draw the section line." };
      }
      if (!this.pendingPoint) {
        this.pendingPoint = [worldX, worldZ];
        return { feedback: "Click second point of section cut line." };
      }
      const [x1, z1] = this.pendingPoint;
      const x2 = worldX;
      const z2 = worldZ;
      if (Math.hypot(x2 - x1, z2 - z1) < 0.5) {
        return { feedback: "Section line is too short - click further away." };
      }
      const v = createView("section", "Section " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      if (v.section) {
        v.section.cutLine = { x1, z1, x2, z2 };
      }
      updateView(v.id, { section: v.section });
      this.pendingPoint = null;
      return {
        newSectionViewId: v.id,
        feedback: "Section created - opening view.",
      };
    }
    if (this.active === "tag-category") {
      const tag: Tag = {
        id: `tag-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        viewId,
        ref,
        kind: "category",
        offsetMm: [150, 150],
        leader: true,
        leaderShape: "straight",
        rotation: 0,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      };
      addTag(tag);
      return { created: tag, feedback: "Tag created." };
    }

    if (this.active === "dim-aligned" || this.active === "dim-linear") {
      if (!this.pendingRef) {
        this.pendingRef = ref;
        return { feedback: this.getHint() };
      }
      const dim: Dimension = {
        id: `dim-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        viewId,
        kind: this.active === "dim-linear" ? "linear" : "aligned",
        styleId: DEFAULT_DIM_STYLES[0].id,
        ref1: this.pendingRef,
        ref2: ref,
        offsetMm: 400,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      };
      addDimension(dim);
      this.pendingRef = null;
      return { created: dim, feedback: "Dimension created." };
    }

    return { feedback: "Unsupported tool." };
  }
}

export const toolState = new ToolStateImpl();
```

--- FILE: src/modules/views/types.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * View definitions â€” the single source of truth for every 2D projection.
 *
 * A ViewDef is a *configuration*. It contains no geometry; it describes how
 * to project the element model onto a plane. The generator produces a
 * Scene2D from a ViewDef + the element model. The renderer draws the Scene2D.
 *
 * This separation is what lets plan / section / elevation share the same
 * renderer, annotation engine, and selection system.
 */

export type ViewKind =
  | "plan"
  | "rcp"
  | "section"
  | "elevation"
  | "detail"
  | "drafting"
  | "3d"
```

```ts
/**
 * Unified Visibility Filter - combines phasing, design options, and
 * temporary hide/isolate (Revit VG / Temporary Hide-Isolate).
 */

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { phasesStore, type PhaseAssignment } from "../phases/phases";
import { designOptionsStore } from "../design-options/design-options";

export interface VisibilityElement {
  id: string;
  category?: string;
  phaseCreated?: string | null;
  phaseDemolished?: string | null;
  designOptionId?: string | null;
  /** Explicit temporary hide. */
  tempHidden?: boolean;
}

export interface CategoryOverride {
  visible: boolean;
  halftone: boolean;
  transparent: boolean;
}

type Listener = () => void;

class VisibilityFilter {
  private tempHidden = new Set<string>();
  private tempIsolated: Set<string> | null = null; // null = no isolate
  private categoryOverrides = new Map<string, CategoryOverride>();
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();

  onChange(cb: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  // -- Temporary Hide / Isolate --------------------------------------

  hideElement(id: string): void {
    this.tempHidden.add(id);
    this.emit();
  }

  hideElements(ids: string[]): void {
    for (const id of ids) this.tempHidden.add(id);
    this.emit();
  }

  isolateElements(ids: string[]): void {
    this.tempIsolated = new Set(ids);
    this.emit();
  }

  resetTemporary(): void {
    this.tempHidden.clear();
    this.tempIsolated = null;
    this.emit();
  }

  isTemporarilyHidden(id: string): boolean {
    if (this.tempIsolated) return !this.tempIsolated.has(id);
    return this.tempHidden.has(id);
  }

  // -- Category overrides --------------------------------------------

  setCategoryOverride(category: string, override: Partial<CategoryOverride>): void {
    const cur = this.categoryOverrides.get(category) ?? {
      visible: true,
      halftone: false,
      transparent: false,
    };
    this.categoryOverrides.set(category, { ...cur, ...override });
    this.emit();
  }

  getCategoryOverride(category: string): CategoryOverride {
    return (
      this.categoryOverrides.get(category) ?? {
        visible: true,
        halftone: false,
        transparent: false,
      }
    );
  }

  clearCategoryOverrides(): void {
    this.categoryOverrides.clear();
    this.emit();
  }

  // -- Combined test -------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * Full visibility test for an element under current view settings.
   */
  isVisible(el: VisibilityElement): boolean {
    // Temporary hide/isolate
    if (this.isTemporarilyHidden(el.id)) return false;

    // Category
    if (el.category) {
      const cat = this.getCategoryOverride(el.category);
      if (!cat.visible) return false;
    }

    // Phasing
    const phaseAssign: PhaseAssignment = {
      phaseCreated: el.phaseCreated ?? null,
      phaseDemolished: el.phaseDemolished ?? null,
    };
    if (!phasesStore.isVisible(phaseAssign)) return false;

    // Design options
    if (!designOptionsStore.isVisible(el.designOptionId)) return false;

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Graphic style hint combining phase role + category overrides.
   */
  graphicStyle(el: VisibilityElement): {
    opacity: number;
    dashed: boolean;
    halftone: boolean;
    role: string;
  } {
    const phase = phasesStore.graphicOverride({
      phaseCreated: el.phaseCreated ?? null,
      phaseDemolished: el.phaseDemolished ?? null,
    });
    const cat = el.category
      ? this.getCategoryOverride(el.category)
      : { visible: true, halftone: false, transparent: false };

    let opacity = phase.opacity;
    if (cat.halftone) opacity = Math.min(opacity, 0.4);
    if (cat.transparent) opacity = Math.min(opacity, 0.3);

    return {
      opacity,
      dashed: phase.dashed,
      halftone: cat.halftone || phase.role === "existing",
      role: phase.role,
    };
  }

  /** Filter a list of elements down to those visible. */
  filter<T extends VisibilityElement>(elements: T[]): T[] {
    return elements.filter((e) => this.isVisible(e));
  }
}

export const visibilityFilter = new VisibilityFilter();

export function setupVisibilityFilter(): typeof visibilityFilter {
  // Ensure dependent stores are booted (safe if already booted)
  try {
    if (typeof (phasesStore as any).boot === "function") (phasesStore as any).boot();
  } catch { /* */ }
  try {
    if (typeof (designOptionsStore as any).boot === "function") (designOptionsStore as any).boot();
  } catch { /* */ }

  try {
    (ctx.features as any).visibility = visibilityFilter;
  } catch { /* */ }
  (window as any).__obsVisibility = visibilityFilter;
  console.log("[visibility-filter] ready");
  return visibilityFilter;
}
```

--- FILE: src/modules/workspace-layout.ts ---
```ts
// openbim-fix:workspace-layout
//
// Persists which dockable panels are open across page reloads and
// provides a "Reset Workspace" that returns to the clean Revit-like
// default (all panels closed).
//
// How it works:
//   1. Every panel that should be remembered registers here with an
//      isVisible() / setVisible(on) pair.
//   2. On page unload, the current state is snapshotted and written
//      to localStorage under "obs.workspace.layout.v1".
//   3. On the next boot, restoreWorkspace() applies the saved state.
//      Missing keys fall back to `defaultOpen` (false everywhere).
//   4. resetWorkspace() closes every registered panel and clears the
//      saved state, so the next reload starts clean again.

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.workspace.layout.v1";

export interface WorkspacePanel {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  isVisible: () => boolean;
  setVisible: (on: boolean) => void;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

const registry = new Map<string, WorkspacePanel>();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function registerWorkspacePanel(p: WorkspacePanel): void {
  registry.set(p.key, p);
}

export function listWorkspacePanels(): WorkspacePanel[] {
  return [...registry.values()];
}

function readSaved(): Record<string, boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? parsed : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function writeSaved(state: Record<string, boolean>): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch {
    // quota exceeded / storage disabled - not fatal
  }
}

function emit(): void {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* listener must never crash */ }
  }
}

export function onWorkspaceChanged(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

export function snapshotWorkspace(): Record<string, boolean> {
  const out: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  for (const [key, p] of registry) {
    try { out[key] = !!p.isVisible(); }
    catch { out[key] = false; }
  }
  return out;
}

export function saveWorkspace(): Record<string, boolean> {
  const snap = snapshotWorkspace();
  writeSaved(snap);
  emit();
  return snap;
}

export function restoreWorkspace(): void {
  const saved = readSaved();
  for (const [key, p] of registry) {
    const want = key in saved ? saved[key] : (p.defaultOpen ?? false);
    try { p.setVisible(!!want); }
    catch (err) { console.warn("[workspace] restore failed:", key, err); }
  }
  emit();
}

export function resetWorkspace(): void {
  for (const p of registry.values()) {
    try { p.setVisible(false); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch { /* */ }
  emit();
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: { message: "Workspace reset - all panels closed", kind: "success" },
    }));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export function showAllWorkspace(): void {
  for (const p of registry.values()) {
    try { p.setVisible(true); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  saveWorkspace();
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: { message: "Workspace - all panels open", kind: "success" },
    }));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

let unloadHookInstalled = false;
export function installWorkspaceUnloadHook(): void {
  if (unloadHookInstalled) return;
  unloadHookInstalled = true;
  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => { saveWorkspace(); });
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") saveWorkspace();
  });
}
```

```ts
export async function loadPlugins() {
  const resp = await fetch('/manifest.json');
  if (!resp.ok) return console.warn('No manifest found');
  const manifest = await resp.json();
  const pluginsTab = document.querySelector('#plugins-tab .ribbon-tab-content');

  for (const entry of manifest.plugins) {
    try {
      const mod = await import(entry.url);
      if (typeof mod.register === 'function') {
        mod.register({
          api: (window as any).bimAPI,
          store: (window as any).bimStore,
          addRibbonButton: (label: string, onClick: () => void) => {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.textContent = label;
            btn.onclick = onClick;
            pluginsTab?.appendChild(btn);
          },
        });
        console.log(`Plugin ${entry.name} loaded`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load plugin', entry.name, e);
    }
  }
}
```
