```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.cwd();
const rel = "server/index.mjs";
const full = path.join(root, rel);
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

let src = await fs.readFile(full, "utf8");

if (src.includes("Open BIM Studio collaboration API")) {
  console.log("NO CHANGE: root index already present.");
  process.exit(0);
}

const anchor = "const url = new URL(";
const idx = src.indexOf(anchor);

if (idx < 0) {
  console.log("SKIP: anchor not found.");
  process.exit(0);
}

const inject =
  '  if (req.url === "/" || req.url === "/index.html" || req.url === "/favicon.ico") {\n' +
  "    return send(res, 200, {\n" +
  '      name: "Open BIM Studio collaboration API",\n' +
  '      status: "online",\n' +
  "      time: new Date().toISOString(),\n" +
  "      endpoints: [\n" +
  '        "GET/PUT /api/projects/:id",\n' +
  '        "GET /api/rooms/:room",\n' +
  '        "GET /api/rooms/:room/events (SSE live)",\n' +
  '        "POST /api/rooms/:room/join|heartbeat|leave|change",\n' +
  "      ],\n" +
  "    });\n" +
  "  }\n\n";

await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
src = src.slice(0, idx) + inject + src.slice(idx);
await fs.writeFile(full, src, "utf8");
console.log("PATCHED: server/index.mjs (root index added).");
```

```ts
// src/services/revitRoundTrip.ts
import axios from 'axios';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';

/**
 * Minimal stub for a Revit ↔ OpenBIMStudio round‑trip.
 * It uploads the current IFC model to Forge, triggers a translation back to RVT,
 * then downloads the resulting RVT file. The actual Revit add‑in would consume
 * that RVT. This demonstrates the flow; real‑world usage requires a Revit
 * plugin to import the downloaded RVT.
 */
export async function roundTripToRevit(api: IfcAPI) {
  const clientId = process.env.FORGE_CLIENT_ID;
  const clientSecret = process.env.FORGE_CLIENT_SECRET;
  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
    console.warn('Forge credentials missing – Revit round‑trip unavailable');
    return;
  }
  // 1️⃣ Get auth token (same as in src/services/forge.ts)
  const tokenRes = await axios.post(
    'https://developer.api.autodesk.com/authentication/v1/authenticate',
    new URLSearchParams({ client_id: clientId, client_secret: clientSecret, grant_type: 'client_credentials', scope: 'data:read data:write' }),
    { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' } }
  );
  const token = tokenRes.data.access_token;

  // 2️⃣ Export current model to IFC buffer
  const modelID = api.GetModelID();
  const ifcData = api.ExportIFC(modelID);

  // 3️⃣ Upload IFC to a temporary bucket (bucket must exist)
  const bucket = 'openbimstudio-temp';
  const objectName = `model-${Date.now()}.ifc`;
  await axios.put(
    `https://developer.api.autodesk.com/oss/v2/buckets/${bucket}/objects/${objectName}`,
    ifcData,
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' } }
  );

  // 4️⃣ Request translation to RVT (if supported – Forge currently offers IFC ↔ RVT via Model Derivative)
  const urn = Buffer.from(`${bucket}/${objectName}`).toString('base64');
  await axios.post(
    'https://developer.api.autodesk.com/modelderivative/v2/designdata/job',
    {
      input: { urn },
      output: { formats: [{ type: 'rvt', views: ['3d'] }] },
    },
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
  );

  // 5️⃣ Poll for translation completion (skipped here – in a UI you would poll the manifest endpoint)

  // 6️⃣ Download the generated RVT (placeholder – manifest URL would be used)
  // const rvtRes = await axios.get(`https://.../manifest/${urn}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, responseType: 'arraybuffer' });
  // fs.writeFileSync('model.rvt', rvtRes.data);

  console.log('Round‑trip to Revit requested – check Forge manifest for completion.');
}
```

```ts
// src/services/rfaImport.ts
import axios from 'axios';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';

/**
 * Minimal stub for importing a Revit .rfa family.
 * The real implementation would use Autodesk Forge's Model Derivative API to
 * translate the .rfa into IFC (or a custom JSON representation) and then ingest
 * that data into the current model.
 */
export async function importRFA(path: string, api: IfcAPI): Promise<void> {
  // 1️⃣ Upload the file to Forge (requires Forge client id/secret – values stored in env)
  const clientId = process.env.FORGE_CLIENT_ID;
  const clientSecret = process.env.FORGE_CLIENT_SECRET;
  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
    console.warn('Forge credentials not set – RFA import unavailable');
    return;
  }
  // Get a token
  const tokenRes = await axios.post(
    'https://developer.api.autodesk.com/authentication/v1/authenticate',
    new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: clientId,
      client_secret: clientSecret,
      grant_type: 'client_credentials',
      scope: 'data:read data:write',
    }),
    { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' } }
  );
  const token = tokenRes.data.access_token;

  // 2️⃣ Upload the .rfa to an OSS bucket (placeholder – bucket must exist)
  const bucketKey = 'openbimstudio-temp';
  const fileName = path.split('/').pop() ?? 'family.rfa';
  const fileData = await axios.get(path, { responseType: 'arraybuffer' }).then(r => r.data);
  await axios.put(
    `https://developer.api.autodesk.com/oss/v2/buckets/${bucketKey}/objects/${fileName}`,
    fileData,
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' } }
  );

  // 3️⃣ Ask Forge to translate to IFC (or a JSON family format)
  await axios.post(
    `https://developer.api.autodesk.com/modelderivative/v2/designdata/job`,
    {
      input: { urn: Buffer.from(`${bucketKey}/${fileName}`).toString('base64') },
      output: { formats: [{ type: 'ifc', views: ['3d'] }] },
    },
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
  );

  // 4️⃣ Poll for completion (skipped – in a real UI we would show a spinner)
  // 5️⃣ Download the resulting IFC and load it via web-ifc
  const ifcUrn = `${bucketKey}/${fileName}`; // placeholder
  const ifcRes = await axios.get(`https://developer.api.autodesk.com/modelderivative/v2/designdata/${ifcUrn}/manifest`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    responseType: 'arraybuffer',
  });
  const buffer = ifcRes.data as ArrayBuffer;
  const modelID = (api as any).OpenModel!(buffer);
  console.log('Imported RFA as IFC model', modelID);
}
```

```ts
/** Default keyboard shortcuts (Revit + Blender hybrid + AccuDraw).
 *
 * Two-letter sequences for tools (WA, SL, CM â€¦), single-letter modals for
 * the gizmo (G, R, S, Q), modifier combos for app commands (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+O,
 * Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+A, F5), and AccuDraw axis reservation
 * (X / Z / Y / Tab while a base point is active).
 *
 * Walk mode owns W A S D Shift Ctrl Space C â€” every shortcut registered
 * here is filtered by the walk handler when it fires.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { history } from "../features/history";
import { selection } from "../features/selection";
import { snapping } from "../features/snapping";
import { gizmo, type GizmoMode } from "../features/gizmo";
import { shortcuts } from "../features/shortcuts";
import { accuDraw } from "../features/accudraw";

import { saveProject, createProject, getCurrentProject } from "../modules/projects/projects";
import { pickAndImport } from "../features/file-interop";
import { showHome } from "../shell/home-screen";
import { runElementClashDetection } from "../features/clash";
import { toggleWalkMode, isWalkModeEnabled } from "../features/walk-mode";

export function registerDefaultShortcuts(): void {
  const setGizmo = (m: GizmoMode) => {
    gizmo.setMode(m);
    (window as any).__obs_setGizmo?.(m);
  };

  /* â”€â”€ App / file â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-save", label: "Save project", keys: "ctrl+s", category: "app",
    handler: () => { void saveProject(); },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-open", label: "Open any file", keys: "ctrl+o", category: "app",
    handler: () => { void pickAndImport(); },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-new", label: "New project", keys: "ctrl+n", category: "app",
    handler: () => {
      const name = prompt("New project name:", "Untitled");
      if (name == null) return;
      void createProject(name.trim() || "Untitled");
    },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-home", label: "Home screen", keys: "ctrl+h", category: "app",
    handler: () => showHome(),
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-run-clash", label: "Run clash test", keys: "f5", category: "app",
    handler: () => { void runElementClashDetection(); },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
  id: "app-clash-review",
  label: "Toggle Clash Review window",
  keys: "ctrl+shift+c",
  category: "app",
  handler: () => {
    const fn = (window as any).__obs_toggleClashReview;
    if (typeof fn === "function") fn();
  },
});
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-toggle-walk", label: "Toggle walk mode", keys: "ctrl+w", category: "app",
    when: () => true,
    handler: () => { try { toggleWalkMode(); } catch { /* */ } },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "app-exit-walk", label: "Exit walk mode", keys: "shift+escape", category: "app",
    when: () => isWalkModeEnabled(),
    handler: () => {
      const fn = (ctx.features as any).walkMode?.disable;
      if (typeof fn === "function") fn();
    },
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Edit â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "undo", label: "Undo", keys: "ctrl+z", category: "edit",
    handler: () => {
      if (!history.canUndo()) {
        try {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
            detail: { message: "Nothing to undo", kind: "warn" },
          }));
        } catch { /* */ }
        return;
      }
      void history.undo();
    },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "redo-ctrl-shift-z", label: "Redo", keys: "ctrl+shift+z", category: "edit",
    handler: () => { void history.redo(); },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "redo-ctrl-y", label: "Redo", keys: "ctrl+y", category: "edit",
    handler: () => { void history.redo(); },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "redo-ctrl-r", label: "Redo", keys: "ctrl+r", category: "edit",
    handler: () => { void history.redo(); },
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Selection â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "select-all", label: "Select all", keys: "ctrl+a", category: "select",
    handler: () => { void selection.selectAll(); },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "cancel-or-clear",
    label: "Cancel tool / Clear selection",
    keys: "escape",
    category: "select",
    when: () => !isWalkModeEnabled(),
    handler: async () => {
      // Floor Plan owns Esc when open
      try {
        if ((window as any).__obsPlanVisible?.()) return;
      } catch { /* */ }
      // Revit-style Esc:
      // 1) Cancel active authoring tool (wall, duct, moveâ€¦) â†’ Select
      // 2) If already Select, clear selection
      try {
        const auth = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
        const tool = auth?.getActiveTool?.();
        if (tool && tool !== "select" && tool !== null) {
          // Preserve lastCommand for Space-bar repeat
          const last = auth?.getLastCommand?.();
          auth.setAuthoringTool?.("select");
          if (last && auth.setLastCommand) auth.setLastCommand(last);
          try {
            window.dispatchEvent(
              new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { message: "Cancelled â€” Select", kind: "info" } }),
            );
          } catch { /* */ }
          try { (window as any).obsRefreshRibbon?.(); } catch { /* */ }
          return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("[shortcuts] Esc cancel tool failed", err);
      }

      // Clear model + authored selection
      try {
        selection.clear();
        await selection.applyToHighlighter();
      } catch { /* */ }
      try {
        const auth = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
        auth?.setSelectedAuthored?.([]);
        // force clear via select tool path
        const ids = auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
        if (ids.length) {
          auth?.setAuthoringTool?.("select");
          // clear by selecting none - use delete path's clear if available
          try {
            const selected = auth.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
            for (const id of selected) {
              /* cleared via setSelectedAuthored */
            }
            auth.setSelectedAuthored?.([]);
          } catch { /* */ }
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { message: "Selection cleared", kind: "info" } }),
        );
      } catch { /* */ }
    },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "delete-selection", label: "Delete selection", keys: "delete", category: "edit",
    handler: () => {
      const fn = (ctx.features as any).authoring?.deleteSelectedElement;
      if (fn) fn();
    },
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Modal gizmo (Blender) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({ id: "gizmo-move",   label: "Move gizmo",     keys: "g", category: "modal", handler: () => setGizmo("move") });
  shortcuts.register({ id: "gizmo-rotate", label: "Rotate gizmo",   keys: "r", category: "modal", handler: () => setGizmo("rotate") });
  shortcuts.register({ id: "gizmo-scale",  label: "Scale gizmo",    keys: "s", category: "modal", handler: () => setGizmo("scale") });
  shortcuts.register({ id: "gizmo-none",   label: "Selection mode", keys: "q", category: "modal", handler: () => setGizmo("none") });

  /* â”€â”€ Authoring two-letter â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  const authoring = () => (ctx.features as any).authoring;
  const setTool = (tool: string | null) => authoring()?.setAuthoringTool?.(tool);

  const toolList: { id: string; label: string; keys: string; tool: string }[] = [
    { id: "tool-wall",    label: "Wall",          keys: "wa", tool: "wall" },
    { id: "tool-slab",    label: "Slab",          keys: "sl", tool: "slab" },
    { id: "tool-column",  label: "Column",        keys: "cm", tool: "column" },
    { id: "tool-beam",    label: "Beam",          keys: "bm", tool: "beam" },
    { id: "tool-brace",   label: "Brace",         keys: "br", tool: "brace" },
    { id: "tool-truss",   label: "Truss",         keys: "tr", tool: "truss" },
    { id: "tool-footing", label: "Footing",       keys: "ft", tool: "footing" },
    { id: "tool-strip",   label: "Strip footing", keys: "sf", tool: "strip" },
    { id: "tool-duct",    label: "Duct",          keys: "du", tool: "duct" },
    { id: "tool-pipe",    label: "Pipe",          keys: "pp", tool: "pipe" },
    { id: "tool-grid",    label: "Grid",          keys: "gr", tool: "grid" },
    { id: "tool-level",   label: "Level",         keys: "lv", tool: "level" },
    { id: "tool-door",    label: "Door",          keys: "dr", tool: "door" },
    { id: "tool-window",  label: "Window",        keys: "wn", tool: "window" },
  ];
  for (const t of toolList) {
    shortcuts.register({
      id: t.id, label: t.label, keys: t.keys, category: "tool",
      handler: () => setTool(t.tool),
    });
  }

    /* â”€â”€ Direct Modeling (SketchUp-parity) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "push-pull-shortcut",
    label: "Push/Pull",
    keys: "pu",
    category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      try {
        const pp = (ctx.features as any).pushPull;
        if (pp?.isEnabled?.()) pp.disable(); else pp?.enable?.();
      } catch { /* */ }
    },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "rectangle-shortcut",
    label: "Rectangle",
    keys: "re",
    category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      try { (ctx.features as any).primitives?.activateRectangle?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "circle-shortcut",
    label: "Circle",
    keys: "ci",
    category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      try { (ctx.features as any).primitives?.activateCircle?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    },
  });
/* â”€â”€ View â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "fit", label: "Fit to view", keys: "f", category: "view",
    handler: () => {
      const fn = (ctx.features as any).cameraTools?.fitAll;
      if (fn) fn();
      else void import("../features/camera-tools").then((m) => m.fitAll());
    },
  });
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "home-view", label: "Home view", keys: "h", category: "view",
    handler: () => {
      const fn = (ctx.features as any).cameraTools?.goHome;
      if (fn) fn();
      else void import("../features/camera-tools").then((m) => m.goHome());
    },
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Snap â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  shortcuts.register({
    id: "snap-toggle", label: "Toggle snapping", keys: "shift+s", category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      const on = !snapping.isEnabled();
      snapping.setEnabled(on);
    },
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Ortho hold â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Shift") snapping.clearOrtho();
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Live gizmo refresh on selection changes â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  selection.onChange(() => {
    if (gizmo.getMode() !== "none") void gizmo.refresh();
  });

  /* â”€â”€ Walk mode toggled from anywhere â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  window.addEventListener("obs:walk-mode-changed", () => { /* ribbon re-renders itself */ });

  /* â”€â”€ AccuDraw key reservation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
  // AccuDraw's own keydown listener runs in capture phase and stops
  // propagation for X / Z / Y / Tab while a base point is active. The
  // registrations below are belt-and-braces: they prevent the app-level
  // two-letter buffer from ever treating X / Z / Y as a starting letter
  // when AccuDraw is engaged.
  const accuActive = () => {
    try { return accuDraw.isActive(); } catch { return false; }
  };
  shortcuts.register({ id: "accu-noop-x",   label: "AccuDraw X",   keys: "x",   category: "tool", when: accuActive, handler: () => { /* handled in accudraw.ts */ } });
  shortcuts.register({ id: "accu-noop-z",   label: "AccuDraw Z",   keys: "z",   category: "tool", when: accuActive, handler: () => { /* handled in accudraw.ts */ } });
  shortcuts.register({ id: "accu-noop-y",   label: "AccuDraw Y",   keys: "y",   category: "tool", when: accuActive, handler: () => { /* handled in accudraw.ts */ } });
  shortcuts.register({ id: "accu-noop-tab", label: "AccuDraw Tab", keys: "tab", category: "tool", when: accuActive, handler: () => { /* handled in accudraw.ts */ } });

  console.log("[shortcuts] registered", shortcuts.list().length, "commands");
}
```

```ts
/** Revit-style File application menu: commands + Recent Documents. */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import * as store from "../modules/projects/store";
import { getCurrentProject, saveProject, openProject, deleteProjectById, isDirty } from "../modules/projects/projects";
import { showHome } from "./home-screen";
import { captureThumbnail } from "../modules/issues/issues";
import { exportBCF } from "../modules/issues/bcf";
import { exportCostCsv } from "../features/cost-panel";
import { pickAndImport } from "../features/file-interop";
import { settingsBox } from "../features/importer";

const menu = document.createElement("div");
menu.style.cssText = "position:fixed;top:100px;left:10px;width:760px;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);z-index:250;display:none;background:#1b1c26;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#e2e8f0;font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";
menu.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const BTN = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:9px 12px;background:transparent;color:#dbe2ea;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:500 12.5px system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left";
const BTN_H = BTN + ";background:#24252f";
const SECTION = "font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#64748b;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;padding:10px 12px 4px";

const esc = (s: string) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]!));
const uid = () => (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `p-${Date.now()}`;

let built = false;

function item(icon: string, label: string, onclick: () => void, hint = "", danger = false): HTMLElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.style.cssText = BTN + (danger ? ";color:#fca5a5" : "");
  b.innerHTML = `<span style="width:20px;text-align:center;font-size:15px">${icon}</span><span style="flex:1">${esc(label)}</span>${hint ? `<span style="opacity:.45;font-size:10px">${esc(hint)}</span>` : ""}`;
  b.onmouseenter = () => (b.style.cssText = BTN_H + (danger ? ";color:#fca5a5" : ""));
  b.onmouseleave = () => (b.style.cssText = BTN + (danger ? ";color:#fca5a5" : ""));
  b.onclick = () => { closeFileMenu(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

async function saveAs() {
  const cur = getCurrentProject();
  if (!cur) { alert("No project is open."); return; }
  const name = prompt("Save project as:", `${cur.name} (copy)`);
  if (!name) return;
  await saveProject();
  const copy: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cur));
  copy.id = uid();
  copy.name = name;
  copy.createdAt = copy.updatedAt = Date.now();
  await store.putProject(copy);
  const blobs = await store.getModelBlobs(cur.id);
  for (const b of blobs) await store.putModelBlob(copy.id, b.modelId, b.name, b.blob);
  await openProject(copy.id);
}

function exportProjectJson() {
  const cur = getCurrentProject();
  if (!cur) { alert("No project is open."); return; }
  void saveProject(true).then(() => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(getCurrentProject(), null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = `${cur.name.replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}.obs.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
  });
}

function printView() {
  const url = captureThumbnail(1800);
  const w = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!w) { alert("Popup blocked — allow popups to print."); return; }
  w.document.write(`<html><head><title>Open BIM Studio — Print</title></head><body style="margin:0"><img src="${url}" style="width:100%" onload="window.print()"></body></html>`);
  w.document.close();
}

async function exportGlb() {
  const auxObjects: THREE.Object3D[] = (ctx.features as any).fileInterop?.getAuxObjects?.() ?? [];
  if (!ctx.fragments.list.size && !auxObjects.length) {
    alert("Nothing to export — the scene is empty."); return;
  }
  try {
    const { GLTFExporter } = await import("three/examples/jsm/exporters/GLTFExporter.js");
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    for (const [, m] of ctx.fragments.list) g.add(m.object.clone(true));
    for (const o of auxObjects) g.add(o.clone(true));
    const cur = getCurrentProject();
    new (GLTFExporter as any).parse(g, (res: ArrayBuffer) => {
      const blob = new Blob([res], { type: "model/gltf-binary" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url; a.download = `${(cur?.name ?? "scene").replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}.glb`;
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
    }, (err: any) => { console.error(err); alert("GLB export failed — see console."); }, { binary: true });
  } catch (err: any) { alert(`GLB export failed: ${err?.message ?? err}`); }
}

async function importProjectFile() {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file"; input.accept = ".obs.json,.json";
  input.onchange = async () => {
    const f = input.files?.[0]; if (!f) return;
    try {
      const doc = JSON.parse(await f.text());
      if (!doc?.id || !Array.isArray(doc.elements)) throw new Error("Not a valid Open BIM Studio project file.");
      await store.putProject(doc);
      await openProject(doc.id);
    } catch (e: any) { alert(`Open project file failed: ${e?.message ?? e}`); }
  };
  input.click();
}

function closeProject() {
  const go = () => showHome();
  if (isDirty()) {
    if (confirm("Project has unsaved changes. Save before closing?")) void saveProject(true).then(go);
    else go();
  } else go();
}

function openOptions() {
  const ov = document.createElement("div");
  ov.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center";
  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText = "background:#1b1c26;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;width:420px;max-height:80vh;overflow:auto;color:#e2e8f0;font:12px system-ui,sans-serif";
  const t = document.createElement("div");
  t.textContent = "Options";
  t.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px";
  const close = document.createElement("button");
  close.textContent = "Close";
  close.style.cssText = "margin-top:10px;padding:7px 14px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600";
  close.onclick = () => ov.remove();
  ov.onmousedown = (e) => { if (e.target === ov) ov.remove(); };
  card.append(t, settingsBox, close);
  ov.appendChild(card);
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
}

function build() {
  built = true;
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:0;min-height:380px";

  const left = document.createElement("div");
  left.style.cssText = "width:300px;flex:none;border-right:1px solid #24252f;padding:6px";
  left.append(
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Application" }),
    item("🆕", "New", () => showHome(), "Ctrl+N"),
    item("📂", "Open Project…", () => showHome()),
    item("🧬", "Open File… (any format)", () => pickAndImport(), "IFC · GLB · OBJ · FBX …"),
    item("📑", "Open Project File…", () => importProjectFile(), ".obs.json"),
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Save" }),
    item("💾", "Save", () => void saveProject(), "Ctrl+S"),
    item("📝", "Save As…", () => void saveAs()),
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Export" }),
    item("🗣", "Issues → BCF", () => exportBCF()),
    item("💰", "Cost → CSV", () => exportCostCsv()),
    item("🧊", "Scene → GLB", () => void exportGlb()),
    item("🖼", "Project → JSON", () => exportProjectJson(), "backup"),
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Document" }),
    item("🖨", "Print…", () => printView()),
    item("⚙️", "Options", () => openOptions()),
    item("🚪", "Close", () => closeProject()),
    item("⏻", "Exit", () => closeProject()),
  );

  const right = document.createElement("div");
  right.style.cssText = "flex:1;padding:10px 12px;overflow:auto";
  const rl = Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Recent Documents" });
  const list = document.createElement("div");
  list.id = "obs-filemenu-recent";
  list.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:4px";
  right.append(rl, list);

  row.append(left, right);
  menu.appendChild(row);
}

async function renderRecents() {
  const list = menu.querySelector("#obs-filemenu-recent") as HTMLElement;
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.5;padding:8px">Loading…</div>`;
  const docs = (await store.listProjectDocs()).sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt).slice(0, 12);
  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (!docs.length) {
    list.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.5;padding:10px;border:1px dashed #34353f;border-radius:8px;text-align:center">Files you open will show up here.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  for (const doc of docs) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:#171821;border:1px solid #24252f;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer";
    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.style.cssText = "flex:1;min-width:0";
    info.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">📄 ${esc(doc.name)}</div>
      <div style="opacity:.5;font-size:10px">${doc.elements?.length ?? 0} objects · ${doc.models?.length ?? 0} model(s) · ${new Date(doc.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}</div>`;
    const open = document.createElement("button");
    open.textContent = "Open";
    open.style.cssText = "padding:4px 10px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;font-weight:600";
    open.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeFileMenu(); void openProject(doc.id); };
    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.textContent = "🗑";
    del.style.cssText = "padding:4px 8px;background:#2a2a3a;border:1px solid #3a3a4a;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px";
    del.onclick = async (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!confirm(`Remove "${doc.name}" from Recent Documents?`)) return;
      await deleteProjectById(doc.id);
      void renderRecents();
    };
    row.onclick = () => { closeFileMenu(); void openProject(doc.id); };
    row.append(info, open, del);
    list.appendChild(row);
  }
}

export function toggleFileMenu() {
  menu.style.display === "block" ? closeFileMenu() : openFileMenu();
}
export function isFileMenuVisible() { return menu.style.display === "block"; }
export function openFileMenu() {
  if (!built) build();
  void renderRecents();
  menu.style.display = "block";
}
export function closeFileMenu() { menu.style.display = "none"; }

export function setupFileMenu() {
  document.body.appendChild(menu);
  window.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    if (menu.style.display === "block" && !menu.contains(e.target as Node)) closeFileMenu();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") closeFileMenu();
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "o") { e.preventDefault(); pickAndImport(); }
  });
  ctx.features.fileMenu = { toggle: toggleFileMenu, open: openFileMenu, close: closeFileMenu };
}
```

```ts
/** Open BIM Studio Project Center — enterprise-style local project launcher. */
import * as store from "../modules/projects/store";
import { createProject, openProject, deleteProjectById, getCurrentProject, onProjectChanged } from "../modules/projects/projects";
import type { ProjectTemplate } from "../modules/projects/types";

const esc = (s: unknown) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>\"']/g, (c) =>
  ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "\"": "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as Record<string, string>)[c],
);

const overlay = document.createElement("div");
overlay.className = "obs-home";
overlay.dataset.role = "home";

const inner = document.createElement("div");
inner.className = "obs-home__inner obs-project-center";
overlay.appendChild(inner);

const TEMPLATE_LABELS: Record<ProjectTemplate, { label: string; note: string }> = {
  blank: { label: "Blank BIM", note: "Clean authoring and open coordination workspace" },
  coordination: { label: "Coordination", note: "Federation, alignment, clash and BCF review" },
  "mep-delivery": { label: "MEP Delivery", note: "MEP authoring, systems and coordination" },
  documentation: { label: "Documentation", note: "Views, sheets, schedules and production" },
  construction: { label: "Construction", note: "4D sequencing, 5D quantities and automation" },
};

const WORKSPACES = [
  ["coordination", "Coordination", "Federate models, align origins, detect clashes and manage BCF issues."],
  ["authoring", "Authoring", "Create and edit architectural, structural and MEP elements with snaps."],
  ["documentation", "Documentation", "Create production sheets, plan views, schedules and saved views."],
  ["mep", "MEP Delivery", "Focus the workspace on duct, pipe, tray, conduit and equipment delivery."],
  ["construction", "Construction", "Simulate 4D, calculate 5D takeoff and run delivery automation."],
  ["qa", "QA / QC", "Run clash detection, IDS validation, issue review and model health checks."],
] as const;

function emitWorkspace(id: string) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-workspace", { detail: { id } }));
  hideHome();
}

function buildStatic() {
  inner.innerHTML = `
    <header class="obs-center-header">
      <div class="obs-center-brand">
        <div class="obs-center-mark" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div>
          <div class="obs-center-title">Open BIM Studio</div>
          <div class="obs-center-subtitle">Professional openBIM project environment</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-center-header-meta">
        <span class="obs-center-badge">LOCAL-FIRST</span>
        <span class="obs-center-badge obs-center-badge--muted">IFC · BCF · IDS</span>
        <span class="obs-center-version">v52</span>
      </div>
    </header>

    <section class="obs-kpi-grid" id="obs-kpis"></section>

    <section class="obs-command-grid">
      <div class="obs-command-card obs-command-card--primary">
        <div class="obs-command-eyebrow">START A PROJECT</div>
        <h2>Set up a BIM workspace</h2>
        <p>Choose a delivery template. Project data stays in your browser unless you explicitly export it.</p>
        <div class="obs-create-row">
          <input id="obs-new-name" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Project name — e.g. HSR PK3 MEP Stations" aria-label="Project name" />
          <select id="obs-template" aria-label="Project template">
            ${Object.entries(TEMPLATE_LABELS).map(([id, t]) => `<option value="${id}">${esc(t.label)}</option>`).join("")}
          </select>
          <button class="obs-btn obs-btn--primary" id="obs-create-project">Create project</button>
        </div>
        <div class="obs-create-hint" id="obs-template-note"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-command-card">
        <div class="obs-command-eyebrow">FAST ACCESS</div>
        <h2>Open BIM workflows</h2>
        <div class="obs-workspace-grid" id="obs-workspaces"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section>
      <div class="obs-home__section-title">
        <span>Recent projects</span>
        <span class="obs-home__section-count" id="obs-count"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-home__grid" id="obs-grid"></div>
    </section>

    <footer class="obs-home__footer">
      <span>Open BIM Studio · local project database · browser-first delivery</span>
      <span><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>O</kbd> Open &nbsp;·&nbsp; <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>S</kbd> Save &nbsp;·&nbsp; <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>P</kbd> Commands</span>
    </footer>`;

  const nameInput = inner.querySelector("#obs-new-name") as HTMLInputElement;
  const template = inner.querySelector("#obs-template") as HTMLSelectElement;
  const note = inner.querySelector("#obs-template-note") as HTMLElement;
  const createBtn = inner.querySelector("#obs-create-project") as HTMLButtonElement;

  const updateTemplateNote = () => {
    note.textContent = TEMPLATE_LABELS[template.value as ProjectTemplate]?.note ?? "";
  };
  template.addEventListener("change", updateTemplateNote);
  updateTemplateNote();
  createBtn.onclick = () => {
    const name = nameInput.value.trim();
    if (!name) {
      nameInput.focus();
      return;
    }
    void createProject(name, { template: template.value as ProjectTemplate });
    nameInput.value = "";
  };
  nameInput.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") createBtn.click();
  });

  const ws = inner.querySelector("#obs-workspaces") as HTMLElement;
  ws.innerHTML = WORKSPACES.map(([id, label, description]) => `
    <button class="obs-workspace-card" data-workspace="${id}">
      <span class="obs-workspace-card__marker"></span>
      <span class="obs-workspace-card__content">
        <b>${esc(label)}</b>
        <small>${esc(description)}</small>
      </span>
      <span class="obs-workspace-card__arrow">→</span>
    </button>`).join("");
  ws.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-workspace]").forEach((button) => {
    button.onclick = () => emitWorkspace(button.dataset.workspace ?? "coordination");
  });
}

function renderKpis(docs: any[]) {
  const kpi = inner.querySelector("#obs-kpis") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!kpi) return;
  const models = docs.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.models?.length ?? 0), 0);
  const elements = docs.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.elements?.length ?? 0), 0);
  const issues = docs.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.issues?.length ?? 0), 0);
  const active = docs.filter((d) => (d.status ?? "active") === "active").length;
  const cards = [
    ["Projects", docs.length, "Local project records"],
    ["Linked models", models, "IFC / Fragments / references"],
    ["Authored objects", elements, "Native authored BIM elements"],
    ["Open issues", issues, active ? `${active} active project${active === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "No active projects"],
  ];
  kpi.innerHTML = cards.map(([label, value, note]) => `
    <div class="obs-kpi">
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>
      <strong>${Number(value).toLocaleString()}</strong>
      <small>${esc(note)}</small>
    </div>`).join("");
}

function projectCard(doc: any): HTMLElement {
  const s = store.summarize(doc);
  const card = document.createElement("article");
  card.className = "obs-card obs-project-card";
  const status = s.status ?? "active";
  const template = TEMPLATE_LABELS[s.template ?? "blank"]?.label ?? "BIM";
  const meta = [s.projectNumber, s.client, s.phase].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
  card.innerHTML = `
    <div class="obs-project-card__top">
      <div class="obs-card__icon">BIM</div>
      <span class="obs-project-status obs-project-status--${esc(status)}">${esc(status.replace("-", " ").toUpperCase())}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="obs-card__title">${esc(s.name)}</div>
    <div class="obs-project-card__template">${esc(template)}</div>
    <div class="obs-card__meta">
      <span>${s.elementCount.toLocaleString()} objects</span><span class="sep">·</span>
      <span>${s.modelCount.toLocaleString()} model(s)</span><span class="sep">·</span>
      <span>${s.issueCount.toLocaleString()} issue(s)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="obs-project-card__identity">${esc(meta || "No project metadata yet")}</div>
    <div class="obs-card__actions"></div>`;

  const actions = card.querySelector(".obs-card__actions") as HTMLElement;
  const openBtn = document.createElement("button");
  openBtn.className = "obs-btn obs-btn--primary obs-btn--sm";
  openBtn.textContent = "Open";
  openBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); void openProject(s.id); };
  const deleteBtn = document.createElement("button");
  deleteBtn.className = "obs-btn obs-btn--sm";
  deleteBtn.textContent = "Delete";
  deleteBtn.onclick = async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!confirm(`Delete “${s.name}” and its stored models? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    await deleteProjectById(s.id);
    void renderList();
  };
  actions.append(openBtn, deleteBtn);
  card.onclick = () => void openProject(s.id);
  return card;
}

async function renderList() {
  const grid = inner.querySelector("#obs-grid") as HTMLElement | null;
  const count = inner.querySelector("#obs-count") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!grid || !count) return;
  const docs = (await store.listProjectDocs()).sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt);
  renderKpis(docs);
  count.textContent = docs.length ? `${docs.length} project${docs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "";
  grid.innerHTML = "";
  if (!docs.length) {
    grid.innerHTML = `<div class="obs-empty" style="grid-column:1/-1"><strong>No project workspace yet</strong>Create a project above, then link IFC/FRAG models and begin coordination.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  for (const doc of docs) grid.appendChild(projectCard(doc));
}

export function showHome() {
  void renderList();
  overlay.classList.add("is-open");
}
export function hideHome() { overlay.classList.remove("is-open"); }
export function setupHomeScreen() {
  buildStatic();
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  onProjectChanged(() => { if (getCurrentProject()) hideHome(); });
}
```

```ts
/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Toast
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
type ToastKind = "info" | "warn" | "success" | "error";
let toastHost: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

function ensureToastHost(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (toastHost) return toastHost;
  const h = document.createElement("div");
  h.className = "obs-toast-host";
  document.body.appendChild(h);
  toastHost = h;
  return h;
}

function toast(message: string, kind: ToastKind = "info", ms = 2400): void {
  const host = ensureToastHost();
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "obs-toast";
  el.dataset.kind = kind;
  el.textContent = message;
  host.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => {
    el.classList.add("obs-toast--out");
    setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 250);
  }, ms);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Optional feature resolution
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function tryIds(): { toggle?: () => void; isVisible?: () => boolean } | null {
  return (ctx.features as any).idsPanel ?? null;
}
function tryTree(): { toggle?: () => void; isVisible?: () => boolean } | null {
  return (ctx.features as any).modelTreePanel ?? null;
}
function tryPropertyPalette(): { open?: () => void; close?: () => void; isVisible?: () => boolean } | null {
  return (ctx.features as any).propertyPalette ?? null;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Left tools panel toggle
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let leftPanelVisible = true;
function toggleLeftPanel() {
  leftPanelVisible = !leftPanelVisible;
  ctx.leftHost.style.display = leftPanelVisible ? "" : "none";
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Root DOM
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const root = document.createElement("div");
root.className = "obs-ribbon";

const tabsRow = document.createElement("div");
tabsRow.className = "obs-ribbon__tabs";

const strip = document.createElement("div");
strip.className = "obs-ribbon__strip";

const pill = document.createElement("div");
pill.className = "obs-ribbon__pill";

/** Revit-style ribbon minimize: double-click a tab (or tabs row) to collapse the strip
 *  so only the tab buttons remain (flat / shrunk). Double-click again to restore. */
let ribbonMinimized = false;
try {
  ribbonMinimized = localStorage.getItem("obs.ribbon.minimized") === "1";
} catch { /* */ }

function applyRibbonMinimize(min: boolean) {
  ribbonMinimized = min;
  if (min) {
    root.classList.add("obs-ribbon--minimized");
    strip.style.display = "none";
  } else {
    root.classList.remove("obs-ribbon--minimized");
    strip.style.display = "";
  }
  try { localStorage.setItem("obs.ribbon.minimized", min ? "1" : "0"); } catch { /* */ }
  // Notify plan view / others that ribbon height changed
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-ribbon-resize"));
}

function toggleRibbonMinimize() {
  applyRibbonMinimize(!ribbonMinimized);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Helpers
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const esc = (s: string) =>
  s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);

interface BtnOpts {
  active?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  planned?: boolean;
  kbd?: string;
}

type Action = () => void | Promise<void>;

function b(
  icon: IconName,
  label: string,
  onclick: Action,
  activeOrOpts: boolean | BtnOpts = false,
  title = "",
): HTMLButtonElement {
  const opts: BtnOpts =
    typeof activeOrOpts === "boolean" ? { active: activeOrOpts, title } : activeOrOpts;
  const el = document.createElement("button");
  el.className = "obs-rb";
  const tip = opts.kbd ? `${label}  (${opts.kbd})` : (opts.title || label);
  el.title = tip;
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
  if (opts.active) el.dataset.active = "1";
  if (opts.planned) el.dataset.planned = "1";
  el.innerHTML =
    `<span class="obs-rb__icon">${svgIcon(icon)}</span>` +
    `<span class="obs-rb__label">${esc(label)}</span>`;
  el.onclick = async () => {
    try {
      await onclick();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[ribbon] action failed", err);
      toast("Action failed — see console.", "warn", 3000);
    }
    renderStrip();
  };
  return el;
}

function planned(
  icon: IconName,
  label: string,
  hint = "This tool is planned for a future release.",
): HTMLButtonElement {
  return b(icon, label, () => toast(hint, "info"), { planned: true, title: `${label} — planned` });
}

function sep(): HTMLElement {
  const d = document.createElement("span");
  d.dataset.obsSep = "1";
  d.style.display = "none";
  return d;
}

function groupLabel(text: string): HTMLElement {
  const d = document.createElement("span");
  d.dataset.obsGroup = text;
  d.style.display = "none";
  return d;
}

function hint(text: string): HTMLElement {
  const s = document.createElement("span");
  s.dataset.obsHint = "1";
  s.textContent = text;
  return s;
}

function toolBtn(icon: IconName, label: string, tool: string, kbd = ""): HTMLButtonElement {
  let active = false;
  try {
    // Match internal tool or ribbon preset name
    const current = getActiveTool() as string | null;
    active = current === tool || (current != null && label.length > 0 && current === tool);
    try {
      const preset = (window as any).__obsAuthoring?.getActivePreset?.();
      if (preset === tool) active = true;
    } catch { /* */ }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return b(
    icon,
    label,
    safe(() => {
      try {
        const cur = getActiveTool() as string | null;
        let preset: string | null = null;
        try { preset = (window as any).__obsAuthoring?.getActivePreset?.() ?? null; } catch { /* */ }
        if (cur === tool || preset === tool) {
          setAuthoringTool(null);
          toast(`${label} off`, "info", 1200);
        } else {
          setAuthoringTool(tool as any);
          // If Floor Plan is open, route tool into 2D plan (Revit behaviour)
          try {
            const pv = (ctx.features as any).planView;
            if (pv?.isVisible?.()) {
              pv.setTool?.(tool);
              toast(`${label} — draw in Floor Plan (also creates 3D)`, "success", 2000);
            } else {
              toast(`${label} — click in the viewport to place`, "success", 1800);
            }
          } catch {
            toast(`${label} — click in the viewport to place`, "success", 1800);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        toast(`Tool "${label}" failed — see console.`, "warn");
        console.warn("[ribbon] tool failed", tool, e);
      }
    }, label),
    { active, kbd, title: `${label} modeling tool` },
  );
}

function safe(fn: Action, label = "action"): Action {
  return async () => {
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[ribbon] ${label}`, err);
      toast(`${label} failed — see console.`, "warn", 3000);
    }
  };
}

function levelInput(): HTMLElement {
  const w = document.createElement("label");
  w.className = "obs-level-input";
  const caption = document.createElement("span");
  caption.textContent = "Level";
  const i = document.createElement("input");
  i.type = "number";
  i.step = "0.1";
  try {
    i.value = String(getLevel());
  } catch {
    i.value = "0";
  }
  i.title = "Current level elevation (m)";
  i.onchange = () => setLevel(Number(i.value) || 0);
  w.append(caption, i);
  return w;
}

function screenshotPresetInput(): HTMLElement {
  const w = document.createElement("label");
  w.className = "obs-level-input";
  const caption = document.createElement("span");
  caption.textContent = "Shot";
  const sel = document.createElement("select");
  sel.title = "Screenshot resolution";
  sel.style.cssText =
    "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
    "color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:500 10px var(--font-mono,monospace);" +
    "padding:3px 4px;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;min-width:64px;outline:none";
  sel.innerHTML =
    `<option value="current">Native</option>` +
    `<option value="hd">HD 1080p</option>` +
    `<option value="4k">4K UHD</option>` +
    `<option value="8k">8K UHD</option>`;
  try { sel.value = getScreenshotPreset(); } catch { sel.value = "hd"; }
  sel.onchange = () => {
    setScreenshotPreset(sel.value as ScreenshotPreset);
    toast(`Screenshot preset: ${sel.value.toUpperCase()}`, "info", 1500);
  };
  w.append(caption, sel);
  return w;
}

function idsButton(): HTMLButtonElement {
  const api = tryIds();
  return b(
    "ids",
    "IDS validation",
    safe(() => {
      if (api?.toggle) api.toggle();
      else toast("IDS panel not loaded.", "warn");
    }, "IDS panel"),
    { active: api?.isVisible?.() ?? false },
  );
}

function treeButton(): HTMLButtonElement {
  const api = tryTree();
  return b(
    "tree",
    "Model tree",
    safe(() => {
      if (api?.toggle) api.toggle();
      else toast("Model tree not loaded.", "warn");
    }, "Model tree"),
    { active: api?.isVisible?.() ?? false },
  );
}

function userInterfaceButton(): HTMLButtonElement {
  const btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.className = "obs-rb";
  btn.title = "User Interface — toggle panels and status bars";
  btn.style.cssText = "min-width:78px;max-width:96px;";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   State
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let activeTab = "file";
let boundsOn = false;

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BIM workspaces — focused command sets for production delivery.
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const WORKSPACES = [
  { id: "authoring", label: "Authoring", caption: "Model + families", tab: "architecture" },
  { id: "mep", label: "MEP Delivery", caption: "Systems + coordination", tab: "mechanical" },
  { id: "coordination", label: "Coordination", caption: "Federation + alignment", tab: "coordinate" },
  { id: "qa", label: "QA / QC", caption: "Clash + IDS + issues", tab: "clash" },
  { id: "documentation", label: "Documentation", caption: "Sheets + views", tab: "view" },
  { id: "construction", label: "Construction", caption: "4D + 5D + automation", tab: "cost" },
] as const;
type WorkspaceId = typeof WORKSPACES[number]["id"];
let activeWorkspace: WorkspaceId = "coordination";
try {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem("obs.workspace");
  if (WORKSPACES.some((w) => w.id === saved)) activeWorkspace = saved as WorkspaceId;
} catch { /* private browsing / storage blocked */ }
function getWorkspaceDefinition(id: WorkspaceId) {
  return WORKSPACES.find((w) => w.id === id) ?? WORKSPACES[2];
}
function setActiveWorkspace(id: string) {
  if (!WORKSPACES.some((w) => w.id === id)) return;
  activeWorkspace = id as WorkspaceId;
  try { localStorage.setItem("obs.workspace", activeWorkspace); } catch { /* */ }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Rendering
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function refreshRibbon() {
  renderTabs();
  renderStrip();
}

function renderTabs() {
  tabsRow.innerHTML = "";

  const brand = document.createElement("div");
  brand.className = "obs-ribbon__brand";
  brand.append(document.createTextNode("Open BIM Studio"));
  const version = document.createElement("span");
  version.className = "obs-ribbon__version";
  version.textContent = "v54";
  brand.appendChild(version);
  tabsRow.appendChild(brand);

  for (const t of TABS) {
    // Removed tabs: BIM Tools, Analyze, Massing & Site
    if (t.id === "bim-tools" || t.id === "analyze" || t.id === "site") continue;
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "obs-ribbon__tab" + (t.id === "file" ? " obs-ribbon__tab--file" : "");
    btn.textContent = t.label;
    if (t.id === activeTab) btn.dataset.active = "1";
    btn.dataset.tab = t.id;
    btn.onclick = () => {
      // Single click: if minimized, expand and switch; if already expanded, just switch tab
      if (ribbonMinimized) {
        applyRibbonMinimize(false);
      }
      activeTab = t.id;
      renderTabs();
      renderStrip();
    };
    // Double-click on tab → toggle minimize (Revit behavior: shrink ribbon so only tabs show)
    btn.ondblclick = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      toggleRibbonMinimize();
    };
    tabsRow.appendChild(btn);
  }

  // Double-click empty area of tabs row also toggles minimize
  tabsRow.ondblclick = (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).classList.contains("obs-ribbon__tab")) return;
    toggleRibbonMinimize();
  };

  tabsRow.appendChild(pill);
  updatePill();
}

function renderStrip() {
  try {
    renderStripImpl();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[ribbon] renderStrip failed for tab "${activeTab}":`, err);
    strip.innerHTML =
      `<div style="color:#fca5a5;padding:20px;font:12px/1.5 monospace;white-space:pre-wrap">` +
      `⚠ Ribbon failed to render tab "${activeTab}".\n` +
      `${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}\n\n` +
      `Open the browser console (F12) for the full trace.</div>`;
  }
}

function renderStripImpl() {
  strip.innerHTML = "";

  const tab = TABS.find((t) => t.id === activeTab) ?? TABS[0];
  let items: HTMLElement[] = [];
  try {
    items = tab.items();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[ribbon] items() threw for tab "${tab.id}":`, err);
    strip.innerHTML =
      `<div style="color:#fca5a5;padding:20px;font:12px/1.5 monospace;white-space:pre-wrap">` +
      `⚠ Tab "${tab.id}" threw during build:\n` +
      `${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}\n\n` +
      `Open the browser console (F12) for the full trace.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return;

  const groups: { label: string; items: HTMLElement[] }[] = [];
  const hints: HTMLElement[] = [];
  let cur: { label: string; items: HTMLElement[] } = { label: "", items: [] };

  for (const it of items) {
    if (!it || !(it instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
    if (it.dataset.obsSep === "1") {
      if (cur.items.length) groups.push(cur);
      cur = { label: "", items: [] };
      continue;
    }
    if (it.dataset.obsGroup) {
      cur.label = it.dataset.obsGroup;
      continue;
    }
    if (it.dataset.obsHint === "1") {
      hints.push(it);
      continue;
    }
    cur.items.push(it);
  }
  if (cur.items.length) groups.push(cur);

  if (!groups.length && !hints.length) {
    const fallback = document.createElement("div");
    fallback.style.cssText =
      "padding:20px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);font:12px system-ui";
    fallback.textContent = `Tab "${tab.label}" has no commands yet.`;
    strip.appendChild(fallback);
    return;
  }

  for (const g of groups) {
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "obs-ribbon-group";
    const bodyEl = document.createElement("div");
    bodyEl.className = "obs-ribbon-group__body";
    for (const el of g.items) bodyEl.appendChild(el);
    wrap.appendChild(bodyEl);
    if (g.label) {
      const lbl = document.createElement("div");
      lbl.className = "obs-ribbon-group__label";
      lbl.textContent = g.label;
      wrap.appendChild(lbl);
    }
    strip.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  for (const h of hints) {
    h.className = "obs-ribbon-hint";
    strip.appendChild(h);
  }
}

function updatePill() {
  try {
    const p = getCurrentProject();
    const workspace = getWorkspaceDefinition(activeWorkspace);
    pill.innerHTML = "";

    const status = document.createElement("span");
    status.className = `obs-ribbon__project-status ${isDirty() ? "is-dirty" : "is-saved"}`;
    status.textContent = isDirty() ? "UNSAVED" : "SAVED";
    status.title = isDirty() ? "Project has unsaved changes" : "Project saved";

    const name = document.createElement("span");
    name.className = "obs-ribbon__project-name";
    name.textContent = p?.name ?? "No project";
    name.title = p?.name ?? "Open or create a project";

    const divider = document.createElement("span");
    divider.className = "obs-ribbon__pill-divider";

    const select = document.createElement("select");
    select.className = "obs-workspace-select";
    select.title = "Switch BIM workspace";
    select.setAttribute("aria-label", "BIM workspace");
    for (const item of WORKSPACES) {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = item.id;
      option.textContent = item.label;
      option.selected = item.id === activeWorkspace;
      select.appendChild(option);
    }
    select.onchange = () => {
      setActiveWorkspace(select.value);
      const next = getWorkspaceDefinition(activeWorkspace);
      activeTab = next.tab;
      renderTabs();
      renderStrip();
    };

    const descriptor = document.createElement("span");
    descriptor.className = "obs-ribbon__workspace-hint";
    descriptor.textContent = workspace.caption;

    pill.append(status, name, divider, select, descriptor);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[ribbon] updatePill failed", err);
    pill.textContent = "";
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Left dock — resizable + dockable tools panel
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function setupLeftDock(mainRow: HTMLElement) {
  const leftWidthKey = "obs.leftPanel.width";
  const dockKey = "obs.leftPanel.dock";
  const minW = 320;
  const maxW = 700;

  mainRow.style.position = "relative";

  let width = 400;
  try {
    width = Math.max(
      minW,
      Math.min(maxW, Number(localStorage.getItem(leftWidthKey)) || 400),
    );
  } catch { /* */ }
  ctx.leftHost.style.width = `${width}px`;
  ctx.leftHost.style.minWidth = `${minW}px`;
  ctx.leftHost.style.maxWidth = `${maxW}px`;
  ctx.leftHost.style.flex = "0 0 auto";
  ctx.leftHost.style.position = "relative";

  const handle = document.createElement("div");
  handle.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;right:-3px;width:6px;cursor:ew-resize;" +
    "background:transparent;z-index:20";
  handle.title = "Drag to resize · Double-click to reset";
  ctx.leftHost.appendChild(handle);

  let resizing = false;
  let startX = 0;
  let startW = 0;

  handle.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    resizing = true;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startW = ctx.leftHost.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    document.body.style.cursor = "ew-resize";
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  handle.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!resizing) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - startX;
    const w = Math.max(minW, Math.min(maxW, startW + dx));
    ctx.leftHost.style.width = `${w}px`;
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  });
  handle.addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => {
    if (!resizing) return;
    resizing = false;
    (e.target as Element).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    document.body.style.cursor = "";
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        leftWidthKey,
        String(Math.round(ctx.leftHost.getBoundingClientRect().width)),
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
  });
  handle.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
    ctx.leftHost.style.width = "400px";
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
    try { localStorage.setItem(leftWidthKey, "400"); } catch { /* */ }
  });

  function applyDock(side: "left" | "right") {
    if (side === "right") {
      mainRow.style.flexDirection = "row-reverse";
      ctx.leftHost.style.borderRight = "none";
      ctx.leftHost.style.borderLeft = "1px solid var(--border-default)";
    } else {
      mainRow.style.flexDirection = "row";
      ctx.leftHost.style.borderLeft = "none";
      ctx.leftHost.style.borderRight = "1px solid var(--border-default)";
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  }
  try {
    const dock = (localStorage.getItem(dockKey) as "left" | "right") || "left";
    applyDock(dock);
  } catch { /* */ }

  (ctx.features as any).leftPanel = {
    setWidth: (w: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(minW, Math.min(maxW, w));
      ctx.leftHost.style.width = `${clamped}px`;
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
      try { localStorage.setItem(leftWidthKey, String(Math.round(clamped))); } catch { /* */ }
    },
    getWidth: () => ctx.leftHost.getBoundingClientRect().width,
    dockLeft: () => {
      applyDock("left");
      try { localStorage.setItem(dockKey, "left"); } catch { /* */ }
    },
    dockRight: () => {
      applyDock("right");
      try { localStorage.setItem(dockKey, "right"); } catch { /* */ }
    },
    toggle: () => toggleLeftPanel(),
  };
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupRibbon() {
  const app = document.getElementById("app") as HTMLElement;
  app.style.flexDirection = "column";

  ctx.leftHost.style.cssText =
    "height:100%;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;" +
    "background:var(--bg-base);border-right:1px solid var(--border-default);" +
    "display:flex;flex-direction:column;";
  // Wheel over left dock scrolls the panel — never zooms 3D
  ctx.leftHost.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); }, { passive: true });


  const mainRow = document.createElement("div");
  mainRow.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;overflow:hidden";
  mainRow.append(ctx.leftHost, ctx.rightHost);

  app.append(root, mainRow);
  root.append(tabsRow, strip);

  setupLeftDock(mainRow);

  onProjectChanged(updatePill);
  updatePill();
  activeTab = getWorkspaceDefinition(activeWorkspace).tab;
  renderTabs();
  renderStrip();
  // Restore minimized state (Revit-style flat ribbon)
  applyRibbonMinimize(ribbonMinimized);

  window.addEventListener("obs-workspace", ((e: CustomEvent) => {
    const id = String(e.detail?.id ?? "");
    setActiveWorkspace(id);
    activeTab = getWorkspaceDefinition(activeWorkspace).tab;
    renderTabs();
    renderStrip();
    toast(`${getWorkspaceDefinition(activeWorkspace).label} workspace`, "success", 1600);
  }) as EventListener);

  // Bridge notify + legacy obs-toast → ribbon toast (single path, no double-fire)
  window.addEventListener("obs-toast", ((e: CustomEvent) => {
    const d = e.detail ?? {};
    const kind = d.kind ?? "info";
    const message = String(d.message ?? "");
    const timeout = d.timeout ?? d.ms ?? (kind === "error" ? 6000 : 2400);
    toast(message, kind, timeout);
  }) as EventListener);
}
```

```ts
import { getProjection } from "../features/camera-tools";
/** Blender-style thin status bar (bottom) — cursor readout + project state. */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  getCurrentProject, isDirty, getDetachedModelCount, onProjectChanged,
} from "../modules/projects/projects";
import { getActiveTool, getElementCount } from "../features/authoring";

const bar = document.createElement("div");
bar.className = "bb-status";

const left = document.createElement("div");
left.className = "bb-status__seg";

const spacer = document.createElement("div");
spacer.className = "bb-status__spacer";

const center = document.createElement("div");
center.className = "bb-status__seg";

const coordsSeg = document.createElement("div");
coordsSeg.className = "bb-status__seg";
coordsSeg.dataset.obsCoords = "1";
coordsSeg.style.cssText =
  "font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.3px;" +
  "min-width:260px;justify-content:flex-end";
coordsSeg.textContent = "X —   Y —   Z —  (Revit: Z↑)";

const spacer2 = document.createElement("div");
spacer2.className = "bb-status__spacer";

const right = document.createElement("div");
right.className = "bb-status__seg";

bar.append(left, spacer, center, coordsSeg, spacer2, right);

const esc = (s: string) =>
  s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);

const TOOL_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  select: "Select", wall: "Wall", slab: "Slab", column: "Column",
  beam: "Beam", brace: "Brace", truss: "Truss", footing: "Footing",
  strip: "Strip", mline: "Model line", duct: "Duct", pipe: "Pipe",
  "cable-tray": "Cable tray", conduit: "Conduit", equipment: "Equipment",
  grid: "Grid", level: "Level", door: "Door", window: "Window",
  move: "Move", copy: "Copy", rotate: "Rotate", mirror: "Mirror",
  array: "Array", offset: "Offset",
};

function kbd(label: string) {
  return `<span class="bb-status__kbd">${label}</span>`;
}

function update() {
  const tool = getActiveTool();
  left.innerHTML = tool
    ? `<span class="bb-status__accent">${esc(TOOL_LABELS[tool] ?? tool)}</span>` +
      `<span style="opacity:.6">·</span>` +
      `<span>LMB confirm · Esc cancel · Enter end chain</span>`
    : `${kbd("LMB")}<span>Select</span>` +
      `${kbd("MMB")}<span>Pan</span>` +
      `${kbd("⇧MMB")}<span>Orbit</span>` +
      `${kbd("Wheel")}<span>Zoom</span>` +
      `${kbd("RMB")}<span>Menu</span>` +
      `${kbd("LMB drag")}<span>Window / Crossing</span>`;

  const models = ctx.fragments.list.size;
  const objects = getElementCount();
  const proj = getProjection();
  center.innerHTML =
    `<span style="opacity:.55">Models</span> <b>${models}</b>` +
    `<span style="opacity:.4">·</span>` +
    `<span style="opacity:.55">Objects</span> <b>${objects}</b>` +
    `<span style="opacity:.4">·</span>` +
    `<span style="opacity:.55">${proj === "orthographic" ? "Orthographic" : "Perspective"}</span>`;

  const p = getCurrentProject();
  const detached = getDetachedModelCount();
  right.innerHTML =
    (detached ? `<span style="color:#dca642">⚠ ${detached} detached</span><span style="opacity:.4">·</span>` : "") +
    (p
      ? `<span style="opacity:.55">${esc(p.projectNumber || "Project") }:</span> <b>${esc(p.name)}</b>` +
        `<span style="opacity:.4">·</span><span style="opacity:.55">${esc((p.units ?? "metric").toUpperCase())}</span>` +
        `<span style="opacity:.4">·</span>` +
        (isDirty()
          ? ` <span style="color:#dca642">● unsaved</span>`
          : ` <span style="color:#7bb040">● saved</span>`)
      : `<span style="opacity:.55">No project</span>`) +
    `<span style="opacity:.4">·</span>` +
    `<span style="opacity:.55">Open BIM Studio v52</span>`;
}

export function setupStatusBar() {
  (document.getElementById("app") as HTMLElement).appendChild(bar);
  onProjectChanged(update);
  setInterval(update, 1200);
  update();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Floating viewport toolbar (Navisworks/Blender class).
 *
 * Placed top-center of the 3D view. Contains, left to right:
 *   - Selection filter dropdown
 *   - Select all / Clear / Invert / Select similar
 *   - Snap toggle + grid size
 *   - Gizmo mode (Move | Rotate | Scale | None)
 *   - Undo / Redo
 *   - Selection count pill
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { history } from "../features/history";
import { selection } from "../features/selection";
import { snapping } from "../features/snapping";
import { gizmo, type GizmoMode } from "../features/gizmo";

const T_BAR = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:4px";
const T_BTN = "display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;transition:background .12s,border-color .12s,color .12s";
const T_BTN_ON = T_BTN + ";background:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)";
const T_SEP = "width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--border-default);margin:0 4px";
const T_SELECT = "height:28px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--bg-inset);border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-primary);font:500 11px system-ui;cursor:pointer;max-width:190px";

let snapOn = false;

export function setupViewportToolbar() {
  // Removed from platform UI (selection filter / top floating bar).
  // Snaps, gizmo, undo remain available via ribbon / shortcuts / context menu.
  console.log("[viewport-toolbar] disabled");
  return;
  const host = ctx.rightHost; // VIEWPORT_TOOLBAR_DISABLED


  const bar = document.createElement("div");
  bar.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:55;display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--bg-floating);border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);user-select:none;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)";
  bar.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

  // ── Selection filter ──
  const filterSel = document.createElement("select");
  filterSel.style.cssText = T_SELECT;
  filterSel.title = "Selection filter (by category)";
  filterSel.innerHTML = `<option value="">All categories</option>`;
  filterSel.onchange = () => {
    const v = filterSel.value;
    selection.setFilter(v ? [v] : null);
  };

  async function refreshFilterOptions() {
    const cats = new Set<string>();
    for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      try {
        const c = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
        for (const k of Object.keys(c ?? {})) cats.add(k);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
    const cur = filterSel.value;
    filterSel.innerHTML =
      `<option value="">All categories</option>` +
      [...cats]
        .sort()
        .map((c) => {
          const nice = c.replace(/^IFC/i, "");
          return `<option value="${c}">${nice}</option>`;
        })
        .join("");
    filterSel.value = cur;
  }
  ctx.fragments.list.onItemSet.add(() => {
    void refreshFilterOptions();
  });

  // ── Selection ops ──
  const btnSelectAll = mkIconBtn("⬛", "Select all", () => void selection.selectAll());
  const btnInvert = mkIconBtn("⇄", "Invert selection", () => void selection.invert());
  const btnClear = mkIconBtn("✕", "Clear selection", async () => {
    selection.clear();
    await selection.applyToHighlighter();
  });

  // ── Snap ──
  const btnSnap = mkIconBtn("⌖", "Toggle object snap", () => {
    snapOn = !snapOn;
    snapping.setEnabled(snapOn);
    updateSnapVisual();
  });
  function updateSnapVisual() {
    btnSnap.style.cssText = snapOn ? T_BTN_ON : T_BTN;
  }

  const gridSel = document.createElement("select");
  gridSel.style.cssText = T_SELECT + ";max-width:78px;font-size:10.5px";
  gridSel.title = "Snap grid size";
  gridSel.innerHTML = `
    <option value="1">1 m</option>
    <option value="0.5">500 mm</option>
    <option value="0.25">250 mm</option>
    <option value="0.1" selected>100 mm</option>
    <option value="0.05">50 mm</option>
    <option value="0.01">10 mm</option>`;
  gridSel.onchange = () => snapping.setGridSize(Number(gridSel.value) || 0.1);

  // ── Gizmo mode ──
  const btnMove = mkIconBtn("↔", "Move (G)", () => setGizmo("move"));
  const btnRotate = mkIconBtn("⟳", "Rotate (R)", () => setGizmo("rotate"));
  const btnScale = mkIconBtn("⤢", "Scale (S)", () => setGizmo("scale"));
  const btnNone = mkIconBtn("▣", "Selection mode (Q)", () => setGizmo("none"));

  function setGizmo(mode: GizmoMode) {
    gizmo.setMode(mode);
    btnMove.style.cssText = mode === "move" ? T_BTN_ON : T_BTN;
    btnRotate.style.cssText = mode === "rotate" ? T_BTN_ON : T_BTN;
    btnScale.style.cssText = mode === "scale" ? T_BTN_ON : T_BTN;
    btnNone.style.cssText = mode === "none" ? T_BTN_ON : T_BTN;
  }
  setGizmo("none");

  // ── Undo / Redo ──
  const btnUndo = mkIconBtn("↶", "Undo (Ctrl+Z)", () => void history.undo());
  const btnRedo = mkIconBtn("↷", "Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)", () => void history.redo());
  history.onChange(() => {
    btnUndo.style.opacity = history.canUndo() ? "1" : "0.35";
    btnRedo.style.opacity = history.canRedo() ? "1" : "0.35";
    const ul = history.undoLabel();
    const rl = history.redoLabel();
    btnUndo.title = ul ? `Undo ${ul} (Ctrl+Z)` : "Undo (Ctrl+Z)";
    btnRedo.title = rl ? `Redo ${rl} (Ctrl+Shift+Z)` : "Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)";
  });

  // ── Selection count ──
  const count = document.createElement("div");
  count.style.cssText =
    "display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;height:30px;background:var(--bg-inset);border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:6px;font:600 11px var(--font-mono);color:var(--text-secondary);min-width:44px;justify-content:center";
  count.title = "Selection size";
  selection.onChange(() => {
    const n = selection.size();
    count.textContent = n === 0 ? "0" : n.toLocaleString();
    count.style.color = n ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--text-tertiary)";
    count.style.borderColor = n ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--border-default)";
  });

  // ── Assemble ──
  bar.append(
    filterSel,
    sep(),
    btnSelectAll,
    btnInvert,
    btnClear,
    sep(),
    btnSnap,
    gridSel,
    sep(),
    btnMove,
    btnRotate,
    btnScale,
    btnNone,
    sep(),
    btnUndo,
    btnRedo,
    sep(),
    count,
  );

  host.appendChild(bar);
  void refreshFilterOptions();
  history.onChange(() => {}); // primes initial button state

  // Expose for external shortcuts
  (window as any).__obs_setGizmo = setGizmo;
}

function mkIconBtn(icon: string, title: string, onclick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.style.cssText = T_BTN;
  b.title = title;
  b.textContent = icon;
  b.onclick = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onclick();
  };
  b.onmouseenter = () => {
    if (!b.style.cssText.includes("accent")) b.style.background = "var(--bg-hover)";
  };
  b.onmouseleave = () => {
    if (!b.style.cssText.includes("accent")) b.style.background = "transparent";
  };
  return b;
}
function sep(): HTMLDivElement {
  const d = document.createElement("div");
  d.style.cssText = "width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--border-default);margin:0 4px";
  return d;
}
```
