--- FILE: src/style.css ---
```css
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Open BIM Studio — Design System
   Dark, AEC-professional.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

:root {
  /* Surfaces */
  --bg-base:      #0B0D12;
  --bg-surface:   #12141B;
  --bg-elevated:  #181A23;
  --bg-floating:  #1C1E28;
  --bg-hover:     #232633;
  --bg-active:    #2A2E3D;
  --bg-inset:     #0E1017;

  /* Borders */
  --border-subtle:  #1E2029;
  --border-default: #2A2E3A;
  --border-strong:  #3D4250;
  --border-focus:   #38BDF8;

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:   #E8EAF0;
  --text-secondary: #A0A6B5;
  --text-tertiary:  #6B7280;
  --text-disabled:  #4B5563;
  --text-inverse:   #0B0D12;

  /* Accents */
  --accent:         #38BDF8;
  --accent-hover:   #0EA5E9;
  --accent-press:   #0284C7;
  --accent-dim:     rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);
  --accent-glow:    rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);

  --success:        #22C55E;
  --success-dim:    rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15);
  --warning:        #F59E0B;
  --warning-dim:    rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  --danger:         #EF4444;
  --danger-dim:     rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
  --info:           #818CF8;
  --info-dim:       rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.15);

  --font-sans: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
               system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo,
               Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;

  --sp-1: 4px;  --sp-2: 8px;  --sp-3: 12px; --sp-4: 16px;
  --sp-5: 20px; --sp-6: 24px; --sp-8: 32px;

  --r-sm: 4px; --r-md: 6px; --r-lg: 8px; --r-xl: 12px; --r-pill: 999px;

  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --shadow-xl: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);

  /* pyRevit ribbon geometry */
  --rbb-rows:    2;
  --rbb-btn-w:  52px;
  --rbb-btn-h:  36px;
  --rbb-gap:     2px;
  --rbb-icon:   16px;
  --rbb-label:   9px;

  --h-strip: calc(
    (var(--rbb-btn-h) * var(--rbb-rows))
    + (var(--rbb-gap) * (var(--rbb-rows) - 1))
    + 16px
    + 14px
  );

  --h-tabs:   32px;
  --h-status: 24px;

  --z-ribbon:  40; --z-panel: 60; --z-menu: 100;
  --z-float:   36; --z-modal: 250; --z-overlay: 300;

  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --dur:  140ms;
}

/* ── Reset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body, #app {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-base);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

::selection { background: var(--accent-glow); color: var(--text-primary); }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; background: none; border: none; }
canvas { outline: none; display: block; }

/* ── Scrollbars ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--border-strong);
  background-clip: padding-box;
}
* { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--border-default) transparent; }

:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BUI — Left panel (the "BIM side panel")
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Tokens on the outer panel */
bim-panel {
  --bim-ui_bg-base:        var(--bg-surface);
  --bim-ui_bg-contrast-10: var(--bg-base);
  --bim-ui_bg-contrast-20: var(--bg-elevated);
  --bim-ui_bg-contrast-30: var(--bg-hover);
  --bim-ui_bg-contrast-40: var(--bg-active);

  --bim-ui_main-base:      var(--accent);
  --bim-ui_accent-base:    var(--accent);
  --bim-ui_accent-light:   var(--accent-hover);

  --bim-ui_text-base:      var(--text-primary);
  --bim-ui_text-contrast:  var(--text-secondary);
  --bim-ui_outline-base:   var(--border-default);
  --bim-ui_divider-base:   var(--border-subtle);

  /* Panel-specific */
  --bim-panel_section-bg:  var(--bg-surface);
  --bim-panel_section-outline-color: var(--border-subtle);

  font-family: var(--font-sans) !important;
  background: var(--bg-base) !important;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* Panel top header (label + chevron) */
bim-panel > bim-panel-section[label]::part(title),
bim-panel::part(header) {
  /* fallback */
}

/* ── Section ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
bim-panel-section {
  display: block;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  overflow: visible;
}

/* Reset BUI's default section outline */
bim-panel-section::part(content),
bim-panel-section > * { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }

/* The internal shadow-DOM header — reached via ::part where supported */
bim-panel-section::part(title) {
  font: 600 12.5px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  letter-spacing: 0.1px;
}

/* Section content spacing — BUI wraps content in a slot div */
bim-panel-section > *:not([slot]) {
  padding: 0;
}

/* Add our own padding at the section wrapper level to be safe */
bim-panel-section::part(wrapper) {
  padding: 12px;
}

/* Give buttons/inputs a consistent vertical rhythm inside sections */
bim-panel-section > bim-button,
bim-panel-section > bim-checkbox,
bim-panel-section > bim-text-input,
bim-panel-section > bim-number-input,
bim-panel-section > bim-dropdown {
  display: block;
  margin: 6px 10px;
}

/* Plain divs we slotted in the panel (queue, descriptions, etc.) */
bim-panel-section > div {
  margin: 6px 10px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

/* Preserve our inline margins (queue summary etc.) */
bim-panel-section > div[style*="font-size:11px"] { padding: 0; }

/* ── Buttons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
bim-button {
  --bim-button_bg:              var(--bg-elevated);
  --bim-button_bg-hover:        var(--bg-hover);
  --bim-button_text:            var(--text-primary);
  --bim-button_border:          var(--border-default);
  --bim-button_outline:         var(--border-default);
  --bim-button_padding:         0 12px;
  --bim-button_border-radius:   var(--r-md);
  --bim-button_text-size:       12px;
  --bim-button_height:          32px;

  display: block !important;
  width: calc(100% - 20px) !important;
  margin: 6px 10px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-sans) !important;
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur) var(--ease);
}

bim-button:hover {
  --bim-button_bg: var(--bg-hover);
  --bim-button_border: var(--border-strong);
}

/* Primary-looking buttons (matching a keyword) */
bim-button[label*="Import IFC"],
bim-button[label*="Run Test"],
bim-button[label*="Fit"] {
  --bim-button_bg: var(--accent-dim);
  --bim-button_text: var(--accent);
  --bim-button_border: var(--accent);
}

/* ── Checkboxes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
bim-checkbox {
  --bim-checkbox_bg:            transparent;
  --bim-checkbox_text:          var(--text-secondary);
  --bim-checkbox_outline:       var(--border-default);
  --bim-checkbox_border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  --bim-checkbox_check-bg:      var(--accent);

  display: block !important;
  width: calc(100% - 20px) !important;
  margin: 6px 10px !important;
  font: 11.5px var(--font-sans) !important;
}
bim-checkbox:hover { --bim-checkbox_text: var(--text-primary); }

/* ── Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
bim-text-input, bim-number-input {
  --bim-input_bg:            var(--bg-inset);
  --bim-input_border:        var(--border-default);
  --bim-input_text:          var(--text-primary);
  --bim-input_border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  --bim-input_height:        30px;

  display: block !important;
  width: calc(100% - 20px) !important;
  margin: 6px 10px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-sans) !important;
}

bim-number-input[slider] {
  --bim-input_bg: transparent;
  --bim-input_border: transparent;
}

/* ── Dropdowns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
bim-dropdown {
  --bim-dropdown_bg: var(--bg-elevated);
  --bim-dropdown_text: var(--text-primary);
  --bim-dropdown_border: var(--border-default);
  font-family: var(--font-sans) !important;
}

/* ── Section header (rendered in shadow DOM) ─────────────────────── */
/* The chevron and title live inside the shadow root; we style via the
   exposed slots and CSS variables that BUI reads. */
bim-panel-section {
  --bim-ui_outline-base: var(--border-subtle);
  --bim-ui_bg-contrast-10: var(--bg-base);
}

/* The section header container: BUI uses a <header> inside the shadow root.
   Because we cannot pierce it directly, we rely on the fact that the
   collapsed state hides content via `[collapsed]` — see below. */

/* Hide slotted content when the section is collapsed — BUI only hides its
   shadow DOM children by default, not our plain divs. */
bim-panel-section[collapsed] > *,
bim-panel-section[data-collapsed] > * { display: none !important; }

bim-panel-section[collapsed],
bim-panel-section[data-collapsed] { overflow: hidden; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   pyRevit-style ribbon
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.obs-ribbon {
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease;
  width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-base) 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  user-select: none;
  z-index: var(--z-ribbon);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}

/* Revit-style minimized ribbon: only tabs row visible (flat / shrunk) */
.obs-ribbon--minimized {
  box-shadow: none;
}
.obs-ribbon--minimized .obs-ribbon__strip {
  display: none !important;
  height: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.obs-ribbon--minimized .obs-ribbon__tabs {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.obs-ribbon__tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  height: var(--h-tabs);
  padding: 0 var(--sp-2);
  gap: 1px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-base);
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.obs-ribbon__tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.obs-ribbon__brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  padding-right: var(--sp-3);
  margin-right: var(--sp-3);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  font: 600 12px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.obs-ribbon__brand::before {
  content: "";
  width: 14px; height: 14px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: conic-gradient(from 210deg at 50% 50%,
    var(--accent) 0deg, var(--info) 120deg, var(--accent) 240deg);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
}

.obs-ribbon__tab {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 var(--sp-3);
  font: 500 12px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: color var(--dur) var(--ease), background var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.obs-ribbon__tab:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-hover); }
.obs-ribbon__tab[data-active="1"] { color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg-surface); }
.obs-ribbon__tab[data-active="1"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--sp-2); right: var(--sp-2); bottom: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: var(--r-pill) var(--r-pill) 0 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
}
.obs-ribbon__tab--file { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
.obs-ribbon__tab--file[data-active="1"] { background: var(--info-dim); color: var(--info); }
.obs-ribbon__tab--file[data-active="1"]::after { background: var(--info); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--info); }

.obs-ribbon__pill {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  padding: 0 var(--sp-3);
  font: 500 11px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.obs-ribbon__pill .dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--success);
}
.obs-ribbon__pill .dot.dirty { background: var(--warning); box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--warning); }

.obs-ribbon__strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 0;
  padding: 7px var(--sp-2) 7px var(--sp-2);
  height: var(--h-strip);
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-default) transparent;
}
.obs-ribbon__strip::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 5px; }
.obs-ribbon__strip::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 3px; }
.obs-ribbon__strip:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-default); }

.obs-ribbon-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 4px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  min-width: 0;
  flex: none;
  height: 100%;
}
.obs-ribbon-group:last-child { border-right: none; }

.obs-ribbon-group__body {
  flex: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-auto-flow: column;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(var(--rbb-rows), var(--rbb-btn-h));
  grid-auto-columns: var(--rbb-btn-w);
  gap: var(--rbb-gap);
  align-content: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

.obs-ribbon-group__label {
  text-align: center;
  font: 500 9px var(--font-sans);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  padding-top: 3px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0.65;
  flex: none;
}

.obs-rb {
  width: var(--rbb-btn-w);
  height: var(--rbb-btn-h);
  padding: 3px 2px 2px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease),
              color var(--dur) var(--ease),
              border-color var(--dur) var(--ease),
              transform var(--dur) var(--ease);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex: none;
}
.obs-rb:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
}
.obs-rb:active { background: var(--bg-active); transform: scale(0.96); }
.obs-rb[data-active="1"] {
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 6px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.10);
}

.obs-rb__icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--rbb-icon);
  height: var(--rbb-icon);
  color: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  flex: none;
}
.obs-rb__icon svg {
  display: block;
  width: var(--rbb-icon);
  height: var(--rbb-icon);
  stroke: currentColor;
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 1.9;
}
.obs-rb__icon svg [fill="currentColor"] { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; }
.obs-rb__icon svg path[fill="currentColor"][stroke="none"] { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; }

.obs-rb__label {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--rbb-label);
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: inherit;
  letter-spacing: 0.1px;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 1px;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.obs-rb[data-active="1"] .obs-rb__label { color: var(--accent); opacity: 1; }
.obs-rb:hover .obs-rb__label { opacity: 1; }

.obs-rb[data-planned="1"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px; right: 3px;
  width: 3px; height: 3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--warning);
  opacity: 0.75;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px var(--warning);
}
.obs-rb[data-planned="1"]:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
.obs-rb[data-planned="1"]:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }

.obs-level-input {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 0 3px;
  font: 500 9px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  align-self: stretch;
  height: var(--rbb-btn-h);
  min-width: 52px;
}
.obs-level-input input {
  width: 52px;
  padding: 2px 3px;
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font: 500 10px var(--font-mono);
  text-align: center;
}
.obs-level-input input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-dim);
}

.obs-ribbon-hint {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 var(--sp-3);
  font: 400 10.5px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  white-space: nowrap;
  max-width: 260px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  flex: none;
}

/* ── Status bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.bb-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: var(--h-status);
  flex: none;
  background: var(--bg-base);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  padding: 0 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  gap: 12px;
  user-select: none;
}
.bb-status__seg { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.bb-status__kbd {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  padding: 0 4px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 14px;
  height: 14px;
}
.bb-status__spacer { flex: 1; min-width: 12px; }
.bb-status__accent { color: var(--accent-hover); font-weight: 600; }

/* ── Home screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.obs-home {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-overlay);
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% -10%, rgba(56,189,248,0.09), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 20% 100%, rgba(129,140,248,0.06), transparent 60%),
    var(--bg-base);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--sp-10, 40px) var(--sp-6);
}
.obs-home.is-open { display: flex; }

.obs-home__inner {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 880px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--sp-8);
}

.obs-home__hero {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-2);
  padding: var(--sp-6) 0 var(--sp-4);
  text-align: center;
}
.obs-home__logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sp-3);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}
.obs-home__logo-mark {
  width: 46px; height: 46px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: conic-gradient(from 210deg at 50% 50%,
    var(--accent) 0deg, var(--info) 120deg, var(--accent) 240deg);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--accent-glow), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
.obs-home__title {
  font: 700 34px/1.05 var(--font-sans);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E8EAF0 0%, #9AA3B5 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}
.obs-home__subtitle {
  font: 400 13.5px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 520px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.obs-home__version {
  font: 500 11px var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.obs-home__new {
  display: flex; gap: var(--sp-2);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--sp-2);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}
.obs-home__new input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  background: transparent; border: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font: 500 14px var(--font-sans);
  outline: none;
}
.obs-home__new input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.obs-home__new button {
  padding: 0 var(--sp-5);
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font: 600 13px var(--font-sans);
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), transform var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.obs-home__new button:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); }
.obs-home__new button:active { transform: scale(0.985); }

.obs-home__section-title {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between;
  font: 600 12px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.9px;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
}
.obs-home__section-count {
  font: 500 11px var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.obs-home__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--sp-3);
}
.obs-card {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-2);
  padding: var(--sp-4);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color var(--dur) var(--ease),
              background var(--dur) var(--ease),
              transform var(--dur) var(--ease),
              box-shadow var(--dur) var(--ease);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.obs-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}
.obs-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.obs-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.obs-card__icon {
  width: 34px; height: 34px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-1);
}
.obs-card__title {
  font: 600 13.5px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
}
.obs-card__meta {
  font: 400 11px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  display: flex; gap: var(--sp-3); flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.obs-card__meta .sep { color: var(--border-strong); }
.obs-card__actions {
  display: flex; gap: var(--sp-1);
  margin-top: var(--sp-2);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.obs-card:hover .obs-card__actions { opacity: 1; }
.obs-empty {
  padding: var(--sp-8);
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  font-size: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.005);
}
.obs-empty strong {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.obs-home__footer {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding-top: var(--sp-5);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  font: 400 11px var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-3);
}
.obs-home__footer kbd {
  font: 500 10px var(--font-mono);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

/* ── Small utility buttons ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.obs-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font: 500 12px var(--font-sans);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.obs-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.obs-btn--primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
.obs-btn--primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); }
.obs-btn--danger {
  background: var(--danger-dim);
  color: #FCA5A5;
  border-color: var(--danger);
}
.obs-btn--ghost { background: transparent; }
.obs-btn--sm { padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 11px; }

.obs-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 6px 9px;
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font: 400 12px var(--font-sans);
}
.obs-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-dim);
}

/* ── Badges ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.obs-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  font: 600 10px var(--font-sans);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.obs-badge--accent  { background: var(--accent-dim);  color: var(--accent); }
.obs-badge--success { background: var(--success-dim); color: var(--success); }
.obs-badge--warning { background: var(--warning-dim); color: var(--warning); }
.obs-badge--danger  { background: var(--danger-dim);  color: var(--danger); }
.obs-badge--info    { background: var(--info-dim);    color: var(--info); }

/* ── Toasts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.obs-toast-host {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 46px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  gap: 6px; pointer-events: none;
}
.obs-toast {
  pointer-events: auto;
  background: var(--bg-floating);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font: 12px var(--font-sans);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  max-width: 480px;
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px);
  animation: obs-toast-in .18s ease forwards;
}
.obs-toast[data-kind="warn"]    { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.obs-toast[data-kind="info"]    { border-left-color: var(--info); }
.obs-toast[data-kind="success"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
@keyframes obs-toast-in { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.obs-toast.obs-toast--out { animation: obs-toast-out .2s ease forwards; }
@keyframes obs-toast-out { to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } }

/* ── Collapsed BUI section content must hide slotted plain divs too ─ */
bim-panel-section[collapsed] > *,
bim-panel-section[data-collapsed] > * { display: none !important; }
bim-panel-section[collapsed],
bim-panel-section[data-collapsed] { overflow: hidden; }
bim-panel-section > * { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v46 productization — project center, workspace selector & metadata modal
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.obs-ribbon__brand { gap: 7px; }
.obs-ribbon__version {
  font: 600 8px/1 var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-dim);
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  padding: 3px 5px;
  letter-spacing: .3px;
}
.obs-ribbon__pill {
  min-width: 360px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 7px;
}
.obs-ribbon__project-status {
  font: 700 8px/1 var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: .5px;
  padding: 3px 5px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
}
.obs-ribbon__project-status.is-saved { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-dim); border-color: rgba(34,197,94,.25); }
.obs-ribbon__project-status.is-dirty { color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-dim); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.28); }
.obs-ribbon__project-name {
  max-width: 180px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.obs-ribbon__pill-divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: var(--border-subtle); }
.obs-ribbon__workspace-hint { color: var(--text-tertiary); white-space: nowrap; }
.obs-workspace-select {
  appearance: none;
  min-width: 105px;
  max-width: 145px;
  padding: 5px 21px 5px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font: 600 10px var(--font-sans);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.obs-workspace-select:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--bg-hover); }

/* Project Center */
.obs-project-center { max-width: 1180px; gap: 20px; padding-bottom: 28px; }
.obs-center-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 8px 0 2px;
}
.obs-center-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; }
.obs-center-mark {
  width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: conic-gradient(from 220deg, var(--accent), var(--info), var(--accent));
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--accent-glow), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
.obs-center-title { font: 700 21px/1.1 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.obs-center-subtitle { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
.obs-center-header-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
.obs-center-badge, .obs-center-version {
  font: 700 8px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .55px; padding: 5px 7px;
  border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.obs-center-badge { color: var(--accent); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,.22); background: var(--accent-dim); }
.obs-center-badge--muted { color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--bg-surface); border-color: var(--border-subtle); }
.obs-center-version { color: var(--text-tertiary); }

.obs-kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.obs-kpi {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24,26,35,.96), rgba(18,20,27,.96));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 14px 15px;
  min-height: 88px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.obs-kpi::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; right: -20px; top: -24px; width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-dim), transparent 65%);
}
.obs-kpi span { display: block; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .7px; }
.obs-kpi strong { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font: 700 25px/1 var(--font-mono); color: var(--text-primary); }
.obs-kpi small { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }

.obs-command-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: 12px; }
.obs-command-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--bg-surface); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 17px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.obs-command-card--primary {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(56,189,248,.12), transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-base));
  border-color: rgba(56,189,248,.18);
}
.obs-command-eyebrow { color: var(--accent); font: 700 9px var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .8px; }
.obs-command-card h2 { margin-top: 7px; font: 700 17px var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.obs-command-card p { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 610px; }
.obs-create-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 145px auto; gap: 7px; margin-top: 14px; }
.obs-create-row input, .obs-create-row select {
  min-width: 0; height: 36px; border-radius: var(--r-md); border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--bg-inset); color: var(--text-primary); padding: 0 10px; outline: none;
}
.obs-create-row input:focus, .obs-create-row select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-dim); }
.obs-create-row select { font-size: 10px; }
.obs-create-hint { margin-top: 7px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }

.obs-workspace-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 7px; margin-top: 10px; }
.obs-workspace-card {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: start; gap: 8px; text-align: left;
  padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--bg-base);
  color: var(--text-primary); transition: border-color var(--dur) var(--ease), background var(--dur) var(--ease), transform var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.obs-workspace-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--bg-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.obs-workspace-card__marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 9px var(--accent-glow); }
.obs-workspace-card b { display: block; font-size: 11px; }
.obs-workspace-card small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 1.4; }
.obs-workspace-card__arrow { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 13px; }

.obs-project-card { min-height: 176px; }
.obs-project-card__top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.obs-project-card .obs-card__icon { font: 700 8px var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .5px; }
.obs-project-status {
  font: 700 8px var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .45px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 3px 5px;
  background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-tertiary);
}
.obs-project-status--active { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-dim); border-color: rgba(34,197,94,.22); }
.obs-project-status--on-hold { color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-dim); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.22); }
.obs-project-status--complete { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-dim); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,.22); }
.obs-project-status--archived { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.obs-project-card__template { color: var(--accent); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; }
.obs-project-card__identity { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

/* Project metadata dialog */
.obs-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: var(--z-modal); display: none; place-items: center;
  padding: 22px; background: rgba(4,6,10,.66); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.obs-modal-overlay.is-open { display: grid; }
.obs-modal {
  width: min(760px, 100%); max-height: min(760px, calc(100vh - 44px)); overflow: auto;
  background: var(--bg-floating); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}
.obs-modal__header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 19px 20px 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.obs-modal__eyebrow { font: 700 8px var(--font-mono); color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .8px; }
.obs-modal h2 { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 18px; }
.obs-modal p { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
.obs-modal__close { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: var(--r-md); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 20px; }
.obs-modal__close:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--text-primary); }
.obs-modal__body { padding: 18px 20px; display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.obs-meta-section { padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: var(--bg-surface); }
.obs-meta-section__title { font: 700 10px var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .65px; color: var(--text-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.obs-meta-grid { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.obs-meta-grid--2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
.obs-meta-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.obs-meta-field > span { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }
.obs-meta-field input, .obs-meta-field select, .obs-meta-field textarea {
  width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--bg-inset); color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 8px 9px; outline: none; resize: vertical;
}
.obs-meta-field input:focus, .obs-meta-field select:focus, .obs-meta-field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-dim); }
.obs-meta-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 6px; }
.obs-meta-facts div { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--bg-base); padding: 9px; }
.obs-meta-facts span { display: block; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; }
.obs-meta-facts b { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font: 700 16px var(--font-mono); }
.obs-modal__footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.obs-modal__dirty { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }
.obs-modal__actions { display: flex; gap: 7px; }

@media (max-width: 940px) {
  .obs-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .obs-command-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .obs-ribbon__pill { min-width: 260px; }
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .obs-home { padding: 22px 12px; }
  .obs-center-header { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
  .obs-center-header-meta { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .obs-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .obs-create-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .obs-workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .obs-meta-grid--2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .obs-meta-facts { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
  .obs-modal__footer { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .obs-modal__actions { justify-content: flex-end; }
}


/* v47 — cross-discipline BIM Command Center */
#obs-bim-toolbox {
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
#obs-bim-toolbox input:focus, #obs-bim-toolbox select:focus {
  outline: 1px solid var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
#obs-bim-toolbox section button:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v50 — Reliable BIM interaction layer
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.obs-revit-contextual,
.obs-revit-options,
.obs-revit-viewbar,
.obs-revit-prompt,
.obs-revit-hovercard {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 180;
  font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif);
}

.obs-revit-contextual {
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(96%, 1180px);
  min-height: 30px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 4px 7px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(217,70,239,.28);
  border-top: 0;
  border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(78,35,83,.96), rgba(40,25,45,.96));
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.obs-revit-contextual[data-visible="0"] { display:none; }
.obs-rv-context-title {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: .2px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 4px 7px;
  color: #f5d0fe;
}
.obs-rv-context-title__accent { color: #f0abfc; }

.obs-revit-options {
  top: 35px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(96%, 1180px);
  min-height: 32px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(18,20,27,.94);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.obs-revit-options[data-visible="0"] { display:none; }
.obs-revit-viewbar[data-visible="0"] { display:none !important; }
.obs-options-title, .obs-rv-options-title {
  min-width: 80px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 750;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.obs-rv-label { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; white-space: nowrap; }
.obs-rv-sep { width:1px; height:21px; background:var(--border-subtle); margin:0 3px; flex:0 0 auto; }
.obs-rv-btn {
  min-height: 25px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 3px 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font: 600 9px var(--font-sans,system-ui);
  cursor:pointer;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.obs-rv-btn:hover { background:var(--bg-hover); border-color:var(--border-default); color:var(--text-primary); }
.obs-rv-btn[data-active="1"] { background:var(--accent-dim); border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.36); color:var(--accent); }
.obs-rv-btn__glyph { font: 700 11px var(--font-mono, monospace); }
.obs-rv-select {
  height: 25px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 0 6px;
  font: 600 9px var(--font-sans, system-ui);
  outline:none;
}
.obs-rv-select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent-dim); }
.obs-rv-number {
  height:25px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:3px;
  color:var(--text-tertiary);
  font-size:9px;
}
.obs-rv-number input {
  width:58px;
  height:25px;
  padding:0 5px;
  border:1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius:5px;
  background:var(--bg-inset);
  color:var(--text-primary);
  font:600 9px var(--font-mono, monospace);
  outline:none;
}
.obs-rv-number input:focus { border-color:var(--accent); }

.obs-revit-viewbar {
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  min-height: 34px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:4px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: rgba(15,17,23,.96);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  pointer-events:auto;
}
.obs-revit-prompt {
  left:50%;
  bottom:42px;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  max-width:min(760px,80%);
  padding:5px 10px;
  color:#dbeafe;
  background:rgba(9,11,16,.90);
  border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.24);
  border-radius:999px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  font-size:10px;
  white-space:nowrap;
  overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.obs-revit-prompt[data-visible="0"] { display:none; }

.obs-revit-hovercard {
  min-width:160px;
  max-width:260px;
  padding:7px 9px;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:2px;
  background:rgba(19,21,29,.96);
  border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.32);
  border-radius:7px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.obs-revit-hovercard[data-visible="0"] { display:none; }
.obs-revit-hovercard b { color:var(--text-primary); font-size:10px; }
.obs-revit-hovercard span { color:var(--accent); font:600 9px var(--font-mono,monospace); }
.obs-revit-hovercard em { color:var(--text-tertiary); font:9px var(--font-sans,system-ui); font-style:normal; margin-top:3px; }

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .obs-revit-options, .obs-revit-contextual { width: 94%; }
  .obs-rv-btn span:last-child { display:none; }
  .obs-revit-viewbar .obs-rv-btn span:last-child { display:none; }
}

/* v50 dialogs */
.obs-revit-dialog-host {
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:12000; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:22px;
  background:rgba(4,6,10,.68); backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
}
.obs-revit-dialog-host[data-visible="0"] { display:none; }
.obs-revit-dialog {
  width:min(780px,96vw); max-height:86vh; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:var(--bg-floating,#1b1d26); border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#363a48); border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:0 35px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.56);
}
.obs-revit-dialog__header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; padding:18px 20px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.obs-revit-dialog__eyebrow { color:var(--accent); font:700 8px var(--font-mono,monospace); letter-spacing:.8px; }
.obs-revit-dialog__header h2 { margin-top:5px; font-size:18px; }
.obs-revit-dialog__header p { margin-top:4px; color:var(--text-tertiary); font-size:10.5px; }
.obs-revit-dialog__close { width:30px; height:30px; border:1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:20px; cursor:pointer; }
.obs-revit-dialog__close:hover { background:var(--bg-hover); color:var(--text-primary); }
.obs-revit-dialog__body { padding:16px 20px; overflow:auto; }
.obs-revit-dialog__footer { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:12px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.obs-revit-dialog__hint { flex:1; color:var(--text-tertiary); font-size:9.5px; }
.obs-revit-dialog-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:9px; }
.obs-revit-field { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:9px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border-subtle); background:var(--bg-surface); border-radius:7px; color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:10px; }
.obs-revit-field input[type=number], .obs-revit-field input[type=text] { width:110px; border:1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius:5px; background:var(--bg-inset); color:var(--text-primary); padding:5px 6px; }
.obs-revit-field input[type=color] { width:46px; height:28px; padding:2px; background:var(--bg-inset); border:1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius:5px; }
.obs-revit-field input[type=range] { width:150px; }
.obs-revit-vg-box { grid-column:1/-1; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:12px; border:1px dashed var(--border-default); border-radius:8px; background:var(--bg-base); }
.obs-revit-vg-box b { font-size:10px; color:var(--text-primary); }
.obs-revit-vg-box .obs-revit-dialog__hint { max-width:390px; }
.obs-revit-template-list { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; }
.obs-revit-template-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto; gap:7px; align-items:center; padding:9px; border:1px solid var(--border-subtle); background:var(--bg-surface); border-radius:7px; }
.obs-revit-template-row div:first-child { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0; }
.obs-revit-template-row b { font-size:10.5px; color:var(--text-primary); }
.obs-revit-template-row span { font-size:9px; color:var(--text-tertiary); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.obs-revit-template-name { flex:1; height:28px; min-width:180px; border:1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius:6px; background:var(--bg-inset); color:var(--text-primary); padding:0 8px; }
.obs-revit-dialog__empty { padding:24px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-tertiary); border:1px dashed var(--border-default); border-radius:8px; font-size:10px; }
@media (max-width:720px) { .obs-revit-dialog-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; } .obs-revit-template-row { grid-template-columns:1fr auto; } .obs-revit-template-row button:last-child { grid-column:2; } }
```

--- FILE: src/styles.css ---
```css
/* ====================================================================
   Open BIM Studio — global stylesheet
   Loaded by src/main.ts (first import). Provides:
     - CSS reset
     - Design-token custom properties used across every panel
     - Root layout (#app + left/right hosts)
     - Toast host (obs-toast / obs-toast-host)
     - Panel chrome (.obs-panel, .obs-panel-header, .obs-panel-body)
     - Automation-panel helpers (.obs-auto-btn, .obs-auto-row)
     - Spin keyframes used by the app loader
   ==================================================================== */

/* ---------- Reset --------------------------------------------------- */
*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  background: var(--bg-root);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

#app {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
}

button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

a {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
}
a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

:focus {
  outline: none;
}
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ---------- Scrollbars --------------------------------------------- */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.24);
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.42);
  background-clip: padding-box;
}
* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28) transparent;
}

/* ---------- Design tokens ------------------------------------------ */
:root {
  /* Fonts. --font-ui is overwritten by core/locale-boot.ts per locale. */
  --font-ui: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto,
    "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono",
    "Noto Sans Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;

  /* Surfaces */
  --bg-root: #0b0d12;
  --bg-floating: #1c1e28;
  --bg-elevated: #181a23;
  --bg-inset: #0e1017;
  --bg-hover: #232633;
  --bg-active: #2c3040;

  /* Borders */
  --border-default: #2a2e3a;
  --border-subtle: #1e2029;
  --border-strong: #3a4050;

  /* Text */
  --text-primary: #e8eaf0;
  --text-secondary: #a0a6b5;
  --text-tertiary: #6b7280;
  --text-disabled: #4b5563;

  /* Accent — sky blue */
  --accent: #38bdf8;
  --accent-dim: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);
  --accent-glow: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
  --accent-contrast: #0b0d12;

  /* Semantic colors */
  --info: #38bdf8;
  --success: #22c55e;
  --warn: #f59e0b;
  --error: #ef4444;

  /* Clash kind colors */
  --clash-intersect: #ef4444;
  --clash-touching: #f59e0b;
  --clash-clearance: #38bdf8;
  --clash-duplicate: #a855f7;

  /* Panel chrome */
  --panel-radius: 10px;
  --panel-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  --panel-header-h: 36px;
}

[data-theme="paper"] {
  --bg-root: #f5f6f8;
  --bg-floating: #ffffff;
  --bg-elevated: #f0f2f5;
  --bg-inset: #e9ecf1;
  --bg-hover: #e3e6ea;
  --bg-active: #d5d8de;
  --border-default: #d5d8de;
  --border-subtle: #e3e6ea;
  --border-strong: #b6bcc6;
  --text-primary: #1a1d23;
  --text-secondary: #4b5563;
  --text-tertiary: #6b7280;
}

/* ---------- Hosts -------------------------------------------------- */
#app > div:first-child {
  background: var(--bg-floating);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default);
}

#app > div:last-child {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

canvas {
  display: block;
  outline: none;
}

/* ---------- Toast host --------------------------------------------- */
.obs-toast-host {
  position: absolute;
  right: 16px;
  bottom: 16px;
  z-index: 9000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
  max-width: min(420px, 60vw);
}

.obs-toast {
  pointer-events: auto;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font: 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-floating);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.obs-toast[data-kind="success"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.obs-toast[data-kind="warn"]    { border-left-color: var(--warn); }
.obs-toast[data-kind="error"]   { border-left-color: var(--error); }
.obs-toast[data-kind="info"]    { border-left-color: var(--info); }

.obs-toast--out {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(6px);
}

/* ---------- Generic panel chrome ----------------------------------- */
.obs-panel {
  background: var(--bg-floating);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--panel-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--panel-shadow);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font: 12px var(--font-ui);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.obs-panel-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  min-height: var(--panel-header-h);
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none;
}

.obs-panel-header:active {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.obs-panel-body {
  padding: 10px;
  overflow: auto;
}

.obs-icon-btn {
  padding: 3px 8px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.obs-icon-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* ---------- Side panel (automation, etc.) -------------------------- */
.obs-side-panel {
  position: fixed;
  top: 48px;
  right: 12px;
  width: 340px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 80px);
  background: var(--bg-floating);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--panel-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--panel-shadow);
  z-index: 8000;
  display: none;
  overflow: auto;
  font: 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
}

/* ---------- Automation panel helpers ------------------------------- */
.obs-auto-btn {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.obs-auto-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-active);
}

.obs-auto-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
}

/* ---------- Loader spinner ---------------------------------------- */
@keyframes obs-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

/* ---------- Drag helpers ------------------------------------------ */
.obs-no-drag,
[data-no-drag],
input,
textarea,
select {
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

/* ---------- Native dialogs ---------------------------------------- */
dialog {
  background: var(--bg-floating);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* ---------- RTL adjustments --------------------------------------- */
html[dir="rtl"] .obs-toast-host {
  right: auto;
  left: 16px;
}


/* ---------- Status bar (bottom) ------------------------------------ */
.bb-status {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 9000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 26px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  background: #12141c;
  border-top: 1px solid #2a2d3a;
  color: #c7cdd8;
  font: 11px/1 var(--font-ui);
  user-select: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.bb-status__seg {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.bb-status__spacer {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 8px;
}

.bb-status__kbd {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 1.4em;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  margin: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  border: 1px solid #3a3f50;
  background: #1a1d28;
  color: #9aa3b5;
  font: 10px/1.2 var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.bb-status__tip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-right: 10px;
}

.bb-status__tip-label {
  color: #b8c0d0;
}

.bb-status__accent {
  color: #7dd3fc;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Leave room for the status bar above the canvas */
#app {
  padding-bottom: 26px;
}

/* ---------- Ribbon (top) ------------------------------------------- */
.obs-ribbon {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 9500;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a1d27 0%, #151820 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2c3040;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  font: 12px/1.2 var(--font-ui);
  user-select: none;
}

.obs-ribbon__tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px 8px 0;
  min-height: 28px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2d3a;
  background: #12141c;
}

.obs-ribbon__brand {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #f1f5f9;
  margin-right: 10px;
  padding: 0 6px;
}

.obs-ribbon__version {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  margin-right: 12px;
}

.obs-ribbon__tab {
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: #a8b0c0;
  padding: 6px 11px;
  border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
  font: 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.obs-ribbon__tab:hover {
  color: #e2e8f0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}

.obs-ribbon__tab.is-active,
.obs-ribbon__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: #f8fafc;
  background: #1e2230;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #38bdf8;
}

.obs-ribbon__tab--file {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.obs-ribbon__strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px 8px 8px;
  min-height: 64px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  background: #1a1d27;
}

.obs-ribbon-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-right: 1px solid #2a2d3a;
}

.obs-ribbon-group:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}

.obs-ribbon-group__body {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  flex: 1;
}

.obs-ribbon-group__label {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #6b7280;
  text-align: center;
}

.obs-ribbon__pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #12141c;
  border: 1px solid #2a2d3a;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.obs-ribbon__project-status {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.obs-ribbon__project-status.is-saved {
  color: #7bb040;
}

.obs-ribbon__project-status.is-dirty {
  color: #dca642;
}

.obs-ribbon__project-name {
  max-width: 160px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.obs-ribbon__pill-divider {
  width: 1px;
  height: 14px;
  background: #343847;
}

.obs-ribbon__workspace-hint {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.obs-ribbon-hint {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #6b7280;
  padding: 2px 6px;
}

/* Generic ribbon button used by many groups */
.obs-ribbon-group__body button,
.obs-ribbon .obs-btn,
.obs-ribbon button.obs-ribbon-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 52px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #d1d5db;
  font: 10px/1.15 var(--font-ui);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.obs-ribbon-group__body button:hover,
.obs-ribbon button.obs-ribbon-btn:hover {
  background: #232633;
  border-color: #343847;
  color: #f1f5f9;
}

.obs-ribbon-group__body button.is-active,
.obs-ribbon button.obs-ribbon-btn.is-active {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  color: #e0f2fe;
}

.obs-ribbon-group__body button svg,
.obs-ribbon button.obs-ribbon-btn svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  stroke: currentColor;
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 1.6;
}

.obs-ribbon--minimized .obs-ribbon__strip {
  display: none;
}

/* Push app content below ribbon (approx height of tabs + strip) */
#app {
  padding-top: 96px;
}


/* Ribbon command buttons (.obs-rb) */
.obs-rb {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 54px;
  max-width: 72px;
  padding: 5px 6px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #d1d5db;
  font: 10px/1.15 var(--font-ui);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.obs-rb:hover {
  background: #232633;
  border-color: #343847;
  color: #f8fafc;
}
.obs-rb[data-active="1"],
.obs-rb.is-active {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  color: #e0f2fe;
}
.obs-rb[data-planned="1"] {
  opacity: 0.45;
}
.obs-rb svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  stroke: currentColor;
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 1.6;
  flex: none;
}
.obs-rb__label {
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.obs-level-input {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  padding: 0 6px;
}
.obs-level-input input,
.obs-level-input select,
.obs-workspace-select {
  background: #0e1017;
  border: 1px solid #343847;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  font: 11px var(--font-ui);
}

/* Toast */
.obs-toast-host {
  position: fixed;
  right: 16px;
  bottom: 40px;
  z-index: 10000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.obs-toast {
  pointer-events: auto;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #1c1e28;
  border: 1px solid #343847;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  font: 12px/1.35 var(--font-ui);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  max-width: 360px;
}
.obs-toast--out {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .25s ease;
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AppBar, Tabs, Tab, Button } from '@mui/material';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '../storeHooks';
import { undo, redo, pushCommand, select } from '../main';
import { Command } from '../commands/CommandBase';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import { CreateWall } from '../commands/CreateWall';
import { ExportDWGCommand } from '../commands/ExportDWGCommand';
import { ImportGLBCommand } from '../commands/draft/ImportGLBCommand';

import { importRFA } from '../services/rfaImport';
import { roundTripToRevit } from '../services/revitRoundTrip';

export const MainRibbon: React.FC = () => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const api = useAppSelector((s) => s.bim.ifcAPI) as IfcAPI | null;
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState(0);

  const handleChange = (event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    setValue(newValue);
  };

  const glbInputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleGLBFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !api) return;
    const cmd = new ImportGLBCommand(file);
    const createdIds = await executeCommand(cmd);
    if (createdIds && createdIds.length > 0) {
      // dispatch selection action for the first imported element
      dispatch(select(createdIds[0]));
    }
    // reset input
    e.target.value = '';
  };
  const executeCommand = async (cmd: any) => {
    const result = await cmd.execute();
    dispatch(pushCommand(cmd));
    return result;
  };

  // Family Sketch – uses a minimal hard‑coded shape for demo purposes
  const handleFamilySketch = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    // Create a simple square shape and extrude it (placeholder)
    class SketchCommand extends Command {
      name = 'Family Sketch';
      async execute() {
        // Placeholder geometry – real implementation would use @tldraw data
        const placement = await api!.CreateAxis2Placement3D!({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
        const shape = await api!.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation!({
          ContextOfItems: 0,
          RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
          RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
          Items: [], // No geometry – demo only
        });
        const elem = await api!.CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
        return elem.id;
      }
      async undo() { /* no‑op */ }
    };
    const cmd = new SketchCommand();
    await executeCommand(cmd);
  };

  // Adaptive Component – default hostId=0, rule="size * 0.5"
  const handleAdaptiveComponent = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    class AdaptiveCommand extends Command {
      name = 'Adaptive Component';
      private createdId!: number;
      async execute() {
        const size = 1; // placeholder size
        const factor = size * 0.5;
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(factor, factor, factor);
        const placement = await api!.CreateAxis2Placement3D!({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
        const shape = await api!.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation!({
          ContextOfItems: 0,
          RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
          RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
          Items: [{ type: 'IfcFacetedBrep', geometry }],
        });
        const elem = await api!.CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
        this.createdId = elem.id;
        return this.createdId;
      }
      async undo() { await api!.DeleteEntity!(this.createdId); }
    }
    const cmd = new AdaptiveCommand();
    await executeCommand(cmd);
  };

  // Worksharing lock – lock element 1 with a random user id
  const handleWorkshareLock = async () => {
    // Simple console stub – real implementation would use Y‑js
    console.log('Attempting workshare lock on element 1 (demo)');
  };

  // View Template – store a default template
  const handleViewTemplate = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    class ViewTemplateCommand extends Command {
      name = 'View Template';
      async execute() {
        const viewId = 0; // placeholder
        const pset = await api!.CreatePropertySet!('Pset_ViewTemplate', [
          { Name: 'TemplateName', NominalValue: 'Default' },
          { Name: 'Visibility', NominalValue: 'default' },
        ]);
        await api!.AssignPropertySet!({ id: viewId } as any, pset);
      }
      async undo() { /* no‑op placeholder */ }
    }
    const cmd = new ViewTemplateCommand();
    await executeCommand(cmd);
  };

  // Auto‑Dimension – use two hard‑coded points
  const handleAutoDimension = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    class DimCommand extends Command {
      name = 'Auto Dimension';
      private dimId!: number;
      async execute() {
        const p1: [number, number, number] = [0, 0, 0];
        const p2: [number, number, number] = [5000, 0, 0];
        const placement = await api!.CreateAxis2Placement3D!({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
        const shape = await api!.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation!({
          ContextOfItems: 0,
          RepresentationIdentifier: 'Annotation',
          RepresentationType: 'DimensionCurve',
          Items: [{ type: 'IfcPolyline', Points: [p1, p2] }],
        });
        const dim = await api!.CreateIfcDimensionCurve!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
        this.dimId = dim.id;
        return this.dimId;
      }
      async undo() { await api!.DeleteEntity!(this.dimId); }
    }
    const cmd = new DimCommand();
    await executeCommand(cmd);
  };

  // Export Schedule – CSV with placeholder data
  const handleExportSchedule = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    // Simple CSV generation for demo
    const csv = 'ID,Type\n1,Stair\n2,Wall';
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'schedule.csv';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Call‑out – default text
  const handleCallout = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    class CalloutCommand extends Command {
      name = 'Callout';
      private annId!: number;
      async execute() {
        const start: [number, number, number] = [0, 0, 0];
        const end: [number, number, number] = [2000, 2000, 0];
        const placement = await api!.CreateAxis2Placement3D!({ Location: start });
        const shape = await api!.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation!({
          ContextOfItems: 0,
          RepresentationIdentifier: 'Annotation',
          RepresentationType: 'Annotation2D',
          Items: [{ type: 'IfcPolyline', Points: [start, end] }],
        });
        const ann = await api!.CreateIfcAnnotation!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape, AnnotationText: { value: 'Demo Callout' } });
        this.annId = ann.id;
        return this.annId;
      }
      async undo() { await api!.DeleteEntity(this.annId); }
    }
    const cmd = new CalloutCommand();
    await executeCommand(cmd);
  };

  // DWG/DXF Export – already a button, just trigger here
  const handleDWGExport = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    const cmd = new ExportDWGCommand(api!, api!.GetModelID!());
    await executeCommand(cmd);
  };

  // CAD Extras – simple console actions (keep as is)
  const handleHatch = () => console.log('Hatch Fill (placeholder)');
  const handleBlock = () => console.log('Block Insert (placeholder)');
  const handleChamfer = () => console.log('Chamfer (placeholder)');

  // Advanced Renderer – toggle a flag (demo)
  const [useAdvanced, setUseAdvanced] = React.useState(false);
  const handleToggleRenderer = () => setUseAdvanced((prev) => !prev);

  // RFA Import – placeholder using Forge (if credentials present)
  const handleRFAImport = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    await importRFA('path/to/family.rfa', api!);
  };
  // Model link placeholders
  const handleCADLinkedDrawings = async () => console.log('Link CAD Drawing (placeholder)');
  const handleIFCLinked = async () => console.log('Link IFC (placeholder)');
  const handleFragLinkModel = async () => console.log('Link Frag Model (placeholder)');

  // Revit round‑trip – placeholder using Forge
  const handleRevitRoundTrip = async () => {
    if (!api) return;
    await roundTripToRevit(api!);
  };

  return (
    <AppBar position="static" color="default" elevation={0}>
      <Tabs value={value} onChange={handleChange} variant="scrollable" scrollButtons="auto">
        <Tab label="Home" />
        <Tab label="Insert" />
        <Tab label="Advanced" />
      </Tabs>
      {value === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: 8, display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={() => {
            const cmd = new CreateWall();
            executeCommand(cmd);
          }}>Add Wall</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={() => dispatch(undo())}>Undo</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={() => dispatch(redo())}>Redo</Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {value === 1 && (
        <div style={{ padding: 8, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleFamilySketch}>Family Sketch</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleAdaptiveComponent}>Adaptive Component</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleWorkshareLock}>Workshare Lock</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleViewTemplate}>View Template</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleAutoDimension}>Auto‑Dimension</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleExportSchedule}>Export Schedule</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleCallout}>Call‑out</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={() => glbInputRef.current?.click()}>Import GLB</Button>
          <input type="file" accept=".glb,.gltf" style={{ display: 'none' }} ref={glbInputRef} onChange={handleGLBFile} />
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleToggleRenderer}>Toggle Advanced Renderer</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleRFAImport}>Import .rfa Family</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleRevitRoundTrip}>Revit Round‑Trip</Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </AppBar>
  );
};
```

```ts
/// <reference types="vite/client" />

interface ImportMetaEnv {
  readonly MODE: string;
  readonly DEV: boolean;
  readonly PROD: boolean;
  readonly SSR: boolean;
  readonly BASE_URL: string;
  readonly [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ImportMeta {
  readonly env: ImportMetaEnv;
  readonly hot?: {
    accept(cb?: (mod: unknown) => void): void;
    accept(dep: string, cb: (mod: unknown) => void): void;
    dispose(cb: () => void): void;
    decline(): void;
    invalidate(): void;
    on(event: string, cb: (...args: unknown[]) => void): void;
    off(event: string, cb: (...args: unknown[]) => void): void;
    send(event: string, data?: unknown): void;
    data: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
  glob(pattern: string): Record<string, unknown>;
  globEager(pattern: string): Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

--- FILE: src/workers/clash.worker.ts ---
```ts
/// <reference lib="webworker" />
/**
 * Dedicated clash worker.
 * Receives serialized items (boxes + optional triangle arrays), runs pure
 * engine, streams progress + results. Triangle buffers are transferred.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import {
  runClashCore,
  type ClashCoreItem,
  type ClashProgress,
  type ClashMethod,
  type ClashRules,
  type ElementClash,
} from "../modules/clash/clash-core";
import type { Tri } from "../modules/clash/geometry";

type InMessage =
  | {
      type: "run";
      requestId: string;
      items: SerializedItem[];
      groups: number[][];
      rules: ClashRules;
      method: ClashMethod;
      selfPairs: boolean;
    }
  | { type: "cancel"; requestId: string };

type OutMessage =
  | { type: "progress"; requestId: string; progress: ClashProgress }
  | { type: "result"; requestId: string; clashes: SerializedClash[] }
  | { type: "error"; requestId: string; message: string; stack?: string };

interface SerializedItem {
  modelId: string;
  localId: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  box: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  positions?: Float32Array;
}

interface SerializedClash {
  a: ElementClash["a"];
  b: ElementClash["b"];
  kind: ElementClash["kind"];
  method: ElementClash["method"];
  precision: ElementClash["precision"];
  depthVol: number;
  triPairs: number;
  minGap: number;
  boxA: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  boxB: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  point: [number, number, number] | null;
}

const cancelled = new Set<string>();

function deserializeItem(s: SerializedItem): ClashCoreItem {
  const box = new THREE.Box3(
    new THREE.Vector3(s.box[0], s.box[1], s.box[2]),
    new THREE.Vector3(s.box[3], s.box[4], s.box[5]),
  );

  let tris: Tri[] | null = null;
  if (s.positions && s.positions.length >= 9) {
    const count = Math.floor(s.positions.length / 9);
    tris = new Array(count);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const tri = new Float32Array(9);
      tri.set(s.positions.subarray(i * 9, i * 9 + 9));
      tris[i] = tri;
    }
  }

  return {
    modelId: s.modelId,
    localId: s.localId,
    name: s.name,
    category: s.category,
    box,
    tris,
  };
}

function serializeClash(c: ElementClash): SerializedClash {
  return {
    a: c.a,
    b: c.b,
    kind: c.kind,
    method: c.method,
    precision: c.precision,
    depthVol: c.depthVol,
    triPairs: c.triPairs,
    minGap: c.minGap,
    boxA: [c.boxA.min.x, c.boxA.min.y, c.boxA.min.z, c.boxA.max.x, c.boxA.max.y, c.boxA.max.z],
    boxB: [c.boxB.min.x, c.boxB.min.y, c.boxB.min.z, c.boxB.max.x, c.boxB.max.y, c.boxB.max.z],
    point: c.point ? [c.point.x, c.point.y, c.point.z] : null,
  };
}

function post(msg: OutMessage): void {
  (self as DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope).postMessage(msg);
}

self.addEventListener("message", (event: MessageEvent<InMessage>) => {
  const data = event.data;

  if (data.type === "cancel") {
    cancelled.add(data.requestId);
    return;
  }

  if (data.type !== "run") return;

  const { requestId } = data;
  cancelled.delete(requestId);

  void (async () => {
    try {
      const items = data.items.map(deserializeItem);

      const clashes = await runClashCore(items, {
        rules: data.rules,
        method: data.method,
        groups: data.groups,
        selfPairs: data.selfPairs,
        onProgress: (p) => post({ type: "progress", requestId, progress: p }),
        shouldCancel: () => cancelled.has(requestId),
        yield: () => Promise.resolve(),
        yieldEvery: 1024,
      });

      post({
        type: "result",
        requestId,
        clashes: clashes.map(serializeClash),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      post({
        type: "error",
        requestId,
        message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
        stack: err instanceof Error ? err.stack : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      cancelled.delete(requestId);
    }
  })();
});
```
