```js
const assert = require("assert");
const dir = process.env.OUT_DIR || "";
const g = require(dir + "/ifc-guid.js");
const r = require(dir + "/room-detect.js");
let passed = 0;
function t(name, fn) { try { fn(); passed++; console.log("  ok  " + name); } catch (e) { console.log("  FAIL " + name + "\n       " + e.message); process.exitCode = 1; } }
const near = (a, b, tol = 1e-6) => assert.ok(Math.abs(a - b) <= tol, `${a} != ${b}`);

t("guid: zero and max vectors", () => {
  assert.strictEqual(g.compressGuid("0".repeat(32)), "0".repeat(22));
  assert.strictEqual(g.compressGuid("f".repeat(32)), "3" + "$".repeat(21));
});
t("guid: round trip + validity for 2000 random ids", () => {
  for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
    const id = g.newIfcGuid();
    assert.ok(g.isValidIfcGuid(id), id);
    assert.strictEqual(g.compressGuid(g.decompressGuid(id)), id);
  }
});
t("guid: stable ids are deterministic, valid and distinct", () => {
  assert.strictEqual(g.stableIfcGuid("wall-1"), g.stableIfcGuid("wall-1"));
  const s = new Set(); for (let i = 0; i < 5000; i++) { const x = g.stableIfcGuid("el-" + i); assert.ok(g.isValidIfcGuid(x)); s.add(x); }
  assert.strictEqual(s.size, 5000);
});
t("guid: 22 hex chars are rejected", () => { assert.ok(!g.isValidIfcGuid("abcdef0123456789abcdef")); });

const box = (x0, z0, x1, z1, th = 0.2, p = "w") => [
  { id: p + "1", start: [x0, z0], end: [x1, z0], thickness: th },
  { id: p + "2", start: [x1, z0], end: [x1, z1], thickness: th },
  { id: p + "3", start: [x1, z1], end: [x0, z1], thickness: th },
  { id: p + "4", start: [x0, z1], end: [x0, z0], thickness: th },
];

t("room: rectangle uses finish faces (4x3 centre-lines, 0.2 walls -> 3.8 x 2.8)", () => {
  const room = r.detectRoomAt([2, 1.5], box(0, 0, 4, 3));
  assert.ok(room); near(room.area, 3.8 * 2.8); assert.ok(room.exact);
  near(room.perimeter, 2 * (3.8 + 2.8)); assert.strictEqual(room.wallIds.length, 4);
});
t("room: centre-line mode", () => {
  near(r.detectRoomAt([2, 1.5], box(0, 0, 4, 3), { boundary: "center" }).area, 12);
});
t("room: click outside or in open plan -> null", () => {
  assert.strictEqual(r.detectRoomAt([10, 10], box(0, 0, 4, 3)), null);
  const open = box(0, 0, 4, 3).slice(0, 3);
  assert.strictEqual(r.detectRoomAt([2, 1.5], open), null);
});
t("room: partition ending on the wall FACE (T-junction, 8 cm off) splits into two rooms", () => {
  const walls = box(0, 0, 6, 3).concat([{ id: "p", start: [3, 0.08], end: [3, 2.9], thickness: 0.1 }]);
  const all = r.detectAllRooms(walls);
  assert.strictEqual(all.length, 2, "rooms: " + all.length);
  const a = all.map((x) => x.area).sort((m, n) => m - n);
  near(a[0], (3 - 0.1 - 0.05) * 2.8, 0.01); near(a[1], a[0], 0.01);
  assert.ok(r.detectRoomAt([1.5, 1.5], walls).area < 8.5);
});
t("room: overshooting walls (X crossings) still close the room", () => {
  const walls = [
    { id: "a", start: [-0.5, 0], end: [4.5, 0], thickness: 0.2 }, { id: "b", start: [4, -0.5], end: [4, 3.5], thickness: 0.2 },
    { id: "c", start: [4.5, 3], end: [-0.5, 3], thickness: 0.2 }, { id: "d", start: [0, 3.5], end: [0, -0.5], thickness: 0.2 },
  ];
  near(r.detectRoomAt([2, 1.5], walls).area, 3.8 * 2.8);
});
t("room: dangling stub wall inside the room is ignored", () => {
  const walls = box(0, 0, 4, 3).concat([{ id: "stub", start: [2, 0], end: [2, 1], thickness: 0.2 }]);
  near(r.detectRoomAt([3, 1.5], walls).area, 3.8 * 2.8);
});
t("room: walled island becomes a hole (net area)", () => {
  const walls = box(0, 0, 8, 6).concat(box(3, 2, 4, 3, 0.2, "i"));
  const room = r.detectRoomAt([6, 4], walls);
  assert.strictEqual(room.holes.length, 1);
  near(room.area, 7.8 * 5.8 - 1.2 * 1.2, 1e-4);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(r.detectRoomAt([3.5, 2.5], walls).area - 0.8 * 0.8) < 1e-4);
});
t("room: L-shaped room", () => {
  const L = [[0, 0], [6, 0], [6, 2], [2, 2], [2, 5], [0, 5]];
  const walls = L.map((p, i) => ({ id: "l" + i, start: p, end: L[(i + 1) % L.length], thickness: 0.2 }));
  const room = r.detectRoomAt([1, 1], walls);
  assert.ok(room && room.exact);
  // centre-line area 6*2 + 2*3 = 18; each unit of wall removes half thickness on the inside
  near(room.area, 18 - 0.1 * 22 + 0.01 * (5 - 1), 0.02);
  assert.ok(room.labelPoint && require(dir + "/room-detect.js").pointInPolygon(room.labelPoint, room.boundary));
});
t("room: separation line (thickness 0) closes a room", () => {
  const walls = box(0, 0, 6, 3).slice(0, 3).concat([{ id: "sep", start: [0, 3], end: [0, 0], thickness: 0 }]);
  assert.ok(r.detectRoomAt([3, 1.5], walls));
});
console.log(`${passed} passed`);
```

```js
const assert = require("assert");
const dir = process.env.OUT_DIR || "";
const { exportAuthoredToIfc } = require(dir + "/authored-ifc.js");
const { isValidIfcGuid } = require(dir + "/ifc-guid.js");
let passed = 0;
function t(name, fn) { try { fn(); passed++; console.log("  ok  " + name); } catch (e) { console.log("  FAIL " + name + "\n       " + e.message); process.exitCode = 1; } }

/* ---- tiny STEP parser ---- */
function splitArgs(s) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, cur = "", inStr = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s[i];
    if (inStr) { cur += c; if (c === "'") { if (s[i + 1] === "'") { cur += "'"; i++; } else inStr = false; } continue; }
    if (c === "'") { inStr = true; cur += c; continue; }
    if (c === "(") depth++; if (c === ")") depth--;
    if (c === "," && depth === 0) { out.push(cur); cur = ""; } else cur += c;
  }
  out.push(cur); return out;
}
function parse(text) {
  const data = text.split("DATA;\n")[1].split("\nENDSEC;")[0].split("\n").filter(Boolean);
  const ents = new Map();
  for (const line of data) {
    const m = /^#(\d+)=([A-Z0-9_]+)\((.*)\);$/.exec(line);
    assert.ok(m, "bad line: " + line.slice(0, 100));
    assert.ok(!ents.has(+m[1]), "duplicate id " + m[1]);
    ents.set(+m[1], { name: m[2], args: m[3] === "" ? [] : splitArgs(m[3]), raw: m[3] });
  }
  return ents;
}
const COUNTS = {
  IFC4: { IFCWALL: 9, IFCSLAB: 9, IFCCOLUMN: 9, IFCBEAM: 9, IFCMEMBER: 9, IFCFOOTING: 9, IFCCOVERING: 9, IFCDOOR: 13, IFCWINDOW: 13, IFCOPENINGELEMENT: 9,
    IFCDUCTSEGMENT: 9, IFCPIPESEGMENT: 9, IFCCABLECARRIERSEGMENT: 9, IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY: 9, IFCSPACE: 11, IFCBUILDINGSTOREY: 10, IFCBUILDING: 12, IFCSITE: 14, IFCPROJECT: 9,
    IFCOWNERHISTORY: 8, IFCEXTRUDEDAREASOLID: 4, IFCRECTANGLEPROFILEDEF: 5, IFCCIRCLEPROFILEDEF: 4, IFCAXIS2PLACEMENT3D: 3, IFCLOCALPLACEMENT: 2, IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION: 4,
    IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE: 6, IFCRELAGGREGATES: 6, IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT: 6, IFCRELFILLSELEMENT: 6, IFCPROPERTYSET: 5, IFCRELDEFINESBYPROPERTIES: 6, IFCELEMENTQUANTITY: 6, IFCQUANTITYLENGTH: 5, IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET: 5, IFCMATERIAL: 3, IFCSTAIR: 9, IFCRAILING: 9, IFCRAMP: 9, IFCCURTAINWALL: 9 },
  IFC2X3: { IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE: 8, IFCSLAB: 9, IFCCOLUMN: 8, IFCBEAM: 8, IFCMEMBER: 8, IFCFOOTING: 9, IFCCOVERING: 9, IFCDOOR: 10, IFCWINDOW: 10, IFCOPENINGELEMENT: 8,
    IFCFLOWSEGMENT: 8, IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY: 9, IFCSPACE: 11, IFCBUILDINGSTOREY: 10, IFCBUILDING: 12, IFCSITE: 14, IFCPROJECT: 9, IFCOWNERHISTORY: 8, IFCQUANTITYLENGTH: 4, IFCMATERIAL: 1, IFCFACETEDBREP: 1, IFCSTAIR: 9, IFCRAILING: 9, IFCRAMP: 9, IFCCURTAINWALL: 8 },
};
function validate(text, schema) {
  const ents = parse(text);
  assert.ok(text.includes(`FILE_SCHEMA(('${schema}'));`));
  const guids = new Set();
  for (const [id, e] of ents) {
    // refs resolve
    for (const m of e.raw.matchAll(/#(\d+)/g)) assert.ok(ents.has(+m[1]), `#${id} ${e.name} -> missing #${m[1]}`);
    // reals contain a decimal point (REAL attributes of the geometry entities)
    if (e.name === "IFCCARTESIANPOINT" || e.name === "IFCDIRECTION") for (const n of e.args[0].slice(1, -1).split(",")) assert.ok(/\./.test(n), `integer in real list: ${e.raw}`);
    if (e.name === "IFCEXTRUDEDAREASOLID") assert.ok(/\./.test(e.args[3]), "depth must be REAL: " + e.args[3]);
    const want = COUNTS[schema][e.name];
    if (want !== undefined) assert.strictEqual(e.args.length, want, `${schema} ${e.name} #${id} has ${e.args.length} attrs, want ${want}`);
    // rooted entities carry a valid, unique GlobalId
    if (/^IFC(WALL|WALLSTANDARDCASE|SLAB|COLUMN|BEAM|MEMBER|FOOTING|COVERING|DOOR|WINDOW|OPENINGELEMENT|DUCTSEGMENT|PIPESEGMENT|CABLECARRIERSEGMENT|FLOWSEGMENT|BUILDINGELEMENTPROXY|SPACE|BUILDINGSTOREY|BUILDING|SITE|PROJECT|REL[A-Z]+|PROPERTYSET|ELEMENTQUANTITY)$/.test(e.name)) {
      const g = e.args[0].slice(1, -1);
      assert.ok(isValidIfcGuid(g), `${e.name} #${id} bad GlobalId ${g}`);
      assert.ok(!guids.has(g), `duplicate GlobalId ${g} (${e.name})`);
      guids.add(g);
    }
  }
  assert.ok(!/NaN|Infinity|undefined/.test(text));
  return ents;
}

t("door: opening is voided from the host wall and filled by the door; width/height are exact", () => {
  const r = exportAuthoredToIfc([walls[0], model.find((m) => m.id === "d1")], { schema: "IFC4", levels });
  const e = parse(r.text);
  const door = [...e.entries()].find(([, v]) => v.name === "IFCDOOR");

  const voids = [...e.values()].find((v) => v.name === "IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT");
```

```js
const assert = require("assert");
const g = require((process.env.OUT_DIR || "") + "/m2-geometry.js");
let passed = 0;
function t(name, fn) { try { fn(); passed++; console.log("  ok  " + name); } catch (e) { console.log("  FAIL " + name + "\n       " + (e.stack || e.message).split("\n").slice(0, 3).join("\n       ")); process.exitCode = 1; } }
const near = (a, b, tol = 1e-6) => assert.ok(Math.abs(a - b) <= tol, `${a} != ${b} (tol ${tol})`);
const vol = (r) => r.parts.filter((p) => p.role === "solid").reduce((s, p) => s + g.signedVolume(p.positions), 0);
const bbox = (r) => { const b = { min: [1e9, 1e9, 1e9], max: [-1e9, -1e9, -1e9] }; for (const p of r.parts) for (let i = 0; i < p.positions.length; i += 3) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { b.min[k] = Math.min(b.min[k], p.positions[i + k]); b.max[k] = Math.max(b.max[k], p.positions[i + k]); } return b; };
const rot = (pt, a, c = [0, 0]) => { const dx = pt[0] - c[0], dz = pt[1] - c[1]; return [c[0] + dx * Math.cos(a) - dz * Math.sin(a), c[1] + dx * Math.sin(a) + dz * Math.cos(a)]; };

// exact cross-section area of a waist-slab flight (stepped top above the sloped underside, clipped at the floor)
const flightArea = (n, L, rh, waist) => { const td = L / n, u0 = waist * td / rh; return td * rh * n * (n + 1) / 2 - 0.5 * (L - u0) * (n * rh - waist); };
t("earClip: concave L polygon (either orientation) tiles exactly its area", () => {
  const L = [[0, 0], [6, 0], [6, 2], [2, 2], [2, 5], [0, 5]];
  for (const poly of [L, L.slice().reverse()]) {
    const tris = g.earClip(poly); let a = 0;
    for (const [i, j, k] of tris) { const A = poly[i], B = poly[j], C = poly[k]; a += ((B[0] - A[0]) * (C[1] - A[1]) - (B[1] - A[1]) * (C[0] - A[0])) / 2; }
    near(a, 18, 1e-9); assert.strictEqual(tris.length, 4);
  }
});
t("stairs: 3.0 m rise over 5 m -> 18 risers of 166.7 mm, 278 mm treads, closed outward shell", () => {

  assert.strictEqual(r.info.risers, 18); near(r.info.riserHeight, 3 / 18); near(r.info.treadDepth, 5 / 18, 1e-9);
  assert.strictEqual(r.info.compliant, true);
  assert.ok(g.isWatertight(r.parts[0].positions), "not watertight");
  near(vol(r), 1.2 * flightArea(18, 5, 3 / 18, 0.12), 1e-9);
  const b = bbox(r); near(b.min[1], 1, 1e-9); near(b.max[1], 4, 1e-9); near(b.min[0], 0, 1e-9); near(b.max[0], 5, 1e-9);
  near(b.min[2], -0.6, 1e-9); near(b.max[2], 0.6, 1e-9);
});
t("stairs: result does not depend on the run direction (handedness of the extrusion)", () => {
  const base = vol(g.buildStair({ start: [0, 0], end: [5, 0], width: 1.2, totalRise: 3, elevation: 0 }));
  for (const a of [0.4, 1.9, 3.3, -2.2]) {

    near(vol(r), base, 1e-6); assert.ok(g.isWatertight(r.parts[0].positions));
  }
});
t("stairs: too steep / too short runs are reported, non-compliant treads flagged", () => {
  assert.throws(() => g.buildStair({ start: [0, 0], end: [0.1, 0], width: 1, totalRise: 3, elevation: 0 }));

});
for (const shape of ["L", "U"]) for (const turn of ["left", "right"]) {
  t(`stairs: ${shape}-shape turning ${turn}: two flights, landing at half rise, top at exactly the total rise`, () => {
    const r = g.buildStair({ start: [0, 0], end: [3, 0], width: 1.1, totalRise: 3.2, elevation: 0, shape, turn });
    assert.strictEqual(r.info.flights, 2); assert.strictEqual(r.info.risers, 19);
    near(r.info.landingHeight, Math.floor(19 / 2) * (3.2 / 19), 1e-9);
    const b = bbox(r); near(b.max[1], 3.2, 1e-9); assert.ok(b.min[1] >= -1e-9);
    const rh = 3.2 / 19, n1 = 9, n2 = 10, w = 1.1, lt = 0.15;
    const landing = shape === "L" ? w * w * lt : w * (2 * w + 0.1) * lt;
    near(vol(r), w * flightArea(n1, 3, rh, 0.12) + w * flightArea(n2, 3, rh, 0.12) + landing, 1e-9);

}
```

```js
const near = (a, b, tol = 1e-9) => assert.ok(Math.abs(a - b) <= tol, `${a} != ${b}`);

global.localStorage = { getItem: (k) => (store.has(k) ? store.get(k) : null), setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: (k) => store.delete(k) };
global.CustomEvent = class { constructor(t, o) { this.type = t; this.detail = o && o.detail; } };
const toasts = [];
global.window = { dispatchEvent(e) { if (e.detail && e.detail.message) toasts.push(e.detail); }, addEventListener() {} };
global.document = {};
const Module = require("module");
const origLoad = Module._load;
class Obj { constructor() { this.children = []; this.userData = {}; } add(...o) { this.children.push(...o); return this; } }
const fakeThree = {
  Group: class extends Obj {}, Mesh: class extends Obj { constructor(g, m) { super(); this.geometry = g; this.material = m; } },
  BufferGeometry: class { setAttribute(n, a) { this[n] = a; } computeVertexNormals() {} dispose() {} },
  Float32BufferAttribute: class { constructor(a, s) { this.array = a; this.itemSize = s; } },
  MeshLambertMaterial: class { constructor(o) { Object.assign(this, o); } dispose() {} }, Color: class { constructor(c) { this.c = c; } },
  DoubleSide: 2,
};
Module._load = function (request, ...rest) { return request === "three" ? fakeThree : origLoad.call(this, request, ...rest); };

const undo = [];
require.cache[require.resolve(path.join(root, "features/history.js"))] = { id: "h", filename: "h", loaded: true, exports: { history: { async exec(cmd) { await cmd.apply(); undo.push(cmd); } } } };

ctx.features = { authoring: api };

(async () => {
  await t("snapPoint: snaps to existing end points, else the 5 cm grid, Shift = orthogonal", () => {

    assert.strictEqual(tools.defaultsFor("roof", [[0, 0], [10, 0], [10, 6], [0, 6]], lv, "straight").properties.slopeDirection, 90); // ridge along the long side
    assert.strictEqual(tools.defaultsFor("roof", [[0, 0], [4, 0], [4, 9], [0, 9]], lv, "straight").properties.slopeDirection, 0);
    near(tools.defaultsFor("stairs", [[0, 0], [5, 0]], { id: null, elevation: 0, above: null }, "straight").params.height, 3);
  });

    assert.strictEqual(el.name, "Stair 1"); assert.deepStrictEqual(selected, [el.id]); assert.ok(rebuilds > before);
    near(el.params.height, 3.4); assert.strictEqual(el.properties.stairShape, "L");
    assert.strictEqual(undo.length, 1); undo[0].revert();
    assert.ok(!elements.includes(el));
    undo[0].apply(); assert.ok(elements.includes(el));

  });

    roomsStore.boot();
    const r1 = roomsStore.createRoom({ boundary: [{ x: 0, z: 0 }, { x: 4, z: 0 }, { x: 4, z: 3 }, { x: 0, z: 3 }], levelId: "L0" });
    const r2 = roomsStore.createRoom({ boundary: [{ x: 6, z: 0 }, { x: 10, z: 0 }, { x: 10, z: 3 }, { x: 6, z: 3 }], levelId: "L0" });
    roomsStore.createRoom({ boundary: [{ x: 0, z: 10 }, { x: 4, z: 10 }, { x: 4, z: 13 }, { x: 0, z: 13 }], levelId: "L1" }); // other level
    assert.strictEqual(tools.ceilingsFromRooms(), 2);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));

    assert.strictEqual(tools.ceilingsFromRooms(), 0);
    assert.ok(r2.id !== r1.id);
  });
  await t("register: palette schemas for the six types, mesh builders and the quantity provider", () => {
    const out = reg.setupM2Register();
    assert.ok(out.ok);
    for (const k of ["stairs", "railing", "ramp", "curtain-wall", "roof", "ceiling"]) {
      assert.ok(SCHEMAS[k] && SCHEMAS[k].fields.length >= 5, k + " schema");

      assert.ok(new Set(keys).size === keys.length, "duplicate field keys in " + k);
    }

    const q = window.__obsM2Quantities({ type: "curtain-wall", params: { height: 3.6, thickness: 0.1, elevation: 0, start: [0, 0], end: [6, 0] } });

    assert.strictEqual(window.__obsM2Quantities({ type: "wall", params: {} }), null);

  await t("mesh builder: one mesh per part (frame + glazing), tagged with the element id, glass transparent; bad params give null instead of throwing", () => {

    assert.strictEqual(g.children[1].material.transparent, true); assert.strictEqual(g.children[0].material.transparent, false);
    assert.strictEqual(reg.buildM2Mesh({ id: "bad", type: "stairs", params: { height: 3, thickness: 0.1, elevation: 0, start: [0, 0], end: [0.05, 0] } }), null);
```

```js
const assert = require("assert");
const dir = process.env.OUT_DIR || "";
const X = require(dir + "/m3-plan.js");
let passed = 0;
function t(name, fn) { try { fn(); passed++; console.log("  ok  " + name); } catch (e) { console.log("  FAIL " + name + "\n       " + (e.stack || e.message).split("\n").slice(0, 3).join("\n       ")); process.exitCode = 1; } }
const near = (a, b, tol = 1e-6) => assert.ok(Math.abs(a - b) <= tol, `${a} != ${b} (tol ${tol})`);
const area = (pts) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length]; s += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; } return Math.abs(s / 2); };
const wall = (id, s, e, o = {}) => ({ id, type: "wall", params: { start: s, end: e, height: 3, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0, ...o } });
const door = (id, host, o = {}) => ({ id, type: "door", hostId: host, params: { width: 0.9, height: 2.1, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0, offsetAlongHost: 3, sillHeight: 0, ...o } });
const win = (id, host, o = {}) => ({ id, type: "window", hostId: host, params: { width: 1.2, height: 1.4, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0, offsetAlongHost: 5, sillHeight: 0.9, ...o } });
const base = { cutElevation: 1.2, bandLow: -0.5, bandHigh: 2.4, scale: 100, kind: "plan", rooms: [] };
const run = (elements, extra = {}) => X.planExtras({ ...base, elements, ...extra });
const polys = (es) => es.filter((e) => e.kind === "polyline");
const lines = (es) => es.filter((e) => e.kind === "line");
const texts = (es) => es.filter((e) => e.kind === "text").map((e) => e.text);

t("poche: walls are broken at the openings the cut plane passes through", () => {
  const r = run([wall("w", [0, 0], [8, 0]), door("d", "w"), win("x", "w")]);
  const total = polys(r.under).reduce((s, p) => s + area(p.points), 0);
  near(total, (8 - 0.9 - 1.2) * 0.2, 1e-9);                      // door (0..2.1) and window (0.9..2.3) both span 1.2 m
  assert.strictEqual(polys(r.under).length, 3);
  const high = run([wall("w", [0, 0], [8, 0]), win("x", "w", { sillHeight: 1.5 })]);   // window sill above the cut: wall stays solid
  near(polys(high.under).reduce((s, p) => s + area(p.points), 0), 8 * 0.2, 1e-9);
  assert.strictEqual(r.stats.pocheWalls, 1);
});
t("poche: only elements the cut plane passes through; columns too; option switches it off", () => {
  const els = [wall("hi", [0, 0], [4, 0], { elevation: 3 }), wall("lo", [0, 5], [4, 5], { height: 1.0 }), { id: "c", type: "column", params: { point: [1, 1], height: 3, thickness: 0.3, depth: 0.4, elevation: 0 } }];
  const r = run(els);
  assert.strictEqual(polys(r.under).length, 1); near(area(polys(r.under)[0].points), 0.12, 1e-9);
  assert.strictEqual(run(els, { options: { poche: false } }).under.length, 0);
});
t("stairs: riser lines up to the cut are solid, those above are dashed, arrow + UP, base geometry suppressed", () => {
  const st = { id: "st", type: "stairs", params: { height: 3, thickness: 0.15, elevation: 0, start: [0, 0], end: [5, 0], width: 1.2 } };
  const r = run([st]);
  assert.ok(r.suppressIds.has("st"));
  const rh = 3 / 18;
  const cutLines = lines(r.cut).length, overLines = lines(r.overhead).length;
  const below = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => (i + 1) * rh).filter((h) => h <= 1.2).length;   // risers 1..17
  assert.strictEqual(cutLines, below); assert.strictEqual(overLines, 17 - below);
  assert.strictEqual(polys(r.cut).length, 1);                                                            // flight outline
  assert.ok(texts(r.symbols).includes("UP")); assert.strictEqual(lines(r.symbols).length, 3);          // arrow = shaft + 2 head strokes
  assert.strictEqual(r.stats.stairs, 1);
});
t("stairs L and U: two flights + landing outlines, arrows on both", () => {
  for (const shape of ["L", "U"]) {
    const st = { id: "s" + shape, type: "stairs", params: { height: 3.2, thickness: 0.15, elevation: 0, start: [0, 0], end: [3, 0], width: 1.1 }, properties: { stairShape: shape } };
    const r = run([st]);
    assert.strictEqual(polys(r.cut).length + polys(r.overhead).length, 3, shape);
    assert.strictEqual(lines(r.symbols).length, 6, shape);
  }
});
t("stairs entirely above the cut are drawn dashed; stairs outside the view range are skipped", () => {
  const above = run([{ id: "s", type: "stairs", params: { height: 3, thickness: 0.15, elevation: 1.5, start: [0, 0], end: [5, 0], width: 1.2 } }]);
  assert.strictEqual(polys(above.cut).length, 0); assert.strictEqual(polys(above.overhead).length, 1);
  const far = run([{ id: "s", type: "stairs", params: { height: 3, thickness: 0.15, elevation: 9, start: [0, 0], end: [5, 0], width: 1.2 } }]);
  assert.strictEqual(far.stats.stairs, 0); assert.strictEqual(far.suppressIds.size, 0);
});
t("railing: a double line per segment (never a closed loop), ramp: outline, arrow and slope", () => {
  const rl = { id: "r", type: "railing", params: { height: 1, thickness: 0.05, elevation: 0, polygon: [[0, 0], [4, 0], [4, 3]] } };
  const r = run([rl]);
  assert.strictEqual(lines(r.cut).length, 4); assert.strictEqual(polys(r.cut).length, 0); assert.ok(r.suppressIds.has("r"));
  const rp = run([{ id: "p", type: "ramp", params: { height: 0.5, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0, start: [0, 0], end: [6, 0], width: 1.5 } }]);
  assert.strictEqual(polys(rp.cut).length, 1); assert.ok(texts(rp.symbols).includes("1:12.0"));
  const high = run([{ ...rl, id: "rh", params: { ...rl.params, elevation: 3 } }], { bandHigh: 4 });
  assert.strictEqual(lines(high.overhead).length, 4); assert.strictEqual(lines(high.cut).length, 0);        // above the cut plane: dashed
  const spanning = run([{ ...rl, id: "rs", params: { ...rl.params, height: 1.5 } }]);
  assert.strictEqual(lines(spanning.cut).length, 4);
});
t("curtain wall: two face lines, one tick per mullion, glazing line", () => {
  const cw = { id: "c", type: "curtain-wall", params: { height: 3.6, thickness: 0.1, elevation: 0, start: [0, 0], end: [6, 0] }, properties: { uSpacing: 1.5 } };
  const r = run([cw]);
  assert.strictEqual(lines(r.cut).length, 2 + 5 + 1);
});
t("roof: dashed outline, ridge for gable only, slope label; ceilings only on reflected ceiling plans", () => {
  const roof = (type) => ({ id: "rf", type: "roof", params: { height: 0.2, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 3.0, polygon: [[0, 0], [10, 0], [10, 6], [0, 6]] }, properties: { roofType: type, slope: 25, slopeDirection: 90 } });
  const g = run([roof("gable")], { bandHigh: 4 }), s = run([roof("shed")], { bandHigh: 4 });
  assert.strictEqual(polys(g.overhead).length, 1); assert.strictEqual(lines(g.overhead).length, 1); assert.strictEqual(lines(s.overhead).length, 0);
  assert.ok(texts(g.symbols).includes("25\u00B0"));
  // the ridge of a gable with slope direction 90 deg (rising along z) runs along x at mid-depth z = 3
  const ridge = lines(g.overhead)[0]; near(ridge.z1, 3, 1e-9); near(ridge.z2, 3, 1e-9);
  const clg = { id: "cl", type: "ceiling", params: { height: 0.02, thickness: 0.02, elevation: 2.7, polygon: [[0, 0], [4, 0], [4, 3], [0, 3]] } };
  assert.strictEqual(run([clg], { bandHigh: 4 }).cut.length, 0);
  const rcp = run([clg], { bandHigh: 4, kind: "rcp" });
  assert.strictEqual(polys(rcp.cut).length, 1); assert.ok(texts(rcp.symbols).includes("CLG 2.70"));
  assert.strictEqual(polys(run([roof("gable")], { bandHigh: 4, kind: "rcp" }).overhead).length, 0);
});
t("marks: doors D1.., windows W1.., properties.mark wins; tags sit beside the opening on the wall normal", () => {
  const els = [wall("w", [0, 0], [8, 0]), door("d1", "w"), win("x1", "w"), door("d2", "w", { offsetAlongHost: 6.5, properties: undefined })];
  els[3].properties = { mark: "EX-1" };
  const m = X.autoMarks(els);
  assert.strictEqual(m.get("d1"), "D1"); assert.strictEqual(m.get("x1"), "W1"); assert.strictEqual(m.get("d2"), "EX-1");
  const r = run(els);
  assert.strictEqual(r.stats.doorTags, 3);
  const circles = r.symbols.filter((e) => e.kind === "circle");
  assert.strictEqual(circles.length, 3);
  near(circles[0].cx, 3, 1e-9); near(circles[0].cz, 0.1 + 0.0045 * 100, 1e-9);      // 4.5 mm on paper at 1:100 = 0.45 m beyond the wall face
  assert.deepStrictEqual(texts(r.symbols).sort(), ["D1", "EX-1", "W1"]);
  assert.strictEqual(run(els, { options: { doorTags: false } }).stats.doorTags, 0);
});
t("rooms: number, name and area stacked at the label point; boundaries optional; tags can be switched off", () => {
  const room = { id: "r1", name: "Office", number: "101", area: 21.456, levelId: null, boundary: [{ x: 0, z: 0 }, { x: 6, z: 0 }, { x: 6, z: 4 }, { x: 0, z: 4 }], labelPoint: [3, 2] };
  const r = run([], { rooms: [room] });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(texts(r.symbols), ["101", "Office", "21.5 m\u00B2"]);
  const tx = r.symbols.filter((e) => e.kind === "text");
  assert.ok(tx[0].z > tx[1].z && tx[1].z > tx[2].z); near(tx[1].z, 2, 1e-9); near(tx[0].z - tx[1].z, 0.0034 * 100, 1e-9);
  assert.strictEqual(r.stats.roomsTagged, 1); assert.strictEqual(polys(r.symbols).length, 0);
  assert.strictEqual(polys(run([], { rooms: [room], options: { roomBoundaries: true } }).symbols).length, 1);
  assert.strictEqual(run([], { rooms: [room], options: { roomTags: false } }).symbols.length, 0);
  const noLp = run([], { rooms: [{ ...room, labelPoint: undefined }] }).symbols.filter((e) => e.kind === "text")[1];
  near(noLp.x, 3, 1e-9); near(noLp.z, 2, 1e-9);
});
console.log(`${passed} passed`);
```

```js
const assert = require("assert");
const path = require("path");
const dir = process.env.OUT_DIR || "";
const root = path.join(dir, "..", "..");
let passed = 0;
async function t(name, fn) { try { await fn(); passed++; console.log("  ok  " + name); } catch (e) { console.log("  FAIL " + name + "\n       " + (e.stack || e.message).split("\n").slice(0, 3).join("\n       ")); process.exitCode = 1; } }
const near = (a, b, tol = 1e-6) => assert.ok(Math.abs(a - b) <= tol, `${a} != ${b}`);

const store = new Map();
global.localStorage = { getItem: (k) => (store.has(k) ? store.get(k) : null), setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: (k) => store.delete(k) };
global.CustomEvent = class { constructor(tp, o) { this.type = tp; this.detail = o && o.detail; } };
const toasts = []; global.window = { dispatchEvent(e) { if (e.detail && e.detail.message) toasts.push(e.detail.message); } }; global.document = {};
/* fake pdf-lib operator API */
const Module = require("module"); const origLoad = Module._load;
let pdfApi = { pushGraphicsState: () => ["q"], popGraphicsState: () => ["Q"], setFillingRgbColor: (r, g, b) => ["rg", r, g, b], moveTo: (x, y) => ["m", x, y], lineTo: (x, y) => ["l", x, y], closePath: () => ["h"], fill: () => ["f"] };
Module._load = function (request, ...rest) { return request === "pdf-lib" ? pdfApi : origLoad.call(this, request, ...rest); };

const { ctx } = require(path.join(root, "core/context.js"));
const { roomsStore } = require(path.join(root, "modules/rooms/rooms.js"));
const reg = require(path.join(dir, "m3-register.js"));
const fill = require(path.join(dir, "m3-pdf-fill.js"));

const wall = (id, s, e, o = {}) => ({ id, type: "wall", params: { start: s, end: e, height: 3, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0, ...o } });
const elements = [wall("w1", [0, 0], [8, 0]), wall("w2", [8, 0], [8, 6]), wall("w3", [8, 6], [0, 6]), wall("w4", [0, 6], [0, 0]),
  { id: "d1", type: "door", hostId: "w1", params: { width: 0.9, height: 2.1, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0, offsetAlongHost: 3, sillHeight: 0 } },
  { id: "st", type: "stairs", params: { height: 3, thickness: 0.15, elevation: 0, start: [1, 1], end: [5, 1], width: 1.2 } }];
ctx.features = { authoring: { getElements: () => elements, getLevels: () => [{ id: "L0", name: "Ground", elevation: 0 }, { id: "L1", name: "First", elevation: 3.4 }] } };

const planDef = (elev = 0) => ({ id: "p", kind: "plan", name: "Plan", scale: 100, plan: { levelId: "x", levelElevation: elev, cutHeight: 1.2, topHeight: 2.4, bottomDepth: 1.2, viewDepth: 4 } });
const emptyScene = () => ({ bounds: { minX: 0, minZ: 0, maxX: 8, maxZ: 6 }, layers: { cut: [{ kind: "line", x1: 0, z1: 0, x2: 1, z2: 0 }], project: [], overhead: [], below: [], grid: [], annotation: [], symbols: [] }, generatedAt: 0 });

(async () => {
  await t("setup installs the generator hooks, PDF fill hook and options API", () => {
    assert.ok(reg.setupM3().ok);
    for (const k of ["planFilter", "plan", "section", "elevation"]) assert.strictEqual(typeof window.__obsViewExt[k], "function");
    assert.strictEqual(window.__obsM3FillPolygon, fill.fillPolygonPdf);
  });
  await t("plan: stairs lose their base-generator geometry, poche goes under the outlines, tags and symbols are added", () => {
    roomsStore.boot();
    roomsStore.createRoom({ boundary: [{ x: 0.1, z: 0.1 }, { x: 7.9, z: 0.1 }, { x: 7.9, z: 5.9 }, { x: 0.1, z: 5.9 }], levelId: "L0" });
    roomsStore.createRoom({ boundary: [{ x: 0.1, z: 0.1 }, { x: 7.9, z: 0.1 }, { x: 7.9, z: 5.9 }, { x: 0.1, z: 5.9 }], levelId: "L1" });
    const def = planDef(0);
    const pv = { segments: [{ x1: 0, z1: 0, x2: 1, z2: 0, kind: "cut", source: "w1" }, { x1: 1, z1: 1, x2: 5, z2: 1, kind: "cut", source: "st" }, { x1: 0, z1: 0, x2: 0, z2: 1, kind: "grid" }], arcs: [] };
    window.__obsViewExt.planFilter(pv, def);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(pv.segments.map((s) => s.source), ["w1", undefined]);
    const scene = emptyScene();
    window.__obsViewExt.plan(def, scene);
    assert.ok(scene.layers.cut[0].fill, "poche polygons first");
    assert.ok(scene.layers.cut.some((e) => e.kind === "line" && e.x1 === 0 && e.z2 === 0 && !e.fill), "base outline kept");
    assert.ok(scene.layers.symbols.some((e) => e.kind === "text" && e.text === "UP"));
    const txt = scene.layers.symbols.filter((e) => e.kind === "text").map((e) => e.text);
    assert.ok(txt.includes("D1")); assert.strictEqual(txt.filter((x) => /m\u00B2/.test(x)).length, 1, "only the room of this level is tagged");
    assert.strictEqual(def.__m3, undefined);
  });
  await t("plan at the next level tags that level's rooms (matched by elevation, not by id)", () => {
    const def = planDef(3.4); const pv = { segments: [], arcs: [] };
    window.__obsViewExt.planFilter(pv, def); const scene = emptyScene(); window.__obsViewExt.plan(def, scene);
    assert.strictEqual(scene.layers.symbols.filter((e) => e.kind === "text" && /m\u00B2/.test(e.text)).length, 1);
    assert.ok(!scene.layers.cut.some((e) => e.fill), "walls end at 3.0 m, so nothing is cut at 3.4 + 1.2");
  });
  await t("plan options persist and switch content off", () => {
    reg.setPlanOption("roomTags", false); reg.setPlanOption("poche", false);
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Compiles the revit-gaps modules with the project's own TypeScript and runs
 * the Node tests. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux:
 *
 *   node tests/run-tests.mjs
 */
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdtempSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const out = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "obs-revit-gaps-"));
const tsc = spawnSync(
  "npx",
  ["tsc", "--ignoreConfig", "--rootDir", "src", "--outDir", out, "--module", "nodenext", "--moduleResolution", "nodenext",
    "--target", "ES2022", "--skipLibCheck", "--noCheck",
    "src/modules/revit-gaps/ifc-guid.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/room-detect.ts",
    "src/modules/revit-gaps/authored-ifc.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/visibility-bridge.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m2-geometry.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m2-register.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m2-tools.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m3-solids.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m3-project.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m3-plan.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m3-register.ts", "src/modules/revit-gaps/m3-pdf-fill.ts", "src/modules/views/store.ts"],
  { cwd: root, stdio: "inherit", shell: true },
);
if (tsc.status !== 0) { console.error("tsc failed"); process.exit(1); }

let failed = false;
for (const f of readdirSync(path.join(root, "tests")).filter((n) => n.endsWith(".test.cjs"))) {
  console.log("== tests/" + f);
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(root, "tests", f)], {
    stdio: "inherit",
    env: { ...process.env, OUT_DIR: path.join(out, "modules", "revit-gaps") },
  });
  if (r.status !== 0) failed = true;
}
console.log(failed ? "\nSOME TESTS FAILED" : "\nALL TESTS PASSED");
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
```

```js
const assert = require("assert");
const dir = process.env.OUT_DIR || "";            // .../modules/revit-gaps
const root = dir + "/../..";                       // compiled src root
let passed = 0;
async function t(name, fn) { try { await fn(); passed++; console.log("  ok  " + name); } catch (e) { console.log("  FAIL " + name + "\n       " + (e.stack || e.message).split("\n").slice(0, 3).join("\n       ")); process.exitCode = 1; } }

/* ---- browser-ish globals ---- */
const store = new Map();
global.localStorage = { getItem: (k) => (store.has(k) ? store.get(k) : null), setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: (k) => store.delete(k) };
global.CustomEvent = class { constructor(t, o) { this.type = t; this.detail = o && o.detail; } };
global.window = { dispatchEvent() {}, addEventListener() {}, setTimeout, clearTimeout, prompt: () => null };
global.document = {};
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));

const { ctx } = require(root + "/core/context.js");
const { visibilityFilter } = require(root + "/modules/visibility/visibility-filter.js");
const { designOptionsStore } = require(root + "/modules/design-options/design-options.js");
const vb = require(dir + "/visibility-bridge.js");

/* ---- fake authored scene ---- */
const mesh = (id) => ({ isMesh: true, userData: { elementId: id }, visible: true, material: { opacity: 1, transparent: false, userData: {} } });
const group = { children: [], add(...o) { this.children.push(...o); return this; }, traverse(fn) { this.children.forEach(fn); } };
let elements = [
  { id: "w1", type: "wall", params: {} }, { id: "w2", type: "wall", params: {} }, { id: "s1", type: "slab", params: {} },
];
elements.forEach((e) => group.children.push(mesh(e.id)));
let selected = [];
let authoringListener = null;
ctx.features = {
  authoring: {
    getAuthoredGroup: () => group, getElements: () => elements, getSelectedIds: () => selected,
    getElementById: (id) => elements.find((e) => e.id === id), onAuthoringChange: (cb) => { authoringListener = cb; return () => {}; },
  },
  selection: { snapshot: () => ({ modelA: new Set([5, 6]) }) },
};
/* ---- fake Fragments + Hider ---- */
const calls = [];
ctx.hider = {
  async set(v, map) { calls.push(["set", v, map ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(map).map(([k, s]) => [k, [...s]])))) : null]); },
  async isolate(map) { calls.push(["isolate", Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(map).map(([k, s]) => [k, [...s]]))]); },
};
ctx.fragments = {
  core: { update() { calls.push(["update"]); } },
  list: new Map([["modelA", { async getItemsOfCategories(pats) { calls.push(["cats", pats.map(String)]); return { IFCWALL: [10, 11], IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE: [12] }; } }]]),
};
const vis = () => Object.fromEntries(group.children.map((m) => [m.userData.elementId, m.visible]));

(async () => {
  await t("setup installs getSelectedIds on the selection manager (it did not exist)", async () => {
    assert.strictEqual(ctx.features.selection.getSelectedIds, undefined);
    assert.ok(vb.setupVisibilityBridge().ok);
    selected = ["w1"];
    assert.deepStrictEqual(ctx.features.selection.getSelectedIds(), ["w1", "frag:modelA::5", "frag:modelA::6"]);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vb.parseFragKey("frag:modelA::5"), { modelId: "modelA", localId: 5 });
    selected = [];
  });
  await t("hideElements now hides the authored mesh (before: nothing listened)", async () => {
    visibilityFilter.hideElements(["w1"]); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: false, w2: true, s1: true });
    visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: true, w2: true, s1: true });
  });
  await t("isolate: only the isolated authored element stays; linked models are hidden", async () => {
    calls.length = 0;
    visibilityFilter.isolateElements(["w2"]); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: false, w2: true, s1: false });
    assert.deepStrictEqual(calls.find((c) => c[0] === "set"), ["set", false, null]);
    visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: true, w2: true, s1: true });
    assert.deepStrictEqual(calls.filter((c) => c[0] === "set").pop(), ["set", true, null]);
  });
  await t("isolate with a fragment item uses Hider.isolate with a model-id map", async () => {
    calls.length = 0;
    visibilityFilter.isolateElements(["frag:modelA::5", "frag:modelA::6"]); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(calls.find((c) => c[0] === "isolate"), ["isolate", { modelA: [5, 6] }]);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: false, w2: false, s1: false });
    visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); await tick();
  });
  await t("hide a fragment item: reset then hide exactly that item", async () => {
    calls.length = 0;
    visibilityFilter.hideElements(["frag:modelA::7"]); await tick();
    const sets = calls.filter((c) => c[0] === "set");
    assert.deepStrictEqual(sets, [["set", true, null], ["set", false, { modelA: [7] }]]);
    visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); await tick();
  });
  await t("nothing active -> the bridge does not touch the Hider (leaves the context menu's own hide alone)", async () => {
    calls.length = 0;
    visibilityFilter.hideElements(["w1"]); await tick();
    // authored-only hide still resets fragments only if we had touched them: after the previous reset we hadn't
    assert.ok(!calls.some((c) => c[0] === "set"), JSON.stringify(calls));
    visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); await tick();
  });
  await t("category override hides authored walls and the matching IFC categories of linked models", async () => {
    calls.length = 0;
    visibilityFilter.setCategoryOverride("wall", { visible: false }); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: false, w2: false, s1: true });
    assert.ok(calls.some((c) => c[0] === "cats"));
    const hide = calls.filter((c) => c[0] === "set" && c[1] === false).pop();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(hide[2], { modelA: [10, 11, 12] });
    visibilityFilter.clearCategoryOverrides(); await tick();
    assert.deepStrictEqual(vis(), { w1: true, w2: true, s1: true });
  });
  await t("halftone category override lowers opacity and restores it", async () => {
    visibilityFilter.setCategoryOverride("slab", { halftone: true }); await tick();
    const m = group.children.find((x) => x.userData.elementId === "s1").material;
    assert.ok(m.transparent && m.opacity <= 0.4, `opacity ${m.opacity}`);
    visibilityFilter.clearCategoryOverrides(); await tick();
    assert.ok(!m.transparent && m.opacity === 1);
  });
  await t("design options: element tagged with an inactive option is hidden, active option shows it", async () => {
    designOptionsStore.boot();
    const set = designOptionsStore.createSet("Entrance");
    const a = designOptionsStore.addOption(set.id, "A"); const b = designOptionsStore.addOption(set.id, "B");
    designOptionsStore.setActive(set.id, a.id);
    elements[2].properties = { designOptionId: b.id };
    vb.applyAuthored(true); await tick();
    assert.strictEqual(vis().s1, false); assert.strictEqual(vis().w1, true);
    designOptionsStore.setActive(set.id, b.id); await tick();
    assert.strictEqual(vis().s1, true);
  });
  await t("tagSelection writes phase / option tags on the selected element", async () => {
    selected = ["w1"];
    // projects module is not loaded in this harness; tagSelection must still tag and re-apply
    const n = await vb.tagSelection({ phaseCreated: "ph-1", designOptionId: null });
    assert.strictEqual(n, 1);
    assert.strictEqual(elements[0].properties.phaseCreated, "ph-1");
    selected = [];
  });
  await t("meshes added by a rebuild are styled after the microtask (group.add hook)", async () => {
    visibilityFilter.hideElements(["w2"]); await tick();
    group.children.length = 0;                       // rebuild: drop everything...
    elements.forEach((e) => group.add(mesh(e.id))); // ...and re-add fresh (visible) meshes
    await tick();
    assert.strictEqual(vis().w2, false); assert.strictEqual(vis().s1, true);
    visibilityFilter.resetTemporary(); await tick();
  });
  console.log(`${passed} passed`);
})();
```

--- FILE: vite.config.ts ---
```ts
import { defineConfig } from "vite";

import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
/**
 * Vite config for Open BIM Studio.
 *
 * Proxies exist because some AI providers do not send permissive CORS
 * headers for browser requests:
 *   /ollama     → http://localhost:11434   (Ollama)
 *   /lmstudio   → http://localhost:1234    (LM Studio; CORS off by default)
 *   /anthropic  → https://api.anthropic.com (Anthropic; no CORS headers)
 *
 * Providers that DO send CORS headers (OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, DeepSeek,
 * Mistral, Together, OpenRouter, Fireworks, Perplexity, xAI) are called
 * directly — no proxy needed.
 */
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), crossOriginIsolation()],
  define: {
    __WEB_IFC_SCRIPT_URL__: JSON.stringify('/web-ifc/web-ifc-api.js'),
  },
  esbuild: { target: "esnext" },
  build: { target: "esnext" },
  resolve: { dedupe: ["lit", "lit-html", "lit-element", "@lit/reactive-element"] },
  worker: {
    format: "es",
  },
  server: {
    port: 3000,
    proxy: {
      "/ollama": {
        target: "http://localhost:11434",
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/ollama/, ""),
      },
      "/lmstudio": {
        target: "http://localhost:1234",
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/lmstudio/, ""),
      },
      "/anthropic": {
        target: "https://api.anthropic.com",
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: true,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/anthropic/, ""),
      },
    },
  },
  preview: {
    port: 3000,
    proxy: {
      "/ollama": {
        target: "http://localhost:11434",
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/ollama/, ""),
      },
      "/lmstudio": {
        target: "http://localhost:1234",
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/lmstudio/, ""),
      },
      "/anthropic": {
        target: "https://api.anthropic.com",
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: true,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/anthropic/, ""),
      },
    },
  },
});
// --- OpenBIMStudio :: COOP/COEP for SharedArrayBuffer (web-ifc-mt) ---
function crossOriginIsolation() {
  return {
    name: "cross-origin-isolation",
    configureServer(server) {
      server.middlewares.use((_req, res, next) => {
        res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", "same-origin");
        res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy", "require-corp");
        res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "cross-origin");
        next();
      });
    },
    configurePreviewServer(server) {
      server.middlewares.use((_req, res, next) => {
        res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", "same-origin");
        res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy", "require-corp");
        res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "cross-origin");
        next();
      });
    },
  };
}
```
